claims.claim_title: Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.
claims.falsifier_summary: dan_feedback off performs equivalently (the EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert pattern regardless of ablation state), or the channel proves functionally redundant with ARC-007 on all four axes -- meaning commitment has no mechanistically real referent and reduces to whatever was already conditioned.
claims.required_event: A decision point with multiple live, differentiated candidate futures, followed by a commitment that is attributable and by a subsequent attention allocation that is either prospective (intent-driven) or retrospective (residue-driven).
claims.manipulation: Enable versus disable the SD-026 dan_feedback prospective precision-template write channel as an ablation, within the five-step validation sequence SD-026 pre-registers (z_goal seeds, z_resource separates, dan_feedback ablation, benefit_ratio, per-channel precision).
claims.control: The dan_feedback-off arm plus the residue-geometry (ARC-007) pathway as the rival explanation, matched on goal and task so template quality and target quality are not confounded.
claims.DV: benefit_ratio under dan_feedback on versus off against a random baseline, and precision on goal-relevant versus goal-irrelevant feature channels; for Leg 1, structural distinctness of the dan_feedback channel from residue writes on at least two of the four non-circular axes (source signal, decay constant, write path, representational format).
claims.instrument: Absent: no dan_feedback symbol exists anywhere in ree_core, SD-026 sits in substrate_queue with ready=false and five unresolved dependencies, and no manifest exercises MECH-251/dan_feedback. SD-014, the gating prerequisite, is still candidate and V3-EXQ-887 moved away from its gate.
claims.consumer_locus: The prospective precision-template write channel into the E1 prior register -- the mechanism that would make willed attention distinguishable from residue-driven attention, and hence commitment distinguishable from conditioning.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Leg 0, currently unmet: E3 must select among genuinely graded, differentiated candidate trajectories rather than making a near-deterministic pick dominated by one candidate. MECH-439 carries ceiling_decision 'exhausted' with ten confirmed substrate_ceiling autopsies finding no graded discrimination, and the same F-dominance root blocks SD-037, ARC-064, ARC-062 GAP-B and SD-034 de-commit.
claims.blocking_reason: Two stacked blockers: Leg 0's alternative-space is not established (MECH-439 F-dominance ceiling, exhausted, escalated to ARC-107/MECH-448), and Leg 2's manipulation does not exist -- SD-026/dan_feedback is unbuilt and explicitly held until SD-014 reaches provisional, which it has not.
false_positives: SD-026 not being queued is not neglect: its own hold ('do not queue validation until SD-014 is at least provisional') is being honoured deliberately, and SD-014's most recent evidence moves away from that gate.
claims.auditor_notes: INV-012 depends_on SD-026 and MECH-095 only; the Leg 0 owners (MECH-439 ceiling, ARC-107 constitution, MECH-448) are named in its what_would_answer but are not registered dependencies, so the graph does not show INV-012 as ceiling-blocked. ARC-107 has since moved candidate -> provisional, which is progress on Leg 0 but does not clear it.
claims.what_would_answer:
CORRECTION (2026-08-07, same digestion session, user-caught): the
original version of this what_would_answer called Leg 1 "answerable
now" without stating a prior precondition it silently assumed --
flagged by the user mid-session: responsibility-bearing commitment
presupposes the agent is genuinely CHOOSING AMONG MULTIPLE LIVE,
DIFFERENTIATED IMAGINED FUTURES, not executing something close to a
single dominant candidate that merely gets labeled "the commitment."
If E3's candidate proposal+selection pipeline is degenerate in that
sense, Leg 1's question (is the ATTENTION-WRITE mechanism
distinguishable from residue-geometry) becomes moot, because there is
no genuine choosing for that mechanism to be the mechanism *of*. This
is now stated as LEG 0 below, ahead of Leg 1, and Leg 1's "answerable
now" is narrowed to mean "answerable now AS A NECESSARY-BUT-NOT-
SUFFICIENT question" -- it no longer implies the claim as a whole is
answerable independent of Leg 0.

LEG 0 (prior non-degeneracy precondition -- CURRENTLY UNMET, per this
session's own findings): does E3 select among genuinely graded,
differentiated candidate trajectories at all, as opposed to a
near-deterministic pick dominated by one candidate? This is not
hypothetical -- MECH-439 (the E3 selection-authority mechanism
directly upstream of any "commitment") is `epistemic_category:
standard`, `ceiling_decision: exhausted`: 10 confirmed
substrate_ceiling autopsies found no genuine graded discrimination
among candidates, and the same F-dominance conversion-ceiling root
was independently confirmed blocking SD-037 (broadcast override,
this session), ARC-064 (bottom-up rule discovery, this session, via
its MECH-309 dependency), and ARC-062 GAP-B, dACC C2, and SD-034
de-commit. Escalated to a constitutional route (ARC-107/MECH-448/449)
rather than resolved at the parametric level. Until E3's own
selection mechanism clears this ceiling -- candidates shown to
compete on genuinely graded, non-monopolized terms -- "commitment"
has no differentiated alternative-space to be a commitment relative
to, and neither Leg 1 nor Leg 2 below can be more than necessary
conditions. CONFIRMED if a future E3 selection test (post-ARC-107)
shows graded, gap-concentrated discrimination among candidates
(matching ARC-106's own load-bearing-vs-decorative test). FALSIFIED
(for Leg 0 specifically, not for INV-012 as a whole) if E3 selection
is shown to be structurally incapable of graded discrimination
regardless of substrate fix -- which would mean INV-012 needs
re-grounding in a different selection mechanism entirely, not merely
a wait for ARC-107.

LEG 1 (derivational, answerable now ONLY as a necessary-but-not-
sufficient question -- see Leg 0 above, not independently decisive):
INV-012's ethical content depends on deliberate/willed attention being
mechanistically distinguishable from reflexive/residue-driven attention
(ARC-007). SD-026's own notes already stage this argument on five axes;
axis 5 ("the INV-012 argument itself") is CIRCULAR -- it cites INV-012's
requirement as evidence for SD-026's distinctness in order to establish
INV-012's coherence, which assumes the conclusion. The genuine proof
obligation rests on the remaining four: (i) causality direction
(retrospective outcome-driven vs prospective intent-driven), (ii)
neuromodulatory gating (DA-gated vs ACh/NA-gated), (iii) clinical
dissociation (amnestic vs frontal-lobe syndromes), (iv) representational
format (episodic specificity vs cross-situational feature generality).
CONFIRMED if a formal/architectural argument (or, once SD-026 is
implemented, a code-level inspection) shows the proposed dan_feedback
channel is structurally distinct from residue-geometry writes on at
least 2 of these 4 axes (e.g. genuinely separate source signal +
separate decay constant + no shared write path other than the common
additive E1-prior register). FALSIFIED if the channel turns out to be
functionally redundant with ARC-007 on all 4 axes despite the
architectural label -- e.g. if "prospective vs retrospective" collapses
to a parameter setting (decay constant) on what is otherwise the same
write mechanism, or if the neuromodulatory/clinical dissociations
invoked have no analogue in REE's own implementation. A falsification
here means "commitment" has no mechanistically real referent and
reduces to "whatever was already conditioned" -- INV-012 would need to
be narrowed or retired, independent of any experiment.

LEG 2 (substrate_conditional, empirical/behavioral, gated): whether the
distinguishable channel -- once it exists -- actually produces willed
(goal-directed, non-reflexive) perception is a behavioral question that
cannot be tested until: (a) SD-014 reaches >= provisional [status as of
this digestion: still candidate, and the most recent evidence
(V3-EXQ-887, 2026-08-04, weakens, unreviewed) moves AWAY from the gate,
not toward it -- FAILED both C1 functional_drive_gating and C2
representational_separability for the SD-014 node-valence vector on all
3 seeds]; (b) SD-026 is implemented (currently unbuilt: no manifest
exercises MECH-251/dan_feedback, no queue entry references SD-026 or
dan_feedback -- the "do not queue until SD-014 >= provisional" hold in
SD-026's own evidence_quality_note is being honored); and (c) SD-026's
own pre-registered five-step validation sequence completes: (i) z_goal
seeds (SD-012), (ii) z_resource separates (SD-014), (iii) dan_feedback
enabled/disabled as ablation, (iv) benefit_ratio measured against random
baseline, (v) feature-channel precision measured on goal-relevant vs
irrelevant dimensions. CONFIRMED if dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio
substantially over dan_feedback=off, with goal-relevant feature channels
showing higher precision than irrelevant ones under dan_feedback=on.
FALSIFIED if dan_feedback=off performs equivalently (replicating the
EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert pattern regardless of ablation state) -- i.e.
z_goal's behavioral effect, if any, is fully mediated by pathways other
than the claimed prospective channel, and the "willed vs reflexive"
distinction has no behavioral signature even if Leg 1's architectural
distinction holds.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 2 as a whole: SD-014 >= provisional
AND SD-026 landed AND steps (i)-(v) above all completed on non-degenerate
seeds. Until then, Leg 2 is untestable by construction, not merely
unfavored -- absence of a benefit_ratio lift right now would say
nothing, because the channel does not yet exist to test.

LEG 3 (retrospective, substrate_conditional, gated -- added 2026-08-07
from a same-day user thought, docs/thoughts/2026-08-07_responsibility_
counterfactual_memory.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_
2026-08-07_responsibility_counterfactual_memory.md): responsibility
additionally requires the agent to (a) retain that a genuinely
differentiated alternative existed at a past decision point -- not just
that "some other action was abstractly possible" -- and roughly what it
was, for the sub-interrupt-threshold cases MECH-485 routes to retention
rather than to real-time correction; (b) evaluate counterfactually
whether that alternative would have avoided the harm actually incurred
or better achieved the goal actually pursued; and (c) attribute the
resulting outcome to the agent's OWN choice specifically, as opposed to
circumstance -- tied to sense-of-self machinery (INV-033, second-order
epistemic access to one's own epistemic states), not a bare
causal-attribution computation alone (SD-003/MECH-276 already provide
the causal-attribution half, for training, not the narrative-retention
half).

Depends on MECH-485 (the retained-alternative supply -- candidates that
crossed neither the fast-interrupt threshold nor triggered orient/
survey, per Q-090's still-open admission-criterion question) AND on a
retention mechanism for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidates that does
NOT YET EXIST in ree-v3 in any form: e3_selector.select() discards
every non-winning candidate every tick; the nearest partial exception,
SD-033e/MECH-264 (frontopolar counterfactual value), reduces the best
unchosen alternative to a transient scalar (cfv_now) overwritten every
tick, with nothing about WHICH alternative existed surviving past the
tick it was computed on. That retention mechanism is deliberately NOT
registered as its own claim as of this writing -- an earlier session's
memory (project_imagination_learning_constraints.md, 2026-05-10) staged
an adjacent candidate registration for this exact territory and
explicitly gated it "do NOT register without dedicated lit-pull";
respected here rather than overridden. ARC-085 (autobiographical event
tokens, V4/V5, unbuilt) is the nearest candidate eventual host, but its
current schema has no field for "sibling alternatives considered and
rejected here."

CONFABULATION-RISK CAUTION (load-bearing, not decorative -- stated
explicitly by the user as the central danger of this leg): admitting
retained/imagined alternative content into this evaluation with the
wrong weighting is a plausible computational account of a hard-learned
delusion -- a positive feedback loop reinforcing a belief that was
never actually tested against reality, distinct from a one-off
hallucination because it is reinforced into stability by its own
imagined "confirmations." This is why Leg 3 is explicitly a
METACOGNITIVE requirement (INV-033), not merely a memory-engineering
one: distinguishing "this happened" from "this was imagined, and I am
only using it to evaluate a counterfactual" is a second-order judgment
about the source and status of one's own mental content. Any future
retention mechanism must follow the MECH-322 template (bounded,
audited, provisional-until-corroborated) -- REE's one existing
precedent for letting imagined content through the MECH-094
imagination/reality write gate under narrow, audited conditions -- not
a general relaxation of MECH-094.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 3: Leg 0 cleared (E3 selects among
genuinely differentiated candidates -- currently unmet) AND the
retention mechanism exists and demonstrably retains content past the
current tick AND retained content remains distinguishable in
provenance from committed/real content (MECH-094's committed_vs_imagined
tag) AND retained alternatives show non-degenerate variance in whether
they would have avoided the harm/achieved the goal (not floor- or
ceiling-saturated). Until all four hold, Leg 3 is untestable by
construction, not merely unfavored.

CONFIRMED if, given the above substrate, an agent that retains and
correctly counterfactually evaluates rejected alternatives shows
measurably different self-attribution behavior (narrative/self-report,
or an internal attribution signal) between "harm followed from my
choice, a retained better alternative existed" and "harm followed from
my choice, no better alternative existed" cases, AND this attribution
does not degrade into elevated confidence for imagined-only
(never-executed) content in real-experience channels (residue,
valence, hippocampal writes) -- i.e. the confabulation guard holds
under test, not merely by design intent.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept
distinguishable from committed content without a hand-tuned,
case-by-case gate (no general MECH-322-shaped template suffices) --
meaning the confabulation risk is not tractably bounded and Leg 3
should be retired or radically narrowed -- OR if providing retained
alternatives produces no measurable change in self-attribution/
responsibility-relevant behavior over an ablated (discard-immediately)
baseline, i.e. retention supplies no function beyond what SD-033e/
MECH-264's existing transient scalar already provides.

LEG 4 (derivational precondition + substrate_conditional test, added
2026-08-25 from docs/thoughts/2026-08-12_responsibility_as_epistemic_
hygiene.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_2026-08-12_
responsibility_as_epistemic_hygiene.md): responsibility's epistemic
function is not exhausted by knowing THAT an outcome was self-caused
(Legs 0-3 and ARC-015/MECH-095 already cover self-vs-other/self-vs-
world DISCRIMINATION). A further, distinct requirement is that once
self-causation is known -- which does not itself require resolving
MECH-095's substrate-ceiling-blocked discrimination task, since an
agent has direct efference-copy access to its OWN committed action
without needing to disambiguate it from a second agent's -- the
belief-UPDATE machinery must discount that observation's evidential
weight for the SPECIFIC prior that motivated the commitment, because
the observation was solicited by the very hypothesis under test
(a selection-bias / look-elsewhere problem, not an attribution
problem). Naive accumulation of self-solicited-but-genuinely-real
evidence can inflate confidence in a prior regardless of that prior's
truth: incorrect prior -> congruent commitment -> prior-shaped
intervention/sampling -> apparently confirmatory evidence -> stronger
incorrect prior -> stronger congruent commitment. This is a THIRD
mechanism, distinct from both existing self-referential-belief risks
already registered: Leg 3 (imagined/retained counterfactual content
contaminating evaluation) concerns IMAGINED content; MAE-3-blocked
ARC-015 Half 1 / MECH-095 concerns DISCRIMINATING self from an actual
OTHER agent. Leg 4 concerns REAL, correctly-self-attributed evidence
whose SAMPLING was itself biased by the commitment under test -- and,
unlike ARC-015 Half 1, this does NOT require a second agent or
multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3: the confound is constructible in a
SINGLE-agent environment where the agent's own committed action
determines which region of state-space it subsequently samples.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires an environment in which (a) an
initially-plausible-but-incorrect prior can drive a committed action,
(b) that action measurably changes which subsequent observations the
agent encounters (attention/movement/information-seeking, not merely
which outcome resolves), and (c) at least one alternative sampling
policy (e.g. an ablated or randomised intervention-selection arm)
would have produced a materially different, less-confirmatory
observation distribution for the SAME underlying prior -- otherwise
"self-solicited" and "independent" evidence are indistinguishable by
construction and the test is vacuous. No existing V3 test-bed is
known to satisfy this; CausalGridWorld's native dynamics were already
found insufficiently structured for the adjacent MECH-095 test
(ARC-015's own non-degeneracy note), though for a different reason
(no distinct OTHER, not no sampling-bias channel) -- this precondition
needs its own dedicated environment check, not an inherited pass/fail
from SD-047.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent whose post-commit belief update
correctly discounts self-solicited evidence (e.g. via provenance-
weighted update rules downstream of MECH-060/061's write-locus
separation, or an explicit endogenous-sampling-bias correction term)
recovers from an initially incorrect prior at a rate statistically
indistinguishable from an agent given independently-sampled evidence
of the same volume, while an otherwise-identical agent lacking this
discounting shows measurably SLOWER or NON-recovery (persistent
incorrect commitment despite nominally-confirmatory real evidence) --
the delusion-like lock-in signature this thought predicts.

FALSIFYING signature: an agent lacking any self-solicitation
discounting recovers from an incorrect prior at the same rate as one
with it (the naive accumulation loop this thought predicts does not
actually manifest at V3 scale, e.g. because exploration/curiosity
drives or residue decay already wash out the confound) -- this would
mean Leg 4 identifies a real but practically-inert risk, not a
load-bearing gap in existing machinery, and should be narrowed to a
documented failure mode (EXT-xxx-shaped) rather than kept as an open
testability leg of INV-012.

claims.claim_title: Ethics emerges from constraint, not optimisation.
claims.falsifier_summary: The constraint arm's harm-avoidance degrades with reward pressure in the same way as the matched optimisation arm, and neither transfers -- i.e. 'constraint' is just a steeply-priced penalty.
claims.required_event: Trials where the highest-scoring trajectory is also the harmful one -- reward pressure and harm preference must genuinely disagree, otherwise both mechanisms produce the same behaviour.
claims.manipulation: Route harm through a hard feasibility constraint (candidate exclusion / CBF-style trajectory certification, the MECH-145 substrate) versus through the existing additive penalty (lambda_ethical, rho_residue * Phi_R), holding the environment and the harm signal identical.
claims.control: Matched harm-avoidance calibration on non-conflict trials so the arms differ only in mechanism; plus a scaled-penalty arm showing the effect is not reproducible by simply raising lambda_ethical.
claims.DV: Behaviour in the tail: frequency of harmful commits as the reward gradient is scaled arbitrarily upward, and whether harm-avoidance degrades gracefully with reward pressure (optimisation signature) or not at all (constraint signature); plus transfer to a harm type never priced into the objective.
claims.instrument: e3_selector.score_trajectory records the additive channels and their per-candidate contributions, so the optimisation arm is fully instrumented. Nothing records a candidate EXCLUSION event, because no exclusion mechanism exists to record.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 candidate CHOICE-SET boundary (which trajectories are admissible at all) versus the score-aggregation boundary (how admissible trajectories are ranked).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both arms must exist and differ mechanistically: a CONSTRAINT arm that removes candidates from the choice set regardless of their score, and an OPTIMISATION arm that prices harm into the score. Only the optimisation arm is built, so the contrast is currently single-armed and any run would be vacuous. The two arms must also be calibrated to matched harm-avoidance on non-conflict trials, or the result reduces to 'the constraint arm was tuned harder'.
claims.blocking_reason: The constraint arm does not exist in V3. Every ethical pathway -- lambda_ethical and rho_residue in e3_selector.score_trajectory, and MECH-357's instrumental-avoidance score bias -- is an additive term on the trajectory score; nothing removes a candidate from the choice set. With one arm built, the contrast has nothing to discriminate.
claims.auditor_notes: INV-038 ('a system with correct post-hoc ethical scoring but without an active constraint preparation substrate') and MECH-145 (CBF-style prescriptive trajectory certification) already own the missing constraint substrate; MECH-125 owns the multi-constraint-versus-scalar-reward framing. INV-015 carries depends_on: [] and has no edge to any of them. Add the edges rather than registering a new node -- and note this is the SAME prerequisite Q-006 is gated on.

claims.claim_title: Stability is prioritized over maximal performance.
claims.falsifier_summary: The indifference point scales without bound with return (the agent always takes enough reward) and stability violations are accepted -- i.e. stability is priced, not prioritised.
claims.required_event: States offering a high-benefit but destabilising option (a resource adjacent to a hazard, or a contamination-accruing revisit path) alongside a lower-benefit safe option.
claims.manipulation: Sweep the return on the destabilising option upward while holding its stability cost fixed, and locate where the architecture switches allegiance.
claims.control: A performance-maximising comparator with the stability machinery disabled (SD-105 selection_entropy_floor off, homeostatic/viability terms zeroed) run at the same return schedule, so the indifference point is measured against an arm that has no stability priority at all.
claims.DV: The return ratio at which the agent abandons the stable option (the indifference point), and whether any stability violation -- health collapse, selection-entropy collapse to monostrategy, precision collapse -- is ever accepted in exchange for return. INV-016 predicts a bounded indifference point and zero accepted stability violations.
claims.instrument: Environment agent_health and energy accounting, normalized selection entropy and running-variance readouts, and SD-105 selection_entropy_floor telemetry all record the components. No instrument names or computes a stability-versus-performance indifference point, which is the statistic the claim turns on.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 trajectory selection under a live conflict, not a design-time weighting of objectives.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A live trade-off must exist in which stability and performance genuinely conflict -- a high-return option that destabilises (health, energy, selection entropy, precision) against a lower-return stable one -- and the arbitration must not itself be a configured constant. As currently worded the claim would be 'tested' by reading back weights the experimenter set, which is why it needs narrowing to an arbitration claim before it is falsifiable at all.
claims.blocking_reason: As stated this is a design priority, not a hypothesis: the priority is a configured constant, so a direct test reads back its own input. It becomes falsifiable only when narrowed to an arbitration claim (bounded indifference point, stability violations never accepted), which is MECH-125's territory and has neither an experiment nor an indifference-point instrument.
claims.auditor_notes: Recommend narrowing before any experiment is proposed: the design-priority reading is a registry/design statement that should not consume experimental capacity, while the arbitration reading is a genuine V3 hypothesis. MECH-125 ('E3 trajectory selection implements multi-constraint viability evaluation rather than scalar reward maximisation') already states the falsifiable form and INV-016 has no edge to it.

claims.claim_title: Runaway behavior is a control failure, not representational.
claims.falsifier_summary: The representation-only repair exits runaway as often as the control-only repair (or better), which would make runaway at least partly representational.
claims.required_event: An induced runaway -- limbic-monopoly compounding under unbounded ascending-spiral gain, or selection-entropy collapse to monostrategy.

deliberately set obf_max_tokens = N_DISTRACTORS + 2 (one slot of

persistence from competitive contention. The buffer's C4
capacity-eviction machinery (_enforce_capacity(), _n_capacity_evictions,
default max_tokens=5) exists and is wired but has never run

config over the existing ObjectFileBuffer):

claims.claim_title: Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.
claims.falsifier_summary: Channel-on agents match the no-communication baseline, or the symbols carry no above-chance latent information, or a shuffled mapping leaves coordination intact -- showing the channel is not mediating.
claims.required_event: A coordination task with information asymmetry: one agent observes something the other must act on, and reward requires that information to cross a channel.
claims.manipulation: Presence of the discrete symbol channel (channel on versus off), plus a post-hoc shuffle of the symbol-to-meaning mapping as a mediation control.
claims.control: A no-communication baseline at matched task difficulty, and a non-symbolic shared-signal arm (e.g. the scent-gradient proxy ARC-047 already specifies) so any gain is attributable to the symbolic layer rather than to any shared channel.
claims.DV: Coordination/task performance relative to the no-communication baseline; probe accuracy decoding the sender's latent state (z_theta/z_delta slice, residue flag, or intent) from the emitted symbol against chance; and the specific degradation under mapping shuffle.
claims.instrument: Absent at both layers. There is no second agent to emit or receive, no symbol vocabulary, no emission recorder and no symbol-to-latent probe anywhere in ree-v3; MECH-014 is a prose interface sketch with no substrate, no confidence score and no queued experiment.
claims.consumer_locus: The inter-agent symbolic channel as a coordination mediator -- language as a layer BETWEEN agents, not a within-agent representation or a control-demand label.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two layers must both exist before any arm discriminates: a multi-agent environment and a real discrete symbol channel between agents. Both verified absent -- ree_core/environment/ holds only causal_grid_world.py, and grep for symbolic/message-passing/communication machinery across ree_core returns only an unimplemented LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label in claustrum/control_demand.py and two unrelated docstring uses of the word symbolic.
claims.blocking_reason: Neither layer exists: no multi-agent environment (ARC-047 is candidate, phase v5, unbuilt) and no symbol-passing channel (MECH-014 is a sketch). Nothing in V3 can emit, receive or decode an inter-agent symbol, so no version of this claim is falsifiable here.
false_positives: The LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum in claustrum/control_demand.py can read as evidence of a language pathway; it is a control-demand label with no implementation behind it and must not be counted as partial substrate.
claims.auditor_notes: language_emergence_bootstrap_v6:LANG-4 (blocked, load-bearing) is the closest existing owner of the emergence experiment; MECH-014 owns the channel interface but is not an ARC-047-equivalent scoped build target. The missing edge is from ARC-009 to a commissioned build node for either layer.
claims.what_would_answer:
Requires two layers of substrate that do not yet exist in ree-v3, neither of which has an implementation and only the first has even a named design target. Layer 1 (shared with ARC-010): a multi-agent environment -- ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated minimal substrate, itself status: candidate, confidence 0.0, gated to implementation_phase v5, and unbuilt. Layer 2 (specific to ARC-009): a discrete symbolic communication channel between agents -- confirmed absent from ree_core/ entirely (no "language", "symbol", "communication", or "message-passing" inter-agent machinery anywhere; the one reference, control_demand.py's LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label, has no implementation behind it). MECH-014 ("Minimal signalling channel requirements") is the closest existing design artifact for this layer, but it is a prose interface sketch only (inputs: latent-state summaries/residue flags; outputs: discrete-or-continuous signals other agents can condition on) with no substrate, no confidence score, and no queued experiment -- it is not an ARC-047-equivalent scoped build target.
A genuine test becomes possible once both layers land: two (or more) REE agent instances in a shared multi-agent environment (per ARC-010/ARC-047), given access to a shared discrete symbol channel (per MECH-014's sketch, built out as a real interface), on a task with information asymmetry -- one agent observes something the other needs to act correctly on, and coordination/reward requires the information to cross the channel (a standard emergent-communication paradigm, e.g. a referential/signalling game or a coordinated-response variant of ARC-047's predator-avoidance setup). Evidence for the claim would be: (1) agents given the symbol channel achieve significantly better task/coordination performance than a no-communication baseline; (2) the symbols carry recoverable meaning -- e.g. probe accuracy predicting the sender's underlying latent state (z_theta/z_delta slice, residue flag, or intent) from the emitted symbol above chance; and (3) ablating the channel, or shuffling the symbol-to-meaning mapping post-hoc, degrades coordination specifically (not just general task performance), showing the effect is mediated by the symbolic layer rather than some other shared signal (e.g. the scent-channel proxies ARC-047 already specifies). Until both the multi-agent substrate and a real (non-sketch) symbol-passing channel exist, no version of this claim is falsifiable in V3.

claims.claim_title: Offline integration (sleep) is required for stability.
claims.falsifier_summary: Sleep-OFF sustains the same stability profile as sleep-ON on all three DVs over the extended or stressed horizon. ARC-011's REE-specific 'required FOR STABILITY' content then fails even though INV-010's weaker cross-species existence claim survives -- which is the point at which the two near-duplicate claims empirically decouple.
claims.required_event: Repeated would-be sleep cycles across a horizon long enough, or under an explicit novelty/harm stressor, that waking-only operation visibly degrades on at least one stability DV while the matched sleep-ON arm does not.
claims.manipulation: Sleep-ON (use_sleep_aggregation_cluster True, full flag stack) versus sleep-OFF, with total experience and compute matched, crossed with a stressor level (elevated novelty/hazard load) so the divergence is forced inside a tractable budget.
claims.control: A matched-experience waking-only arm that receives the same number of gradient steps in the waking phase as the sleep arm spends offline, so any advantage is attributable to offline integration and not to extra optimisation; same seeds throughout.
claims.DV: Three pre-registered stability DVs measured at t_k against t_0 per arm: ContextMemory slot_cosine_sim trending toward degeneracy, committed-action-class entropy retained as a fraction of its own t_0 value, and residue-field norm/variance growth.
claims.instrument: All three recorders exist and have been exercised -- slot_cosine_sim in the SD-017/EXQ-436 family, committed_class_entropy in the MECH-314/590c/706 family, residue-field norms on ResidueField. REEAgent.offline_integration() and should_integrate() exist (agent.py:12606/12631), the dim=-1 defect is fixed with contract test_offline_integration_cat_dim.py, and drivers now call it (v3_exq_430, v3_exq_996, the v3_exq_1048/1057 family).
claims.consumer_locus: The agent's cross-episode representational and policy state over many cycles -- the stability of the learned system, not within-episode performance and not any single sleep pass's immediate output.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The horizon or stressor must be sufficient for instability to appear in AT LEAST ONE arm: neither EXQ-430 (0/3 seeds differential) nor V3-EXQ-691 (sleep-OFF marginally LESS eroded) reached that regime. The sleep-ON arm must run the full landed stack (use_sleep_aggregation_cluster, which sets use_sleep_loop, sws_enabled and rem_enabled together) rather than the partial legacy configs, and the agent-loop replay entry must actually be exercised now that the torch.cat dim defect is fixed.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing is missing: levers, arms, DVs and recorders all exist and the agent-loop replay entry is fixed and now called. The binding constraint is non-degeneracy plus budget -- the two closest attempts both ran horizons at which neither arm destabilised, so a valid test needs an extended horizon or an explicit stressor, and no queued experiment is tagged ARC-011.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note's statement that 'no script under ree-v3/experiments/ has ever called agent.offline_integration() or agent.should_integrate()' is no longer true: v3_exq_430, v3_exq_996, v3_exq_586, infant_curriculum and the v3_exq_1048/1057 family all call it, so the successor's workaround note is discharged.
claims.auditor_notes: ARC-011 and INV-010 remain near-duplicate in wording and share the zebrafish citation; the WWA already flags this for a governance pass. The three DVs are owned by three different experiment families, so an ARC-011 driver is an integration job, not three new instruments.
claims.what_would_answer:
ARC-011 asserts offline integration (sleep) is REQUIRED FOR STABILITY --
distinct from INV-010 (sleep exists and is required, a bare universal
necessity grounded in cross-species biology, no depends_on) in that
ARC-011 stakes a REE-specific architectural claim: that omitting sleep
causes measurable instability, mediated through ARC-007 (hippocampal
replay) and ARC-005 (control plane). [Digestion note, not resolved
here: INV-010 and ARC-011 are near-duplicate in wording -- worth a
governance pass to make the distinction explicit in one or both
entries, or confirm they should stay separate.] Never tested as its
own claim: 0 genuine_exp entries (claim_evidence.v1.json), sole
evidence one literature citation (zebrafish sleep biology) shared with
INV-010. The extensive sleep experimental corpus in this codebase
(SD-017, MECH-120, MECH-204, MECH-272/273/275/285, Q-055) all attaches
to child mechanism claims, never to ARC-011 or INV-010 directly.

STABILITY OPERATIONALIZED (per docs/architecture/sleep.md's own
"Failure if omitted" list, using DVs already instrumented in the
sleep-cluster experiments):
  (a) Representation drift: slot_cosine_sim among ContextMemory slots
      rising toward ~1.0 (context representations collapsing/
      undifferentiated) -- instrumented since the SD-017/EXQ-436
      family.
  (b) Policy/diversity erosion ("monostrategy convergence"): committed-
      action-class entropy retained at t_k vs t_0, sleep-ON vs
      sleep-OFF -- the DV used by V3-EXQ-691/Q-055.
  (c) Residue-field runaway: unbounded growth/variance in the residue
      field R, or policy entropy collapsing toward frozen -- the
      "residue overgeneralisation" / "brittle or frozen policy
      selection" failure modes named in sleep.md.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison must run long enough / over
enough would-be sleep cycles that instability has a chance to manifest
in EITHER arm. A short run where neither condition destabilizes is
uninformative -- this is not hypothetical caution, it is the observed
failure mode of the two closest existing attempts: EXQ-430 (SLEEP harm
< NO_SLEEP, INV-010) found no differential effect in 0/3 seeds and was
read as substrate-gated/inconclusive rather than falsifying;
V3-EXQ-691 (Q-055) found sleep-OFF was NOT visibly worse than sleep-ON
on diversity erosion at the horizon tested (sleep-OFF was in fact
marginally LESS eroded). Both are consistent with "the run never got
long/stressed enough for the predicted divergence to appear," not with
"sleep doesn't matter." A valid test therefore needs either (i) a
horizon long enough that waking-only operation visibly degrades on
>=1 of the DVs above while the sleep-ON arm does not, or (ii) an
explicit stressor (elevated novelty/harm load, episode count well past
where current sleep-adjacent experiments stop) to force the divergence
within a tractable budget. The sleep-ON arm must run the FULL flag
stack (use_sleep_loop, sws_enabled, rem_enabled,
use_sleep_aggregation_cluster -- landed 2026-05-16 GAP-3), not the
partial/legacy configs used in EXQ-418/436/538a, which repeatedly
produced vacuous or non_contributory results from missing read-paths
rather than a genuine sleep-ON vs sleep-OFF contrast.

CONFIRMING signature: the sleep-OFF arm shows measurable degradation
on >=1 of the three stability DVs over the extended/stressed horizon
(slot_cosine_sim trending toward degenerate; action-class entropy
collapsing toward a frozen/monostrategy floor; residue-field
norm/variance growing without bound), while the sleep-ON arm (full
flag stack) does not show the same degradation, or shows it
significantly less severely, matched for total experience/compute.

FALSIFYING: sleep-OFF sustains the same stability profile as sleep-ON
across all three DVs over the extended/stressed horizon -- no
differential drift, no differential diversity erosion, no differential
residue runaway. This would falsify ARC-011's specific "required FOR
STABILITY, in REE" claim even if INV-010's weaker "sleep exists and is
architecturally motivated" survives on cross-species biological-
analogy grounds alone -- this is the concrete point at which the two
claims can empirically decouple, which is why they should not share
one falsifier.

claims.claim_title: E3 does not require an explicit ethical cost term.
claims.falsifier_summary: Setting lambda_ethical = 0 produces a significant rise in contact rate or harm exposure, beyond the matched-magnitude control's effect, on >= 2/3 seeds. E3 then does require an explicit ethical cost term, and ARC-012 as an architectural commitment does not hold in the built substrate.
claims.required_event: Trials presenting an approach-gradient conflict: a trajectory that is better on reality cost F and on residue Phi but worse on harm proximity, so the presence or absence of the explicit M term changes which trajectory is committed.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the explicit ethical cost term on the live scoring path -- lambda_ethical = 0 (E3Config, consumed as lambda_eff in e3_selector.score_trajectory) -- against the shipped lambda_ethical = 1.0, holding f_weight, rho_residue, the harm stream and training budget fixed.
claims.control: A matched arm that removes an equal amount of score magnitude from a NON-ethical channel (f_weight or rho_residue scaled to the same mean contribution recorded by the commensurability estimator), so the comparison is 'ethical term removed' rather than 'score scale changed'.
claims.DV: Hazard contact rate and cumulative harm exposure per episode in the lambda_ethical = 0 arm relative to the lambda_ethical = 1 arm at matched seeds, with per-channel mean contributions (f_weighted / harm_weighted / residue_weighted) recorded so the counterfactual weighting is auditable.
claims.instrument: The manipulation and the score decomposition both exist: e3_selector.score_trajectory composes f_weight * F + lambda_eff * M + rho_residue * Phi, with three M evaluation routes (compute_harm_forward_cost, compute_harm_stream_cost, compute_harm_cost_fallback) and _last_commensurability_raw recording each channel's raw magnitude. No experiment in ree-v3 references ARC-012 at all; no run ablates lambda_ethical.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 committed-selection score -- whether harm avoidance requires its own priced term there, or is recoverable from the residue and reality channels alone. Not the harm encoder and not the environment's harm generation, both of which stay identical across arms.

claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks the run: the ablation knob, the three M routes, the per-channel decomposition and the behavioural DVs all exist on the live path. claims.claim_title: Astrocyte-aware regulatory stack mediates control-plane precision routing.
claims.falsifier_summary: The field is built and exercised but tracks the monoamine input with negligible lag, shows no heterogeneity beyond the existing per-depth channels, gives no annealing advantage, or leaves alpha_k unchanged when ablated -- i.e. it is a redundant re-description of the current parameterisation.
claims.required_event: A step change in a monoamine-like broadcast signal while the agent is running, so the field's response lag and its spatial profile at fixed depth can both be observed.
claims.manipulation: Step the monoamine-like input, and separately ablate the field module entirely, holding the existing per-channel precision parameterisation fixed in both arms.
claims.control: The current live mechanism INV-008 confirmed -- direct per-depth-channel precision logits with no field interposed -- plus a weights-only recalibration arm for the sleep-annealing sub-test.

claims.falsifier_summary: Residue's effect on ranking is the same for R and R' candidates (a broadcast constant, not a terrain), or the R-specific effect does not survive a context transition -- residue is not persistent latent-space curvature.
claims.required_event: An agent that traverses a harm-marked region and later revisits it, or transits between two distinguishable regions, with residue laid down along the first path.
claims.manipulation: Fork a trained agent into a harm-accruing path in region R versus a harm-free path, with a matched control accruing equal harm mass in a distant region R', holding all non-residue score surfaces bit-identical.
claims.control: The residue-zeroed arm (the V3-EXQ-697 idiom base_i = raw_score_i - residue_weighted_i) plus the equal-harm-elsewhere fork, on matched RNG and matched candidate sets.
claims.DV: Location-specific change in the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking attributable to residue -- flip rate of the residue-intact versus residue-zeroed argmin conditioned on region -- and survival of region-R centres across a context transition.
claims.instrument: Present but mis-scaled. ResidueField / RBFLayer (residue/field.py) and the 697 decomposition record residue's contribution to scoring (flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.06-0.996 across seeds), but nothing records centre survival across contexts and the kernel cannot resolve region identity at default bandwidth.
claims.consumer_locus: The residue term inside E3 candidate scoring as a function of WHERE the candidate sits in z_world -- geometry -- not merely whether a residue term is present.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The residue field must be able to express spatial contrast and to retain a path. claims.blocking_reason: At production defaults the residue field is spatially near-uniform (0.8% kernel contrast across the entire reachable manifold), so a geometry falsifier cannot discriminate; and the 32-slot round-robin means injecting fork history RELOCATES the 32 most recent centres rather than extending a path, making any positive result unattributable between geometry and near-field deletion.
false_positives: The 2026-09-06 evidence_quality_note's 'No substrate hold on ARC-013' predates the 2026-09-17 measurement and is now wrong on the geometry leg: the same two substrate facts that blocked MECH-023 (32-slot ring, 1.0 bandwidth over a 0.125-wide manifold) bear directly on ARC-013's registered title.

claims.what_would_answer:
ARC-014 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "safe imagination" (positive: useful internal
simulation genuinely occurs) and "without commitment" (negative: it
never durably writes to real-experience state) are separate assertions
with DIFFERENT evidentiary status.

LEG A -- SAFE IMAGINATION (that Default Mode / DMN replay genuinely
executes and its content reaches SOME functional consumer). ANSWER by
architectural audit of the live replay/ghost call site, not by
V3-EXQ-880 (which does not exercise it). ree_core/agent.py's
_do_replay() (the production ghost/replay call site) calls
hippocampal.replay()/diverse_replay() -- so the GENERATIVE act of
internal simulation genuinely fires in production -- but per the
V3-EXQ-880 driver's own docstring, its output trajectories are
currently DISCARDED without ever reaching lateral_pfc.update() or
residue_field.accumulate(); MECH-319 names this the "reserved seam"
for the still-pending V3-EXQ-543c replay-driven invocation path.
Separately, INV-011's own audit (this session) traces a DIFFERENT
generative pathway -- E1 internal generation via simulate()/sense()
with hypothesis_tag=True -- through ~30 live agent.py call sites and
concludes DMN/E1 rollout content reaches phi(z)-adjacent read paths
for attenuated affect without producing a belief update. That is
evidence LEG A holds for the E1/simulate() pathway specifically; it is
NOT evidence for the hippocampal _do_replay()/DMN-ghost pathway, whose
output is currently discarded wholesale (not merely write-suppressed)
and is not yet wired to any consumer, safe or not. LEG A therefore
remains PARTIALLY answered: confirmed for E1/simulate(), open
(reserved seam, pending 543c) for the DMN/hippocampal-replay pathway
specifically named in ARC-014's own "Default Mode" title.

LEG B -- WITHOUT COMMITMENT (that simulation-tagged content, IF it
reached a commitment-capable write consumer, would be suppressed while
waking-tagged content commits). ANSWERED by V3-EXQ-880 (2026-08-02,
PASS, 3/3 seeds). Matched-content design: identical captured
(z_delta, z_world) content from a real seeded env rollout applied to
two agents built from the same seed, differing only in
hypothesis_tag/simulation_mode. Two independent channels, both
load-bearing: rule_state/MECH-319 (sim_rule_state_delta <= 1e-7,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_rule_state_delta >= 1e-4, measured
0.31-0.43 all seeds); residue/MECH-094 (sim_residue_delta <= 1e-6,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_residue_delta >= 1.0, measured ~2.0 all
seeds). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the experiment constructs the write-gate
seam DIRECTLY via manual tag injection and direct API calls -- it does
NOT drive the real production _do_replay() call site, which (see LEG
A) currently discards its trajectories before they would ever reach
these consumers at all. V3-EXQ-880 therefore confirms the categorical
write-gate ITSELF behaves correctly as a defense-in-depth safeguard,
not that production replay content is currently routed through it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (LEG B, per V3-EXQ-880's own pre-registered
grid): C0 path-exercised (WAKE arm n_waking_admitted == N_CAPTURE; SIM
arm n_simulation_blocked == N_CAPTURE, n_simulation_admitted == 0)
AND C1/C2/C4/C5 (all load-bearing, combined via plain AND).

FALSIFYING evidence (LEG B): a future experiment driving genuine
replay-tagged content through the real _do_replay() -> consumer path
(once 543c wires it) finds simulation-tagged content reaching
lateral_pfc.update() or residue_field.accumulate() and durably
altering state -- i.e. the gate confirmed here in isolation is
bypassed once wired to the real call site.

CONFIRMING evidence (LEG A residual): a future experiment or audit
showing the DMN/_do_replay() pathway's discarded trajectories are (or
become, post-543c) actually consumed by some functional read path --
would close LEG A for the specific pathway ARC-014's "Default Mode"
title names.

claims.claim_title: Path authority and interruptibility via norepinephrine-like control.
claims.falsifier_summary: The E3 rate changes with arousal while the per-opportunity margin and the de-commit fraction stay flat -- nu modulates deliberation frequency only; or the effect is sign-consistent in the opposite direction (higher nu, lower authority).
claims.required_event: Repeated fresh deliberation opportunities on a trained substrate under at least three arousal levels, each with post-commit world prediction-error spikes available to challenge the commitment.
claims.manipulation: Vary the nu-analogue -- clock.beta_magnitude_scale and the endogenous beta magnitude feeding update_e3_rate_from_beta -- across at least three levels on ONE trained substrate per seed, using capture and restore of the agent surface between arms; optionally add the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst arm.
claims.control: The same trained substrate at baseline arousal with identical seeds and identical environment stream, plus an explicit measurement of per-arm E3-rate separation so a rate effect is not mistaken for an authority effect.
claims.DV: Two: the normalised E3 score margin per fresh selection, read pre-sampling off e3.last_scores as (second_min - min) / (median - min) -- the same quantity BetaGate.should_admit_elevation gates on; and the fraction of post-commit E2 world PE spikes above the running-variance threshold that produce a de-commit (beta gate leaving the elevated state).
claims.instrument: e3.last_scores and the score-decomposition diagnostics record the margin directly; BetaGate.get_state exposes the readiness margin, refractory and elevation counters. The de-commit DV has no direct event counter -- get_state has no release count and there are ten distinct release sites in agent.py -- so it must be reconstructed by polling is_elevated per tick and attributing transitions to PE spikes.
claims.consumer_locus: Per-deliberation-opportunity path authority at the commit-entry gate, not deliberation frequency (which is MECH-093's arithmetic and was already shown by V3-EXQ-505).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The environment must be stepped with the selected action applied (the V3-EXQ-1018 driver was refused for re-sensing one frozen observation for 900 ticks), e3_score_decomp_enabled must be True so urgency and commit diagnostics are written, the arousal levels must sit off the clock.py clamp so e3_steps varies with endogenous beta magnitude, and no arm may record n_committed == 0.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks the margin leg: clock.update_e3_rate_from_beta, beta_magnitude_scale, e3.last_scores, e3_score_decomp_enabled, BetaGate.should_admit_elevation and phasic_surprise_burst all exist and were re-verified. The claim simply has no queued successor to the burned V3-EXQ-1018. The de-commit leg needs a driver-side release-transition recorder, since BetaGate exposes no release counter.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The V3-EXQ-1018 refusal is often read as MECH-005 being blocked on substrate; it was a driver defect list (frozen observation, unset decomposition flag, clamped arousal), and the substrate the claim names is built.
claims.auditor_notes: 1018 is burned and 1026 was reserved and released, so a successor needs a fresh EXQ number; the seven successor changes are enumerated in the refusal record.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the environment must be STEPPED during measurement with the selected action applied (the V3-EXQ-1018 driver was refused 2026-09-11 precisely because it re-sensed one frozen observation for 900 ticks, so its arousal arms differed only in draw count -- evidence/planning/exq1026_mech005_nu_path_authority_refusal_20260911.md F1); e3_score_decomp_enabled must be True so urgency_applied / committed / commit_variance are actually written (F3); the arousal levels must sit off the clock.py t=min(1,max(0,||z_beta||*scale)) clamp so e3_steps varies with endogenous ||z_beta|| (F5); and the per-arm E3-rate separation must be measured, not assumed. Degenerate if any arm records n_committed == 0 (no commitment to have authority over) or if the between-seed SD of the DV is so small that an uncalibrated absolute floor binds the gate.
CONFIRMING: the per-deliberation-opportunity path-authority statistic MOVES with the nu-analog. DV = the normalised E3 score margin at each fresh selection, read pre-sampling off e3.last_scores ((second_min - min)/(median - min), the same quantity BetaGate.should_admit_elevation gates commit entry on), compared across >=3 arousal levels of clock.beta_magnitude_scale / ||z_beta|| on ONE trained substrate per seed (capture_agent_surface / restore_agent_surface between arms). Sub-claims (1) and (3) of the architecture doc are confirmed if (1) the margin rises with the nu-analog, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds with |delta| >= 2 SD(per-seed deltas), AND (3) the fraction of post-commit E2 world prediction-error spikes (above the running-variance threshold) that produce a de-commit (beta_gate.release / committed_trajectory cleared) is higher under high nu than low nu -- post-commit error carries more weight when nu is high.
FALSIFYING: the E3 RATE changes with arousal (that is the MECH-093 arithmetic V3-EXQ-505 already showed and is NOT this claim) while the per-opportunity margin and the post-commit de-commit fraction are flat across arms -- nu as realised in V3 modulates deliberation FREQUENCY only, and per-opportunity path authority is set by machinery nu never touches (the beta_gate latch, the commit-variance gate). A sign-consistent effect in the OPPOSITE direction (higher nu, lower authority / lower post-commit error weight) also weakens the claim as stated.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py update_e3_rate_from_beta (MECH-093, the ||z_beta|| arousal path), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py urgency_weight in select() (V3-EXQ-785a instrument) and last_scores, ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py (latch + should_admit_elevation), SD-069 ree_core/regulators/phasic_surprise_burst.py for a phasic arm. All built. Biology: LC-NE adaptive gain (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005) -- tonic NE sets how tightly the current task set is held; the claim is the REE reading of that, so a lit-pull is not owed before the test.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now. The 1018 design is the starting point with the seven successor changes enumerated in the refusal record; it needs a FRESH EXQ number (1018 is burned; 1026 was reserved and released). complicated (buildable).

claims.claim_title: Language emergence and bootstrapping dynamics.
claims.falsifier_summary: (a) the ungated arm acquires comparable compositional generalizing communication -- language does not need the play-mode host; (b) the gated arm never gets beyond fixed-token pattern matching -- play_mode necessary but not sufficient; or (c) degrading play_mode leaves communication intact while degrading other play-dependent behaviours -- language is dissociable from play_mode, falsifying the routing claim shared with MECH-308.
claims.required_event: Bootstrap episodes in a multi-agent partially observable world in which two independently optimizing agents face referents they must coordinate over, with play_mode-gated bilateral frame opening available in one arm.
claims.manipulation: Presence versus absence of play_mode gating on otherwise identical bootstrap episodes (basic-expression channels available in both arms, conversational violations scored as synthetic z_harm only in the gated arm), plus a later play_mode degradation arm.
claims.control: Multi-agent plus symbolic-channel substrate WITHOUT play_mode gating, matched on seeds, episode count, partial-observability structure and referent distribution; plus an unrelated play-dependent behaviour probe for the dissociation test.
claims.DV: Compositional generalization of the emergent communication across NOVEL referent combinations (not just training referents), the demonstrative versus fixed-token character of negation, and the differential degradation of communication versus other competencies when play_mode availability is removed.
claims.instrument: Absent at every layer. There is no utterance log, no referent-signal mutual-information recorder and no compositional-generalization probe, because there is no channel to instrument; ree_core/claustrum/coalition_templates.py records in its own header that social/language/reality-coherence consumers do not exist yet in ree_core.
claims.consumer_locus: The play_mode-gated bilateral frame as the HOST of language acquisition -- the claim's assertion is about routing, so the locus is the dependency of communication acquisition on play_mode, not communication competence in isolation.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Three substrate layers, all reconfirmed absent 2026-09-22. Layer 1: a multi-agent, partially observable environment -- ree_core/environment/ contains only causal_grid_world.py and SocialGridWorld (ARC-047) has zero hits. Layer 2: play_mode -- zero hits (the only match, _diverse_replay_mode_counts in hippocampal/module.py:270, is a false positive). Layer 3: the expression catalog -- zero hits for proto_symbol, basic_expression, negation_primitive, symbol_ground. The environment must also support more than one INDEPENDENTLY optimizing agent; a scripted partner cannot test this, and play_mode's synthetic z_goal/z_harm substitution must be shown to route real gradient (MECH-194) first.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: all three required layers are absent from ree_core/ and the designated minimal substrate ARC-047 SocialGridWorld is itself candidate, confidence 0.0 and v5-gated. The proper test sits at the V5/V6 multi-agent plus play-mode boundary.
claims.auditor_notes: Duplicate-node risk: MECH-308 (registered 2026-05-08) duplicates much of this play-mode-as-language-game framing and the WWA already flags it as a governance merge candidate; a coordinator composing falsifiers for both will produce two near-identical specs. LANG-2 (enabling-conditions register, open/load-bearing) is the natural owner of the layer inventory but has no substrate_queue entry.
claims.what_would_answer:
Requires three layers of substrate, none of which exist in ree_core/ (2026-08-08). Layer 1 (shared with ARC-009/ARC-010): a multi-agent environment with partial- observability other-agent modelling -- ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated minimal substrate, itself candidate/confidence 0.0/v5-gated, unbuilt. Layer 2: the play_mode substrate this claim's own doc routes language through (INV-058/MECH-194/ ARC-049) -- confirmed absent (the only "play_mode" string match in ree_core/ is a false positive, "_diverse_replay_mode_counts"). Layer 3: the basic expression catalog and proto-symbol accretion machinery specific to this claim (play pose, head-tilt, mutual gaze, distress vocalisation, approach cue, vocal mimicry, pointing, negation primitives) -- confirmed absent (zero hits for proto_symbol, basic_expression, negation_primitive, symbol_ground).
CONFIRMING: once play_mode and a multi-agent substrate exist, an agent trained WITH play_mode-gated bootstrap episodes (bilateral frame-opening via basic-expression channels, conversational violations scored as synthetic z_harm) acquires compositional, socially-grounded communication that generalizes across novel referent combinations, with demonstrative (partner-model-dependent) rather than fixed-token negation. Loss of play_mode availability should degrade this communication while leaving other competencies intact.
FALSIFYING: (a) an agent given the multi-agent + symbolic-channel substrate WITHOUT play_mode gating still acquires compositional, generalizing communication at comparable rates -- language does not need the play-mode host; (b) an agent WITH play_mode gating fails to bootstrap beyond fixed-token pattern-matching -- play_mode necessary but not sufficient; (c) degrading play_mode leaves communication intact while degrading unrelated play-dependent behaviors -- language is dissociable from play_mode rather than routed through it, falsifying the central architectural claim shared with MECH-308.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the multi-agent substrate must support genuinely partial observability and >1 independently-optimizing agent (a scripted "partner" cannot test this), and play_mode's synthetic z_goal/z_harm substitution must be independently verified to route real gradient (MECH-194) before any result can be attributed to the play-mode-hosting hypothesis rather than the underlying learning substrate.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): companion claim MECH-308 (registered 2026-05-08) duplicates much of this play-mode-as-language-game framing -- worth a governance merge-candidate review to decide which claim should carry it going forward.

claims.claim_title: Language failure modes and pathologies.
claims.falsifier_summary: The report tracks the actual E3/residue determinants (no misreport) and emitting a justification leaves harm-stream gain at commit unchanged (no suppression) -- language is not decoupled from the embodied evaluation in the way the claim asserts, and the ideological-capture limb shows no harm-like signal on frame-threatening evidence.
claims.required_event: An agent making a harm-relevant choice and then emitting a symbolic justification of that choice through a live language channel, with the harm/residue determinants of the choice recorded independently.
claims.manipulation: Vary the coupling of the symbolic channel to the harm/residue signals as a manipulable parameter (coupled versus decoupled emission), and separately vary the precision of the non-linguistic harm evidence available to the reporting layer.
claims.control: Matched choices with no justification emitted, and coupled-channel arms at matched precision, so a language-driven shift is separable from the choice's own determinants.
claims.DV: Two DVs that must be tested separately, not pooled. Misreport: divergence between the reported justification and the actual E3/residue determinants of the choice, read from the residue field and harm streams directly and never from the report. Suppression: gain change on the harm/residue stream at the commit step, measured while the justification is emitted (the Jarcho 2011 signature).
claims.instrument: Absent. No language channel exists to log an utterance, so neither the misreport divergence nor the emission-locked harm-gain change can be recorded; residue and harm-stream readouts exist but have nothing to be compared against.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit step where the symbolic report is emitted -- the claim asserts that decoupled language acts ON the harm/residue evaluation at commit, not that it merely correlates with a downstream outcome.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A real (non-sketch) symbolic output channel (ARC-009) reporting on the agent's own action selection, plus a second agent (ARC-010) for the reputation-substitution limb. Reconfirmed 2026-09-22: ree_core/ carries only the register-only label ControlDemandType.LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION (ree_core/claustrum/control_demand.py:49) and a single-agent causal_grid_world. The non-linguistic harm evidence must also be independently readable, since the misreport limb requires comparing the report against the residue/harm determinants rather than against itself.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: no symbolic output channel and no multi-agent substrate exist, and EXP-0745's release_condition names both as prerequisites. The proper test sits at the ARC-009 symbolic-channel boundary for the misreport and suppression limbs, and at the ARC-010 multi-agent boundary for reputation substitution.
claims.auditor_notes: R7 is a genuine third component, not decoration: GFLAG-0276 (open, chipped to /claim-synthesis) records that the claim bundles five failure modes of very different evidential standing, and the moral-licensing limb has NO REE-native test proposed pending independent resolution of whether the human effect is real (Kuper & Bott 2019 bias-corrected d approx -0.05 to 0.18). Do not compose a single pooled falsifier across the five limbs.
claims.what_would_answer: Once a REE instance has a real (non-sketch) symbolic output channel (ARC-009) reporting on its own action selection, the misreport and suppression readings of rationalisation come apart cleanly and must be tested separately: misreport is whether the reported justification tracks the actual E3/residue determinants of the choice (read the residue field and harm streams directly, never the language report -- Hall 2012, Turpin 2023); suppression is whether emitting the justification is accompanied by a measurable gain reduction on the harm/residue stream at the commit step (the Jarcho 2011 signature, i.e. this claim's own "precision misrouting" pathology). Bureaucratic dissociation and reputation substitution predict that the precision of the non-linguistic harm evidence available to the reporting layer gates the size of any language-driven shift in downstream harm appraisal or reputational cost (Walker 2021). Ideological capture predicts a harm-like signal evoked by frame-threatening evidence on identity-bound propositions, not an absent signal on frame-consistent harm (Kaplan 2016) -- this is the "spurious residue from narrative contamination" pathology, not suppression/override as originally mapped. Reputation substitution and any social-scoring failure additionally require a second agent (ARC-010) to score against. Moral licensing has no REE-native test proposed here pending independent resolution of whether the human effect is real (see notes). No REE agent currently has a symbolic output channel or a multi-agent substrate to condition on any of this (GFLAG-0269 tracks epistemic_category classification for the whole ARC-009/ARC-010 language cluster, MECH-011 through MECH-015, including this claim).

claims.claim_title: Subjective now is a control surface across temporal horizons.
claims.falsifier_summary: The anticipatory fraction is the same at window 1 and window 10 and at horizon 1 and 30 -- harm avoidance is reactive in every arm -- or the integrating window lowers restraint and raises harm.
claims.required_event: Approach episodes where a hazard is reachable in k > 1 steps, so restraint can precede any realised harm, with E3 ticking across a genuine cross-rate interval.
claims.manipulation: theta_buffer_size 1 versus the default 10, and E2 rollout_horizon 1 versus 30, on one trained substrate per seed.
claims.control: The window-1 / horizon-1 arm on the same trained substrate and seed, with a warm-up hazard-survival gate and a z_world norm-ratio gate applied before scoring.
claims.DV: Anticipatory-restraint fraction -- of trajectories that would reach a hazard within the rollout horizon, the fraction rejected or de-committed BEFORE realised harm rises above zero, read off the pre-sampling E3 score rather than the sampled action.
claims.instrument: ThetaBuffer.summary, e2_fast rollouts and e3_selector harm_eval exist and V3-EXQ-1050 implemented the anticipatory-fraction readout, but it did not record z_world step delta, z0 norm, the E3 tick trace or the position trace -- the four readouts that discriminate the two live causes.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 commitment as a horizon-integrating control surface, at the theta-window / E3-tick boundary rather than at the per-env-step sensory timestamp.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: theta_buffer_size > 1 must actually change the summary -- V3-EXQ-1050's ARM_WIN10 diverged from ARM_WIN1 by median L2 8.5e-6 to 6.3e-5 against a 1e-3 floor, so the arms were bit-identical -- E3 must tick slower than the env step so a cross-rate interval exists (it fired on 2380 of 2400 steps), and vetoes must fire at a non-zero rate in every arm.
claims.blocking_reason: The window is fed and consumed but rank-invariant: it moves the summary by ~1e-5 against ~1e-1 for one action, so WIN1 and WIN10 produced identical trajectories and C2 was never measured. E3's tick rate collapsed to nearly every step, so the cross-rate regime the claim is about never occurred, and in-band ticks were adjacent-step pseudo-replicates.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-1050's C1 pooled lift of +0.076 is not partial support: it is sign-consistent in only 2 of 3 seeds, the curves are non-monotone, and the failing seed's warm-up hazard-survival gate failed yet its cells were scored green.
claims.auditor_notes: The 1050a re-run the confirmed autopsy routed (diagnose the E3 rate, make the window span a real cross-rate interval, add warm-up-survival and z_world-norm-ratio gates, record the four missing readouts) is not written and is not in ree-v3/experiment_queue.json as of 2026-09-22; the autopsy created no substrate entry, so a governance chip is the only owner.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the theta window must actually integrate more than one E1 step (theta_buffer_size > 1; at 1 the summary IS the instantaneous z_world and the arms coincide), E2 rollouts must reach beyond the current step (rollout_horizon > 1), the environment must carry hazards that are reachable in k > 1 steps so 'restraint before harm' is possible, and vetoes / de-commits must fire at a non-zero rate in EVERY arm (a zero-veto arm cannot show an anticipatory fraction). Degenerate if the harm-approach episodes are so short that predicted and realised harm coincide within one theta window.
CONFIRMING: E3 commitment behaves as a control surface that integrates predictions across horizons rather than reacting to the current sensory timestamp. Readout = the ANTICIPATORY-RESTRAINT FRACTION: of trajectories that would have reached a hazard within the E2 rollout horizon, the fraction rejected or de-committed BEFORE any realised harm signal (z_harm / harm_eval on the actual z_world) rises above zero, where 'rejected' is read off the pre-sampling E3 score (harm term of J via e2.world_forward rollouts) not the sampled action. Discriminative pair on one trained substrate per seed: theta_buffer_size = 1 vs the default 10 (and/or E2 rollout_horizon 1 vs 30). CONFIRMING if the anticipatory fraction is higher under the integrating window, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, AND realised harm per episode falls with it (the restraint is protective, not just earlier). A further corollary, worth one extra readout: commit decisions are better predicted (AUC) by the ThetaBuffer.summary() vector than by the instantaneous E1 z_world.
FALSIFYING: the anticipatory-restraint fraction is the same at window 1 and window 10 (and at horizon 1 and 30) -- harm avoidance is reactive in every arm, triggered only by realised harm PE, so 'now' as a horizon-integrating control surface has no substrate content in V3; or the integrating window LOWERS anticipatory restraint / raises harm (the window smears the hazard signal), which weakens the claim's 'restraint before harm' clause directly.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py (ThetaBuffer.summary, MECH-089), ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py rollouts + world_forward, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py (prediction_horizon 20), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py harm_eval over rollout world states, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py E3 heartbeat. All built; the anticipatory-fraction readout is a driver-side instrument. Biology: cortical-cerebellar fast/slow prediction, not hippocampal -- the claim is already framed on that basis.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now; complicated (buildable). Keep the learning-eligibility half of the claim ('learning signals about the future felt as present') OUT of this falsifier -- it is a separate, harder measurement on when E1/E2 updates are applied, and folding it in would over-specify the test.

claims.claim_title: Is ethics developmental rather than additive?
claims.falsifier_summary: Behaviour depends only on the present penalty term, is schedule-invariant at matched exposure, and reverts when the penalty is removed.
claims.required_event: Extended harm exposure under deliberately different schedules, followed by a late penalty-removal probe and a novel-harm-type probe.
claims.manipulation: Vary the ORDER and TIMING of harm exposure (early-harm versus late-harm schedules) with total exposure matched; then at test set lambda_ethical to zero while leaving the accumulated residue path (rho_residue * Phi_R) intact.
claims.control: An additive arm with a fixed value function and constant lambda_ethical, schedule-matched to the developmental arm; plus a residue-zeroed arm so 'behaviour survived penalty removal' cannot be credited to anything other than the accumulated representation.
claims.DV: (i) final harm-avoidance as a function of exposure schedule at matched total exposure (path dependence), (ii) harm-avoidance on a harm type never trained on, (iii) harm-avoidance after lambda_ethical is removed late -- the developmental prediction is schedule-dependence, transfer, and persistence; the additive prediction is schedule-invariance, no transfer, and reversion.
claims.instrument: Environment harm accounting and the e3_selector per-channel score decomposition record the behavioural DVs and which channel carried them; the residue field records the accumulated harm geometry. What no instrument exposes is whether the VALUE FUNCTION was reshaped, as distinct from a persistent additive residue term still being present -- that is the load-bearing missing measurement.
claims.consumer_locus: Whether ethical constraint lives in the value REPRESENTATION (reshaped by experience) or in a separable penalty TERM that can be removed intact.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The developmental and additive arms must differ in MECHANISM, not merely in strength. claims.blocking_reason: V3 has no constraint arm to contrast against optimisation: harm is priced into the score everywhere and nothing removes a candidate from the choice set, so 'developmental' and 'additive' differ only by whether the additive term is learned. claims.manipulation: Set the affect context by environment configuration (hazard proximity, resource availability, goal presence) as the labelled independent variable, with the volatility_signal_dim rv injection pathway enabled so z_beta has a control-plane input.

claims.manipulation: Inject graded Gaussian noise of pre-registered std directly into the world_forward prediction error that feeds e3.update_running_variance, during eval only, at target running-variance multiples 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.5 / 4.0 / 7.0 of the per-seed eval baseline.
claims.control: A noise-free eval calibration window fixes the per-seed baseline and sets commit_threshold = 2 x eval_baseline; seeds, content and candidate generation held identical across sweep levels, and no behavioural harm DV is attached (that is ARC-029).

over shared predictive machinery but independent modules.

heterogeneity_note): the V2 precision_regime_probe imposed precision externally
rather than deriving it from E3 and had no end-to-end commitment wiring; V3

variance gap (train ~0.000032-0.000064 vs eval ~0.001, so the threshold never

dominates threshold-adaptation behaviour; V3-EXQ-642's autopsy records a

non_contributory still scores as if half-refuted. Re-scoring needs a governance eye
