claims.claim_title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.
claims.falsifier_summary: With multi-stage traversal demonstrated, staged and flat are statistically indistinguishable, or the flat arm matches or exceeds the staged arm at equal or lower cost.
claims.required_event: A curriculum run in which phase advance fires more than once AND the phase change reaches the agent through a live channel -- env_kwargs harm_gradient_enabled / transient_benefit_enabled, or config_overrides offline_integration_frequency.
claims.manipulation: Phase-advance gating on versus off: the gated staged curriculum against an ungated flat baseline at identical total episode budget and eventual feature set.
claims.control: The flat ARM_0/ARM_1-style ungated arm at matched budget and seeds, with the legacy spike gate as the reference advance rule.
claims.DV: Fraction of the 7-criterion developmental gate satisfied (>=6/7 in >=4/5 seeds), or an already-used downstream competence/stability metric at matched total training cost, reproduced on a second curriculum-bearing lineage.
claims.instrument: InfantCurriculumScheduler plus the 591h/996 harness record per-episode h_pos, crossing counts, advance episode and final_z_goal_norm; V3-EXQ-996 measured 135 diverging episodes on 4/5 seeds, so a live phase-to-agent channel now demonstrably exists.
claims.consumer_locus: Training-regime structure -- whether explicit stage gates change outcome quality, not merely interpretability or debuggability.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The staged arm must demonstrably traverse more than one phase boundary and the gate criteria must be reachable by some arm; staged and unstaged must differ only in the presence of gating, at identical total episode budget, seeds and eventual feature set.
claims.blocking_reason: Two of the three blocking gate criteria are unreachable in the infant lineage: final_z_goal_norm measures 0.0 to 9.2e-12 against a 0.4 bar and observed H_pos maxes at 1.08 against a 3.23 bar, so no arm can clear >=6/7. The same z_goal floor keeps _try_phase_1_to_2 shut, so the staged arm can traverse exactly one boundary.
false_positives: The 2026-09-04 note's 'the curriculum's one wired phase channel was inert through 591b-591h' is now superseded for the successor: V3-EXQ-996 measured a live env_kwargs channel (135 diverging episodes on 4/5 seeds, cause independently probed).
claims.auditor_notes: EXP-0264's release condition names scaffolded_sd054_onboarding as the z_goal-healthy lineage (ready true, z_goal ~0.52 entering P2), but that node's unblocks_claims lists 20 claims and ARC-019 is not among them. What is missing is the edge that re-homes the staged-vs-flat test onto a lineage where z_goal survives -- not new substrate.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A staged-vs-unstaged comparison is only informative if
the staged arm can actually traverse its stages under the tested budget -- i.e. the
phase-advance gate criteria (as in InfantCurriculumScheduler / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8) must be reachable, and the unstaged control must differ from the staged arm only
in the presence/absence of gating (same total episode budget, same environmental feature set
eventually enabled, same seeds) -- not merely relabeled episode counts. V3-EXQ-591 (2026-05-27)
demonstrated the failure mode this precondition guards against: all arms (staged and flat
alike) plateaued at 1/7 gate criteria because a goal-pipeline prerequisite (z_goal seeding,
goal_pipeline:GAP-4) was not yet substrate-ready, producing a substrate-ceiling non-result
rather than a test of the curriculum question. This precondition must be independently
verified (e.g. staged arm reaches at least Phase 1 in >=80% of seeds) before treating any
outcome below as evidence either way.

CONFIRMING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds, the staged/gated curriculum arm
(ARM_2-style, phase-advance gated on the DEV-NEED-008 / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8 criteria) reaches a materially higher fraction of the 7-criterion developmental
gate (>=6/7 in >=4/5 seeds, per V3-EXQ-591's own acceptance design) than an unstaged/ungated
baseline trained on the identical total episode budget and identical eventual feature set
(flat ARM_0/ARM_1-style). Equivalently, on any already-used downstream competence metric in
this registry (e.g. MECH-457 competence-floor measures, or convergence quality/H_pos
trajectory stability), the staged arm should show measurably better or more stable outcomes
than the ungated control at matched total training cost -- and this advantage should
reproduce across at least one additional curriculum-bearing lineage (e.g. scaffolded_sd054
onboarding, or the play-type progression of MECH-197) once each is substrate-ready, not
just the infant-stage instance.

FALSIFYING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds (staged arm demonstrably traverses
multiple stages), the staged/gated arm shows no reliable advantage over the unstaged/ungated
baseline at matched total training budget -- e.g. gate-criterion satisfaction, competence-floor
measures, or convergence quality are statistically indistinguishable between staged and flat
arms, or the flat arm matches/exceeds the staged arm at equal or lower cost. This would
indicate the explicit stage/gate structure is not doing useful work beyond what unstructured
training achieves anyway -- the curriculum may still be a convenient scaffold for organizing
training runs and diagnostics, but "staged development with explicit gates" would not be
architecturally load-bearing for outcome quality, only for interpretability/debuggability
(which is a different, weaker claim than ARC-019 currently asserts).

claims.claim_title: Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.
claims.falsifier_summary: Offline consolidation mutates an authority-store equivalent directly with no type check and no code path distinguishable from an ordinary representational write; or a boundary exists but admits any offline-originated write regardless of type; or the only enforcement is a naming or comment convention with no machine-checked gate.
claims.required_event: An offline/sleep consolidation pass that generates a candidate authority-affecting change -- a commitment-token mint, an external-action dispatch, or a direct write to a POL/ID/CAPS-equivalent store.
claims.manipulation: Enable versus disable the typed commit boundary on the offline path, and vary the TYPE of the attempted write (representational/residue/precision/access-route versus authority-affecting) with the origin held constant at offline.
claims.control: An ordinary representational or access-route consolidation write of matched magnitude and origin, which per the 2026-09-10 GFLAG-0128 ruling must pass unimpeded; and a waking-origin authority write as the origin control.
claims.DV: Whether the authority-affecting offline write lands directly, is rejected, or is re-routed through the verifier path -- read as a per-write outcome by type crossed with origin, not as an aggregate consolidation-quality score.
claims.instrument: Absent. ree_core/sleep/ has phase and routing machinery (phase_manager.py, routing_gate.py with per-phase anchor/probe channel weights) and MECH-094-style hypothesis_tag refusals, but no write-type taxonomy, no authority store, and no per-write interception record.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit boundary between offline consolidation and privileged authority stores (POL/ID/CAPS analogs) -- not the sleep phase gate and not the residue accumulation gate, both of which V3 does have.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: An offline code path must be CAPABLE of attempting a privileged-authority write and be intercepted, rather than never attempting one by construction. Verified FAILING: grep of ree_core for write_locus, permission_matrix, commit_boundary, commit_token and authority_store returns zero hits, and MECH-067 has no code presence at all.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 has no privileged-authority store and no typed commit boundary, so offline consolidation cannot even attempt the write the falsifier needs to observe being intercepted. MECH-067 names the required permission matrix but is provisional, has no ree_core presence and no substrate-queue entry.
false_positives: The sleep pipeline's phase and routing gates (SWS/REM anchor/probe weights, sleep-onset permits) can look like the asserted boundary; they gate write STRENGTH by phase, not write AUTHORITY by type, so they do not partially satisfy the precondition.
claims.auditor_notes: The 2026-09-10 GFLAG-0128 ruling widened the permitted list to access-route quantities; that only widens what the (still absent) boundary must let through and does not move the precondition. MECH-067's V1-only provenance (EXQ-005/EVB-0043) has never been retested in V3.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary mechanism gating writes FROM offline/sleep consolidation TO privileged authority stores (POL/ID/CAPS per docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020) -- i.e. MECH-067's "machine-checkable phase/store/actor permission matrix" (or equivalent) must actually be wired into the V3 sleep pipeline, with an offline code path CAPABLE of attempting an authority-store write and being intercepted/typed-routed rather than merely never attempting one by construction. THIS PRECONDITION CURRENTLY FAILS: exhaustive grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ for write_locus, permission_matrix, POL/CAPS/ID authority-store analogs, commit_token, and commit_boundary returns zero hits. The sleep pipeline has phase/mode routing (SWS/REM gates, sleep-onset permits) but no privileged-authority-store concept and no typed commit-boundary/ verifier-mediation machinery. MECH-067, the claim this would be implemented through, is provisional on V1 substrate only (ree-v1-minimal EXQ-005/EVB-0043, 2026-02-27) and has never been retested in V3. Do not force a genuine_exp test while this precondition is unmet -- any attempt would be vacuous (no reachable write path to authority stores exists for offline consolidation to violate OR respect). CONFIRMING (once the precondition is met): an experiment in which offline/sleep consolidation generates a candidate authority-affecting change (a commitment-token mint, an external-action dispatch, or a direct write to a POL/ID/CAPS-equivalent store) is rejected or re-routed through the typed commit-boundary/verifier path rather than landing directly -- distinguishable from an ordinary representational/residue/ precision write (which should succeed unimpeded, per the sleep.md "MAY update" list). FALSIFYING: (a) offline/sleep consolidation can mutate a privileged authority-store equivalent directly, with no type check, no verifier mediation, and no distinguishable code path from an ordinary representational write; or (b) a boundary exists but does not discriminate by TYPE (any offline-originated write reaches the store regardless of whether it is representational or authority-affecting); or (c) the only enforcement is a naming/comment-level convention with no machine-checked gate.
SCOPE RULING 2026-09-10 (governance, GFLAG-0128, user decision, option (a)): the permissive MAY-update list this claim inherits from docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020 NOW EXPLICITLY INCLUDES ACCESS-ROUTE QUANTITIES -- retrieval-cue mappings, model-to-policy readouts, proposal distributions, and eligibility/competitive-gain mappings -- so an offline BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS REPAIR operation (ARC-137, Q-102) is PERMITTED by ARC-020 rather than, as before, neither permitted nor forbidden by omission. Read it as a widening of what counts as "an ordinary representational/residue/ precision write" in the CONFIRMING clause above, and hence of what the typed boundary must let through unimpeded. The MUST NOT list is untouched: an access-route write that mints a commitment token, dispatches an external action, or reaches a POL/ID/CAPS equivalent is still authority-affecting and must be typed-routed, so the FALSIFYING clauses above stand unchanged. Surfaced by the duplication audit in thought_intake_2026-09-02_sleep_as_deferred_reorganisation_and_behavioural_access_repair.md; the defect was ARC-020's silence, not a rival claim.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a fair test requires (a) the three instrument defects fixed for V3-EXQ-876 to stay fixed (SelectionResult.committed read, not the stale cache; agent.update_residue() called every eval tick so running_variance is live; well-sampled committed AND uncommitted windows, non-degenerate per seed) AND (b) the doing-mode-delta DV re-operationalized so a negative/null result can be trusted as real rather than an artifact. V3-EXQ-876 (2026-08-02) cleared (a) cleanly but its DV choice is now suspect on two grounds from the claim's own literature: Friston 2013 records precision as continuous, not a discrete mode switch, while the harm- counterfactual-gap DV tests a discrete committed-vs-uncommitted split; and Thura & Cisek 2014 predicts CONVERGENCE (narrowing) of premotor/M1 representations during commitment -- the opposite sign from what the DV's C1 criterion assumed. A valid re-operationalization must capture context-dependent precision modulation during genuinely committed episodes without conflating it with a downstream harm- differentiation proxy whose predicted sign the claim's own literature disputes -- either by testing the reversed sign directly, or by gating on precision itself (precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean, already recorded in V3-EXQ-876 and separating by 4-5 orders of magnitude in every seed, but never scored as a criterion).
CONFIRMING: once re-operationalized, HIGH_CAUSAL/committed conditions show a precision lift over LOW_CAUSAL/uncommitted conditions in the predicted direction, exceeding a pre-registered margin (the claim's history sets 0.05 as the prior bar from V2's slope criterion, though a direct precision-ratio criterion should set its own bar given the much larger separation already observed).
FALSIFYING: even after a GENUINE re-operationalization (not a re-run of the same DV), the result stays flat or wrong-signed under the same non-degenerate preconditions -- this is now a REAL falsification, not a second measurement-defect pass. MECH-025 has already used one "instrument defect, not evidence against" exemption (V3-EXQ-876); a second wrong-sign or null result after the DV itself has been changed to address the sign-mismatch critique should be read as real claim pressure. Distinguish "still a DV problem" from "now genuinely falsified" by whether the new DV's own positive-control gates (precision separation, or whichever direct signal the redesign gates on) clear cleanly: if they clear and the predicted relationship still fails, that is falsification; if the gates themselves fail to clear, that is a substrate/instrument problem warranting a genuine third fix, not accepting the null.

claims.claim_title: Ready vigilance primes restraint under high sensitivity without action.
claims.falsifier_summary: The regulator finds no stable non-maximal optimum (sensitivity and restraint trade off monotonically), or at the tuned regime sensitivity and restraint are not coupled as the claim predicts.
claims.required_event: The agent held in an uncommitted-but-vigilant window with threat present at a regulator-tuned sensitivity level, rather than at a forced heartbeat period.
claims.manipulation: Run at the regulator's tuned optimum versus below it (passivity) and above it (hypervigilance), with the regulator setting the z_beta -> e3_steps_per_tick rate as a closed loop rather than a binary switch.
claims.control: The passivity arm (low sensitivity, no restraint signal) and the hypervigilance arm (sensitivity above the optimum), matched for threat exposure and seeds.
claims.DV: Co-occurrence of suppressed motor commitment with elevated detection/precision at the tuned level: commitment rate and false-alarm rate against detection sensitivity, scored at E3 decision ticks and hold-invariant.
claims.instrument: MECH-093's rate-modulation channel exists (ree-v3/ree_core/utils/config.py:3442, z_beta varies e3_steps_per_tick) and is confirmed live, but no regulator exists in ree_core/regulators/, and the sensitivity readout used by 999/999a is broken or unscorable.
claims.consumer_locus: The arousal / heartbeat-rate control surface and its effect on E3 commitment -- not episode harm rate, and not a static precision parameter.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: MECH-161's arousal regulator must exist and settle on a stable non-maximal optimum, and the sensitivity readout must separate a perfect avoider from an untrained one -- V3-EXQ-999's gate cannot (a geometrically perfect avoider scores 0.0000 against a +0.05 floor, inside the policy-free null band).
claims.blocking_reason: The manipulation does not exist: ree_core contains no MECH-161 controller and substrate_queue has no entry for one, only MECH-093's open-loop z_beta channel. Both probes bypassed the regulator by forcing heartbeat periods -- 999 aborted on a precondition gate with no power, 999a FAILed non_degenerate on wall-hugging -- and EXQ-067's restraint DV read zero uncommitted steps.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: MECH-026 needs the agent HELD at a regulator-selected non-maximal sensitivity, plus a restraint/sensitivity readout at E3 decision ticks that can separate a perfect avoider from an untrained one.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: A closed-loop arousal controller over the existing MECH-093 z_beta -> e3_steps_per_tick channel that settles on an interior optimum, yielding tuned / below / above arms instead of forced-period sweeps.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Hold-invariant per-decision-tick detection sensitivity with commitment and false-alarm rates, carrying a positive control in which a geometrically perfect avoider scores at ceiling.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: No substrate_queue entry names the regulator; MECH-161 is a claim, not a build node, and the confirmed 2026-09-04 autopsy records that the first probe chose to bypass the regulator rather than build it, so nothing of the 999a shape will move MECH-026.

claims.auditor_notes: The instrument half (a readout with a perfect-avoider positive control) is the cheaper and more transferable piece and could be registered on its own; the controller half is a mechanism build and should not be authorised on this audit's say-so. MECH-026 also carries a governance question in its own WWA about whether overall_confidence 0.701 is lit-heavy.
claims.coordinator_note: Only the INSTRUMENT half of this candidate (hold-invariant per-decision-tick restraint/sensitivity readout with a perfect-avoider positive control) is registered; the closed-loop arousal controller is MECH-026's own mechanism and stays claim-owned pending governance.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-161's arousal regulator -- a controller that tunes MECH-093's heartbeat-rate channel (z_beta -> e3_steps_per_tick) to a genuine inverted-U optimum on the LC-NE curve, rather than treating sensitivity as a binary high/low switch -- must be built and confirmed live before this claim is fairly testable. Current state: UNBUILT, not merely untested (MECH-161's controller is described only as something that "could be implemented as" a z_beta-gated controller; no such controller exists in ree_core/). claims.claim_title: Ethical behavior depends on mode transitions and learning preservation.
claims.falsifier_summary: A = B = C on both readouts -- mode transitions and cross-mode preservation are irrelevant to harm behaviour in V3 -- or C = A because harm learning is fully re-acquirable within a mode, which falsifies the preservation clause and narrows the claim to the transition clause alone.
claims.required_event: Long lives on a curriculum where hazards are encountered on both sides of at least one genuine mode transition, with harm learned before a transition and tested after it.
claims.manipulation: Three arms on matched seeds: (A) intact, (B) mode-locked via an unreachable switch_threshold, (C) reset-on-switch, restoring the residue field and the e2_harm_s weights to their pre-switch snapshot at every mode switch.
claims.control: Arm A (intact, transitions and preservation both present) as the reference for both readouts, with hazard exposure matched across arms.
claims.DV: Recurrence rate of harm from hazards learned BEFORE a transition and measured AFTER it, plus the avoidance cost (approach-suppression of non-harm resources) in the post-transition mode, each sign-consistent across >=3 seeds.
claims.instrument: ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py exposes operating_mode, mode_switch_trigger and write_gate(target); ree_core/residue/field.py and the ARC-033 e2_harm_s path carry the harm learning. What is missing is any registered MECH-261 gate on a harm-learning write: agent.py:11053 calls residue_field.accumulate ungated, and register_target is never called anywhere in ree_core.
claims.consumer_locus: The mode-conditioned write gate over harm consolidation -- whether the locked mode actually withholds a harm-learning write -- not the mode label itself.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Mode transitions must genuinely occur within a life (SalienceCoordinator.mode_switch_trigger firing with current_mode changing more often than once per episode, and regime_occupancy_gate reporting 'graded' rather than bang-bang), the locked arm must hold current_mode constant, and the locked mode must gate a write path that actually matters for harm learning. Degenerate if hazards cluster on one side of every transition or if harm is re-learned within one episode.
claims.blocking_reason: Two of the claim's own preconditions are unsatisfiable today: genuine within-life graded mode transitions are still owed by substrate_queue 'mode-governance-engagement' / 'sd_salience_contested_mode_occupancy', and no MECH-261 write_gate target is registered on residue_field.accumulate or e2_harm_s, so a locked mode gates nothing that matters for harm learning.
false_positives: The WWA says the MECH-261 write_gate's consumers 'today' are the SD-033a/b/e PFC analogs; agent.py in fact calls write_gate for autonomic, e1_sensory_encoder, e3_policy, hippocampal_write_consolidation, hippocampal_anchor_set and hippocampal_persistence_appraisal as well. The substantive point stands -- none of them is a harm-learning write.
claims.auditor_notes: The WWA's falsifier design correctly anticipates both blockers as degeneracy conditions, so it should be KEPT; only its trailing 2026-09-16 disposition line ('testable now; complicated (buildable)') is contradicted by EXP-0765's measured refusal and should be corrected without touching the falsifier.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: mode transitions must actually OCCUR in the intact arm (SalienceCoordinator.mode_switch_trigger fires and current_mode changes >= k times per life, with hazards encountered on BOTH sides of at least one transition); the mode-locked arm must genuinely suppress transitions (switch_threshold set unreachable; verify current_mode is constant); and the 'learning not preserved' arm must genuinely remove the learning (ResidueField num_harm_events and the e2_harm_s weight hash revert at each switch). Degenerate if hazards cluster on one side of every transition, if MECH-261 mode-conditioned write gating has no live consumer in the configuration (today its consumers are the SD-033a/b/e PFC analogs, so the locked mode must actually gate a write path that matters for harm learning), or if harm is re-learned within one episode fast enough that a reset is behaviourally invisible.
CONFIRMING: harm-avoidance depends on BOTH clauses. Three arms on matched seeds over long lives with hazards straddling transitions: (A) intact; (B) mode-locked (no transitions); (C) reset-on-switch (residue field + e2_harm_s restored to their pre-switch snapshot at every mode switch, transitions intact). Readouts: recurrence rate of harm from hazards learned BEFORE a transition, measured AFTER it; and the avoidance COST (approach-suppression of non-harm resources, i.e. over-generalised avoidance) in the post-transition mode. CONFIRMING if (C) shows harm recurrence above (A) (preservation across transitions is load-bearing) AND (B) shows a distinct deficit from (A) -- either harm recurrence (the locked mode cannot consolidate what it learned) or an avoidance-cost rise (a hypervigilance lock), sign-consistent across >=3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: (A) = (B) = (C) on both readouts -- mode transitions and cross-mode preservation are irrelevant to harm behaviour in V3, and 'ethical behaviour depends on appropriate transitions between modes' has no content here; or (C) = (A) because harm learning is entirely re-acquirable within-mode (then the preservation clause is false as stated and the claim should be narrowed to the transition clause).
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py (SD-032a operating_mode, MECH-259 switch threshold, MECH-261 write_gate registry), ree_core/residue/field.py, e2_harm_s (ARC-033) in ree_core/agent.py, ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py for the offline_consolidation mode. Built. Note the MECH-027 hypervigilance probe (V3-EXQ-979, 2026-09-02) was refused because the precision channel had no graded runtime consumer -- this design does not read precision; it reads harm recurrence and avoidance cost, which have consumers.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now; complicated (buildable). Biology first: the doc grounds this in fatigue / trauma / care as mode-shaping factors -- the reset-on-switch arm is the mechanistic analogue of state-dependent learning failing to transfer; no lit-pull owed before the test.

fixed scalar weighting of the component streams (i.e. a single
linear or monotonic combination fits the choice behaviour as well
as the vector/Pareto rule does) -- this would indicate VALENCE is
functioning as a de facto scalar reward regardless of its vector
representation, and would refute the "no scalar collapse" claim
even if the underlying data structure remains vector-shaped.
claims.stale_reason: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition asks for the named VALENCE component streams to be independently computable per candidate and to co-vary; against current code the test is degenerate in BOTH directions rather than merely under-powered. E3.score_trajectory composes an explicit scalar J = F + lambda*M + rho*Phi_R - beta*B (e3_selector.py:1605-1777), so with the modulators off a fixed scalar weighting reproduces rankings by construction (automatic FALSIFY); with use_e3_channel_commensurability or use_learned_channel_gating on, the effective per-channel weights are running-statistic or plasticity-updated, so no fixed weighting fits (automatic CONFIRM). The precondition must therefore gate on the existence of a non-compensatory ranking rule, not on component variance.

claims.claim_title: Other-harm triggers veto only under high-certainty catastrophic outcomes.
claims.falsifier_summary: The veto and ranking pathways behave identically (pure soft coupling); or a hard veto fires on low-certainty or non-catastrophic predictions; or high-certainty catastrophic other-harm never produces a behavioural floor even after extended training; or the same pattern emerges with no distinguishable other representation.
claims.required_event: Trials in a multi-agent environment where an action is predicted to cause catastrophic irreversible harm to another agent at high certainty, alongside matched low-certainty and non-catastrophic trials.
claims.manipulation: Cross predicted-other-harm certainty with predicted severity in a factorial design, holding self-harm exposure and reward pressure constant, with a threshold-gated hard veto instantiated in the action-selection path.
claims.control: Self-directed harm at matched certainty and severity (the social-specificity control), and a soft-coupling arm where other-harm only lowers rank without exclusion (the MECH-127-style comparator).
claims.DV: Selection frequency of veto-eligible actions as a function of certainty and severity: a hard behavioural floor near 0 percent in the high-certainty catastrophic cell that is qualitatively discontinuous from the reduced-but-nonzero frequency in low-certainty cells, and the same discontinuity absent in the self-harm control.
claims.instrument: None exists in V3. A recorder would sit at the action-selection boundary in a multi-agent environment, logging per-action other-harm certainty, predicted severity, veto firing and the selected action -- all of which require the ARC-047 SocialGridWorld and an other-tagged cost channel first.
claims.consumer_locus: The action-admissibility boundary before selection (a hard exclusion), not a continuous cost term inside the E3 score sum.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Requires an other-agent representation that produces a distinguishable 'other' tag for cost logic to condition on, and a discrete hard-veto primitive gated on certainty times severity. Re-verified today: zero hits for selflike, self_like, other_agent or SocialGrid under ree_core, the only environment is causal_grid_world.py, and the single occurrence of 'veto' in ree_core is one word in a comment.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: no other-agent representation, no social environment, and no hard-veto or action-block primitive anywhere in ree_core. Both preconditions are V4 items (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld under MECH-031), so a V3 analogue would test self-harm gating under a social label rather than the claim.
claims.auditor_notes: The two v5 plan nodes (MIRROR-4, LOVE-1) already own the prerequisite and are marked blocked; nothing links MECH-036 to a substrate_queue entry, so the only missing edge is registry-side. No V3 falsifier should be invented for this claim.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (1) a functioning OTHER_SELFLIKE / other-agent detection substrate (MECH-031, gated on ARC-010 -> ARC-047's SocialGridWorld, implementation_phase v4; confirmed zero hits for "OTHER_SELFLIKE"/"self_like"/"selflike" anywhere under ree_core/ as of 2026-08-08) actually instantiated and producing a distinguishable "other" tag for cost/veto logic to condition on, and (2) a discrete hard-veto/action-block primitive -- as opposed to REE's existing continuous PE-weighted control-demand signal (E2_harm_a/E2_harm_s -> dACC, or a MECH-127-style soft other_cost_loss term) -- gated on a certainty x severity threshold. claims.claim_title: Arcuate-like sequence-to-motor channel nudges language emergence.
claims.falsifier_summary: ON equals LESION on rate and latency (the dorsal channel is not load-bearing and the nudge is empty), or ON is worse than LESION (fast routing prevents consistent use by committing to signals before meaning grounds), or ON emerges with ZERO emergence in LESION (the channel is a REQUIRED module, contradicting the nudge framing).
claims.required_event: Repeated two-agent episodes under joint-attention-gated resource access, in which a discrete low-cost signalling action is available and symbolic coordination can emerge.
claims.manipulation: ON arm routes hippocampal rollout / E1 sequence summaries (the multi-content theta packet, ree_core/latent/multi_content_theta_packet.py) fast into E2 affordances over the signalling actions, plus a pre-commit self-correction loop (E2 PE on the agent's own emitted signal evaluated BEFORE commit). LESION arm severs that routing, leaving only the ordinary slow path with no pre-commit correction.
claims.control: Matched-seed LESION arm with identical signalling actions, identical task and identical episode budget; the only difference is the fast routing and the pre-commit correction hook.
claims.DV: Three readouts jointly: referential consistency (mutual information between emitted signal and referent world state, above a shuffled-referent baseline), coordination success rate, and time-to-first-consistent-use -- with the NUDGE pattern requiring ON to exceed LESION on all three while LESION still shows some emergence.
claims.instrument: Absent. There is no signalling affordance to log and no referent-signal mutual-information recorder; ree_core/claustrum/coalition_templates.py states in its own header that social / language / reality-coherence consumers do not exist yet in ree_core, and ree_core/environment/ holds only the single-agent causal_grid_world.py.
claims.consumer_locus: The E2 affordance layer over signalling actions and the pre-commit self-correction step -- the claim asserts a ROUTING speed-up into affordance evaluation, not a new language module.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Coordination pressure must be REAL and FELT in the lesioned baseline: a two-agent task where a resource is obtainable only under joint attention, with baseline agents demonstrably attempting it (non-zero coordination attempts per episode) and at least occasional success with no channel. If NO emergence occurs in either arm the result is uninterpretable -- no pressure, not no nudge. The signalling action must be equally available in both arms; only the fast sequence-to-motor ROUTING differs.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: no multi-agent environment and no signalling affordance exist, so the required coordination event cannot be generated and the lesion has nothing to sever. The upstream question -- whether V3 hosts a multi-agent environment at all -- is a research-direction decision, not a queue decision.
claims.auditor_notes: The ON-arm SOURCE already exists (multi_content_theta_packet.py); only the destination (signalling affordances in a two-agent world) is missing, which makes this the cheapest of the four language-cluster claims in this batch to unblock if the multi-agent research-direction decision goes that way. EXP-0783's release_condition already orders the two builds correctly and requires the non-degeneracy precondition to be demonstrated empirically FIRST; the claim's own note asks for a dorsal-stream-lesion lit-pull before the build, not after.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: coordination pressure must be REAL and FELT in the lesioned baseline -- a two-agent task where a resource is obtainable only under joint attention, with the baseline agents demonstrably attempting it (non-zero coordination attempts per episode) and at least occasional success without any channel. If NO emergence occurs in either arm the result is uninterpretable (no pressure, not no nudge). The signalling action must be equally available in both arms; only the fast sequence-to-motor ROUTING differs.
CONFIRMING: an AF-like channel is a NUDGE -- it raises the rate and lowers the latency of emergent symbolic coordination without being required for it. Arms on matched seeds: (ON) fast routing from hippocampal rollout / E1 sequence summaries (the theta packet) into E2 affordances over the signalling actions, plus a low-latency self-correction loop (E2 PE on the agent's own emitted signal evaluated BEFORE commit, able to interrupt or refine the output); (LESION) the same signalling actions with that routing severed (signals reach E2 only through the ordinary slow path, no pre-commit correction). Readouts: referential consistency (mutual information between emitted signal and the referent world state, above a shuffled-referent baseline), coordination success rate, and time-to-first-consistent-use. CONFIRMING if ON exceeds LESION on all three, sign-consistent across >=3 seed pairs, AND LESION still shows some emergence (nudge, not module) -- the doc's 'neither dorsal nor ventral alone is sufficient' clause predicts exactly that pattern.
FALSIFYING: ON = LESION on rate and latency (the dorsal sequence channel is not load-bearing for emergence -- the nudge is empty), or ON < LESION (fast routing PREVENTS consistent use, e.g. by committing to signals before meaning grounds), or emergence in ON with ZERO in LESION (the channel is a REQUIRED module, contradicting the claim's 'nudge, not a new module' framing -- a weakening of the claim as stated, though not of language emergence).
SUBSTRATE: NOT BUILT. ree_core has no multi-agent environment, no signalling / articulation affordance, and no language or social consumer modules (ree_core/claustrum/coalition_templates.py records that social / language / reality-coherence consumers 'do not exist yet in ree_core'). Two builds are named, in order: (1) a two-agent CausalGridWorld variant with a discrete low-cost signalling action and a joint-attention-gated resource; (2) the AF-analog routing from the multi-content theta packet (ree_core/latent/multi_content_theta_packet.py) into E2 affordances over the signalling actions, with a pre-commit self-correction hook. Biology first: the human AF is a functional analog with dorsal AND ventral streams both needed -- the build must not be a 'language module', and a targeted lit-pull on dorsal-stream lesion effects on protolanguage should precede the build, not follow it.
Disposition 2026-09-16: substrate_conditional -- do NOT mint an EXP; route to /implement-substrate scoping only after the plan-of-record decides whether V3 hosts a multi-agent environment at all (that is a research-direction decision, not a queue decision). complex (probe-gated) at the environment question.

claims.claim_title: Modes are stable regions in control-channel space, not separate modules.
claims.falsifier_summary: Channel values form no stable clusters, or transitions are simultaneous and discrete across all channels at once -- indistinguishable from a one-hot module switch -- which supports the discrete-module reading instead.
claims.required_event: Transitions between named regimes (task-engaged, default-mode-like, emergency) occurring often enough within a run to sample the trajectory through channel space, including at least one forced interrupt-like transition.
claims.manipulation: Drive transitions by manipulating the channel inputs (arousal, readiness, precision routing, commit threshold, replay scheduling) rather than by setting a mode flag, so the transition path through channel space is what is observed.
claims.control: A discrete-switch comparator in which the mode is set directly at the register, giving the instantaneous all-channel step change the falsifying architecture predicts.
claims.DV: Cluster structure and transition shape in the joint channel space: within-regime dispersion versus between-regime separation of the channel vector, and per-channel lead-lag over the transition window (graded channel-by-channel co-movement versus simultaneous step change across all channels).
claims.instrument: The soft operating_mode vector, current_mode and mode_switch_trigger are emitted per tick by SalienceCoordinator, and E3 emits precision and commit diagnostics, so a joint per-tick channel vector is recordable. Missing: any recorder for the veto/interrupt channel, and a precision channel entry that actually varies.
claims.consumer_locus: The control-plane channel state itself as the carrier of mode, versus a discrete mode register that selects a module -- the architectural boundary the claim is about.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The named channels must be independently measurable with non-zero cross-condition variance. Two of them fail today: the precision/gain channel readout was bit-identical across all three channel levels in V3-EXQ-802, and the hard-veto/interrupt channel has no substrate at all (one comment occurrence of 'veto' in ree_core). The mode register was also one-hot in 26 of 30 cells with two of four modes never occupied.
claims.blocking_reason: The channel space is degenerate where it must vary: the mode register is effectively one-hot with two modes never occupied, and the precision channel readout is invariant to its own manipulation, so 'stable region' and 'discrete flag' are not yet distinguishable. One named channel (hard veto/interrupt) has no substrate to measure at all.
false_positives: The coordinator is sometimes described as a discrete mode switch, which would make the claim trivially false; it in fact emits a soft probability vector over modes and only derives a discrete current_mode with an exit-threshold rail, so the continuous representation the claim needs does exist -- it is the occupancy that is degenerate.
claims.auditor_notes: This claim and MECH-002 are blocked by the same two measurements (mode-register degeneracy and the invariant precision readout); a single re-measure of the V3-EXQ-802 ladder with the graded precision consumer armed would inform both, so they should be scheduled together rather than as two separate probes.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the named control channels
(arousal baseline/volatility, action readiness/motor gating,
precision/gain routing, commitment threshold/interruptibility,
replay/learning scheduling, hard veto/interrupt threshold) to be
independently measurable and to show non-zero cross-condition
variance -- a run where all channels move in lockstep cannot
discriminate "stable region in a continuous space" from "discrete
module."
CONFIRMING signature: named modes (task-engaged, default-mode-like,
emergency) correspond to distinct, STABLE clusters/regions in the
joint channel space (e.g. task-engaged = high readiness + elevated
precision; default-mode-like = low readiness + high replay + low
precision; emergency = high arousal + high readiness + high veto),
with transitions between modes traceable as a CONTINUOUS trajectory
through channel space (gradual co-movement of the relevant channels)
rather than an instantaneous discrete flag flip -- EXCEPT for
hard-veto interrupts, which this claim's own text predicts should
look like a fast, forced transition overriding the rest of the
channel state.
FALSIFYING: the named "modes" do not correspond to any stable
clustering in channel space (channel values wander freely without
forming recognisable regions); or transitions between modes are
measurably instantaneous/discrete across ALL channels simultaneously
(indistinguishable from a one-hot module switch) rather than showing
channel-by-channel graded movement -- would falsify the "continuous
space, not separate modules" framing and support a discrete-module
reading instead.

claims.claim_title: Safety baseline and volatility are distinct control channels for arousal/readiness.
claims.falsifier_summary: The two manipulations produce statistically indistinguishable downstream footprints -- either signal moves the same consumers -- indicating the nominally separate computations collapse onto a single threat-level scalar, which is exactly what MECH-040 was written to rule out.
claims.required_event: A life containing a sustained low-magnitude harm floor and, factorially crossed with it, a bursty or oscillating prediction-error regime -- the CausalGridWorld hazard schedule and the world_rule_shift knob supply the two independent levers.
claims.manipulation: A 2x2 factorial: sustained-threat level (low/high, via a persistent low-magnitude hazard floor) crossed with PE volatility (low/high, via a bursty rule-shift schedule), with both regulators enabled in every cell.
claims.control: The low/low cell as baseline plus a both-off bit-identical arm to confirm the regulators are the only difference; each single-factor cell is the control for the other factor.
claims.DV: Channel-selective downstream footprints: override_signal and the CeA/BLA freeze-gain it scales versus the SD-069 burst envelope and the softmax temperature delta, measured per cell; the discriminating quantity is whether each consumer moves under only one factor.
claims.instrument: ree_core/regulators/broadcast_override.py computes sustained_threat over a rolling z_harm window and exposes override_signal, consumed at agent.py in the CeA/BLA gain, the PFC eta gain and the SalienceCoordinator affinity input; e3_selector exposes volatility_estimate, consumed by the z_beta encoder and ree_core/regulators/phasic_surprise_burst.py. No experiment records both footprints in one factorial.
claims.consumer_locus: The downstream consumers of arousal/readiness -- freeze gate and commit gate versus softmax temperature and burst envelope -- not the internal scalars themselves.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both channels must be enabled (use_broadcast_override and use_phasic_burst are each default False and bit-identical OFF, and the z_beta volatility consumer needs volatility_signal_dim > 0), and the two manipulations must move their own signal without moving the other: the sustained harm floor must raise sustained_threat while holding PE variance flat, and the bursty regime must raise volatility_estimate while holding the z_harm mean flat. Degenerate if the sustained_threat window saturates at the default 0.4 threshold in every cell.
claims.blocking_reason: Not a substrate gap: both channels, both regulators and their live consumers exist and are enableable. No experiment has ever crossed them factorially -- the only proposal, EXP-0353, is marked executed against the archived ree-v2/experiments-lab corpus that was removed from the index, and no v3 script names MECH-040.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note treats the demotion recommendation as the live risk; the more material fact is that no ree-v3 experiment script mentions MECH-040 at all, so the claim is untested rather than contested, and the archived-corpus conflict_ratio is not a V3 finding.
claims.auditor_notes: Worth pre-checking before queueing: override_sustained_threat_threshold defaults to 0.4 over a 12-tick window, so a hazard schedule strong enough to move sustained_threat may saturate it; a dose-graded harm floor with the threshold pinned is the cheap way to keep the factor graded.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test window must exercise BOTH SD-037's sustained_threat signal and Q-007's volatility_estimate through genuinely INDEPENDENT manipulations -- a sustained low-magnitude harm floor (moves sustained_threat, holds PE variance flat) crossed factorially with a bursty/oscillating PE regime (moves volatility_estimate, holds z_harm mean flat). Both use_phasic_burst and the SD-037 broadcast-override regulator must be enabled -- both are bit-identical OFF by default.
CONFIRMING: the two channels show distinguishable downstream footprints -- a low-sustained-threat/high-volatility cell moves volatility-driven consumers (SD-069 burst envelope, softmax temperature) while leaving override_signal/freeze-gate near baseline, and the mirror-image pattern for the reverse cell. A combined cell should show a non-strictly-multiplicative combination consistent with the claim's "OR" framing. claims.claim_title: Pre-commitment mode manager commits with hysteresis and switching costs.

claims.manipulation: Vary the hysteresis magnitude across at least three levels -- SalienceCoordinator exit_thresholds[current_mode] (the MECH-266 Schmitt lower rail) and/or BetaGate refractory ticks via apply_refractory (SD-034) -- with the incentive schedule identical across arms.
claims.control: A symmetric arm (exit_threshold 1.0, refractory 0) on the same seeds and the same incentive schedule, which fixes the memoryless expectation against which excess dwell is measured.
claims.DV: Excess dwell after incentive removal: ticks from incentive removal to the first beta_gate release, and sd034_committed_run_length, each expressed as a difference from the symmetric arm's distribution; plus switches per episode (_n_switches). claims.instrument: BetaGate.get_state exposes sd034_committed_run_length, sd034_refractory_remaining, hold_count and the MECH-090 elevation counters; SalienceCoordinator.tick returns current_mode, mode_switch_trigger and counts switches. claims.blocking_reason: The only V3 design that ran (V3-EXQ-068) measured commitment_rate, which ceilings at 1.0 in eval so both arms are pinned and nothing discriminates; EXP-1302 is gated on exactly that. claims.claim_title: mu/kappa stability overlays modulate mode entropy and switching pressure.
claims.falsifier_summary: With both fixes landed and both preconditions met, the behavioural DiD still fails the floor or switching pressure is unresponsive -- the confirmed internal entropy shift converts to nothing behavioural.
claims.required_event: Episodes whose environmental stability varies (resource/hazard density and rest schedule) so that PCCAnalog-derived mu moves, with contested modes genuinely occupied for a non-trivial fraction of steps.
claims.manipulation: Coupling ON versus OFF (salience_use_stability_temperature) in a 2x2 within-seed factorial crossed with STABLE versus VOLATILE environment, mu never written directly.
claims.control: Coupling-OFF arm at matched seeds sharing one onboarding deep-copied into all four cells, which is what makes the difference-in-differences valid.
claims.DV: Leg (a): behavioural difference-in-differences on state-visitation entropy and action entropy between coupling arms across environment regimes, against the 0.02 floor. Leg (b): dwell time and switch count independent of episode boundaries, as a function of mu and kappa.
claims.instrument: salience_coordinator.py records effective_temperature and mode_entropy; tests/contracts/test_mech048_stability_temperature.py pins the wiring; v3_exq_799 supplies the 2x2 DiD harness and confirmed the internal mechanism fires (mode-prior entropy differs 1.105 nats between coupling-ON STABLE and VOLATILE). No instrument exists downstream that converts a mode-prior entropy shift into behaviour at a detectable scale.
claims.consumer_locus: The SalienceCoordinator mode prior (softmax temperature) and its downstream write/selection consumer, not the switch threshold multiplier which was already wired.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Leg (a): mu must be driven from upstream environmental state through PCCAnalog, never injected -- under direct injection 'entropy falls as mu rises' is an arithmetic identity of the coupling. Leg (b): the contested modes must actually be occupied; V3-EXQ-464b/464c/467d/464d all recorded fraction_in_external_task = 0.0 at every seed across a 20x hysteresis sweep, so switching pressure is unmeasurable on a mode never entered.
claims.blocking_reason: Leg (a) is a pure consumer-reachability gap: V3-EXQ-799 confirmed mu reaches the mode prior and entropy moves with it, but the behavioural DiD measured 0.0007 and 0.002 against a 0.02 floor because nothing downstream converts prior entropy into action at detectable scale. The write_gate-breadth fix was routed to implement-substrate in the 2026-07-24 backlog autopsy and was never registered in substrate_queue, so it has no owning node. Leg (b) has a node but it is probe-gated and not ready.
false_positives: Reading V3-EXQ-799's FAIL as evidence against MECH-048 is wrong and already corrected in the record: the mechanism fired and was confirmed; what failed was a downstream consumer with no sensitivity, which is why the run is non_contributory / competence_implementation_gap.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: Leg (a)'s behavioural difference-in-differences needs a downstream consumer whose sensitivity to a mode-prior entropy shift is large enough to clear the registered 0.02 floor; at present a confirmed 1.105-nat prior-entropy change produces a 0.0007-0.002 behavioural change.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: A mode-prior entropy change that propagates into selection/write breadth, so that coupling-ON versus coupling-OFF differs in observable behaviour under the same environmental regime contrast.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-tick write/selection breadth alongside the existing effective_temperature and mode_entropy readouts, so the entropy-to-behaviour transfer function is measurable rather than inferred from a null DiD.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: The 2026-07-24 backlog autopsy routed this to implement-substrate as 'write_gate breadth' but no substrate_queue entry was ever minted; sd_032d owns the producer side only and sd_salience_contested_mode_occupancy is explicitly a different, deliberately unbundled build for leg (b).

claims.auditor_notes: Registering this node must not be read as authorising the build; it is the missing owner for a routing decision already taken and recorded.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-048 asserts overlays modulating BOTH
(a) mode-prior sharpness/entropy AND (b) switching pressure -- each leg
has its OWN precondition and its OWN confirmed-not-yet-testable history;
do not conflate a result on one leg with a verdict on the other.
Leg (a) precondition: requires mu driven from UPSTREAM environmental
state (via PCCAnalog), not direct injection -- "entropy falls as mu
rises" under direct injection is an arithmetic identity of the coupling
(asserted by the contract tests as wiring, not evidence). V3-EXQ-799
already did this correctly and confirmed the mechanism fires (mode-prior
entropy moves with mu, non-degenerate), but found a SEPARATE gap: no
behavioural DV downstream of the entropy shift currently has enough
sensitivity to detect it (write_gate breadth issue, routed to
/implement-substrate, not yet landed). A run against the UNFIXED
consumer path reproduces V3-EXQ-799's C1/C2 FAIL and is not a fresh test
-- it should self-route substrate_not_ready/competence_implementation_gap
until the write_gate fix lands.
Leg (b) precondition: requires the contested modes to actually be
occupied. V3-EXQ-464b/464c/467d/464d all FAIL with
fraction_in_external_task=0.0 at every seed across a 20x hysteresis
sweep -- switching pressure cannot be measured on a mode that is never
entered. This is a distinct, separate /implement-substrate build from
leg (a)'s consumer-path gap; do not bundle a leg-(a) fix as also
resolving leg (b).
CONFIRMING signature: once the write_gate/consumer-path fix lands (leg a)
and contested modes are genuinely occupied (leg b), driving mu from
upstream environmental state produces a measurable, seed-stable
behavioural difference-in-differences (visitation entropy and/or action
entropy) between coupling-ON and coupling-OFF arms, clearing the 0.02
floor V3-EXQ-799 used -- confirming the entropy-modulation mechanism
converts to real behaviour, not just an internal representational shift.
Separately, once modes are occupied, switching pressure (dwell time,
n_switches independent of episode boundaries) measurably responds to
mu/kappa.
FALSIFYING signature: even with both fixes landed and both preconditions
met, the behavioural DiD still fails to clear the floor (leg a) or
switching pressure shows no response to mu/kappa once modes are occupied
(leg b) -- either would mean the confirmed internal mechanism (entropy
genuinely shifts with mu) does not convert to any measurable behavioural
or switching-pressure effect, falsifying the claim's functional
consequence even though its internal wiring is confirmed correct.

claims.claim_title: Oxytocin/vasopressin analogues modulate relational topology and mode priors.
claims.falsifier_summary: Bonding and defensive behaviour are fully reproduced by the generic threat/salience mode_prior applied uniformly, with no per-agent relational-distance state doing any work.
claims.required_event: An affiliative signal directed at one specific other agent j and, separately, a boundary-threat signal from a different agent m, within the same life, so that per-agent addressing can be distinguished from a global shift.
claims.manipulation: Deliver the affiliative and threat signals to distinct named agents while holding total signal magnitude matched, and ablate the per-agent relational-distance state so the same signals can only act through the existing generic threat/salience channel.
claims.control: The generic-channel arm is the control: identical signals routed through a single scalar threat/affiliation variable applied uniformly regardless of which agent triggered them.
claims.DV: Per-agent selectivity -- the change in relational distance R_self_j and in bonding-mode prior for trajectories involving j, minus the change in R_self_k for an untouched agent k -- and the mirrored quantity for the defensive direction toward m, with generalisation across agents as the falsifying signature.
claims.instrument: Absent. ree_core/amygdala/cea.py supplies one generic threat/salience mode_prior channel with no per-agent addressing, and there is no relational-distance state to read at all.
claims.consumer_locus: The per-target-agent mode-prior control plane -- whether relational state is addressed per other agent or only globally -- not generic arousal or valence.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Re-confirmed against live HEAD for this audit: zero hits across ree_core for relational_topology, relational_distance, pair_bond, oxytocin, vasopressin, mirror_model, shadow_bundle and other_self, and ree_core/environment/ contains only causal_grid_world.py. Without a per-other-agent state variable there is no object for a relational distance to attach to, and the claim collapses into 'arousal/valence exists', already covered by ARC-005.
claims.blocking_reason: Both preconditions are unmet: no multi-agent relational substrate (the ARC-010 dependency) and no per-target-agent addressing in the existing mode-prior channel. The proper test sits at the V5 social boundary.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-160 is listed as mentioning this claim and describes a MECH-051/052 analog; its line 61 is a prediction comment in a Q-023 convergence-pair script, not a test of relational topology, and it must not be read as partial V3 coverage.
claims.auditor_notes: Only the literature proposal LIT-0800 is progressable now. Do not mint a V3 stopgap for per-agent addressing: without the ARC-010 relational substrate it would have no agents to address, which is the degenerate case the claim's own precondition already names.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) a multi-agent relational substrate with a per-other-agent state variable R_{self,j} distinguishing specific detected agents j -- this is the ARC-010 dependency, confirmed absent from ree_core/ (zero hits for mirror_model, shadow_bundle, other_self, a 4th independent confirmation this campaign) -- and (b) a mode-prior control plane that can be biased PER TARGET AGENT rather than globally. ARC-005 exists and is active, but its mode_prior mechanism today (ree_core/amygdala/cea.py) is a single generic threat/salience channel with no per-agent addressing. Without (a), there is no object for "agent j" to attach a relational distance to -- the claim collapses into "arousal/valence exists," already covered by existing ARC-005/ARC-046 machinery. Zero hits anywhere in ree-v3/ for relational_topology, relational_distance, pair_bond, oxytocin, or vasopressin.
CONFIRMING: once ARC-010 lands, a per-agent, bidirectional, dissociable effect -- affiliative signal toward a specific agent j lowers R_{self,j} and raises bonding- mode prior/shared-reward weighting specifically for trajectories involving j, while leaving R_{self,k} for other agents k unchanged; a boundary-threat signal from a different agent m raises R_{self,m} and defensive-mode prior specifically toward m, without generalizing to j.
FALSIFYING: bonding/defense behavior is fully explained by the existing generic threat/salience mode_prior channel applied uniformly regardless of which agent triggered it -- no per-agent relational-distance state does any work, and collapsing all agents into a single scalar threat/affiliation signal reproduces the same mode-prior shifts.

claims.claim_title: Prolactin analogue stabilises care-investment persistence.
claims.falsifier_summary: C_j decays at the same rate or faster with the persistence term active; OR the term produces indiscriminate stickiness -- uniformly high C_j regardless of BondStrength_j -- rather than differential persistence keyed to established bonds, contradicting the claimed division of labour between oxytocin (creates closeness) and prolactin (sustains care where closeness exists).
claims.required_event: A sustained caregiving-type relationship with a persistent other agent, competing against a higher-immediate-reward alternative under delayed payoff, resource scarcity or asymmetric exchange.
claims.manipulation: Activate versus ablate the prolactin-analogue persistence term on C_j decay (C_j decay slowed per alpha_P * BondStrength_j - beta * Decay), on otherwise matched agents.
claims.control: Matched agent with the persistence term ablated, identical bonds, identical competing-reward schedule and identical seeds; plus a varied-BondStrength_j arm to test whether the effect is differential rather than indiscriminate.
claims.DV: Duration and magnitude of continued resource/attention investment in the caregiving relationship before defection to the higher-immediate-reward option, AND the dependence of that persistence on BondStrength_j -- a persistence that is uniformly high regardless of bond strength counts against the claim, not for it.
claims.instrument: Absent at every level. There is no C_j, no BondStrength_j and no relational-distance recorder, because the ARC-010 and MECH-051 substrate that would produce them is unbuilt; nothing in ree_core/ logs a per-other-agent investment trajectory.
claims.consumer_locus: The control-plane care-investment weight w_j ~ C_j * (1 - R_self_j) and its decay rate -- the claim asserts a persistence modulator on an existing bond, not a bond-formation mechanism (which is MECH-051's oxytocin/vasopressin role).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Four stacked requirements, none met. ARC-010 mirror modelling is absent from ree_core/ (zero hits for mirror_model / other_self), MECH-051 must supply BondStrength_j and relational distance R_self_j, MECH-048 mu/kappa stability overlays must be promoted, and a care-investment weight C_j must exist in the control plane. Reconfirmed 2026-09-22: zero hits anywhere in ree-v3/ for prolactin, care_invest, care_weight, persistence_gain or bond_strength -- pure documentation-stage mechanism.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: ARC-010 is v5-phased and absent, MECH-051 is substrate_conditional, and no care-investment weight exists. The proper test sits at the V5 mirror-modelling boundary, in a persistent multi-agent setting with an exposed per-other-agent investment weight and its decay rate.
claims.auditor_notes: The second falsifying clause (indiscriminate stickiness) is the one that actually discriminates this claim from a generic persistence bonus, and it needs BondStrength_j to VARY across relationships -- so any eventual V5 testbed must carry at least two other agents at different bond strengths, not one. MIRROR-7 is blocked/high and bundles MECH-052 with MECH-127; the missing edge is that neither has a substrate_queue entry.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires ARC-010 (confirmed absent from ree_core/), MECH-051 (oxytocin/vasopressin relational topology, supplying BondStrength_j and relational distance R_{self,j} -- itself substrate_conditional, digested this same wave), and MECH-048 (mu/kappa stability overlays, currently provisional) promoted -- plus an actual care-investment weight C_j implemented in the control plane (w_j ~ C_j * (1 - R_{self,j})) and a testbed presenting a sustained caregiving-type goal/relationship competing against short-term reward under delayed payoff, resource scarcity, or asymmetric exchange. Zero hits anywhere in ree-v3/ for prolactin, care_invest, care_weight, or persistence_gain -- pure documentation-stage mechanism.
CONFIRMING: an agent with the prolactin-analogue persistence term active (C_j decay slowed per alpha_P * BondStrength_j - beta * Decay) continues investing resources/ attention in a caregiving-type relationship for LONGER, with greater resistance to defecting toward a competing higher-immediate-reward option, than an otherwise- matched agent with the persistence term ablated -- across delayed-reward, resource- cost, and asymmetric-exchange conditions.
FALSIFYING: C_j decays at the same rate or faster in the prolactin-analogue-active agent as in the ablated control under matched conditions. Also falsifying: activating the persistence term produces indiscriminate stickiness -- uniformly high C_j regardless of BondStrength_j -- rather than differential persistence keyed to established bonds, contradicting the claimed division of labor (oxytocin creates closeness, prolactin sustains care where closeness already exists).
