claims.claim_title: Signed harm/benefit prediction-error precision channels remain distinct.
claims.falsifier_summary: The benefit channel, once built, shares its variance state with the harm channel; or downstream sensitivity to harm-PE-only and benefit-PE-only manipulations is statistically indistinguishable; or the benefit channel cannot train or stabilise unless driven by the harm channel's precision state.
claims.required_event: Trials in which harm-PE and benefit-PE take different values -- an appetitive outcome that is better than predicted while the aversive outcome is as predicted, and the converse -- so the two signed channels are decoupled in the same episode.
claims.manipulation: Perturb harm-PE only, then benefit-PE only, at matched magnitude on matched seeds, once a benefit-side precision-weighted channel exists; and additionally share versus separate the two channels' variance state as the architectural comparator.
claims.control: The unperturbed arm plus a shared-precision arm in which one variance state serves both channels, which is the falsifying architecture the claim denies.
claims.DV: Divergence in downstream control-plane response between harm-PE-only and benefit-PE-only perturbations at matched magnitude -- dACC-equivalent precision-weighted PE output and the resulting commitment or control-demand change -- plus the numerical independence of the two variance states (cross-correlation of the two precision traces under decoupled drive).
claims.instrument: The harm side is instrumented (DACCAdaptiveControl precision-weighted affective-pain PE, dacc._last_pe_unsaturated). The benefit side has no instrument at all: E3.benefit_eval_head is a plain proximity-regression head with no PE, no variance tracker and no control-plane consumer.
claims.consumer_locus: The control-plane readout that consumes precision-weighted signed PE (dACC analogue), not the E3 score sum.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both a harm-side and a benefit-side signed precision-weighted PE channel must be live, each with its own forward model and its own variance/precision state updated independently of the other. Re-verified today: e2_harm_a.py and e2_harm_s.py are dedicated harm forward models, while no benefit forward model, no benefit precision or variance tracker, and no pi_H/pi_B symbol exists anywhere in ree_core. The precondition is architecturally unmet.
claims.blocking_reason: The benefit half of the comparison does not exist: no benefit forward model, no benefit-side precision or variance state, and no control-plane consumer for a benefit PE. The existing benefit valuation head also never converged (EXQ-085m r2 = -8.6, EXQ-183 auc 0.538), so even a freshly built channel would start non-degenerate only after ARC-030 is repaired.
false_positives: Reading the claim as 'no signed precision channel exists in V3' would be wrong in the harm direction: E2HarmAForward/E2HarmSForward feed an explicitly precision-weighted affective-pain PE into the dACC, so the asymmetry is one channel present and one absent, not zero.
claims.auditor_notes: The WWA's own 2026-08-08 request -- that governance consider rescoping the title away from 'remain distinct', which presupposes a parity the substrate lacks -- was never raised as a governance flag (the only MECH-054 flag, GFLAG-0031, is an unrelated resolved literature issue). That is the missing edge.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison requires BOTH a harm-side and a benefit-side channel to be actually exercised live, each producing its own precision-weighted signed prediction-error from its own forward model, with each channel's precision/variance state stored and updated independently of the other's.
CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08 digestion pass): ARCHITECTURALLY ASYMMETRIC -- precondition NOT met. HARM side: E2HarmAForward/E2HarmSForward (MECH-258) are dedicated forward models, consumed by DACCAdaptiveControl as an explicit "precision-weighted affective-pain prediction error." BENEFIT side: E3Selector's benefit_eval_head (ARC-030/MECH-112) is a plain proximity-regression head with no paired forward model and no benefit-specific precision/variance tracker -- no analogue of _running_variance or a benefit-side dACC exists anywhere in ree_core. The learned benefit_eval_head has never converged (EXQ-085m: r2=-8.6; EXQ-183: auc=0.538, near chance); ARC-030's one PASS came from fixed-weight CEM scoring used INSTEAD OF the learned head, and ARC-030 remains candidate/pending_retest_after_substrate. Today's substrate has ONE live signed-precision-weighted PE channel (harm), not two -- MECH-054's comparison cannot yet be run.
CONFIRMING: once a benefit-side channel reaches the same class as the harm-side one -- a benefit forward model whose PE is consumed by its own precision-weighted control-plane readout, verified numerically and causally independent of the harm channel's -- and downstream consumers respond differently to a manipulation that decouples harm-PE from benefit-PE, that is confirming evidence.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (a) the benefit-side channel, once built, shares its precision/variance state with the harm channel; (b) downstream consumers show statistically indistinguishable sensitivity to harm-PE-only vs. benefit-PE-only manipulations; or (c) the benefit-side channel requires being driven by the harm channel's precision state to train or stabilize at all.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): the title/wording presupposes parity between harm and benefit channels that doesn't currently exist -- flagged for governance to consider whether MECH-054 should be rescoped (e.g. "benefit- side signed-PE precision channel does not yet exist; harm-side does") rather than "remain distinct". Also flagging a possible cross-claim consistency question against MECH-043's "unsigned PE" framing for the sibling dopamine-like channel -- not resolved here, worth a synthesis pass relating MECH-043/054/002/055's precision-channel taxonomy.

claims.claim_title: Affective channel separation keeps hedonic tone, valence, and signed PE distinct.
claims.falsifier_summary: Any two axes move in a fixed predictable ratio under a single-axis perturbation, or VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the harm-side forward-model PE are numerically redundant under decoupling -- one collapsed harm scalar wearing two labels.
claims.required_event: A sustained mismatch between the agent's action-conditioned forward model and the world, with harm exposure held matched to control.
claims.manipulation: world_rule_shift (SD-MEL-PRODUCER), which periodically re-permutes the action-to-displacement map so every action-conditioned forward model including E2HarmAForward becomes systematically wrong, decoupling the dACC harm-PE from the z_harm_s level that feeds VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE.
claims.control: A no-shift arm at matched seeds and matched measured harm exposure, plus the three levers explicitly ruled out first (AIC descending attenuation, harm_nonredundancy_weight, env_drift) so the null is not attributed to a dead lever.
claims.DV: Cross-axis correlation and variance/timing signatures -- specifically whether VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the dACC-consumed harm forward-model PE are numerically redundant (correlation near 1) under the decoupling manipulation, and whether any two axes move in a fixed ratio under a single-axis perturbation.
claims.instrument: The narrowed driver exists as ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_1062_mech055_affect_channel_separation_diagnostic.py (C1-C4 cover both of the claim's falsifiers at representational level), but it is UNTRACKED in the shared checkout and not in experiment_queue.json; no instrument exists for a benefit-side signed PE because no such channel exists.
claims.consumer_locus: The representational level -- the residue-field VALENCE vector and the dACC-consumed precision-weighted harm PE -- not a behavioural readout, since V3-EXQ-799 found no downstream behavioural DV sensitive enough for axis 1.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All three axes must be independently perturbable; re-verified today that axis 3's benefit half does not exist (no benefit forward model or benefit-side precision tracker anywhere in ree_core, only E2HarmAForward), so only the narrowed two-axis-plus-harm-only test is non-degenerate, and the decoupling manipulation must move the harm forward-model residual while leaving harm exposure matched.
claims.blocking_reason: The harm/benefit duality the claim's own wording requires cannot be measured: there is no benefit-side forward model or benefit-side precision tracker in ree_core, so axis 3's positive half has no recordable DV. The narrowed two-axis-plus-harm-only leg is fully runnable -- its driver is written and its lever is substrate-verified -- and merely unqueued.
false_positives: The harm_nonredundancy_weight lever reads like an available decoupling knob but is a measured floor (baseline cosine^2 8.5e-05 to 0.025 in V3-EXQ-323), and it is a dataclass field with no from_dims kwarg, so passing it is silently swallowed.
claims.auditor_notes: v3_exq_1062 is an UNTRACKED file in the shared ree-v3 checkout -- another session's live work. Do not treat its presence as a landed artifact, and do not touch it; the coordinator should confirm ownership before citing it as instrumentation.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires each of the three named axes independently computable and independently perturbable -- (a) hedonic-stability (mu/kappa overlays), (b) VALENCE vector components with non-zero cross-candidate variance on >=2 components simultaneously, (c) signed PE precision from a genuine forward-model- based precision-weighted PE on BOTH harm and benefit sides. CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08): (a) PARTIALLY MET -- mu now reaches both mode-prior temperature and threshold (SD-032d, 2026-07-21), V3-EXQ-799 confirmed non-degenerate internal variance (1.105 nats between coupling states); downstream behavioural legibility gap is separate and doesn't block a representational-level test. (b) representationally real (VALENCE_COMPONENTS, ree_core/residue/field.py) but experimentally untested (MECH-035 records no prior run as of 2026-08-06). (c) NOT MET per MECH-054's 2026-08-08 finding -- only the harm-side channel is real/precision-tracked; no benefit-side analogue exists. Consequence: the full three-axis-with-harm/benefit-duality test cannot yet run; a narrower two-axis-plus-harm-only test CAN run now and should self-route substrate_not_ready if attempted as a verdict on the full claim before the benefit-side channel lands.
COLLAPSE-RISK CHECK (new finding, 2026-08-08): before any distinctness test is credited, it must rule out a specific risk -- REE carries TWO harm-related representations downstream of the same z_harm_s/z_harm_a signal: VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE (residue-field tag, axis 2) and the DACC-consumed harm forward-model PE (axis 3). Nothing currently shows these carry independent variance rather than being one collapsed harm scalar wearing two labels -- the same failure class MECH-048 hit before its 2026-07-21 fix (an arithmetic identity mistaken for a measurement). A test showing these merely live in different variables, without showing independent variance under a manipulation that perturbs one without the other, has not established distinctness.
CONFIRMING: under the two-axis-plus-harm-only test, manipulations targeting each axis individually produce measurable, non-degenerate effects on that axis's own documented downstream role WITHOUT matched lockstep effects on the other axes -- no single upstream perturbation moves all measured axes in a fixed, predictable ratio. Separately, VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the DACC harm-PE show measurably different variance/timing signatures under a manipulation that decouples their upstream sources, ruling out the collapsed-harm-scalar case above.
FALSIFYING: (i) any two axes move in a fixed, predictable ratio under manipulations designed to perturb only one; (ii) VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the harm-side forward-model PE are numerically redundant (correlation ~1) under a decoupling manipulation; (iii) once built, the benefit-side signed-PE channel requires being driven by or sharing state with VALENCE_WANTING/LIKING to train or stabilize, mirroring MECH-054's own falsifier (c).
NAMING NOTE: REE's "hedonic tone" (mu/kappa) is NOT the standard affective- neuroscience hedonic-tone/valence distinction -- it functions as a control-plane stability/inertia regulator (softmax-temperature modulator), not a content-bearing affect quale. The real hedonic-impact-like content (Berridge wanting/liking) lives inside the VALENCE vector (axis 2), not axis 1.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): the MECH-043/054/002/055 precision- channel taxonomy synthesis flagged in MECH-054's digestion is reinforced here -- MECH-035's VALENCE vector also carries harm-adjacent (HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE) and benefit-adjacent (WANTING/LIKING) components that sit conceptually on top of the same signals MECH-054/055 assign to "signed PE precision." A synthesis pass should map MECH-002 -> MECH-043 -> MECH-054 -> MECH-035 -> MECH-055 explicitly and resolve whether VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE is a redundant readout of the DACC harm signal or a genuinely independent channel -- undocumented either way as of this pass.
CATEGORY JUDGMENT CALL: epistemic_category is set to standard for consistency with sibling MECH-054's treatment of the same underlying substrate gap (see MECH-054's own what_would_answer). A stricter reading -- since this claim's own wording requires the harm/benefit duality inside axis 3, and that duality's benefit half is architecturally absent -- could defensibly argue substrate_conditional instead; flagged for governance to revisit if the stricter reading is preferred.

claims.claim_title: Residue should constrain trajectories before distorting core representations.
claims.falsifier_summary: Last-quarter harm under trajectory-wide placement exceeds endpoint-only by more than the tolerance on a properly powered sweep, or intermediate residue mass is statistically indistinguishable from zero -- trajectory-first placement wired but inert.
claims.required_event: Committed multi-step trajectories through graded hazard proximity in which intermediate steps carry harm-relevant signal that the terminal state alone does not encode.
claims.manipulation: Restrict ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory to the terminal step only (endpoint-only ablation), using the same monkey-patch swap V3-EXQ-397 already uses to null the full-horizon read out.
claims.control: Trajectory-wide placement, which is the live default read path for both E3's Phi_R term and hippocampal rollout terrain scoring, at matched seeds and episodes (at least 3 seeds / 200 episodes, EVB-0039 scale).
claims.DV: Last-quarter-episode enacted harm ratio, trajectory-wide over endpoint-only against the 1.05 tolerance, plus intermediate residue mass localised along the executed path rather than only at the terminus.
claims.instrument: ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory (ree-v3/ree_core/residue/field.py:618) is read live by e3_selector.py:1391 and hippocampal/module.py:1775; the three rehearsal-lane hard invariants the WWA names do NOT exist anywhere in ree-v3.
claims.consumer_locus: Trajectory-level gating -- hippocampal rollout costs and E3 thresholds -- ahead of any distortion of the core representation.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The environment must produce mid-path harm-relevant state changes distinct from the terminal state (graded hazard proximity, harm_gradient_enabled / INF-ENV-001), and the trajectories under test must be genuinely committed -- MECH-094 blocks residue accumulation from hypothesis-tagged rehearsal, so a rehearsal-only run cannot exercise the claim.
claims.blocking_reason: Legs (a) and (b) are runnable now -- the full-horizon read is default-wired into both consumers and the endpoint-only swap pattern already exists -- but no V3-scale re-test has ever been queued. Leg (c) is not measurable: ledger_edit_detected_count, domination_lock_in_events and explanation_policy_divergence_rate appear nowhere in ree-v3.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim is not substrate-blocked, despite carrying no V3 evidence: the mechanism is confirmed live and default-wired, and the WWA's own 2026-08-08 flag says as much -- what is absent is a queued experiment.
claims.auditor_notes: Criterion (c) of the WWA names three recorders that do not exist in ree-v3 (whole-repo grep returns nothing): either they are built as driver-side counters or criterion (c) is dropped from the scoring set -- the coordinator should decide, since the WWA currently makes an unmeasurable invariant FALSIFYING. All prior support is pre-V3 (ree-v1-minimal EVB-0039, ree-v2 revalidation).
claims.what_would_answer:
Asks whether placing residue pressure in trajectory-level gating (hippocampal rollout costs, E3 thresholds) ahead of representational distortion actually reduces enacted harm relative to a residue signal that only reads the terminal/endpoint state -- the same question EVB-0039 (residue_trajectory_placement, ree-v1-minimal 2026-02-26 PASS, ree-v2 revalidation 2026-03-14 PASS) answered on pre-V3 substrate, reprised against V3's live mechanism.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test environment must produce intermediate (mid-path) harm-relevant world-state changes that are distinct from the terminal state -- i.e. a hazard/harm signal attributable to specific intermediate steps along the executed path, not only encoded in the final state. Without that, TRAJECTORY-WIDE and ENDPOINT-ONLY residue placement are indistinguishable and the test is vacuous (this was true of EVB-0039's CausalGridWorld hazard layout and must hold for its V3 successor too). Trajectories under test must be genuinely committed (non-hypothesis-tagged); MECH-094 blocks residue accumulation from rehearsal/replay content, so a rehearsal-only run cannot exercise this claim.
CONFIRMING: reprise EVB-0039's own operationalization directly on the V3 substrate, comparing (i) TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement, using ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory() over the full step horizon -- already the live default read path for both E3's Phi_R term (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) and hippocampal rollout terrain scoring (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py) -- against (ii) an ENDPOINT-ONLY ablation, restricting evaluate_trajectory() to the terminal step only, via the same code-swap pattern V3-EXQ-046/397/397c/397d already use to null it out for ARC-007. A CONFIRMING result requires, across a multi-seed sweep at least as large as EVB-0039's (3 seeds / 200 episodes): (a) path-spread criterion -- trajectory-wide intermediate residue mass is non-zero and localised along the executed path, not only at the terminus; (b) harm-avoidance criterion -- last-quarter-episode harm under TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement is no worse than ENDPOINT-ONLY by more than the EVB-0039 harm_tolerance_factor (ratio <= 1.05), ideally recovering a margin closer to the original ree-v1-minimal PASS (0.724 vs 0.8127, ~11%) than the much thinner ree-v2 revalidation margin (1.2493 vs 1.2273, ~1.8%, which only passed inside tolerance); and (c) MECH-056's own rehearsal-lane hooks hold over the same sweep: ledger_edit_detected_count == 0, domination_lock_in_events == 0, and explanation_policy_divergence_rate <= 0.05.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): last-quarter-episode harm under TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement exceeds ENDPOINT-ONLY by more than the harm_tolerance_factor (ratio > 1.05) on the V3 substrate across a properly-powered multi-seed sweep -- i.e. trajectory-level gating measurably fails to reduce enacted harm relative to judging only the terminal state, on an environment materially more complex than the CausalGridWorld toy grid both prior PASSes used. Also falsifying: the path-spread criterion failing (trajectory_wide_mean_intermediate_residue_mass statistically indistinguishable from zero), which would show that evaluate_trajectory()'s full-horizon read is present in code but contributes no real signal beyond what the terminal step alone gives in the live E3/ hippocampal gating path -- i.e. "trajectory-first placement" is wired but inert. claims.required_event: Genuinely generated multi-step committed sequences -- 3-waypoint subgoal runs in CausalGridWorld subgoal_mode, with arrival detected by position rather than by grid cell type.

claims.DV: Harm rate and path efficiency per arm at matched budget, conditioned on genuinely committed spans, together with committed-sequence count and mean length as the gate; the architecturally predicted ordering is FULL below NO_ATTRIBUTION below NO_GATING.
claims.instrument: v3_exq_139 and v3_exq_203 record n_committed_sequences, mean_committed_seq_len and per-arm harm_rate; causal_grid_world.py supplies subgoal_mode plus the SD-094 subgoal_arrival_position_check fix; agent.beta_gate and the E3 running_variance path supply both manipulations.

claims.claim_title: Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.
claims.falsifier_summary: The conditional channel adds nothing beyond a time-lagged transform of residual error, or MERGED performs at least as well as SEPARATED at V3 scale -- the V1-minimal separation result was scale-specific and the separation is not operationally load-bearing.
claims.required_event: A trained agent making commit decisions while both a conditional predictive-uncertainty estimate and a residual prediction error are available for the same transition.
claims.manipulation: SEPARATED versus MERGED: gate commitment on the SD-063 per-transition conditional predictive variance (use_conditional_precision_gate with a trained quantile head) versus on the state-blind running-variance EMA derived from residual error.
claims.control: Matched seeds and matched training budget, with an untrained-head arm as the vacuity control and the SD-031 agency-residual check confirming the head has not absorbed the E2 agency signal.
claims.DV: Two quantities, kept separate: (a) whether the confidence channel is a function of residual error -- correlation of predicted uncertainty with the EMA of realised error ACROSS TIME, which must be low; and (b) operational value -- task harm under SEPARATED versus MERGED at matched training. Per-point precision_error_corr with realised error should be HIGH, not low, and must not be used as the distinctness test.
claims.instrument: Substrate present, claim untagged. e2_world_uncertainty.py records the predictive distribution and e3_selector.py:4043 records the EMA path, and tests/contracts/test_sd063_conditional_uncertainty_head.py pins the head -- but V3-EXQ-712 and 716/716a all carry claim_ids = [], so no V3 manifest reaches MECH-059; its sole scored entry is the 2026-03-14 ree-v1-minimal/v2 run.
claims.consumer_locus: E3's commit gate -- which estimate the commitment decision reads -- not the encoder or the forward model's point prediction.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both arms must be instantiated AND trained: use_e2_world_uncertainty, its online phased training, and use_conditional_precision_gate are all default False, and an untrained head leaves predictive_variance near-uniform (the 604a / 624a / 614d / 640a vacuous-channel failure class). The two channels must also not be trivially identical, and the correlation target must be re-specified so a state-blind EMA cannot pass by carrying no information.
claims.blocking_reason: As written the falsifier is non-discriminating: |corr(confidence, PE)| < 0.3 is satisfied trivially by the state-blind EMA (corr ~0.0 by construction) and failed by the informative quantile head (0.379), so the criterion selects the uninformative channel. Compounding this, all three enabling flags are default False and no V3 run carries MECH-059 in claim_ids.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: MECH-059's single scored experimental entry is the 2026-03-14 ree-v1-minimal/v2 control_plane_precision_separation run; the claim has zero V3 manifests, so 'un-retested V3-scale extension' is right but understates it -- the V3 substrate that would test it has existed since V3-EXQ-712 and was tagged to no claim.

claims.claim_title: Pre-commit simulation and post-commit realized-error channels must stay responsibility-distinct via write-boundary enforcement.
claims.falsifier_summary: Contamination produces no measurable residue inflation at V3 scale (write-locus separation has no detectable effect), or the contaminated arm is at least as good as the clean arm on harm ordering, which would falsify write-boundary enforcement as load-bearing.
claims.required_event: A pre-commit simulation/rollout that produces a harm estimate, followed by the post-commit environment step that returns realised harm -- both already occur every tick in V3.
claims.manipulation: Route the pre-commit simulated harm into the durable residue field by calling REEAgent.update_residue with hypothesis_tag=False on the rollout-derived harm estimate (contaminated arm), leaving the post-commit path untouched.
claims.control: The production arm, where ResidueField.accumulate refuses hypothesis-tagged content (MECH-094) and update_residue is guarded by 'owned and not hypothesis_tag', so only post-commit realised harm writes.
claims.DV: Two, matching the V1 EXQ-005 pair: total_residue mass at end of run in the contaminated arm versus the clean arm (inflation ratio), and last-quarter harm outcome ordering (clean at least as good as contaminated within a small margin), both across at least three seeds.
claims.instrument: ResidueField registers total_residue as a buffer and returns it from accumulate and get_state; update_residue emits residue_* metrics per tick; harm_this_episode and the environment harm signal give the ordering DV. Every element of the DV pair is already recorded.
claims.consumer_locus: The durable write boundary into the persistent residue field, downstream of commitment -- not the E1 training path and not episode reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both arms must show non-zero variance in residue accumulation and in harm ordering across seeds; a run where total_residue is flat regardless of contamination cannot discriminate. The contaminated arm must inject genuine pre-commit simulated harm (E3 rollout harm estimates on the selected trajectory), not replayed real harm, or the manipulation is a volume effect rather than a write-locus effect.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks a run. Every element exists: pre-commit harm estimates from the E3 rollout scorers, a public update_residue that accepts hypothesis_tag, the MECH-094 refusal gate as the clean arm, and total_residue as the recorded DV. The only gap is that no V3 experiment tags MECH-060 -- V3-EXQ-140 built the same contaminated/clean pair but tagged MECH-094 and measured harm_eval discrimination instead of residue mass.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The 2026-08-08 'superseded/measurement_test_design_defect' verdict attaches to the legacy ree-v2 provenance sweep, not to the V1-minimal EXQ-005 PASS and not to the V3 extension, which has never been attempted.
claims.auditor_notes: Duplicate-node risk with MECH-067: the same driver could serve both, but MECH-067 needs a phase-and-store audit across sleep and simulation, while MECH-060 needs only the two-arm residue-mass pair; keeping them separate avoids importing MECH-067's blocked release condition into a runnable test.

contaminated (pre-commit sim_error leaking into the persistent

contaminated (pre-commit sim_error allowed to write into the

residue inflation (contaminated condition's total_residue
substantially exceeds clean's) and harm ordering (clean condition's

claims.claim_title: Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.
claims.falsifier_summary: At V3 scale the pre-commit and post-commit streams become highly correlated at or above the bar, or the blended arm matches or beats the boundary arm on harm under matched harm exposure -- with a non-zero harm-event count, so the null is a measurement and not an empty run.
claims.required_event: A commitment transition on a trial where the agent subsequently contacts harm, so that a pre-commit E1/E2 prediction error and a post-commit realized-harm error both exist for the same decision.
claims.manipulation: Route error by commit state (WITH-BOUNDARY: pre-commit error only to the prediction path, post-commit error only to the harm-evaluation path) versus a BLENDED arm in which both errors flow to both paths at every step.
claims.control: The BLENDED no-boundary arm on identical seeds, task, candidate set and update budget, plus a soft learned-gate arm (MINIMAL_BOUNDARY) to separate the binary token from any boundary at all.
claims.DV: Absolute Pearson correlation between the pre-commit and post-commit error streams (distinct-signals, bar |r| < 0.7 at V1, < 0.30 as pre-registered at V3) AND the WITH-BOUNDARY minus BLENDED difference in last-quartile harm under a policy that actually learns from the routed loss.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-155 records both streams and the correlation, but in a bespoke harness that builds its own gate over CausalGridWorldV2 rather than reading the substrate commit flag; ree_core exposes commit state as e3_selector commit_state is_committed / committed_now, and there is no per-stream pre/post error recorder in ree_core itself.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 commit boundary in e3_selector.py (variance-threshold commit, _committed_trajectory) and the routing of error from that boundary into the E1/E2 prediction path versus the E3 harm-evaluation path.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both a pre-commit error stream and a post-commit error stream must be separately recorded on the SAME run, with non-zero cross-seed variance in their correlation, and the run must produce enough agent-attributed harm contacts for the harm-error stream to be estimable at all; V3-EXQ-155 produced n_harm_events = 0 in all three arms, so the comparison was vacuous by construction.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate commit flag has exactly one live consumer (hippocampal persistence_appraisal_compute), not error routing; the only V3 test built its own gate and produced zero harm events with a random action policy, so both the distinct-signals and the boundary-helps DVs were degenerate.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The V3-EXQ-155 FAIL is not evidence against MECH-061: its own data-quality gate C7 failed (n_harm_events = 0, last_q_harm = 0.0 in all three arms under a random action policy), so C1/C3/C4 are unmet preconditions, not results.
claims.auditor_notes: A V3 retest needs two changes the current script does not have: a policy that actually consumes the routed loss (155 acted randomly) and a harm-contact rate above the 30-event floor. Reading the real e3 commit flag instead of an episode-fraction phase split would also make the test about the substrate boundary rather than a simulated one.

claims.required_event: E3 selection ticks on a warmed, non-degenerate agent whose action-value landscape has dynamic range, carrying genuine surprise events that the phasic lever can lock to and quiet intervals in which only the tonic lever acts.

claims.control: The T0P0 cell is the joint-OFF reference and each single-lever cell is the other's control; the frozen shared multiplier is what makes the four cells commensurable, since a live closed-loop entropy set-point regulates the very DV the arms are compared on.
claims.DV: Sub-claim (i): population-level sin_angle between the tonic and phasic effect vectors against the orthogonality margin, on a representative seed sample rather than the best seed. Sub-claim (ii): a double dissociation -- toggling one lever without the other produces measurably different behavioural signatures -- read with a bounded, asserted phasic duty cycle and recorded sustained-entropy headroom.
claims.instrument: The levers and most of the telemetry exist (ree_core/regulators/phasic_surprise_burst.py, the noise-floor tonic lever, experiments/_lib/probe_warmup.py, _lib/entropy_headroom.py, _lib/robustness_bars.py, the 777/779/963 driver lineage). The missing instrument is the freeze/share API on SelectionEntropyFloor -- no freeze(), no one-way latch, no frozen-multiplier accessor -- so the entropy DV cannot be held constant across arms.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 softmax temperature readout where the tonic baseline and the phasic event-locked transient act on the SAME channel -- the question is whether they remain separable degrees of freedom there, not whether two neuromodulatory systems exist upstream.

claims.claim_title: Reality-coherence conflict lane modulates loop precision and commitment thresholds before execution lock-in.
claims.falsifier_summary: A live, computed RC_conflict produces no measurable pre-commit change in lock-in pressure or threshold, so the lane is not separable from S1/S3; or the shift tracks absolute authority magnitude independent of internal precision, refuting the ratio account; or no hysteresis appears.
claims.required_event: Matched-surface-content observations that differ only in authority or provenance -- a spoofed versus a verified source signal on an otherwise identical instruction or observation -- delivered during the pre-commit window.
claims.manipulation: Vary the authority/provenance mismatch at matched content, and cross it with the ratio manipulation the claim's literature grounding demands: one arm holding absolute authority-signal strength fixed while varying internal E1 precision, another holding internal precision fixed while varying authority-signal strength, with the ratio moved equivalently in both.
claims.control: Verified-provenance trials at matched content and matched surprise magnitude, plus a benign-novelty arm that produces the same raw prediction error without any provenance mismatch -- the discriminator between a reality-coherence lane and a generic conflict signal.
claims.DV: Pre-commit change in the effective commitment threshold and in lock-in pressure attributable to the provenance manipulation, tested for (i) dependence on the precision RATIO rather than authority magnitude alone, (ii) hysteresis (theta_high > theta_low with bounded recovery), and (iii) a guarded floor that is not chronically breached under sustained pressure.
claims.instrument: Half present. The commitment threshold IS measurable pre-commit (e3_selector.py commit_threshold, variance_commit_threshold at :285 and the quantile-tracking path at :535-858). RC_conflict, DA_A/DA_M lock-in pressure and pi_rc have no implementation; V3-EXQ-158 computes an RC-conflict proxy driver-side from z_world prediction error and is tagged Q-018 only, never reaching the agent's commit gate.
claims.consumer_locus: The pre-execution-lock-in control plane -- RC_conflict modulating loop precision and the commitment threshold BEFORE commit -- not a downstream behavioural correlate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: RC_conflict must be an explicit, independently readable channel with live non-zero variance across the manipulation, and the commitment threshold and lock-in pressure must be separately measurable at the PRE-COMMIT stage so a shift can be attributed to RC_conflict rather than read off final behaviour. Grep for rc_conflict, reality_coherence and pi_rc returns zero hits in ree_core, so any run today would score a flat, uncomputed channel and must self-route substrate_not_ready.
claims.blocking_reason: The asserted RC_conflict channel does not exist in ree_core, so there is nothing to read and nothing to attribute a threshold shift to, and the environment cannot mark an observation with provenance or authority at matched content. Two of the six dependencies (ARC-007, ARC-018) also sit on the V3-Pending Gate.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-158 exists and is titled RC-conflict threshold calibration, which reads as prior coverage of MECH-065; it tags Q-018 only, defines RC_conflict as a driver-side function of z_world prediction error, and never touches the E3 commit gate.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: An explicit, independently readable RC_conflict channel plus an authority/provenance-mismatch event at matched surface content, so that a pre-commit threshold shift can be attributed to reality-coherence conflict rather than to generic surprise.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Observations carrying a provenance or authority tag that can be spoofed or verified while the content is held bit-identical, giving RC_conflict measurable non-zero variance.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: A per-tick RC_conflict scalar recorded alongside the already-measurable commit_threshold, with a benign-novelty control channel so the lane can be separated from S1/S3 conflict.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: No substrate_queue entry, closure-plan node or governance flag covers reality-coherence conflict, provenance tagging or authority spoofing; the 2026-09-04 authority-field intake cross-references MECH-065 only as a predicted benefit of MECH-534, not as an owner. The control-plane doc still lists the S5 update equations as its own TODO.

claims.auditor_notes: Registering the channel does not license the whole lane: the DA_A/DA_M lock-in-pressure readout and the pi_rc guarded floor are separate and heavier, and the hysteresis clause is only testable once the channel moves. Build the event and the channel first; the threshold half is already instrumented.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
MECH-065 is currently a schematic design claim -- the RC_conflict signal, the
DA_A/DA_M lock-in-pressure dampening, the commitment-threshold (tau/theta_high/
theta_low) hysteresis, and the Pi_rc guarded floor are all still on the
control-plane doc's own TODO list ("formalise control plane state variables",
"specify update equations... for S5 reality-coherence conflict computation").
A test is informative only once: (a) RC_conflict is computed as an explicit,
independently-readable channel (not inferred post-hoc from downstream behaviour),
with live non-zero variance across an authority/provenance-mismatch manipulation
-- a channel that never moves cannot be shown to modulate anything, and any run
against a flat/uncomputed RC_conflict channel self-routes substrate_not_ready,
not FAIL; and (b) commitment threshold and DA_A/DA_M lock-in pressure are
themselves separately measurable at the pre-commit stage, so a shift in them can
be attributed to RC_conflict specifically rather than read off final behavioural
outcome. Two of the six dependencies (ARC-007, ARC-018) are held on the
V3-Pending Gate as of this digestion -- their resolution is upstream of a clean
test here, since MECH-065's provenance/authority framing leans on both.
CONFIRMING signature: under a manipulation that varies authority/provenance
mismatch at matched surface content (e.g. spoofed vs. verified source signal on
an otherwise identical instruction/observation), RC_conflict rises measurably,
DA_A/DA_M lock-in pressure is measurably dampened, and the effective commitment
threshold is measurably raised -- all BEFORE execution lock-in (pre-commit-stage
change, not a downstream behavioural correlate) -- with the system biasing toward
verification/exploration rather than premature commit. Per the claim's own
literature grounding (Sterzer et al. 2016), the effect should track the
PRECISION RATIO of internal-model precision to authority-signal precision, not
authority-signal magnitude alone: an arm that holds absolute authority-signal
strength fixed while varying internal (E1) precision should shift the threshold
the same way as an arm that holds internal precision fixed and varies authority
signal strength, provided the ratio moves equivalently. The response should also
show hysteresis (theta_high > theta_low, bounded recovery via tau_rc_recovery)
rather than a single crisp threshold, and should never suppress reality-conflict
sensitivity below the guarded floor (Pi_rc >= pi_rc_floor) under sustained
exteroceptive pressure.
FALSIFYING signature: if the provenance/authority-mismatch manipulation produces
no measurable pre-commit change in DA_A/DA_M or commitment threshold -- i.e.
RC_conflict, even when computed and live, has no separable causal effect on
lock-in pressure or threshold -- the claim is refuted: reality-coherence
conflict does not constitute a distinct control-plane lane and any observed
downstream effect is better explained by existing signals (S1/S3) alone. Also
falsifying if the threshold shift tracks absolute authority-signal magnitude
independent of internal precision (i.e. the ratio manipulation described above
does NOT dissociate, so magnitude alone predicts the shift as well as the ratio
does) -- this would refute the specific ratio-based account MECH-065 currently
rests on (Sterzer et al.), even if some cruder RC-conflict effect survives. Also
falsifying if the response shows no hysteresis (theta_high == theta_low, or
chronic drift below pi_rc_floor under sustained pressure) -- the design
constraint that reality-conflict must not chronically over-suppress from
transient ambiguity would then be unmet.
EVIDENCE STATUS: no experimental evidence exists for this claim as of this
digestion (2026-08-06) -- only literature grounding (Sterzer et al. 2016, Howes
& Murray 2020, Damiani et al. 2022) supporting the ratio-based reframing of the
threshold, and a clinical-analogue mapping. That literature is supportive of the
general precision-miscalibration framing but does not itself test REE's specific
three-signal (provenance/temporal/identity/policy) carve of RC_conflict -- treat
it as motivating, not confirming.

claims.claim_title: What is the smallest commit-boundary token that still supports reliable multi-timescale attribution?
claims.falsifier_summary: Reliability is flat across the whole granularity sweep (no floor exists, so the 'smallest token' question is ill-posed), or the coarsest arm itself fails the floor, making every finer arm uninterpretable.
claims.required_event: Repeated commit episodes at a controllable commit-token granularity, from whole-trajectory down to per-step, with the task held fixed.
claims.manipulation: Sweep commit-boundary granularity coarse -> fine while holding task, environment and policy fixed, so granularity is the only independent variable.
claims.control: The coarsest (whole-trajectory) arm as the reliability reference, plus the EXQ-003 / MECH-061 blended arm in which pre-commit and post-commit signals are routed together rather than separately.
claims.DV: Rank correlation between the credit assigned to a commit token and that token's ground-truth outcome contribution, computed at both a within-commit and an across-commit timescale; the answer is the smallest granularity at which rank-corr stays above 0.5 at BOTH timescales.
claims.instrument: MECH-276's ScientistAttributionBuffer is the closest existing multi-scale credit recorder -- it keys counterfactual-backed attribution by (scale, segment_id) -- but those are MECH-284/MECH-269 spatial regions, not commit tokens, and it holds no ground-truth outcome contribution to correlate against. No per-commit-token credit-versus-ground-truth recorder exists anywhere in ree_core.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit-token boundary at which credit is routed. The only commit primitive in V3 is the BetaGate hold/release (ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py) and its unit is a single tick.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The coarsest arm must itself attribute reliably (rank-corr > 0.5), or a fine-grained failure is uninterpretable. Separately, the commit boundary must actually be exercised: V3-EXQ-155 died because an entropy-bonus-only policy (ENT_BONUS=5e-3, z_world/z_self detached from the policy forward pass) converged to a maximum-entropy random walk at action_entropy = ln(5), so the boundary never fired; a harm-avoidance policy gradient and a measured non-zero committed fraction are required first.
claims.blocking_reason: No commit-boundary-granularity knob exists: the commit unit is the per-tick BetaGate release and nothing in ree_core/utils/config.py varies it (closure_decommit_hold_ticks is a de-commit refractory, not a token-size knob). No substrate_queue entry owns it -- I checked all 189 -- and no instrument correlates per-token credit with ground-truth contribution.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: A tunable commit-boundary granularity, plus a per-commit-token credit record that can be correlated against ground-truth outcome contribution at two timescales.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Commit tokens spanning a configurable number of ticks (whole-trajectory down to per-step), making granularity a swept independent variable rather than a hard-coded unit of the BetaGate release.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-token assigned credit and per-token ground-truth outcome contribution, emitted at within-commit and across-commit timescales so a rank correlation is computable at each.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: Verified absent from substrate_queue.json (189 entries, none naming Q-015 or a commit-granularity knob) and from ree_core/utils/config.py; MECH-276's (scale, segment_id) attribution keys spatial regions rather than commit tokens; and the 2026-08-28 unrunnable-falsifier population lists Q-015 as one of six active claims with an unmet precondition and no build route.

claims.auditor_notes: This is a measurement/event item, not a new cognitive mechanism -- it makes an existing hard-coded unit adjustable and exposes a credit record. The first half of Q-015 (pre/post-commit signals stay uncorrelated and separate routing beats blending) is already answered at ree-v1-minimal scale by EXQ-003/EVB-0041 and is NOT what the prerequisite unblocks.
claims.what_would_answer:
PARTIALLY answered already (EXQ-003 / MECH-061, ree-v1-minimal): the minimal
contract requires at least that pre-commit and post-commit signals stay
uncorrelated (|corr| < 0.7) and that routing them separately beats blending.
The OPEN part -- the smallest token granularity that still works -- needs a
substrate that does not yet exist: a tunable commit-boundary granularity knob.
Falsifier (once that knob exists): sweep commit-boundary granularity coarse
(whole-trajectory) -> fine (per-step), task fixed; reliability = rank-corr
between credit assigned to a commit-token and that token's ground-truth outcome
contribution, at >=2 timescales (within-commit, across-commit). The answer is the
SMALLEST granularity at which reliability stays above floor (rank-corr > 0.5) at
both timescales; below it attribution degrades to chance. Non-degeneracy
precondition: the coarsest arm must itself attribute reliably. Substrate-blocked:
V3 hard-codes the commit-token unit; no commit-boundary-granularity knob is in
substrate_queue yet. (Routed substrate_conditional per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

claims.claim_title: What arbitration policy best resolves tri-loop gate conflicts without coupling collapse?
claims.falsifier_summary: Every candidate policy either exhibits coupling collapse (all gates co-suppress) or fails to record and resolve conflict at all, on a run whose conflict count is demonstrably above zero -- i.e. arbitration cannot be had without collapse at this substrate.
claims.required_event: A task state in which the gates disagree -- one stream must be suppressed while others commit -- occurring often enough to estimate arbitration outcomes.
claims.manipulation: Swap the arbitration policy across arms: explicit recorded arbitration against a commit_id, silent dominance, winner-take-all, and threshold-coupled, holding the gate substrate and task fixed.
claims.control: The silent-dominance baseline on matched seeds and conflict rate, with per-gate suppression variance recorded so a no-conflict run is detectable rather than silently vacuous.
claims.DV: Cross-gate suppression correlation (coupling collapse if all gates co-suppress together), the fraction of conflicts resolved and attributable per commit_id, and committed-action quality on the conflict task relative to the silent-dominance baseline.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-156 builds its own LoopGate modules over CausalGridWorldV2 and records per-gate values and arbitration outcomes; ree_core has no gate_motor / gate_cognitive_set / gate_motivational objects at all, so nothing records substrate gate conflict.
claims.consumer_locus: The pre-commit eligibility layer of E3 selection -- where parallel loop channels would arbitrate before a committed action, per ARC-110's segregated-loop constitution.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two conditions, both currently unmet. The three gates must be separate and live, each consuming its own proposal manifold with non-zero independent gating variance -- as built they are COLLAPSED into one E3 selector with additive bias channels (MECH-062's own 2026-06-22 status note). And the policy must be trained with a harm-avoidance gradient actually wired to it: V3-EXQ-156 trained on an entropy bonus with z_world/z_self detached, converged to a max-entropy random walk and never generated a single gate conflict.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate a tri-loop gate CONFLICT: the motor / cognitive-set / motivational loops are collapsed into one E3 selector feeding additive bias channels, so the three gates the question arbitrates between do not exist as separate consumers. The one attempted run compounded this with a policy that never produced conflicts.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-156's superseded result is not evidence about arbitration policies: with action_entropy pinned at ln(5) the policy never entered conflict, so all four arms were compared on an empty event set.
claims.auditor_notes: Q-016 depends_on MECH-062 / ARC-003 / ARC-005 but NOT on ARC-110, whose own awaiting field is 'learned_cross_loop_arbitration_validation_falsifier' -- i.e. ARC-110 already owns this question's substrate and half its falsifier. That missing edge is the cheapest fix here.
claims.what_would_answer:
Pit candidate tri-loop arbitration policies against each other on a substrate
where MECH-062's three gates (gate_motor, gate_cognitive_set,
gate_motivational) are LIVE -- each consuming its own proposal manifold and
showing non-zero, independent gating variance -- and a task that deliberately
drives the gates into conflict (one stream must be suppressed while others
commit). Candidate policies: explicit recorded arbitration (conflict resolved
against a commit_id) vs silent-dominance vs winner-take-all vs
threshold-coupled. ANSWER "policy P best resolves conflict without coupling
collapse" if under P a suppressed stream does NOT force the other gates into
suppression (no pathological global coupling: cross-gate suppression
correlation stays below floor), conflicts are resolved and attributable per
commit_id, AND committed-action quality on the conflict task beats the
silent-dominance baseline. ANSWER against any policy that exhibits coupling
collapse (all gates co-suppress) or fails to record/resolve conflict. HARD
PRECONDITION (the EXQ-156 lesson): the policy must be trained with a
harm-avoidance gradient actually wired to it -- EXQ-156 was superseded because
the policy trained on entropy bonus alone (ENT_BONUS=5e-3) with z_world/z_self
detached, converged to a max-entropy random walk
(action_entropy=ln(5)=1.6094), and never GENERATED gate conflicts; with no
conflicts the arbitration policy is untested and the run is vacuous.

claims.claim_title: What RC-conflict threshold calibration blocks authority spoofing without chronic over-suppression?
claims.falsifier_summary: No setting separates the two directions on organic events: either spoofing leaks through at every theta_high that leaves legitimate switching intact, or every theta_low that catches spoofing chronically suppresses or oscillates legitimate switching. The hysteresis parameterisation is then miscalibrated in principle, not merely mis-tuned.
claims.required_event: An authority or provenance conflict arising organically -- an internally generated prediction or instruction being presented to the agent with the provenance markers of an external observation -- interleaved with legitimate task-set switches that must be allowed through.
claims.manipulation: Sweep the five hysteresis hooks (theta_high, theta_low, tau_rc_recovery, pi_rc_floor, max_defensive_hold_steps) across their range while holding the organic event stream fixed, and cross with a legitimate-task-switch stream so both error directions are exercised at every setting.
claims.control: A no-spoof arm carrying only legitimate switches at each threshold setting (to read the false-positive/chronic-suppression direction), and a gate-disabled arm at the same event stream (to establish the unsuppressed miss rate baseline).
claims.DV: Jointly, at each threshold: spoof detection rate / miss rate on the organic events, and the suppression profile on legitimate switches -- fraction of legitimate switches suppressed, time to release of the defensive hold against tau_rc_recovery, and whether precision is ever pinned below pi_rc_floor.
claims.instrument: Absent from the substrate. ree_core contains zero occurrences of rc_conflict, theta_high, theta_low, tau_rc_recovery, pi_rc_floor, max_defensive_hold_steps, MECH-065, or any spoof/provenance channel; the only implementation in the repository is inside experiments/v3_exq_158, a self-contained simulation. CausalGridWorld has no provenance or authority marking on any observation.
claims.consumer_locus: The control plane's S5 RC-conflict gate and its downstream suppression of dopaminergic gain and nociceptive precision -- an architectural boundary that does not currently exist in the agent, so the calibration has no consumer.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The spoofing events must ARISE from organic provenance conflict rather than be synthesised, which is the hard precondition the existing what_would_answer already registers, and the RC-conflict gate under calibration must be the one the agent actually runs. Neither holds: V3-EXQ-158 injected 2000+ events and built its own WorldEncoder / SelfEncoder / WorldPredictor / Policy / HarmEvaluator inside the driver, so the calibrated thresholds were never applied to REEAgent.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate the required event and does not carry the gate. There is no provenance or authority channel in the environment and no RC-conflict lane in ree_core; EXQ-158's PASS calibrated a driver-local toy control plane, so it answers the arithmetic of the hysteresis rule and nothing about the agent.
false_positives: The live_status evidence pointer reads 'supports/PASS' from V3-EXQ-158 and the quadrant counts one genuine experimental entry; read without the driver, that implies the RC-conflict gate is implemented and calibrated in the agent. It is not -- the run calibrated a standalone simulation and the gate has no substrate existence.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: Q-018's falsifier needs organic provenance conflict and a gate in the agent; both are absent, so no calibration measured in V3 today can generalise past the driver-local simulation EXQ-158 already ran.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: An environment-level provenance/authority marking on observations (source tag plus a mis-marking mode that lets an internally generated signal arrive with external provenance), so authority-spoofing events arise from the event stream rather than being synthesised by a driver.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-tick records of provenance-conflict magnitude, gate state (armed / held / released), hold duration against tau_rc_recovery, and the realised precision floor -- enough to read spoof detection and legitimate-switch suppression as two separate error directions from one run.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: MECH-065 names the RC-conflict lane conceptually but no substrate_queue entry, closure-plan node or governance flag registers building it; a scan of all 189 substrate_queue entries returns nothing on spoofing, provenance, rc_conflict or authority.

claims.auditor_notes: Registration only -- the proposed node is an environment/instrument item (a provenance channel plus gate telemetry), deliberately not the cognitive RC-conflict mechanism itself. If the coordinator prefers, this can be folded into MECH-065 rather than minted separately; the essential point is that Q-018's single PASS is driver-local and should not be read as substrate evidence.
claims.what_would_answer:
Inject authority/provenance-spoofing events across a calibrated sweep of the
RC-conflict hysteresis hooks (theta_high, theta_low, tau_rc_recovery,
pi_rc_floor, max_defensive_hold_steps) and measure both error directions
jointly. ANSWER "threshold T blocks spoofing without chronic over-suppression"
if at T the S5 RC-conflict gate fires on (near) all spoofing events and
applies suppression (DA_A/DA_M down, Pi_noc up) -- high spoof-detection / low
miss-rate -- WHILE legitimate task-set switching recovers within the bounded
hysteresis window (defensive hold released by tau_rc_recovery, precision never
pinned below pi_rc_floor, false-positive suppression of legitimate switches
below floor and not chronic). ANSWER "miscalibrated" if no setting separates
the two: either spoofing leaks through (theta_high too high) or legitimate
switching is chronically suppressed / oscillates (theta_low too low, recovery
too slow). HARD PRECONDITION on generalisation: EXQ-158 PASSed but synthesised
2000+ spoofing events directly rather than letting them arise from organic
hazard encounters -- it answers the threshold-calibration leg but NOT the full
organic harm-encounter pipeline; a complete answer requires the spoofing
events to emerge from organic provenance conflict, not be injected, before the
calibration is declared robust.

claims.claim_title: Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.
claims.falsifier_summary: The precision-to-commitment signal collapses to a fixed value independent of estimated uncertainty once the eval-derived threshold is correctly calibrated -- which would not touch the axiom but would falsify REE's precision architecture as an operational consequence of it, and would call ARC-016's stable status into question.
claims.required_event: A graded observation-noise ladder during evaluation, producing a range of E3-derived precision/running-variance values within one run.
claims.manipulation: Sweep eval-time derived noise across the ladder while holding the trained agent and task fixed, per the V3-EXQ-818 design.
claims.control: The unperturbed noise level as the reference rung, with per-seed correlations required to agree in sign so a single-seed artefact cannot carry the result.
claims.DV: Correlation between E3-derived precision (running variance) and commit rate across the ladder -- measured mean_rho_rv_vs_commit = -0.955 against a -0.8 floor, all seeds negative.
claims.instrument: Built and exercised: ree-v3 e3_selector exposes the running-variance commit gate and V3-EXQ-818 (eval_derived_noise_precision_sweep, PASS 2026-07-25) records the sweep and the per-seed correlations.
claims.consumer_locus: The precision architecture's commit gate in e3_selector -- whether commitment is driven by estimated uncertainty or by a fixed schedule decoupled from it.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The commit rate must be free to vary -- strictly between floor and ceiling rather than pinned -- across a graded uncertainty manipulation, and the commit threshold must be eval-derived rather than a fixed schedule; V3-EXQ-818 satisfied this (gate_green true, commit rate non-degenerate across the noise ladder).
claims.blocking_reason: The primary component is runnable and has passed (V3-EXQ-818). What is not runnable is the axiom itself (out of domain at every version) and the secondary component: whether pre-commit simulation (INV-011) and the commitment gate (INV-012) are uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguards is unevidenced, and INV-012 is itself blocked behind the F-dominance ceiling.
false_positives: GFLAG-0091 groups INV-025 with the substrate-blocked axiom claims, but its reframed leg rests on already-built, already-validated V1/V2/V3 machinery -- substrate_conditional should not be applied to it mechanically.
claims.auditor_notes: The missing edge is bookkeeping rather than substrate: V3-EXQ-818 is tagged to ARC-016, so INV-025 carries zero experimental entries while its own falsifier's primary component has passed. A cross-tag or an explicit citation edge would show that.
claims.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-025 as literally stated -- that epistemic uncertainty is irreducible IN PRINCIPLE for any finite agent in a real world, not merely irreducible for REE's current architecture -- is a foundational epistemological premise (Axiom 1 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "You can never be sure"). No REE experiment can prove uncertainty is irreducible in principle; an experiment can only show that REE's OWN uncertainty estimates are non-degenerate (do not collapse to false certainty), never that some other architecture could not in principle eliminate uncertainty. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked, unlike the ARC-010/V5-gated legs drafted for INV-028/INV-029): INV-025's own architectural-consequence text names the machinery directly -- "the entire precision architecture (ARC-016, INV-008, INV-009)... follows necessarily from this axiom," with pre-commit simulation (INV-011) and the commitment gate (INV-012) as necessary responses. Unlike the mirror-modelling legs for the other axiom claims, this machinery is core V1/V2/V3 substrate that is already built and, for its primary component, already validated. The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's architecture actually IMPLEMENT the operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible -- i.e. does precision-weighted prediction error remain genuinely non-degenerate across training and eval, and does the commitment gate (INV-012) function as an uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguard rather than a fixed schedule decoupled from it.
ALREADY ANSWERED, primary component (ARC-016, status: stable, 2026-07-25): the eval-time structural test of exactly this question has run and PASSED. V3-EXQ-818 (eval_derived_noise_precision_sweep) found mean_rho_rv_vs_commit = -0.955 -- commit-rate tracks E3-derived precision MONOTONICALLY across a graded-noise ladder, non-degenerate (commit rate strictly between floor and ceiling, not pinned), load-bearing C1 PASS, gate_green = True. See ARC-016's own what_would_answer for the full non-degeneracy precondition this reuses (do not re-derive).
SECONDARY COMPONENT, currently UNCONFIRMED (INV-011, INV-012): whether pre-commit simulation and the commitment gate specifically function as uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguards is not independently evidenced -- neither carries its own what_would_answer today. INV-012 additionally carries pending_substrate_reconfirmation=true (emergent_from SD-026, still candidate) and per its own notes cannot be cited as supporting evidence until substrate reconfirmation.
Confirming observation: commit-rate continues to track E3-derived precision/variance monotonically under a graded manipulation, non-degenerate across the manipulated range, reproducing V3-EXQ-818.
Falsifying observation: the precision/commitment signal COLLAPSES to a fixed value independent of estimated uncertainty once the eval-derived threshold is correctly calibrated -- would not falsify the axiom (out of domain) but would falsify the claim that REE's precision architecture is a genuine operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible, and would call ARC-016's stable status into question.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes-4fd18d): fourth of the five original axiom claims digested. Unlike INV-028/INV-029 (substrate_conditional, unbuilt V5 substrate), INV-025's reframed leg rests on already-built, already- validated V1/V2/V3 machinery. Do not apply substrate_conditional mechanically to every axiom claim -- check what the architectural- consequence machinery actually requires, per claim.

(a) do prediction-error channels (z_world/SD-005, E1/E2/E3) produce structured, learnable surprise, not noise; (b) does the residue field genuinely accumulate what ACTUALLY happened distinct from prediction, and is that load-bearing (INV-004/INV-006 post-commit persistence); (c) does ARC-024's claim that harm gradients precede/predict harm events hold up empirically.
Confirming signature: prediction-error metrics improve with training rather than sitting at noise floor, AND residue-field-driven behaviour measurably diverges from a trust-the-prediction-always baseline in a way that tracks actual outcomes.
Falsifying signature: prediction error stays indistinguishable from noise regardless of training, OR the residue field fails to build non-zero contrast at all (as already seen in EXQ-151/EXQ-215 -- an open implementation gap, not yet resolved), OR the residue trace never diverges usefully from the prediction it's supposed to be independent of. Caveats already on record: z_world does NOT reliably show reciprocal specialisation vs z_self (EXQ-047g/113/532), and ARC-024 itself is currently provisional/demoted, not confirmed -- so this leg is testable-now but not yet won.
claims.stale_reason: The falsifying clause rests on 'the residue field fails to build non-zero contrast at all (as already seen in EXQ-151/EXQ-215 -- an open implementation gap, not yet resolved)'. That gap is closed: V3-EXQ-697 measured a POPULATED field (residue_populated true, coverage 100%, mean_weight 2.5-54) with flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.0596-0.9964, mean 0.628 over 5 seeds -- residue does build contrast and does change the pre-sampling E3 argmin. The live limit is different in kind: RBFLayer.add_residue is a 32-slot ring buffer that OVERWRITES, so the field cannot hold a path (recorded 2026-09-17, MECH-023 blocked).

claims.claim_title: Shared-world ethics requires modelling others as co-inhabitants of the same consequence space.
claims.falsifier_summary: Other-harm produces a measurably attenuated or differently-shaped error signal, or fails to couple into the same E3 ranking path, while the same predictive machinery is confirmed to be representing both self and other.
claims.required_event: Self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other, paired with self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes at matched magnitude.
claims.manipulation: Swap the target of the same self-caused harmful action between own outcomes and the modelled other's outcomes, holding the action, the attribution pipeline and the harm magnitude fixed.
claims.control: The own-harm arm as the matched comparator, plus a world-caused (unattributed) harm-to-other arm to isolate attribution from mere observation.
claims.DV: Functional form, magnitude scaling and downstream pull of the harm-error signal entering E3 ranking and routing -- statistically indistinguishable across own-harm and other-harm if the self-other difference is only a routing difference.
claims.instrument: The E3 harm-error and attribution instruments exist (SD-003 attribution, e3_selector scoring, residue accumulation), but nothing can generate other-agent harm: ree_core/environment contains only causal_grid_world.py and ARC-047 is candidate at phase v5 with confidence 0.0.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 harm-evaluation and ranking pathway -- whether own-harm and modelled-other-harm route through one machinery or through separate pathways.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A second agent whose harm is attributable to the tested agent's own action, represented through the same predictive machinery as the self (ARC-010 mirror modelling with OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging), and confirmed to be so represented before the error-signal comparison is read -- otherwise a magnitude difference measures representation quality rather than routing.
claims.blocking_reason: No multi-agent substrate exists: ARC-047 SocialGridWorld is candidate/v5/confidence 0.0 and the environment package holds a single-agent world only, so a self-caused-harm-to-other event cannot be generated at all. The axiom leg is permanently out of domain.
claims.auditor_notes: Same substrate node as INV-029 and ARC-010 -- three claims share one blocker, so the coordinator should expect one prerequisite (MAE-1/MAE-2 multi-agent substrate) to unblock the cluster rather than three separate ones.
claims.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-028 as literally stated -- that other agents' harm and benefit are real "by exactly the same grounds as the agent's own," because they are selves (INV-026) in the same world (INV-027) -- is a foundational ethical/metaphysical premise (Axiom 4 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "Others share this world"). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether another agent's harm is metaphysically real by the same grounds as the agent's own. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- INV-028's own architectural consequence names it directly: "when another self is represented using the same predictive machinery as the self, their harm generates the same error signal structure as own-harm" (grounds mirror modelling, INV-005, at the REE-specific level via ARC-010). The testable question is whether self-caused harm to a MODELLED OTHER (via ARC-010 mirror modelling -- reused self/other latent stack, ARC-004 L-space with reduced precision gains) generates an error-signal / harm-evaluation structure statistically indistinguishable from self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- i.e. whether the self-other distinction is actually just "a routing difference within the same architecture, not a different architecture," once it is measurable rather than asserted.
Confirming observation: comparing self-caused harm to the agent's own modelled outcomes against self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other (ARC-010's OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged shadow-bundle estimate), the harm-error signal driving E3 ranking/routing shows the same functional form, magnitude scaling, and downstream repair/avoidance pull in both conditions -- i.e. no separate "other-harm" pathway exists; own-harm and modelled-other-harm route through the same machinery.
Falsifying observation: self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other produces a measurably different error-signal structure than self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- e.g. attenuated magnitude, a distinct functional form, or no coupling into the same E3 ranking/routing pathway -- even though the same predictive machinery is confirmed to be representing both self and other. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements the "routing difference, not architecture difference" mechanism INV-028 asserts as its consequence.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): same V5/multi-agent substrate gap as ARC-010 and INV-029 -- requires ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) where a second agent's harm is attributable to the tested agent's own action (not merely observed/ world-caused harm), so that a genuine self-harm vs. other-harm error-signal comparison is possible. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5); see ARC-010's own what_would_answer for the full substrate description. Do not re-derive -- cross-reference.

claims.claim_title: Love as long-horizon care-investment is a structurally coherent agent disposition, not an add-on sentiment.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same modelling machinery confirmed present, other-directed benefit fully re-derives as own short-horizon reward with no dissociable long-horizon component, and self-caused harm to the other leaves no residue or repair-search signature -- empathy as simulation without coupled valence.
claims.required_event: Self-caused harm to a modelled other agent, followed by an opportunity to invest in that other's outcomes at a cost to the agent's own short-horizon reward.
claims.manipulation: Vary whether the other is mirror-modelled (ARC-010 OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging on) and whether the harm to it is self-caused or world-caused, against matched prediction accuracy about the other.
claims.control: A matched arm with equal predictive accuracy about the other but no self-attribution of the harm (empathy-as-simulation control), plus a self-harm arm for the magnitude comparison.
claims.DV: Sustained other-directed investment that trades against own short-horizon reward, measured over a horizon long enough to dissociate the two, plus residue accumulation and repair-search or help-recruitment rate following self-caused harm to the other.
claims.instrument: Absent at the environment level: ree_core/environment holds only causal_grid_world.py, so no other agent can be harmed by this agent's action. The residue recorder (ree_core/residue/field.py) and the E3 harm path exist and would serve once such an event can occur.
claims.consumer_locus: The benefit-gradient / mirror-modelling / residue coupling -- whether care shows up as a residue-driven repair pull rather than as a proxy for own reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Three conditions, all unmet in V3: a second agent whose harm is attributable to the tested agent's own action; a residue/attachment signal that is engaged and off-floor, separable from ordinary prediction error and from the raw z_beta leak; and long-horizon credit assignment under which other-directed investment and short-horizon self-interest are not collinear by construction.
claims.blocking_reason: The literal axiom leg is out of domain at every version. The reframed leg needs a multi-agent substrate in which another agent's harm is attributable to this agent: ARC-047 SocialGridWorld is candidate, phase v5, confidence 0.0, and ree_core/environment contains only the single-agent causal grid world.
claims.auditor_notes: Do not invent a V3 proxy here: harm to a scripted non-agent object would satisfy the shape and none of the content, since the discriminator the claim rests on (care versus simulation) requires the other to be mirror-modelled AND genuinely harmable by this agent. The V5 plan nodes MAE-1/MAE-2 already own the substrate.
claims.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-029 as literally stated -- that love/genuine connection is metaphysically real, not reducible to self-interest or a computational strategy -- is a foundational ethical/philosophical premise (Axiom 6/7 of five_axioms_foundations.md, formerly the compressed "Love exists" of the original five axioms). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether love is metaphysically real. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- does REE's benefit-gradient/mirror- modelling/residue machinery implement a disposition functionally consistent with the axiom: (i) long-horizon, other-directed investment (ii) dissociable from short-horizon self-interested reward-seeking, and (iii) a residue/ repair-search signature under self-caused harm to a modelled other, distinguishing genuine care from empathy-as-simulation (the "torturer feels no residue" discriminator; see evidence/planning/ thought_intake_2026-07-09_residue_care_marker_mood_regulation.md, candidate claim 1, itself framed there as a falsifier for INV-001 and explicitly cross-referenced to this claim).
Confirming observation: an agent that models another self-like agent (ARC-010 mirror modelling / MECH-164 z_beta-leak) shows sustained investment toward that other's outcomes trading off against its own short-horizon reward, AND self-caused harm to that other generates a residue signal that measurably drives repair-search/help-recruitment.
Falsifying observation: the same modelling machinery (accurate prediction of the other's affect/outcomes) is present, but benefit-seeking toward the other fully re-derives as a proxy for the agent's own short-horizon reward with no dissociable long-horizon component, and/or self-caused harm to the modelled other produces no residue/repair-search signature -- i.e. the architecture implements empathy as simulation without the coupled valence that would make it care. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements a disposition functionally consistent with it.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): requires (1) a multi-agent or other-agent-modelling substrate sufficient to instantiate a loved-analog other that can be genuinely harmed by the agent's own action (ARC-010 mirror modelling extended to a second agent whose harm is attributable to the tested agent, not merely observed/world-caused harm); (2) a residue/attachment mechanism that is actively engaged and produces a measurable, non-floor-pinned signal distinguishable from ordinary prediction error or the raw z_beta leak itself; and (3) long-horizon credit assignment sufficient that short-horizon self-interest and long-horizon other-directed investment are actually dissociable in the metric rather than collinear by construction. Per the residue-care-marker intake this is V5/multi-agent substrate (WS-10 minimal 2-agent world), not present in V3 -- so this leg currently self-routes to substrate-blocked rather than yielding a PASS/FAIL.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes- 4fd18d): this is the first of the five original axiom claims (INV-015, INV-026, INV-027, INV-028, INV-029) to be digested. methodology): the calibration gap
mean_causal_sig(near_hazard) - mean_causal_sig(safe), computed from E2's

(the EXQ-007-010 series used >0.05) under sufficient per-step observation

load-bearing confirmation of ARC-021 itself additionally requires an

and/or harm-attribution accuracy relative to the separated-channel
baseline, isolating channel separation as the causal factor rather than
only observing that separated channels trend the right direction.
