claims.claim_title: Sensory prediction error, motor-sensory error, and harm/goal error are incommensurable and cannot be collapsed.
claims.falsifier_summary: A merged single-channel agent reproduces the separated arm's per-channel scale, covariance and lag structure and matches or beats it on harm calibration at adequate power -- the channels are commensurable and collapsing them costs nothing.
claims.required_event: A trained agent accruing sensory prediction error (E1), motor-sensory error (E2) and harm/goal error (E3) on the same episodes, with a durable parameter update taken from those errors.
claims.manipulation: Collapse the three error channels into a single merged learning signal (one combined loss over agent.parameters(), one optimizer) instead of three independent optimizers, holding the observation stream, candidate set and update budget fixed.
claims.control: The SEPARATED arm -- three independent optimizers backwarding each loss immediately -- on identical seeds, with a scale/covariance/temporal readout of the three error streams as the non-collapse baseline.
claims.DV: Divergence of the three error streams under merge versus separation: per-channel scale ratios, cross-channel covariance and lag structure measured on the ree_core E1/E2/E3 signals, plus the action-conditioned pre-sigmoid harm-calibration gap as the consequence leg.
claims.instrument: Partly missing. ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_005_mech069_error_scale.py covers the scale leg; v3_exq_993a and v3_exq_1011 record the calibration_gap consequence but read DRIVER-LOCAL surrogate heads over a frozen z_world, not the named E1/E2/E3 stack. No recorder exists for the merged condition because the merged run crashes.
claims.consumer_locus: The three learning channels' write paths into E1, E2 and E3 parameters -- whether a single merged error signal can carry all three without loss -- not episode-level task performance.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The MERGED (collapsed-channel) arm must actually run to completion against the real E1/E2/E3 stack, and the SEPARATED control arm must produce a DV with headroom -- V3-EXQ-993's separated arm measured a largest calibration_gap of 0.00152 against a 0.02 floor (13.1x short), so the ablation had nothing to remove. Both a runnable merge and a non-degenerate control are required before the comparison means anything.
claims.blocking_reason: The MERGED arm cannot be run: ContextMemory.write mutates the nn.Parameter e1.context_memory.memory in place via .data (e1_deep.py:169-179), advancing its autograd version counter and invalidating the retained forward that a single merged backward needs. SEPARATE runs clean because it backwards each loss immediately. The defect lives in ree_core and is not repairable from a driver.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-1011's weakens direction does not bear on MECH-069's scale/covariance/temporal content -- governance narrowed it 2026-09-09 to the collapse-degrades-harm-calibration consequence only, and it was measured on surrogate heads, not the E1/E2/E3 stack.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0229 explicitly routes the fix and suggests amending contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy rather than minting a new entry -- these are DIFFERENT defects in the same function (that entry is hard-argmin addressing degeneracy; this is autograd in-place mutation under a merged backward). No contract exercises a merged-optimizer backward over agent.parameters(); that is the missing gate.

claims.claim_title: E2 harm prediction is better calibrated for agent-caused vs environment-caused transitions.
claims.falsifier_summary: harm_eval is flat or jumps only at contact, OR the calibration_gap does not differ (or reverses) between the two groups, OR the observed gap collapses to noise once measured on a ground-truth partition confirmed to track avoidability rather than provenance.
claims.required_event: Approach-to-hazard trajectories on CausalGridWorldV2 producing graded proximity states, plus contact transitions of both labelled classes in sufficient number per seed.
claims.manipulation: Compare calibration_gap computed on the steps preceding agent_caused_hazard / hazard_approach transitions against the steps preceding env_caused_hazard transitions and locomotion, with and without ARC-024 proxy gradient fields.
claims.control: Locomotion and env_caused_hazard transition groups as the low-calibration comparator, plus the no-proxy-field configuration (EXQ-026) as the weaker but valid variant of the same test.
claims.DV: harm_eval(z_world_t) as a graded function of hazard proximity (the none < approach < contact ordering), and calibration_gap ahead of the agent-attributed group minus calibration_gap ahead of the environment-attributed group, against the pre-registered 0.03 magnitude.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py emits transition_type labels and V3-EXQ-026/029 record calibration_gap and the graded none/approach/contact means. The labels are the problem: agent_caused_hazard means entering a contaminated cell the agent's own footprint produced, while env_caused_hazard means entering an environment-placed hazard -- both require the agent to step in, so the split encodes object provenance, not agency of the harm.
claims.consumer_locus: E3.harm_eval read on z_world before the transition, not E2's harm prediction and not the post-contact harm signal.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: z_world must carry hazard_field proximity channels and SD-007 reafference correction must be active, or harm_eval has no proximity structure to be calibrated against and a flat score is instrumentation failure. Separately, the agent-versus-environment partition must be confirmed to track proximal avoidability rather than hazard-object provenance.
claims.blocking_reason: The graded-proximity leg is runnable and passed (EXQ-029: none 0.373, approach 0.612, contact 0.666). The agent-versus-environment asymmetry leg rests on transition_type, which distinguishes who placed the hazard object, not who caused the harm -- both classes are equally proximally avoidable, so the recorded instrument measures a different axis from the one the title asserts.
false_positives: Reading the EXQ-085 through 085g FAIL series as evidence against MECH-071 is wrong: those failed on C2 goal-directed navigation (a goal-to-action-selection wiring bug owned by SD-015/MECH-112/ARC-030) while C3, the calibration criterion, passed in every one of them.
claims.auditor_notes: The MECH-072 / V3-EXQ-877 provenance finding was scoped to that claim's stay-comparator discriminator, but the label semantics it exposed are shared, and MECH-071's own WWA already carries the caveat. Verified directly in causal_grid_world.py: agent_caused_hazard fires on entering a contaminated cell, env_caused_hazard on entering a placed hazard.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): requires
CausalGridWorldV2 (or successor) with hazard_field proximity channels present in
z_world and SD-007 reafference correction active (removing self-motion
contamination from the proximity signal) -- without both, harm_eval has no
proximity structure to be calibrated against and a flat/degenerate score is an
instrumentation failure, not disconfirmation. A test without ARC-024 proxy
gradient fields (as EXQ-026) is a valid but weaker test than one with them (as
EXQ-029, which showed a much larger calibration_gap); either is informative, but
do not compare their magnitudes as if measuring the same thing.
EXCLUDED FROM SCORING: the EXQ-085/085a-085g goal-seeded-navigation series is
NOT informative for or against this claim. All eight manifests were
reclassified evidence_direction_per_claim=non_contributory on 2026-06-02
(memo: evidence/planning/exq085_mech071_disposition_2026-06-02.md) because
their repeated FAILs were on criterion C2 (goal-directed navigation, a
scaffolding bug later traced to goal_state not being wired to action
selection), a mechanism owned by SD-015/MECH-112/ARC-030 -- not on C3
(calibration gradient), which PASSed in every one of those runs. Only a
C3-shaped calibration-gap test (EXQ-026/EXQ-029 pattern) bears on MECH-071.
CAVEAT for any future test that partitions by agent_caused_hazard vs
env_caused_hazard specifically: the 2026-08-03 autopsy of the sibling claim
MECH-072 (V3-EXQ-877, evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-877_2026-08-03.md)
found that CausalGridWorldV2's transition_type labels encode hazard-OBJECT
PROVENANCE (did the environment place this tile, or did the agent's own
contamination footprint), which is anti-correlated with PROXIMAL avoidability
for the contamination mechanic specifically. That finding was scoped to
MECH-072's counterfactual (stay-comparator) discriminator, not to MECH-071's
calibration-gap measure, and MECH-071's own evidence (EXQ-026/029) does not use
a stay-counterfactual -- so it is not automatically undermined. But a future
run should confirm which axis it is actually testing (labeled provenance vs
true proximal avoidability) before its result is taken as a clean test of
"agent-caused" in the intuitive sense the title uses.
CONFIRMING signature: harm_eval(z_world_t) rises monotonically/continuously as
the agent approaches a hazard (not only at the contact event -- e.g. the graded
none < approach < contact pattern from EXQ-029), AND calibration_gap computed
ahead of agent_caused_hazard/hazard_approach transitions exceeds calibration_gap
ahead of env_caused_hazard transitions or locomotion by a margin comparable to
or exceeding the EXQ-026 threshold (>0.03 gap magnitude, or the pre-registered
threshold of the specific test design).
FALSIFYING signature: harm_eval shows no graded/continuous structure with
proximity (jumps only at contact, or is flat), OR calibration_gap does not
differ (or reverses) between the agent_caused_hazard/hazard_approach group and
the env_caused_hazard/locomotion group, OR the gap that is observed collapses
to noise once measured on a ground-truth partition confirmed to track proximal
avoidability rather than object provenance (see CAVEAT above).

claims.claim_title: Foreseeable-harm gating on residue accumulation reduces false attribution without degrading harm avoidance.
claims.falsifier_summary: Under the same oracle label and a sound discriminator (null-CF sanity met, harm_fwd_r2 above floor), gating produces no reduction in false attribution or reduces it only at the cost of a measurable rise in harm_rate -- foreseeability gating does not buy cleaner attribution.
claims.required_event: Harm events of both kinds within one episode stream: harm the agent could have avoided by acting differently this tick, and harm no alternative action this tick would have avoided, with the agent's action sequence long enough to accumulate residue at both classes of location.
claims.manipulation: Gate residue accumulation on the ARC-033/SD-011 counterfactual discriminator: GATED arm passes owned=True to REEAgent.update_residue only when causal_sig = harm_eval(E2HarmSForward(z_harm_s, a_actual)) - harm_eval(E2HarmSForward(z_harm_s, a_stay)) exceeds the threshold; UNGATED arm accumulates at every harm event.
claims.control: Matched-seed ungated arm on the identical trajectory, plus a null-counterfactual control (a_actual substituted for a_stay, causal_sig must be ~0) and an oracle-gated positive-control arm driven by the replay-derived avoidability label, which upper-bounds the achievable false-attribution reduction.
claims.DV: false_attr_rate = residue accumulated at NON-avoidable harm events divided by total residue, scored against the replayed proximal-avoidability oracle rather than transition_type, paired with harm_rate (harm avoidance must not degrade) on the same seeds.
claims.instrument: Every piece exists and none is combined: the gate hook is REEAgent.update_residue(owned=, world_delta=) into ResidueField.accumulate; the discriminator is exercised by V3-EXQ-877; and the oracle needs only the deepcopy(env) snapshot-and-replay pattern already used by V3-EXQ-817/817a/1006. No experiment computes the avoidability label.
claims.consumer_locus: The owned= decision at residue accumulation -- which harm events leave a durable trace in the residue field -- not the discriminator's own accuracy, which V3-EXQ-431/525 already validated separately.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The ground-truth agency partition must be PROXIMAL AVOIDABILITY, derived by replaying the stay action from the pre-action state against the environment's own step function -- not CausalGridWorldV2 transition_type labels, which encode hazard-OBJECT provenance and are anti-correlated with avoidability for the contamination mechanic. Both classes must occur at or above a pre-registered minimum count, the discriminator must clear its null-counterfactual sanity check, and harm-forward quality (harm_fwd_r2) must stay above its floor so a gate failure is not a model failure.
claims.blocking_reason: Not substrate: the gate, the discriminator and the env-replay snapshot idiom all exist. The confirmed V3-EXQ-877 autopsy showed the scored ground truth measures the wrong causal axis, and routed a redesign with a replay-derived avoidability label. That redesign was never written or queued -- no 877a script, no queue entry, and no experiment anywhere computes an avoidability oracle.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The 2026-03-20 note that MECH-072 is blocked on SD-005/SD-011 is no longer the operative blocker -- SD-011 landed and V3-EXQ-877 ran the real counterfactual discriminator; the live blocker is the scoring label, not the split.
The 877 direction reversal reads as evidence against the claim; the autopsy established it is the mechanistically correct behaviour of a proximal comparator scored on a diachronic label.
claims.auditor_notes: ARC-037's what_would_answer already carries this proximal-avoidability requirement as its P1 and cross-references MECH-072's C1, so the two falsifiers should share one oracle implementation. The autopsy's second routing (a separate diachronic/footprint self-attribution claim) was never registered -- ARC-037's falsifying clause (d) is where it currently lives.

claims.falsifier_summary: Later-stage representations lose raw-observation correlation without gaining any typed content the earlier stage lacked (compression, not abstraction), OR the recovered ordering matches an ARC-007/ARC-014 rival at least as well as ARC-022's, leaving Q-020 unadjudicated in ARC-022's favour.
claims.required_event: A trained agent stepping CausalGridWorldV2 through harm contacts and goal-relevant resource contacts, with the representation at each named pipeline stage captured at the same step index.
claims.manipulation: Lesion or bypass each stage in turn along the asserted order -- identity E2.world_forward, frozen hippocampal proposal stage (module.propose_trajectories), z_goal writer disabled -- so the ORDER of typed-object passing is manipulated rather than only described.
claims.control: The rival ARC-007 and ARC-014 orderings fitted to the same representational data as explicit comparator models, plus a shuffled-stage-label null; V3-EXQ-208's three levels alone give no rival to beat.
claims.DV: Typed-object recoverability that is NEW at a later stage: harm/goal identity linearly recoverable at stage k+1 but not at stage k, alongside the drop in raw-observation RSA, both sign-consistent across seeds. Not a monotone RSA decline alone, which any lossy compression produces.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_208_arc022_hierarchical_pipeline_probe.py records RSA(obs, level) and RSA(harm, level) for z_world, the E1 LSTM hidden state and the E2 world_forward prediction only. There is no recorder for a DMN stage, the Goal/Avoid stage or the hippocampal proposal stage, and grep for dmn/default_mode over ree_core/ returns nothing.
claims.consumer_locus: The inter-stage representational interface -- what one stage hands the next -- not agent behaviour and not end-of-episode outcome.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: E1 and E2 must be trained to a converged world-forward before any abstraction gradient is read, and the eval sample must contain both harm and non-harm states so the harm-agreement similarity matrix is non-degenerate. claims.blocking_reason: V3-EXQ-208 measures decodability (RSA correlation drop) across three levels, not typed-object passing, and is experiment_purpose diagnostic so it cannot weight confidence. Two of the five asserted stages have no recorder and a DMN stage has no module in ree_core at all, so the pipeline ORDER the claim asserts has never been manipulated.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT

claims.claim_title: Amygdala functions as read/write head for valenced hippocampal map — parent claim split into MECH-074a-d (2026-04-21).
claims.falsifier_summary: FULL clears but neither single-route arm does (authority without separability), or, on the new consumer, both single-route deltas fall below their replication floors with all preconditions green -- separability would then be a property of the replay-sampling path alone and the parent's scope should be narrowed to that path in text.
claims.required_event: Arousal-varying encoding and retrieval episodes in which BLA encoding_gain and retrieval_bias both vary across stored traces, so both the strength route and the address route have something to move.
claims.manipulation: Four matched-seed arms: FULL, TAG_OFF (strength route only), GAIN_FLAT (address route only), OFF -- the route-dissociation design of V3-EXQ-888, repeated on a second readout consumer.
claims.control: The fully-OFF arm as the instrument control (888 measured -0.0006 / -0.0107 / +0.0063), plus the replication floors set from 888's across-seed SDs: 0.06 for the address route and 0.15 for the strength route on a new consumer.
claims.DV: AOR_z, the arousal-ordering ratio of sampled traces, differenced against the OFF arm: head authority = AOR_z(FULL) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03 on >= 2/3 seeds; separability = BOTH single-route arms independently clearing the same floor.
claims.instrument: BLA outputs are consumed in ree-v3/ree_core/agent.py only at the replay call sites (diverse_replay under replay_diversity_enabled and the REM attribution pass), and applied in ree_core/hippocampal/module.py where retrieval_bias reweights exploration-buffer sampling. No E3-side recorder exists because no E3-side consumer exists.
claims.consumer_locus: SD-035's specified data flow has TWO readout consumers: hippocampal replay sampling (built) and E3.select candidate reweighting (specified at sd_035_amygdala_analog.md lines 158/170/223, not built).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: V3-EXQ-888's five readiness gates verbatim (n_traces >= 8; gt_arousal buffer std >= 0.02; buffer/label index alignment 1.0; memory_strength range >= 0.05; retrieval_bias range >= 0.01) plus OFF-arm flatness |AOR_z| <= 0.02. On a new consumer add the length check: HippocampalModule silently ignores a retrieval_bias whose numel differs from the buffer length, degenerating to uniform sampling with no error.
claims.blocking_reason: The second readout consumer does not exist. retrieval_bias has exactly two live call sites in agent.py, both replay paths; e3_selector.py never receives it, although SD-035's data-flow spec states 'E3.select accepts BLA retrieval_bias to reweight hippocampal candidate proposals' and SD-035 is marked implemented. Without that wiring the WWA's new-consumer arm cannot be run.
false_positives: SD-035's substrate_queue status 'implemented' is over-stated for this line item: its own wiring list includes 'E3.select accepts retrieval_bias', which is absent from ree_core.
claims.auditor_notes: Two caveats on the claim's only experimental entry, V3-EXQ-888: (1) its neutral arm is configured num_hazards=0, which is why MECH-074 appears on the open GFLAG-0304 contamination list with 100 percent of its indexer-scored entries affected; (2) GFLAG-0249 records that 888's four load-bearing criteria carry no measured value or threshold, so the PASS is not re-derivable from the manifest alone.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: reuse V3-EXQ-888's readiness block verbatim; do not re-derive it. All five must be reported green in-run: n_traces >= 8; buffer std of the ground-truth arousal label >= 0.02 (this is the statistic EVERY AOR routes on -- all four AORs are differences of means of gt_arousal, so zero spread forces every AOR to 0 regardless of weighting); buffer/label index alignment == 1.0; memory_strength range across buffer traces >= 0.05 (the strength route cannot move a weighted sample if encoding_gain does not vary); retrieval_bias range across buffer traces >= 0.01 (same for the address route). Plus the instrument control: the fully-OFF arm must be flat, |AOR_z(OFF)| <= 0.02 on every seed (888 measured -0.0006 / -0.0107 / +0.0063). For a run on a NEW consumer, add: the consumer must be shown to actually receive a non-uniform weight vector -- HippocampalModule silently ignores a retrieval_bias whose numel does not equal the buffer length (hippocampal/module.py:2964), so a length mismatch degenerates to uniform sampling with no error.
CONFIRMING: four arms at matched seeds (FULL / TAG_OFF = strength route only / GAIN_FLAT = address route only / OFF). Head authority: AOR_z(FULL) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03 on >= 2/3 seeds. Separability: BOTH single-route arms independently clear the same floor -- AOR_z(TAG_OFF) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03 AND AOR_z(GAIN_FLAT) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03. On a NEW consumer (E3.select proposal reweighting, once wired per SD-035's data-flow spec) the address-route arm must clear 0.06, i.e. 2x the across-seed SD of that arm's delta as measured in 888 (0.0313), because the 0.03 absolute floor sits at exactly 1 SD there and would not distinguish replication from noise; the strength-route arm's observed SD is 0.0740, so its replication floor is 0.15.
FALSIFYING: FULL clears but NEITHER single-route arm does -- authority without separability, i.e. one undifferentiated write channel rather than a read/write head with two routes, which is the parent's specific residual assertion and the only thing it still claims beyond the children. Also falsifying: the OFF arm is not flat (|AOR_z| > 0.02), which voids the instrument rather than the claim; or, on the new consumer, both single-route deltas fall below their replication floors with all preconditions green -- separability would then be a property of the replay-sampling path only, and the parent's scope should be narrowed to that path in text rather than left general.

claims.claim_title: BLA analogue applies an arousal-dependent multiplicative gain to HippocampalModule write strength.
claims.falsifier_summary: With preconditions green, threat-recall delta below the floor on >= 2/3 seeds -- the gain buys replay-composition bias but no recall benefit and the write-strength-to-retrievability mapping is mis-specified. Separately: threat gain bought at neutral cost (neutral delta <= -0.05), which routes to bla_retrieval_bias_compensation rather than to abandoning the claim.
claims.required_event: Live-loop episodes containing arousing threat items and matched neutral items encoded under the BLA post-event window, followed by a retrieval probe on both item classes.
claims.manipulation: ARM_GAIN (use_amygdala_analog=True, use_bla_analog=True, defaults) versus ARM_GAIN_1 with override_bla_encoding_gain pinned to 1.0, everything else bit-identical at matched seeds.
claims.control: The gain-pinned arm at matched seeds, plus the neutral-item class within each arm as the within-run comparator for the cost half of the falsifier.
claims.DV: Threat-context RECALL ACCURACY delta and neutral RECALL ACCURACY delta on a retrieval probe -- explicitly NOT the arousal-over-representation share statistic used by V3-EXQ-659 and V3-EXQ-888, since AOR is a share of a fixed replay budget and an AOR rise and a neutral decrement are the same event counted twice.
claims.instrument: The manipulation exists (override_bla_encoding_gain, config.py:6692, read at agent.py:5428) and the write path exists (BLAAnalog encoding_gain -> Trajectory.memory_strength -> hippocampal/module.py). The DV instrument does NOT: grep finds no recall/retrieval accuracy probe in ree_core or experiments/_lib, and memory_strength's only live consumer weights replay SAMPLING, which is the AOR statistic itself.
claims.consumer_locus: Hippocampal write strength at encoding time and its effect on later RETRIEVABILITY -- the write-strength-to-recall mapping, not replay composition.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: bla_n_ticks > 0 in the live loop (the exact defect that vacated V3-EXQ-474's C2-C5); per-episode peak encoding_gain range >= 0.05 with at least one episode above bla_arousal_threshold_on = 0.4 and no saturation at the inverted-U peak; and BOTH recall DVs strictly between floor and ceiling in the gain=1 baseline so a neutral-recall decrement is measurable at all.
claims.blocking_reason: There is no recall-accuracy probe anywhere in the tree, and memory_strength's only downstream consumer is replay-sampling weight in hippocampal/module.py -- so the asserted write-strength-to-retrievability step has no live consumer to read. Both banked entries (659, 888) measure the AOR share, which the claim's own precondition (4) rules out as the DV.
claims.auditor_notes: EXP-1382 already proposes exactly this run with the right acceptance checks and is the correct owner, but it presumes a recall probe that does not exist; the honest sequencing is probe first, run second. The probe is a measurement item (encode tagged items, query the store, score retrieval), not a new cognitive mechanism -- worth the coordinator deciding whether it needs a node. GFLAG-0304 (hazard-free contamination) is open and may touch this family's banked entries.
claims.coordinator_note: The recall-accuracy probe this row names as missing is registered once, together with MECH-074b's central/gist-vs-peripheral item category, as a single item-level recall instrument node; see prerequisites_registered.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) BLA must actually tick in the live loop -- report `bla_n_ticks > 0`; this is the exact defect that vacated V3-EXQ-474's C2-C5 (an env.step 5-tuple unpacking bug left `bla_n_ticks = 0` and turned the run into synthetic BLAAnalog.tick() unit tests). (2) The gain must VARY: per-episode peak encoding_gain range across the buffer >= 0.05 (888's MS_RANGE_FLOOR), with at least one episode above `bla_arousal_threshold_on = 0.4` and not every threat episode pinned at the inverted-U peak -- a saturated gain is a constant and tests nothing. (3) BOTH DVs must be live: threat-item recall and neutral-item recall each strictly between floor and ceiling in the gain=1 baseline, so that a DECREMENT in neutral recall is measurable at all. (4) The DV must be RECALL ACCURACY on a probe, NOT the arousal-over-representation statistic used by V3-EXQ-659 and V3-EXQ-888. This is the load-bearing precondition: AOR is a share-of-a-fixed-budget measure, so an AOR increase and a neutral-recall decrement are the SAME event expressed twice -- the existing evidence therefore cannot address the second half of this claim's own falsifier even in principle.
CONFIRMING: two arms at matched seeds -- ARM_GAIN (use_amygdala_analog=True, use_bla_analog=True, defaults) vs ARM_GAIN_1 (`override_bla_encoding_gain` pinned to 1.0, everything else bit-identical). Threat-context recall accuracy delta >= max(0.05 absolute, 1 SD of the across-seed delta) on >= 2/3 seeds, AND neutral recall delta > -0.02 on the same seeds. Both halves required -- a threat-recall gain alone is not a PASS of this falsifier as registered.
FALSIFYING: with preconditions green, threat-recall delta below the floor on >= 2/3 seeds -- the encoding-gain arithmetic buys replay-composition bias (659/888) but no recall benefit, and the claim's mapping from write strength to retrievability is mis-specified. SEPARATELY falsifying the arithmetic but not the mechanism: threat gain bought at neutral cost (neutral recall delta <= -0.05), which is the claim's own named second failure mode and routes to `bla_retrieval_bias_compensation` (0.1-0.3, the zero-sum form already implemented and default-off) rather than to abandoning the claim.

Independently, ARM_VECTOR missing the floor with all preconditions green narrows the claim to the sampling path with no item-level readout authority.

claims.instrument: The bias vector and its lever exist (ree_core/amygdala/bla.py per-trace retrieval_bias, retrieval_bias_compensation wired end-to-end; bla_retrieval_tag_at_encoding in config), and V3-EXQ-888's C2 measured the per-trace vector shifting arousal over-representation in a WEIGHTED REPLAY SAMPLE. What is absent is any item-level recall readout: grep of ree_core finds no central/gist versus peripheral item category anywhere, so the dissociation DV has no recorder.
claims.consumer_locus: Content-selective per-trace priority over the hippocampal replay/reactivation SAMPLE -- the locus the 2026-09-09 claim-synthesis narrowed to; the retrieval-time item-level readout enhancement is the unevidenced residual this falsifier is for.

claims.blocking_reason: The environment cannot generate the required event. No central/gist versus peripheral item distinction exists anywhere in ree_core or CausalGridWorldV2, and no per-item recall readout exists, so precondition (b) of the claim's own what_would_answer is unsatisfiable; without it a run re-measures V3-EXQ-888's between-trace threat-versus-neutral contrast, which is already answered and vacuous against the residual.
false_positives: Roozendaal and McGaugh 2011 weakening the RETRIEVAL locus is not evidence against the claim as it now stands: the 2026-09-09 synthesis already narrowed the locus to the replay/reactivation sample, and the what_would_answer encodes that narrowing.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: A within-episode central/gist versus peripheral item distinction with per-item recall scored independently, so the vector-versus-scalar contrast can be read as the LaBar and Cabeza dissociation rather than as 888's between-trace threat-versus-neutral contrast.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Episodes that expose categorised items (central/gist threat-associated versus peripheral neutral) inside one episode, tagged at encoding, with the arousal tag written per item.

claims.auditor_notes: This is a measurement/environment item, not a new cognitive mechanism: the BLA vector and the replay path already exist and V3-EXQ-888 C2 already measured the sampling leg. claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see MECH-074's own what_would_answer for the shared readiness block (n_traces, gt_arousal spread, buffer/label alignment, both route-nonuniformity floors, OFF-arm flatness) -- do not re-derive it. (b) The environment/harness must expose CENTRAL/GIST vs PERIPHERAL items WITHIN the same episode, each with independently measurable recall. Without (b) the run re-measures 888's between-trace threat-vs-neutral contrast, which is already answered and is NOT the LaBar & Cabeza central/peripheral dissociation this claim is about; a "PASS" obtained that way would be vacuous with respect to the residual.
CONFIRMING: three arms at matched seeds -- ARM_VECTOR (per-trace w_i = 1 + alpha*tag_i, alpha in [0.3, 1.0]), ARM_SCALAR (uniform w = 1 + alpha*mean(tag) across all traces; equivalently `bla_retrieval_tag_at_encoding=False`), ARM_OFF. claims.claim_title: CeA analogue emits a fast subcortical priming signal (fast_prime) on low-frequency z_harm_a with an overridable decay window, distinct from MECH-046's cortical mode-prior write.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the gate firing, fast_prime and the AIC crossing are simultaneous or AIC leads -- the signal is not functionally a PRIME. Also falsifying: the pulse proves non-overridable in-loop, so the override discipline that bounds this claim is false in the only regime that matters.
claims.required_event: An embodied harm event that crosses the registered fast-route threshold in the live loop, with the AIC/dACC comparator processing the SAME event so the two onsets can be timed against each other.
claims.manipulation: None on the CeA module itself for the residual leg -- the comparison is of ONSET TIMES on one event; the manipulable arms are cortical confirmation arriving inside versus outside the 8-step override window, to test the hold and the decay.
claims.control: The driven-regime baselines already banked by V3-EXQ-895 (C1 onset 0 steps, C2 half-life 4.0, C3 amplitude 0.297 <= 0.50, C4 hold 1.0 / separation 0.703, C5 0.8 bound), which fix the expected values that the embodied run must reproduce.

claims.instrument: ree_core/amygdala/cea.py emits fast_prime with its decay and override-window state; AICAnalog is built and wired (ree_core/cingulate/aic_analog.py, constructed in agent.py and used at two sites) so a comparator crossing time is readable. V3-EXQ-895 recorded embodied_fire_count = 0 on every seed with max ||LowFreq(z_harm_a)||_1/n = 0.216 and fast_prime identically 0.0. A run that lowers the threshold to force firing measures the threshold, not the claim.
claims.blocking_reason: The mechanism never enters the regime where the falsifier discriminates: the registered threshold is 0.5 on ||LowFreq(z_harm_a)||_1/n and the only embodied measurement peaked at 0.216, so fast_prime is identically 0.0 and every DV is undefined. claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- this is the whole finding, not a formality: the CeA fast gate must actually FIRE in the regime being measured, at its REGISTERED threshold. The only embodied measurement to date (V3-EXQ-895's non-gating SELECTIVITY_PROBE, 4 seeds, 2044 ticks total) recorded embodied_fire_count = 0 on every seed with max ||LowFreq(z_harm_a)||_1/n = 0.216 against cea_fast_route_threshold = 0.5, and fast_prime identically 0.0. claims.claim_title: Does ARC-007's no-value-computation constraint survive MECH-073 (valence intrinsic to hippocampal map)?
claims.falsifier_summary: S3 above the registered epsilon and above the shuffled-label band on a majority of seeds; the S1 x S3 2x2 then selects between revising ARC-007 (S1 high, S3 high) and rejecting MECH-073 (S1 at chance, S3 high).
claims.required_event: Episodes from one frozen trained agent in which the agent visits several distinct residue cells and encounters both harm and safe steps in sufficient number to train a per-step decoder.
claims.manipulation: None behavioural by design -- this is a source-dissociation decoding contrast. The only manipulation is the zeroing of the residue term used for the decision-relevance precondition, plus the shuffled-label control arm.
claims.control: Label-permuted arm that must land at chance, and residualisation of S2 on S1 so shared variance is not double counted; no behavioural DV is carried, so the C2 harm-advantage cluster cannot be re-derived as this claim's verdict.
claims.DV: S3 = AUROC(S1 + S2) minus AUROC(S1) for a per-step harm/safe label, where S1 decodes from residue_field.evaluate / evaluate_valence at visited z_world points and S2 from HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories output read as PROPOSED, before E3 ranks it.
claims.instrument: Both sources exist and are readable: ree_core/residue/field.py evaluate (:604) and evaluate_valence (:355, :937); hippocampal/module.py propose_trajectories (:2037) returns List[Trajectory] before E3. No driver assembles them into the S1/S2/S3 probe, and no run has ever recorded the decision-relevance statistic.
claims.consumer_locus: The proposer-to-E3 boundary: whether the hippocampal proposal carries value information over and above what the terrain geometry already supplies, which is what ARC-007 STRICT forbids.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All four of the WWA's gates: terrain liveness measured RELATIVE (spread/|mean| against a declared floor, not 266b's absolute 1e-4 which passed at a 0.02% modulation); decision relevance (fraction of steps where argmax J(zeta) flips when the residue term is zeroed); spatial coverage well above 266b's 1.2 residue cells per episode; and a decoder sample floor with a label-permuted arm landing at chance.
claims.blocking_reason: The decoding instruments exist and the design is fully specified, but the non-degeneracy regime has never been shown reachable: V3-EXQ-266b measured 1.2 residue cells per episode (no positional contrast for geometry to embody) and the decision-relevance gate has never been measured at all. That coverage failure is the MECH-457 competence-floor regime, not a design defect.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: V3-EXQ-266b's weakens does not bear on the leg Q-020's WWA now isolates: 266b measured the behavioural harm-advantage (C2 cluster), while the untested half is the representational non-computation claim, which carries no behavioural DV.
claims.auditor_notes: The out-of-domain leg (does the biological hippocampus compute value) is settled by literature and routes through /lit-pull only; do not let a chip re-open it as an experiment.
claims.what_would_answer:
Q-020 is FUSED: one leg is neuroanatomy already answered by
literature, one leg is a live REE dissociation. Named separately.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (answered; not REE-testable): "does the biological
hippocampus COMPUTE value -- RPE, utility, outcome evaluation?"
Answered 2026-04-02 by literature synthesis (Resolution A): it does
not; it stores the geometrically-encoded result of computation
performed externally (Bittner 2017 BTSP plateau write-triggers;
Teyler & Rudy 2007 indexing; McGaugh 2004 / Dolcos 2004 BLA
write-depth modulation; Gauthier 2018 reward cells reread as stable
BLA-tagged relays). V3-EXQ-266b does not bear on this leg and did NOT
reopen it -- its own manifest says so. New evidence here routes
through /lit-pull, never through the experiment queue.

REE LEG (live -- this is what the 2026-07-25 reopening actually put
in question): Resolution A asserts a DISSOCIATION -- the map EMBODIES
value-shaped geometry (MECH-073) while the proposer navigating it
computes no value (ARC-007 STRICT; MECH-073's conflict_note calls it
"the value-flat hippocampal proposer"). Only the EMBODIMENT half has
ever been tested: V3-EXQ-375 PASS 3/3, VALENCE_GEOM probe-AUROC
0.982/0.923, VALENCE_ABLATED at chance. The NON-COMPUTATION half --
that the proposer adds no value information the terrain did not
already supply -- is UNTESTED, and it is the half that carries
ARC-007's constraint. That is Q-020's own content. The shaped-vs-flat
harm advantage V3-EXQ-266b measured is ARC-007/MECH-073's behavioural
leg, sits in the C2 harm_advantage_not_reproduced cluster (114a /
120a / 266b), and must NOT be re-run under this claim.

Answered by EXPERIMENT: a SOURCE-DISSOCIATION decoding probe over one
frozen trained agent, deliberately carrying NO behavioural DV, so the
C2 cluster's harm-advantage collapse cannot be re-derived as this
claim's verdict. Decode a per-step harm/safe label from:
(S1) MAP GEOMETRY -- residue_field.evaluate / evaluate_valence at the
visited z_world points;
(S2) PROPOSER STATE -- HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories output
as PROPOSED, read before E3's J(zeta) ranks it;
(S3) the INCREMENT S2 adds over S1 -- AUROC(S1 (+) S2) minus
AUROC(S1), with S2 residualised on S1 so shared variance is not
double-counted. S3 is the load-bearing statistic; S1 and S2 alone are
context.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four; any failure self-routes
substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a verdict):
(a) TERRAIN LIVENESS, RELATIVE NOT ABSOLUTE. V3-EXQ-266b's P2 floor
was an ABSOLUTE spread >= 1e-4 and passed GREEN at spread 0.0034637
on a probe mean of 17.586 -- a 0.02% modulation riding a large DC
offset, i.e. a constant field with numerical jitter. Register
spread/|mean| against a declared floor, not raw spread.
(b) DECISION RELEVANCE. The terrain term must be able to move
selection: fraction of steps at which argmax J(zeta) differs from
argmax J(zeta) with the residue term zeroed, against a registered
floor. A field with large spread that never flips a rank is inert at
the decision scale however green an absolute-spread gate reads.
(c) SPATIAL COVERAGE. Distinct residue cells visited per episode must
exceed 1 by a registered margin. V3-EXQ-266b measured
mean_cells_per_episode = 1.2 -- the agent barely left one cell, so
there was no positional contrast for geometry to embody, and a field
probed at effectively one location is not a landscape.
(d) DECODER FLOOR + SHUFFLED-LABEL CONTROL. Registered minimum harm
and safe sample counts per seed, plus a label-permuted arm that must
land at chance. This is the representational analogue of 266b's
A2_STATIC no-op control: a contrast without a control that CANNOT
succeed is not adjudicable.

CONFIRMING signature (Resolution A holds; ARC-007 STRICT survives
MECH-073): S1 AUROC above a registered floor, replicating V3-EXQ-375;
S3 increment at or below a registered epsilon and inside the
shuffled-label band, in all seeds. The proposer carries no value
information the geometry did not already supply -- it embodies, it
does not compute.

FALSIFYING signature (Resolution A fails; the conflict_note's A/B
fork reopens): S3 increment above the registered epsilon and above
the shuffled-label band in a majority of seeds. The proposer computes
value of its own, which is exactly what ARC-007's
no-value-computation constraint forbids. The S1 x S3 2x2 SELECTS
which fork: S1 high AND S3 high routes to option (A), revise ARC-007
(the hippocampal stage computes value after all, and INV-014's
representation/regulation separation comes into play); S1 at chance
AND S3 high routes to option (B), reject MECH-073 (value never
entered the geometry and the proposer is doing the work). Apply the
outcome to ARC-022's conflict_note in the same pass -- it names the
same fork and defers to this claim.

Scoped to Pathway A (drive absence, the ARC-030 route) only; Pathway B
(self-incoherence-gated commit suppression via MECH-113/114) is a separate,

Two-arm ablation on the V3 forage/harm stack, trained identically except for
the Go drive: approach arm (z_goal attractor + novelty/self-maintenance ON) vs
avoidance-only arm (harm gradient only, Go drive ablated). ANSWER "yes -- flatness"
if over training the avoidance-only arm collapses to a quiescent floor
(resource_visit_rate < 0.2x the approach arm AND policy_entropy within epsilon of

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a continuous ACh-analogue plasticity-gain parameter in ree_core, distinct from the binary hypothesis_tag gate, causally read at hippocampal write time (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, ree_core/residue/field.py) and continuously modulating write/accumulation strength. claims.claim_title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
claims.falsifier_summary: Tagged content durably alters ANY real-experience channel through an ungoverned path -- tag ignored, defaulted away by a getattr fallback on a newly landed consumer, or bypassed outside MECH-322's stated conditions -- or the MECH-322 carve-out itself fires in waking DMN, outside sleep phase, or without the replay_origin audit flag.
claims.required_event: A run in which simulate() / _do_replay / the DMN rollout genuinely fires, paired with matched waking episodes that commit and write on the same channels, plus a sleep phase in which the MECH-322 carve-out can be observed under and outside its three ANDed preconditions.
claims.manipulation: Simulation/replay mode versus matched waking commitment on identical content, with the hypothesis_tag / simulation_mode flag as the manipulated variable, plus a coverage manipulation: re-derive the write-capable-consumer set from the current tree and assert each member's gate.
claims.control: The matched waking arm is the load-bearing control (without it, "no simulation write" is indistinguishable from "no write at all"), and the MECH-322 sleep-only carve-out is the one sanctioned exception that must be shown to fire strictly inside its three conditions.
claims.DV: Two quantities. Behavioural: durable change in real-experience channels (residue / phi(z) accumulation, valence update, hippocampal RBF/MEL write, chunk formation, novelty/visitation state) under simulation versus waking on matched content. Coverage: the count of write-capable consumers in the CURRENT tree that reach a durable channel without consulting hypothesis_tag, simulation_mode or an equivalent replay_origin flag.
claims.instrument: The behavioural side is instrumented -- ResidueField.accumulate / accumulate_benefit / accumulate_safety / update_valence all take and honour hypothesis_tag, and V3-EXQ-499 / 633 / 880 have run. The COVERAGE side has no instrument: no contract test or audit script enumerates write-capable consumers from the current tree and asserts each gates, so the WWA's third precondition cannot presently be discharged.
claims.consumer_locus: Every durable real-experience belief-update channel -- the residue field primarily, plus the agent.py gating sites for MEL writes, novelty/visitation buffers, EMA advancement, chunking, escape-affordance learning and pACC/cingulate drive updates.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The audited write path must be LIVE, not merely present: hypothesis_tag=True content must actually be generated and reach the write sites during the run (a zero simulation-firing count is a vacuity signal, not a PASS); the paired waking arm must produce non-zero durable writes on the same channels; and the call-site set must be re-derived from the current tree at run time, never from a stored list.
claims.blocking_reason: The behavioural leg is runnable and has run. The coverage-regression leg has no recorder: nothing re-derives the write-capable-consumer set from the current tree and asserts each gate, and the failure mode the claim names is precisely a NEWLY LANDED consumer that never learned about the tag, which a historical PASS cannot discharge.
false_positives: GFLAG-0285's 'measured 87 today' is an apples-to-oranges comparison: 87 is every mention of hypothesis_tag in agent.py, while the WWA's ~30 refers to the getattr(new_latent, "hypothesis_tag") gating form, of which there are 21. The flag's point stands (the number is stale) but the magnitude is overstated.

The 2026-04-09 EXQ-140 note 'no explicit simulation/real distinction mechanism implemented in ree_core' is long superseded -- the gate is now wired across residue, amygdala, pfc, hippocampal, sleep and goal modules.

claims.claim_title: E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).
claims.falsifier_summary: A context-gated variant still shows the adverse direction (batched worse than raw) even within stable windows, or no gating scheme recovers the static-k losses, which would mean E1-to-E3 temporal batching is not viable at any granularity and the theta-gamma framing should be retired in favour of raw pass-through.
claims.required_event: Alternating stable/uncommitted and volatile/committed windows within an episode, with harm-relevant state changes occurring in both, so batching can be applied selectively and its effect measured separately in each regime.
claims.manipulation: Gate the theta window on the agent's own commitment/volatility state -- batch during stable/uncommitted windows and pass through raw during volatile/committed ones -- against a fixed static-k baseline at k=2 and k=4 and a raw pass-through (theta-bypass) arm.
claims.control: The static-k arms and the theta-bypass arm at matched seeds and matched E3 tick rate, with the phase-weighted summary mode held constant so the gating effect is not confounded with the SD-100 phase weighting that landed separately.
claims.DV: harm_auc and E3 prediction error, reported separately for stable-window and volatile-window ticks, in the context-gated arm versus static-k and versus raw pass-through, plus the E3 update-rate cost saved during stable windows.
claims.instrument: ThetaBuffer records and summarises (ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py) and the clock emits theta_tick, and the harm_auc / prediction-error DVs are already implemented in the V3-EXQ-066 and V3-EXQ-122 drivers. What is absent is the gating manipulation itself: theta_tick is global_step modulo a fixed theta_buffer_size (ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py), with no context input.
claims.consumer_locus: The E1-to-E3 packaging boundary -- what E3 samples at its heartbeat tick, upstream of harm attribution, not the E3 scoring arithmetic.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A context-gated (non-uniform) theta window must exist and be tested against a fixed static-k baseline with non-zero cross-condition variance on harm_auc and prediction-error metrics; theta_buffer_size must exceed 1 so the summary is not the instantaneous z_world; and the environment must produce genuinely distinguishable stable and volatile windows, or the gate has nothing to condition on. A run using only static-k configurations cannot reopen the question.
claims.blocking_reason: The manipulation the falsifier requires does not exist. theta_tick is a fixed modulus of a constant theta_buffer_size and ThetaBuffer.summary has no context input, so V3 cannot generate a context-gated batching regime at all. The SD-100 phase-weighted summary that landed is position-sensitive, not context-gated, and its own note says so.
false_positives: Reading the landed SD-100 phase-weighted summary as discharging MECH-089's open redesign is wrong; the claim's own 2026-08-10 note already distinguishes phase-weighting from context-gating, and only the former landed.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: MECH-089's only open falsifier requires a non-uniform, context-conditioned theta window tested against a fixed static-k baseline; a static-k run can only reproduce the already-confirmed adverse result.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: A context-gated theta batching regime: the theta window (width and/or whether summary() is consulted at all) conditioned on an existing commitment/volatility signal such as beta_gate elevation or E3 running_variance, behind a default-OFF flag that is bit-identical when disabled.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-tick records of which regime each theta tick was in, plus harm_auc and E3 prediction error split by regime, so the batching cost and benefit can be attributed to stable versus volatile windows separately.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: The only substrate_queue entry naming MECH-089 is theta-buffer-phase-aware-summary, which is implemented and delivers the phase-weighted summary only; no entry, claim depends_on edge, closure-plan node or code path owns the context-gating half, and a corpus search for a context-gated theta owner returns nothing.

claims.auditor_notes: Small and well-scoped: the gating signal already exists (beta_gate.is_elevated, E3 running_variance), so this is a wiring plus flag item rather than a new mechanism. It should be registered as a measurement/manipulation prerequisite, not a cognitive-mechanism claim.
claims.what_would_answer:
ALREADY-ESTABLISHED (do not re-litigate): uniform static-k theta batching
(k=1, 2, 4) is CONFIRMED HARMFUL for harm attribution (EXQ-066: batched
error 2.28x worse than raw; EXQ-122: harm_auc delta=-0.135 adverse
direction, C1/C2/C3 fail). This is settled; only the context-gated
redesign remains open.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a context-dependent (non-uniform)
theta window implementation to exist and be tested against a fixed
static-k baseline with non-zero cross-condition variance on harm_auc /
prediction-error metrics -- a run using only static-k configurations
cannot reopen this question, it can only reproduce the already-confirmed
weakening.
CONFIRMING signature: a context-gated theta window (batching only during
stable/uncommitted windows, not uniformly) shows harm_auc and
prediction-error metrics AT LEAST at raw (unbatched) levels during
volatile/committed windows, while still providing the batching benefit
(reduced update-rate cost to E3) during stable windows -- i.e. the gating
recovers what static k=2/k=4 lost.
FALSIFYING: a context-gated variant STILL shows the adverse direction
(batched worse than raw) even during stable windows, or no context-gating
scheme recovers the static-k losses -- would indicate E1->E3 temporal
batching is not a viable mechanism at any granularity and the
theta-gamma framing should be retired in favour of raw pass-through.

claims.claim_title: Dual-stream observation routing sends exteroceptive input to both E1 and a dedicated harm detection pathway.
claims.falsifier_summary: A single encoder with a learned routing gate reproduces the same downstream behaviour and stream separation, or both heads exist and neither occupies a recoverable frame -- in which case the egocentric/allocentric language is biological motivation rather than architectural content.
claims.required_event: Episodes in which harm-salient structure and identity/layout structure are separably present, and in which agent position varies enough for a frame distinction to be recoverable.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the architectural distinction -- replace the separate heads with a single encoder plus a learned routing gate (the alternative this claim rejects) -- versus the built dual/triple-head SplitEncoder.
claims.control: Matched-capacity single-encoder arm with the same parameter budget and training schedule, so any difference is architectural rather than capacity-driven.
claims.DV: Stream separation and downstream behaviour: for the harm leg, harm-detection gap between routed and ablated arms above a task-calibrated threshold; for the frame leg, above-chance decoding of self-relative coordinates from z_self and of agent-position-invariant coordinates from z_world.
claims.instrument: SplitEncoder (latent/stack.py) instantiates self, world and lateral (z_harm) heads, so the routing leg is recordable; the frame leg has no instrument at all -- nothing in ree_core measures or asserts which reference frame either head occupies.
claims.consumer_locus: The observation encoder's routing boundary: exteroceptive input reaching E1 and, separately, a dedicated harm pathway feeding E3 without passing through E2_world.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two structurally distinct heads with a testable difference must exist. The harm-routing leg needs harm_dim > 0 so SplitEncoder's lateral head is instantiated, and a task hard enough that a single stream does not saturate it (EXQ-130's 8x8 grid did, giving sub-threshold gaps in both arms). The frame leg needs a frame difference that does not exist: grep of ree_core for egocentric, allocentric and reference_frame returns nothing, re-verified 2026-09-22.
claims.blocking_reason: The frame half has no measurement at any boundary -- no reference-frame representation or probe exists in the substrate. The routing half is measurable but its only run was underpowered: both arms were sub-threshold on an 8x8 task that a single stream saturates, so the design never entered a discriminating regime.
false_positives: EXQ-130 is sometimes read as evidence against dual-stream routing; the 2026-03-30 review reclassified it inconclusive (gap_stream_on 0.015 versus gap_ablated 0.019, both sub-threshold) -- an underpowered task, not a weakens.
claims.auditor_notes: MECH-555 already owns the reference-frame interface question with its own failing preconditions, and ARC-087 owns the V4 perceptual-adaptor substrate; the frame leg should be routed to them rather than given a new node.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two structurally distinct encoder heads must exist with a TESTABLE frame difference. V3 has the z_self/z_world split (SD-005 SplitEncoder) but nothing that makes one head egocentric and the other allocentric, and nothing that measures which frame either occupies (zero egocentric/allocentric/reference_frame matches in ree_core, verified 2026-09-15) -- the frame half of this claim was never built, and the claim is currently untestable in the vacuous sense ARC-087 records for its own substrate gate.
CONFIRMING: with both heads live, a frame-diagnostic probe recovers self-relative coordinates from z_self and agent-position-invariant coordinates from z_world at above-chance separation, AND removing the architectural distinction (a single encoder with a learned routing gate, the alternative this claim rejects) degrades the separation and the downstream split -- the claim's own stated failure mode, the z_self/z_world split degrading back toward z_gamma conflation.
FALSIFYING: a single encoder with a learned routing gate produces the same downstream behaviour and the same stream separation (the two-head requirement is not load-bearing); OR the two heads exist and neither occupies a recoverable frame, in which case the egocentric/allocentric language should be retired to biological motivation rather than architectural content.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; NOT excreted -- it is the only place REE records a frame commitment and MECH-555 depends on it. Currency: the frame half is asserted and unimplemented.

claims.claim_title: Peripersonal space geometry defines the commit locus — the spatial boundary of committed action.
claims.falsifier_summary: Commit-onset distance is unrelated to the envelope extent, or commits are distributed indistinguishably from non-commit ticks in distance -- the commit locus is not spatially defined.
claims.required_event: A commit onset (beta-gate elevation / committed-trajectory latch) during an approach to a hazard or resource cell, recorded together with the agent-to-object distance at that tick.
claims.manipulation: Vary the spatial extent of the near-body envelope -- the contact radius at which self-world consequences interact -- and observe whether the commit boundary moves with it; no such parameter exists, since contamination is an on-cell event and ree_core contains no peripersonal-space representation at all.
claims.control: Matched runs with the envelope parameter unchanged, plus a harm-exposure-matched arm so the commit-distance distribution is not driven by approach frequency.
claims.DV: The distribution of agent-to-object distance at commit onset versus at non-commit ticks, and specifically whether its mode tracks the manipulated envelope extent -- not harm-prediction accuracy.
claims.instrument: Commit onsets are observable through BetaGate and the E3 selector's commit branches, and grid position is available in the driver, so a commit-with-distance recorder is buildable; nothing records it today, and V3-EXQ-137 recorded harm_eval_gap instead.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit boundary itself -- where beta elevates and a trajectory is latched -- which the claim asserts coincides with the peripersonal envelope.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Commit must be a discriminable event with non-zero rate in the probe window (beta-gate elevations actually occur and vary), and the spatial envelope under test must be manipulable independently of harm exposure -- otherwise a shift in commit location is confounded with a shift in how often the agent is near a hazard.
claims.blocking_reason: There is no peripersonal-space representation in ree_core and no manipulable contact-envelope parameter, so the required manipulation cannot be generated. The one run on record, V3-EXQ-137, changed the harm_eval_head input and measured harm_eval_gap; it never touched the commit mechanism, so its FAIL does not bear on the commit-locus claim as stated.
false_positives: The 2026-04-24 FAIL is recorded as weakens for MECH-097, but the driver manipulated harm_eval_head inputs and measured harm-prediction quality; the commit locus was never manipulated or measured, so this is a failed test under an unmet precondition rather than evidence against the claim.
EXP-1319 attributes the block to MECH-091; MECH-091 governs phase-reset timing, not the spatial boundary, so clearing it would not by itself make this design discriminative.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: A commit-locus falsifier needs commit events timestamped with the agent-to-object distance, and a way to move the near-body envelope independently of harm exposure.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: A contact-envelope scale parameter in the grid environment (the radius at which a self-world consequence is registered), giving at least two envelope settings at matched hazard density.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: A commit-event recorder emitting, per beta-gate elevation, the tick, the agent position and the distance to the nearest hazard and resource, so commit-onset distance distributions are directly comparable across envelope settings.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: No substrate_queue entry, closure-plan node or governance flag owns a peripersonal or contact-envelope construct; SD-005 and ARC-016 are implemented and do not cover it, and EXP-1319 misattributes the block to MECH-091.

claims.auditor_notes: Prefer building the recorder first: the commit-onset distance distribution alone is a cheap diagnostic that would say whether any spatial structure exists before the environment parameter is worth adding.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Commit must be a discriminable event with non-zero rate in the probe window (beta-gate elevations actually occur and vary), and the spatial envelope under test must be manipulable independently of harm exposure -- otherwise a shift in commit location is confounded with a shift in how often the agent is near a hazard.
CONFIRMING: Commit onsets cluster at a characteristic agent-to-object distance, and that distance shifts with the manipulated envelope extent while harm exposure is held matched. Manipulation: Vary the spatial extent of the near-body envelope -- the contact radius at which self-world consequences interact -- and observe whether the commit boundary moves with it; no such parameter exists, since contamination is an on-cell event and ree_core contains no peripersonal-space representation at all. Control: Matched runs with the envelope parameter unchanged, plus a harm-exposure-matched arm so the commit-distance distribution is not driven by approach frequency. Required event: A commit onset (beta-gate elevation / committed-trajectory latch) during an approach to a hazard or resource cell, recorded together with the agent-to-object distance at that tick. DV: The distribution of agent-to-object distance at commit onset versus at non-commit ticks, and specifically whether its mode tracks the manipulated envelope extent -- not harm-prediction accuracy.
FALSIFYING: Commit-onset distance is unrelated to the envelope extent, or commits are distributed indistinguishably from non-commit ticks in distance -- the commit locus is not spatially defined. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Commit onsets are observable through BetaGate and the E3 selector's commit branches, and grid position is available in the driver, so a commit-with-distance recorder is buildable; nothing records it today, and V3-EXQ-137 recorded harm_eval_gap instead. Consumer / boundary: The commit boundary itself -- where beta elevates and a trajectory is latched -- which the claim asserts coincides with the peripersonal envelope. Existing ownership: SD-005, ARC-016, MECH-091, EXP-1319.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); There is no peripersonal-space representation in ree_core and no manipulable contact-envelope parameter, so the required manipulation cannot be generated. The one run on record, V3-EXQ-137, changed the harm_eval_head input and measured harm_eval_gap; it never touched the commit mechanism, so its FAIL does not bear on the commit-locus claim as stated. Secondary classes: R1, R4. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. claims.claim_title: Reafference cancellation: z_world subtracts predicted self-caused sensory change to isolate external events.
claims.falsifier_summary: With both preconditions met, selectivity in the corrected stream is indistinguishable from OFF and sham -- subtraction removes self-motion content without isolating external events.
claims.required_event: Locomotion steps producing a purely reafferent egocentric view shift, interleaved with steps carrying a genuine externally-caused world change.
claims.manipulation: Reafference correction ON vs OFF (LatentStackConfig.reafference_action_dim > 0, applying z_world_corrected = z_world_raw - predicted locomotion delta in LatentStack.encode), with a mis-paired-action sham arm.
claims.control: Correction OFF with the identical trained encoder and the sham (action-shuffled) correction arm, so the contrast isolates the subtraction rather than the extra module.
claims.DV: Event selectivity in the corrected z_world: the difference in z_world change between externally-caused-event steps and matched self-motion-only steps (event_selectivity_delta), read out of the corrected stream with a held-out probe.
claims.instrument: LatentStack.encode exposes z_world_raw as an SD-007 diagnostic and the 069/082/099a/110/529 drivers compute event_selectivity_delta; what is missing is a DV that can register exogenous events, since zworld_p0.py records transition-type decodability at or below chance in the world_obs channel.
claims.consumer_locus: The encoder boundary before E2_world -- the claim asserts the cancellation belongs at encoder level, so the DV must be read on the corrected z_world that E2/E3 consume.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two must hold and neither has: (a) the ReafferencePredictor must reach the pre-registered held-out R2 >= 0.70 on empty-space steps, trained inside the live loop rather than on sense()-only collected data (measured R2 has been -0.027 to 0.40); and (b) z_world must carry any exogenous-event signal at all, which is what the DV reads.
claims.blocking_reason: The DV does not exist: z_world is a static single-frame encoding and carries transition-type information at or below chance (-0.014 3-class, -0.060 6-class held out), reproduced six times in 2026-09. The manipulation is sound (predictor R2 0.34-0.40, action-sensitive) but every one of the 18 runs measured selectivity in a channel with no exogenous-event signal, under an undertrained canceller.
false_positives: The 'z_world at world_dim=32 lacks discriminative granularity' reading was refuted by V3-EXQ-783; dimensionality is not the fault here either -- an untrained encoder and an absent event channel are.
claims.auditor_notes: MECH-098's DV gap is the SAME gap MECH-221/MECH-222 are blocked on (the z_world exogenous-event channel, parked behind zworld_adequacy_plan.md / SD-106 by user decision 2026-09-16), but MECH-098 is not linked to that owner anywhere. claims.claim_title: Visual streams use a three-pathway architecture (ventral/dorsal/frontal) for object, action, and executive routing.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the comparator demonstrably off ceiling and capacity matched, the lateral head adds nothing or degrades the harm channel, as the run-2 adverse direction (auc_delta -0.0384) suggested -- three-stream routing is over-specification at V3 scale.
claims.required_event: Episodes containing agent-caused versus environment-caused contact events with motion structure, i.e. trials where dorsal (self-motion), ventral (object identity) and lateral (dynamic/agency) information are separately diagnostic of the outcome.
claims.manipulation: THREE_STREAM arm (harm_dim > 0, SplitEncoder.lateral_head built and z_harm routed into E3 harm evaluation) versus TWO_STREAM arm (harm_dim = 0, lateral head absent), matched seeds, matched training budget, run on the SD-047 multi-source dynamics substrate with a non-saturating routing label.
claims.control: The TWO_STREAM arm at identical seeds/budget, plus a parameter-matched control in which the lateral head exists but receives a shuffled or non-motion input, so extra capacity is separated from the claimed dorsal/ventral/lateral routing.
claims.DV: Agency-attribution and harm discrimination measured in a regime where the two-stream comparator is demonstrably below ceiling (report AUC_TWO and its distance from 1.0 as a gating statistic), plus avoidance behaviour; the discriminating quantity is the THREE minus TWO delta conditioned on that headroom.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/stack.py builds lateral_head from hazard+contamination channels and returns z_harm; ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py harm_eval_lateral consumes it; the 098/098b drivers compute auc_delta. What is missing is a headroom gate on the control arm and a driver that runs on the agency_comparator_testbed_sd047 non-saturating label.
claims.consumer_locus: The encoder-to-E3 harm/agency evaluation path: whether a third anatomically separate stream adds discriminative information that the two-stream encoder cannot carry.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The TWO-stream comparator must not already be at ceiling on the attribution/harm readout: V3-EXQ-098b measured AUC_TWO 0.9989 against AUC_THREE 0.9942, so the auc_delta DV has no headroom in which a third stream could show an advantage. The lateral head must be built (latent.harm_dim > 0; the config default 0 disables it) and its output must reach the E3 harm evaluation.
claims.blocking_reason: The two-stream comparator saturates (AUC 0.9989), so auc_delta cannot discriminate; both existing runs measured a ceiling, not the mechanism. false_positives: The claim's own note that the lateral head 'may actively interfere' reads run 2 as evidence against three-stream routing; with the two-stream control at AUC 0.9989 that delta is ceiling noise, not an interference finding.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim's biological content (three anatomically distinct pathways) is not what the V3 falsifier tests; the V3 falsifier only asks whether a separate lateral head adds information. Any rewrite should say so explicitly.

claims.claim_title: z_world encoder requires event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss during training.
claims.falsifier_summary: OFF matches or exceeds ON on held-out decodability under the current recipe with adequate seeds -- the auxiliary loss is not required for z_world to carry event-discriminative information. V3-EXQ-897 measured exactly this direction (OFF >= ON on 3/3 seeds, deltas -0.025/-0.010/-0.005) but at seed counts too small to be more than sign-consistent, and deliberately did not tag MECH-100.
claims.required_event: Training episodes containing all three transition types (none / env_caused_hazard / agent_caused_hazard) in sufficient numbers for a class-balanced CE term and a held-out probe.
claims.manipulation: Add versus omit the event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss on the z_world encoder, on top of an otherwise bit-identical training recipe (V3-EXQ-897's ARM_EVENT_CE_ON / ARM_EVENT_CE_OFF).
claims.control: Bit-identical OFF arm (same env exposure, rollout policy, buffer, other heads, optimiser, hyperparameters) plus a validated positive-control probe on a label the world channel is known to carry.
claims.DV: Held-out DECODABILITY MARGIN (macro-recall minus chance) for event type from a frozen-encoder independent probe, ON minus OFF; plus, for the claim's downstream half, E2_world forward prediction error and E3 harm-evaluation calibration on the same arms.
claims.instrument: The substrate wiring exists (config.use_event_classifier, SplitEncoder.event_classifier at latent/stack.py:900/1037, REEAgent.compute_event_contrastive_loss at agent.py:11391) but is an ONLINE per-step batch=1 path, which is SD-070's documented fault 3; V3-EXQ-897 therefore trains the head via an experiment-local ZWorldP0TrainerEventCE subclass and records decodability margin, selectivity_margin and event_classification_acc.
claims.consumer_locus: The z_world encoder's representation, and the gradient it supplies to E2_world and E3 harm evaluation -- not the classifier head's own accuracy.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: z_world must not be collapsed for reasons unrelated to the event-CE term (both arms must run the SD-070 anti-collapse recipe identically), and the event-type label must be decodable in principle from the encoding the probe reads -- transition_type is a property of the TRANSITION while z_world is a static single-frame encoding, and a probe on raw world_obs with no encoder scores at or below chance for that label.
claims.blocking_reason: The decodability ablation has been run once at 3 seeds and read direction=unknown; the substrate's own SD-009 wiring is unusable under the current recipe (online batch=1 re-arms collapse), and the claim's downstream half (stronger gradient for E2_world / E3 to exploit) is measured by nothing. The label/encoding mismatch may also make the CE target ill-posed.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The four supporting EXQ-020/022 runs are not current evidence: they predate SD-070 by four months and were measured under the recipe that collapses z_world to participation_ratio ~1.06.
claims.auditor_notes: A successor to V3-EXQ-897 at higher seed count that TAGS MECH-100 and adds the downstream DV would close this. Note 897's deliberate refusal to tag MECH-100 -- do not read its direction=unknown as a MECH-100 verdict.

claims.claim_title: E1 performs multimodal exteroceptive fusion across sensory modalities before feeding E2.
claims.falsifier_summary: Multi-modal input yields no measurable improvement over the vision-only baseline at matched budget, or the observed fusion is fully explained by naive channel concatenation with no precision-weighting or complementary-structure signature.
claims.required_event: A scene in which a second modality carries information the visual/spatial channel does not -- an off-view event or a contact-only surface property that cannot be read off the 5x5 local view.
claims.manipulation: Present both modalities jointly versus each alone at matched training budget, then ablate one modality at test time.
claims.control: Vision-only and second-modality-only arms at matched budget, plus a naive channel-concatenation arm that has no precision weighting.
claims.DV: Accuracy and robustness of E1's shared world latent (z_world prediction/reconstruction error) with both modalities versus each alone at matched budget, and the degradation slope under test-time single-modality ablation, compared against the concatenation control.
claims.instrument: Absent at the environment boundary: CausalGridWorldV2 emits one exteroceptive vector and SplitEncoder's world head reads it whole, so there is no per-modality reliability or precision-weighting readout to record.
claims.consumer_locus: E1's shared world latent (z_world) before E2 consumption -- fusion upstream of the world model, not downstream behaviour.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A second exteroceptive modality must be sourced independently of the visual/spatial world_state pathway. Re-verified 2026-09-22: every world_state channel in causal_grid_world.py (local_view, contamination_view, hazard_field_view, resource_field_view, SD-065 cue, waypoint field) is computed from the same grid state, so any added channel is a re-encoding, not a second source.
claims.blocking_reason: V3's environment cannot generate the required event: it exposes exactly one exteroceptive source, and both prior attempts (EXQ-128 auditory tone, EXQ-134 somatosensory contact) synthesised their second channel from the same hazard/resource fields, which is why both were superseded rather than informative.
claims.auditor_notes: The V4 perceptual-adaptors plan (PA-3 deep-adaptor, PA-5 cross-modal negotiation currency) owns the modality-heterogeneity roadmap and ARC-087 carries the same hard substrate precondition; no substrate_queue entry proposes a second V3 exteroceptive channel, so the missing edge is from those V4 nodes to MECH-103's falsifier rather than a new node.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: "genuine" multi-modal exteroceptive input requires a second modality sourced independently of the visual/spatial world_state pathway -- not a synthetic channel re-derived from the same underlying grid state (as EXQ-128's "auditory" tone and EXQ-134's "somatosensory" contact signal both were, both computed from hazard_field/resource_field/harm_signal). Re-verified 2026-08-08: ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py still exposes exactly one true exteroceptive channel (world_state, vision/spatial), no independent auditory/somatosensory channel exists. Until V3's environment exposes such a channel, this claim is untestable, not merely under-tested -- confirmed twice (EXQ-128, EXQ-134).
