claims.claim_title: Unexpected harm events spike commitment uncertainty (LC-NE volatility interrupt), enabling de-commitment.
claims.falsifier_summary: Selectivity replicates but sufficiency does not -- the endogenous delta stays far below the rv-to-threshold gap and transition rates are indistinguishable between ON and ABLATED. This refutes the enabling-de-commitment half while leaving the spike half standing, and is grounds to re-tag the claim substrate_ceiling.
claims.required_event: Unexpected harm while committed -- realised harm substantially exceeding harm_eval's prediction -- occurring often enough in committed state to support attribution over a post-spike window.
claims.manipulation: ENDOGENOUS-ON versus ABLATED (e3._ema_alpha = 0.0, variance frozen -- the V3-EXQ-204 ablation) on matched seeds sharing trained weights and episode sequence, with no injected variance impulse in either arm.
claims.control: The ABLATED arm, with its committed-to-uncommitted transition rate reported and shown non-degenerate; breath_period pinned to 0 in both arms so MECH-108's sweep cannot manufacture uncommitted windows.
claims.DV: Two legs in the same arm. Selectivity: endogenous delta_var_unexpected minus delta_var_expected, against three SD of the per-seed delta plus a 1e-4 absolute floor. Sufficiency: committed-to-uncommitted transitions attributable to those events within the 20-tick post-spike window, as a ratio to the ABLATED arm's rate.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py exposes _running_variance, its last-error snapshot and the WCI floor; V3-EXQ-623 supplies the post-spike-window attribution and V3-EXQ-204/365/126 the selectivity statistic. All existing sufficiency evidence came from drivers poking the variance, which the falsifier now forbids.
claims.consumer_locus: The ARC-016 commit gate reading running_variance against effective_threshold, not the E3 softmax-temperature channel that SD-069's phasic surprise burst uses.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The control arm must show committed-fraction strictly between 0 and 1, at least ten unexpected-harm events in committed state, the SD-076 rv floor binding on under ten percent of ticks, breath_period explicitly 0 in both arms (from_dims defaults it to 50, which arms the MECH-108 sweep), and no driver line writing agent.e3._running_variance in the ON arm.
claims.blocking_reason: The sufficiency leg cannot reach a verdict in the available regime: the only endogenous magnitude measured is ~1.6-1.9e-6 against a ~0.39 rv-to-threshold gap, the hard SD-076 floor pinned rv at exactly 0.010000 on all four V3-EXQ-794 arms, and with breath_period forced to 0 the control arm's committed-fraction pins at 1.0, which the precondition itself rules out as a verdict.
false_positives: Treating the 2026-09-09 demotion as evidence the claim is wrong is a misreading: the flag's own wording says the claim is not judged wrong and no evidence was excluded, only that 'active' over-read a conjunction taken across runs.
claims.auditor_notes: Route-2 wiring (running_variance += surprise_coeff * harm_surprise) is named in the claim notes but does not exist anywhere in ree_core -- no surprise_coeff, no harm-surprise impulse into _running_variance; phasic_surprise_burst.py:32 says as much, and its own channel is the E3 softmax temperature, not the commit gate. EXP-1384 is proposed and unqueued; the coordinator should decide whether the honest next step is registering Route-2 or narrowing the claim to the spike half.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it. Specific to this run, the CONTROL (gate-ON,
no-injection) arm must report and satisfy: (a) realised `running_variance` range and its distance
to `effective_threshold` (base 0.40, `config.py:1022`); (b) realised committed-fraction strictly
between 0 and 1 -- a run at 1.0 cannot observe a de-commitment; (c) `n_unexpected_harm_events >= 10`
occurring *in committed state* (V3-EXQ-623 C5); (d) the SD-076 floor's binding fraction --
`running_variance` must not sit at `waking_confidence_rv_floor` for more than 10% of ticks, which
is the exact clamp V3-EXQ-794 hit (`rv_final` EXACTLY 0.010000 on all four arms); and (e)
`breath_period = 0` in BOTH arms, because `from_dims` otherwise arms MECH-108's sweep by
default and a sweep-driven uncommitted window would be misread as a surprise-driven one. And,
load-bearing: no line of the driver may write `agent.e3._running_variance` in the ON arm --
the entire question is whether the endogenous impulse suffices.

CONFIRMING. On a matched-seed pair over >= 3 seeds sharing trained weights and episode
sequence -- ENDOGENOUS-ON vs ABLATED (`_ema_alpha = 0.0`, variance frozen; the V3-EXQ-204
ablation) -- the ON arm shows BOTH legs *in the same arm*: (i) SELECTIVITY: endogenous
`delta_var_unexpected` exceeds `delta_var_expected` by more than 3 SD of the per-seed delta AND by
an absolute floor of 1e-4, in >= 2 of 3 seeds; and (ii) SUFFICIENCY: committed -> uncommitted
transitions attributable to those events (V3-EXQ-623's 20-tick POST_SPIKE_WINDOW attribution)
occur at >= 2.0x the ABLATED arm's rate, with the ABLATED rate reported and non-degenerate, in
>= 2 of 3 seeds. Leg (ii) in the absence of any injection is what has never been shown.

FALSIFYING. Leg (i) replicates and leg (ii) does not: the endogenous `delta_var_unexpected` is
real and selective but stays far below the rv-to-threshold gap, so committed -> uncommitted
transition rates are statistically indistinguishable between ON and ABLATED. V3-EXQ-204's own
endogenous magnitude (`harm_spike_rv ~1.6-1.9e-6` against a ~0.39 gap) *predicts exactly this
outcome*, so it must be treated as the live alternative hypothesis, not the surprise. This
refutes the "enabling de-commitment" half of the title while leaving "spikes commitment
uncertainty" standing, and is grounds to demote MECH-104 from `active` and to re-tag it
`substrate_ceiling`. A second, distinct falsifying pattern: the ABLATED arm shows the *same*
transition rate, which means the observed transitions were never surprise-driven at all (most
likely MECH-108's sweep, or the readiness gates) -- which is why precondition (e) is mandatory.

claims.claim_title: Hippocampal sequence completion drives BG beta release via subiculum-NAc-VTA dopaminergic loop.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the range/threshold parity established and the pathway firing, release timing and rate are statistically indistinguishable between arms -- every release would have fired anyway via another pathway, so the loop is architecturally present but functionally redundant.
claims.required_event: A hippocampal trajectory proposal of high quality (low residue cost) while beta is elevated -- the sequence-completion event the subiculum-NAc-VTA loop is supposed to signal.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the dopamine-analog coupling: completion signal delivered to BetaGate.receive_hippocampal_completion at its configured threshold versus suppressed, holding every other BetaGate release pathway at identical trigger conditions.
claims.control: Matched seeds and config with all other release pathways (natural commit, maintenance-release, habenula abort) held at identical trigger conditions across arms.
claims.DV: Release latency and total release count attributable to the completion pathway specifically, plus the rate at which completion_signal crosses threshold -- reported with the realised signal distribution so an unreachable threshold is visible.
claims.instrument: HippocampalModule.compute_completion_signal caches _last_completion_signal and BetaGate exposes completion_release_threshold and _last_completion_signal in its state; the 944 family reports that the pathway never fires, but the per-tick signal distribution is not persisted in any manifest.
claims.consumer_locus: The BetaGate release decision -- the bridge from the hippocampal trajectory candidacy gate to the BG policy propagation gate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The producer's achievable range must cross the consumer's threshold: compute_completion_signal must be able to exceed _completion_release_threshold on the configured substrate, heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable must be True (it defaults False, so the agent.py wiring never runs at production config), and the threshold must be reachable as a configured value rather than by poking a private attribute.
claims.blocking_reason: The signal can never cross the gate. compute_completion_signal returns sigmoid(-best_score*0.5) on a non-negative residue cost (RBF weights start at zero and accumulate positive magnitude; all three subtractive terms default to zero), giving a range of (0, 0.5] against a 0.75 threshold; the module docstring's stated [0.5, 1.0) range is inverted. beta_gate_bistable also defaults False, so the wiring does not run at production config.
false_positives: The pre-2026-08-08 note 'this coupling is currently absent ... cannot be tested experimentally' was correctly struck -- all three wiring changes exist. The correction is right about the wiring and silent about the range defect, which is the real blocker.

V3-EXQ-944's banked figure 'completion trigger fired 0 of 15 cells' is unverified (never persisted to a manifest) and its two recorded maxima conflict; the arithmetic bound is the independent and stronger finding.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: An ON/OFF ablation of the hippocampal-completion release pathway that is not bit-identical by construction, i.e. one in which the completion signal can actually cross the release threshold and the pathway can fire.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Range/threshold parity on the completion pathway: either rescale compute_completion_signal so a low-residue trajectory maps above the release threshold, or expose completion_release_threshold as a config field calibrated to the producer's realised distribution, and surface beta_gate_bistable through REEConfig.from_dims so the wiring runs at production config.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-tick completion_signal distribution and receive_hippocampal_completion invocation count persisted to the manifest, so 'never invoked' is distinguishable from 'invoked but below threshold'.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: substrate_queue.json has zero entries naming compute_completion_signal or completion_release_threshold; GFLAG-0344 diagnosed the defect on 2026-09-18 and explicitly asked for a queue entry that was never opened. The nearby residue entries (SD-024, ARC-046, SD-067, the MECH-303 bandwidth item) all own different residue properties.

claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0344 pairs this with a residue-field GEOMETRY defect (32-slot RBF ring buffer, kernel_bandwidth 1.0 against a 0.1249-diameter manifold) which it also reports as unowned; MECH-105's unreachable threshold is a scaling bug on the same quantity, so the coordinator may wish to scope the two together.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the three required changes from this claim's own notes ARE implemented (confirmed 2026-08-08 by source inspection) -- this is NOT the "cannot be tested experimentally" state the notes previously described (see CORRECTION below). (1) HippocampalModule.compute_completion_signal() [ree_core/hippocampal/module.py] emits a dopamine-analog completion signal (sigmoid over min residue cost across proposed trajectories). (2) BetaGate.receive_hippocampal_completion() [ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py] receives it and calls gate.release() when beta is elevated and the signal crosses _completion_release_threshold. (3) The two are wired at ree_core/agent.py under an explicit "ARC-028 / MECH-105" comment, gated on config.heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable (True in the MECH-090/SD-034 experiment family) and beta_gate.is_elevated. A run is non-degenerate only if beta_gate_bistable=True, beta_gate.is_elevated is reached at least once, and completion_signal takes a non-degenerate range of values -- and, per ARC-028's own audit, only if the effect of this pathway is isolated from BetaGate's other independent release pathways (MECH-091 urgency-interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation, SD-034 closure operator).
CONFIRMING: a controlled ablation (matched seeds/config; ON arm with the pathway live at its configured threshold vs. OFF arm with it suppressed) while holding every other BetaGate release pathway at identical trigger conditions across both arms, shows release timing/rate measurably and reproducibly contingent on compute_completion_signal(): releases attributable to this pathway specifically occur at non-trivial rate, and ablating the dopamine-analog coupling variable measurably shifts release latency or total release count relative to the intact ON arm.
FALSIFYING: release timing/rate are statistically indistinguishable between arms once other pathways are accounted for -- every release attributed to this pathway would have fired anyway via another pathway, or completion_signal never crosses threshold under realistic trajectory-quality distributions. In that case the two gates remain functionally decoupled in practice despite the code-level wiring existing, and the dopaminergic-loop mechanism is architecturally present but functionally redundant/non-necessary.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): check whether MECH-290 (named alongside MECH-105 in ARC-028's own drift note as sharing this same stale-notes pattern) needs the equivalent correction.
claims.stale_reason: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition checks only that the three wiring changes exist, which they do. The WWA's FALSIFYING branch would therefore record a scaling defect as evidence that the pathway is functionally redundant.

claims.claim_title: Commitment threshold is asymmetrically modulated by outcome valence: positive outcomes lower it, negative outcomes raise it.
claims.falsifier_summary: Either valence history does not shift commitment latency once MECH-104 and SD-011 are pinned off (the 231a result was carried by the driver's hand-set BIAS_WEIGHT), or latency shifts while |w_neg| / |w_pos| is indistinguishable from 1.0 -- which refutes MECH-106 as written and supports only the narrower monotonic-modulation successor.
claims.required_event: Extended waking episodes accumulating a differentiated outcome-valence history -- runs of harm contact and large prediction error versus runs of low harm and successful trajectory completion -- followed by fresh commitment opportunities in both histories.
claims.manipulation: Matched-seed VALENCE_BIAS versus NO_BIAS ablation over at least 5 seeds with independent positive and negative gains, applied to commit_threshold_effective = commit_threshold_base * (1 + valence_bias) via a slow EMA on outcome valence.
claims.control: The NO_BIAS arm at identical seeds is the no-manipulation control (its latency ratio must stay inside [0.5, 2.5], V3-EXQ-231a's retained C4), with MECH-104 and SD-011 pinned off in both arms.
claims.DV: Two legs: mean latency-to-commit after a negative-outcome history versus a positive one in the VALENCE_BIAS arm (SIGN-INVERTED 2026-09-10 -- shorter after negative, because a raised threshold is MORE permissive against the variance gate); and the fitted |w_neg| / |w_pos| ratio with a per-seed-bootstrap CI, which is the claim's actual asymmetry content.
claims.instrument: Nothing in ree_core records or produces this: grep confirms valence_bias appears nowhere in ree_core (the GFLAG-0163 finding, re-verified in this audit). The only implementation was inside v3_exq_231a's driver, using a symmetric linear map base * (1 + 1.2 * (da - 0.5)) that made the asymmetry criterion arithmetically derivable from the divergence criterion.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 commit gate -- effective_threshold in e3_selector.select, the same multiplicative chain SD-011's urgency term modulates -- on a slow (dopaminergic/motivational) timescale, distinct from running_variance and from MECH-104's fast volatility interrupt.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The shared commit-gate dynamic-range precondition, needed twice over (both the base and the valence-modulated threshold must sit where running_variance can cross them), plus the claim's own four: da_pos - da_neg > 0.20 measured; latency-to-commit finite and unsaturated in BOTH valence conditions; independent w_pos and w_neg as free parameters (a symmetric linear map makes the asymmetry criterion an arithmetic consequence of the divergence criterion, which is how V3-EXQ-231a's C2 could not fail); and MECH-104's impulse plus SD-011's urgency pinned off since they move the same inequality.
claims.blocking_reason: The asserted mechanism has no substrate: no slow outcome-valence bias on the commit threshold exists in ree_core, so the quantity cannot reach the e3_selector locus the claim names, and any run must re-implement it in a driver -- which is precisely how the degenerate symmetric map that voided V3-EXQ-231a's asymmetry criterion arose.
false_positives: GFLAG-0164's premise that MECH-106 and SD-011 make opposite-sign predictions was adjudicated WRONG: the claim's prose carried a pre-2026-03-18 precision-space gloss and read its own operator backwards; SD-011 and the arithmetic were both fine.

The recorded 5/5 criteria PASS of V3-EXQ-231a overstates the evidence: C2 threshold_asymmetry could not fail whenever C1 passed under the driver's own symmetric map, so the asymmetry the claim is named for was never tested.
claims.auditor_notes: MECH-106 is phase v3 while its nearest planning neighbour AE-10 is V4 and deliberately disjoint; do not fold this into AE-10. GFLAG-0304 also lists this claim in the hazard-free-corpus contamination set.
claims.coordinator_note: Prerequisite candidate (slow outcome-valence bias on the E3 commit threshold with independent w_pos/w_neg gains) NOT registered by this audit: it is MECH-106's own asserted mechanism, not a measurement/event prerequisite, and the brief prefers instrument items over new cognitive-mechanism builds. The existing node is the claim itself (candidate, phase v3); the missing edge is a governance-owned substrate_queue build row. The audit's load-bearing finding stands: valence_bias exists nowhere in ree_core and V3-EXQ-231a's driver-side symmetric map made the asymmetry criterion arithmetically degenerate, so no run should re-implement it in a driver.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it -- and note MECH-106 needs it *twice over*, because both
the base threshold and the valence-modulated threshold must sit where `running_variance` can
actually cross them. Specific to this claim: (a) the run must exhibit a differentiated valence
history -- `da_pos - da_neg > 0.20` measured, which is the precise failure that made the original
V3-EXQ-231 a design flaw rather than a claim failure ("PERSISTENT and REACTIVE conditions produced
identical commit values"); (b) latency-to-commit must be finite and unsaturated in BOTH the
positive-history and negative-history conditions -- an episode-length-censored latency in the
negative condition measures the episode budget, not the threshold; (c) the modulation must be
implemented asymmetrically, i.e. with independent gains for the positive and negative
directions (`w_pos != w_neg` as free parameters), because a symmetric linear map makes the
asymmetry criterion an arithmetic consequence of the divergence criterion (see V3-EXQ-231a above)
and therefore vacuous; (d) MECH-104's impulse and SD-011's urgency term must be pinned OFF
(`urgency_weight = 0.0`, no rv injection) -- they move the same inequality (G3 preamble (iv)).

CONFIRMING. With independent positive/negative gains and a matched-seed VALENCE_BIAS vs NO_BIAS
ablation over >= 5 seeds: (i) the direction leg, SIGN-INVERTED 2026-09-10 under GFLAG-0164
option (A) -- the superseded text required latency-to-commit to be LONGER after negative
outcomes; under this claim's own arithmetic a raised threshold is MORE permissive against the
variance gate, so the registered prediction had the wrong sign and any run scored against it was
scored backwards -- mean latency-to-commit is SHORTER after a negative-outcome history than
after a positive one in the VALENCE_BIAS arm, by more than 3 SD of
the per-seed latency delta and by an absolute floor of 5 ticks, in >= 4 of 5 seeds, while the
NO_BIAS arm shows a latency ratio inside [0.5, 2.5] (V3-EXQ-231a's C4, retained as the
no-manipulation control); and (ii) the asymmetry leg, which is the claim's actual content --
the fitted `|w_neg| / |w_pos|` is bounded away from 1.0 (>= 1.5, or <= 0.67) with a
per-seed-bootstrap CI excluding 1.0, in >= 4 of 5 seeds. Leg (ii) must be measured, not assumed:
it is what separates MECH-106 from the weaker claim "outcome valence modulates the commit
threshold at all".

FALSIFYING. Either (i) fails -- valence history does not shift commitment latency once
MECH-104 and SD-011 are pinned off, which would say the EXQ-231a result was carried by the
driver's hand-set `BIAS_WEIGHT` rather than by any property of outcome valence -- or (i) passes
and (ii) fails, i.e. `|w_neg| / |w_pos|` is statistically indistinguishable from 1.0. The second
is the more likely and the more informative: it would refute MECH-106 *as written* (asymmetric)
while supporting a narrower successor ("outcome valence modulates the commit threshold
monotonically"), and would be grounds to demote from `provisional` and re-title. A third pattern:
the seed-42 anomaly recorded in `evidence_quality_note` ("near-zero divergence, no commitments")
recurs on more than 1 of 5 seeds -- that is precondition (a) failing, not a result, and the run
must be re-designed rather than adjudicated.

claims.claim_title: HippocampalModule must emit a trajectory completion signal wired to BetaGate to couple the candidacy and propagation gates.
claims.falsifier_summary: Release timing and rate are statistically indistinguishable between arms once the other pathways are accounted for, or the completion signal never realistically crosses threshold -- the two gates stay functionally decoupled despite the code-level wiring.
claims.required_event: A committed episode in which the hippocampal module proposes a trajectory good enough to signal completion while beta is elevated, so the completion pathway has an opportunity to release the gate.
claims.manipulation: Hippocampal-completion pathway live (threshold at its configured value) versus suppressed (threshold pinned above 1.0), with every other BetaGate release pathway -- MECH-091 urgency interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation, SD-034 closure, maintenance release -- held at identical trigger conditions.
claims.control: The matched-seed suppressed-pathway arm, plus the audited alternative release pathways held fixed so attribution is possible at tick level.
claims.DV: Count and latency of beta releases attributable specifically to the completion pathway -- releases firing at ticks where no other pathway's trigger condition is independently met -- and the shift in the release-latency distribution and total release count when the pathway is suppressed.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: beta_gate_bistable True, the gate actually elevating, AND compute_completion_signal reaching the 0.75 release threshold. Because the signal is sigmoid(-best_residue_cost * 0.5), it is below 0.5 for any positive residue cost, so crossing 0.75 needs a best residue cost at or below about -2.2 -- a regime no measured run has entered.
claims.blocking_reason: The pathway never fires in any measured environment -- completion_signal max 0.0 against a 0.75 threshold across 15 cells -- so an ON/OFF ablation is degenerate by construction. claims.auditor_notes: Two cheap, separable items would make this testable and neither is a new mechanism: expose completion_release_threshold on the heartbeat config so an OFF arm exists, and record the completion-signal distribution against the threshold in an env where trajectory residue cost can go usefully negative. claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three parts; all three must hold before C1 is read as
evidence -- this claim's entire experimental record fails at least one of them).
(P1) BOTH REGIMES MUST BE OCCUPIED WITHIN A SINGLE RUN. The claim asserts two operating
*modes*, which is a within-agent contrast, not a between-arm one. Every prior test measured a
gated agent against a differently-configured agent: V3-EXQ-063a's gate-active arm recorded
`n_committed_active_stable = 1155.5` against `n_uncommitted_active_stable = 0.0`, so its C3
"non-degeneracy" gate (1156 vs 0) passed vacuously and the two-mode contrast was never
realised. Require, per seed, in the alternating arm: `committed_step_fraction` in [0.15, 0.85]
AND mean committed-run length >= 3 consecutive ticks, on >= 4/5 seeds. The run-length half is
load-bearing and not a formality: V3-EXQ-460i established that "the active SD-034 de-commit
control-plane fragments the latch to ~1-tick blips even with the lever OFF" and that 460h's
sustained ~2400-step hold did not reproduce, so a 50/50 committed/uncommitted split composed
of 1-tick alternations is NOT two operating modes and must fail this gate. If P1 cannot be met
at default settings, it is met by arming `use_natural_commit_latch_hold` (and, for macro
programs, `use_persistent_committed_program_handle` + `use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit`) --
all three are default-`False`, all three are in `REEConfig.from_dims`, and none has ever been
armed in an ARC-029 run. If P1 still fails with those armed, ARC-029 converts to
`substrate_conditional` on commitment-occupancy sustainment and this falsifier is not readable.
(P2) THE MODE MANIPULATION MUST NOT MOVE PRECISION. In ree-v3, `committed` is
`commit_variance < effective_threshold` (`e3_selector.py:3674`) and
`current_precision = 1/(running_variance + 1e-6)` (`:771`), so commitment and precision are
the same scalar; ARC-016's own promotion verdict measures `mean_rho_rv_vs_commit = -0.955`.
An ablation that forces `running_variance` -- as V3-EXQ-063a's does, to
`commit_threshold + 0.1 = 0.50`, i.e. `precision = 2.0`, against an operating point measured
as low as `rv = 0.005420` (V3-EXQ-794) -- simultaneously perturbs dACC precision gating
(`dacc.py:373`), the harm-nonredundancy scale, serotonin REM entry, the MECH-204 sleep
writeback, and the heartbeat sweep. Its harm gap is therefore unattributable between "the
commitment gate did work" and "the agent's precision was crushed" -- structurally the same
confound the 2026-06-03 autopsy used to retag V3-EXQ-630 `non_contributory` ("SD-022
limb-damage degrade drives commitment via running_variance"). Require instead that the mode
driver act on the THRESHOLD: MECH-108's BreathOscillator already does exactly this
(`clock.py:20-31`, `effective_threshold = base_threshold * (1.0 - sweep_amplitude)`), leaving
`running_variance` and every precision consumer untouched. Gate on it: the distribution of
`current_precision` must be statistically indistinguishable between the alternating arm and a
static control arm (paired per-seed mean and SD difference below a pre-registered floor). Set
`sweep_amplitude` from the run's own measured `rv` distribution, not from a guess -- with
`commitment_threshold = 0.40`, pushing an agent operating at `rv ~= 0.33` uncommitted needs
`sweep_amplitude > 0.18`, while one operating at `rv ~= 0.0054` needs `> 0.986`. This is why
EXQ-199's earlier BreathOscillator attempt recorded `committed_step_count = 0` on both seeds:
the amplitude was not calibrated to the lineage's own operating point.
(P3) THE HARM DV MUST BE OFF THE FLOOR. EXQ-227 diagnosed that SD-010/011/012 cut harm
rates ~100x, making any gate signal undetectable at the original `num_hazards=4,
hazard_harm=0.02` parameters. Require a per-seed harm rate at least an order of magnitude
above the measurement floor; V3-EXQ-063a's ~-0.055 harm/step is a demonstrated workable
operating point, so this is a calibration requirement, not an open problem.

CONFIRMING. With P1-P3 met, within the SAME agent and seed: mean harm-per-step during
committed windows is lower than during uncommitted windows in the STABLE environment, with a
paired per-seed delta exceeding `max(0.5 * SD(per-seed paired delta), 0.002 harm/step)` and
the same sign on >= 4/5 seeds; AND the gap NARROWS in the volatile environment
(`gap_volatile < gap_stable`, >= 4/5 seeds) -- the context-dependence half, which is the part
that distinguishes ARC-029 from a generic "commitment is good" claim; AND, as the sharper
version of the same prediction already written into this claim's own notes from the
Humphries 2012 pull, the advantage is strongest at LOW hazard density (2-3 hazards) and
weakest or reversed at HIGH density (6-8), i.e. a significant density x mode interaction
rather than only a main effect.

FALSIFYING. With P1-P3 all met and the precision-invariance gate P2 clean, the committed
and uncommitted windows show no harm difference (paired delta within the noise band on a
majority of seeds), or a difference in the wrong direction in the STABLE condition. Because
the manipulation is threshold-side, such a null CANNOT be explained away as a precision
artifact, which is the one exemption every prior ARC-029 test has been able to claim. This
would be a genuine falsification: the commitment gate would be shown to be structurally real
(ARC-016, `stable`) but behaviourally inert on harm, and ARC-029 should be narrowed to the
structural claim or retired in favour of ARC-016. Distinguish this from "still an instrument
problem" strictly by P1/P2: if occupancy or precision-invariance fails to gate cleanly, the
run is `non_contributory`, not evidence.

The variance-tracking quantile commitment bar built in response landed in ree-v3 on 2026-09-18 and is the lever a rewritten P1 must name (GFLAG-0346, GFLAG-0354).

claims.claim_title: ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same gates met, the ON arm either under-subtracts (self-caused variance during locomotion indistinguishable from OFF) or over-subtracts (exogenous events become harder to detect in ON than in OFF, the EXQ-027b signature of correction_delta -0.045 and harm_pred_std 0.108 -> 0.008), or ON is indistinguishable from SHAM -- any matched-magnitude subtraction would do as well as the learned one.
claims.required_event: Within one episode set, pure-locomotion steps in which the agent moves and the world does not, interleaved with steps carrying an independent world-caused event the agent did not produce.
claims.manipulation: Three arms on the residualization pathway: reafference_action_dim = action_dim with a trained ReafferencePredictor; the predictor set to None after P0; and a SHAM arm subtracting the same module's output with the action mis-paired -- the three already implemented in experiments/v3_exq_1018.
claims.control: The SHAM arm is the matched-magnitude control (mis-paired R2 -2.94, cos 0.59 against the real correction), and the OFF arm at identical seeds is the absolute reference; the within-run z_world versus z_world_raw contrast is explicitly NOT a control because it also carries the alpha_world EMA.
claims.DV: A discrimination margin, not a variance level: agent-caused versus world-caused step classification accuracy (or AUC) computed from the downstream z_world stream, compared across the three arms, together with the self-caused variance share during pure-locomotion steps so under- and over-subtraction are separable.
claims.instrument: ReafferencePredictor and the z_world_raw diagnostic exist (latent/stack.py:42-116, LatentState.z_world_raw), the ON/OFF/SHAM arms exist in v3_exq_1018, and EXQ-111 carries the pre-registered C1/C2/C3 ladder. claims.consumer_locus: The z_world stream as consumed downstream of the encoder, where the residualization must preserve exogenous signal while removing self-caused signal -- not the predictor's fit quality, which is a manipulation check.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Three gates. false_positives: The registered CURRENT STATE reading 'predictor quality repeatedly below threshold across three separate attempts, implemented-but-unvalidated' is now stale as a blocker: the shipped module reaches held-out R2 0.34-0.40 against a 0.10 gate at an adequate budget, so the C1 failures were a training-budget artefact and not a property of the predictor.

claims.claim_title: HARM stream is a dedicated sensory pathway separate from z_world processing.
claims.falsifier_summary: Under matched budget the fused arm matches the split arm on all three: calibration_gap inside the split arm's band, world_forward_r2 undegraded, reafference correction not inverting on approach. The 2026-03-19 root-cause cluster was then a training-procedure or SD-005 effect, SD-010 narrows to an implementation preference, and it stops underwriting SD-003 / SD-007 / MECH-102.
claims.required_event: Episodes with genuine hazard approach and contact under a dense-enough proximity gradient that harm content is present in both the shared world channel and the dedicated harm channel, plus agent-caused and world-caused changes so reafference correction has something to act on.
claims.manipulation: use_harm_stream = False (no HarmEncoder; E3 evaluates M via harm_eval_head on z_world through compute_harm_cost_fallback) against use_harm_stream = True, with the fused arm given supervision budget on z_world equal to the split arm's direct MSE supervision on the HarmEncoder.
claims.control: The split arm at matched seeds and matched total gradient steps, plus an explicit budget-parity readout, since the EXQ-094 lesson is that an unmatched budget produces a 100x harm_var regression that is a budget artefact rather than a fusion result.
claims.DV: The three registered failure signatures under matched budget: correlation between residue density and hazard density in an environment where the agent causes no harm; world_forward_r2 against the EXQ-044 floor; and the sign of the SD-007 reafference correction's effect on the harm estimate during hazard APPROACH.
claims.instrument: The fused arm is genuinely constructible -- with use_proxy_fields = True the world channel already carries hazard_field_view[25] (causal_grid_world.py header), so the fused arm is a fair fusion rather than a deletion of harm content -- and compute_harm_cost_fallback trains harm_eval_head on z_world. world_forward_r2 is recorded across the 058/177 family; the residue-vs-hazard density correlation has no existing recorder.
claims.consumer_locus: The separation of the harm pathway from z_world processing at the encoder, read at E3's M(zeta) evaluation -- the question is whether the third stream is architecturally necessary, not whether the split encoder works.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: As the existing what_would_answer registers: the test must be FUSED versus SPLIT under a matched training budget, not another split-arm demonstration and not the HarmBridge design (bridge_r2 = 0 by construction). One addition verified here: the harm DV must be off the floor -- SD-010/011/012 cut realised harm rates roughly 100x, so a baseline contact/harm rate must be witnessed per arm or both arms report near-zero and the ablation cannot discriminate.
claims.blocking_reason: The ablation has never been run: all 22 experimental entries measure the split arm only. The substrate for a fair fused arm exists (use_harm_stream off, hazard_field_view already inside world_obs, trained harm_eval_head on z_world). The two residual gaps are a recorder for residue-density versus hazard-density correlation and the post-SD-010/011/012 harm-rate floor.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: A natural reading of 'harm_obs is a separate obs_dict key' is that turning use_harm_stream off deletes harm content from the agent's input, making a fused arm impossible. It does not: under use_proxy_fields=True the world channel already contains hazard_field_view[25], so z_world can encode hazard proximity and the fused arm is a fair comparator.
claims.auditor_notes: SD-011's what_would_answer owns the stream readouts, encoder-floor correction and sourcing-mode caveat for the whole harm-stream group; do not re-derive them here. The reafference-inversion leg is shared with SD-007 in this same batch and is co-blocked by the same z_world adequacy gate on the world-caused-change side.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test must be a FUSED-vs-SPLIT ablation, not
another demonstration that the split encoder works. All 22 existing experimental
entries (EXQ-056/056c/058/058b/058c/059/059c and successors) measure the SPLIT arm
only -- Pearson r_z_harm 0.914-0.973, calibration_gap 0.712, clean rank ordering.
Not one runs the fused control. A rerun of the split arm alone is degenerate: it
can only re-confirm what is already established and cannot discriminate. The
ablation arm must route harm content back through the z_world encoder with
TRAINING BUDGET HELD EQUAL (the EXQ-094 lesson: training E3 on bridge noise
produced a 100x harm_var regression, which is a budget artefact, not a fusion
result). It must also NOT be the HarmBridge design: SD-010 makes z_world
perpendicular to z_harm BY CONSTRUCTION, so a learned z_world -> z_harm bridge has
nothing to learn and returns bridge_r2=0 trivially (EXQ-093, EXQ-094) -- that is a
restatement of the architecture, not a test of it.
CONFIRMING: under matched budget, the fused arm reproduces at least two of the
three failure signatures this claim was registered to explain -- (1) residue
contamination: ResidueField's world_delta accumulation tracks hazard proximity
rather than causal footprint, measurable as a rising correlation between residue
density and hazard density in an environment where the agent causes no harm;
(2) counterfactual collapse: world_forward_r2 degrades toward the EXQ-044 value
(~0.0) because E2 cannot simultaneously predict world dynamics and harm proximity
from one latent; (3) reafference inversion: applying SD-007 correction to the
fused stream reduces the harm estimate as the agent APPROACHES a hazard (the
EXQ-027b over-correction, correction_delta=-0.045, harm_pred_std 0.108 -> 0.008).
Reproducing these under a fair control is what upgrades the claim from "the split
works" to "the split is necessary".
FALSIFYING: under matched budget the fused arm matches the split arm on all three
-- calibration_gap within the split arm's band, world_forward_r2 undegraded,
reafference correction not inverting on approach. That would mean the 2026-03-19
root-cause cluster (EXQ-027b / 043 / 044 / 047) was attributable to training
procedure or to the SD-005 z_self/z_world split alone, and that the third stream
is a convenience rather than an architectural necessity. SD-010 would then narrow
to an implementation preference and would stop underwriting SD-003 / SD-007 /
MECH-102.
DO NOT RE-DERIVE the stream readouts, the encoder-floor correction, or the
sourcing-mode caveat here -- see SD-011's own what_would_answer, which owns them
for the whole harm-stream group. SD-010 concerns the separation of harm from
z_world; SD-011 concerns the separation WITHIN harm.

claims.claim_title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).
claims.falsifier_summary: With those same gates met, either stream_corr rises toward saturation or the D3 reversal returns -- z_harm_a is a filtered copy rather than a second source -- or harm_fwd_r2 on z_harm_s collapses toward the obs-space near-zero causal gap, leaving the SD-003 / ARC-033 consumers nothing to attribute against.
claims.required_event: Sustained ambient hazard exposure with episodes long enough for the rolling harm-history window to fill, including approach and withdrawal transitions so the sensory stream carries action-conditional structure the affective stream does not.
claims.manipulation: Cross the second source (harm_history_len 0 versus 10) with the P0h affective-encoder warmup (episodes 0 versus non-zero), and with use_gabaergic_decay OFF versus ON so the two streams are given different leaky-integrator poles.
claims.control: A matched arm with the affective encoder left at random initialisation (P0h episodes 0) and a matched arm at harm_history_len 0, both at the identical seed, plus the encoder-floor response harm_encoder(zeros) / affective_harm_encoder(zeros, zeros) subtracted from every level.
claims.DV: Floor-robust relative stream_corr between z_harm_s and z_harm_a, the autocorr_gap between the two streams, and harm_fwd_r2 of the E2_harm_s forward model on z_harm_s, each reported per arm with the direction of the D3 contrast (R2_affective must not exceed R2_sensory).
claims.instrument: The streams and knobs exist (ree_core/latent/stack.py AffectiveHarmEncoder and harm_history input; ree_core/regulators/gabaergic_decay.py per-stream poles; ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_s.py). The missing piece is a driver that enables the landed P0h stage (experiments/_lib/zharm_a_p0_warmup.py, default zharm_a_p0_episodes 0) and reports the three DVs as floor-subtracted relatives.
claims.consumer_locus: The divergence of the two harm encoders' outputs where ARC-016 harm-variance gating reads z_harm_a and SD-003 / ARC-033 counterfactual attribution reads z_harm_s -- the functional division of labour, not the anatomical grounding.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Three measured gates, all recorded per run: harm_history_len > 0 so the affective encoder receives a source beyond the rank-2 harm_obs_a broadcast; the P0h warmup actually ran with a non-zero affective-encoder weight delta, so z_harm_a is not a frozen random projection; and the sourcing mode (limb_damage_enabled True versus legacy proximity EMA) declared, since V3-EXQ-917 measured safe-vs-unsafe AUC 0.52 damage-sourced against 0.84-0.97 proximity-sourced.
claims.blocking_reason: At the shipped defaults the test is degenerate: harm_history_len is 0, harm_obs_a has exact rank 2, and no optimizer group reaches the AffectiveHarmEncoder on the standard all-on trainer, so z_harm_a can only be a transform of the sensory stream. The repair (P0h warmup stage) landed default-OFF on 2026-09-19 and no driver enables it.

claims.claim_title: Exhalation is the physiological instantiation of E3 trajectory-abandonment — each exhale sweeps pre-commit rollouts for viability and clears the hypothesis tag.
claims.falsifier_summary: No reliable or an inverted relationship between sweep occurrence and abandonment once the gate is in a two-sided regime, or an effect fully explained by the other threshold modulators -- in which case the claim reduces to breath being one non-privileged periodic modulator rather than THE instantiation of trajectory abandonment.
claims.required_event: Repeated breath cycles during multi-candidate deliberation, each opening a sweep window at the commit gate while a trajectory is already committed.
claims.manipulation: Vary breath_period and breath_sweep_amplitude (HeartbeatClock, wired through agent.py as sweep_threshold_reduction into E3Selector's effective_threshold) across arms, including a breath_period=0 off arm.
claims.control: Breath-off and amplitude-zero arms at the identical operating point, with SD-011 urgency and SD-093 progress-velocity modulators held fixed so the breath term is the only mover of the effective threshold.
claims.DV: Plan-abandonment rate -- committed-to-uncommitted transitions per deliberation window, and mean uninterrupted committed-run length -- as a function of sweep-window occurrence rate, with the transitions time-locked to sweep windows rather than merely correlated over the run.
claims.instrument: E3Selector applies the reduction at effective_threshold and V3-EXQ-1049/1070a already record committed_step_fraction and per-episode mean committed-run length; the sweep-locked abandonment count and the MECH-094 hypothesis-tag clear are not recorded, and the oscillator is phase-undifferentiated (one window per cycle, no separate inhale-scan phase).
claims.consumer_locus: The ARC-016 commit decision inside E3Selector.select -- the threshold on the commit gate, not episode reward and not the hypothesis tag, which has no breath coupling in code.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The commit gate must be in a regime where the threshold can be crossed in both directions -- committed_step_fraction inside roughly [0.15, 0.85] with mean committed-run length at least 3 -- which currently requires use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold armed with a pre-registered quantile and window; and episodes must be longer than breath_period minus sweep_duration or no sweep fires at all.
claims.blocking_reason: At the trained operating point the agent is permanently committed, so the manipulation cannot move the DV; the enabling lever landed only days ago, default-off, and V3-EXQ-1070a (the run that would locate a feasible operating point) FAILed its training-tick-budget precondition and licensed no verdict.
false_positives: The WWA's instruction not to gate this test on SD-006 phase 2 is correct and remains so; the real gate is the commit-gate operating point, which the WWA does not mention.
claims.auditor_notes: The ARC-029 operating-point line (1049 -> 1070 -> 1070a) is the natural carrier for MECH-107's precondition; a MECH-107 test queued ahead of it would re-derive the inertness finding rather than test the claim.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): the novelty/
curiosity signal must be wired into E3 candidate scoring as a PER-CANDIDATE weighting,
not a uniform scalar broadcast added identically to every candidate. A uniform additive
shift is argmin-invariant by construction -- it cannot change which candidate is selected
regardless of magnitude -- and this is not a hypothetical failure mode: it is exactly what
EXQ-141b (2026-05-08) and V3-EXQ-590a (2026-05-25) ran into. V3-EXQ-590a's sweep over
novelty_bonus_weight in {0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0} produced byte-identical mean_coverage,
mean_h_pos, and mean_novelty_ema across all five arms (to 16 sig figs) precisely because
the broadcast term could not have moved selection even in principle. That broadcast branch
was deleted 2026-05-25 as dead-by-construction; `_dc_novelty_w` is now hardcoded to 0.0 and
retained only for schema compatibility (confirmed independently by the 2026-07-19 MECH-463
scoping spike). A run using the old broadcast pathway -- which is most of the evidence
collected on this claim to date -- tests nothing about MECH-111 and must self-route
substrate_not_ready rather than count as PASS or FAIL. Separately, the eval metric used to
detect an effect must not already be saturated (coverage=1.0 ceiling was one of two live,
non-exclusive readings of the 590a null result) -- an unsaturated behavioral DV (e.g.
resource/state coverage below ceiling, positional entropy, or an explicit per-candidate
novelty-conditioned selection margin) is required.
CONFIRMING signature: with a genuinely per-candidate novelty pathway wired to E3 selection
(the MECH-314a per-candidate RBF upgrade path, or equivalent) and an unsaturated DV,
moderate-magnitude E1 surprise at a candidate state produces a directional, seed-stable
INCREASE in that candidate's selection probability/score relative to a matched
ablation/control, while high-magnitude ("alarming") surprise in the same state instead
suppresses selection -- i.e. the approach/avoidance dissociation the claim asserts shows up
as a discriminative, non-degenerate effect, not merely a nonzero novelty_ema.
FALSIFYING signature: even with a correctly per-candidate (non-argmin-invariant) novelty
pathway and an unsaturated DV, moderate-magnitude novelty at a candidate produces no
directional, seed-stable selection advantage over ablation/control. This would mean
curiosity/novelty fails to function as an intrinsic positive-valence drive even when
structurally capable of influencing choice, refuting the claim's core assertion -- as
distinct from merely reconfirming the already-known routing defect above.

evidence_quality_note reads uniformly negative (FAIL/weakens x3), but governance-agenda
tracking (EVB-0029) separately logs this claim at conflict_ratio 0.667 with directional/
source disagreement across 5 considered entries (2 supports, 1 weakens). Reconciling
that discrepancy is a governance call, not resolved by this digestion pass.

claims.claim_title: Can D_eff (z_self participation ratio, coherence) and Hopfield pattern stability (z_self familiarity) dissociate in the REE architecture?
claims.falsifier_summary: No R2/R3 separation on D_eff at any inducible perturbation, so low D_eff always co-occurs with high stability and either metric suffices for MECH-113.
claims.required_event: An agent with a trained Hopfield memory of z_self patterns, evaluated under three z_self regimes: normal, noise-perturbed, and structured-novel.
claims.manipulation: Replace or perturb z_self per regime -- R2 additive Gaussian noise at sigma ~2, R3 a SPARSE coherent direction orthogonal to the stored mean, scaled to the familiar norm.
claims.control: R1 unperturbed z_self from the same episodes and the same steps, giving the baseline D_eff and stability pair.
claims.DV: Joint position on the (D_eff, Hopfield stability) plane per regime -- specifically whether R3 is separable from R2 in D_eff while both collapse stability relative to R1.
claims.instrument: agent.compute_z_self_d_eff computes the within-vector participation ratio and HopfieldMemory.stability the familiarity; v3_exq_084d records both per regime per step, including an analytic r3_d_eff readout that already flags the construction problem.
claims.consumer_locus: The z_self representation itself and the MECH-113 self-monitoring readout that consumes it -- whether one latent quality or two is being measured.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: R3 must actually be a low-D_eff state. The perturbation must land z_self in a concentrated (few-component) configuration outside the familiar subspace; a dense random direction is high-D_eff by construction and makes the R2/R3 contrast undecidable whatever the outcome.
claims.blocking_reason: The R3 vector is built as a dense Gaussian direction Gram-Schmidt-orthogonalised to the stored mean, whose participation ratio is high by construction (~0.64 x self_dim, matching the observed 22.6). The docstring calls it 'concentrated (low D_eff ~1)', which is false for a dense vector, so C1 could never pass and the ordering result is an artifact.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The recorded EXQ-084d reading 'novelty increases D_eff rather than targeting subspace' is a construction artifact of build_r3_vector, not a property of z_self geometry; a sparse orthogonal direction would give D_eff near 1 by the same formula.
The claim's affirmative 'D_eff and stability do dissociate' rests on that same run; independence of MOVEMENT was shown, but the R3 quadrant the WWA calls decisive was never instantiated.
claims.auditor_notes: MECH-119 has no substrate module anywhere in ree_core -- the structured-novel perturbation exists only as driver-side arithmetic applied at read-out, and z_r3 is never fed back into the agent, so it cannot land the agent in a coherent-but-novel basin as the claim's notes require. Fixing build_r3_vector to emit a sparse direction is a cheap experiment-side repair; the in-basin version is a separate, larger question.
claims.what_would_answer:
Induce the three regimes on z_self and read D_eff (participation ratio) and
Hopfield pattern stability (familiarity) jointly per regime: R1 normal
training, R2 noise perturbation (sigma~2), R3 structured-novel perturbation (a
coherent but never-seen z_self configuration via targeted basis rotation).
ANSWER "yes -- D_eff and stability dissociate" if R3 is empirically separable
from R2 on the (D_eff, stability) plane: stability collapses in BOTH R2 and R3
(replicating the EXQ-084d stab_R2~0.06 / stab_R3~0.03 vs R1~0.95 split) WHILE
D_eff stays low in R3 and rises in R2, i.e. the two metrics move along
independent axes rather than co-varying. ANSWER "no -- they are converging
measures of one latent" if low D_eff always co-occurs with high stability and
high D_eff with low stability across all three regimes (no R2/R3 separation),
in which case either metric suffices for MECH-113 and the MECH-113->{MECH-118
familiarity, D_eff coherence} split is unmotivated. SHARPER than EXQ-084d:
that run confirmed independent MOVEMENT but found the R2/R3 D_eff ORDERING
reversed from prediction (d_eff_R3 > d_eff_R2) and D_eff flat across R1/R2;
the decisive test is not the sign of the ordering but whether R3 (low-D_eff,
low-stability) is reachable AND distinguishable from R2 at all -- if R3 cannot
be induced as a distinct quadrant, the dissociation is not established
regardless of the EXQ-084d affirmative on raw independence. HARD PRECONDITION:
MECH-119 must deliver a controllable structured-novel perturbation that lands
z_self in a coherent-but-novel basin (low D_eff by construction); if the
perturbation cannot hold D_eff low while collapsing stability, R3 is not
instantiated and the test is vacuous.

claims.claim_title: E1's LSTM hidden state serves as the working memory substrate for goal representation; when conditioned on z_goal_latent, E1 maintains goal context recurrently across steps without requiring ongoing benefit signals.
claims.falsifier_summary: Goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 show no difference on goal-approaching segments once seeding is reliable, or conditioning improves non-goal segments equally, which would make the effect general regularisation rather than goal-conditioned working memory.
claims.required_event: Episodes in which a seeded z_goal persists long enough that the agent traverses identifiable goal-approaching segments interleaved with non-goal segments, under a budget long enough for the LSTM hidden state to carry goal context across steps.
claims.manipulation: e1_goal_conditioned ON versus OFF with goal_dim set so goal_input_proj is actually constructed (the bug 076e missed and 076f fixed), holding seeding, budget, environment and seeds identical.
claims.control: The unconditioned E1 arm on matched seeds, plus a shuffled-goal arm in which z_goal_latent is permuted across episodes, which removes any effect attributable to the extra input dimension rather than to goal content.
claims.DV: E1 one-step prediction error measured SEPARATELY on goal-approaching versus non-goal segments; the discriminating quantity is the conditioned-minus-unconditioned error difference on goal segments MINUS the same difference on non-goal segments, not z_goal_norm decay or halflife.
claims.instrument: No segment-resolved recorder exists. E1 prediction error is computed only as a whole-sequence F.mse_loss inside the training step (agent.py around line 11302) and E1Deep.update_from_observation returns a batch-mean e1_error_magnitude with no live reader; nothing labels a step as goal-approaching, and all three prior drivers reduced to z_goal_norm/halflife instead.
claims.consumer_locus: E1's LSTM recurrent state as a goal-conditioned working-memory substrate -- prediction quality on goal-relevant transitions, not the separately-governed decay_goal exponential on z_goal itself.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: z_goal seeding must be reliable enough that goal-approaching trajectory segments are genuinely identifiable, and E1 prediction error must show non-zero cross-condition variance on those segments. V3-EXQ-076e/f measured the opposite -- goal_norm ~0.0014-0.0025 in BOTH conditions by step 6000 -- so E1 conditioning had nothing to maintain, and MECH-428's seeding-sparse regime remains unresolved.
claims.blocking_reason: The corrected design mandated by the 2026-04-04 user adjudication -- segment-resolved E1 prediction error -- was never built. All three prior runs measured z_goal_norm persistence, which the claim does not predict, and no recorder splits E1 error by goal-approaching versus non-goal segments. Underneath that, the seeding precondition MECH-428 owns is still unresolved.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The 076d/e/f zero-difference results are not evidence against the claim: 076f was correctly classified non_contributory because it tested z_goal decay, which is governed by decay_goal independently of E1 conditioning.
claims.auditor_notes: The V3-EXQ-1004 autopsy states that unscaffolded z_goal already persists ~1000 steps, which sits oddly beside 076e/f's near-zero-by-step-6000 reading; the seeding regime differs between harnesses and should be pinned before a successor is sized.
claims.what_would_answer:
TEST-DESIGN HISTORY (already established, do not repeat): three prior
attempts (EXQ-076d/e/f) all measured the WRONG thing -- z_goal_norm
decay/persistence directly -- and found zero measurable difference
between goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 in every variant (076d
budget too small; 076e/f blocked by SD-012 seeding quality producing
near-zero z_goal_norm in BOTH conditions by step 6000, so E1
conditioning had nothing to maintain). The 2026-04-04 user-adjudicated
correction: this claim's own stated mechanism is about E1 PREDICTION
ERROR on goal-directed trajectory segments, NOT z_goal decay rate
(governed by a separate decay_goal parameter independent of E1
conditioning). A test of z_goal_norm persistence does not test this
claim at all -- 076f was correctly classified non_contributory.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) z_goal seeding to be
reliable enough that goal-directed trajectory segments are genuinely
identifiable (not the near-zero-by-step-6000 collapse 076e/f
exhibited), and (b) E1 prediction error to be measured SEPARATELY on
goal-approaching vs. non-goal segments, with non-zero cross-condition
variance.
CONFIRMING signature: E1 prediction error on goal-approaching
trajectory segments is measurably LOWER when E1 is goal-conditioned
(receives z_goal_latent) versus unconditioned, while non-goal
segments show NO measurable difference between conditions -- E1
"predicts better because it knows what it is predicting toward,"
specifically on the segments where that knowledge is relevant.
FALSIFYING: goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 show no measurable
difference in prediction error on goal-approaching segments (once
z_goal seeding is reliable) -- the LSTM hidden state is not
functioning as a goal-conditioned working-memory substrate; or
conditioning affects non-goal segments equally (would suggest a
general regularisation effect rather than goal-specific working
memory). Separately open: whether MECH-116 is a WM subcomponent of
SD-033a or a distinct E1 recurrent-WM substrate (flagged 2026-04-19,
unresolved governance question, not this wwa's job to settle).

claims.claim_title: The wanting signal (goal-distance scoring via z_goal_latent) and the liking signal (benefit_eval_head receipt predictor) are functionally dissociable in trajectory scoring.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same preconditions, the two ablations produce statistically indistinguishable post-relocation approach behaviour, or the separation disappears once the window is shortened relative to the z_goal half-life, or it survives with the liking head at chance-level receipt prediction -- in which case the contrast is a decay-constant artifact rather than a wanting/liking dissociation.
claims.required_event: Resource relocation from L1 to L2 mid-episode after the agent has been trained to approach L1, so wanting (goal-distance scoring) and liking (receipt prediction) are placed in direct conflict about where to go next.
claims.manipulation: Ablate each channel independently at matched seeds: goal_weight to zero (wanting off, liking intact) versus benefit_eval_enabled off (liking off, wanting intact) versus both on, with use_resource_proximity_head ON in every arm so z_world carries resource content.
claims.control: The both-on arm and a navigation-matched baseline in which neither channel scores, so the greedy-navigation confound that produced the EXQ-074d/074e C1 failure cannot reappear, plus a relocation-window length chosen well inside the z_goal half-life.
claims.DV: Post-relocation L1 approach fraction over a window short relative to the z_goal half-life, contrasted between the wanting-intact and liking-intact arms, together with the redirect latency to L2 in each arm and the held-out r2 of the liking head against benefit receipt as a reported covariate.
claims.instrument: Both channels exist and are separately weighted: ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py computes the goal-distance wanting term under config.goal_weight and hosts benefit_eval_head; ree_core/goal.py applies decay_goal; ree_core/residue/field.py holds the benefit terrain. SD-018's resource-proximity supervision exists (use_resource_proximity_head, compute_resource_proximity_loss) but its own r2 > 0.5 validation was never cleanly recorded and no MECH-117 run enables it.
claims.consumer_locus: Trajectory scoring in E3 select: whether removing one channel changes the committed approach target while the other is intact, not the downstream resource-acquisition rate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both signals must carry the content the claim attributes to them, measured not assumed. The liking head must predict benefit receipt above its own permuted null on held-out data (config.py records benefit_eval_head(z_world) at R2 = -0.004 without resource-proximity supervision, so use_resource_proximity_head must be ON with its r2 reported per seed), and the wanting persistence window must be short relative to the z_goal half-life (~139 steps at decay_goal 0.005) or the persistence DV is entailed by the decay constant rather than measured.
claims.blocking_reason: The existing supporting runs are degenerate in two ways: the liking head was read off a z_world measured orthogonal to resource proximity (r2 = -0.004) with resource-proximity supervision default-OFF, and the wanting persistence DV was scored over a 200-step window against a z_goal half-life of about 139 steps, so persistence is largely entailed by decay_goal. No run reports either as a covariate.

false_positives: The 2026-04-06 reclassification of the EXQ-074e/074f FAIL runs as blocked on missing serotonergic substrate (MECH-186/187/188) is not the live blocker; the measured binding constraint is the observation-to-z_world encoding that leaves the liking head with no resource content to read.

claims.claim_title: A content class that is stored and retrievable in the REE system is not thereby active in the navigable state used for trajectory evaluation; active participation requires a preparation substrate (vmPFC-analog) that converts stored content into live state components at evaluation time.
claims.falsifier_summary: Ablating the preparation pathway produces no dissociation -- retrieval and generation degrade together, or generation stays correct despite ablated preparation -- which falsifies ARC-035 and INV-037 jointly, since the invariant is emergent from the mechanism.
claims.required_event: A trajectory-evaluation episode in which harm-associated or constraint-relevant content is demonstrably stored and retrievable, while candidate trajectories are generated and selected.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the vmPFC-analog preparation pathway (per ARC-035's protocol) while leaving storage and explicit retrieval intact -- not removing the residue or constraint content itself.
claims.control: An intact-preparation arm, plus a content-ablation arm that removes the stored content, so that a preparation lesion is distinguishable from a content lesion.
claims.DV: The DISSOCIATION: explicit-query retrievability of the stored content (residue evaluate() at a queried z_world, constraint articulation) held intact WHILE harm-associated trajectory avoidance in generation degrades -- both measured on the same agent in the same episode.
claims.instrument: Half present. ree_core/residue/field.py exposes evaluate() / evaluate_valence() as an explicit-query readout and evaluate_trajectory() as the generation-side consumer, so the dissociation DV is recordable. What is missing is the ablation target: residue reaches E3 scoring directly, with no intervening preparation stage to lesion.
claims.consumer_locus: The stored-to-active conversion step that makes stored content a live component of the state used for trajectory evaluation -- asserted by ARC-035, and architecturally absent as a distinct boundary in V3.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A separable preparation stage must exist between stored content and the navigable state, so that lesioning preparation is distinguishable from lesioning the content itself. Verified FAILING: ree_core has no vmPFC-analog compiler module -- vmPFC appears only as an anatomical label on unrelated mechanisms (residue/field.py MECH-303 safety terrain, agent.py MECH-324 IL maintenance operator, utils/config.py).
claims.blocking_reason: The asserted causal locus has no code realisation: stored residue reaches the evaluator directly, so there is no preparation stage to ablate. The nearest available manipulation removes the CONTENT from scoring, which tests something else. ARC-035/SD-033c remain candidate with ready:false.
false_positives: SD-016 ContextMemory cue-indexed retrieval is implemented and can look like the preparation pathway; it is a retrieval/addressing mechanism feeding E1 predictions, not a stored-to-active compiler, and its own content-selective retrieval validation is still gated (V3-EXQ-418d/418e attention-collapse FAILs).
claims.auditor_notes: Do not author an independent INV-037 falsifier -- the WWA correctly defers to ARC-035's single joint test, and that deference is still right. The useful new finding is that the readout half already exists (residue evaluate() versus evaluate_trajectory()), so only the ablation target is owed.
claims.what_would_answer:
INV-037 is an EMERGENT invariant (emergent_from: ARC-035) -- it is architecturally UN-STATEABLE, not merely unevidenced, unless ARC-035 (the vmPFC-analog stored->active compiler) exists as a real substrate concept. The stored/active distinction this invariant asserts IS the distinction ARC-035 defines; there is no independent test of the general principle apart from a test of the specific mechanism. INV-037 therefore inherits ARC-035's exact current gating: ARC-035 is 'candidate' with epistemic_category substrate_conditional -- 3 of its 4 content-class pathways (residue/psychopathy, constraint/vmPFC-lesion, safety-memory/PTSD) are flagged pending_substrate_reconfirmation via SD-016, whose own evidence (V3-EXQ-418d/418e) shows attention-collapse FAILs -- wired but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval -- and the 4th pathway (social/identity constraints, MECH-132) has no wired substrate at all. Do not attempt to answer INV-037 independently of ARC-035's own falsifier; a single experiment answers both, at different levels of abstraction (INV-037 = the general principle, ARC-035 = the specific REE mechanism).
THE TEST (cross-referenced from ARC-035, not re-derived): ablate the vmPFC-analog preparation pathway and measure whether trajectory selection dissociates from stored-content retrievability. See ARC-035's own what_would_answer for the full ablation protocol and per-content-class operationalisation; do not duplicate that design here.
CONFIRMING signature (restates the claim's own three numbered experimental predictions, already well-formed in the notes above): (1) A system with correct residue storage but degraded preparation routing shows intact residue retrieval on explicit query while failing to avoid harm-associated trajectories in generation -- stored but not active. (2) A system with correct constraint encoding but no preparation pathway articulates constraints correctly when queried while generating constraint-violating trajectories. (3) The failure mode in (1)/(2) is not correctable by adding post-hoc constraint checking after generation (see INV-038) -- confirming that activation must happen at generation time, not evaluation-after-the-fact. Any one of these three, replicated across the corresponding content class, counts as confirming evidence for both INV-037 and ARC-035 jointly.
FALSIFYING: if ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway (per ARC-035's protocol) produces NO dissociation between stored-content retrievability and trajectory-generation behavior -- i.e. retrieval and generation degrade together, or generation stays correct despite ablated preparation -- this falsifies ARC-035 AND INV-037 together. Because INV-037 is emergent from ARC-035 specifically, there is no scenario in which ARC-035 is falsified but INV-037 survives, or vice versa: falsification of the mechanism is falsification of the principle it instantiates.
Standing block, independent of the ablation result: until SD-016's content-selective retrieval FAILs are resolved and MECH-132's social/identity pathway is wired, INV-037 cannot be answered either way for those specific content classes -- absence of a dissociation there is not yet evidence against the invariant, only evidence the substrate under test does not yet instantiate the mechanism the invariant depends on.

claims.claim_title: A system with correct post-hoc ethical scoring but without an active constraint preparation substrate will produce the EVR pattern: correct verbal moral judgments coexisting with unconstrained trajectory generation; this pattern is not correctable by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy.
claims.falsifier_summary: Raising post-hoc scoring accuracy alone, with preparation still ablated, reduces the EVR pattern; or the EVR pattern also appears with preparation intact, meaning something other than the ARC-035 pathway is load-bearing.
claims.required_event: Trajectory generation followed by a separable downstream scoring stage that can accept or suppress generated candidates -- the architecture the claim contrasts against generative-time constraint.
claims.manipulation: A 2x2: preparation substrate {intact, ablated} crossed with post-hoc scoring accuracy {high, degraded}, with the post-hoc stage instantiated as a distinct scorer applied after candidate generation.
claims.control: The preparation-intact / scoring-degraded cell is the control that carries the substantive asymmetry -- it must show the mirror pattern (constrained behaviour, poor explicit justification) rather than the EVR pattern.
claims.DV: Rate at which norm-violating trajectories are generated as primary candidates despite a correct scorer, failure of suppression under simulated time or resource pressure, and default-to-unconstrained behaviour on ambiguous cases -- each measured per cell.
claims.instrument: Missing on both arms. ree_core contains no post-hoc scoring or veto stage (grep for post_hoc and veto finds none; harm cost is applied inside E3 candidate evaluation, pre-commit), and the preparation pathway is the non-selective SD-016 route plus an unbuilt MECH-132 social-constraint gate.
claims.consumer_locus: The boundary between trajectory generation and trajectory evaluation: whether normative content is active in the generative state or only applied to already-generated candidates.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two independent non-degeneracy checks: the ARC-035 preparation pathway must be content-selective before ablating it can mean anything, and the post-hoc scoring degradation must be verified to produce measurably worse scoring on held-out cases rather than being a flag with no behavioural reach.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 has no separable post-hoc ethical-scoring stage to degrade -- harm scoring happens inside E3 candidate evaluation, so the claim's own contrast architecture cannot be instantiated -- and the preparation arm inherits ARC-035's unmet non-degeneracy precondition (SD-016 attention collapse; MECH-132 unbuilt).
false_positives: Reading the blocker as ARC-035 alone is incomplete: even with ARC-035 non-degenerate, the post-hoc-filter comparator arm still does not exist anywhere in the substrate.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: INV-038's 2x2 needs a post-hoc scoring stage whose accuracy can be set independently of the generative pathway, so that 'correct scoring, absent preparation' is a producible condition rather than a described one.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: An experiment-layer scorer applied to E3 candidate trajectories after generation, with a calibrated accuracy knob (high / degraded) and a held-out manipulation check proving the degradation changes scoring accuracy.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-cell counts of norm-violating candidates generated versus suppressed, suppression failure rate under an imposed step or compute budget, and the ambiguous-case default -- recorded per arm.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: No substrate_queue entry, claim or design doc registers a post-hoc ethical filter; ree_core has no such stage, and ARC-035's owners cover only the preparation side of the contrast.

claims.auditor_notes: The prerequisite is deliberately an experiment-layer comparator, not a new cognitive mechanism; it should not be read as endorsing a post-hoc ethics module in the architecture -- it is the control arm the claim needs in order to be refutable.
