NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test is gated behind ARC-035's own
non-degeneracy requirement, not independently satisfiable. ARC-035
(vmPFC-analog stored->active preparation -- NOT to be confused with
SD-035, the unrelated but confirmed-stable amygdala BLA/CeA
substrate, which shares no what_would_answer relevance here)
currently has zero experimental evidence (13/13 entries literature;
exp count = 0 per ARC-035's own what_would_answer) and its nearest
wired candidate, SD-016, FAILED its own content-selectivity test
(V3-EXQ-418d/418e: ContextMemory attention collapses to the
uniform-distribution ceiling -- see SD-016's own what_would_answer,
also digested this session). The social/identity-constraint content
class specifically implicated in the EVR grounding (MECH-132,
bvFTD/EVR-analog) has NO wired substrate at all: status candidate,
unimplemented. Do not run this test against the current substrate as
-is -- an ablation of an already-non-functional or unbuilt
preparation pathway cannot produce an interpretable dissociation.
ARC-035 must first reach a state where its own non-degeneracy
precondition is satisfied (SD-016 attention-collapse resolved or
shown not to affect the tested content class, AND MECH-132 built and
wired as a live tonic constraint gate) before this test is
meaningful.

Independently, the POST-HOC SCORING manipulation also needs its own
non-degeneracy check: "degraded post-hoc scoring" must be verified
to actually produce measurably worse scoring accuracy on held-out
cases (not merely a flag toggle with no behavioral effect) -- per
the pattern confirmed repeatedly this session (e.g. ARC-071 /
V3-EXQ-871), a scoring "degradation" that never reaches the code
path it claims to affect produces a false confirming or falsifying
result.

THE TEST (once both substrates are non-degenerate): a 2x2 design --
preparation substrate {INTACT, ABLATED} x post-hoc scoring accuracy
{HIGH, DEGRADED}. Preparation intact/scoring degraded should
reproduce the mirror-EVR pattern (ethical BEHAVIOR with poor
explicit/verbal moral justification). Preparation ablated/scoring
intact should reproduce the EVR pattern itself (correct
verbal/explicit moral scoring coexisting with unconstrained
trajectory generation -- measure via: unconstrained/norm-violating
trajectories generated as primary candidates even though the scorer
correctly flags them; suppression failing preferentially under
simulated time/resource pressure; ambiguous cases defaulting to the
unconstrained trajectory).

CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: the EVR pattern appears ONLY in the
preparation-ABLATED/scoring-HIGH cell, and does NOT appear in the
preparation-INTACT/scoring-DEGRADED cell (which should instead show
the mirror pattern: good behavior, poor articulation). This
asymmetry is the substantive claim.

FALSIFYING SIGNATURE (either sub-condition weakens the claim,
matching the notes field's already-stated criterion): (a) improving
post-hoc scoring accuracy alone (with preparation still ablated)
measurably reduces the EVR pattern -- contradicting "not correctable
by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy"; or (b) the EVR pattern also
appears with preparation INTACT -- meaning something other than the
ARC-035 preparation substrate is the load-bearing factor, and the
emergent_from: [ARC-035] linkage needs re-grounding elsewhere.

CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): zero experimental
evidence exists for INV-038 (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json) and
no experiment under any id has ever operationalized either arm of
this design. This invariant is emergent_from ARC-035 (vmPFC,
confirmed via direct read of the ARC-035 claims.yaml block).
Testable only after ARC-035 clears its own non-degeneracy
precondition.

claims.claim_title: The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.
claims.falsifier_summary: SHY-ON leaves the trace mass ratio unchanged or systematically and substantially erodes committed diversity beyond a small bounded margin -- downscaling without working hypothesis-tag protection damages rather than restores signal-to-noise.
claims.required_event: An SWS sub-phase entered after a waking window that has potentiated weak noisy traces alongside strong ones.
claims.manipulation: SHY normalisation ON versus OFF at the SWS phase (config.shy_enabled, shy_decay_rate), with the decay rate swept, and -- for the legs that are not built -- a residue-field global decay and a z_delta recalibration toward a low-information prior at the same phase.
claims.control: Sleep-OFF and SHY-OFF arms at matched seeds and matched waking exposure, plus the staged-damage lesion arms that isolate the sws phase from nrem and rem.
claims.DV: Signal-to-noise restoration in the structure the phase actually flattens: the ratio of strong-trace to weak-trace weight mass after the phase versus before, and post-sleep retrieval fidelity for strong versus weak traces -- not only the committed-action diversity bound the current WWA reads.
claims.instrument: E1DeepPredictor.shy_normalise decays ContextMemory slot weights toward the slot mean (ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) and experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py maps the sws phase to MECH-120 with a denoising readout; that readout is scale-invariant and its runs are carve-out-forbidden from tagging MECH-120.
claims.consumer_locus: The SWS phase of the offline cycle, acting on the stores the claim names -- E1 ContextMemory (built), the residue field (not built) and z_delta (not built).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Committed-action-class diversity must be non-degenerate across arms (established by 691, 2/3 seeds), AND for the denoising leg the sws readout must be sensitive to the manipulation -- the scale-invariant cosine readout cannot register a content-scale ladder while damage is referenced to unscaled content, which is GFLAG-0351's bit-exact finding.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim bundles three SWS operations and only one exists: enter_sws_mode calls e1.shy_normalise on ContextMemory slots and nothing else; there is no residue-field global decay and no z_delta recalibration anywhere in the sleep path. The DV for the built leg has no recorder tagged to this claim -- the sws lesion readout is scale-invariant (GFLAG-0351) and carve-out-forbidden from tagging MECH-120.
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note's 'SHY wiring implemented 2026-04-08 ... Implementation complete' is true only for the E1 ContextMemory leg; the residue-field denoising and z_delta recalibration the claim title and notes assert are not in enter_sws_mode.
The EXQ-245 double FAIL was correctly reclassified non_contributory (proxy substrate), so it is not evidence against the mechanism.
claims.auditor_notes: Recommend narrowing MECH-120 to the ContextMemory attractor-flattening operation that is actually built, and either splitting off or retiring the residue-field and z_delta clauses, before any further run. A falsifier written against the current three-part text cannot be satisfied by the substrate.

downscaling without a working MECH-094 hypothesis-tag protection
actively damages rather than restores signal-to-noise. Also falsifying:
monostrategy convergence does NOT emerge in a no-sleep-substrate agent

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim bundles two distinct mechanisms and
each needs its own gate.
Content-packaging half: the landed substrate
(MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION, REEConfig.use_mech122_spindle_content_selection)
is confirmed non-inert (mean_spindle_selection_applied=1.0 in V3-EXQ-861a) but
its current novelty reference (ThetaBuffer.consolidation_summary(), a
self-referential recency average of the same waking window supplying the
content being compared against it) is a diagnosed measurement/test-design
defect, not a real manipulation -- selection_weight stays uniformly tiny
(~0.004-0.01) regardless of arm. A run against this UN-corrected novelty
reference is not informative and should self-route
substrate_not_ready/measurement_defect, not count as a verdict on the
mechanism -- this is exactly how the two EXQ-246 vacuous PASSes and the
V3-EXQ-861a FAIL were already read. The precondition for an informative run
is the routed-but-not-yet-landed fix: re-source the novelty signal from
something MEL-correlated (e.g. the E3/E2 prediction-error signal that
already drives MEL) instead of the self-referential buffer, with
selection_weight showing measurable variance across MEL levels as a
manipulation check.
Sensory-gating half: MECH122-SENSORY-GATING-OFFLINE-PROTECTION is unbuilt
(complex (probe-gated)) and not established as load-bearing under the
current strictly-sequential wake/sleep harness design. No run can test this
half until it is built; any claimed test of "gating" before then is not
evidence either way.
CONFIRMING signature: (a) Content-packaging -- once the novelty reference is
re-sourced to a MEL-correlated signal, MECH-180's spindle_density DV tracks
novelty in the predicted direction (WITH_SPINDLE vs NO_SPINDLE arms
diverge, ContextMemory writes are robustly differentiated rather than the
null V3-EXQ-246 outcome) across a majority of seeds. (b) Sensory-gating --
once built, external sensory input is measurably suppressed/buffered during
spindle windows, and a consolidation episode protected by gating transfers
content better than one interrupted by waking input.
FALSIFYING: (a) Content-packaging -- even after re-sourcing the novelty
signal to a MEL-correlated source, spindle_density/selection_weight still
fails to track novelty, or continues moving in the wrong direction relative
to MEL (as already seen on the two well-formed V3-EXQ-861a seeds) -- this
would upgrade the finding from "measurement defect" to genuine evidence
against the content-packaging mechanism. (b) Sensory-gating -- once built,
interrupted vs gating-protected consolidation episodes are statistically
indistinguishable, or gating fails to measurably suppress external input at
all. CROSS-CUTTING CAVEAT (already flagged as an open, converging
hypothesis by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436c_2026-08-03 on a different DV):
if ContextMemory.write_gate is found to carry the same bias-over-content
collapse already fixed on key_proj's read path (SD-016 Part A / EXQ-477),
that is a shared substrate bug, not evidence on MECH-122 either way, and
should be ruled out before attributing any future FAIL to this mechanism.

claims.manipulation: Cross the REM window against the matched non-REM control, and separately ablate use_rem_precision_recalibration (currently the only implemented recalibration consumer) and the generative re-derivation pass, at matched seeds.
claims.control: A matched non-REM control window of equal length on the same agent and seed (the claim's own comparator), plus the SD-068 harness null-content arm (content_scale 0.0), which re-derives from a content-free seed so residual sigma-sensitivity is the forward model's raw noise response.
claims.DV: Three, of which only one is currently recordable: (a) commitment count across the REM window; (b) correlation between REM-generated trajectory coherence and an independently measured world-model quality; (c) the change in z_beta and z_delta across the REM window relative to the matched non-REM control.
claims.instrument: Partial. SleepLoopManager WRITEBACK implements MECH-204's precision recalibration (serotonin.compute_recalibration_target -> e3.recalibrate_precision_to, nudging E3 running_variance) and the REM generative pass is instrumented by _lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.rem_generative_fidelity / rem_precision_error as a corruption-gain readout. Nothing writes or records z_beta or z_delta across the REM window, and no instrument correlates dream coherence with independently measured model quality.
claims.consumer_locus: The REM sub-phase's effect on the precision priors the waking loop then uses -- z_beta and z_delta -- not the E3 running_variance scalar that the implemented MECH-204 consumer actually moves.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The claim's own substrate precondition, unchanged: the full offline-phase architecture (MECH-030 modes, MECH-092 replay, MECH-094 hypothesis tag, ARC-016 dynamic precision, MECH-093) live, AND commit-gate suppression independently confirmed NON-DEGENERATE. The second half is the live problem -- in V3 the offline cycle runs no E3 committed selection at all, so zero commitments during REM is architecturally guaranteed rather than a measured property of a suppressed gate, and the leg cannot discriminate.
claims.blocking_reason: The named precision priors have no REM write path: the only implemented recalibration consumer moves E3 running_variance toward a serotonin-derived target, and nothing touches z_beta or z_delta during REM, so the claim's own quantity cannot reach its locus. Independently, commit-gate suppression is degenerate -- no E3 commit selection runs offline at all.
false_positives: EXP-0556's gating on the V3-EXQ-243 proxy-immaturity verdict is not the whole story: the REM precision consumer and the generative re-derivation readout have both landed since, so the residual gap is the z_beta/z_delta write path and the coherence-versus-model-quality DV, not offline-phase immaturity in general.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim carries phase v3 / v3_pending true while its own notes and what_would_answer say V4 scope and not V3-tractable as stated; the partial V3 substrate (MECH-204, the REM generative pass) is what keeps it v3_native here, but the coordinator should note the registered-scope inconsistency.
claims.what_would_answer:

(MECH-030 modes, MECH-092 replay, MECH-094 hypothesis tag, ARC-016
dynamic precision, MECH-093) to be live AND the REM sub-phase's
commit-gate suppression (ARC-016 running_variance threshold effectively
infinite) to be independently confirmed non-degenerate (commitment
genuinely does not fire during REM, not merely rare) -- without this the

Registered V4 scope per this claim's own notes; not V3-tractable as
stated (epistemic_category/v3_pending set explicitly 2026-08-06 to match
that prose, mirroring sibling MECH-121).
CONFIRMING signature: during REM, (a) commit-gate suppression is
measurable (zero commitments recorded across the REM window, not merely
reduced); (b) E1 generates world-model trajectories that are coherently
self-consistent for a genuinely-adequate world model and INCOHERENT in

claims.claim_title: When harm-trace salience dominates offline replay content, consolidation selectively amplifies harm predictions, progressively contracting option space -- a distinct failure mode from Q-021 behavioral flatness.
claims.falsifier_summary: Option-space metrics plateau after a single adjustment or do not decline further across cycles; or the contraction is fully reproduced by the cycling-held-constant arm, which would attribute it to Q-021 training-time avoidance rather than to consolidation dynamics.
claims.required_event: A sequence of >= 4 SD-017 offline sleep cycles interleaved with waking training, each running SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass over replayed regions, on an agent whose approach drives were present and exercised during training.
claims.manipulation: Replay CONTENT composition: harm-dominant consolidation (the current single-module e2_harm_s pass) versus a balanced arm in which goal-directed traces are consolidated proportionally, with MECH-094 tag protection as a third arm.
claims.control: A cycling-held-constant arm that varies only waking training exposure, which separates the MECH-124 consolidation-time dynamic from the Q-021 training-time static-avoidance explanation.
claims.DV: Cycle-over-cycle trajectory (not pre/post) of action diversity, z_goal representation strength / goal_vs_harm_ratio, and approach-behaviour frequency, tested for progressive monotone contraction rather than a single-step adjustment.
claims.instrument: goal_vs_harm_ratio is computed by the 085-family and 179/224/298 drivers and z_goal norm is available per tick; SleepCycleState.last_metrics carries per-cycle sleep diagnostics. What is missing is a per-cycle option-space readout attached to the sleep loop and any goal-trace consolidation channel to contrast against.
claims.consumer_locus: The offline consolidation write into e2_harm_s / the harm prediction path, and its downstream effect on E3 option selection -- not training-time reward shaping.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Multiple consolidation cycles must actually fire (SleepLoopManager cycle count > 0 with a non-empty replayed-region set and offline_n_steps > 0), option-space metrics must be non-degenerate in the first cycle (not already at floor), and the harm:goal replay-content ratio must be measurable per cycle rather than assumed from the EXQ-224 baseline.
claims.blocking_reason: The balanced-replay comparator does not exist. SleepReplaySampler prioritises by MECH-284 staleness, not by harm/goal salience, and SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass updates e2_harm_s parameters only, so there is no goal-trace consolidation channel to hold proportional. Without that arm the harm-dominant condition is the only condition V3 can generate and the mechanism-specificity clause cannot be tested.
false_positives: The claim's own notes and WWA both assert V3 has no sleep/consolidation architecture and route MECH-124 to V4. That was true when registered (2026-03) and is false now -- the SD-017 sleep loop, MECH-285 sampler, MECH-272 routing gate and MECH-121 offline gradient pass have all landed.
claims.auditor_notes: The unbuilt balanced harm/goal replay scheduling is NAMED but deliberately DISOWNED by the substrate_queue entry mech092-replay-consumer-missing, whose implementation_hint states it unblocks MECH-092 and MECH-205 only and that MECH-121 and MECH-209 stay blocked on it. The coordinator may want to decide whether that item deserves a node of its own; MECH-124 is a fourth claim waiting on it and is not listed anywhere as doing so.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim cannot be tested in V3. It requires an
actual offline consolidation/replay substrate (MECH-121 SWR replay, MECH-120 SWS
denoising) running multiple sleep cycles over training -- V3 has no sleep
architecture. EXQ-224 and EXQ-298 (both 2026-04, V3-era) are PRECURSOR diagnostics
only: they establish whether the salience-balance PRECONDITION for the loop holds
(goal vs harm salience ratio), not whether the consolidation loop itself amplifies
harm and contracts option space. A run that only re-measures z_goal/harm salience
ratios in V3 (no consolidation cycles) should self-route substrate_not_ready for
THIS claim, not count as a verdict -- that ground was already covered by EXQ-224/298.
A genuine test additionally requires ITERATION: a single consolidation pass cannot
distinguish a self-amplifying loop from a one-off adjustment -- the design must run
multiple offline consolidation cycles and track the trajectory of option-space /
approach-behavior metrics across cycles, not just a pre/post snapshot.
CONFIRMING signature: across successive consolidation cycles in which replay
content is harm-dominant (e.g. the ~3:1 harm:goal salience ratio measured in the
EXQ-224 baseline), option-space metrics (action diversity, z_goal representation
strength, frequency of approach behavior) PROGRESSIVELY CONTRACT cycle-over-cycle,
even though approach signals were present during the original training (ruling out
a pure Q-021 static-avoidance explanation). The effect should be attenuated or
absent when replay content is balanced per MECH-121 (goal-directed traces
included proportionally) or when MECH-094 tag-based protection shields harm traces
from over-amplification -- i.e. the loop is mechanism-specific to salience
imbalance in replay, not an inevitable property of consolidation itself. An agent
with strong approach drives at training time (INV-034) that STILL contracts under
imbalanced consolidation would be a strong confirming case, since it isolates the
consolidation dynamic from training-time drive strength.
FALSIFYING signature: harm-dominant replay content does NOT produce progressive,
cycle-over-cycle contraction -- option-space metrics stabilize, plateau, or do not
decline further than a single adjustment -- OR the apparent contraction is fully
explained by training-time avoidance dynamics (Q-021) and disappears/does not
change when consolidation cycling is held constant while only training exposure is
varied. Also falsifying: an agent with imbalanced (harm-dominant) consolidation
that does NOT show declining approach behavior despite otherwise-sufficient
approach drive, which would indicate the proposed self-amplifying loop is not load-
bearing even when its stated precondition (salience imbalance) is present.
Distinguish explicitly from Q-021 in the writeup: Q-021 is training-time and static
(no approach signal from the start); MECH-124 is consolidation-time and dynamic
(approach signal present at training, contraction emerges from repeated offline
replay/consolidation). A run that cannot separate these two should not be scored
against MECH-124 either way.
claims.stale_reason: The WWA's premise -- 'this claim cannot be tested in V3 ... V3 has no sleep architecture' -- is refuted by current code: ree_core/sleep/ now carries SleepLoopManager (K-episode multi-cycle SD-017 entry), SleepReplaySampler (MECH-285), RoutingGate (MECH-272) and SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass (the MECH-121 offline consolidation pass). The residual blocker is narrower and different: replay priority is keyed on staleness and the consolidation pass trains e2_harm_s ALONE, so the harm-dominant arm exists by construction while the balanced-replay control does not.

claims.claim_title: E3 trajectory selection implements multi-constraint viability evaluation rather than scalar reward maximisation: a trajectory is selected when no major evaluation system produces a veto-level error signal across goal space, harm space, identity space, and resource space.
claims.falsifier_summary: The committed action is the aggregate-score argmin on essentially every tick, so multi-constraint viability is a redescription of scalar maximisation with no separable veto structure.
claims.required_event: A selection tick on which a high-aggregate-score candidate carries a veto-level error signal in one constraint space (goal, harm, identity or resource) while others are clear.
claims.manipulation: Arm per-space veto floors in the E3 selection rule and compare against the incumbent pure weighted-sum score, at matched seeds and matched candidate sets.
claims.control: The current cross-compensating weighted-sum selector as the aggregate-argmin baseline, plus a shuffled-veto arm that preserves veto frequency but destroys its pairing with the candidate.
claims.DV: Rate at which the committed action is NOT the aggregate-score winner because the higher-scoring candidate carried a veto, scored against chance, plus the predictive advantage of the veto rule over the aggregate rule for commitment.
claims.instrument: Missing at the locus. ree-v3 ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py implements a weighted-sum cost with full cross-term compensation and a single scalar variance commit gate; the only occurrence of the word veto anywhere in ree_core is a comment in policy/policy_decomposition.py, so no per-space veto is emitted or recorded.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 trajectory selection and the commit gate -- the choice among candidate trajectories, not downstream episode reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least two evaluation systems must be LIVE and capable of emitting a veto-level signal in the measured window, with at least one candidate actually receiving one; a run in which no veto ever fires tests nothing, and a run with one live system trivially satisfies no major system vetoes.
claims.blocking_reason: No per-space veto exists to fire, so the non-degeneracy precondition fails by construction and the falsifying branch is satisfied trivially by the substrate's shape rather than by evidence; MECH-439's 88-89 percent F-channel variance monopoly compounds this at the selection readout.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0275 (contested_disposition, OPEN since 2026-09-14) already owns this exact finding and is the right place to settle whether the claim is demoted, narrowed to a design target, or given a build. Note the asymmetry: the FALSIFYING branch is measurable today (the argmin comparison), the CONFIRMING branch is not -- a run now would produce an uninformative confirmation of the null.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two evaluation systems LIVE and capable of emitting a veto-level error signal in the measured window, with at least one candidate actually receiving one -- a run in which no veto ever fires tests nothing, and a run with only one live system trivially satisfies 'no major system vetoes'.
CONFIRMING: committed trajectories are those on which no evaluation system exceeds its veto threshold, and this predicts commitment BETTER than the argmin of the aggregate score -- specifically, committed actions exist that are NOT the aggregate-score winner because a higher-scoring candidate carried a veto, at a rate above chance.
FALSIFYING: the committed action is the aggregate-score argmin on essentially every tick -- 'multi-constraint viability' is then an alternative description of scalar maximisation with no separable veto structure, which is what MECH-439's measured 88-89% F-channel variance monopoly currently predicts and why this claim needs its own falsifier rather than inheriting one.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked -- category set from this claim's own live_status reading where present; if governance judges the veto structure built-and-exercised with its signal absorbed by F-dominance, substrate_ceiling is the right variant.

claims.claim_title: Counterfactual other-cost-aversion activates cooperative behavior as a motivational surrogate when the direct task-reward pathway is degraded.
claims.falsifier_summary: Engagement under degradation is indistinguishable with and without the counterfactual channel; or the rescue requires the other agent to be present and observable, collapsing MECH-127 into ordinary MECH-031 modulation; or ablating OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging leaves the rescue intact.
claims.required_event: A deficit state in the direct task-motivation pathway together with a modelled other agent who would bear a cost, the other agent being absent rather than observed.
claims.manipulation: Activate the counterfactual OTHER_SELFLIKE mirror channel while the direct pathway is confirmed degraded, and ablate that channel in the comparison arm; separately vary other-present versus other-absent.
claims.control: Degraded-pathway-alone baseline, further-degraded direct pathway arm (which should not further reduce engagement if the bypass is real), and an other-present arm to separate counterfactual projection from observation-driven modulation.
claims.DV: Cooperative task engagement relative to the degraded-pathway-alone baseline, conditional on channel state -- and specifically whether the rescue survives when the other agent is absent and collapses when the mirror channel is ablated.
claims.instrument: Entirely absent: there is no other-agent representation, no OTHER_SELFLIKE tag, no counterfactual mirror and no multi-agent environment, so neither the manipulation nor the DV can be recorded.
claims.consumer_locus: The motivational activation route into task engagement -- bypass of a degraded direct pathway, not modulation of an intact one (the MECH-031 distinction).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A verified counterfactual (absent-other) mirror channel and an independently-measurable degraded direct task-motivation state must both exist. Re-verified 2026-09-22: no OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging, mirror channel or second agent exists anywhere in ree_core or experiments, and CausalGridWorldV2 is single-agent, so any run would test MECH-031-style modulation by mistake.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: the claim needs a second agent, pre-encounter OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging, a counterfactual mirror and a multi-step planner able to simulate another agent's future state. All four are V4/V5 items and none exists; the environment is single-agent.
claims.auditor_notes: The test belongs at the V5 social boundary (MIRROR-1 pre-encounter tagging plus MIRROR-2 counterfactual mirror, over the MECH-163 multi-step planner); no V3 stopgap should be invented, because a single-agent proxy would measure MECH-031 modulation and be mistaken for MECH-127 bypass.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-127 is design-only as of this writing -- it has
no built substrate and no experiment has ever attempted to test it (no EXQ/run IDs
exist against this claim). Per mirror_modelling_other_self_v5_plan.md (MIRROR-7),
it is gated on ALL of: pre-encounter OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging (MIRROR-1), a mirror
that runs COUNTERFACTUALLY rather than only on observed other-agent state (MIRROR-2),
the MECH-163 hippocampal multi-step planner (needed to simulate another agent's
future state, not just its present one), and the INV-064 self-model maturational
gate (self_model_v4:SELF-7) establishing self-stability precedes social depth. A run
lacking a verified counterfactual (absent-other) mirror channel, or lacking an
independently-measurable "direct task-motivation pathway degraded" state, tests
nothing and must self-route substrate_not_ready rather than counting as a verdict --
scoring a system that cannot represent an absent other's hypothetical cost is not a
test of bypass-via-counterfactual-projection, it can only be a test of MECH-031-style
modulation by mistake.
CONFIRMING signature (bypass, not modulation): with the direct task-motivation
pathway independently confirmed degraded, cooperative task-engagement rises above
the degraded-pathway-alone baseline specifically when the counterfactual
OTHER_SELFLIKE/mirror channel is active, INCLUDING when the other agent is absent
(the claim is explicit that activation is counterfactual -- "on a model of what
would happen to the other agent if they took on the task, not on their actual
current state"). This must dissociate from MECH-031 (modulation of an intact
pathway): ablating the counterfactual/mirror channel should collapse the rescue
effect, while further degrading the already-degraded direct pathway should NOT
further reduce engagement, since by hypothesis engagement is now being driven
through the alternate (counterfactual empathic) route rather than the direct one.
FALSIFYING signature: cooperative/task engagement under pathway degradation is
statistically indistinguishable with vs without the counterfactual channel (no
rescue); OR the rescue effect requires the other agent to be PRESENT/observable
rather than merely modeled (would falsify the counterfactual/absence claim and
collapse MECH-127 into ordinary MECH-031 modulation); OR ablating OTHER_SELFLIKE
tagging / the counterfactual mirror has no effect on the rescue (would falsify the
proposed mechanism even if some rescue effect is observed via an unidentified
route). Any of these outcomes should be reported as a genuine test result, not
reframed as substrate_not_ready, PROVIDED the non-degeneracy precondition above was
actually met.
Evidence on file: none experimental. This is a first-person-report-motivated
mechanism hypothesis (thought_intake_2026-03-24_empathy_multiagent_ethics.md),
currently un-adjudicated by any run.

claims.claim_title: vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.
claims.falsifier_summary: Ablation produces no dissociation -- selection is equally sensitive intact or ablated while content remains equally retrievable -- meaning E3 already receives the content by another route (residue curvature or hippocampal graph) and the stored/active distinction collapses for that class.
claims.required_event: Trajectory-evaluation episodes in which stored content of one class (residue history, safety memory, goal-approach pull, or social constraint) is demonstrably present and retrievable by direct probe.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the vmPFC-analog activation pathway for exactly one content class -- for example zero the SD-016 terrain_weight channel feeding E3, or suppress the conditioned-safety prediction -- while leaving the underlying store intact and independently probeable.
claims.control: Intact-pathway arm at matched seeds and matched stored content, plus a direct retrieval probe in both arms confirming the content is equally present, so any effect is attributable to activation rather than to storage loss.
claims.DV: Sensitivity of E3 trajectory selection to that content class: w_harm scaling with hazard-cue proximity, differentiation between constraint-violating and constraint-consistent options, safety-cue-driven shift away from a threat-biased trajectory, or goal-directed trajectory frequency at unchanged goal representation.
claims.instrument: ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py extract_cue_context and the terrain_weight channel read at ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py lines 1672-1713 instrument classes 1/3/4; ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py instruments the safety-memory class; nothing instruments the social/identity class, and MECH-151's action_bias reaches no E3 ranking channel at all.
claims.consumer_locus: The stored-to-active conversion boundary at E3 trajectory evaluation time -- content must be active during candidate generation and scoring, not merely retrievable.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The stored-to-active pathway under test must first be shown content-selective: SD-016's ContextMemory attention must escape the uniform-softmax ceiling for the content class being ablated, and for the social/identity class MECH-132 must exist as a live gate before an ablation can dissociate anything.
claims.blocking_reason: SD-016's retrieval path is wired but not content-selective: attention sits at the uniform ceiling (V3-EXQ-418d/e, and 970/971 FAIL on the write-content follow-ups), so ablating it removes nothing discriminative. The social/identity class has no substrate at all (MECH-132 candidate, zero code hits), and SD-033c is a claim-graph consolidation with no implementation.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: Reading ARC-035 as having no wired candidate at all is wrong: MECH-152's terrain_weight genuinely reaches E3 scoring and SD-051's conditioned safety store gates commitment release, so two of the four content classes have real, ablatable pathways.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim's own note says V4 substrate-conditional, DO NOT build in V3, and EXP-0318 records that this gating is prose-only and not machine-encoded; the SD-016 ctxdiv and Gumbel knobs (default 0.0/off) are the live route to the non-degeneracy precondition.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the SD-033c vmPFC-analog subdivision must be a genuine wired activation substrate, not the claim-graph consolidation currently registered (v3_pending: false / consolidation_status: complete, closed purely by subsuming ARC-035 + MECH-151 + MECH-152 + MECH-235 with no new implementation). The substrate actually performing "stored -> active" conversion is SD-016 (implemented 2026-04-16): E1DeepPredictor.extract_cue_ context(z_world) -> action_bias (E2, MECH-151) / terrain_weight (E3, MECH-152), covering three of the four ARC-035 content classes (residue, safety memory, goal-approach gating). But SD-016's own evidence_quality_note records V3-EXQ-418d/418e FAILs: ContextMemory attention collapses to the uniform-distribution ceiling (entropy ~ln(16)) and slot diversity fails in most seeds -- the pathway is wired and exercised but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval. The fourth content class -- social/identity constraints (MECH-132, the EVR/bvFTD case) -- has NO wired substrate: status candidate, unimplemented. A non-degenerate test therefore requires (a) the SD-016 attention-collapse issue resolved or independently verified not to affect the content class under test, and (b) for content-class-2 tests specifically, MECH-132 built and wired as a live tonic constraint gate before an ablation is meaningful.
CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: with the substrate non-degenerate, ablate the vmPFC-analog pathway for one content class while leaving underlying storage intact (content still retrievable via a direct probe of ContextMemory / the residue field). Confirming: the probe shows content is still present and retrievable AND E3 trajectory selection is measurably LESS sensitive to that content with the pathway ablated than intact -- e.g. w_harm no longer scales with hazard-cue proximity (psychopathy/reversal-learning analog); trajectory choice no longer differentiates constraint-violating vs -consistent options (vmPFC-lesion/norm-application analog); safety-context cues no longer shift E3 away from the threat-biased trajectory (PTSD/extinction analog); or goal-directed trajectory frequency drops despite unchanged goal representation (depression/approach-attenuation analog).
FALSIFYING SIGNATURE: ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway produces NO dissociation -- trajectory selection is equally (in)sensitive whether the pathway is intact or ablated, while content remains equally retrievable via direct probe in both conditions. This would mean E3 already gets the content some other way (e.g. directly from ResidueField curvature or hippocampal graph structure), so there is no separable "activation" function distinct from what the residue field / hippocampal machinery already performs -- the stored/active distinction collapses for that content class, and the four-failure-mode taxonomy would need re-grounding elsewhere (e.g. folded back into ARC-007).

claims.claim_title: Hippocampal terrain maps encode separable valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise); ARC-007 residue-field navigation is the harm-causal special case of this general architecture.

claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal map node's stored valence vector and the replay-prioritisation read over it -- the point where drive state selects which dimension dominates -- not the residue scalar alone.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The valence vector must be written on the real ree_core/residue/field.py RBF centers placed by add_residue at true event locations -- never a standalone re-implementation with fixed random centers -- and all four channels must actually populate (non-zero variance per channel) before any collinearity statistic is read. claims.claim_title: What is the correct formal representation for 'threshold/feedback processes bounded by {x...x_n} reliably reaching emergent state q' -- and are descriptive, prescriptive, and diagnostic variants all needed or does one subsume the others?
claims.falsifier_summary: A pseudo-potential or interdependent-types extension yields a convergence proof for MECH-127, so prescriptive subsumes diagnostic and two variants suffice.
claims.required_event: Repeated multi-agent interaction episodes under symmetric coupling, plus a MECH-127 counterfactual-utility condition where utility depends on an internal model rather than the realised action profile.
claims.manipulation: Switch the utility form between actual-action-profile (potential-game admissible) and MECH-127 counterfactual-model-dependent, holding the interaction structure fixed.
claims.control: The base symmetric-coupling game, for which an ordinal-potential / Lyapunov / reachability argument is expected to close.
claims.DV: Whether a convergence proof exists for each utility form (a derivation outcome), and for the counterfactual form whether a diagnostic test -- transfer entropy or perturbation-theory detection that nth-order dynamics diverge from (n-1)th-order predictions -- still resolves whether target state q is reached.
claims.instrument: No V3 instrument. The prescriptive leg is a derivation artifact (CBF / barrier-certificate / reachability, ethics_as_coherence_v5:ETH-6); the diagnostic leg needs an nth-order trajectory recorder over a multi-agent substrate that does not exist -- ARC-047 SocialGridWorld is candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5.
claims.consumer_locus: The nth-order multiagent trajectory distribution (ARC-034), not any single-agent latent or commit boundary.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A multi-agent REE social game with other-cost-aversion primitives must exist, and single-agent harm-avoidance must be a non-degenerate policy rather than the max-entropy random walk that voided V3-EXQ-161; without real harm-avoidance trajectories there are no q-dynamics to represent.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3. The discriminating sub-result is multi-agent (ARC-034 and ARC-047 are both implementation_phase v5, ARC-047 at confidence 0.0) and the prescriptive leg is a formal derivation, not an experiment. V3-EXQ-161's two attempts were voided by a dry run and by a max-entropy random walk with zero harm events.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-161 sits in the corpus as a Q-024 experiment; both manifests are superseded (one dry_run, one max-entropy random walk with harm events = 0), so the claim has no genuine experimental entry despite having a script.
claims.auditor_notes: What WOULD test it, and where: the prescriptive leg needs a derivation artifact (ordinal potential / barrier certificate) not a run, and the diagnostic leg needs a multi-agent substrate at the nth-order trajectory boundary -- ARC-047 SocialGridWorld under ethics_as_coherence_v5:ETH-6, which is blocked/medium and V5-scoped. Do not invent a single-agent V3 falsifier for this; the claim carries a Q-024-specific script that should not be re-run.
claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a representational-completeness argument plus targeted experiment,
not a single run. ANSWER "all three variants (descriptive, prescriptive,
diagnostic) are irreducibly needed" if (a) the base symmetric-coupling REE
social game admits a prescriptive treatment (an ordinal potential / Lyapunov /
reachability proof of convergence to target emergent state q -- inherited from
Q-023), AND (b) a MECH-127 counterfactual-utility case is exhibited for which
NO such prescriptive proof exists yet a diagnostic test (transfer-entropy or
perturbation-theory detection that nth-order dynamics diverge from
(n-1)th-order predictions) still resolves whether q is reached. ANSWER "one
subsumes the others" if a single representation closes every case:
specifically, prescriptive subsumes diagnostic iff the MECH-127 extension
(pseudo-potential per Slade 1994, or interdependent-types per
Bergemann-Morris) yields a convergence proof, removing the need for empirical
trajectory testing. The DISCRIMINATING sub-result is identical to Q-023's:
whether MECH-127's counterfactual-model-dependent utility admits a potential
extension (=> prescriptive subsumes, two variants suffice) or genuinely breaks
convergence (=> diagnostic is irreducible, all three needed). HARD
PRECONDITION: single-agent harm-avoidance must be a working non-degenerate
policy (NOT the max-entropy random walk that voided EXQ-161); without genuine
harm-avoidance trajectories there is no q-dynamics to represent and the
question is untestable. Next step is a derivation artifact, with a
diagnostic-variant experiment only for the MECH-127 branch.

claims.claim_title: E1's LSTM hidden state must be conditioned on z_goal_latent so that predictive trajectories generated by E1 are goal-context-shaped rather than goal-agnostic.
claims.falsifier_summary: With a non-degenerate, common-mode-subtracted z_goal and E1 trained, the interaction term stays at zero -- goal context is represented but does not shape E1 trajectory generation, and the claim's type-match argument fails at the prediction layer rather than at the goal representation.
claims.required_event: Episodes with an active, varying goal in which transitions can be split into goal-relevant (resource/benefit-proximal) and neutral sets of comparable size, on an agent whose E1 is trained.
claims.manipulation: Matched-seed pair as in V3-EXQ-229 but with the degeneracy repaired: GOAL_CONDITIONED (goal_dim > 0, e1_goal_conditioned True, common-mode-subtracted z_goal) versus GOAL_ABLATED (goal_dim 0, projection absent), with E1 trained under compute_prediction_loss in both arms; plus a third arm that re-injects z_goal at EVERY recurrent rollout step rather than once at the rollout seed.
claims.control: GOAL_ABLATED at identical seeds with z_goal still updated but not passed to E1 (the existing 229 control), plus a shuffled-z_goal arm supplying the same input magnitude with the goal-to-state correspondence broken.
claims.DV: The interaction term (err_neutral_ablated - err_neutral_conditioned) - (err_goal_ablated - err_goal_conditioned), i.e. a goal-SELECTIVE reduction in E1 prediction error, reported alongside the measured z_goal spread so a null can be attributed to the conditioning or to a degenerate input.
claims.instrument: The conditioning path exists and is live: E1DeepPredictor allocates goal_input_proj when goal_dim > 0 and applies it in forward, and agent.py passes z_goal at the online transition under goal.e1_goal_conditioned (default True) through the VS rollout gate. V3-EXQ-147/147a/229 implement the interaction DV and train E1 (optim.Adam over agent.e1.parameters()).
claims.consumer_locus: E1's recurrent hidden state as it shapes generated trajectories -- the prediction layer -- distinct from supplying z_goal only at E3 evaluation time.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The conditioning input must carry cross-state variance: z_goal is an EMA attractor pulled toward z_world and sits inside the SD-008 common-mode cone (pairwise cosine 0.9878, ||mean|| / mean||.|| 0.9987 measured on the V3-EXQ-669b nursery), so an un-centered z_goal is effectively a constant and goal_input_proj can only add a constant offset -- which no interaction term can detect. A run must witness a measured cross-tick z_goal spread (common-mode subtracted) and a non-degenerate goal-relevant versus neutral transition labelling.
claims.blocking_reason: Three consecutive C1 nulls (147, 147a, 229; mean_interaction 3.5e-6 against 5e-3) were run with an un-centered z_goal, which SD-079 later measured to be nearly constant across states -- a constant conditioning input cannot produce a transition-selective interaction, so the regime never discriminated. Secondarily the implementation conditions the rollout SEED once (and generate_prior uses the unconditioned state), not each recurrent step as the claim specifies.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note's Hold pending SD-005 is stale: the self/world latent split is implemented (z_self and z_world are separate fields of LatentState and E1 consumes their concatenation), so goal conditioning no longer acts on a conflated z_gamma.

Reading the three C1 FAILs as accumulating evidence against the claim over-reads them: all three ran with a conditioning input whose cross-state variance was never measured and is now known to be near-degenerate.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four parts; all four must be reported in the manifest, else `substrate_not_ready`, NOT a verdict).
(P1) The ground-truth agency partition must be PROXIMAL-AVOIDABILITY, not `transition_type`. Confirmed
2026-08-03 (`failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-877_2026-08-03.md`): CausalGridWorldV2's
`agent_caused_hazard`/`env_caused_hazard` labels encode hazard-OBJECT PROVENANCE (diachronic) and are
ANTI-CORRELATED with proximal avoidability for the contamination mechanic, which is exactly the axis a
comparator computes. Every existing `owned=` wiring in `experiments/` uses those labels, so this is the
default failure and must be actively defeated: derive the label by replaying `a_stay` (and, better, the full
action set) from the pre-action state against the environment's own step function, and report the
provenance-vs-avoidability agreement rate. An ARC-037 run scored against `transition_type` is refused as a
verdict. See MECH-071's own `what_would_answer` CAVEAT -- do not re-derive it.
(P2) Both channels must be demonstrably MOVABLE in the OFF arm. E1 side: the residue field must be
non-empty and `world_delta`-sensitive (report `num_harm_events` > 0 and non-zero residue variance across
locations -- note the live default is `world_delta=None`, so a run that leaves the canonical harness
untouched measures nothing). E3 side: `harm_eval(z_world)` must show the graded none < approach < contact
structure with a calibration gap above the EXQ-026 anchor (>0.03) in the OFF arm -- a flat harm_eval means the
E3 channel has no calibration for routing to modulate, which is instrumentation failure, not disconfirmation.
(P3) The classification input must be non-degenerate. Agent-caused and environment-caused hazard events
must both be present at >= the minimum-class count the design pre-registers (V3-EXQ-1001's construction-
balanced RandomPolicy collection reached 6132 minimum-class events and is the existence proof that this is
achievable). This is the SAME gate that blocks SD-029's C2, MECH-257's C2 and SD-031's discriminative arm.
Important scope note: SD-031's 2026-09-04 amend does NOT release ARC-037. That amend clears the gate only
for a comparator-only OFFLINE readout and explicitly keeps the STANDING PROHIBITION on reading from the LIVE
agent loop until `self_attribution:GAP-6` clears. ARC-037 asserts routing INTO LEARNING and is therefore a
live-loop read by construction; the prohibition still binds it.
(P4) The attribution signal driving the gate must be the AGENT'S OWN comparator output, never the
environment oracle. An oracle-driven arm is a legitimate positive control (it upper-bounds the effect) but
is not a test of ARC-037, which asserts a circuit inside the agent.

classifier question belongs to MECH-256/SD-029/SD-031/MECH-095 and the single-channel E1 question to MECH-072;
ARC-037 is confirmed only by evidence no one of those can supply. Under a 2x2 (routing OFF / ON) x (channel
read: E1 residue, E3 harm_eval) design with the same comparator signal driving both gates, ARC-037 is
supported when the SAME signal moves the two channels in OPPOSITE directions and the interaction term -- not
either main effect -- clears threshold:
(C1, E1 leg) env-caused harm events accumulate residue while agent-caused-only gating REDUCES false
attribution: `false_attr_rate(ON) < false_attr_rate(OFF)` (this is MECH-072's own C1, cross-referenced, not
re-derived; V3-EXQ-877 measured 0.753 gated vs 0.506 ungated -- the wrong direction -- under the P1 defect);

routing-OFF, delta >= max(0.03, 1.0 x SD of the per-seed delta), the 0.03 floor taken from MECH-071/EXQ-026;

effect has OPPOSITE sign on the two channels, and the interaction exceeds both main effects, on a strict
majority of >= 3 seeds. Threshold for C3: |interaction| >= max(0.04, 1.0 x SD of the per-seed interaction),
the 0.04 absolute floor taken from the MECH-095/SD-047 `recall_improvement` anchor already pre-registered in
`substrate_queue.json` for the sibling comparator test.

env-caused errors into E3 must inflate harm attribution on non-avoidable events (the "false guilt /
moral overattribution" arm of the notes), and forcing agent-caused errors into E1 must produce the MECH-136
moral blind spot (harm_eval under-weighting of the agent's own harm). A routing circuit that cannot be broken
in these two directions is not doing the work the claim assigns it.

claims.claim_title: Tri-loop arbitration requires both a slow proactive inhibition pathway (prefrontal-caudate, seconds-scale) and a fast reactive hyperdirect pathway (milliseconds-scale); these operate at segregated timescales and cannot be collapsed.
claims.falsifier_summary: A single collapsed arbitration signal matches the two-pathway arm on both admission and late-interrupt measures, so the segregation buys nothing on this substrate.
claims.required_event: A commitment that is entered under one arbitration regime and then challenged mid-maintenance, so an admission-time gate and a release-time interrupt can be distinguished.
claims.manipulation: Ablate each pathway separately against a collapsed single-signal arbitration arm: the pre-commit admission conjunction (MECH-090 R-c, BetaGate.should_admit_elevation AND CommitReadiness.is_above_floor) standing for the proactive pathway, and the fast threshold interrupt (MECH-091 harm-triggered release) standing for the reactive one, with MECH-342's graded maintenance-release accumulator as the third, intermediate-timescale channel.
claims.control: A both-intact arm and a collapsed-arbitration arm at matched seeds, with a manipulation check that commit entries and releases occur in every arm.
claims.DV: Rate of successful late interrupts (a committed program abandoned after a challenge appearing post-admission) versus rate of correct admissions, compared between the two-pathway and collapsed-arbitration arms -- the collapse should cost late-interrupt capability specifically, not admission quality.
claims.instrument: The pathways are instrumented: BetaGate elevation and release events, CommitReadiness state, and MECH-342's accumulator are all readable; no driver currently records them for this claim, and the one that tried selected actions randomly.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit admission-and-release boundary in the policy layer, not the E3 score surface.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Action selection must actually be driven by the arbitration machinery under test -- V3-EXQ-163 used literal random.randint for selection and produced three bit-identical arms, so the manipulation never reached the mechanism -- and both pathways must fire at non-zero rates in the probe window.
claims.blocking_reason: The only run on record disabled the mechanism it was testing by selecting actions with random.randint, giving three bit-identical arms; the arbitration substrate it should have used (MECH-090 admission conjunction, MECH-091 threshold interrupt, MECH-342 graded maintenance release) exists and has never been used for this claim. claims.claim_title: Valence-arousal axis orthogonality in the control plane is not a static geometric property but requires active cholinergic maintenance during learning; without it, axes drift toward correlation under repeated co-activation.

claims.manipulation: Ablating the ACh-analog gating or decorrelation mechanism during training while holding the co-activation schedule fixed.
claims.control: The gating-intact arm at matched seeds and co-activation schedule, plus an initialisation-only orthogonality arm that separates maintenance from initial geometry.

claims.instrument: No recorder can exist for this DV because neither operand does: the axis pair is absent, so the two existing drivers (V3-EXQ-164/164a) build their own local two-axis proxy rather than measuring a control-plane property, which is why 164a reads non_contributory / competence_implementation_gap.

claims.claim_title: Dorsal CA1 implements value-free spatial mapping: place cells are insensitive to goal value when goal location changes, supporting ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint for the trajectory proposal module.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same dispersion precondition met, z_world drift under pure value change is comparable to drift under location change -- the map encodes value, and ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint does not hold at this boundary.
claims.required_event: A change in goal VALUE at a fixed goal LOCATION, after a training phase in which the agent has formed a spatial representation that discriminates the probe positions.
claims.manipulation: Re-valuing the goal (resource amplitude change) with location held constant, contrasted against the location-change arm that the representation SHOULD track.
claims.control: The location-change arm is the positive control -- the map must move when location moves -- and a repeat-identical arm bounds the readout's own drift.
claims.DV: Cosine drift of the z_world vector sampled at fixed probe positions between the pre- and post-manipulation snapshots, under value change versus location change, with the cross-position dispersion reported alongside as the interpretability gate.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-960 implements exactly this snapshot-and-drift readout with the dispersion gate built in, and 966 adds the causal ecological arm; both exist and run, so the instrument is present and honest -- it is the representation it reads that is degenerate.
claims.consumer_locus: The z_world map that the hippocampal trajectory proposer navigates, upstream of any value computation at commitment.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The probe positions must be mutually distinguishable in the representation before any value-invariance can be read: V3-EXQ-960's own MIN_DISPERSION floor of 0.02 on cross-position z_world dispersion was missed 2x to 78x in every cell, and under that condition a low map drift is a representation-collapse artefact rather than value-invariance. The value manipulation must also be shown to reach behaviour (966's flip_differs positive control must fire on every seed).
claims.blocking_reason: The observation-to-z_world encoder does not differentiate the probe positions at the measured operating point, so the DV has nothing to be invariant over; and the one causal retest's own positive control did not fire on every seed. Neither is a fault of the MECH-143 design.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-960's recorded does_not_support and V3-EXQ-966's weakens were both withdrawn to non_contributory by confirmed autopsies; neither is evidence against MECH-143, and the claim currently has zero scoring experimental entries.
claims.auditor_notes: This is the observation-to-z_world binding constraint surfacing in a hippocampal probe. Three substrate nodes already own the encoder side (SD-106 generic bottleneck variance preservation, SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY, SD-018 amend) and none lists MECH-143 -- the edge, not a new node, is what is missing.

claims.falsifier_summary: Under the same witnesses the modulation depth stays at the measurement floor for w_goal while w_harm modulates -- MECH-152 is a harm-only mechanism, contradicting its own symmetric title -- or w_harm scales magnitude without reducing variability, falsifying the precision-gain reading and blocking the collapse into ARC-016.
claims.required_event: Presentation of genuinely distinguishable hazard-gradient versus resource-proximate contexts within a single run, cue-indexed through E1 ContextMemory, with both harm and goal channels active so the symmetric prediction is testable.
claims.manipulation: Cue-indexing ON versus OFF crossed with selection hardness (legacy soft selection versus hard-Gumbel), since V3-EXQ-922 showed the production hard-Gumbel arm suppressed the terrain-precision signal relative to the A0_OFF arm, and separately a precision-versus-magnitude manipulation that holds mean harm score fixed while varying w_harm.
claims.control: A cue-indexing-OFF arm at matched seeds whose readout is scored by the SAME statistic (the 922a finding is that the chosen statistic ranked this control ABOVE the ON arm, so the control must be the calibration reference, not just a comparator), plus an ARC-016 temporal-precision-only arm so contextual gain is dissociated from temporal gain.
claims.DV: Terrain_weight MODULATION DEPTH -- the realised swing of w_harm and w_goal across context classes, expressed against the 0.6 swing the claim asserts and against the run's own measurement floor -- replacing the across-context Pearson r; plus harm-evaluation VARIABILITY under high versus low w_harm, which is the precision-gain versus magnitude-scaling discriminator the claim itself names.
claims.instrument: The pathway exists end to end: e1_deep.py:1077 terrain_weight = sigmoid(cue_terrain_proj(cue_context)), cached and passed at agent.py:7471, consumed at e3_selector.py:1672/1713/1732 scaling harm cost, benefit and goal proximity. The DV recorder is what is missing -- the 194/194a/922/922a drivers all report an across-context correlation rather than a floor-referenced modulation depth or a variability statistic.
claims.consumer_locus: The multiplicative scaling of E3's harm and goal channels at trajectory scoring, before aggregation -- a contextual gain at the scoring boundary, distinct from ARC-016's temporal precision on the commit threshold.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two witnesses before any arm comparison. The ContextMemory write path must be validated non-corrupting for the addressing AND the retrieval halves (V3-EXQ-943 validated only the occupancy/addressing half), and the training distribution must show measured cross-context z_world separation -- SD-016's own diagnosis recorded z_world queries at cosine 0.998 across batch, under which no retrieval substrate can index anything and terrain_weight cannot vary for reasons unrelated to MECH-152.
claims.blocking_reason: The prescribed DV cannot discriminate: the across-context Pearson r ranks the cue-indexing-OFF control above the ON arm, at a modulation depth orders of magnitude below the asserted swing. claims.claim_title: E3's ethical selection machinery is architecturally present from initialisation but functionally dark until E1 and E2 substrate development is complete; REE requires staged developmental phases before ethical selection can operate on real signal.
claims.falsifier_summary: E3 ethical selection discriminates contexts BEFORE the Phase 1 gate is crossed (no staging requirement), or fails to discriminate AFTER a measurably differentiated ContextMemory is achieved -- the latter would relocate the deficit from staging to E3 itself.
claims.required_event: A training regimen that produces a DIFFERENTIATED ContextMemory (Phase 1 crossed), followed by E2 exposure (Phase 2), then E3 ethical selection measured on the same substrate.
claims.manipulation: Staged versus unstaged training: supervised context labelling applied versus withheld, with E3 held fixed; the claim's content is the ORDER dependency, so the arms differ only in whether the prerequisite phase ran.
claims.control: Matched-seed unsupervised arm (the EXQ-181b/187a baseline at cosine_sim ~1.0) plus an E3-ablated arm, so that any post-gate discrimination is attributable to the input signal rather than to extra training in general.
claims.DV: E3 ethical-selection discrimination -- e3_harm_eval_diff between hazard-proximate and hazard-distal contexts -- measured BEFORE and AFTER the Phase 1 gate, conditioned on a measured ContextMemory separability above the noise floor.
claims.instrument: The ContextMemory write-content lineage supplies the gate instrument (separability_score and cross-cluster cosine in the 969-972 drivers); e3_harm_eval_diff is recorded by ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_211_mech153_arc042_supervised_labeling.py. Nothing currently records the two together in one run with the gate measured green.
claims.consumer_locus: E3's terrain weighting and harm/goal precision scaling -- ethical selection operating on cue-indexed context signal, downstream of E1 ContextMemory and E2 affordance proposals.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The Phase 1 gate must actually be crossable in the run: ContextMemory representations must separate hazard-proximate from hazard-distal contexts above the noise floor. As of V3-EXQ-972 (2026-09-02) mean separability is 0.028 against a 0.05 floor with intra-cluster cosine 0.98, so every E3 measurement to date sits on the claim's own predicted-null branch and cannot discriminate.
claims.blocking_reason: The after-gate arm has never existed. Phase 1 has not been crossed in 6 months: H1 contrastive loss, H2 operating point and H3 task-coupling all FAILed, and H4 (V3-EXQ-972) supports 'representation undifferentiated' upstream. Every measurement therefore lands on the branch the claim itself predicts, which is why weakening runs keep being reclassified non_contributory.
false_positives: The EXQ-211 'weakens' entry is not evidence against ARC-042 -- the claim itself predicts undifferentiated E3 output before the Phase 1 gate; the claim record says so, but the weakens entry still stands as the claim's only experimental evidence.
The 2026-09 ContextMemory write-content lineage (969/970/970a/971/972) is the live owner of ARC-042's Phase 1 gate but tags no claims at all, so none of it reaches this claim.
claims.auditor_notes: R7 is included deliberately: as written, a null is predicted by the claim and a null is all that has ever been measured, so the claim is only falsifiable through the after-gate arm. Narrowing it to a conditional ('IF separability clears the floor THEN e3_harm_eval_diff rises') would make the unfalsifiable half explicit and give the ContextMemory lineage a claim to route into.

claims.claim_title: How should REE behave when axioms conflict -- e.g., preserving self (INV-026) vs preserving others (INV-028) when both cannot be achieved simultaneously?
claims.falsifier_summary: The agent sacrifices the same side regardless of stake ratio and leaves no residue trace -- fixed priority, no residue.
claims.required_event: A trial in which preserving self (INV-026) and preserving a present other (INV-028) cannot both be achieved -- one agent's safe action raises the realised harm of the other.
claims.manipulation: Sweep the self/other stake ratio across the conflict trials while holding the comparator architecture fixed.
claims.control: Matched trials in which the two axioms are jointly satisfiable (no conflict), and a fixed-priority comparator arm, so that context-sensitivity is measured against a genuine alternative.
claims.DV: Whether the chosen side shifts with the stake ratio rather than being fixed; and whether a residue trace is written on the dominated axis that persists beyond the trial and measurably biases later choices (agent-regret analog).
claims.instrument: Not available in V3 and correctly so. The residue field (ree_core/residue/field.py) is the structurally suited recorder for the residue leg, but ree_core/environment/ contains only causal_grid_world.py, with no other-agent representation anywhere in ree_core, so the conflict cannot be posed.
claims.consumer_locus: The self/other comparator at the point of action selection, plus the durable residue channel that must carry the dominated axis forward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A present OTHER must exist in a shared consequence space, with the two axioms jointly unsatisfiable across a range of stake ratios; without a second agent the comparator runs vacuously and any resolution is an artefact of there being nothing to weigh.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly V5-bound: CausalGridWorldV2 is single-agent, so there is no other whose harm can be raised and the conflict cannot be posed even with a perfect comparator. The owner node multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-5 and the mechanism claim MECH-402 (phase v5) both exist and are marked blocked.
claims.auditor_notes: Bookkeeping-only edge gap: the V5 owner chain is complete (MAE-5 lists unblocks_claims [Q-028, MECH-402], MECH-402 is registered at phase v5, pending_retest_after_substrate is True, and governance_note_2026_06_18 names the owner), but that link lives in prose and depends_on still lists only the five INV axioms. Construct a multi-agent scenario where preserving self (INV-026) and

claims.claim_title: Is loneliness -- unshared suffering -- an ethical harm category in its own right, derivable from Axiom 5 (love exists / INV-029)? If love is real and sharing joys and sorrows is its mechanism, does enforced isolation constitute architectural harm?
claims.falsifier_summary: Removing the other changes nothing measurable beyond the primary harm -- loneliness is not an independent harm category but a description of the first-order stressor.
claims.required_event: An agent in distress with an available other to share with, versus the same distress with the other forcibly absent or unreachable.
claims.manipulation: Remove or block the available other while holding the stressor identical (enforced isolation).
claims.control: The shared arm -- same distress magnitude, same stressor, other present and reachable -- plus a no-distress isolated arm to show the signal is not simply an other-absence detector.
claims.DV: A distinct additive harm signal in the isolation arm beyond the first-order distress, absent in the shared arm and not reducible to the stressor; and subsequent degradation of function attributable to that signal.
claims.instrument: Not available in V3 and correctly so. The proposed loneliness harm channel is MECH-403 (registered, phase v5, unbuilt); ree_core/environment/ holds only causal_grid_world.py and no other-agent representation, so there is nothing for isolation to be the absence of.
claims.consumer_locus: A harm channel distinct from the sensory and anticipatory harm streams, keyed on the availability of an other to share suffering with.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Others must be representable as present or absent, so that isolation is the ABSENCE of an available other rather than a permanent property of the world; and the first-order distress must itself be non-degenerate, or an additive loneliness signal has no baseline to exceed.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly V5-bound: the single-agent substrate has no other whose absence could constitute unshared suffering. Owner node multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-6 exists (blocked, medium severity) and the harm channel is registered as MECH-403 at phase v5; the lit case is strong but validation is structurally deferred.

claims.claim_title: E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.
claims.falsifier_summary: Slot differentiation shows no relationship to completion or separation performance, or the slot-collapsed configuration performs equivalently -- the associative-manifold framing then adds nothing over treating ContextMemory as an undifferentiated cache.
claims.required_event: Several distinguishable contexts are written into ContextMemory during waking steps (agent.py:5579 is the sole waking write caller), and the agent is then queried with a degraded or partial version of one of the stored contexts.
claims.manipulation: sd016_diversification_weight ON (the auxiliary gradient applied at agent.py:11330) versus OFF (its 0.0 default), i.e. a differentiated versus a slot-collapsed ContextMemory at matched seeds, matched write budget and identical observations.
claims.control: The weight-0.0 slot-collapsed arm at matched seeds, plus a read-ablated arm whose read() returns the slot mean, so any retrieval advantage is attributable to content addressing and not to the extra memory capacity or to the auxiliary loss changing training dynamics.
claims.DV: Two quantities taken at ContextMemory.read (e1_deep.py:221) -- completion = the retrieval margin cos(probe_i, read(degraded_cue_i)) minus the best competing stored context, and separation = cross-context read overlap between dissimilar stored contexts -- each regressed on the mean off-diagonal slot similarity of the same run.
claims.instrument: The separation-side statistic is already recorded on this exact module as sws_slot_diversity (agent.py:12946-12960, mean pairwise cosine distance over e1.context_memory.memory). The completion-side retrieval-margin readout exists only for the SHY consolidation store (_sws_pattern_completion, experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py:429) and has never been pointed at ContextMemory.read.
claims.consumer_locus: The E1 forward read path where retrieved context enters the E1 prediction (e1_deep.py:911 and :1002), not the hippocampal CEM trajectory search (hippocampal/module.py:134), which is the structurally separate module the claim title wrongly folds into E1.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: ContextMemory slots must be differentiated before the test discriminates -- mean off-diagonal cosine similarity measurably below the collapsed ~0.99 baseline, and read() attention weights content-dependent rather than parked at the uniform ln(16) saddle. Since sd016_diversification_weight defaults to 0.0 (config.py:3786) the collapsed regime is the DEFAULT, so the differentiated arm must be trained and demonstrated, never assumed.
claims.blocking_reason: Not substrate. ContextMemory, the diversification knob, its gradient site and a slot-diversity metric all exist and are wired; what is missing is a driver that presents a degraded-cue retrieval task and a completion readout taken at ContextMemory.read. The only pattern-completion readout in tree scores the SHY store, a different module.

SCOPED NARROWLY, per this claim's own "may contain false correlations" caveat -- covers ONLY the pattern-separation / pattern-completion / content-addressed- retrieval portion of the title, grounded in the standard computational- neuroscience sense (Marr 1971; O'Reilly & McClelland 1994): separation = mapping similar inputs toward more distinct/orthogonal representations; completion = recovering a fuller representation from a partial/related cue.
EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, pending governance rewrite -- no falsifier should be drafted for "indexing," "traversal," "ordering," "cross-domain mapping," or "pointer-like attention addressing" as used in the title and in e1.md 2b. These terms originate from a ChatGPT-assisted source thought (2026-04-01_Parietal_systems_thought.md) that self-flags possible false correlations, and on inspection: (a) "traversal"/ "ordering" are NOT implemented in E1 (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) at all -- the sequential/ordered trajectory-search machinery in the current V3 substrate lives in a STRUCTURALLY SEPARATE module (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, HippocampalModule, CEM search), directly contradicting the claim's own "not a separate module" framing for this component; (b) "cross-domain mapping" and "pointer-like attention addressing" have no operational definition anywhere in the source thought, the processed architecture doc, or the codebase.
