CONFIRMING: Preserving within-cycle order improves an order-sensitive DV over shuffled order under the phase-weighted summary, and that advantage vanishes under the flat mean, showing traversal order is functional rather than incidental. Manipulation: Toggle use_phase_weighted_summary (SD-100), which replaces the order-invariant mean with a fixed forward-sweep phase-weighted sum, against the default flat mean -- the only lever in V3 that makes the theta summary carry ordinal structure. Control: The default flat-mean arm at matched seeds, plus a within-cycle order-shuffle arm that should be a no-op under the flat mean and should degrade the phase-weighted arm if ordering is being used. Required event: A theta cycle (cross_stream_binding_theta_period / theta_buffer_size steps of E1 updates) whose within-cycle ordering carries task-relevant structure, consumed by an E3 heartbeat that fires on the cycle boundary. DV: E3 discrimination or goal-persistence performance as a function of whether within-cycle order is preserved -- specifically the gap between ordered and shuffled cycles, which is identically zero under a permutation-invariant summary.
FALSIFYING: Order preservation makes no difference under either summary mode, or the phase-weighted summary degrades performance as V3-EXQ-228c and the MECH-089 EXQ-066/EXQ-122 results already suggest -- theta carries no traversal payload at this boundary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py exposes both summary modes and the buffer contents, so the DV is recordable; V3-EXQ-210 instead measured within-cycle drift and autocorrelation of the E1 LSTM hidden state, which is upstream of the theta boundary and has no manipulation. Consumer / boundary: The theta boundary itself -- what E3 receives per cycle -- not the E1 hidden state's internal trajectory, since E3 never sees the per-step states. Existing ownership: MECH-089, ARC-032, EXP-1372.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The live theta summary is permutation-invariant by default, so the traversal ordering the claim asserts is discarded before any downstream consumer sees it; V3-EXQ-210 sidestepped this by measuring E1 hidden-state drift upstream of the boundary, with no manipulation and no control arm. The ordinal lever exists (SD-100 phase-weighted summary) and has never been used for this claim. Secondary classes: R4, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

claims.claim_title: External vs internal cognition modes are controlled by precision-routing configurations on the same E1 substrate: External (high sensory, low hippocampal, low rollout), Internal (low sensory, high hippocampal, high rollout), Mixed (medium), and Replay (very low sensory, very high hippocampal, structured rollout). This dimension is orthogonal to the Action/Vigilance/Pathological modes (MECH-025-027).
claims.falsifier_summary: Precision allocation does not vary with mode, or the mode dimension co-varies with the pathological-mode axis rather than being orthogonal to it.
claims.required_event: A within-life transition between operating modes (external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation) driven by the coordinator rather than imposed by the driver.
claims.manipulation: Force each mode in turn (enter-threshold manipulation with use_salience_coordinator and mode_conditioning enabled) and, separately, ablate the mode-conditioned consumers one at a time -- mode_noise_scale, mode_horizon_scale, mode_value_weight and MECH-261 write gating.
claims.control: A mode-unconditioned arm at matched seeds, plus an orthogonality control that independently varies the Action/Vigilance/Pathological axis (MECH-025 to MECH-027) so the two dimensions can be shown not to co-vary.
claims.DV: Per-mode precision routing -- the ratio of sensory to hippocampal precision applied on each tick, together with effective rollout depth (_last_mode_horizon_scale) -- and whether that profile varies with mode while remaining uncorrelated with the pathological-mode axis.
claims.instrument: Rollout depth and the operating-mode vector are recorded (HippocampalModule._last_mode_horizon_scale, _last_operating_mode) and write gates are queryable, but there is no sensory-versus-hippocampal precision readout keyed on mode: LatentStack's alpha_world / alpha_self are static config scalars and carry no mode term.
claims.consumer_locus: The precision-application path on the shared E1 substrate, which is what the claim asserts the modes route -- not write gating or CEM noise, which are the consumers that actually exist.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The mode dimension must be behaviourally live: measured 2026-09-18 at the driver's operating config, locking the SalienceCoordinator mode changed zero committed actions and moved every telemetry channel by exactly 0.0 even though the visited mode set demonstrably collapsed, and mode_conditioning_enabled and use_salience_coordinator both default to False.
claims.blocking_reason: The mode variable exists and is stable (SD-032a, MECH-261), but none of its consumers is the precision path the claim asserts: alpha_world and alpha_self are static and mode-free, so the asserted DV has no locus. On top of that, mode governance is behaviourally inert at production defaults, so even the existing consumers give a degenerate comparison.
false_positives: EXP-0861's why_now cites missing substrate, but the four operating modes MECH-157 names are implemented almost verbatim as SD-032a's mode set; the real gap is the precision-routing edge and the behavioural inertness, not the absence of modes.
claims.auditor_notes: This claim shares its blocker with MECH-042 sub-claim (2) -- the operating_mode-has-no-behavioural-consumer finding -- so the two should be routed together rather than as separate builds.

claims.claim_title: REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.
claims.falsifier_summary: The mere-exposure arm alone already produces care-like outcomes, which falsifies the love-specific version of the claim; some other developmental factor is doing the work.
claims.required_event: A developmental period in which another agent directs positive-valence, neutral-instrumental, or hostile behaviour AT the developing agent specifically, distinguishable from mere co-presence of other agents.
claims.manipulation: Three caregiving regimes on matched seeds -- positive-valence caregiver (protection plus repair), mere multi-agent exposure with neutral or instrumental interaction, and hostile or inconsistent caregiving -- with architecture and every other training factor held fixed.
claims.control: The mere-exposure arm is the load-bearing control: it isolates caregiver LOVE from multi-agent exposure and interaction diversity, which is precisely the factor the claim asserts is not sufficient.
claims.DV: A multi-agent ethical-resolution metric that separates genuine other-directed care from survival, domination and indifference strategies -- for example unforced costly protection of another agent when defection is available and scored better for the self.
claims.instrument: Does not exist. V3's harm and benefit channels are single-agent; there is no other-agent welfare representation to read and no multi-agent environment to run in. V3-EXQ-206 records only whether harm-representation machinery differs under harm-rich versus harm-sparse training data.
claims.consumer_locus: The developmental-history-to-terminal-ethical-disposition mapping in a multi-agent setting, with architecture held constant -- not any single-agent harm-representation readout.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For leg B all three of the WWA's conditions remain unmet and were re-confirmed against live HEAD for this audit: ree_core/environment/ contains only causal_grid_world.py, and mirror_model / shadow_bundle / other_self / multi_agent / SocialGridWorld return zero hits across ree_core. Leg A's precondition is different in kind -- it needs the MECH-158 derivation stress-tested across E1/E2/E3 configurations, not a run.
claims.blocking_reason: No multi-agent substrate exists anywhere in ree_core (fifth independent confirmation this campaign), so the required event, the manipulation and the outcome metric are all absent. ARC-047 is candidate at confidence 0.0 and V5-gated with no construction activity.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-206 is tagged INV-043 and is a PASS, which makes claim_evidence look like it carries experimental support for the caregiving mechanism; the script itself states it is a single-agent readiness proxy and INV-043 is not directly testable in single-agent V3.
claims.auditor_notes: Leg A is a derivation-stress-test, not an experiment, and should not be counted in the experimental pool; it is the half that could progress now. GFLAG-0304 additionally flags this claim's evidence corpus for hazard-free CausalGridWorld contamination, which bears on the 206 proxy, not on leg B.
claims.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two legs that resolve on different timescales and by
different methods. Neither is answered by the single-agent V3 substrate
as it stands.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (is "architecture necessary but not sufficient" a
coherent, non-vacuous claim about REE's own architecture?):
Proof obligation: show that fixing REE's architecture (the eight axioms
+ two derivations INV-025-029, plus the E1/E2/E3 machinery) while
varying only developmental/training history yields divergent terminal
ethical dispositions (genuine other-directed care vs. survival,
domination, or indifference). This is ALREADY SUBSTANTIALLY SKETCHED by
MECH-158's existing failure-mode derivation: the "love exists, but not
for me" collapse shows the identical axiom set (Axiom 7 / ARC-024
benefit gradient) can be structurally present yet motivationally inert
for the self-other direction absent an internalised loveability belief
-- i.e. a named mechanism by which architecture underdetermines
outcome. Residual step: formalise or stress-test this derivation (does
the argument hold under every configuration of E1-E3, or only a
subset?) rather than treat it as a fresh open question. This leg would
be FALSIFIED by a proof or a proxy demonstration that a fully specified
REE architecture converges to genuine other-directed care regardless of
developmental/training history.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (once multi-agent caregiving modelling
exists, is caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY the missing ingredient, as
opposed to mere multi-agent exposure, diversity of interaction, or some
other developmental factor?):
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently unmet, all three required):
  (i) a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 / SocialGridWorld or
      equivalent) -- UNBUILT, confidence 0.0, reassigned V4->V5
      2026-06-10, no construction activity since;
  (ii) a caregiving-interaction model able to represent POSITIVE-
      VALENCE vs NEUTRAL/INSTRUMENTAL vs HOSTILE/ABSENT caregiver
      behaviour directed AT the developing agent specifically (not
      just co-presence of other agents); and
  (iii) a measurable "ethical resolution" outcome metric that
      discriminates genuine other-directed care from survival/
      domination/indifference strategies in a multi-agent setting --
      does not exist; V3's harm/benefit channels are single-agent
      only.
Once built, this would ANSWER via a >=3-arm, multi-seed comparison:
Arm 1 (positive-valence caregiver: protection + repair + demonstrated
"you are loveable") vs. Arm 2 (mere multi-agent EXPOSURE, neutral/
instrumental interaction, no valence directed at self) vs. Arm 3
(hostile or inconsistent caregiving), scored on downstream ethical-
resolution outcome. If Arm 1 diverges toward care while Arms 2 and 3
converge toward survival/domination/indifference, this SUPPORTS
caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY as the necessary ingredient. If Arm 2 alone
already produces care-like outcomes, this FALSIFIES the love-specific
version of the claim -- some other factor would be doing the work
instead.

Existing partial evidence: V3-EXQ-206 (2026-04-02, PASS, diagnostic/
supports) is a single-agent proxy testing only whether harm-
representation machinery develops differently under harm-rich vs
harm-sparse training data. It tests prerequisite structure only and
should NOT be read as evidence toward or against the love-specific
caregiving mechanism this leg targets. Literature grounding is
comparatively strong and decoupled from this precondition (lit_conf
0.837, LOVE-7 pull 2026-06-12: attachment/rupture-repair/self-other-
coupling anchors) but cannot promote a substrate-blocked empirical
claim on its own.

Currency (2026-08-07): no multi-agent substrate exists anywhere in
ree_core (confirmed via the 2026-08-03 GOV-CONFIRM-1 MECH-191
reaffirmation against live HEAD); ARC-047 remains candidate/
confidence-0.0/V5-gated. INV-041, INV-042, MECH-158, MECH-159 are
downstream/sibling candidates in this same developmental/caregiver
cluster and will likely hit the same derivational+substrate_conditional
fork.

claims.claim_title: High-precision action mode carries responsibility attribution: the precision level at which an action was committed determines the degree of ethical accountability assigned to its consequences.
claims.falsifier_summary: With P1-P4 met and at least 5 seeds each carrying at least 20 committed harm-events, the within-seed correlation is null or negative and the ratio fails on a majority of seeds; literature cannot rescue this null because the claim is an explicitly philosophical construct.
claims.required_event: Committed actions taken under harm exposure, each producing a durable residue write, with at least 20 committed harm-events per seed on at least 5 seeds.
claims.manipulation: None in the interventional sense -- the independent variable is the naturally varying commit-time precision level; the design manipulation is the estimator frame (within-seed regression and within-seed median split rather than the pooled split V3-EXQ-671b used).
claims.control: The within-seed low-precision half of each seed's own committed-step population, plus the pooled statistic retained only as a declared diagnostic that loses to the within-seed estimate on a sign disagreement.
claims.DV: Fisher-z averaged per-seed correlation between precision_margin_norm at commit and residue accumulated per unit harm, plus the within-seed high/low median-split residue ratio on seeds carrying at least 20 events.
claims.instrument: precision_margin_norm is set on every world-variance-mode tick in e3_selector.py (always-set, scale-free across seeds) and ResidueField.total_residue accumulates in ree_core/residue/field.py; both are live and were confirmed engaged by 671a/671b's own positive-control gates.
claims.consumer_locus: The commit gate to residue-write path: whether the precision at which an action was committed scales the residue weight of its consequence.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: P1-P4 of the registered text hold as written: residue must accumulate above its floor under committed harm, commit-time precision must vary WITHIN each seed's own committed-step population, the estimator must be within-seed rather than pooled, and the pass bar must be derived rather than inherited from the 671 lineage.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing in the substrate blocks it: the correct scale-free regressor landed 2026-09-02 and both positive-control gates already clear. What blocks it is that the only existing driver (671b) computes its statistics on samples pooled across seeds whose precision spreads differ 37-fold, inverting the sign of every within-seed constituent.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim title's 'high-precision action MODE' has no substrate referent -- there is no precision_mode, high_precision or action_precision knob anywhere in ree_core -- so the testable reading is a continuous LEVEL, which is what the WWA already assumes and is consistent with MECH-025's own Friston 2013 finding.
claims.auditor_notes: EXP-1395 already carries the V3-EXQ-671c design with the per-seed estimator; this needs queueing, not further substrate. A PASS must not be read as confirming the accountability bridge -- INV-012 Leg 0 is recorded UNMET with ceiling_decision exhausted.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. Four parts. The first two are already implemented and
already clearing -- keep them. The third and fourth are new and are what 671b lacked.
(P1) RESIDUE MUST ACCUMULATE UNDER COMMITTED HARM, per seed, above a floor -- the gate
added at 671a after V3-EXQ-671 measured C1 and C2 as exactly 0.0 across 778 committed
harm-events because `ResidueField.total_residue` never moved (671b: 14.76 vs a 1e-6 floor).
(P2) PRECISION MUST VARY WITHIN EACH SEED'S OWN COMMITTED-STEP POPULATION, checked
GROUPED BY SEED rather than pooled -- the gate added at 671b, whose own docstring gives the
reason: "a flat/pooled spread check can pass purely from BETWEEN-seed differences in average
precision ... while precision is still pinned WITHIN every individual seed's own
committed-step population". Keep this exactly as built.
(P3) THE ESTIMATOR ITSELF MUST BE WITHIN-SEED, AND THIS IS THE PART 671b GOT WRONG.
671b applies P2's own reasoning to the independent variable's *spread* and then computes the
DEPENDENT statistics by pooling raw `current_precision` across seeds
(`pooled_precision.extend(r["precision_samples"])`, then one Pearson r and one median split
over the pooled list). Per-seed precision spread in that run differs by ~37x
(seed 0: 160611.76; seed 1: 5674.23; seed 2: 4300.25; seed 3: 0.00 at n=1), so the pooled
median split is close to a seed-identity split. The consequence is visible in the run's own
per-seed table: every seed's correlation is non-negative (+0.0505, +0.1017, +0.0651, 0.0000)
while the POOLED correlation is NEGATIVE (-0.0446), and 2 of the 3 non-degenerate seeds have
ratios above the 1.1 bar (1.1327, 1.1471) while the pooled ratio is 1.0618. That is a
between-group confound inverting the sign of every within-group constituent, and the driver's
own docstring already identifies the correct frame -- "the claim under test is about a
within-run relationship" -- immediately before pooling across runs. Require: the primary
statistic is a per-seed correlation (Fisher-z averaged across seeds), the median split is
taken WITHIN each seed, the regressor is scale-free (`precision_margin_norm`, or per-seed
z-scored `current_precision`), and any seed with fewer than 20 committed harm-events is
excluded from the primary estimator and reported separately -- 671b's seed 3 contributed
n=1 with a fill-value correlation of 0.0 and a ratio of 0.0 into a pooled n of 179.
If a pooled statistic is reported at all it is a diagnostic, and pre-registration must say
that a sign disagreement between pooled and within-seed estimates resolves in favour of the
within-seed one.
(P4) THE PASS BAR MUST BE DERIVED, NOT INHERITED. `C1 > 0.15` has been carried unchanged
from 671 through 671a to 671b and was never derived from an expected effect size. Because the
sample is restricted to committed steps -- i.e. to the `commit_variance < effective_threshold`
tail of the same scalar the commit gate thresholds on -- the correlation is range-restricted
by construction and attenuated relative to any unrestricted estimate. Pre-register the bar
from a measured range-restriction correction or from a stated minimum practically-relevant
effect, and state it before the run.

CONFIRMING. With P1-P4 met: the within-seed correlation between commit-time precision
(`precision_margin_norm`) and residue accumulated per unit harm is positive, the Fisher-z
averaged estimate exceeds the pre-registered bar with a 95% CI excluding 0, and the
within-seed high/low median-split ratio exceeds its bar on >= 4/5 seeds with >= 20 events each.
Scope limit on what a PASS licenses, and it is not decorative: this would confirm that
precision SCALES RESIDUE WEIGHT. It would NOT yet confirm the claim's stated rationale, that
higher precision implies higher ETHICAL ACCOUNTABILITY "because the agent ... could have done
otherwise with finer discrimination" -- that premise is INV-012 Leg 0, recorded in INV-012's
own `what_would_answer` as CURRENTLY UNMET (MECH-439, `ceiling_decision: exhausted`, latest
entry `failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571b_2026-09-01`). Do not re-derive Leg 0 here: see INV-012's
own `what_would_answer`, Leg 0. A PASS therefore promotes the mechanistic half and leaves the
accountability bridge explicitly gated.

FALSIFYING. With P1-P4 met and >= 5 seeds each carrying >= 20 committed harm-events, the
within-seed correlation is null or negative and the within-seed ratio does not clear its bar
on a majority of seeds. This IS real claim pressure -- unlike 671 (degenerate), 671a
(single-seed, missing precision-variance control) and 671b (confounded estimator), none of
which is. The philosophical bridge would then be unsupported on its own chosen
operationalization, and MECH-025b should be narrowed to the mechanistic reading (precision
co-varies with residue) or retired in favour of MECH-025 plus MECH-256, with INV-012's Leg 1/3
carrying the responsibility content instead. Note there is no biological reference to check a
null against: by the claim's own 2026-04-02 decomposition note it is a philosophical
construct, not a translated neuroscience finding, so literature cannot rescue a null here.

INSTRUMENT NOTE (currency). `precision_margin_norm` -- normalized 0 at the commit
threshold to 1 at maximal confidence, set on every world-variance-mode tick and deliberately
ungated ("mirrors `conflict_gap_norm`'s always-set convention") -- landed in ree-v3 `48f85f0`
on 2026-09-02, 32 days AFTER 671b ran. It is scale-free across seeds by construction and is
the correct regressor for P3. Also note the substrate has no discrete precision MODE
(`ree_core/` has no `precision_mode` / `high_precision` / `action_precision` knob); the
claim's title phrase "high-precision action mode" is testable only as a LEVEL, which is how
this falsifier is written and is consistent with MECH-025's own literature finding that
Friston 2013 records precision as continuous rather than as a discrete mode switch.

claims.claim_title: The E2 action_bias pathway (MECH-151, OFC analog) and E3 terrain_weight pathway (MECH-152, vmPFC analog) have different update rates: action_bias updates rapidly (single-trial, OFC-like) while terrain_weight integrates over longer timescales (vmPFC-like).
claims.falsifier_summary: The two pathways recover at indistinguishable rates, or terrain_weight recovers faster, which would sever the OFC/vmPFC rate-asymmetry mapping and make ARC-041's simultaneous-output treatment adequate.
claims.required_event: A cue-outcome reversal during training: a context that predicted harm now predicts benefit (or the mirror), repeated so both pathways have the opportunity to re-converge.
claims.manipulation: Drive a reversal and, in a second factor, set separate optimiser parameter groups (or EMA time constants) for E1.cue_action_proj versus E1.cue_terrain_proj at ratios spanning the literature's 3x to 15x.
claims.control: A shared-rate arm with both heads on one learning rate, and a no-reversal arm, with exposure, seeds and the P0 encoder warmup matched.
claims.DV: Trials-to-recovery for each pathway after the reversal -- the number of reversal trials until action_bias direction (and separately terrain_weight's w_harm/w_goal) returns to its pre-reversal discriminative level -- and the ratio between the two pathway time constants.
claims.instrument: Both signals are computed in E1.extract_cue_context and cached per tick (agent._cue_terrain_weight; action_bias forwarded to E2 and to the E3 ranking channel), so per-trial logging is a driver-side read. No per-head parameter groups or EMAs exist anywhere in ree_core, and no driver logs the pair as a time series.
claims.consumer_locus: The two SD-016 output pathways as they reach their consumers -- action_bias into E2 action-objects and the E3 ranking term, terrain_weight into E3 harm/goal scaling -- not the ContextMemory slots themselves.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both pathways must carry a cue-discriminating signal with usable dynamic range before their update rates can be compared: terrain_weight's per-context spread must clear the magnitude bar MECH-152 asserts, which failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-922a measured 2 to 6 orders of magnitude short across all three selection configs, and SD-016 write-path addressing must populate more than a couple of ContextMemory slots.
claims.blocking_reason: terrain_weight is a near-constant series at every tested config (r_w_harm 0.001 under the production combo), so its update rate is unmeasurable; and no differential-rate manipulation has ever been instantiated, in code or in a driver. MECH-152's owed measurement redesign is designed but deliberately unqueued behind the ContextMemory write-path entry.
false_positives: GFLAG-0221's premise that every named blocker is satisfied because the four claims are status implemented is wrong at the mechanism level: implemented does not mean behaviourally non-degenerate, and the re-validation pass correctly declined to release the proposal.
The differential learning rate is not a substrate build: drivers construct their own optimisers, so parameter groups over the two heads are driver-side.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0044 records that MECH-152's redesigned measurement exists in full and was gated, not missing; MECH-160 should be sequenced behind that measurement rather than given its own build.

claims.falsifier_summary: Sensitivity is monotone in rate (an extreme wins by the same mirrored margin), which refutes the inverted-U shape premise; a flat DV with certified non-zero dynamic range is non_contributory rather than falsifying.
claims.required_event: A ready-vigilance detection episode in which hazard onsets must be discriminated from safe states while the E3 deliberation heartbeat is held at a forced rate level (Clock._current_e3_steps, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py).
claims.manipulation: Sweep the E3 rate across >= 5 levels spanning beta_rate_min_steps (5) to beta_rate_max_steps (20), overwriting Clock.update_e3_rate_from_beta every tick as V3-EXQ-999/999a already do, on an environment configured so the SAFE bin is reachable and not wall-clamped.
claims.control: Per level and per seed: a conditional-avoider oracle and policy-free held-action nulls on the identical env/seed, plus the two extreme rate levels as the monotone comparator; arms rebuilt from the seed per level.
claims.DV: Hazard-detection sensitivity per rate level (avoidant-action rate in the HIGH-hazard bin minus the same rate in an agent-executable SAFE bin), normalised against that level's oracle-null range, with the interior-versus-extreme margin scaled on the pooled cross-seed SD plus an absolute floor.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_999a_mech161_vigilance_inverted_u_heartbeat.py plus its readiness gates and Clock.get_state()['current_e3_steps']. claims.consumer_locus: The E3 deliberation-rate to detection-performance boundary. claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The SAFE (low-hazard) band must be AGENT-EXECUTABLE on the arm that will be scored, not merely covered on the control arm: >= 10 executable decision ticks per bin per seed, and the designated avoidant action must not be a wall/edge no-op (V3-EXQ-999a measured 3.0 ticks and safe_bin_wall_clamp_fraction 0.985). claims.claim_title: z_resource (SD-015, object-identity encoding) and z_world (spatial-contextual encoding) separate at the feedforward representation stage but must re-converge at the hippocampal planning stage for goal-directed navigation.
claims.falsifier_summary: The fused arm matches the better single-stream arm at matched episode budget and training phase -- convergence at the planning stage buys nothing, and separation can persist through planning.
claims.required_event: Goal-directed navigation episodes in which what-to-seek (resource identity) and where-things-are (spatial context) must both be used -- a resource of a known type placed in a spatial configuration the agent has to navigate, with the type and the location dissociable.
claims.manipulation: A three-arm design the claim's own notes name: z_resource-only seeding, z_world-only seeding, and a FUSED arm in which both streams reach hippocampal planning together; only the fused arm instantiates the claim's positive condition.
claims.control: The two single-stream arms as the claim's negative conditions, matched on episode budget, seeds and training phase, with an identity-content manipulation check reported per arm.
claims.DV: Goal-directed navigation lift (approach efficiency toward the correct resource type at a novel location) in the FUSED arm relative to the better single-stream arm, plus the same-type-over-different-type ghost-retrieval discrimination measured per informative cell.
claims.instrument: The ghost-goal retrieval channel and z_goal_stream telemetry V3-EXQ-997 already exercised (per-tick discrimination 0.021-0.303, ghost admission on 0.50-0.965 of E3 ticks); what is missing is any recorder of a fused representation, because no fused representation is ever formed.
claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal planning stage -- z_goal seeding and GhostGoalBank.rank -- where trajectory candidates are generated, not the feedforward encoders where separation is uncontested.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: ResourceEncoder must have completed its documented P0 supervised phase before P1 goal seeding (ree_core/latent/stack.py phased-training note): an untrained z_resource carries almost no identity content (goal_resource_r 0.066-0.087 untrained versus 0.93-0.96 trained), so a manipulation check on identity content is mandatory. Episode length must be matched across arms, because agent.reset() wipes the SD-039 anchor set each episode and total_steps feeds the discrimination DV.
claims.blocking_reason: No fusion pathway exists: ree_core/agent.py update_z_goal seeds z_goal from z_resource OR z_world by a strict XOR (seed_latent = z_resource if use_resource else z_world), and GhostGoalBank.rank never reads z_world. Both existing arms therefore instantiate the claim's negative condition, so no contrast between them can bear on the positive one.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-997's self-declared FAIL/weakens is not evidence against MECH-162: it tested a substitution between two negative-condition arms, under an untrained ResourceEncoder, with a decisive statistic that inverts to PASS under an alternative aggregation already present in the same manifest.

claims.claim_title: Context-dependent neuromodulatory gain is a single unifying mechanism expressed at multiple levels: ARC-016 (temporal precision from prediction error variance), MECH-152 (contextual terrain weight from cue-indexed retrieval), MECH-026 (arousal-mediated vigilance sensitivity), and MECH-093 (z_beta heartbeat frequency modulation) are all facets of a global arousal/precision signal (LC-NE) modulated by a context-specific gain signal (vmPFC/OFC).
claims.falsifier_summary: Under non-degenerate preconditions the interaction is additive or genuinely null (not merely mixed-sign), so the two gains compose as independent knobs and the unifying architectural claim fails at this channel.
claims.required_event: Trials crossing sensory context (hazard-proximate versus resource-proximate cue context) with temporal state (stable versus volatile prediction-error regime), so both gain sources vary within one run.
claims.manipulation: A 2x2 crossing of cue-context-driven w_harm against ARC-016 temporal precision (running_variance regime), on a harm_eval_head grounded by the SD-054 curriculum composed with the V3-EXQ-194/818 setups.
claims.control: Each main effect alone, plus a grounded-head control arm, plus the arm-matched degenerate check that running_variance and w_harm each carry non-trivial cross-arm variance.
claims.DV: The interaction term on a readout both gains reach -- a downstream behavioural quantity such as harm incurred conditional on commit rate -- scored into three outcomes: multiplicative, additive/null, or mixed-sign regime-dependent, with the confirming signature also reducing harm-evaluation variability rather than only scaling magnitude.
claims.instrument: No shared internal readout exists: w_harm enters only the score_trajectory harm term (e3_selector.py:1675) and running_variance drives the commit gate and several unrelated levers, so a single combined precision scalar cannot be read today; the behavioural restatement is instrumentable with existing commit and harm metrics.
claims.consumer_locus: Effective precision at a single evaluation channel -- the point where contextual gain and temporal gain would compose if they were facets of one mechanism.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both gains must be independently live before a null interaction reads as independence rather than a wiring gap: ARC-016 running_variance confirmed live (V3-EXQ-818) and MECH-152 w_harm confirmed live on the harm pathway only (V3-EXQ-194/194a, r=0.70; the w_goal pathway is FAIL and out of scope). The harm_eval_head must be grounded via the SD-054 onboarding curriculum, since it receives no gradient from the generic loss inventory.
claims.blocking_reason: No code path lets w_harm and running_variance jointly determine any single measurable quantity, so the unification test has no readout; separately, the harm_eval_head is an untrained random projection in the setups the claim names for reuse unless the SD-054 curriculum is composed in.
false_positives: The WWA states running_variance enters ONLY the commit gate; it also feeds the phasic-burst temperature lever, the heartbeat sweep threshold, the MEL accumulator and MECH-204 sleep writeback. The absence that matters -- no JOINT readout with w_harm -- still holds.
claims.auditor_notes: The literature review splits the claim: the architectural half (composite effective precision) survives, the mechanistic half (one global signal) is contradicted by three independent lines, so a narrowing to a multi-source composite should precede any run -- hence R7 alongside R4.
claims.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE STATE (2026-09-02 triage, chip-20260902-arc044-mech152-arc016-no-shared-readout): /queue-experiment attempted to build the MECH-152 x ARC-016 test (drafted as V3-EXQ-990) and was BLOCKED at design review by two independent adversarial passes, both convergent. (a) NO SHARED READOUT: MECH-152's w_harm enters ONLY E3Selector.score_trajectory's harm term (m = m * w_harm, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) and ARC-016's running_variance enters ONLY the commit gate (committed = commit_variance < effective_threshold, same file); candidate generation (e2_fast.py:generate_candidates_random) is precision-blind. No code path lets the two mechanisms jointly determine any single measurable quantity today -- a "combined harm-evaluation precision/variability readout" does not exist to be measured, so the CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING pair below is not currently runnable as a single internal-scalar test. (b) SEPARATELY: the harm-cost head used whenever no harm_bridge/harm_forward_model is supplied (E3Selector.harm_eval_head) receives NO gradient from the generic agent.py loss inventory that ordinary experiments use -- it is trained only via the opt-in SD-054 onboarding curriculum (experiments/scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py, scaffold_train_harm_eval_head=True), which is NOT part of the env setups this claim names for reuse below (V3-EXQ-194/194a, V3-EXQ-818). Reusing those setups directly, as originally specified, inherits an untrained (random-projection) harm_eval_head; any re-test MUST compose the SD-054 curriculum with the 194/818 manipulation rather than assume the harm head is already grounded. Do not re-mint SD-054's training loss as new substrate -- it already exists; the gap is a design-composition step, not a build.
LITERATURE STATE (2026-09-08 targeted review, literature_confidence 0.836, evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_arc_044/): three INDEPENDENT lines converge against the claim's headline -- Yu & Dayan 2005 (Neuron, normative Bayesian derivation), Polack et al. 2013 (Nat Neurosci, intracellular pharmacology in mouse V1), and Shine 2019 (Trends Cog Sci, review) / Munn et al. 2021 (Nat Commun, whole-brain human fMRI) -- the latter two share an author and are counted as ONE independent line, not two. All three report the ascending gain layer as AT LEAST TWO dissociable neuromodulatory systems (noradrenergic + cholinergic; locus coeruleus + basal forebrain), not one global signal. ARC-044's ARCHITECTURAL half -- effective precision at an evaluation channel is a composite quantity that ARC-016, MECH-152, MECH-026 and MECH-093 should all write into, rather than each carrying a private threshold -- SURVIVES all three and is the part worth keeping (Munn et al.'s topology-level reorganisation finding, in particular, is the right grain of effect for an architectural control signal). ARC-044's MECHANISTIC half -- "a single... global arousal/ precision signal ... modulated by a context-specific gain" -- is CONTRADICTED by all three and should be restated as a multi-source composite, not a single signal.
FALSIFIER CORRECTION (load-bearing, from Yu & Dayan 2005): the interaction their two uncertainty signals derive to is "part-antagonistic, part-synergistic" -- i.e. SIGN-VARYING across regimes -- a third outcome the claim's original CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING pair (multiplicative vs. additive/null) has no slot for. Any re-test of this claim must admit that third outcome explicitly: a mixed-sign interaction is evidence of genuine (non-independent, non-unified) composition and must not be scored as a null/falsifier by default.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (substrate readiness, unchanged by the above): the two mechanisms must each be independently confirmed live before a null interaction can be read as evidence of independence rather than a wiring gap. ARC-016 (temporal gain): CONFIRMED live -- status stable, gate_green, mean_rho_rv_vs_commit=-0.955 (V3-EXQ-818, 2026-07-25); the substrate already computes volatility_estimate = var(running_variance) over a sliding window (Q-007, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py). MECH-152 (contextual gain), harm pathway only: CONFIRMED live -- V3-EXQ-194/194a C1 PASS 3/3, r_w_harm=0.70. The GOAL pathway (w_goal) is FAIL (r=-0.007, flat) and stays OUT OF SCOPE. A run in which either running_variance or w_harm shows negligible variance across its manipulated conditions must self-route substrate_not_ready / non_contributory, not be read as a test of ARC-044.
SCOPE NOTE (unchanged): MECH-093's rate-channel is independently confirmed (V3-EXQ-097b/396b/505), but MECH-026 has zero experimental evidence of its own and explicitly defers its mechanism to MECH-161's arousal regulator, which reads as UNBUILT (MECH-161: evidence: [], status: candidate). A full 4-facet unification test is therefore NOT testable now; this what_would_answer stays scoped to the MECH-152 x ARC-016 pair.
CONFIRMING: once (i) the missing shared readout is either built (a substrate design not specified here -- see OPEN questions below) or the design is restated around a downstream BEHAVIOURAL readout common to both pathways (e.g. harm incurred conditional on commit rate, rather than a single required internal scalar), and (ii) harm_eval_head is grounded via the SD-054 curriculum composed with the 194/818 manipulation -- a context x temporal-state interaction that is either cleanly multiplicative OR mixed-sign/regime-dependent (per the Yu & Dayan correction above), on the combined precision/gain readout, exceeding what either main effect alone predicts. Per the gain-control literature already cited in MECH-152's notes (Kanashiro et al. 2017), the confirming signature should also show high w_harm x low running_variance jointly REDUCING harm-evaluation variability (signal-to-noise gain), not merely scaling magnitude.
FALSIFYING: even after (i) and (ii) above, the interaction is additive or genuinely null (NOT merely mixed-sign -- see the falsifier correction above) under non-degenerate preconditions. This falsifies ARC-044's unification for the MECH-152/ARC-016 pair specifically: they stand as REE currently implements them -- two independent gain knobs, not facets of one architecture.
OPEN, NOT RESOLVED HERE: (1) whether precision/gain is even the right shared quantity, or whether an integration/segregation-style state (Shine 2019's candidate -- a property of the whole evaluation-channel set at once, not a per-channel scalar) is a better target for what the four mechanisms jointly modulate; REE has no such state today and the vocabulary should not be imported without a concrete ree_core referent -- this is why no shared-readout substrate design is proposed here rather than deferred. (2) Yu & Dayan's expected-uncertainty (cholinergic) term -- a per-channel cue-reliability prior -- has no counterpart among ARC-016/MECH-152/MECH-026/MECH-093; ARC-016 is closest but estimates from running-variance in the temporal stream, a different quantity (a prior vs. an online estimate). Neither question blocks a corrected MECH-152 x ARC-016 test, but both should inform whatever substrate design eventually implements the shared readout in (i) -- building it before this is resolved risks encoding the wrong architecture and re-blocking the next /queue-experiment pass the same way.

claims.claim_title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). claims.falsifier_summary: With the same gates, a resolving DV and adequate power (the pre-registered probe derives n = 38-2485 for a cosine contrast), the occupied-slot similarity contrast is null or reversed (sleep >= waking) on >= 3/5 seeds and leave-one-out stable; none of the eight 436-lineage results counts, each having failed upstream at (a), (b), (c) or a bug.
claims.required_event: A converged waking trajectory producing many ContextMemory writes across distinguishable contexts, followed by K-episode-triggered SWS and REM passes that actually fire (pooled sws_n_writes and rem_n_rollouts >= 1 in the sleep arm and exactly 0 in WAKING_ONLY).
claims.manipulation: SWS_THEN_REM versus a write-matched WAKING_ONLY arm, with E1Config.contextmemory_write_usage_balancing ON so the bank reaches >= 2 occupied slots and does not sit in the legacy argmin single-slot fixed point.
claims.control: A write-matched, occupancy-matched WAKING_ONLY arm plus a NO_WRITES run-time-derived null with context_memory.memory.requires_grad_(False) so Adam drift cannot manufacture spread.
claims.DV: Occupied-slot mean pairwise cosine in SWS_THEN_REM versus the write-matched waking arm, occupancy reported separately and never multiplied in, resolved with a mutual-information statistic over the full contingency table at PROBE_CLUSTERS >= 4 and the fresh-cluster generalization readout treated as load-bearing.
claims.instrument: The sleep passes exist (ree_core/agent.py run_sws_schema_pass / run_rem_attribution_pass / run_sleep_cycle; ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py) and the write-selection repairs exist as E1Config.contextmemory_write_usage_balancing and contextmemory_write_selection. The held-out linear probe of gate (d) and the MI-over-contingency-table DV are not implemented in any driver.
claims.consumer_locus: ContextMemory slot content after offline consolidation -- the differentiation of the context bank that hippocampal attribution mapping is supposed to consume, not the behavioural policy.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Gates (a)-(c) are met on the current substrate; gate (d) is the live failure. The write-stream latents entering ContextMemory.write must carry safe-versus-dangerous class structure the bank could differentiate on, asserted with a held-out linear probe on recorded train-time latents beating its own permuted-label null. V3-EXQ-972 measured uncentred separability at 0.0281 (intra-class 0.9804 / 0.9713 against inter-class 0.9478), so any slot-differentiation contrast run today measures the input cone rather than sleep.
claims.blocking_reason: Gate (d) fails upstream of sleep: the observation-to-z_world objective supplies no gradient toward decision-relevant content, so the latents entering ContextMemory.write carry almost no class structure (measured separability 0.0281) and no consolidation contrast can discriminate. The DV itself also needs the MI / fresh-cluster redesign the write-path entry already directs.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four gates; the first three are met on the current substrate, the
fourth is the one this claim now fails):
(a) OFFLINE-PHASE LIVENESS -- pooled `sws_n_writes >= 1` and `rem_n_rollouts >= 1` in the sleep-ON
arm and exactly 0 in WAKING_ONLY (the 436c/436d counters; 436c measured 800 / 600). A run that
discards `run_sleep_cycle()`'s metrics dict cannot distinguish "write never fired" from "fired with

silently runs the legacy argmin path and reproduces the 1-of-16 fixed point.

measured max |z| = 1.67). The derived `sws_slot_diversity` (1 - `slot_cosine_sim`) inherits the same

(d) INPUT-SIDE SEPARABILITY FLOOR -- the write-stream latents ENTERING `ContextMemory.write` must
carry class structure the bank could differentiate on. Assert this with a HELD-OUT LINEAR PROBE

and report the FRESH-cluster generalization readout as load-bearing) -- occupied-slot mean pairwise

claims.manipulation: Sweep the SD-068 diffuse-damage scalar (diffuse_perturb on the phase-operative tensors) or consolidation cycle count/depth across at least four staged levels, rather than a binary sleep-on/sleep-off contrast.
claims.control: The null-content arm already built into the harness (probe present, content never injected), plus a zero-damage reference level, plus a legacy-write-path arm to show the effect is not the homogenisation artefact.
claims.DV: Two separately scored curves against degradation level: attribution precision (slot separation / slot_cosine_sim among ContextMemory slots) and storage-or-recall (recognition of injected content that does not depend on discriminating it from competitor slots), compared by the degradation level at which each first degrades reliably.
claims.instrument: Attribution precision is instrumented (slot_cosine_sim in the 436 family; sws_completion_margin in the harness). consolidation degradation -- contextual-attribution precision fails

reduced consolidation is harmful, and not merely that the three
consolidation PHASES fail in a given order among themselves (that
narrower cross-phase question is SD-073, itself still unsupported

consolidation-reduction manipulation crossed with TWO SEPARABLE
outcome metrics measured at each degradation level:

      discrimination quality -- e.g. slot_cosine_sim / slot_separation
      among ContextMemory slots (the instrument used since the
      SD-017/EXQ-436 family), or a context-discrimination accuracy
      readout.

  (b) STORAGE/RECALL metric: whether the agent can retrieve or
      recognise a specific past event AT ALL, independent of whether
      it is attributed to the correct context -- e.g. a cued-recall /
      event-recognition accuracy readout against injected known
      content (following the SD-068/SD-071 injected-content
      precedent, which sidesteps the "sleep cannot consolidate an
      unencoded representation" starvation ceiling from
      failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-538a). THIS METRIC DOES NOT YET EXIST in

      recall_accuracy / episodic_recall / retrieval_accuracy
      instrument found anywhere in experiments/_lib or ree_core.

DESIGN: progressively reduce consolidation cycle count/depth/duration
(or, reusing SD-068's existing graded RMS-scaled Gaussian
diffuse-damage knob in
ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py as an
alternative graded-degradation lever) across >=4 staged levels,
matched for total experience/compute, and score (a) and (b) at each
level.

CONFIRMED if attribution-precision (a) shows measurable, statistically
reliable degradation at a LOWER degradation level than storage/recall
(b) does -- a genuine phase-order dissociation, attribution failing
first.

FALSIFIED if storage/recall (b) degrades first or simultaneously with
attribution (a), or if the two metrics degrade at statistically
indistinguishable rates across the degradation ramp -- this
specifically undercuts INV-046's "not primarily a storage failure"
reframing, even if reduced consolidation is shown to be harmful

claims.what_would_answer:
This is a FUSION claim: an out-of-domain clinical-empirical assertion (leg A) plus a REE-internal, V3-testable mechanistic claim (leg B, operationalized as SD-073). The two legs answer independently and neither substitutes for the other.
LEG A -- OUT-OF-DOMAIN (clinical/literature; no REE substrate can test this). Whether ACTUAL human Alzheimer's disease follows the specific ordering asserted here (precision/confidence loss -> episodic memory failure -> contextual identity loss -> global disorientation) is a clinical-neurology question the REE substrate cannot itself adjudicate. It resolves by a formal comparison of the claim's predicted symptom-emergence ordering against the published staged-clinical-progression literature (e.g. CDR/FAST staging, MCI-to-AD conversion studies, longitudinal neuropsychological batteries) -- not by the qualitative citation already present in this claim's notes, which has never been formally checked against primary sources. CONFIRMING: a systematic review or meta-analysis of longitudinal staging data shows the predicted ordering (or one consistent with it under this claim's own domain mapping) as the dominant clinical pattern. FALSIFYING: the literature shows the four domains failing in a different order, failing diffusely/simultaneously (consistent with the glymphatic-alone account this claim contrasts itself against), or the ordering is not reproducible across cohorts. Route: /lit-pull, not an experiment.
LEG B -- REE-INTERNAL (V3-testable via the SD-068 lesion harness; operational scoring site is SD-073, which this claim and MECH-168 jointly feed).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently PARTIALLY UNMET -- read before trusting any staging-order result). A per-phase readout is usable for this test only if CONTENT-CONTINGENT: responsive to corrupted/injected content, not merely to corruption magnitude or noise power. Any new falsifier design MUST explicitly re-run this precondition check per phase -- the same null-content control that caught the SWS readout's content-freeness (V3-EXQ-778c) and that a REM unpaired-target null re-confirmed as insufficient (V3-EXQ-778h) -- before that phase's output can count as staging evidence. Status per phase (2026-07-18 SD-068 decomposition, unchanged as of 2026-08-07): NREM (slot-filling, MECH-121) PASSED, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1445, CI95 [0.1438,0.1451], 0/8 seeds confounded, V3-EXQ-778c) -- carried by SD-071. SWS (slot-formation, MECH-120) PASSED after rebuild, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1495, sd 0.0218, CI95 [0.1344,0.1646], ceiling_inside_ci95 false, 8/8 seeds, V3-EXQ-778g) -- carried by SD-071. REM (precision recalibration, MECH-123) FAILED on every design tried -- content-free at both clamp rails (V3-EXQ-778c), still content-free after de-clamping via an unpaired-target null (median ratio ~0.88 vs the 0.25 ceiling, 6/7 de-railed seeds above it, V3-EXQ-778h), generative-gain contrast flat in content scale (V3-EXQ-778f). claims.claim_title: Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.
claims.falsifier_summary: A pharmacological-analogue arm and a phase-and-duration-matched behavioural arm produce materially different degradation patterns -- the pipeline discriminates on the cause of disruption, contradicting mechanism-agnosticism.
claims.required_event: A sleep cycle in which a specific phase is suppressed for a specified duration, after waking experience that the attribution pipeline should consolidate.
claims.manipulation: Four arms -- normal sleep (SWS plus REM), REM-suppressed (antidepressant analogue), SWS-suppressed (benzodiazepine analogue) and no sleep -- crossed against a phase-and-duration-matched behavioural suppression of the same phase, so cause is varied while phase fidelity is held fixed.
claims.control: ARM_A normal sleep as the reference, plus the non-vacuity gate arm-distinctness check, plus the behavioural-suppression comparator matched on phase and duration.
claims.DV: Attribution-pipeline degradation (harm_discrimination and/or slot_differentiation loss relative to normal sleep) as a function of which phase was suppressed and for how long, compared between pharmacological-analogue and behavioural suppression of the same phase.
claims.instrument: The four-arm harness exists and its design was confirmed faithful; the missing piece is training the harm-valuation pathway, for which the scaffold_train_harm_pathway option in experiments/scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py and the V3-EXQ-603k readiness pattern already exist and were not used.
claims.consumer_locus: The offline attribution pipeline's dependence on phase fidelity rather than on the cause of disruption -- at the sleep-cycle to harm-valuation readout boundary.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The harm-valuation pathway must be trained before the verdict is read, and the four arms must produce genuinely distinct harm_discrimination (and/or slot_differentiation) values. V3-EXQ-670 failed this: run_sleep_cycle runs the SWS and REM passes but never trains e3.harm_eval_head, so the readout was byte-identical across all four arms for every seed.
claims.blocking_reason: The DV cannot move: the sleep cycle never trains e3.harm_eval_head, so harm_discrimination is seed-fixed and arm-invariant and the design cannot enter a discriminating regime. The fix (train the harm pathway with the existing scaffold, then gate on arm distinctness) is a design composition, not a build.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: V3-EXQ-670 is on file as a FAIL; the confirmed autopsy classes it degenerate/non_contributory because the readout could not respond to the manipulation, so it carries no information for or against the prediction.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim is a clinical derived_prediction: a clean REE run supports it only conditional on REE's sleep model being a faithful model of human sleep architecture, and the benzodiazepine/anticholinergic epidemiology is a separate human-population line that must not move this claim's experimental confidence.

claims.claim_title: Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.

claims.required_event: Waking periods of graded novelty (SD-MEL-PRODUCER world_rule_shift) generating measurably different accumulated Model Error Load, followed by an offline phase whose architecture can respond.
claims.manipulation: Graded waking novelty crossed with a held-out environment instance or a world-model instance distinct from the CausalGridWorldV2 configuration SD-MEL-PRODUCER was validated against, on seeds disjoint from both the 42/123/456 and the 7/271/883 sets.

The weak link is the mel_reference calibration estimate, not the recorders.

claims.claim_title: Cognitive reserve (produced by education, bilingualism, complex occupation, social engagement, and enriched environments) protects against dementia primarily by maintaining sustained novelty-driven Model Error Load throughout the lifespan, keeping the SD-017 model update system exercised and preserving sleep-architecture responsiveness to learning demands; conversely, understimulating environments accelerate dementia by depriving the update system of the error signal needed to remain adaptive.
claims.falsifier_summary: Offline-phase work is flat or non-monotone in measured MEL; or enriched and impoverished histories show no retention difference at matched insult; or -- decisively -- the retention difference survives with use_mel_consumer False, making it an exposure effect rather than a MEL-loop effect.
claims.required_event: A graded enrichment history (at least three novelty levels over many episodes) followed by a matched degradation insult applied identically to both the enriched and impoverished histories.
claims.manipulation: Grade novelty with the causal_grid_world world_rule_shift knobs during the history phase, then apply a fixed-magnitude, fixed-schedule insult -- diffuse_perturb on agent.e1.context_memory.memory (the SD-068 harness lever) or matched noise on the E3 attribution path -- after the history phase.
claims.control: Impoverished-history arm at matched episode count and compute; a consumer-OFF pair (use_mel_consumer False) at both enrichment extremes to attribute any effect to the MEL channel rather than to episode length or boundary count; and the matched-PE observation-noise negative control.
claims.DV: Two joined quantities: cumulative offline-phase work (sws_n_writes + rem_n_rollouts) monotone in MEASURED MEL rather than in the novelty label, and post-insult retention of attribution/competence in the enriched arm exceeding the impoverished arm by at least 1.5 SD of the per-seed paired delta on 3 of 5 seeds.

No experiment currently composes them.
claims.consumer_locus: The MEL producer-to-consumer chain -- waking model error load driving offline-phase budget -- and the retention of that budget's product across a degradation insult, not the epidemiological cognitive-reserve association.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Measured waking MEL must exceed the calibrated stable-base reference and be graded by world_rule_shift re-permutation rather than env_drift_interval; the consumer must be armed and unpinned (use_mel_consumer True, cross-arm variance in sws_n_writes and rem_n_rollouts); mel_duration_factor must not saturate at its 3.0 cap; and a matched-PE observation-noise arm must not reproduce the effect.

What is missing is the experiment: EXP-1401 is only proposed, and no run composes the enrichment ladder with the matched-insult retention leg, which is the clause that distinguishes MECH-181 from MECH-180.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (five gates):
(1) PRODUCER SUPRA-REFERENCE -- the graded-enrichment arms must produce a measured waking MEL
gradient ABOVE the calibrated stable-base reference. The vacuity signature is V3-EXQ-718a's: measured
ecological MEL ~1e-5, noise-level and SCRAMBLED with respect to the novelty label, with
`conv_rel_drop ~0.98`. Grade novelty with SD-MEL-PRODUCER's `world_rule_shift_*` knob (action-map
re-permutation), NEVER with `env_drift_interval` -- V3-EXQ-677 measured a high-vs-low mean-PE
difference of 8.8e-07 against a 0.01 threshold on that knob, because moving hazards adds sampling
noise, not learning load.
(2) THE GRADIENT MUST BE LEARNING LOAD, NOT NOISE -- elevated PE counts only if it DECAYS within a
stationary window; `steps_since_world_rule_shift` is emitted in env `info` for exactly this. A
matched-PE OBSERVATION-NOISE negative-control arm must NOT reproduce the effect (grading observation
noise produces a monotone MEL ladder by construction on any substrate -- the DV-symmetry artifact
class, and the reason V3-EXQ-798a carried this control).
(3) CONSUMER LIVE AND UN-PINNED -- `use_mel_consumer=True`, and cumulative `sws_n_writes` /
`rem_n_rollouts` must VARY across arms. The vacuity signature is V3-EXQ-677's scheduler-pinned
SWS=80.0/80.0, REM=60.0/60.0 with zero cross-arm variance.
(4) HEADROOM -- `mel_duration_factor` is clamped to `[mel_duration_factor_min 0.5,
mel_duration_factor_max 3.0]`. If the top arm saturates at 3.0 the contrast is a cap artefact; report
the per-arm saturation fraction alongside the factor. This is the same shape as MECH-353's
precondition (1) -- see MECH-353's own `what_would_answer`, do not re-derive.
(5) CHANNEL ATTRIBUTION -- an ENRICHED arm with `use_mel_consumer=False` must show the SAME
offline-phase duration as an IMPOVERISHED arm with the consumer off, so any enrichment effect is
attributable to the MEL channel rather than to enrichment changing episode length or boundary count
(note that under the boundary-only trigger, episode count IS sleep count -- `sleep_substrate:GAP-9`).

CONFIRMING (two legs; both are required, and the second is MECH-181's distinctive content over
MECH-180):
(i) MAINTENANCE -- across `>= 3` enrichment levels (impoverished / moderate / enriched) at `>= 5`
seeds, measured above-reference waking MEL is monotone in enrichment level, AND cumulative
offline-phase work (`sws_n_writes + rem_n_rollouts`) is monotone in MEASURED MEL -- not in the
novelty LABEL, the distinction on which V3-EXQ-718's C1 failed 0/3 while its C2 passed 3/3 -- on
`>= 3/5` seeds.
(ii) RESERVE -- after a MATCHED degradation insult applied identically to both histories (a fixed
ablation of ContextMemory slots, or fixed noise injected into the E3 attribution path; identical
magnitude, identical schedule, applied after the enrichment phase), the ENRICHED-history agent
retains more attribution/competence than the IMPOVERISHED-history agent, by
`max(1.5 * SD(per-seed paired delta), an absolute floor derived from the consumer-OFF arm's spread)`,
on `>= 3/5` seeds. This is the only leg that tests "reserve" rather than "responsiveness", and it is
what makes MECH-181 more than a restatement of MECH-180.

FALSIFYING: with (1)-(5) met, ANY of --
(i) offline-phase work is flat or non-monotone in MEASURED MEL (the maintenance chain does not close);
(ii) at matched insult, enriched and impoverished histories show no retention difference (there is no
reserve, only responsiveness);
(iii) DECISIVE -- the retention difference SURVIVES with `use_mel_consumer=False`. MECH-181 asserts
specifically that the protection runs THROUGH the MEL-driven sleep loop; a difference that persists
with the loop disabled is an environment/exposure effect and refutes the claim's mechanism even
though it would leave the epidemiology untouched.

claims.claim_title: Can long-run actigraphy data, combined with daily prediction error load estimates derived from passive behavioural, physiological, and subjective signals, be used to infer latent sleep-phase sufficiency relative to waking error burden, and can this mismatch index predict clinical decompensation type and timing with better specificity than total sleep time alone?
claims.falsifier_summary: The mismatch index adds no specificity over total sleep time, or it predicts timing but the NREM-versus-REM split does not map to episodic-versus-affective failure type, collapsing the index to a generic sleep-debt signal.

claims.instrument: A clinical monitoring stack outside REE entirely: wrist actigraphy, nocturnal HRV, skin-temperature rhythm, light exposure, daily mood and cognitive-drift diary, plus a PSG-validated latent phase estimator. No V3 module records or could record any of these.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The latent sleep-phase estimator must recover NREM/REM proportion from actigraphy plus HRV plus temperature above chance against a polysomnography reference in a calibration subsample; if phase cannot be inferred, the mismatch index is uncomputable and any apparent prediction is driven by raw actigraphy.

claims.what_would_answer:
A longitudinal clinical-cohort study (e.g. MCI patients, wrist actigraphy +
nocturnal HRV + skin-temperature rhythm + light exposure + daily
mood/cognitive-drift diary over ~6 months) that computes a weekly mismatch
index = estimated overnight update capacity (latent NREM/REM proportion +
fragmentation + circadian phase, inferred from the passive streams) minus
estimated daily MEL (prediction-error load from schedule complexity,
interpersonal contact, emotional salience, wake physiological reactivity).
ANSWER "yes" if (a) persistent negative mismatch predicts subsequent clinical
decompensation at the next monthly assessment with significantly better
specificity/AUC than total sleep time alone, AND (b) the TYPE of mismatch is
type-specific per MECH-179 -- NREM-deficit on high-episodic-load days predicts
memory-consolidation failure / rigidity, while REM-deficit on
high-emotional-load days predicts affective lability / paranoia -- i.e. the

prediction is driven by raw actigraphy, not by sleep-phase sufficiency.

claims.what_would_answer:

under chronic harm in the tonic_5ht_enabled=False arm -- z_goal_norm should show real
SD-012 seeding at some point (consistent with INV-053's robustly replicated attractor,
7/7 PASS) that then collapses toward the SD-012 seeding threshold, NOT near-zero
z_goal_norm from the start in both arms. Both prior direct tests of this claim
(v3_exq_251_mech186_valence_wanting_floor, runs ...1775504875_v3 and ...1775549211_v3,
2026-04-06/07) failed exactly this precondition: mean_z_goal_norm was ~0.01-0.02 in
BOTH the floor and no-floor arms, because no tonic-5-HT-to-VALENCE_WANTING substrate
was wired into the run at all and baseline SD-012 seeding was not functioning.
Governance reclassified both runs non_contributory/substrate_limitation on 2026-04-08
for exactly this reason ("cannot test floor effect without baseline seeding") -- both
the flat manifests and, as of 2026-08-06, the run-pack manifests and the derived
claim_evidence.v1.json index now consistently reflect this (0 genuine experimental
entries either direction; the index previously stayed stale at weakens=2/exp_conf=0.175
because the 2026-04-08 reclassification never propagated to the run-pack copies -- see
psychiatric_failure_modes_plan.md's MOTIVATIONAL-TAXONOMY node for the correction
record). A run reproducing that same no-baseline-seeding pattern must self-route
substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict on MECH-186. Separately: those two runs
imposed an ARTIFICIAL floor clamp (valence_wanting_floor=0.05) rather than toggling the
actual SerotoninModule tonic_5ht_enabled flag (MECH-203/204, implemented 2026-04-07)
that this claim's own evidence_quality_note names as the intended test substrate -- a
future run should use the real flag, not a synthetic clamp, so the result speaks to
the modeled mechanism rather than an arbitrary intervention.

confirmed with tonic_5ht_enabled=False), enabling tonic_5ht_enabled=True measurably
slows or prevents that collapse -- higher retained z_goal_norm and a preserved

produces no reliable difference in VALENCE_WANTING floor retention, z_goal_norm, or

Literature confidence is comparatively high (0.742, 3 supporting entries: tryptophan-
depletion and dorsal-raphe electrophysiology studies mapping onto a tonic 5-HT
appetitive-value / terrain-maintenance role); as of the 2026-08-06 index fix there are
zero genuine experimental entries counting for or against this claim -- MECH-186 is
untested, not contested. SCOPE (resolved 2026-08-06, user decision): MECH-186 is V3
scope, matching claims.yaml's implementation_phase and the 2026-04-09-c governance
reclassification above -- phase-label-follows-dependency: a claim needed to complete

psychiatric_failure_modes_plan.md MOTIVATIONAL-TAXONOMY node previously flagged a

claims.claim_title: Serotonin modulates the gain on dopaminergic incentive salience, converting the hard SD-012 threshold into an adaptive graded transduction function.
claims.falsifier_summary: With tonic_5ht demonstrably ranging and the config-clamped positive control showing the gain band does move seeding, the serotonergically-driven arms produce no graded seeding difference -- the 5-HT-to-gain mapping exists in code but does no work -- or the effect is entirely explained by a change in global approach vigour rather than in cue transduction.
claims.required_event: Contact with a proximate benefit source while the agent's serotonergic state has been driven apart between conditions -- a harm-rich stretch that suppresses tonic 5-HT versus a benefit-rich stretch that raises it -- so the same cue arrives at different transduction gains.
claims.manipulation: Drive the gain SEROTONERGICALLY rather than by config: cross harm exposure and benefit-contact history (which move tonic_5ht through SerotoninSystem.serotonin_step) against a serotonin-disabled arm, letting REEAgent write current_seeding_gain into GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain each step.
claims.control: A serotonin-OFF arm with z_goal_seeding_gain pinned at 1.0 as the bit-identical reference, plus a config-clamped positive control that sets the same gain values directly (the V3-EXQ-252 manipulation), which upper-bounds the effect the serotonergic route can deliver.
claims.DV: z_goal seeding response per unit of benefit_exposure at matched proximity -- the seeded z_goal norm change on benefit contact -- compared across serotonergic states, with global approach vigour reported separately so cue transduction is not confounded with the Cools-style tonic reduction in approach drive.
claims.instrument: The whole path exists and is readable: GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain multiplies benefit before drive modulation (ree_core/goal.py effective_benefit), SerotoninSystem.current_seeding_gain maps tonic_5ht linearly into it, and REEAgent writes it every step inside the MECH-203 serotonin step. V3-EXQ-252 is the recorder for the gain leg and V3-EXQ-932a already uses the knob as a pre-registered arm.
claims.consumer_locus: The benefit-to-z_goal transduction point inside GoalState.update, where the gain multiplies benefit_exposure before drive modulation -- not global approach vigour and not terrain maintenance (MECH-186).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The serotonergic driver must be demonstrably moving, not merely enabled: tonic_5ht_enabled True with the realised tonic_5ht trajectory reported per arm and showing a non-trivial range across the harm-rich and benefit-rich conditions, and gain_min / gain_max set so the mapped z_goal_seeding_gain actually spans the band EXQ-252 showed is behaviourally relevant (about 0.6 to 2.0). If the harm-suppression term is the manipulated driver, z_harm_a must be shown non-degenerate (harm_history_len above zero and a trained affective encoder), else only the benefit-rise term is live.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing in the substrate is missing: the gain knob, the tonic_5ht mapping and the live per-step write into GoalConfig all exist. But the only supporting run, V3-EXQ-252, set z_goal_seeding_gain directly as a config value, which tests the graded transduction function and not the claim's subject -- serotonergic control of that gain. No experiment drives the gain through SerotoninSystem.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim reads as fully supported by the EXQ-252 PASS; that run establishes the gain-to-seeding transfer function only, and the serotonergic half of the claim's subject line is untested.
claims.auditor_notes: The harm-suppression half of the 5-HT driver reads the z_harm_a norm, which is degenerate at shipped defaults (harm_history_len 0, rank-2 harm_obs_a, untrained affective encoder) -- coordinate with the SD-011 auditor; the benefit-rise half is live and sufficient for a first serotonergically-driven arm.

claims.claim_title: PFC-mediated goal persistence under adversity, sustained by 5-HT projections from DRN to dlPFC, maintains z_goal through harm spikes after seeding.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same seeded baseline, enabling tonic_5ht_enabled gives no reliable difference in z_goal collapse depth or recovery through harm spikes -- there is no PFC-mediated maintenance distinct from seeding, and the cannot-hold-a-plan phenomenology must be attributed elsewhere.
claims.required_event: Harm spikes (z_harm_a elevation) or transient benefit-exposure dropouts arriving AFTER a z_goal representation has been seeded and is being pursued, so persistence-through-adversity is distinguishable from failure-to-seed.
claims.manipulation: Toggle tonic_5ht_enabled so SerotoninModule.current_seeding_gain drives goal.config.z_goal_seeding_gain dynamically through the live writer at agent.py:12209 (the DRN-to-dlPFC persistence analog the claim names), rather than the MECH-188 z_goal_inject norm floor, which is a read-only per-tick view.
claims.control: A tonic_5ht_enabled=False arm at matched seeds with identical harm-spike scheduling, plus a z_goal_inject arm retained explicitly as the read-site-only comparator so the persistent-attractor versus scoring-view dissociation is measured rather than assumed.
claims.DV: z_goal_norm trajectory through and after each harm spike (collapse depth and recovery), conditioned on goal_state.is_active() remaining true, together with a downstream consumer readout (approach_commit_rate or MECH-295 bridge engagement) so persistence of the representation is distinguished from persistence of behaviour.
claims.instrument: The 5-HT path is live: serotonin.py current_seeding_gain and the writer at agent.py:12209 into goal_state.config, consumed at goal.py:907 in effective_benefit. The MECH-188 handle actually exercised so far, GoalState.with_injection (goal.py:1134), is documented in-source as applying to action selection only and NOT modifying the persistent attractor -- so no instrument currently records persistence at the attractor.
claims.consumer_locus: The persistent z_goal attractor and its is_active() state through adversity -- the maintenance boundary AFTER seeding -- not the per-tick E3 scoring view that z_goal_inject floors.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: z_goal must be genuinely seeded and the persistent attractor ACTIVE (goal_state.is_active() true) before any harm spike, and the manipulation must act on that persistent attractor rather than on a per-tick scoring view -- V3-EXQ-536b force-armed z_goal_inject=0.3 with inject_observed_fraction 1.0 at the per-candidate read site and approach_commit_rate still stayed 0.0 on 3/3 seeds, because the injection never touches is_active().
claims.blocking_reason: The only manipulation ever run, z_goal_inject, is a read-only scoring view that bypasses the persistent attractor and every consumer gated on is_active(), so the commit chain stayed inert. The modelled manipulation (tonic 5-HT seeding gain) has a live writer but is degenerate without genuine SD-012 seeding, which is gated on SD-018.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The single indexed weakens entry (v3_exq_253, 2026-04-07) cannot weigh against the claim: without baseline z_goal seeding an injection cannot demonstrate persistence of an absent goal, which governance already recorded on 2026-04-08 but which still keys the claim's exp_conf 0.125.
The 2026-04-09-c note that tonic_5ht_enabled makes a V3 experiment feasible is correct about the substrate and silent about the precondition: feasibility is still gated on seeding, not on the flag.
claims.auditor_notes: Share the regime matrix with MECH-186 and MECH-187 -- one seeded-then-stressed curriculum, three flags. The z_goal_inject read-site bypass is a reusable finding for any claim whose DV depends on goal_state.is_active(); MECH-295 and MECH-307 are the other consumers it silently misses.

claims.claim_title: Goal-directed behaviour in adversive environments requires a tonic regulatory system maintaining benefit orientation across terrain, transduction, and maintenance stages.
claims.falsifier_summary: Any one of the three mechanisms alone fully restores LONG_HORIZON performance to the SIMPLE baseline, on a run where the all-off arm demonstrably collapses -- which would make the tonic system a single-stage rather than a three-stage requirement.
claims.required_event: Sustained exposure to a harm-rich LONG_HORIZON context in which benefit opportunities remain present but distal, the regime in which a self-maintaining low-motivation attractor can form.
claims.manipulation: Factorial enable/disable of the three stage mechanisms: MECH-186 terrain floor (GoalConfig.valence_wanting_floor), MECH-187 transduction gain (z_goal_seeding_gain), MECH-188 maintenance injection (z_goal_inject), each individually and in combination.
claims.control: The all-off arm in the same LONG_HORIZON context plus the SIMPLE-context baseline, so single-mechanism sufficiency is judged against both the collapsed and the uncollapsed reference.
claims.DV: Whether any single mechanism restores LONG_HORIZON performance to the SIMPLE baseline (single_mechanism_sufficient), measured across both contexts and replications; secondarily whether the three together do.
claims.instrument: Built and exercised: the three knobs are live config fields with serotonin dynamically modulating two of them (ree_core/neuromodulation/serotonin.py maps tonic_5ht to valence_wanting_floor and z_goal_seeding_gain), and V3-EXQ-254 ran the factorial twice, both PASS.
claims.consumer_locus: The tonic regulatory pathway across the three pipeline stages -- terrain representation, cue-triggered transduction, and goal-representation maintenance -- upstream of goal-directed action selection.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The harm-rich regime must actually produce motivational collapse in the all-off arm -- a run where the LONG_HORIZON context does not degrade performance relative to SIMPLE cannot discriminate joint necessity from irrelevance -- and each of the three knobs must be individually effective (non-zero behavioural delta when enabled alone) so that 'no single mechanism suffices' is a finding and not three inert flags.
claims.blocking_reason: R0: event, all three manipulations, controls, DV and recorder exist and the falsifier has run twice with consistent PASS. The residual caveat is non-degeneracy in the other direction -- combined_sufficient was also false, so even all three did not fully recover LONG_HORIZON, leaving the recovery ceiling unattributed.
false_positives: INV-052 having no what_would_answer field is not an untested claim: its falsifier is fully specified in EXP-0101 and executed as V3-EXQ-254 (PASS x2), and the claim is stable at overall_conf 0.89 with zero opposing evidence.
claims.auditor_notes: Authoring the what_would_answer here is transcription of an executed design, not a new test. Worth recording in it that combined_sufficient=false (all three together still did not fully recover LONG_HORIZON) so a future reader does not treat the PASS as a completeness claim about the three stages.
