claims.claim_title: Chronic harm-dominated environments produce a self-maintaining depressive attractor: z_goal seeding failure, terrain collapse, and HABIT/PLANNED behavioural equivalence.
claims.falsifier_summary: z_goal norm stays near zero and HABIT/PLANNED equivalence stays near 1.0 in the benign arm too, or the equivalence dissolves once V_s mode diversity is available -- the attractor is a substrate artefact rather than an environmentally produced state.
claims.required_event: A trained agent run to warmup end under environments spanning a hazard-to-benefit ratio range, with z_goal seeding, terrain and behaviour read at the same point in each.
claims.manipulation: Vary environmental harm dominance as the independent variable -- hazard count and hazard_harm swept from benign to chronic -- rather than fixing 8x8 / 1 resource / 3 hazards / hazard_harm 0.02 as every replication has.
claims.control: A benign low-harm arm at matched seeds and matched training budget, which the claim's own description already asserts must show intact goal-directed function, plus a mode-diversity-enabled arm post MECH-269 V_s.
claims.DV: z_goal norm at warmup end and |HABIT_harm_rate - PLANNED_harm_rate| as a FUNCTION of harm dominance -- the dose-response slope and the benign-arm contrast, not the absolute values in the chronic cell alone.
claims.instrument: Present but never used this way. v3_exq_249/268/406/434 all record goal_norm, behavioral_equivalence, harm_rate and accumulated_harm per seed; none of them instantiates more than one environment configuration, so no run emits the contrast the claim asserts.
claims.consumer_locus: The environment-to-substrate pathway -- chronic harm dominance acting on SD-011/SD-012 benefit-exposure seeding -- and its behavioural consequence, not internal damage to the agent.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Mode diversity must be available so that HABIT/PLANNED equivalence can in principle be violated, and the environment's harm dominance must be an independently varied factor. Under the V_s monostrategy lock the policy is collapsed regardless of harm density, so behavioural equivalence near 1.0 is a property of the substrate rather than of the depressive attractor.
claims.blocking_reason: All four 'independent replications' run one environment configuration (8x8, 1 resource, 3 hazards, hazard_harm 0.02) with HABIT and PLANNED as the only arms. The claim's independent variable -- harm dominance -- is never varied, so seven supports and zero fails rest on a design with no comparator on the thing being claimed.

claims.claim_title: Does the hazard/resource ratio (not absolute harm intensity) determine the onset threshold for the computational depression attractor?
claims.falsifier_summary: Onset is set by absolute hazard intensity regardless of resource density (a horizontal boundary), or resource enrichment rescues at no fixed hazard level.
claims.required_event: A CausalGridWorldV2 parameter sweep in which the agent reaches resources at some (hazard, resource) settings and enters the INV-053 depression attractor at others.
claims.manipulation: Hold hazard_harm fixed and vary resource density (num_resources) against hazard density (num_hazards) on a grid, so absolute harm intensity and the hazard/resource ratio are dissociated.
claims.control: Cells at matched absolute hazard_harm but different resource density, and cells at matched ratio but different absolute intensity, so a horizontal boundary and a ratio iso-line make different predictions.
claims.DV: The shape of the attractor-onset boundary in (hazard, resource) space -- whether onset (behavioural flattening, HABIT==PLANNED, goal_reach_rate collapse) tracks a ratio iso-line or a horizontal intensity threshold.
claims.instrument: v3_exq_451_q034_hazard_resource_threshold_retest.py and v3_exq_526_q034_reef_threshold_sweep.py both record goal_reach_rate and action_class_entropy per grid point; the recorders are adequate, the behaviour they record is not.
claims.consumer_locus: Environmental parameter ratio -> operating-mode selection -> INV-053 attractor entry, at the policy/operating-mode boundary rather than at any single harm channel.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The agent must show behavioural variation across grid cells -- non-zero goal_reach_rate and non-zero action_class_entropy in at least the resource-rich cells. EXQ-451 read 0.0 on both in 15 of 15 cells, which makes any boundary shape unreadable.
claims.blocking_reason: V_s monostrategy lock-in collapses every grid cell into one operating mode, so resource density cannot move behaviour and no boundary shape is readable. MECH-269 is marked implemented and ready:true but its own post_implementation_validation_status is wired_but_inert -- the V_s commit-release and freeze-recommit read hooks are dead on this env.
false_positives: Reading MECH-269 as a landed blocker because its substrate_queue status is implemented and ready:true is wrong: the same entry records post_implementation_validation_status wired_but_inert and vs_commit_release_count=0 in both arms, so the precondition the WWA names is still unmet.
claims.auditor_notes: Coordinator: MECH-269's implemented/ready:true pair is the single most misleading status in this batch -- it makes Q-034, SD-029, SD-032b, SD-036 and INV-054 all read as unblocked. The operative blocker is loop/anchor read-side liveness, the same class of degeneracy Q-019 and Q-052 hit.
claims.what_would_answer:
An environmental-parameter sweep in CausalGridWorldV2 holding hazard_harm
constant and varying resource availability (num_resources / num_hazards),
measuring onset of the INV-053 depression attractor as a function of the
hazard/resource ratio rather than absolute harm intensity. ANSWER "yes -- the
ratio sets the threshold" if the attractor onset tracks a critical
hazard/resource ratio: a fixed hazard_harm level with sufficient resource
density does NOT enter the attractor while the SAME hazard_harm with
insufficient resources does, and the onset boundary in (hazard, resource)
space is a ratio iso-line rather than a horizontal hazard-intensity threshold.
ANSWER "no" if onset is governed by absolute hazard intensity independent of
resource density (a horizontal boundary), or if resource enrichment fails to
rescue at any fixed hazard level. HARD PRECONDITION (the EXQ-451 failure
mode): the agent must exhibit behavioural variation across the grid -- EXQ-451
produced goal_reach_rate=0.0 and action_class_entropy=0.0 in all 15/15 grid

one operating mode, making the sweep blind to any threshold. The test is
vacuous until MECH-269 V_s landing unlocks alternative operating modes so that
resource density can actually move behaviour; a sweep where every cell is
monostrategy-locked cannot answer the ratio-vs-intensity question regardless
of outcome.

claims.claim_title: Mutual frame-maintenance signaling is necessary for play to function as distinct from manipulation: unilateral play declaration without partner agreement masks real harm as synthetic.
claims.falsifier_summary: A unilateral declaration by A suffices to have both agents' harm/residue machinery treat the interaction as non-harmful even with B's signal withdrawn -- an OR-gate rather than the asserted AND-gate.
claims.required_event: A paired-agent interaction in which one agent asserts the play frame while the second agent's frame-maintenance signal is present, withheld, or withdrawn mid-episode.
claims.manipulation: Withhold or withdraw agent B's frame signal while agent A continues asserting the frame, and compare against mutually sustained framing and against an unframed real-harm episode.
claims.control: Matched real-harm episode with no play framing at all, and a mutually-sustained-frame episode, at matched interaction content and seeds.
claims.DV: Whether each agent's harm/residue-update machinery suppresses real-harm learning: B's harm/residue updates under withdrawn framing should be indistinguishable from the matched unframed real-harm episode, not from the mutually framed one.
claims.instrument: Neither substrate exists. ree_core has no play-frame signalling channel (zero hits for play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, ambiguity_threshold) and no multi-agent environment; the only proposal, ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, is candidate at implementation_phase v5.
claims.consumer_locus: A two-party AND gate on the harm/residue update path -- the bilateral analogue of MECH-094's one-party hypothesis_tag write-gating, which is built and load-bearing (87 hypothesis_tag references in agent.py).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A partner capable of independently withholding or withdrawing the frame signal off-script must exist; with a complicit scripted experimenter, unilateral assertion and mutual agreement are experimentally indistinguishable, so the claim's distinctive content cannot be probed at all.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim's content is bilateral by construction and V3 is single-agent with a complicit scripted environment, so it has no V3-testable slice even in principle; the multi-agent substrate it needs is ARC-047, registered at phase v5, and the play-frame channel is unbuilt as well.
false_positives: INV-059 is often bundled with ARC-049 as if it shared ARC-049's V3-degenerate slice; it does not -- ARC-049's slice tests the agent's own policy, which needs no partner, while INV-059's clause needs one.
claims.auditor_notes: Correctly out of the V3 experimental pool: the right boundary is a multi-agent environment where a partner's frame signal is autonomous, i.e. ARC-047 at V5, with the play-frame channel as a prerequisite.
claims.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this claim requires TWO substrates, neither of
which exists in V3. (a) A play-frame-signaling channel distinct from
MECH-094's hypothesis tag -- the play_frame_tag / L1 (frame_open/
frame_close) / L3 (ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair) architecture
named in ARC-049's notes. Confirmed UNIMPLEMENTED by direct search of
ree_core (2026-08, re-confirmed this session): zero occurrences of
play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold
anywhere in the substrate. (b) A multi-agent substrate in which a
second, autonomous agent can independently generate, monitor, or
withdraw a frame-maintenance signal. No such substrate exists
anywhere in ree_core; the only proposal (ARC-047, SocialGridWorld) is
status: candidate, confidence: 0.0, implementation_phase: v5.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is stricter than ARC-049's own
gate. ARC-049 has a testable V3-degenerate slice (single-agent,
experimenter-scripted signal, testing whether the tag is load-bearing
for the agent's OWN policy) precisely BECAUSE that slice does not
require a second agent. INV-059's claim is specifically about the
MUTUAL/BILATERAL property -- "unilateral... without partner
agreement" is only a meaningful distinction when there is a partner
capable of independently agreeing or disagreeing. With a scripted,
complicit experimenter standing in for the partner (V3's degenerate
case), the "partner" can never withhold or withdraw its signal except
on the experimenter's own schedule -- so unilateral assertion and
mutual agreement are experimentally indistinguishable. INV-059
therefore has NO V3-testable slice at all, unlike ARC-049; both
preconditions (a) and (b) must hold before any evidence bears on it.

STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE (per this claim's own notes, drawing the MECH-094
parallel explicitly): MECH-094 confirmed that internal hypothesis-
tagging is load-bearing via a write-gate mechanism -- roughly 30 call
sites in agent.py gate weight updates on the tag's state. The
play-frame gate this claim requires is the BILATERAL analogue:
instead of one internal tag gating one agent's own learning, the
harm/residue-update machinery of EACH agent must gate on BOTH
agents' frame-maintenance signals jointly -- a two-party AND, not a
one-party flag.

CONFIRMING evidence (once both substrates exist): in a paired-agent
setup, the harm/residue-update machinery suppresses real-harm
learning ONLY when BOTH agents' frame-maintenance signals (L1 open +
L2 ongoing + L3 repair, as applicable) are mutually sustained. If
agent A's frame signal is present but agent B's is absent, withheld,
or withdrawn mid-episode, B's harm/residue machinery treats the
interaction as real -- statistically indistinguishable from a matched
real-harm episode with no play framing at all.

FALSIFYING evidence (the exploit this invariant warns against): agent
A can unilaterally declare "this is play" and have the interaction
treated as non-harmful/non-learning by BOTH agents' harm/residue-
update machinery, even when agent B's frame-agreement signal is
absent or actively withdrawn -- the frame tag honored on the basis of
EITHER party's signal alone (an OR-gate) rather than requiring mutual
sustainment (an AND-gate).

SCOPE: a PASS establishes that the bilateral gate is functionally
load-bearing once built -- it does not, by itself, establish that no
other exploit path exists (e.g. a partner whose frame signal can be
spoofed rather than withheld is a distinct, unaddressed failure
mode). Status stays substrate_conditional regardless of outcome.

claims.claim_title: Existence has value sufficient to justify its continuation.
claims.falsifier_summary: Under those same non-degenerate conditions, the noise substitute produces no measurable degradation in committed hazard avoidance -- the harm machinery is architecturally decorative at the selection boundary. This would falsify the axiom's named architectural CONSEQUENCE, not the axiom itself.
claims.required_event: Trajectory selection episodes on a TRAINED substrate in which hazard-avoidance and a competing trained objective genuinely disagree across the candidate set, so that the harm term's contribution to ranking is contestable rather than dominant.
claims.manipulation: Replace the ResidueField / z_harm_s output feeding E3's harm-weighted scoring with a distribution-matched noise substitute, holding the candidate set, environment seed and all other channels fixed.
claims.control: Intact-signal arm on matched seeds, plus a state-blind action-generic baseline (measured rho_truth 0.021 against an intact 0.517) that bounds any shortcut by which ranking could track hazard without the signal.
claims.DV: SELECTION-level change in committed-trajectory hazard avoidance under the noise substitution relative to intact, reported against a pre-registered instrument-failure discriminator: the arm must additionally show that the intact signal carried recoverable current-tick hazard information (non-degenerate rho_truth), otherwise the null routes to substrate_not_ready rather than to weakens.
claims.instrument: ResidueField (ree_core/residue/field.py) and E3's harm heads (harm_eval_z_harm_head, compute_harm_forward_cost in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) exist and are wired; what is missing is a routable criterion, not a recorder. V3-EXQ-533's harm-stream ablation returned non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect and EVB-1368/EXP-0720 was refused at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 on a red-team blocking verdict.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 cross-candidate trajectory ranking and the downstream committed action -- the point at which the harm gradient is asserted to be information rather than noise; NOT the axiom's own truth, which is out of domain.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The harm term must not dominate the cross-candidate E3 score range -- EXP-0720's release_condition targets harm_term_range_share_of_score well below the 0.95 measured -- so a trained competing channel (z_world/E1/E2) actually contests selection; and the ablation target must be a channel whose path into ranking is candidate-DEPENDENT. z_harm_a fails that test: its only route into scoring is a candidate-uniform positive scalar gain and compute_harm_forward_cost does not take it at all (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py), so the residue/z_harm_s path is the only admissible target.
claims.blocking_reason: The falsifier does not discriminate in the reachable regime: the harm term is ~0.95 of the cross-candidate E3 score range and CausalGridWorldV2 redraws hazards per episode, so both criterion formulations are structurally satisfied and the falsifying world reads as instrument-not-ready. z_harm_a is additionally rank-invariant by arithmetic, so it is not a valid ablation target at all.
false_positives: The WWA treats V3-EXQ-533's non_contributory verdict as a fixable measurement design defect; GFLAG-0291 shows the defect is in the criterion's routability, so correcting the design alone would not have produced an informative result.

The WWA's blanket statement that the machinery is 'confirmed live and wired' is true but not sufficient: z_harm_a reaches ranking only as a candidate-uniform scalar gain, so for that stream the ablation target does not exist at the ranking level.
claims.auditor_notes: The rewrite is owed to governance, not to a queue session: GFLAG-0291 explicitly asks governance to restate the falsifier at the SELECTION level against a trained competing channel and to name the instrument failure it must be distinguished from. Two durable findings should be folded into the claim regardless (z_harm_a rank-invariance; action-generic baseline rho_truth 0.021 vs intact 0.517). The homeostatic-drive consequence (D1 / SD-012) is a separate unregistered consequence and stays out of scope.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): Axiom 2 as literally stated -- "existence is worth continuing... not derived from pleasure, utility, or purpose -- it is axiomatic" (five_axioms_foundations.md Axiom 2) -- is a foundational normative/metaphysical premise about the INTRINSIC value of existence itself. No REE experiment can prove or disprove that existence has intrinsic value; an experiment can only show that REE's architecture BEHAVES AS IF existence has value (treats harm/terminal-state signals as informative rather than arbitrary), never that existence really does carry value independent of any valuing agent. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
LIVE UNCERTAINTY ON THE AXIOM'S OWN STATUS (do not silently resolve): the doc's own Open Questions table flags this directly -- Q-031 "Is Axiom 2 (existence has value) truly axiomatic, or is it derivable from Axiom 1 + Axiom 4? Does vulnerability alone generate value, or must value be stipulated?" The 2026-04-07 revision itself only states Axiom 2 was "implicit" in the original five-axiom compression, not that it is settled as independently axiomatic rather than derivable. This claim registers the axiom as currently stated in the canonical doc; it does not adjudicate Q-031.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked; per INV-025's precedent note, check what the architectural-consequence machinery actually requires rather than defaulting to substrate_conditional): the axiom's own text names the consequence directly -- "this axiom makes the harm gradient non-arbitrary: harm matters because existence matters. If existence had no value, harm signals would be noise rather than information." The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's harm-gradient/residue machinery actually function as a signal ABOUT something that matters -- i.e. is it functionally load-bearing for commitment/self-preservation-relevant behaviour and connected to genuine consequences -- or is it architecturally indistinguishable from noise that could be swapped out with no behavioural effect. (Architectural Mapping table, row "2. Existence has value": "Harm gradient non-arbitrariness, homeostatic drive grounding" -- this claim's testable leg covers the first consequence named; the second, homeostatic drive/terminal-state avoidance (D1, SD-012), is a separate, not-yet-registered consequence and is out of scope here.)
MACHINERY CONFIRMED LIVE AND WIRED (2026-08-07 digestion pass, INV-006/INV-007 audits, this session): ResidueField (ree_core/residue/field.py), z_harm_a/z_harm_s, the amygdala BLA/CeA analogue (SD-035), and dACC (MECH-258) are confirmed live, and INV-007's audit traces their reach into E3's harm-weighted trajectory scoring (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py). So the causal PATHWAY the axiom's consequence requires -- harm signal -> trajectory evaluation -- exists structurally; this is a precondition for the leg being testable at all, not itself confirming evidence for non-arbitrariness.
STRUCTURAL SUPPORT ALREADY ON RECORD (ARC-024, provisional): EXQ-028 PASS and EXQ-029 PASS (2026-03-18), reconfirmed on genuinely-trained substrate by V3-EXQ-032d PASS 5/5 (2026-07-29), show the world generates a genuine, spatially graded proxy-gradient field (not a binary/ decorative contact-only signal) and that E3.harm_eval learns a graded danger model extending backward from contact to approach (none=0.373/approach=0.612/contact=0.666, EXQ-029). This is evidence that the WORLD-MODEL layer of the harm signal is structured and learnable, not noise -- but it is not yet the specific ablation/ noise-substitution contrast this claim's falsifier requires (see next).
OPEN FALSIFIER, NOT YET CLEANLY TESTED: V3-EXQ-533 (mech102_harm_stream_ablation, 2026-05-06) attempted a harm-stream ablation in this space but returned verdict "non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect" -- inconclusive due to a measurement/design defect, not informative in either direction. claims.claim_title: Play mode operates by substituting synthetic z_goal and z_harm signals while permitting full learning flow through E3/E2/E1 as if signals were real.
claims.falsifier_summary: Play episodes reproduce the simulation arm (writes effectively suppressed), or z_harm shows no threshold elevation (full suppression or unchanged threshold), or synthetic z_goal tracks flat or entropy-derived magnitude rather than learning-progress rate.
claims.required_event: A play episode: an episode-scoped frame in which z_goal and z_harm are supplied synthetically while the agent still acts, commits and updates, followed by matched real-signal episodes.
claims.manipulation: Turn the play-frame tag on for an episode so synthetic z_goal (learning-progress weighted) and synthetic z_harm are substituted for the real signals, with writes ADMITTED rather than suppressed; sweep the harm escalation threshold between the play and non-play settings.
claims.control: Matched real-signal (non-play) episodes at identical curriculum position, plus a simulation-mode arm in which the same synthetic signals are supplied but writes are SUPPRESSED (the existing simulation_mode=True path) -- play must differ from both.
claims.DV: Three quantities: (a) magnitude of E3/E2/E1 weight change per synthetic-signal episode relative to the suppressed-write simulation arm; (b) the z_harm escalation threshold at which harm-driven veto fires, play versus non-play; (c) correlation of synthetic z_goal magnitude with d(PE)/dt rather than with flat or entropy-derived magnitude.
claims.instrument: No play-side recorder exists. The nearest live instrument is MECH-319 SimulationModeRuleGate per-site counters (n_waking_admitted, n_simulation_blocked, n_simulation_admitted) in ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/simulation_mode_rule_gate.py, which records write admission under a categorical synthetic tag but only at the rule-arbitration layer (gated_policy, lateral_pfc), not at E3/E2/E1.
claims.consumer_locus: The write-admission boundary under a synthetic-signal tag: whether the frame tag gates learning flow into E3 trajectory competence, E2 forward model and E1 world model, rather than episode reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Play and non-play episodes must be otherwise identical (same observation stream, same candidate actions, same total update budget, same harm exposure), and E3/E2/E1 must show non-zero weight change in the non-play arm, so that a difference in learning dynamics is attributable to the frame tag and not to a dead update path.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate a play episode at all: no play-frame tag, no synthetic z_goal seeding, no episode-scoped raised harm threshold anywhere in ree_core. The one related primitive that DOES exist (MECH-319 admit_writes) admits synthetic-tagged writes only at the rule-arbitration layer, so even a hand-built play arm would not reach the E3/E2/E1 locus the claim asserts.
false_positives: The cluster-wide diagnosis that V3 has NO synthetic-versus-real write primitive is now wrong: MECH-319's SimulationModeRuleGate implements exactly a categorical synthetic tag whose admit_writes=True branch admits writes under that tag, which is structurally the play-frame authorisation MECH-194 posits -- but only at the rule-arbitration layer.
claims.auditor_notes: The V3 play-substrate build is named precisely in developmental_dmn_v4:DMN-3's readiness_gate (ARC-049 play_frame_tag in LatentState, MECH-194 synthetic seeding with raised harm threshold, INV-059 frame-drop trigger) but DMN-3 is itself status blocked ON that build, so the build has a specification and no owner node -- an edge gap, not an unwritten prerequisite. simulation (gradients suppressed) -- collapses play into simulation,
contradicting "play is authorized-synthetic learning, not

claims.control: No-play arm at identical curriculum position and identical total update count, plus a play arm whose synthetic calibration equals the real calibration (so any transfer difference cannot be attributed to calibration mismatch alone).
claims.DV: Two dissociable quantities: (a) real-episode goal-pursuit performance of play-trained E3/E2 weights versus the no-play arm; (b) post-close values of the two magnitude scalars -- GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain and REEConfig.contextual_safety_harm_threshold -- measured against the real drive and harm signals rather than the synthetic values held during play.
claims.instrument: No play-side instrument exists. The magnitude side now has concrete named scalars to read (z_goal_seeding_gain in ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py, dynamically modulated by the MECH-187 serotonin path; contextual_safety_harm_threshold in ree-v3/ree_core/utils/config.py); the transfer side would use ordinary checkpoint/arm-reuse evaluation. Nothing records a play-close recalibration event because MECH-196 is unbuilt.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Play and no-play agents must reach a common downstream real-task evaluation at matched total update budget, and the two outcomes must be independently movable: policy-structure transfer and magnitude calibration must be carried by separable parameters, or the dissociation cannot be measured as two results rather than one.
claims.blocking_reason: The whole play arm is absent: no play frame, no synthetic seeding, and MECH-196's close-time recalibration event is registered with no what_would_answer, no substrate and no experiment, so the moment at which re-anchoring is supposed to happen does not exist to be observed.

calibration," "harm threshold calibration") does not correspond to
an existing scalar variable in the current E3/goal architecture --

MSE-distance to a z_goal POSITION vector, not by a magnitude scalar.

values the agent operated under during play.

no measurable real-episode advantage; (ii) CALIBRATION LEAKAGE --

disposition.

claims.claim_title: Play mode boundary requires a co-maintained context tag held by both agent and environment; agent-internal tagging alone is insufficient and unilateral play assertion without mutual signal is manipulation.

claims.required_event: A play episode with an injected aggression-adjacent action at an ambiguity juncture, bracketed by experimenter-scripted L1 frame open/close events and an L2 persistent frame flag.

SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: the play_frame_tag mechanism named in this claim's
own notes (persistent L2 flag in LatentState, L1 frame_open/frame_close
events, L3 ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair signals) is UNIMPLEMENTED
in V3 -- confirmed by direct search of ree_core (2026-08): zero occurrences
of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere
in the substrate. No experiment has exercised this mechanism. Everything
below is gated on building it first.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- WHAT IS AND IS NOT TESTABLE IN THE V3
DEGENERATE CASE: per this claim's own notes, V3's environment is
experimenter-complicit by design (the experimenter scripts play-mode
signals rather than a partner agent generating them autonomously). This
means:
  - TESTABLE IN V3 (single-agent, experimenter-scripted signal): whether
    the agent's OWN behavior differentially responds to L1 (frame open/
    close) and L3 (repair) events that the experimenter injects on a
    schedule. This tests whether play_frame_tag is load-bearing for the
    agent's own policy, not whether it is legible to or co-maintained
    with a partner.
  - NOT TESTABLE IN V3, REQUIRES V4/MULTI-AGENT: whether the tag is
    genuinely BILATERAL -- externally legible to and monitored by a
    partner that can independently initiate a frame violation or a
    repair, rather than following an experimenter's script. This is
    specifically the clause "unilateral play assertion without mutual
    signal is manipulation" (INV-059). A scripted experimenter can only
    ever cooperate with the frame; it cannot play the role of a partner
    who is deceived by a unilateral assertion, so the manipulation
    signature cannot be produced or falsified in V3. Sibling questions
    Q-050 and Q-051 already establish this precondition explicitly for
    games-with-rules and cooperative play, and the same reasoning
    applies to ARC-049's own bilateral clause.

CONFIRMING signature (V3-testable slice, once play_frame_tag is built):
following the Q-048/Q-049 pattern, inject an aggression-adjacent action
(bite-shake or equivalent) at an ambiguity juncture, with two arms --
(1) L3 repair signal present immediately after the action, (2) L3 repair
signal withheld. Measure post-juncture behavior (continuation of
play-typical action selection vs escalation/withdrawal consistent with a
real-harm read). ANSWER "genuine frame-tracking" if behavior differs
measurably between arms in the direction predicted by Bekoff 1995's
non-random repair-signal placement, at or above an effect-size floor
across >=2/3 seeds. This also requires L1 (frame open/close) to produce a
detectable behavioral state change on its own, as a baseline check that
the tag is read at all before testing L3's selective effect.

FALSIFYING signature: behavior at ambiguity junctures is statistically
indistinguishable between L3-present and L3-absent arms (and/or L1
open/close events produce no detectable behavioral change) -- the
play_frame_tag is tracked internally but not load-bearing for action
selection, i.e. decorative rather than functional. This would falsify the
V3-testable slice without touching the bilateral/manipulation clause,
which remains open regardless (see below).

SCOPE OF WHAT A PASSING V3 RESULT WOULD AND WOULD NOT ESTABLISH: a PASS
on the confirming signature above would show a co-maintained-style tag CAN
be functionally load-bearing for an agent's own behavior. It would NOT
confirm the full claim as titled -- the bilateral co-maintenance
requirement and the "unilateral assertion is manipulation" clause are
untestable without a partner agent capable of independently violating or
repairing the frame (V4 multi-agent, per INV-059 and Q-050/Q-051). The
full claim stays substrate_conditional/open even if the V3 slice passes.

claims.claim_title: Play dominates the child developmental phase; the type of play progresses as subsystem competence develops, systematically training architectural components in dependency order.
claims.falsifier_summary: Play allocation is comparable to or a minority of other modes (dominance clause fails), or skipping/reordering produces no deficit (dependency-order clause fails) -- recorded as demoting the surviving half rather than as a single binary verdict.
claims.required_event: A child-phase curriculum in which play occupies a measurable share of the episode budget and the play type advances through sensorimotor, constructive, pretend, rule-based and cooperative stages.
claims.manipulation: Two joined manipulations: measure budget allocation to play absent override (dominance), and skip or reorder one play type relative to the canonical order (dependency order), following MECH-197's ablation design rather than duplicating it.
claims.control: Canonical-order arm at matched total episodes and matched compute, plus a no-override baseline for the dominance measurement so allocation is a scheduler outcome and not a hard-coded constant.
claims.DV: Share of child-phase episodes allocated to play, and the subsystem-competence deficit in the stage following a skipped or reordered type, measured against the canonical-order arm at matched experience.
claims.instrument: Partially present but at the wrong stage: experiments/infant_curriculum.py implements a four-phase INFANT scheduler (episode-count plus telemetry gates) at the experiment layer, with no child phase, no play modes and no type ordering; ree_core has no curriculum scheduler at all.
claims.consumer_locus: The developmental curriculum scheduler's mode allocation during the child phase, and the competence prerequisites each play type is asserted to install for the next.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Play types must be distinct and orderable in the substrate (not relabelled episodes of one mode) and a curriculum scheduler must allocate child-phase budget across modes; otherwise the dominance clause measures a scheduler constant and the ordering clause has nothing to permute.
claims.blocking_reason: Neither joined prediction can be exercised: there is no play mode, no play-type taxonomy and no child-phase scheduler in ree_core, and the only scheduler that exists is an experiment-layer infant-stage helper with four non-play phases.
false_positives: Reading INV-060 as having no scheduler precedent at all is wrong: the infant curriculum scheduler is a working four-phase, telemetry-gated exemplar at the experiment layer, so the child-phase version is an extension rather than a new class of machinery.
claims.auditor_notes: Leg (b) is the same testable content as MECH-197, so the two must not be given separate experiments; INV-060's distinctive content is the dominance clause, which needs the scheduler rather than the play types.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: play-mode substrate confirmed entirely unbuilt (re-verified 2026-08-08, zero hits for play_frame_tag/play_mode/synthetic_z_goal in ree_core/). Two joined predictions: (a) DOMINANCE -- play is the dominant child-phase behavioral mode, measurable once a curriculum scheduler exists; (b) TYPE PROGRESSION -- sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative, each training the next stage's prerequisites. Leg (b) is the same testable content as sibling claim MECH-197 -- cross-reference its ablation design rather than duplicating.
CONFIRMING: scheduler allocates majority child-phase budget to play absent override, AND skipping an earlier play type produces measurable subsystem-competence deficits in the next type. FALSIFYING: comparable/minority play allocation (dominance clause fails) OR no deficit from skipping/reordering (dependency-order clause fails) -- record as demoting the surviving half rather than a binary pass/fail, given the two-part title.

claims.claim_title: Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.
claims.falsifier_summary: Either pretend-play dose has no measurable effect at all (base MECH-198 mechanism does not hold), or the failure signatures are statistically independent across agents (no above-chance co-occurrence), which falsifies the UNIFIED-ETIOLOGY assertion without falsifying MECH-200/201/202 individually.
claims.required_event: A developmental curriculum in which pretend-play exposure is dosed (zero / intermediate / full) with all other developmental exposure held constant, followed by adult-phase probes that can elicit both confusion directions (real-to-synthetic and synthetic-to-real) in the same agent.
claims.manipulation: Vary pretend-play dose across a population of otherwise matched agents, so that the co-operation of hypothesis_tag and play_frame_tag during the play epoch is undertrained by a graded amount.
claims.control: Full-dose pretend-play agents, matched on seeds, total training ticks, environment exposure and reward schedule; plus a dose-zero arm to anchor the gradient endpoint.
claims.DV: Per-agent joint distribution over failure signatures: rate of real-to-synthetic misclassification, rate of synthetic-to-real misclassification, and per-subsystem degradation (frame tag, commitment gate, threat evaluation), scored so above-chance CO-OCCURRENCE within agents can be distinguished from independent per-subsystem degradation, plus a dose-response gradient on breadth and severity.
claims.instrument: Absent. No dose-variable pretend-play curriculum exists in ree-v3/experiments/, and no recorder emits a per-agent multi-signature vector; the nearest existing telemetry is hypothesis_tag propagation diagnostics, which record one tag's flow and not a cross-subsystem failure profile.
claims.consumer_locus: The developmental frame-distinction mechanism itself (joint hypothesis_tag/play_frame_tag training), asserted to be the SHARED substrate whose undertraining produces several downstream clinical-analog failure modes -- not any one downstream subsystem.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both frame tags must be co-activatable and dose-varied: MECH-094's agent-internal hypothesis_tag is confirmed live and load-bearing (ree_core/amygdala/bla.py, cea.py, pfc/ofc_analog.py, hippocampal/module.py, residue/field.py), but ARC-049's play_frame_tag has zero hits in ree_core/ (the only 'play_mode'-shaped string is the false positive _diverse_replay_mode_counts). The unifying leg additionally requires each agent to be scoreable on several distinct failure signatures at once, not one aggregate count.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate the required event: ARC-049 play_frame_tag and the pretend-play curriculum (MECH-198) are absent from ree_core/, so the manipulation has nothing to dose. Secondary: even given the event, no instrument emits the per-agent multi-signature co-occurrence vector the unifying leg needs.
claims.auditor_notes: The clinical leg (that human derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity and commitment paralysis share this etiology) is external_only and the claim's own SCOPE NOTE already says so; only the architectural leg is V3-shaped. FRAME-TAG in psychiatric_failure_modes_plan.md is open/high but has no substrate_queue entry, which is where the missing edge sits.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: gated on TWO things -- MECH-198's own full precondition (co-activatable hypothesis_tag + play_frame_tag, dose-varied pretend-play curriculum; see MECH-198's own what_would_answer for that build list), AND a further requirement specific to this claim's UNIFYING structure: the same undertrained agents must be scoreable on multiple distinct failure signatures at once (both confusion directions + multiple affected subsystems), not just one aggregate count. Only MECH-094 (agent- internal hypothesis_tag) is built (confirmed 2026-08-08, load-bearing throughout agent.py/amygdala/pfc/hippocampal/predictors); ARC-049 (play_frame_tag), MECH-197/198/ 200/201/202, and INV-055 are all confirmed unbuilt. No dose-variable pretend-play experiment exists anywhere in the codebase.
CONFIRMING: within one population of agents varying pretend-play dose (other developmental exposure held constant), the SAME undertrained agents show BOTH confusion directions and a subsystem-degradation pattern that predicts which clinical-analog failure mode dominates for that agent (dissociation, not uniform degradation), plus a dose-response gradient (intermediate dose -> intermediate severity/breadth).
FALSIFYING: either the base MECH-198 mechanism doesn't hold (pretend-play dose has no measurable effect), OR the resulting failure modes are STATISTICALLY INDEPENDENT across agents (no above-chance co-occurrence) -- falsifies the UNIFIED-ETIOLOGY claim specifically ("different failure signatures of the same mechanism") WITHOUT falsifying any individual downstream mechanism (MECH-200/201/202) on its own, each of which could still independently hold as correct for its own failure mode.
SCOPE NOTE (preserving this claim's existing domain-modelling carve-out): even a full PASS on the confirming signature above establishes only that REE's own architecture instantiates a common-substrate pattern for these failure signatures -- it does NOT by itself establish that human derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share this etiology. That further step requires the domain-modelling assumption already flagged in this claim's notes (that REE's frame-distinction architecture correctly models human developmental frame-distinction) -- a separate, currently unverified premise this claim does not itself test.

claims.required_event: Real-consequence operation under an ambiguous frame signal -- a situation whose frame membership (real or synthetic) is genuinely underdetermined, with real harm present.
claims.manipulation: Vary the developmental pretend-play exposure that is supposed to calibrate the real/synthetic decision boundary, then measure the adult default under ambiguity; the crude lesion substitute is to force the synthetic tag on waking ticks.
claims.control: Adequately-play-exercised agent at matched budget under identical ambiguous-frame trials, plus unambiguous real-frame trials in both groups to show the deficit is specific to ambiguity rather than to harm processing generally.

claims.instrument: Absent at the required boundary. simulation_mode is a caller-supplied boolean at every site (ree_core/agent.py, amygdala/bla.py, comparator/suffering_derivative_comparator.py), never inferred, so no tagging DECISION is recorded and no misclassification rate can be computed. claims.blocking_reason: V3 has no ambiguous-frame event and no frame INFERENCE: simulation_mode is passed as an argument, so the tag is correct by construction and the real->synthetic error cannot arise. claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Replay must actually fire at a non-zero rate and the write sites downstream of it must show non-zero weight change when writes ARE admitted; if the replay-driven path is inert, admitting its writes changes nothing and the lesion cannot discriminate.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
MECH-204 states a MECHANISM but has never stated its own falsification
conditions -- not the DV, not the required drift source, not the timescale at
which the correction must act. Every test to date has had to invent all three,
and each invention was wrong in a DIFFERENT way (EXQ-541 within-cycle no-op;
541a/541b under-powered timescale; V3-EXQ-596/602 scored on a cluster criterion
that is not a MECH-204 prediction; V3-EXQ-774 tautological DV; V3-EXQ-794
clamped drift source). That signature diversity is a SPECIFICATION gap, not a
granularity gap -- /claim-synthesis 2026-07-22
(claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-22.md sec 1c) REFUSED to decompose MECH-204 on
exactly this ground: classifying the cluster by the autopsies' own
four_layer_diagnosis yields ZERO non-degenerate substrate-ready FAIL signatures
and not one target carries `weakened`. This block supplies the three missing
objects so they are not re-invented a sixth time.

(a) THE DRIFT SOURCE -- now SD-076 (`use_waking_confidence_inflation`),
registered separately 2026-07-20 because it is the SOURCE while MECH-204 is the
CORRECTION, and the two must be independently ablatable. A MECH-204 test is
ADMISSIBLE ONLY WITH AN ACTIVE, DEMONSTRATED DRIFT SOURCE. "Sleep recalibrates
waking precision drift" is unfalsifiable if waking precision cannot drift, so a
null measured without live drift is a TAUTOLOGY, not evidence (V3-EXQ-774). The
drift must be shown live IN THE RUN -- a strict dose separation on the drift
variable between arms -- BEFORE the correction is scored. SD-076 currently has
NO usable headroom: V3-EXQ-794 pinned `rv_final` at exactly 0.010000 on all four
inflation arms, with `overconfidence_score` bit-identical to 15 significant
figures (-1.004111904519277) at the LO and HI asymmetry levels. MECH-204 is
therefore NOT ANSWERABLE until `sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands
(separate /implement-substrate chip), followed by the V3-EXQ-794a re-run.

(b) THE PRECISION DV, AND THE NON-TAUTOLOGY BURDEN. ANY proposed DV must be
shown non-tautological BEFORE it is used. The paid lesson is V3-EXQ-774: a
SYMMETRIC precision EMA makes `running_variance` track true prediction error BY
CONSTRUCTION, pinning `overconfidence_score` near zero regardless of what is
ablated (774 measured -0.000148 and -0.000918). The DV must be a quantity whose
value can be driven materially away from the calibrated point by the drift
source ALONE, with the correction ablated. Discharge the burden in-run by
showing (i) the drift-on / correction-off arm moves the DV materially away from
calibration, and (ii) two drift doses produce DIFFERENT DV values beyond float
noise -- identical values at two nominally different doses are a SATURATION
fingerprint, not a null (V3-EXQ-794). The Phase 7 / Option B write-site in
PRECISION space (not E3-score space) is correct and must not be revisited; it is
what escapes the V3-EXQ-604c DV-invariance class.

(c) THE MINIMUM TIMESCALE IS RESOLVED, NOT OPEN: >= 16 sleep cycles per arm.
Measured -- do not re-derive it. At 4 cycles (541a/541b) cross-arm rv divergence
tops out at 1.75% against a 5% bar (inconclusive_timescale: the rv EMA damping
overwhelms the per-cycle nudge). At 16 cycles (541c; sleep_loop_K=1,
EPISODES_PER_RUN=16, precision_zero_point_ema_alpha=0.1) divergence is monotone
in step size -- 0.90% / 1.81% / 4.51% / ~10% at step 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.25 / 0.50 --
and step=0.50 clears the 5% C4 bar in 3/3 seeds, with C1-C4 PASS overall. A
MECH-204 run at fewer than 16 cycles per arm is under-powered BY MEASUREMENT and
its null carries no weight.

ANSWERS MECH-204 (5-HT withdrawal actively CALIBRATES the zero-point, not merely
permits recalibration) if, with the drift source demonstrably live and the DV
shown non-tautological, at >= 16 cycles per arm the recalibration-ON arm returns
the precision DV toward the cumulative zero-point reference relative to the
drift-only arm, with a monotone dose-response in
`rem_precision_recalibration_step` and sign consistency across seeds.

REFUTES MECH-204 if, under those same admissibility conditions, the correction
fires every cycle (C1) and adjusts with the correct sign (C2) yet leaves the
drifted DV statistically indistinguishable from the drift-only arm across the
defensible step range {0.05, 0.10, 0.25} -- i.e. 5-HT withdrawal is PERMISSIVE
only, and MECH-123 needs no zero-point term.

DOES NOT ANSWER IT EITHER WAY: any run whose overall outcome is decided by a
cluster-integration criterion that is not a MECH-204 prediction. V3-EXQ-596/602
FAILED on cluster_live_frac, a MECH-285 / GAP-3 criterion, while STRENGTHENING
MECH-204 on its own C1+C3 (recalibration fired every cycle in 3/3 seeds; 8.4-27.6%
rv divergence at 12 cycles).

NO TIMESCALE CHILD CLAIM IS WARRANTED NOW -- 541c already answered it. A
`recalibration_timescale` child becomes warranted ONLY IF, after
`sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands and V3-EXQ-794a runs, the
correction fails on CYCLE COUNT again. Registering one now would mint an untested
claim from a resolved problem.

claims.previous_what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- read this before configuring any run; the shipped
default is the known-vacuous setting. surprise_gated_replay defaults to False
(config.py:3423). [corrected 2026-09-10, GFLAG-0203] The former 0.001 threshold
trap is CLOSED: pe_surprise_threshold now defaults to 1e-5 (config.py:3438,
promoted by GFLAG-0075, ree-v3 2fdf721 2026-09-01 / restored 26ae2a7 2026-09-02).
The liveness assertions below still stand and must still be made from measured
output, not config. The gate
must therefore assert, from measured run output and not from config: (a)
surprise_gated_replay=True AND valence_enabled=True; (b) a NON-ZERO count of
surprise writes to the residue field (EXQ-258b smoke reference: 64/100 steps);
(c) _pe_ema > 0 at the replay call so surprise_weight = min(1.0, _pe_ema * 5.0) is
not pinned at its 0.3 fallback (agent.py:9913-9917); (d) genuine PE VARIANCE
across episodes -- a flat PE stream makes any priority ordering unmeasurable
regardless of threshold. pe_ema_alpha was correctly fixed to 0.02 (~50-step
window); 0.1 is the known-too-fast value that drives surprise to zero.
CONFIRMING -- leg 1 (allocation, the claim's own three predictions): (i) replay
frequency of an episode correlates positively with its initial prediction-error
magnitude; (ii) replay of an episode DECREASES as the forward models improve on it
(the tapering / natural-termination signature); (iii) selectively blocking replay
of high-surprise episodes impairs model correction for the BLOCKED episodes
specifically, not globally. Prediction (iii) requires MECH-092's missing consumer;
(i) and (ii) are measurable today against replay start-selection.
CONFIRMING -- leg 2 (the priority RULE, and this is the discriminator): priority
tracks PE x NEED (Mattar & Daw 2018, Refinement D) -- i.e. a high-PE episode in a
region the agent will NOT revisit is DE-prioritised despite high gain.
Constructing exactly that cell (rare region, high PE, low revisit probability)
separates this claim from MECH-092, whose anti-recency framing (Gupta 2010, via
depends_on: MECH-289) predicts the OPPOSITE for the same cell -- replay it MORE
because it is under-sampled. Both rules are instantiated on the same drive_state
vector consumed by HippocampalModule.replay() start-selection, so at most one can
be operative. A single 3-cell probe (high-PE/high-need, high-PE/low-need,
low-PE/high-need) adjudicates both claims at once and is the highest-value
experiment this group affords.
CONFIRMING -- leg 3 (generative, not rote): replayed content consists of
hippocampally-constrained RECOMBINATIONS (forward + reverse segment composition,
Refinement C) rather than verbatim re-presentation, and the variations are
CONTRASTIVELY paired with the anchor episode (variations where the surprising
outcome did NOT occur), with the harm/goal valence asymmetry writing to the
avoidance vs approach map respectively (ARC-031).
FALSIFYING: with the threshold set to a value that demonstrably fires and PE
variance present, replay allocation is INDEPENDENT of prediction-error magnitude --
episodes selected by recency, uniformly, or by valence alone with no PE term --
which falsifies the surprise-gating core. Or: replay of an episode does NOT taper
as forward-model error on it drops (no convergence-based termination, falsifying
the natural-termination prediction and, clinically, the intrusive-replay reading).
Or: allocation tracks RAW PE with no need/relevance term, which falsifies
Refinement D specifically and hands the discriminator to MECH-092's anti-recency
rule. Or: replayed content is verbatim re-presentation with no counterfactual
variation, falsifying the generative half while leaving the gating half intact.
CROSS-REFERENCES -- do not re-derive. The hypothesis_tag requirement on every
generated variation (tag loss during generative replay = confabulation; tag loss
on high-affect replay = the PTSD-intrusion reading) is MECH-094's condition. WHEN
replay fires at all is MECH-092's. The downstream "does the corrected model help"
measurement is gated on MECH-092's missing replay-output consumer and must not be
posed as a fresh MECH-205 blocker.

claims.claim_title: CA1 acts as a PE-proportional comparator that writes episodes to the surprise buffer: mismatch between CA3 prediction and entorhinal actual input produces a graded signal that tags the episode for offline replay and suppresses retrieval of the now-erroneous prediction.
claims.falsifier_summary: Mismatch magnitude does not rank-order post-replay improvement, or the graded arm is indistinguishable from the binarised arm (the sharpest falsifier), or CA3-channel reliance does not fall with mismatch or falls symmetrically on the control channel.
claims.required_event: A tick on which a pattern-completed anchor prediction and an actual/variation representation are both present and disagree by a graded amount, followed by offline replay of the tagged episode.
claims.manipulation: Prioritise replay by graded CA1 mismatch magnitude, against a binarised match/mismatch version of the same comparator and against the incumbent staleness ranker, at matched seeds and matched replay budget.
claims.control: Arm (ii) MECH-285 staleness priority (ree-v3 ree_core/sleep/replay_sampler.py, the built incumbent) and arm (iii) the binarised CA1 priority, which is the claim's own stated null.
claims.DV: Spearman rank correlation between per-episode mismatch magnitude and post-replay forward-model improvement on that episode's content (rho >= 0.3, CI excluding 0, >= 6 seeds), plus forward-PE reduction per replay slot of the graded arm over the binarised arm; and for leg B the slope of CA3-channel reliance against mismatch magnitude with a matched control channel.
claims.instrument: Absent at the claim's locus. There is no CA1 module in ree_core/hippocampal or ree_core/sleep; the one comparator-ish path is fed pe_dict=None at ree_core/agent.py:5639 and degrades to a latent delta; and replay output is discarded -- _do_replay assigns replay_trajs at agent.py:10858-10865 and nothing reads it.
claims.consumer_locus: The write into the replay-priority queue and the gate on the pattern-completed channel into downstream selection, not post-hoc episode scoring.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Three conjuncts: a CA1-equivalent comparator with two genuinely distinct live channels (decorrelation floor |corr| < 0.95 and non-zero variance in each); the mismatch statistic must be forward prediction error rather than a latent delta; and replayed episodes must actually reach a consumer, reported as a non-zero count.
claims.blocking_reason: Replay output has no consumer at all (replay_trajs discarded), so every DV is unmeasurable; there is no two-channel CA1 comparator, and the nearest mismatch path receives pe_dict=None and therefore records a latent delta rather than prediction error.
claims.auditor_notes: substrate_queue entry mech092-replay-consumer-missing is REGISTRATION_ONLY_not_a_build_authorisation and is the shared root blocker for MECH-206 and MECH-271 in this batch: until replay reaches any consumer, neither replay-priority nor replay-routing can be measured.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three conjuncts, all measured on the run's own data; the run is
unreadable until all three hold).
(1) *Comparator exists and both channels are live.* A CA1-equivalent submodule must receive two
genuinely distinct inputs on the same tick -- a CA3-like pattern-completed anchor
representation and an entorhinal-like actual/variation representation -- and the run must
report non-zero cross-tick variance in BOTH channels separately, plus a channel-decorrelation
floor (|corr(ch_CA3, ch_EC)| < 0.95 over the window). A single-channel residual computed from
one stream is MECH-256's comparator, not this claim's: if only one channel varies, the run
self-routes `substrate_not_ready_requeue` and says nothing about MECH-206.
(2) *The mismatch statistic is PE, not a latent delta.* See MECH-288's own
`what_would_answer` LIVE GRADED-MISMATCH PRECONDITION -- do not re-derive it. The identical
hazard applies here: `agent.py:5448` currently passes `pe_dict=None` to the one comparator-ish
substrate that exists, which silently degrades it to `sum_s ||z_s(t) - z_s(t-1)||`
(`event_segmenter.py:139-142`). Any MECH-206 test must assert its mismatch input is forward
prediction error and record which quantity it used.
(3) *The consumer reads.* Replay output must be consumed by something. As of 2026-09-01
(`substrate_queue.json:mech092-replay-consumer-missing`, verified against source) `_do_replay`
discards `replay_trajs` and no reader exists in `ree_core/`, so every DV below is currently
unmeasurable. The run must report a non-zero count of replayed episodes that reached a
consumer; a zero here is a substrate verdict, never a claim verdict.

CONFIRMING (two legs; leg A is the priority claim, leg B the suppression claim -- the claim
is fully confirmed only by both, and leg A alone is the weaker "PE-tagging" reading).
*Leg A -- graded PE ranks replay, and does so better than the incumbent staleness ranker.*
Three arms at matched seeds and matched replay budget: (i) CA1-comparator PE-magnitude
priority; (ii) MECH-285 staleness priority (`replay_sampler.py`, the built incumbent); (iii)
BINARISED CA1 priority -- the same comparator thresholded to a match/mismatch flag, which is

requires"). CONFIRMED requires BOTH: (a) rank correlation between per-episode CA1 mismatch
magnitude and post-replay forward-model improvement on that episode's content, Spearman
rho >= 0.3 with the 95% CI excluding 0 across >= 6 seeds; AND (b) arm (i) beats arm (iii) on
forward-PE reduction per replay slot by a margin exceeding max(1.0 x SD of the per-seed delta,
an absolute floor of 2% relative), with consistent sign across seeds. Arm (ii) is reported as
the competitive baseline: MECH-206 is confirmed *as the priority signal* only if (i) is not
beaten by (ii); if (ii) wins, MECH-206 survives only as a tagging mechanism and the priority
claim is transferred to MECH-284/MECH-288.
*Leg B -- retrieval suppression (Bein 2020 bidirectional shift).* On high-mismatch ticks the
agent's reliance on the pattern-completed prediction must FALL within the same or the next
tick: the weight/gate on the CA3-like channel into downstream selection drops monotonically
with mismatch magnitude, with a non-zero negative slope whose CI excludes 0, and the effect
must be specific -- no equivalent drop on a matched control channel (the EC-like actual input,
which Bein 2020 predicts should go UP).

FALSIFYING.
With all three preconditions green: (a) mismatch magnitude does not rank-order post-replay
improvement (rho CI includes 0), OR the graded arm is statistically indistinguishable from the
BINARISED arm (iii) -- the latter is the sharpest falsifier available, because it directly
refutes the claim's load-bearing gradedness argument while leaving "CA1 tags surprising
episodes" intact; (b) the CA3-channel reliance does not fall with mismatch, or falls
symmetrically on the control channel (no bidirectional shift -- a generic arousal/gain effect,
not the claimed connectivity dissociation); (c) a CA1-specific lesion impairs forward replay
as much as it impairs buffer population (the claim's Predict-(1) requires the dissociation, not
just the impairment). Any of (a)+(b) together refutes the claim as stated; (a) alone with (b)
holding demotes it to "CA1 tags, something else ranks".

LOAD (C1 manipulation check differed by 8.8e-07 against a 0.01 threshold; sleep counts identical
across arms). Manipulation check, pre-registered as a gate BEFORE any DV is read: mean waking MEL
strictly monotone across the four intake arms with relative spread > 0.25 (the V3-EXQ-701c relative
criterion; the absolute ABS_MEL_FLOOR=1e-4 of 701c is structurally unreachable on a converged base
and must NOT be reused). Plus the producer's own reducibility control: elevated PE must DECAY within
a stationary window (assert against the emitted `steps_since_world_rule_shift`), and a matched-PE
observation-noise arm must NOT reproduce the DV pattern -- otherwise the ladder is grading noise and
any monotone DV is the DV-symmetry artifact SD-MEL-PRODUCER's design note names by that name.

(P2) THE OFFLINE BUDGET MUST BE PINNED, AND SHOWN PINNED. `use_mel_consumer=False`,
`use_entry_pressure=False`, `use_within_life_sleep_trigger=False` (all default False at
`ree_core/utils/config.py:6291/6337` and `mel_consumer.py`). Assert from output that
`cumulative_sws_writes` and `cumulative_rem_rollouts` have ZERO cross-arm variance -- the exact
scheduler-pinned property (SWS=80/REM=60) that V3-EXQ-677 recorded as a defect for MECH-180 is the
control this claim requires. Without it, low intake -> low MEL -> shorter sleep -> worse function is
the consumer's arithmetic, not this invariant; see INV-050's own what_would_answer on that degeneracy
and failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-718a_2026-07-08's "the producer must be validated with the consumer ABSENT".

(P3) SLEEP MUST ACTUALLY FIRE, AND THE OFFLINE PATHWAY MUST BE UNSILENCED. Multi-episode driver, so
`SleepLoopManager.notify_episode_end()` is reachable at all (sleep_substrate:GAP-9: under a true

(P4) THE TYPE-1/2 INSTRUMENT MUST BE LIVE. Do not re-derive this: see MECH-205's own
what_would_answer NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION verbatim (`surprise_gated_replay=True` AND

the trap it describes is closed; the liveness assertions themselves still stand and must still be made

(2026-08-02..08-04) found SWS_THEN_REM collapses `slot_cosine_sim` toward ~1.0 -- homogenisation, the

root cause still unresolved (see INV-049's what_would_answer, and the substrate_queue entry
`contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy`, status `implemented_pending_validation`). The Type-3
leg is therefore EXCLUDED from this falsifier (below) rather than measured through that instrument.

CONFIRMING (two legs, both at pinned offline budget, four intake arms
`world_rule_shift_interval` in {0 = never / long / medium / short}, >= 3 seeds):

(C1) STARVATION, i.e. monotone degradation of offline FUNCTION as intake falls, with sleep quantity
held constant. Leg A (Types 1/2 contrastive replay): the count of VALENCE_SURPRISE residue writes per
waking period and the realised `surprise_weight` at the replay call fall monotonically with intake,
and the replay start-selection distribution collapses toward uniform (rising entropy of the
start-selection histogram / falling spread of replay priority) -- i.e. surprise-gating has nothing

prediction error, measured on a FROZEN held-out battery with the V3-EXQ-701b/701c frozen-probe
instrument (pre-sleep PE minus post-sleep PE on the same frozen battery, so the DV is what sleep
ADDED, not how hard the waking period was), falls monotonically with intake. Both legs monotone
(non-increasing across intake-sorted arms) on >= 2/3 seeds.

(C2) THE FLOOR, which is what makes this claim distinct from INV-050 and is the load-bearing leg.
The degradation must be DISPROPORTIONATE at the low end -- a knee, not a slope. Pre-registered shape
test: the per-seed drop in the C1 DVs between the two LOWEST intake arms exceeds the drop between the

highest arm's DV value)` (SD-scaled gate plus an absolute floor, per the project's effect-size
convention), on >= 2/3 seeds, in the SAME direction on both legs. A run that satisfies P1-P5, C1 and
C2 would be the first evidence of any kind for this claim and the first demonstration that offline
function has a material FLOOR distinct from INV-050's proportional drive.

re-read after the fact):

demonstrably pinned, sleep demonstrably firing in every arm, the MECH-205 instrument demonstrably

(F2) SMOOTH, NO KNEE -- the partial falsification, and the likeliest outcome. C1 passes (monotone
degradation) but C2 fails: degradation is proportional across the whole ladder with no
disproportionate low-end collapse. Then the word "minimum" in this claim is not earned: what has been

disposition to take before running it.)

claims.claim_title: affective_harm_hysteretic_integration
claims.falsifier_summary: Symmetric decay, matched-dose schedules producing indistinguishable z_harm_a, high-r2 reconstruction of z_harm_a from z_harm_un, or the two channels predicting mode-switch and avoidance interchangeably -- the integrator adds nothing beyond a delayed copy of the sensory stream.
claims.required_event: Harm bouts with clean onset and offset, run in escapable and inescapable regimes, plus matched-cumulative-dose schedules contrasting repeated brief exposures with a single continuous exposure.
claims.manipulation: Controllability (escapable versus inescapable, through the external or avoidance_efficacy escapability seam) and exposure schedule (repeated brief versus continuous at matched dose), with the per-consumer redirect flags set for whichever downstream signature is under test.
claims.control: Accumulator OFF (bit-identical) and the constant-escapability arm, at matched z_harm_un dose and seeds, so any z_harm_a difference is attributable to the hysteretic integration rather than to exposure.
claims.DV: Fitted onset versus recovery time constants for z_harm_a against z_harm_un; z_harm_a peak for matched cumulative dose across the two schedules; r2 and cosine-squared of z_harm_a reconstructed from z_harm_un by monotonic or time-shifted transforms; and the dissociation of mode-switch rate from avoidance amplitude across the two channels.
claims.instrument: ree_core/affect/harm_suffering_accumulator.py writes LatentState.z_harm_suffering; v3_exq_962 records the controllability gate, persistence and asymmetric-decay contrasts with readiness preconditions; harm_suffering_redirect_aic carries the signal into aic_salience, but harm_suffering_redirect_dacc and _pacc have no read site anywhere in agent.py.
claims.consumer_locus: z_harm_un into the hysteretic integrator into z_harm_suffering, consumed by the urgency / PAG / MECH-091 interrupt path (wired) and by the MECH-259 mode-switch consumer (only via the AIC redirect).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: use_harm_suffering_accumulator and use_harm_un both True, an escapability mode other than the constant default (constant gives g=0 and the module is inert), and real dynamic range in z_harm_un across onset and offset events -- V3-EXQ-962 measured worst-seed z_harm_un norms of 0.85-0.92 against a 0.05 floor, so this is met on that recipe.
claims.blocking_reason: Mostly runnable now: V3-EXQ-962 passed six load-bearing criteria including the asymmetric-decay contrast on a precondition-clean substrate. The unrun legs -- matched-dose non-linear summation and the nonredundancy reconstruction test -- need no new substrate. Only the mode-switch versus avoidance dissociation is blocked: harm_suffering_redirect_dacc and _pacc are defined but have no consumer read site, and coordinator mode governance is inert at production defaults.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The 11/11 unit contracts are sometimes cited as validation; the WWA correctly excludes them, and this audit confirms they test arithmetic only.
claims.auditor_notes: Keep the MECH-305 separation the WWA insists on: 962 scored a controllability gate as well as the temporal contrasts, so when reading it as MECH-219 evidence credit the temporal criteria (C2, C2_CONTRAST), not C1 alone. The two cheapest outstanding legs (summation, nonredundancy) are measurement designs over existing telemetry and nothing currently owns queuing them.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the run must actually exercise the accumulator
substrate, not merely have it present-but-inert. use_harm_suffering_accumulator=True
(master flag, default OFF/bit-identical) AND use_harm_un=True (loud precondition
per the 2026-06-10 implementation_note) must both be set, and the relevant
consumer redirect flag(s) for whichever downstream signature is being tested
(e.g. the mode-switch consumer for prediction 4) must be enabled -- most
default OFF except the v1 urgency/PAG/MECH-091-interrupt wiring. z_harm_un
itself must show real dynamic range within the run (nonzero variance across
onset/offset events) -- a flat or near-constant z_harm_un gives the
integrator nothing to demonstrate hysteresis over. A run failing any of these
self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict on the mechanism. The 11/11
unit contracts already on file (test_mech_219_harm_suffering_accumulator.py)
establish only that the arithmetic (drive computation, alpha_rise/alpha_fall,
gate math) matches spec -- they are NOT evidence for this claim's behavioral/
representational content and should not be cited as validation.
Scope note: this falsifier covers the TEMPORAL/HYSTERETIC content of MECH-219
(its own predictions 1, 2, 4 below). The controllability-gating question
(originally this claim's prediction 3) was narrowed out to MECH-305
(2026-05-04), which is a separate, currently lit-only claim depending on
MECH-219. Do not treat a controllability-only demonstration as confirming
MECH-219, and do not fold a MECH-219 temporal-signature test into a
MECH-305 controllability test -- keep the two experiments and their
verdicts separate.
CONFIRMING signature (all should hold, on a substrate meeting the
precondition above):
(1) Asymmetric decay: after harm offset, z_harm_un falls rapidly while
    z_harm_a remains elevated and decays measurably slower (e.g.
    alpha_fall << alpha_rise reflected in fitted onset vs recovery time
    constants, not just eyeballed trajectories).
(2) Non-linear summation: repeated brief harm exposures produce a higher
    z_harm_a than a single continuous exposure of equal cumulative
    duration x intensity -- i.e. the signal is not just a rescaled EMA of
    total dose, but genuinely path-dependent.
(3, formalizing prediction 4) Separable behavioral signature: z_harm_a
    (not z_harm_un) is the variable that predicts mode-switch rate
    (MECH-259), while z_harm_un drives immediate avoidance amplitude --
    an ablation or regression showing the two channels dissociate, not
    that either alone explains both behaviors.
(4) Nonredundancy: z_harm_a is NOT reconstructible from z_harm_un by a
    simple monotonic or time-shifted transform (low r2 / low cosine-sq
    overlap, consistent with the SD-019 nonredundancy metric this claim
    depends on) -- i.e. the explicit "pure delay" null model
    (z_harm_a(t) = z_harm_s(t-k)) that this claim's own notes reject is
    actually tested and rejected, not assumed.
FALSIFYING signature: decay is symmetric or z_harm_a collapses as fast as
z_harm_un after offset (no genuine hysteresis); repeated-brief and
single-continuous exposures of matched cumulative dose produce
statistically indistinguishable z_harm_a (no summation advantage, i.e.
it behaves as a simple EMA on raw exposure); z_harm_a is reconstructible
from z_harm_un with high r2/cosine-sq (fails nonredundancy, reduces to
the rejected pure-delay model); or z_harm_a and z_harm_un predict
mode-switch and avoidance interchangeably with no separable signature.
Any of these would mean the hysteretic-integrator design adds no
functional content beyond a delayed copy of the sensory stream, and the
claim should be revisited rather than simply re-run with different
hyperparameters.

claims.claim_title: proxy_goal_necessity
claims.falsifier_summary: BOTH-OFF is statistically indistinguishable from BOTH-ON, i.e. proxy-goal density has no measurable effect on beyond-horizon acquisition, contradicting the architectural-necessity reading.
claims.required_event: A sparse/distal-resource episode in which the resource z_world state lies beyond the 10-step CEM horizon, followed by an acquisition attempt that must be planned through intermediate wanting-bearing states.
claims.manipulation: A four-cell {MECH-216 schema-seeded VALENCE_WANTING ON/OFF} x {MECH-217 reverse-replay wanting spread ON/OFF} design; both levers exist in code (agent.py seeds VALENCE_WANTING from the E1 schema readout head, and hippocampal.spread_reverse_replay_wanting is driven from agent.py's offline pass under config.reverse_replay_fraction).
claims.control: The BOTH-OFF cell plus a no-gradient random-walk floor arm on the identical environment and seeds, with the two single-ON cells supplying the intermediate density points.
claims.DV: Beyond-horizon resource acquisition rate per episode, compared BOTH-ON vs BOTH-OFF against a margin clearing cross-seed SD, jointly with proxy-goal density in the wanting landscape (share of z_world nodes carrying non-zero VALENCE_WANTING) so acquisition can be regressed on density rather than merely on arm label.
claims.instrument: MECH-217's spread telemetry exists (rem_wanting_spread_n_steps / rem_wanting_spread_mean in agent.py) and the residue field exposes VALENCE_WANTING coverage, but no driver records beyond-horizon acquisition rate in a beyond-horizon environment -- that apparatus is unbuilt, as MECH-217's own not-yet-built LEG 2 also records.

claims.claim_title: DA-modulated RBF center density: dopaminergic signal at reward encounters allocates multiple closely-spaced RBF centers in the hippocampal residue field, creating representational expansion at reward locations without requiring environmental richness.
claims.falsifier_summary: rho(da, cluster_size) at or below zero on a live sample meeting the event floor, OR any live harm event allocating a cluster, OR a replay-tagged event allocating expansion. Residual-specific: the expansion fraction stays flat or the achievable range stays at the ~0.018 order across the full sweep, which converts the SD-024 to SD-025 handoff to substrate_ceiling rather than refuting the mechanism.
claims.required_event: Live reward contacts during a trained run, each routed through REEAgent.update_z_goal to ResidueField.accumulate_benefit with dopamine_signal = benefit_exposure * drive_level.
claims.manipulation: A dose-response sweep of da_allocation_scale crossed with drive_level (pinned via the GoalState drive_floor / drive_ema_alpha knobs rather than left to the env energy trace), with a replay-tagged arm to re-assert the MECH-094 gate.
claims.control: The producer-OFF arm (benefit_terrain_live_producer False) as the zero-density baseline, the harm/safety terrains as the MECH-233 asymmetry control (single-centre allocation), and a same-statistic positive control for the curiosity-bonus range.
claims.DV: The residual, not the mechanism: the expansion FRACTION (n_expansion_events / n_benefit_events) as a function of DA, and the resulting cross-candidate curiosity-bonus range, which must exceed max(3 x SD_seed, 0.05) -- SD_seed = 0.0052, live range measured 0.0177 against a 13.83 positive control.
claims.instrument: Built and exercised: ree_core/residue/field.py add_residue_cluster and the weight-independent compute_local_density, the live producer at ree_core/agent.py update_z_goal, the SD-025 read in ree_core/hippocampal/curiosity.py, and the recorders proven in v3_exq_900 and v3_exq_795. Report raw density, not density_delta -- the 2026-09-14 autopsy showed the delta statistic is largely arithmetic in cluster_size.
claims.consumer_locus: The standing representational density signal that the SD-025 curiosity drive actually reads, not the allocation event itself -- the SD-024 to SD-025 handoff.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A P0 readiness sweep over a well-separated DA sweep must certify the instrument (rho(da, cluster_size) >= 0.9 and rho(cluster_size, density) >= 0.9 at synthetic locations), the live sample must carry at least 5 pooled expansion events (cluster_size >= 2) so the rank correlation is not vacuous, and benefit_terrain_live_producer must be True with no direct accumulate_benefit call in the driver outside a declared control -- agent.py must be the writer.
claims.blocking_reason: R0: every element is built and has been exercised. da_allocation_scale is a direct ResidueConfig knob, drive_level is manipulable through the GoalState drive_floor, da_benefit_num_centers lets the benefit terrain exceed the 32-slot default, and V3-EXQ-900/795 already recorded both DVs. The residual dose-response arm is the only unrun piece and EXP-1391 is proposed, not blocked.
