claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. The DA -> cluster-size relation must be measured through the real
substrate call path, not by constructing clusters in the test, and the live sample must carry
rank information:
(1) A P0 readiness sweep over a well-separated `DA_SWEEP` (e.g. 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.2 steps) at
synthetic locations must yield `rho(da, cluster_size) >= 0.9` and
`rho(cluster_size, density) >= 0.9`. This certifies the instrument before any live claim is read.
(2) The LIVE sample must contain `n_expansion_events` (events allocating cluster_size >= 2)
`>= 5` pooled across seeds. A live sample in which every event allocated the same cluster size
carries no rank information and a correlation over it is vacuous -- this is the precondition,
and V3-EXQ-900 met it only barely (6 events out of 57 benefit events, at
`da_allocation_scale=40.0`).
(3) `benefit_terrain_live_producer=True` with no direct `accumulate_benefit` call in the driver
outside a declared control -- `agent.py:11570` must be the writer. This is the shared group
precondition; ARC-057's and SD-025's falsifiers point here rather than restating it.

CONFIRMING (mechanism -- already satisfied by V3-EXQ-900, 2026-08-08, PASS/supports; retained
as the standing falsifier).
- C1: over live benefit events, `rho(dopamine_signal, allocated cluster_size) >= 0.3`.
  *(measured 0.533)*
- C2: `rho(cluster_size, weight-independent density readout) >= 0.3`. *(measured 0.517 -- NOTE, governance 2026-09-15 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-900_2026-09-14: this is the density_DELTA statistic (post-minus-pre density at the event location), NOT the pre-registered raw-density readout, which measures rho = 0.18 on this run and does NOT clear the 0.30 bar; C2's functional half is not established by V3-EXQ-900)*
- C4 (MECH-233 asymmetry): across every live harm event, zero cluster allocations on the
  harm/threat terrain. *(measured: 0 of 1403)*
- C5 (MECH-094 gate): a replay/simulation-tagged event allocates zero expansion. Enforced in
  code at `field.py:665` and asserted at the `agent.py` call site; must be re-asserted in any run
  that exercises replay.

CONFIRMING (the RESIDUAL, not yet tested, and the part that matters downstream). SD-024 as written
asserts expansion happens *"at reward encounters"* -- unqualified. The live data says it happens
at a small minority of them. A dose-response arm sweeping `da_allocation_scale` and, separately,
`drive_level`, supports the claim in its downstream-usable form iff the expansion FRACTION
(`n_expansion_events / n_benefit_events`) rises monotonically with DA and reaches a regime where
the resulting cross-candidate curiosity-bonus range exceeds `max(3 x SD_seed, 0.05)` -- where
`SD_seed = 0.0052` and the observed live range was `0.0177` in V3-EXQ-795 against a
same-statistic positive control of `13.83`. Pin `drive_level` explicitly: V3-EXQ-900 measured
`mean_benefit_magnitude` at cluster>=2 (0.5577) and at cluster==1 (0.5582) as effectively
identical, so benefit magnitude is not the discriminator in vivo and `drive_level` is the
untested lever.

FALSIFYING.
- `rho(da, cluster_size)` at or below zero on a live sample meeting precondition (2) -- the
  allocation rule does not track DA in the live agent.
- Any live harm event allocating a cluster (refutes the MECH-233 asymmetry the claim explicitly
  preserves, and would invalidate the SD-024 workaround's central selectivity argument).
- A replay-tagged event allocating expansion (refutes the MECH-094 gate).
- Residual-specific: the expansion fraction stays flat, or the achievable cross-candidate
  range stays at the ~0.018 order, across the full sweep of `da_allocation_scale` and
  `drive_level`. That would not refute SD-024's *mechanism* -- C1/C2 would still hold -- but it
  would establish that the mechanism cannot reach a magnitude the downstream consumer can use,
  and that finding would convert the SD-024 -> SD-025 handoff to `substrate_ceiling`
  (built, exercised, non-degenerate, signal absorbed downstream), which is precisely the
  discriminator `REE_assembly/CLAUDE.md` sets out. Say so in the run's interpretation rather than
  recording a bare PASS on C1/C2.
- Lit-side counterexample to watch (does not by itself refute): SD-024's `notes` predict
  perseveration from DA locked HIGH; the Retailleau & Morris 2018 entry in
  `claim_evidence.v1.json` records perseveration from D1 blockade. Per the lit/exp decoupling
  rule this is non-load-bearing for the claim's status, but the failure-mode taxonomy in `notes`
  should be reconciled or explicitly scoped rather than left carrying a possible sign inversion.

claims.claim_title: Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.
claims.falsifier_summary: The divergence rate is indistinguishable from zero across the whole reachable sweep while producer, expansion-count and strictly-positive cross-candidate range are all green -- the substrate_ceiling signature, which re-tags SD-025 rather than refuting the drive mechanism.
claims.required_event: Live episodes in which the agent's own consummatory contacts lay down benefit terrain via residue.benefit_terrain_live_producer, producing at least five RBF expansion events, so representational density is non-zero at CEM scoring time.
claims.manipulation: Same-seed, same-substrate curiosity_weight ON/OFF contrast, swept across the reachable curiosity_weight x da_allocation_scale grid rather than tested only at the V3-EXQ-795 operating point.
claims.control: The OFF arm at curiosity_weight = 0.0 is bit-identical (the tracker is never built), plus the hand-built positive control on the same statistic (range 13.83 in V3-EXQ-795) as the reachability anchor.
claims.DV: Committed-action divergence rate -- the fraction of decisions where the selected CEM candidate differs between arms -- required to exceed max(3 x SD_seed, 0.02), with the cross-candidate bonus range reported alongside as the mechanistic explanation.
claims.instrument: HippocampalModule._curiosity_bonus and compute_novelty_score expose the term; experiments/_lib/baselines/mech477_dualsystem_arbitration.py::_curiosity_bonus_range already computes the cross-candidate RANGE fail-closed. The divergence rate itself is a paired-arm experiment-level statistic with no standing recorder in ree_core and no queued driver computing it.
claims.consumer_locus: CEM trajectory selection inside HippocampalModule._score_trajectory -- which candidate is committed -- not the scalar bonus value.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Inherited wholesale from SD-024: live benefit-terrain producer on, driver never calls accumulate_benefit itself, n_expansion_events >= 5. Plus curiosity_weight > 0 so the FamiliarityTracker is actually constructed, and the cross-candidate RANGE (max-min) of the bonus strictly non-zero -- a uniform bonus cancels under the CEM argmin. No saturating binary gate may be load-bearing.
claims.blocking_reason: R0 on substrate: flags, live producer, tracker, bonus and range readout all exist and 767a validated the mechanism in vitro. What is missing is a queued run -- EXP-1392 is only proposed. The live range (0.0177 against a 13.83 positive control) means the sweep may find no reachable regime, which the falsifier already treats as a verdict, not a null.
false_positives: GFLAG-0197 (fishtank family runs with the curiosity channel dead while its config reads as on) is a configuration defect in THOSE runs; it is not evidence that SD-025's own falsifier is unrunnable, since benefit_terrain_live_producer landed 2026-07-20 and V3-EXQ-795 exercised it.
claims.auditor_notes: The only missing artefact is the driver. If the coordinator wants one chip out of this batch, EXP-1392 is the cheapest fully-specified runnable falsifier in it.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See SD-024's `what_would_answer` precondition -- do not
re-derive it. SD-025 is the consumer of SD-024's product and inherits its preconditions
wholesale: live producer on, driver never calls `accumulate_benefit`, `n_expansion_events >= 5`.
Two SD-025-specific additions:
(1) `curiosity_weight > 0` AND the `FamiliarityTracker` actually constructed
(`module.py:140` -- at `curiosity_weight = 0.0` the tracker is never built and every ablation is
bit-identical, which is a silent no-op, not a null).
(2) The argmin-relevant statistic must be the cross-candidate RANGE of the bonus, never its
mean. `_curiosity_bonus` returns a scalar per candidate trajectory; a component common to all
candidates is inert in the CEM selection and cancels. Report `max-min across candidates` per
decision and require it strictly non-zero. V3-EXQ-795 already routes on this statistic (its L4a,
and the V3-EXQ-643 correction it cites); a design that reports only
`curiosity_bonus_abs_mean` reproduces the V3-EXQ-604c broadcast-scalar failure mode.
(3) Do not let a saturating binary preference gate be load-bearing. V3-EXQ-767's single
load-bearing gate `L1a_pref_A_on` pinned at exactly 1.0 on all 8 seeds and the run was adjudicated
vacuous; 767a's continuous CEM score-margin is the sanctioned replacement. Any SD-025 gate must
carry non-zero cross-seed variance.

CONFIRMING (mechanism -- already satisfied in vitro by V3-EXQ-767a, 2026-07-17,
adjudicated REAL/non-vacuous; retained as the standing falsifier).
- L1a propagation: the curiosity term produces a non-zero continuous CEM score-margin
  `min(sparse) - min(dense)` favouring the denser region. *(measured 39.26, range 26.95-45.61
  over 8 seeds)*
- L1c weight-independence (ARC-007-strict): zeroing the benefit VALUE while leaving centre
  positions intact leaves the margin unchanged (`<= 0.1`). *(measured 0.0)* This is what makes it a
  representational-density drive rather than a disguised value gradient, and it is SD-025's single
  most distinctive property.
- L2a familiarity anti-perseveration and L2b MECH-094 replay control (replay must not raise
  familiarity). *(measured 20.05 and 0.0)*

CONFIRMING (the RESIDUAL, and the actual open question). SD-025 supports its downstream role iff,
on a LIVE run with a behavioural outcome DV, the curiosity term changes committed action:
a same-seed, same-substrate `curiosity_weight` ON/OFF contrast must yield a non-zero
committed-action divergence rate (fraction of decisions where the selected candidate differs
between arms) exceeding `max(3 x SD_seed, 0.02)`, with the cross-candidate bonus range reported
alongside as the mechanistic explanation of whatever is observed. Anchor for calibration: the live
range measured in V3-EXQ-795 is `0.0177` (SD `0.0052`, n=3 seeds) against a hand-built positive
control of `13.83` on the same statistic -- so the design must sweep `curiosity_weight` and
`da_allocation_scale` far enough to establish whether ANY reachable setting produces divergence,
not merely test the 795 operating point.

FALSIFYING.
- L1c fails (zeroing benefit weights collapses the margin): SD-025 is a value-follower, not a
  density-follower, and its distinguishing property is refuted.
- L2b fails (replay raises familiarity): the MECH-094 gate the drive depends on is broken.
- Residual-specific: the committed-action divergence rate is indistinguishable from zero
  across the full reachable `curiosity_weight` x `da_allocation_scale` sweep while the
  preconditions are green (producer on, expansion events >= 5, cross-candidate range strictly
  positive). That is the `substrate_ceiling` signature by the discriminator in
  `REE_assembly/CLAUDE.md`: built, exercised, non-degenerate, and the signal absorbed downstream
  before it reaches committed action. On that outcome, re-tag SD-025
  `epistemic_category: substrate_ceiling` naming the absorbing mechanism, and stop re-running the
  existing design.
- NOT falsifying: any null from a run with `benefit_terrain_live_producer` unset. That is the
  fishtank-family configuration and it makes the bonus identically 0.0 regardless of
  `curiosity_weight` -- a no-op, not a result.

SCOPE BOUND. This falsifier addresses the DRIVE and its live consequentiality only. It does not
address the SD-024 x SD-025 INTERACTION (that is ARC-057's `what_would_answer`; see it), and it
does not address strategy-diversity GENERATION -- MECH-458 establishes that this drive is a
reward-conditional exploitation amplifier with zero proactive pull toward under-represented
regions, so a diversity null here supports MECH-458 and says nothing against SD-025.

claims.falsifier_summary: With the same gate met, the false-confirmation rate is statistically indistinguishable across ARM_RESID_ON, ARM_RESID_OFF and ARM_SHAM_RESID -- self-prediction persistence in z_world does not inflate the coherency signal, so the mandatory pipeline ordering is an unneeded constraint rather than a load-bearing one.
claims.required_event: Ticks on which the agent's own locomotion produces a large predicted sensory change while the exogenous world does NOT change, so a contaminated z_world would agree with its own self-prediction and a residualized z_world would not.
claims.manipulation: Cross use_per_stream_vs=True with the three reafference arms already built in ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_1018 (ARM_RESID_ON with a trained ReafferencePredictor, ARM_RESID_OFF with the predictor set to None after P0, ARM_SHAM_RESID subtracting the same module with the action mis-paired).
claims.control: ARM_SHAM_RESID is the matched-magnitude control (measured R2 -2.94 mis-paired versus 0.34-0.40 correctly paired, cos 0.59), plus a stationary-agent arm in which no self-caused change occurs so any coherency-score difference between arms must be zero by construction.
claims.DV: The rate of HIGH-coherency ticks that coincide with a verified absence of exogenous change (false confirmations per 100 ticks), compared across the three arms at matched seeds -- not the mean coherency score, which moves for scale reasons.
claims.instrument: The only live coherency signal is MECH-269 per-stream V_s (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py update_per_stream_vs, config.use_per_stream_vs default False). It reads latent_state.z_world, i.e. already DOWNSTREAM of the SD-007 correction, so the ordering INV-066 mandates already holds for it -- but V_s is an identity-prediction proxy (1 - norm(z_t - z_t-1)/norm(z_t)), a temporal-stability score, NOT the z_world-versus-observation comparison the claim names. That comparison has no recorder.
claims.consumer_locus: The input boundary of any control-plane coherency/verisimilitude computation over z_world -- the ordering constraint between the residualization gate and the first coherency reader, not any downstream behavioural consequence.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two gates, both measured per arm. (a) z_world must carry enough exogenous-world content for a coherency comparison to be non-vacuous -- the MECH-222 scoping measured drift-detection AUC 0.53-0.63 and graded Spearman at chance from dz_world, so on the shipped encoder a coherency readout has nothing veridical to be right or wrong about. (b) The residualization manipulation must be the ARM contrast (reafference_action_dim ON / OFF / SHAM), never a within-run z_world vs z_world_raw contrast: z_world_raw is PRE-EMA as well as pre-correction, so that contrast measures alpha_world smoothing.
claims.blocking_reason: The named coherency reader does not compute the named comparison. MECH-269 V_s is a temporal identity proxy; the forward-predictor routing that would make it a verisimilitude-against-prediction signal is Phase 2 and was vetoed (substrate_queue MECH-269b-followup-B). Underneath that, z_world carries exogenous-event information at chance, so MECH-221/MECH-222 are annotated substrate_conditional with no observable DV in V3.

claims.claim_title: Are the three psychosis substrate failure modes (MECH-094 tag-loss, MECH-222 self-attribution overflow, MECH-065/MECH-223 precision/bias) experimentally dissociable in the REE substrate?
claims.falsifier_summary: The inductions cross-contaminate (a single-target ablation moves another arm's locus) or the three signatures collapse onto one phenotype -- not dissociable.
claims.required_event: Matched episodes in which replay/simulation fires (for the MECH-094 arm), in which exogenous world events occur that the agent did not cause (for the MECH-222 arm), and in which a high-salience external-authority signal conflicts with the internal model (for the MECH-065 arm).
claims.manipulation: Three single-target inductions with the other two intact -- open the post-commit write channel during replay (MECH-094); disable continuous z_self residualization, i.e. ablate the SD-007 ReafferencePredictor correction in LatentStack.encode (MECH-222); lower the RC-conflict threshold so external authority overrides the internal model (MECH-065).
claims.control: An all-intact arm at matched seeds, plus per-arm attribution controls: for MECH-222 the verified action-sensitivity check on the reafference predictor (mis-paired action drops held-out R2 to -2.94), and for MECH-094 the paired waking arm that must write non-zero on the same channels.
claims.DV: Cross-contamination structure -- whether each induction perturbs only its own structural locus with the other two measurably unaffected (leg A) -- and whether the three induced behavioural signatures separate along the Lavalle 2020 source-monitoring template into episodic replay-flooding, continuous internally-consistent contamination, and context-triggered external- source paranoia (leg B).
claims.instrument: MECH-094's side is instrumented (ResidueField.accumulate/accumulate_benefit/accumulate_safety hypothesis_tag gates; 21 getattr(new_latent, "hypothesis_tag") sites in agent.py). The MECH-222 DV does NOT exist: z_world carries no decodable exogenous-world-event signal (at chance across four measurement rounds, independently recorded in ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py), because z_world is a static single-frame encoding and SD-005 routes the informative body delta to z_self. There is no RC-conflict-lane instrument at all.
claims.consumer_locus: Three distinct structural loci the claim asserts are separable -- the replay event boundary (MECH-094), the z_world construction pipeline (MECH-222), and the RC-conflict lane threshold (MECH-065) -- plus MECH-223 as a bias modifier on the latter two.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All three ablation targets must be implemented and independently inducible with a non-zero, separable effect. Verified against the current tree, only MECH-094 is: MECH-222, MECH-065 and MECH-223 have ZERO occurrences anywhere in ree_core, so two of the three arms cannot be induced at all and the triple-ablation is vacuous by construction.
claims.blocking_reason: Two of three arms cannot be run. MECH-222's manipulation exists but its DV does not -- the z_world exogenous-event channel measures at chance, so EXP-0893 was routed blocked_substrate and the V3-EXQ-1018 reservation released. MECH-065's RC-conflict lane and MECH-223 have no substrate in ree_core at all.
false_positives: The 2026-05-02 note's two-step path ('verify MECH-222 + MECH-065 + MECH-223 implementation status') has an answer that is not recorded on the claim: as of the current tree all three are absent from ree_core, MECH-223 entirely.
claims.auditor_notes: The MECH-222 DV gap has a named owner (the 2026-09-10 staged doc) and is the one leg with a real route forward; MECH-065/MECH-223 are unbuilt mechanisms, so Q-037 should be narrowed to the 094-vs-222 pair or explicitly parked until the RC-conflict lane exists, rather than carried as a triple ablation.
claims.what_would_answer:
Run a triple-ablation dissociation: selectively induce each of the three
psychosis substrates -- MECH-094 tag-loss (open the post-commit write channel
during replay), MECH-222 self-attribution overflow (disable continuous z_self
residualization so self-content persists in z_world), MECH-065 precision-ratio
miscalibration (lower the RC-conflict threshold so external authority
overrides internal model) -- one at a time, leaving the others intact. Read
distinct behavioural signatures. ANSWER "dissociable" on BOTH legs: (A) each
ablation perturbs ONLY its own structural locus with the others measurably
unaffected, AND (B) the induced signatures match the predicted clinical
fingerprints (episodic replay-flooding for MECH-094, continuous
internally-consistent delusional logic for MECH-222, context-triggered
external-source paranoia for MECH-065), using the Lavalle 2020 OCD-vs-SCZ
source-monitoring dissociation as the readout template. ANSWER "not
dissociable" if ablations cross-contaminate or the signatures collapse onto
one phenotype. HARD PRECONDITION: ALL THREE mechanisms must be implemented and
each independently inducible with non-zero, separable effect before the
dissociation can be read; MECH-094 is implemented (V3-EXQ-499 PASS) but
MECH-222 / MECH-065 / MECH-223 status must be verified live and non-degenerate
first -- if any target is pinned or absent, the triple-ablation is vacuous.
The Corlett 2025 caveat (MECH-065 may need splitting) bears on leg (A) for
that arm specifically. V3-tractable in principle but gated on the upstream
three-mechanism cohort landing.

claims.claim_title: The self is defined as the dynamically sustained process maintaining high temporal-depth verisimilitude across time, not a static representation.
claims.falsifier_summary: A frozen self preserves coherence and behaviour as well as the live process does, so 'dynamically sustained process' adds nothing; a non-recovering perturbation is not a refutation but routes the claim to ARC-053 as untestable here.
claims.required_event: A trained life in which the stateful self-latent is maintained tick by tick, so that a perturbation of the maintenance PROCESS and a freeze of that process can be applied to the same substrate from a common capture point.
claims.manipulation: (a) Transient perturbation: a one-tick noise burst injected into the SelfRecurrenceCell hidden state (prev_state.z_self) with the maintenance process left running. (b) Frozen maintenance: the stored z_self held exactly as it was while the recurrent update is stopped and the E1-anchor blend removed (self_recurrence_e1_coupling = 0 supplies the anchor half).
claims.control: An unperturbed live-process arm restored from the same capture on the same seed, plus a legacy fixed-alpha-EMA arm (use_self_recurrence off) as the no-dedicated-process reference.
claims.DV: Recovery profile of per_stream_vs['z_self'] after the burst (dip depth and ticks to return inside the unperturbed noise band) and the divergence of the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking from the unperturbed control over the same window, contrasted against the frozen-maintenance arm's drift with an untouched stored representation.
claims.instrument: HippocampalModule.update_per_stream_vs (module.py:3750-3790) computes and EMA-smooths the V_s proxy; the DR-13 diagnostic readout in stack.py exposes the recurrence terms. Missing: there is no freeze or perturbation API -- grep for freeze_self / perturb_z_self / self_recurrence_freeze returns nothing, so both manipulations need driver-side state surgery.
claims.consumer_locus: The maintenance process itself -- whether coherence and behaviour depend on the ongoing update or only on the stored self-vector -- read at the self-latent to candidate-ranking boundary, not at episode outcome.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: use_self_recurrence ON (SelfRecurrenceCell is instantiated at stack.py:1551 only under that flag), z_self must reach behaviour on a route that is actually live, and per_stream_vs['z_self'] must sit strictly inside (0, 1) at baseline rather than pinned at its 1.0 initialisation. The perturbation magnitude must survive the per_stream_vs_tau EMA, calibrated in a pilot.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate exists but nothing uses it: no experiment targets INV-069, and neither manipulation has a lever -- the freeze arm in particular has no flag, only an off-switch that reverts to the EMA rather than holding z_self constant.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The WWA names DR-10 (use_self_viability_weighting) as the route by which z_self reaches behaviour; that path is inert on the flag alone -- e3_selector.py:1771 also requires a per-candidate self_viability, and agent.py:9626 supplies only whatever set_injected_self_viability() was handed, with no internal producer.

Treating DR-10 as the only route understates reachability: GatedPolicy consumes z_self directly as an input stream (gated_policy.py:465-514) under use_gated_policy, which is a live behavioural route not requiring any injection.
claims.auditor_notes: The V_s proxy caveat in the WWA is correct and should survive any rewrite: a result under it is admissible for the process-versus-state dissociation only, never as evidence about the INV-067 verisimilitude formalism. Check the per_stream_vs baseline is off 1.0 in a pilot before committing seeds.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the self must be a MAINTAINED PROCESS in the substrate under test -- use_self_recurrence ON (SelfRecurrenceCell, the DR-13 stateful z_self) -- and z_self must reach behaviour (use_self_viability_weighting ON, DR-10), otherwise a self perturbation cannot change anything downstream and the test is vacuous. The coherence readout, per_stream_vs['z_self'] (use_per_stream_vs with z_self registered), must sit strictly inside (0, 1) at baseline: it initialises at 1.0 and saturates there when z_self is constant, so a pinned readout detects nothing. Degenerate if the perturbation is small enough to vanish inside the readout's EMA smoothing (per_stream_vs_tau) -- calibrate its magnitude to produce a measurable dip in a pilot.
CONFIRMING: the self is the PROCESS, not the stored state. Two manipulations on one trained substrate per seed (capture/restore between cells): (a) TRANSIENT PERTURBATION -- inject a one-tick noise burst into the recurrent hidden state and leave the maintenance process running: CONFIRMING if per_stream_vs['z_self'] dips then RECOVERS to baseline within k ticks and the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking re-converges to the unperturbed control's (rank divergence returns to the noise band); (b) FROZEN MAINTENANCE -- leave the stored z_self exactly as it was but stop the process (freeze the SelfRecurrenceCell hidden update and remove the E1-anchor blend): CONFIRMING if coherence and behaviour DRIFT from the live-process control over the same window even though the representation was untouched. Both together, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, dissociate process from state as the claim asserts.
FALSIFYING: (b) a frozen self preserves coherence and behaviour as well as the live process does -- the self is adequately captured by a stored vector and 'dynamically sustained process' adds nothing; or (a) the perturbation never recovers -- there is no maintenance process in V3 at all, in which case the claim is not refuted but UNTESTABLE here and routes to substrate (ARC-053 temporal coherence loop), see below.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/latent/self_recurrence.py (built, flag-gated, explicitly designed to be lesionable and perturbation-isolated), ree_core/hippocampal/module.py update_per_stream_vs (the identity-prediction proxy V_s = 1 - ||z_curr - z_prev|| / ||z_curr||, EMA-smoothed), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py DR-10 self-viability penalty. CAVEAT stated rather than papered over: V_s is a crude identity-prediction proxy, NOT INV-067's precision-weighted phase-aligned hierarchical correspondence, and D_self (its temporal-depth EMA) is computed driver-side from it; the ARC-053 distributed TCL that would give the full V(t) is unbuilt (v3 architecture commitment, not landed). A result under the proxy is admissible for the process-vs-state DISSOCIATION; it is NOT evidence about the verisimilitude formalism itself.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now under the proxy reading -- complicated (buildable); substrate_conditional for the full V(t)/D_V reading on ARC-053.

claims.claim_title: Language functions as a mechanism for recognising, repairing, and re-establishing self-other equivalence across agents.
claims.falsifier_summary: Language shows no differential repair effect on beta_j beyond the information-matched non-language arm -- restoration tracks generic interaction time or information exchanged, not the linguistic channel. This falsifies language-as-similarity-repair-technology without falsifying INV-028 or INV-070.
claims.required_event: Two REE agents whose mutual similarity inference (beta_j) has measurably degraded or collapsed, followed by a bounded exchange episode between them.
claims.manipulation: Introduce a language/dialogue exchange channel between the two agents after the beta_j collapse, versus a non-language interaction channel of matched duration and matched information content.
claims.control: Matched-duration, matched-information non-language interaction arm (contact, co-presence, observed action) plus a no-interaction arm, on identical collapse inductions and seeds.
claims.DV: Recovery of beta_j (and of the INV-028 self-other equivalence estimate) from its collapsed value, measured as recovery magnitude and rate, compared across the language arm and the information-matched non-language arm rather than against a no-interaction baseline alone.
claims.instrument: Absent at both levels. No beta_j / similarity-weight recorder exists because the ARC-010 substrate that would produce it is unbuilt, and there is no utterance channel to log, so nothing records either the manipulation or the DV.
claims.consumer_locus: The other-agent similarity model (beta_j / D_V_j) inside each agent, the quantity the claim says language repairs -- not aggregate cooperation rate or task score.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two stacked substrate gaps, both reconfirmed 2026-09-22 by grep of ree_core/: (1) no mirror-modelling / similarity-inference substrate (zero hits for mirror_model, shadow_bundle, other_self), so there is no beta_j to degrade or restore; (2) no inter-agent communication channel (zero hits for utterance or dialogue; the only near-hit, ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py, is intra-agent binding between one agent's own latent streams). beta_j must also be independently measurable and shown to have actually collapsed before any repair can be scored.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: ARC-010 mirror modelling is v5-phased and absent, and no inter-agent symbolic channel exists anywhere in ree_core/. The proper test sits at the V5 multi-agent boundary, in a two-agent environment with a discrete utterance channel and an exposed per-agent similarity weight.
false_positives: cross_stream_binder.py's 'communication-through-coherence' language reads as an inter-agent channel but is intra-agent latent-stream binding; it is not a partial owner of this claim's communication requirement.
claims.auditor_notes: INV-072 depends on INV-071 and the claim's own WWA predicts it will inherit this framing; the coordinator should expect a near-duplicate spec there. ethics_as_coherence_v5_plan.md carries only an umbrella node -- no child node owns the inter-agent language channel, which is where the missing edge sits.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (two stacked gaps, currently unmet): (1) the multi-agent similarity-inference substrate this whole ethics cluster depends on -- ARC-010 mirror modelling / D_V_j / beta_j similarity weighting -- confirmed absent from ree_core/ (zero hits for mirror_model, shadow_bundle, other_self, ARC-010; see ARC-056's 2026-08-08 digestion); AND (2) a language or symbolic-communication channel between REE agents, a further-downstream requirement specific to this claim, ALSO confirmed absent -- no dialogue/utterance/message-passing mechanism exists between agents anywhere in ree_core/ (the sole near-hit, cross_stream_binder.py's "communication- through-coherence," describes intra-agent binding between an agent's own latent streams, not inter-agent exchange).
CONFIRMING: once both exist, introducing a language/dialogue exchange between two REE agents whose similarity-inference (beta_j) has degraded or collapsed measurably RESTORES beta_j / re-establishes self-other equivalence, via the mechanisms this claim's notes specify -- (a) revealing inner states, (b) negotiating threat, (c) repairing misclassification, (d) restoring INV-028 belief, (e) expanding "sufficiently like me" -- in a way a non-language interaction of matched duration and information content does not produce to the same degree.
FALSIFYING: language exchange shows no differential repair effect on beta_j beyond what an equivalent-duration, equivalent-information non-language interaction produces -- restoration tracks generic interaction time or information exchanged, not the specific linguistic channel this claim assigns the repair work to. This would falsify language-as-similarity-repair-technology specifically, without necessarily falsifying INV-028/070 (interaction of any kind could still repair similarity inference through non-linguistic routes).
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): INV-072 (which depends on INV-071) will very likely inherit this same category/reasoning when digested -- can reuse this non-degeneracy framing rather than re-deriving.

claims.claim_title: Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.
claims.falsifier_summary: Harmful action tracks a single generic threat or salience channel applied uniformly regardless of which other agent triggered it, or the similarity and threat pathways cannot be dissociated -- the dual-pathway carve would then add nothing over MECH-102's terminal error-correction account.
claims.required_event: An encounter in which a specific other agent is either modelled as self-like or not, and either does or does not predict a threat to the protected existence of self or of a protected other, with a harmful action available.
claims.manipulation: Cross the two asserted conditions independently for the same other agent: similarity (high versus collapsed self-likeness) by biasing the other-model, and threat (genuine versus absent) by the other's behaviour, with surface features held matched; then separately manipulate INFERENCE ACCURACY by injecting a false threat percept or a distorted similarity estimate.
claims.control: The accurate-inference cells are the control for the inaccurate ones: a hallucinated-threat arm and a propaganda-distorted-similarity arm must be scored against matched arms where the same protection drop follows an accurate inference.
claims.DV: Rate of harmful action toward the specific other as a function of the crossed similarity and threat factors, conditioned on the accuracy of the inference that produced each -- with the prediction that protection drops only when either condition genuinely fails, and that an inaccurate inference producing the same behaviour is classified as an ethical failure rather than a satisfied condition.
claims.instrument: Absent at every point: no per-other similarity state, no other-directed threat estimate, no other-directed harm affordance, and no recorder that could separate 'acted on an accurate model' from 'acted on a distorted one'. INV-070's accuracy requirement has no measurable referent in a single-agent substrate.
claims.consumer_locus: The other-agent protection gate -- whether the ethical protection afforded to a modelled other is conditional on similarity and threat as the axioms assert -- not any single-agent harm-avoidance behaviour.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The test discriminates only if the agent (i) represents specific other agents as distinct objects with a modelled similarity-to-self, (ii) can form a threat prediction about a named other, and (iii) has a genuinely available harmful action toward that other alongside non-harmful alternatives. None of the three exists: ree_core/environment/ holds only causal_grid_world.py and there is no other-agent representation anywhere in ree_core.
claims.blocking_reason: There is no multi-agent substrate and no other-agent representation in ree_core, so neither condition of the corollary can be instantiated. claims.claim_title: Developmental bootstrapping necessity: any model-building agent requiring flexible multi-option behavioral selection must undergo a dedicated motor-sensory exploration epoch before reinforcement learning narrows the repertoire; insufficient exploration permanently restricts the option library.

claims.manipulation: Presence versus absence of the dedicated exploration epoch (store populated and feedback loop live versus epoch omitted), plus a later catch-up arm that grants the no-epoch agent equivalent additional exploration time after RL has begun, to test the claimed PERMANENCE.
claims.control: Matched-seed no-exploration-epoch agent with identical total ticks and identical reward schedule; plus the catch-up arm above as the permanence control.
claims.DV: Retained option-library diversity measured reward-independently -- traj_pairwise_cosine_mean across stored trajectories, per-tick action-class entropy, and H_pos / zone_coverage (infant_substrate GAP-5/GAP-7) -- compared between epoch and no-epoch arms, and the residual gap after the catch-up arm's equivalent later exploration.

claims.claim_title: Does REE require a unified meta-level threshold supervisor that adapts pass/fail and commit/release thresholds across substrates from system-wide instability metrics, or do the existing scattered adaptive loci (ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC interoceptive baseline EMA, SD-032d PCC stability scalar, SD-032e pACC drive bias) produce coherent meta-stability under chronic load without a supervisor?
claims.falsifier_summary: The four series drift independently under the same conditions -- first principal component no larger than the shuffled null, low cross-correlation, divergent setpoints -- licensing the supervisor / volatility-tracker / sleep-writeback SD cluster.
claims.required_event: Sustained chronic load -- drive_level held near 0.9 for roughly 1000 steps -- with matched normal-load episodes, long enough for the slowest locus (SD-032e pACC drive bias, ~347-step EMA) to move.
claims.manipulation: Drive-level clamp at the chronic-load setpoint versus a matched baseline setpoint, with ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC, SD-032d PCC and SD-032e pACC all enabled, plus single-locus disable arms to test whether coherence survives removing any one contributor.

claims.required_event: Live CausalGridWorldV2 episodes in which the agent's own consummatory reward contacts lay down benefit terrain, producing DA-driven cluster expansion the curiosity drive can then follow.
claims.manipulation: 2x2 ablation run end-to-end through REEAgent: both-OFF, DA-ON with curiosity-OFF, DA-OFF with curiosity-ON, both-ON, at 8 or more seeds, with the live producer enabled.
claims.control: Both-OFF arm and the two single-drive arms at matched seeds, plus the weight-zeroing control (benefit weights zeroed, centre positions intact) and an extinction phase after a maintained both-ON phase.
claims.DV: The interaction contrast on the continuous CEM approach score-margin -- margin(both-ON) minus margin(DA-only) minus margin(curiosity-only) plus margin(both-OFF) -- against max(3 x cross-seed SD, 1.0), with the weight-zeroed margin and the extinction decay as the discriminating controls.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three parts; the run is vacuous without all three).
(1) Live producer, not driver-populated terrain. `residue.benefit_terrain_live_producer=True`
and the driver must NEVER call `ResidueField.accumulate_benefit` outside a declared positive
control. This is the precondition SD-024's own `what_would_answer` states; see it and do not
re-derive. Every prior ARC-057 run (766 / 767 / 767a / 768 / 768a) populated the terrain from the
driver and therefore tested the mechanism, not the agent.
(2) Producer actually fired at a measurable rate. Report `n_benefit_events`,
`n_expansion_events` (cluster_size >= 2) and `mean_cluster_size` per arm. Floor:
`n_expansion_events >= 5` pooled (V3-EXQ-900's own floor, met there at 6). Below that floor the
both-ON arm is not distinguishable from the SD-025-alone arm and the 2x2 is uninterpretable --
this is the group's mutual confound, and it must be a gate, not a post-hoc note.
(3) The selection statistic varies across candidates and across seeds. The load-bearing
statistic is the CONTINUOUS CEM score-margin (768a's re-operationalisation; the binary argmin
gate that saturated at exactly 1.0 with zero cross-seed variance is what made V3-EXQ-768 vacuous
and MUST NOT be reintroduced). Require non-zero cross-seed variance on the both-ON margin and a
non-zero cross-candidate range on the curiosity bonus (V3-EXQ-795's L4a statistic).

CONFIRMING. A 2x2 ablation (both-OFF / DA-ON+curiosity-OFF / DA-OFF+curiosity-ON /
both-ON) run end-to-end through `REEAgent` on a real `CausalGridWorldV2` episode loop with the
live producer, at >= 8 seeds, supports ARC-057 iff all four hold:
- C1 (super-additivity, the claim itself): `margin(both-ON) - margin(DA-only) -
  margin(curiosity-only) + margin(both-OFF)` exceeds `max(3 x SD_seed(that contrast), 1.0)`, where
  `SD_seed` is the cross-seed SD of the interaction contrast. The absolute floor of 1.0 is
  inherited from 768a's C1 (which measured 14.37 in vitro); the SD-scaled term is what makes the
  gate meaningful at the far smaller in-vivo effect sizes measured in 795.
- C2 (neither alone): each single-drive arm's margin is within `1 x SD_seed` of the both-OFF
  arm. In vitro 768a read 0.0 and -0.01; a live run reading materially above zero on a single arm
  is itself informative and must not be waved through.
- C3 (no valence gradient -- ARC-057's negative half): repeat the both-ON arm with all benefit
  WEIGHTS zeroed while leaving centre POSITIONS intact (768a's C4 weight-zeroing control, and 766's
  L2c). The margin must be statistically indistinguishable from the unzeroed both-ON arm. If
  zeroing the value collapses the margin, approach was riding value, not density, and ARC-057's
  central negative claim fails regardless of C1.
- C4 (extinction, ARC-057 notes sub-prediction 3): after a maintained both-ON phase, remove
  the reward contingency (DA modulation ceases; FIFO centre lifecycle overwrites the cluster) and
  show the approach margin decays toward the both-OFF level over a bounded number of episodes.
  This is the arm that discriminates *"there is more map"* from *"a gradient was installed"*: a
  gradient account predicts persistence, the expansion account predicts decay.

FALSIFYING. Any of:
(a) the interaction contrast fails C1 while precondition (2) is met at a healthy expansion
rate -- i.e. the producer demonstrably fired and the conjunction still bought nothing over the
single arms. This is the direct refutation.
(b) C3 fails -- weight-zeroing collapses the margin -- which refutes "no explicit approach
gradient is required" even if C1 passes.
(c) a single-drive arm alone produces the full margin (C2 fails), which would make ARC-057 an
additive claim about one drive, not an interaction claim.
NOT falsifying, and this is the trap this claim has already fallen into twice: a null with
`n_expansion_events < 5`, a null with zero cross-seed variance on the load-bearing statistic, or a

claims.claim_title: DMS (goal-directed) and DLS (habitual) corticostriatal circuits can produce simultaneous parallel motor outputs only when targeting anatomically distinct motor effector pools; within the same effector pool, habitual and goal-directed outputs compete via winner-takes-all basal ganglia selection, not independent parallel expression.
claims.falsifier_summary: Commitment suppresses the OTHER pool too, making REE's commitment a global gate, or the habitual channel is expressed concurrently with the deliberative one on the committed pool, refuting the winner-takes-all model and reopening the Layer 3 design question.
claims.required_event: A committed E3 trajectory addressing one effector channel while a habitual output is concurrently computed for a second, independently commandable channel whose command is not mutually exclusive with the first within a step.
claims.manipulation: Commitment on channel A versus no commitment, crossed with whether the habitual output targets channel A (same pool) or channel B (cross pool).
claims.control: The uncommitted baseline expression rate of the habitual channel, measured per channel and per seed, so suppression is scored as a ratio against that channel's own baseline rather than across channels.
claims.DV: The conjunction and dissociation -- cross-domain habitual expression ratio within [0.85, 1.15] with a bootstrap CI excluding 0.5, AND same-domain habitual expression suppressed by more than 3 SD of the per-seed suppression delta with at least 50 percent absolute expression loss, in at least 2 of 3 seeds.
claims.instrument: Per-channel expression counting does not exist because there is no second channel; the habitual-versus-deliberative separation would have to be read from an E1-direct output or from policy chunking (ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py), which today feeds the PROPOSAL layer rather than competing at selection.
claims.consumer_locus: Basal-ganglia-analog selection between habitual and deliberative outputs per effector pool (the MECH-090 BetaGate boundary), not overall behavioural performance.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Re-verified -- CausalGridWorld exposes exactly one action channel (a single discrete choice, action = int(action) % self.action_dim at causal_grid_world.py:2492, action_dim property at :1677, and it is the only environment module in tree), so the same-effector leg is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION and the cross-effector leg is untestable. A habitual channel separately observable from the E3 deliberative one is also required.
claims.blocking_reason: One action channel in the only environment module, so the cross-effector arm cannot be built and the same-effector arm is vacuous. No substrate_queue entry, plan node or claim owns a multi-effector environment -- grep for effector over substrate_queue.json returns nothing.
claims.auditor_notes: Register, do not build on this claim's account alone. GFLAG-0165 resolved MECH-234 as ALREADY-DISCHARGED -- its operative REE consequence (do not build Layer 3) was applied long ago -- so the multi-effector environment is worth building only if other claims need it. The literature leg of the falsifier (a report of simultaneous DMS- and DLS-driven output within one effector pool) remains answerable by lit-pull with no substrate at all.

Recorded for governance as the item that would make the claim's V3 test possible if it is ever re-opened.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. The test requires an environment with >= 2 anatomically
distinct effector pools -- two independently-commandable action channels whose commands are not
mutually exclusive within a step. `ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py` has exactly one
(`action_dim` 5-6, a single discrete choice, `causal_grid_world.py:1529, 2341-2344`), so on the
current substrate the same-effector leg is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION and the cross-effector leg is
UNTESTABLE -- there is no non-degenerate run available and any "confirmation" would be vacuous.
Additionally: a habitual channel distinct from the E3 deliberative channel must be separately
observable (E1-direct or a policy-chunking output per `ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py`,
ARC-071), so that "both computed" can be distinguished from "one was expressed".

CONFIRMING (conditional on a multi-effector substrate landing). With two channels A and B, and
a committed E3 trajectory addressing channel A: (i) CROSS-DOMAIN -- the habitual output on channel
B is expressed at a rate statistically indistinguishable from its uncommitted baseline (a
ratio within [0.85, 1.15] with a bootstrap CI excluding 0.5), i.e. commitment does not suppress the
other pool; AND (ii) SAME-DOMAIN -- the habitual output on channel A is suppressed relative to its
uncommitted baseline by more than 3 SD of the per-seed suppression delta and by an absolute floor
of 50% expression loss, in >= 2 of 3 seeds. The claim's content is the CONJUNCTION and the
DISSOCIATION between (i) and (ii); either alone is a weaker claim.

FALSIFYING. Either (i) fails -- commitment suppresses the *other* effector pool too, which
would mean REE's commitment is a global gate rather than a per-effector one and would invalidate
the "Layer 3 applies in multi-effector environments" half of the ruling -- or (ii) fails, i.e. the
habitual channel is expressed on the committed effector concurrently with the deliberative one,
which would refute the winner-takes-all model MECH-090's BetaGate encodes and reopen the Layer 3
design question the claim closed. For the out-of-domain leg, a counterexample looks like: a
peer-reviewed report of *simultaneous, independently-expressed* DMS- and DLS-driven motor output
within a single effector pool in an intact animal (i.e. not sequential alternation and not
cross-pool), which would contradict Balleine & O'Doherty (2010)'s qualification and require the
title's "only when" to be weakened.

claims.claim_title: vmPFC arbitration continuously weights model-based (E3/deliberative) vs. model-free (E1/habitual) contributions to action selection on a spectrum, not a binary switch. Commitment (beta-elevated E3) shifts weighting toward model-based without silencing the habitual channel; unexpected threat (urgency signal) shifts weighting toward model-free. The MECH-091 urgency interrupt is the substrate implementation of this arbitration shift, not a bypass of the beta gate.
claims.falsifier_summary: w steps at a threshold rather than grading with harm magnitude, or commitment zeroes the habitual contribution entirely -- either outcome makes the arbitration a binary switch, which is exactly what the claim denies.
claims.required_event: A dose range of unexpected-threat magnitude (|z_harm_a|) spanning the region either side of the current binary interrupt threshold, encountered while an E3 trajectory is committed.
claims.manipulation: Vary z_harm_a magnitude continuously across the dose range under commitment, with commitment state (beta-elevated versus not) crossed in.
claims.control: Matched ticks at the same uncertainty inputs (u_habit and u_planned) but without the harm dose, plus the shipped binary-interrupt arm, so that a graded response is separable from threshold crossing and from uncertainty-driven depth arbitration.
claims.DV: The arbitration weight itself as a function of |z_harm_a|, measured at the arbitration site upstream of the committed-selection argmin -- confirming needs a continuous dose-response with the habitual contribution downweighted but non-zero under commitment, not a step at a threshold.
claims.instrument: last_arbitration (e3_selector.py:1962) records w and both uncertainty terms per tick, but w = sigmoid(gain*(u_habit_n - u_planned_n) + bias) (:1950) is a deterministic function of exactly those two inputs. z_harm_a is forwarded by select() and consumed only by score_trajectory (lambda_ethical scaling at :1665-1670), never reaching w, so the recorder cannot show a harm dose-response even in principle.
claims.consumer_locus: The vmPFC-analog arbitration between deliberative and habitual channel contributions, upstream of selection -- not the commit threshold and not the binary beta-gate release at agent.py:6754.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A graded arbitration weight exists and is per-tick readable (_arbitrate_dual_system, e3_selector.py:1800, exposed via last_arbitration at :1962, gated by use_dualsystem_arbitration), and it must be non-degenerate at the operating point -- the function returns a degenerate flag when score spreads collapse. What is missing is that the weight must be able to MOVE with harm for the test to discriminate.
claims.blocking_reason: The graded weight exists and is validated, but harm never reaches it -- the partial correlation of w with z_harm_a given the two uncertainty terms is identically zero by construction, so the cheap re-run was refused at design. The owed harm-PE arbitrator input (about one line plus a config knob and a bit-identity contract) was deliberately not written into substrate_queue.json.
false_positives: GFLAG-0080's premise that no graded arbitration weight was ever built is false -- it landed ree-v3 4472811 on 2026-07-22 and was validated by V3-EXQ-811a; the flag must be closed as MISDIAGNOSED, not as satisfied.

claims.auditor_notes: A graded harm path DOES exist but at a different locus -- SD-011 urgency_weight scales the COMMIT THRESHOLD continuously with |z_harm_a| (e3_selector.py:3976-3998, default 0.0). That is threshold permissiveness, not deliberative-versus-habitual weighting, and must not be substituted for the claim's DV. Line-number drift in the WWA is real but harmless (urgency_interrupt_threshold is config.py:1359 today).

claims.claim_title: Hippocampal trajectory proposals must be conditioned on a goal signal (z_goal) injected from E3 via a dedicated input channel; without this conditioning, the hippocampal module generates only position-based trajectories and cannot produce goal-directed navigation toward target states.
claims.falsifier_summary: Navigation is unchanged by ablation under a selector that demonstrably can consume goal information -- the hippocampal proposals are goal-directed without the injection, so the dedicated channel is not required.
claims.required_event: Goal-directed navigation episodes in which the hippocampal CEM proposes trajectories while a structured z_goal attractor is maintained in E3 (MECH-230 intact) and ghost-probe seeding is active.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the E3 -> hippocampal goal input (the current_z_goal injection / ghost-probe channel) while leaving E3's goal encoding intact, then restore it; run with use_cem_modulatory_authority enabled so the wanting term can actually move the elite argsort.
claims.control: The goal-encoding-intact / channel-ablated arm versus the channel-restored arm at matched seeds, plus a NOGOAL calibration arm confirming bit-identical trajectories when no goal is set.
claims.DV: Goal-terrain navigation score and the fraction of elite trajectories whose first-action class is goal-directed, as a function of z_goal_norm; recovery proportional to z_goal_norm on restoration is the claim's own stated prediction.
claims.instrument: ree_core/hippocampal/module.py _score_trajectory with the return_components path plus the elite-selection diagnostics, and the wanting/curiosity/mode_value modulatory terms rescaled by cem_modulatory_authority_gain; V3-EXQ-914/914a recorded the channel's own P1/P2 preconditions but not a selector able to consume it.
claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal trajectory-proposal and CEM elite-selection stage -- the consumer of z_goal -- not E3's maintenance of z_goal, which MECH-230 already covers.

claims.claim_title: The hippocampal module encodes pairwise distance relations between states in the z_world latent manifold — not only positional tags — providing a metric structure that enables distance-based navigation toward goal states across the residue-field terrain.
claims.falsifier_summary: Representational distances show no reliable correlation with true manifold distances even after metric supervision, or distance-requiring navigation performance is indistinguishable from a lookup/tag baseline while membership performance is unaffected.
claims.required_event: Navigation episodes that require comparing distances between NON-ADJACENT candidate states, rather than retrieving or recognising a previously visited state.
claims.manipulation: Add a distance-preservation / distance-respecting contrastive objective to the hippocampal map's embedding training, and ablate it, at matched seeds and matched episode budget.
claims.control: A categorical/positional-only arm (reconstruction or classification objective only) and a lookup / nearest-neighbour-tag baseline with no access to distance information, scored on both distance-requiring and pure membership tasks.
claims.DV: Correlation between pairwise distances in the learned representation and true manifold distances (representational-distance probe), and trajectory-proposal success on distance-requiring navigation relative to the lookup baseline, with membership/retrieval performance as the specificity control.
claims.instrument: Missing at the hippocampal locus. ree_core/hippocampal/module.py computes no pairwise distance or similarity structure over the map, and the only z_world distance in ree_core is the raw MSE in goal.py (goal_distance/goal_proximity) used by goal tracking -- which is the categorical/lookup alternative the claim must rule out. No representational-distance probe exists under experiments/_lib.
claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal map's representation of its indexing space (action objects), where a metric structure would have to live for distance-based navigation to be well defined.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The comparison must be made over the space the hippocampal map actually indexes -- action-object space O per SD-004, not raw z_world -- and there must be a defensible reference for true manifold distance in that space; without metric supervision the representation is expected to look categorical, so an untrained probe alone cannot distinguish absent metric structure from absent training pressure.
claims.blocking_reason: No metric-supervision objective exists on the hippocampal map, and no representational-distance probe or true-distance reference exists to score one, so the manipulation and the DV are both unbuilt. The claim also states its locus as the z_world manifold while the map indexes action-object space, which must be narrowed before a test is designed.
false_positives: The 2026-08-08 currency note states that no distance-preservation, contrastive or metric-supervision objective exists anywhere in ree_core; SD-056's InfoNCE world_forward_contrastive_loss has been in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py since 2026-05-29 (commit 041a974). It is an action-identification objective rather than metric preservation, so the substantive gap stands, but the absence statement as written is wrong and the existing InfoNCE machinery is the natural starting point for a metric variant.
claims.auditor_notes: The title/subject mismatch (z_world manifold versus action-object indexing space) is flagged inside the claim as owed to governance but no governance_flag record exists for it; the coordinator may want that raised before any falsifier is authored.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the HippocampalModule already exists and performs trajectory search over ACTION-OBJECT space O (E2.action_object(z_world, a) -> o_t, per SD-004), not raw z_world directly -- this claim's title should be read as "distance relations over the hippocampal map's indexing space." No distance-preservation, contrastive, or metric-supervision training objective exists anywhere in ree_core as of this date. The only distance computation touching z_world today is a raw MSE used by goal-tracking machinery, not a learned hippocampal encoding -- i.e. the substrate currently looks exactly like the categorical/lookup alternative this claim needs to rule out. The claim is untestable as stated until a distance-preservation objective is added to HippocampalModule (or its action-object embedding) training.
CONFIRMING: once a distance-preservation/contrastive loss is added, a representational-distance probe shows pairwise distances in the learned representation correlate with true manifold distances at a level above what an undifferentiated/categorical-only control achieves; AND trajectory proposals succeed at "navigate toward goal" tasks that specifically require distance comparison between non-adjacent candidate states (not just membership/retrieval of a previously-visited state), with performance degrading when the metric-supervision loss is ablated.
FALSIFYING: representational-distance probes show no reliable correlation between the hippocampal module's internal similarity structure and true manifold distances, even after adding the metric-supervision objective -- the representation remains categorical/positional rather than metric regardless of training pressure; OR trajectory-proposal performance on distance-requiring navigation tasks is statistically indistinguishable from a lookup/nearest-neighbor-tag baseline that has no access to distance information, while performance on pure membership/retrieval tasks is unaffected -- showing the metric structure adds no functional value beyond what a position tag already provides.

claims.claim_title: Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.
claims.falsifier_summary: With both gates cleared, belief persistence tracks input noise or prior structure rather than the precision ratio, or the self-sealing signature appears at every precision setting including the intact one -- the ratio is not load-bearing.
claims.required_event: A learning phase in which the agent acquires a world regularity, followed by a regime change that genuinely disconfirms that regularity -- i.e. produces a measurable prediction-error spike in the intact control agent.
claims.manipulation: Down-weighting sensory prediction-error precision relative to prior precision (the pe_precision ladder: control, low, very low), applied only to the backward pass so the reported forward loss stays comparable across arms.
claims.control: The intact-precision arm as positive control for adaptation, plus the two registered alternative pathways at matched input -- MECH-246 signal degradation and MECH-247 pathological priors -- which must NOT reproduce the persistence.
claims.DV: The adaptation ratio across the regime change (early minus late phase-B loss over early phase-B loss) differenced per seed between the intact and down-weighted arms, with a dose-response over the precision ladder.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-826a implements the full ladder, logs unweighted per-step E1 loss for fair cross-arm comparison, and self-routes to non_contributory on a precondition miss; the instrument is sound and the two failing gates are properties of the regime it ran in.
claims.consumer_locus: The precision weighting applied to the E1/E2 bottom-up error before it updates the generative model -- upstream of source monitoring, which MECH-094 owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both control-arm readiness gates must clear before any arm is interpretable: phase-A world-model convergence ratio at or above 0.25 (measured 0.152) and the phase-B regime-change disconfirmation spike at or above 1.15 (measured 0.966). The third gate, that lowering pe_precision genuinely reduces belief updating, already passes at 2.06 against a 1.5 floor, so gradient flow is not the issue.
claims.blocking_reason: The discriminating regime is not entered: the intact control agent neither converges enough in phase A nor shows a disconfirmation spike when hazards are relocated, so there is no adaptation for precision down-weighting to remove. The causal lever itself is confirmed engaged.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
claims.auditor_notes: Load-bearing cross-link the WWA does not yet make: 826a's disconfirmation gate uses hazard RELOCATION, and V3-EXQ-677 established that relocation only moves hazards whose optimal prediction is their mean, adding sampling noise rather than learning load. The SD-MEL-PRODUCER world_rule_shift knobs (implemented, ladder graded by V3-EXQ-1069) are the manipulation that produces a genuine, decaying PE elevation and are the natural replacement for P2.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two readiness gates the V3-EXQ-826a evidence_quality_note names must both clear before any arm is interpretable -- phase-A convergence ratio at or above its 0.25 floor (measured 0.152) and regime-change disconfirmation at or above 1.15 (measured 0.966); pe_precision_manipulation_took passed (2.06 vs 1.5 floor), so E1 trains and the outstanding gates are convergence and disconfirmation, not gradient flow.
CONFIRMING: down-weighting sensory prediction-error precision relative to prior precision produces beliefs that persist against incoming percepts, with a dose-response on the precision ratio, and the persistence is NOT reproduced by the two registered alternative pathways at matched input (MECH-246 signal degradation, MECH-247 pathological priors).
FALSIFYING: belief persistence tracks input noise or prior structure rather than the precision ratio; OR the self-sealing signature appears at every precision setting including the intact one (the precision ratio is not load-bearing).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional on its own readiness gates (two non_contributory runs, 826/826a), and separately (c2) out-of-domain for its clinical content, which resolves by literature. The 2026-09-15 provenance ingestion deliberately did NOT register a fourth (provenance-error) pathway beside this claim.

claims.claim_title: Hallucination is a generative-model dominance failure where top-down predictions produce percepts without corresponding bottom-up sensory grounding.

claims.control: Frozen-last-observation arm over the same window, same seed and same trained model, plus a grounded arm in which observation continues, so drift from the true state is measured rather than assumed.

claims.falsifier_summary: Encoding-side mode-setting alone reproduces the whole functional separation with no retrieval-side stage needed -- MECH-248 then earns no keep over MECH-249.
claims.required_event: Retrieval of content whose origin differs from its surface form -- an internally generated replay or simulation trace and an externally received perception that are matched in content and strength at the point of retrieval.
claims.manipulation: Ablate a retrieval-side attribution stage while holding the encoding-side write gating fixed, and separately ablate encoding-side mode-setting while leaving the attribution stage intact.
claims.control: The encoding-side-only configuration (MECH-249 neuromodulatory mode-setting alone), which is the rival account the claim must beat, plus matched-content trials where the true source is known by construction.
claims.DV: Attribution accuracy and calibration at retrieval -- P(external | representation) against ground-truth origin, with association strength held matched -- and its selective degradation under attribution-stage ablation while encoding-side write profiles remain unchanged.
claims.instrument: Missing. No P(external) or source-attribution readout exists in ree_core; p_external in cingulate/aic_analog.py:243 is an operating-MODE weight (external task versus internal), not a per-representation attribution, and BLAAttributionHead (amygdala/attribution_head.py:320) does causal harm attribution to slots, not source attribution.
claims.consumer_locus: Retrieval-time attribution of stored content to an internal or external origin, downstream of the encoding-side write gate that hypothesis_tag controls -- a different architectural boundary from MECH-094's write decision.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A source-monitoring readout distinct from the write gate must exist -- the architecture must report P(external | representation) separately from whether the item was permitted to write. Re-verified today: hypothesis_tag is a single bool on LatentState (stack.py:753) and in E2FastConfig (e2_fast.py:63) and is the same bit for both roles.
claims.blocking_reason: Two missing instruments, not one. There is no retrieval-side source readout, and the rival arm the falsifier compares against is also unbuilt -- ree_core/neuromodulation contains only serotonin.py, so MECH-249's continuous ACh and NA inputs do not exist and cannot be held intact as the control.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: MECH-248 and Q-105 both need P(external | representation) to be readable separately from the write gate, so that attribution can be scored, ablated and dissociated from write permission.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: No new cognitive mechanism -- a retrieval-side readout head over already-stored representations that emits a graded source-attribution score, plus a switch to ablate it, leaving hypothesis_tag's write gating untouched and bit-identical when off.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-item graded P(external) with its ground-truth origin, enabling attribution accuracy and calibration curves, which today cannot be computed because the only source signal is the binary write-gate bit.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: substrate_queue.json's self-attribution entries (SD-030 comparator_z_self, SD-031 comparator_z_world, MECH-256) are reafference comparators for self-versus-world motor prediction; none exposes a source-attribution readout, and Q-105 is a v4 consumer of the readout rather than its owner.

claims.auditor_notes: Q-105 (implementation_phase v4) needs this same readout plus an evidence-cardinality readout; if the coordinator registers one node it should serve both, and MECH-249's ACh/NA build is a SEPARATE unbuilt prerequisite that this candidate deliberately does not absorb.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a source-monitoring readout DISTINCT from the write gate must exist -- the architecture must be able to report P(external | representation) separately from whether the item was allowed to write. In the current tree it cannot: hypothesis_tag (ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) is the same bit for both.
CONFIRMING: a distinct attribution stage, operating at RETRIEVAL rather than at encoding, reproduces the functional separation MECH-094 asserts, and its ablation degrades attribution while leaving the encoding-side neuromodulatory mode-setting (MECH-249) intact.

claims.claim_title: The end of exhalation (expiration phase) provides a hard, periodic release signal for committed motor programs via respiratory-motor coupling -- a breath-timed gate-release mechanism distinct from hippocampal completion (ARC-028) and urgency interrupt (MECH-091).
claims.falsifier_summary: Transitions increase but are uniformly distributed over the breath cycle, making the mechanism a periodic release RATE rather than a phase-locked boundary event and collapsing the residual back into MECH-108's window model.
claims.required_event: An exhale-end phase boundary of the breath cycle occurring while the beta gate is elevated on a committed trajectory.
claims.manipulation: RELEASE-ON versus RELEASE-OFF at matched seeds and identical breath_period, so MECH-108's sweep is present in both arms and cancels, with a third breath_period = 0 arm to rule out the sweep as the source.
claims.control: The matched-seed RELEASE-OFF arm at the same breath_period, plus the breath_period = 0 arm and MECH-104's surprise impulse pinned off so no second de-commitment driver is live.
claims.DV: Two legs -- phase locking, committed-to-uncommitted transitions clustering at the exhale-end boundary with a Rayleigh test rejecting uniformity over the breath cycle at p below 0.01 in at least 2 of 3 seeds; and causal contribution, the ON arm's transition rate exceeding OFF by more than 3 SD of the per-seed delta and at least 1 transition per 5 breath cycles.
claims.instrument: Neither leg is recordable today. MultiRateClock tracks _breath_phase_step but exposes only is_sweep_phase() (heartbeat/clock.py:114-120) -- there is no exhale-end boundary event and no per-tick breath phase on the transition record, so transitions cannot be binned by phase.
claims.consumer_locus: The MECH-090 bistable beta gate's release, as a third pathway alongside hippocampal completion and urgency interrupt -- the gate boundary itself, not the commit threshold that MECH-108 softens.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Re-verified -- the release-OFF arm must sustain commitment (committed fraction above 0.8) or there is nothing for a hard release to break, the breath cycle must be running with the exhale-end boundary counted, and MECH-108's threshold softening must be shown inert at the operating point so de-commitments cannot be attributed to two mechanisms at once.
claims.blocking_reason: The breath phase exists but never reaches the gate. BetaGate has receive_hippocampal_completion (heartbeat/beta_gate.py:282) and ten release() call sites in agent.py, none breath-driven, and no receive_respiratory_phase entry point; the clock exposes no exhale-end boundary. The hook is unowned -- substrate_queue.json has no breath or respiratory entry.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: MECH-250 needs a positive release trigger at the exhale-end boundary and the ability to bin de-commitment events by breath phase, neither of which the shipped BreathOscillator provides.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Expose the exhale-end boundary as an event on MultiRateClock and add BetaGate.receive_respiratory_phase(phase) calling release() at that boundary behind a default-off flag, bit-identical when off -- roughly the same shape as the existing receive_hippocampal_completion route.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Per-tick breath phase attached to committed-to-uncommitted transition records, which is what makes the circular-concentration (Rayleigh) leg computable and separates phase locking from a bare rate increase.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: The 2026-09-06 thought-digestion partial-absorption kept this residual under substrate_conditional but registered no build; substrate_queue.json contains no breath or respiratory entry, and MECH-108's BreathOscillator is complete as built and does something different (threshold softening, arithmetically inert at the operating point).

claims.auditor_notes: The precondition is the likeliest failure -- the committed fraction in the OFF arm must be above 0.8 before the run means anything, and the digest flags that as the cheapest pattern to hit; treat it as a re-design signal, not a result.
claims.coordinator_note: Merged into the mech108 breath-phase instrument node (exhale-end boundary event + default-off BetaGate hook); see prerequisites_registered.
claims.what_would_answer:
question is *hard release at a boundary*, not *periodic uncommitted windows*, which is MECH-108's):

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it. Specific to this claim, and decisive: the run must
establish that MECH-108's existing threshold softening is INERT at the run's own operating
point -- report `effective_threshold` under sweep (`0.40 x (1 - sweep_amplitude)`) against the
realised `running_variance` distribution, and confirm the softened threshold is not crossed. If
the sweep alone *does* produce uncommitted steps in this configuration, MECH-250's residual is not
separable from MECH-108 in that run and the run cannot adjudicate it -- re-derive the operating
point first. Additionally: (a) the committed-fraction in the release-OFF control arm must be
strictly between 0 and 1, and specifically high (> 0.8) -- a hard release is only observable
against a background of sustained commitment; (b) the breath cycle must be running
(`breath_period > 0`) and the exhale-end boundary must be counted, with `n_boundaries >= 20` per
episode-block; (c) MECH-104's surprise impulse must be pinned off (no rv injection,
`_ema_alpha` at its default) so that de-commitments cannot be attributed to two mechanisms at
once (G3 preamble (iv)).

CONFIRMING. With a `receive_respiratory_phase(EXHALE_END) -> beta_gate.release()` build, on a
matched-seed RELEASE-ON vs RELEASE-OFF pair (both with `breath_period = 50`, so MECH-108's sweep is
identical in both arms and cancels): (i) PHASE-LOCKING -- committed -> uncommitted transitions
in the ON arm cluster at the exhale-end boundary, with a circular-phase concentration over the
breath cycle whose Rayleigh test rejects uniformity at p < 0.01 in >= 2 of 3 seeds; and
(ii) CAUSAL CONTRIBUTION -- the ON arm's transition rate exceeds the OFF arm's by more than
3 SD of the per-seed rate delta and by an absolute floor of 1 transition per 5 breath cycles.
Leg (i) is what distinguishes MECH-250 from any generic periodic de-commitment, and (ii) is what
distinguishes it from MECH-108's already-present sweep.

FALSIFYING. (ii) holds but (i) fails: transitions increase but are uniformly distributed over
the breath cycle, meaning the mechanism is a periodic release *rate* rather than a
*phase-locked boundary* event -- that refutes MECH-250 as written and collapses the residual back
into MECH-108's window model, i.e. it makes the full absorption correct after all. Alternatively,
(i) and (ii) both hold but the OFF arm shows the same transition rate once `breath_period = 0` is
also tested as a third arm -- meaning the transitions were produced by the sweep, not the release.
A third pattern, and the cheapest to hit: the OFF arm's committed-fraction is already < 0.8 in
the control, so there was never sustained commitment for a release to break -- that is the
precondition failing, and is a re-design signal, not a result.
