claims.claim_title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the trigger reachable and exercised (ruling out the substrate-not-engaged confound), operating_mode transitions are statistically indistinguishable from the scrambled-input control -- mode switches occur at chance rate regardless of subdivision input -- which is a genuine weakens against the coordinator mechanism and should trigger stable-to-candidate reconsideration.
claims.required_event: A trained agent running long enough to accumulate salient events (dACC prediction error, AIC urgency, external_task drive, CeA mode prior) that carry the coordinator's salience aggregate across its enter and exit rails repeatedly within one episode window.
claims.manipulation: Vary the underlying subdivision salience inputs while holding the switch machinery fixed -- e.g. scheduled threat/foraging contexts that move dacc_pe and external_task_drive -- and compare against a scrambled-input arm in which the same signal magnitudes are delivered with their temporal association to context destroyed.
claims.control: A scrambled/phase-shifted salience-input arm at matched seeds and matched marginal signal distribution, plus the use_salience_coordinator OFF baseline for the behavioural null.
claims.DV: Per-tick coupling between the coordinator's own salience_aggregate / subdivision inputs and its mode transitions -- mutual information or lagged correlation between input state and current_mode, and the switch rate conditioned on input state, against the scrambled-input arm's chance level.
claims.instrument: SalienceCoordinator.tick returns operating_mode, current_mode, mode_switch_trigger, salience_aggregate, enter_threshold, exit_threshold, current_mode_prob and mode_entropy per tick, so the coupling DV is directly recordable. No existing driver records it: 934/935/935a, 464e and 467e record occupancy, switch counts and dwell, which are marginal statistics, not input-output coupling.
claims.consumer_locus: The coordinator's input-to-mode mapping -- whether operating_mode transitions are driven by the AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog salience signals rather than occurring independently of them.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The coordinator's discrete register must be genuinely exercised rather than saturated: mode occupancy must be strictly between 0 and 1 for at least two modes over the measurement window, with a non-zero switch count, and the readiness gate's route_reason must not be relied on (it is confirmed to emit a factually-false reason at 100 percent occupancy). Affinity inputs must include at least one signal the bounding operator does not pin.
claims.blocking_reason: The coordinator, its inputs and its per-tick readouts all exist and occupancy is now reachable, but every run in the lineage measures occupancy/dwell/switch counts for MECH-266's hysteresis question; none records the input-to-transition coupling SD-032a's own falsifier needs. The readiness gate on salience_coordinator.py is separately confirmed corrupting-severity and must not be trusted as the non-vacuity check.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: Reading the bang-bang occupancy shape of 464e/467e as evidence against SD-032a is wrong: the claim's own functional_restatement specifies discrete, not graded, mode transitions; that shape bears on MECH-266's hysteresis, not on the coordinator.

The claim that no MECH-261 write gate can be perturbed by the coordinator is correct for write_gate (it reads the soft operating_mode vector), but current_mode IS consumed by ree_core/governance/closure_operator.py, so the discrete register is not entirely consumer-less.

claims.control: The pcc-off arm (SalienceCoordinator effective_threshold equal to the bare switch_threshold) at matched seeds, and a stability-clamped arm holding pcc_stability at its baseline so only its VARIATION is removed.

claims.claim_title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.
claims.falsifier_summary: Arm C reproduces arm A's forward-propagation bias (mode gating unnecessary) or arm B reproduces it (the coordinator overlay is over-specification and coordination is local), on matched seeds with the quiescence precondition met.
claims.required_event: A scheduled micro-quiescence window (MECH-092 SWR-analog) carrying specific replayed trajectories, followed by external_task action selection on the same environment within the forward-propagation horizon.
claims.manipulation: The EXP-0148 three-arm design: (A) intact coordinator emitting the full soft operating_mode vector; (B) coordinator output clamped to a constant external_task one-hot while per-substrate gates keep their local logic; (C) gates replaced by permanently-open local heuristics with no operating_mode dependence.
claims.control: Arm C is the no-mode-gating null and arm B the coordinator lesion; both matched on seeds, replay content and quiescence schedule, with 5 seeds per arm and a pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 acceptance on the primary metric.
claims.DV: Post-quiescence action-selection bias toward recently replayed trajectories -- cosine similarity between replay content and the next committed trajectory embedding -- plus cross-mode write bleed (writes into the viability map originating from replay content during external_task commitment).
claims.instrument: MISSING. The write gates are consumed (agent.py write_gate call sites for autonomic, e3_policy, sd_033a, sd_033b) and the soft vector is exposed, but nothing records replay-content-to-next-trajectory correspondence, and SalienceCoordinator exposes no API to clamp operating_mode to a fixed vector for arm B.
claims.consumer_locus: Cross-mode forward propagation: replayed content routed through the mode-conditioned write gates into SD-033a/SD-033b and thence into subsequent external_task action selection -- not the within-tick gate arithmetic already validated by V3-EXQ-446/453.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A quiescence window in which internal_replay actually carries content and the mode vector is not pinned to external_task: internal_replay weight must be materially above zero over the replay window and the replayed trajectory content must be recorded, otherwise the post-quiescence bias DV has nothing to correlate against and a null is vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: Neither half of the causal test can be instantiated: there is no recorder for the post-quiescence replay-to-action bias metric, and no fixed-operating-mode clamp for the coordinator-lesion arm. claims.previous_what_would_answer:
SD-033's load-bearing falsifiable content is carried by its first
subdivision, SD-033a (lateral-PFC-analog), which IS implemented
(ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py, landed 2026-04-20) -- this is
a comparative ablation test, not a substrate-existence test. SD-033b
(OFC-analog) remains unbuilt (second V3 priority); SD-033c/d are
registration-only consolidations of already-active substrate
(ARC-035/MECH-151/152/235; E3 trajectory machinery) and are not
separately falsifiable; SD-033e is V4-deferred (only a V3 forward-compat
hook exists).

ANSWER "SD-033a is over-specification, E3 alone suffices" if a ree-v3
implementation WITHOUT SD-033a's rule/goal substrate reproduces, without
degradation, all three MECH-262 functional signatures relative to the
SD-033a-ON arm: (i) stimulus-abstracted generalisation -- transfer to
novel stimuli under the same rule produces equivalent representational/
behavioural effect; (ii) distractor-resistant persistence -- rule-
selective effect survives internal_replay / MECH-092 micro-quiescence
intervals; (iv) training-dependent emergence -- the effect strengthens
with training exposure rather than being present from init. ANSWER
"SD-033a is required" (falsifies the over-specification hypothesis) if
E3-alone fails any of the three and the SD-033a-ON arm passes it.

CURRENT STATE (partial, mixed -- not "untested"): signature (ii) has
DIRECT SUPPORTING evidence (V3-EXQ-484: replay_drift/task_drift ratio
0.088, C1-C4 PASS, canonical governance replica). Substrate wiring
integrity (frozen-silent vs trainable-nonzero contrast) is confirmed
PASS across V3-EXQ-598/598b/598c. Signature (iv)'s causal test
(V3-EXQ-598b) and the closure-coupled persistence probe (V3-EXQ-461c)
both reached SD-033a's own decision boundary correctly but could not
complete, because of substrate ceilings IN OTHER CLAIMS, not in
SD-033a: MECH-309 monomodal collapse (blocks iv) and the SD-034
ClosureOperator's env->emit_closure() hook being unwired on the
foraging-competent agent (blocks the closure-coupled persistence read).
Both are recorded non_contributory/substrate_ceiling,
pending_retest_after_substrate, explicitly NOT a weakening of SD-033a.
Signature (i), stimulus-abstracted generalisation to a novel stimulus
under a held rule, has no experiment at all yet -- this is the one
clean gap, not a substrate block.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a run of this ablation is vacuous, in
either direction, unless the agent demonstrably occupies the states the
test depends on. Confirmed failure modes to guard against (all from the
SD-034 closure-cluster-ext autopsy, 2026-06-12): (a) the agent must
actually enter external_task / internal_planning mode with nonzero
occupancy -- V3-EXQ-464c/467c passed their own non-vacuity gate while
fraction_in_external_task=0.0 for the entire run, because that gate
counted episode-boundary mode settles rather than genuine mode
occupancy; (b) if the persistence read is closure-coupled (as in the
461c design), SD-034's closure-coupled-resolution trigger must actually
fire (n_closure_coupled_resolutions >= 1) -- committed Hold-window
formation alone is not sufficient, and this precondition silently
failed on the foraging-competent substrate; (c) the agent must clear
whatever generic competence floor gates task engagement on the chosen

claims.what_would_answer:
This claim packages TWO distinct testability scopes -- do not conflate them.
SCOPE 1 -- the V3-NARROW de-commit lever (BUILT, 2026-07-09; blocked, not unbuilt). ree-v3 REEConfig.use_frontopolar_decommit + frontopolar_gain wire a parameter-free geometric proxy for function (1) counterfactual value (||z_chosen - z_goal|| - ||z_alt - z_goal||) into a commit-latch release pressure for function (3)/(4) disengagement-for-exploration. This is testable in principle today; it is currently untestable IN PRACTICE for one named reason, not an open-ended one.
Non-degeneracy precondition (all three must hold; none does as of 2026-08-08):
  (i) the MECH-457 competence floor is cleared -- per
      competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md, the campaign's
      discrimination job is finished but its one residual thread
      (H-consummation-binding) showed both arms installed at ~14% of ceiling
      (V3-EXQ-821), underpowering ANY contrast run on this substrate; the
      scoped fix (stronger BC install landing in the 20-40 forage/episode
      range, corrected 8-metric instrument -- landed 2026-08-07) is named but
      NOT yet queued or re-run. Until a run on this substrate clears a usable
      floor, an all-ON/all-OFF de-commit contrast cannot be distinguished from
      floor-saturation noise;
  (ii) a genuine 3+-alternative decision context is present, so "best
      unchosen alternative" is a differentiated rather than degenerate
      quantity (a 1-2-option context makes the geometric advantage trivial);
  (iii) use_frontopolar_decommit is actually flipped ON with nonzero
      frontopolar_gain (the OFF/default arm is bit-identical to baseline by
      construction and is not itself a test of anything).

CONFIRMING (mirrors the Mansouri 2015 lesion phenotype already named in this claim's notes): the ON arm shows release pressure -- de-commit/switch rate -- that positively covaries with frontopolar_gain * max(0, cfv_now - cfv_at_entry), and relative to the OFF arm shows measurably WORSE current-task persistence but BETTER counterfactual exploration (willingness to abandon the committed trajectory for a superior alternative); the OFF arm shows the inverse -- over-focus on the committed course, impaired exploration of better-valued alternatives.
FALSIFYING: once the floor precondition is cleared and a genuine 3+-way decision context is exercised, the ON arm's switch/de-commit behaviour is statistically indistinguishable from the OFF arm's despite nonzero frontopolar_gain -- i.e. the geometric counterfactual-advantage signal is not behaviourally load-bearing even in this minimal parameter-free form. This would mean the V3-narrow slice does not reproduce even the weak version of the Mansouri 2015 phenotype, independent of whatever the full V4 learned substrate might later show.
SCOPE 2 -- the V4-FULL four-function module (UNBUILT; MECH-264 head + MECH-265 monitor over K>=2 simultaneously active goals). Not operationally testable yet at all, and no non-degeneracy precondition can be stated in concrete terms until its own prerequisites exist: MECH-163 hippocampal multi-step planning (a 1-step counterfactual collapses MECH-264 to MECH-257) and a CausalGridWorldV2 dual/K-active-goal environment extension (function (4)/MECH-265 is structurally inaccessible with the current single-resource env). Per this claim's own v4_scope_deferred note, the SD-033e design doc itself (with a follow-up frontopolar lit-pull) is a V4-ENTRY prerequisite, not V3 work -- so this scope's own concrete falsifier is properly drafted at that design-doc stage, not here. The three pre-registered V4 proposals already staged for it (manual_proposals.v1.json EXP-0165/0166/0167 -- counterfactual-value dissociation, Mansouri-2015 ablation phenotype, and SD-033c/SD-033e double-dissociation respectively) remain status: gated, reconfirmed gated 2026-08-02, on exactly these unmet prerequisites.
POINTER, not re-derivation: for the counterfactual-value-TRACKING mechanism itself (MECH-264's own falsifier -- chosen-vs-unchosen value dissociation at the V4 substrate level), see MECH-264's own what_would_answer. This entry is scoped to the MODULE level (the V3-narrow lever's own testability, and the V4-full four-function packaging separately) and does not restate MECH-264's falsifier.

claims.claim_title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]
claims.falsifier_summary: The OFF-tuned arm reproduces >= 4 of the 5 components AND its residue-discharge DV lands within 1 SD of ON on >= 2/3 seeds -- closure is emergent from the existing substrate and SD-034 is over-specification.
claims.required_event: Satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition during an episode -- either the automatic rule-stability detector firing or an env sequence_complete routed through notify_env_completion.
claims.manipulation: Three arms: closure operator ON, OFF-baseline, and OFF-tuned (a genuine MECH-090 + MECH-260 + MECH-094 parameter search), holding the completion-generating environment fixed.
claims.control: OFF-baseline at shipped defaults plus the OFF-tuned best-performing member; identical completion rate and identical env across arms.
claims.DV: The five parts of the done token scored SEPARATELY -- beta release surviving closure_decommit_hold_ticks, targeted MECH-260 No-Go on the just-completed class, within-domain residue attenuation with the 1e-6 floor intact, a closure_event reaching SD-032a, and MECH-268 pe rebaseline -- plus the ON-vs-OFF-tuned gap on the 466e residue-discharge quantity.
claims.instrument: ree_core/governance/closure_operator.py fires and counts all five parts; get_state() returns n_ticks, n_closures, n_habenula_aborts, stable_tick_count and last_event, and the per-event skipped:<cause> strings live on ClosureEvent.reason in event_log -- the histogram must be built from event_log, it is NOT aggregated by get_state().
claims.consumer_locus: Rule completion to commitment release: whether closure is a coordinated operator or an emergent consequence of the existing MECH-090 / MECH-260 / MECH-094 substrate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: ON side: use_closure_operator=True with use_lateral_pfc_analog=True on the 603n foraging-competent substrate, with n_closures >= 1 AND nogo_installed >= 1 on >= 2/3 seeds and a non-flat residue-discharge DV. OFF-tuned side: a real search -- at least 3 distinct settings each of the MECH-090 beta thresholds, MECH-260 history depth and the MECH-094 mode-gating predicate, with the BEST member reported. diagnostic_logging must be on so skip causes are recoverable.
claims.blocking_reason: R0: the operator, the env-completion hook (Leg A), the de-commit hold (Leg B), the five component instruments and a demonstrated non-flat residue DV (V3-EXQ-466e PASS) all exist. The only instrument caveat is that the skip-cause histogram must be derived from ClosureOperator.event_log rather than get_state().
false_positives: The 460h/460i/715/715a/717 'closure DV vacuous' lineage is the de-commit MAGNITUDE face, decomposed to MECH-445/446 on 2026-06-19 and explicitly outside this claim's scope fence -- it is not evidence that SD-034's own falsifier is blocked.
The 2026-06-04 'agent never tolerance-completes, n_closures=0 in every arm' ceiling was closed by the 2026-06-12 Leg-A env-completion hook; it is not a live blocker.
claims.auditor_notes: Second-highest readiness in this batch. EXP-1385 already specifies the three-arm design; the OFF-tuned sweep is the expensive part and is a design cost, not a substrate gap.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- two-sided, because this test has a tuned control arm that can be
made vacuous as easily as the treatment arm. (ON side) `use_closure_operator=True` with
`use_lateral_pfc_analog=True` (enforced, agent.py:2277), on the 603n foraging-competent substrate,
and the closure path must demonstrably fire: `n_closures >= 1` AND `nogo_installed >= 1` on >= 2/3
seeds -- this is the exact gate the 2026-06-12 amend pre-registered, and the exact defect
V3-EXQ-460c hit (`n_closures = 0` despite env `sequence_completions` of 2/5/6). The residue-discharge
DV must be non-flat, i.e. reproduce V3-EXQ-466e's demonstrated separation, not sit at floor.
(OFF-tuned side) the control arm must be a real search and not a token one: at least 3 distinct
settings each of the MECH-090 beta commit/release thresholds, the MECH-260 action-history depth, and
the MECH-094 mode-gating predicate, with the BEST-performing member reported as the control, not the
mean. If `n_closures = 0` in ON, or the tuned sweep collapses to a single point, the run self-routes
`substrate_not_ready_requeue` and MUST NOT be scored in either direction. Report `n_ticks`,
`n_closures`, `n_habenula_aborts` and the `skipped:<cause>` histogram from `ClosureOperator.get_state()`
for every arm, so a null is attributable to a named skip cause rather than to "closure did nothing".

CONFIRMING: three arms -- ON, OFF-baseline, OFF-tuned. SD-034 is supported if the ON arm reproduces
the five-part token JOINTLY -- (a) MECH-090 beta release surviving `closure_decommit_hold_ticks`,
(b) targeted MECH-260 No-Go on the just-completed action class, (c) within-domain residue attenuation
with the 1e-6 floor asserted intact (the "residue cannot be erased" invariant), (d) a `closure_event`
reaching SD-032a, (e) MECH-268 dACC pe rebaseline -- while the OFF-tuned arm reproduces at most ONE
of the five; and if the ON-vs-OFF-tuned gap on the 466e residue-discharge DV exceeds
max(1.5 x the pooled SD of the per-seed ON-minus-OFF-tuned delta, an absolute floor of 10% of the
OFF-baseline within-domain residue mass) on >= 2/3 seeds. Scoring the five components SEPARATELY is
load-bearing: a scalar composite would let a large residue effect mask the absence of the No-Go
pulse, which is precisely the failure the 2026-06-12 amend was built to fix.

FALSIFYING: the OFF-tuned arm reproduces >= 4 of the 5 components AND its residue-discharge DV lands
within 1 SD of ON on >= 2/3 seeds. Then closure is emergent from the existing MECH-090/MECH-260/
MECH-094 substrate and SD-034 is over-specification -- this is the claim's own primary falsifier,
unchanged. SECONDARY (also the claim's own, and it routes elsewhere rather than weakening SD-034):
if ON resolves verified-but-not-released but introduces PREMATURE disengagement -- beta released
before the terminal step on a fraction of multi-step episodes exceeding OFF-baseline by more than
the same margin -- then the SD-033a completion-condition detector or the mode-conditioning logic is
wrong, not the operator; that outcome self-routes to the detector and MUST NOT be recorded as a
weakens on SD-034.

SCOPE FENCE (mandatory, and the reason this draft is fenced rather than broad): the closure->beta
COUPLING face and the de-commit MAGNITUDE face are NOT in scope. They were decomposed out to
MECH-445 and MECH-446 on 2026-06-19 (user-approved, spec
`evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_SD-034-closure_2026-06-19.md`) and have since accumulated eight
further runs of their own (460h/i/j/k/l, 715, 715a, 717). A null on either is NOT a null on SD-034,
and no de-commit DV may be scored against this claim.

claims.claim_title: Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.
claims.falsifier_summary: CeA ON fails to shorten mode-switch latency relative to OFF under a regime where switches demonstrably occur, or the zeroed-prior arm matches ON rather than OFF (the effect is not carried by mode_prior); or the BLA gain condition fails to improve threat-context recall in the live loop, or improves neutral recall equally, or remap_signal does not fire in its window.
claims.required_event: Graded threat contexts that drive z_harm_a across the CeA threshold and produce mode-switch opportunities, plus a live-loop encoding episode in a threat context followed by a later recall probe in the same and in a neutral context.
claims.manipulation: EXQ-A: use_cea_analog ON versus OFF with a third zeroed-mode-prior arm. EXQ-B: BLA encoding-gain condition ON versus OFF across threat and neutral encoding contexts, with remap_signal windows recorded.
claims.control: The zeroed-prior arm is the CeA leg's own control (it must match OFF); the neutral-context encoding arm is the BLA leg's control; and the use_amygdala_analog OFF arm supplies the bit-identical backward-compatibility baseline.
claims.DV: CeA leg: mode-switch LATENCY (ticks from threat onset to the first mode_switch_trigger) in ON versus OFF versus zeroed-prior. BLA leg: threat-context recall accuracy in the live loop under the gain condition, paired against neutral-context recall so a gain that merely raises all recall is separated from selective threat-context enhancement, plus remap_signal firing within the expected post-event window.
claims.instrument: The modules and their outputs exist and are consumed: ree_core/amygdala/cea.py mode_prior and fast_prime are injected into SalienceCoordinator via update_signal before tick (agent.py), and ree_core/amygdala/bla.py supplies encoding_gain, retrieval_bias and remap_signal. Mode-switch latency is derivable from the coordinator's per-tick trigger; a live-loop threat-versus-neutral RECALL task DV is not implemented in any driver.
claims.consumer_locus: Upstream of the cingulate: the amygdala-to-coordinator mode-prior route for the CeA leg, and the BLA-to-hippocampal-write-path encoding-gain route for the BLA leg.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For the CeA leg, the SD-032a mode register must actually alternate in the measurement window (non-saturated occupancy, non-zero switch count), since CeA mode_prior is registered only on the external_task affinity slot and cannot express where the register is pinned. For the BLA leg, the amygdala must be exercised in the live loop (bla_n_ticks > 0 -- V3-EXQ-474's C2-C5 were synthetic tick() calls after an env.step unpacking bug), and acceptance must be calibrated against the SD-032b dACC affective-PE underperformance so a null is not read as falsification of SD-035.
claims.blocking_reason: Both literal falsifiers were never executed: V3-EXQ-501 substituted an analog-versus-binary contrast for the CeA ON/OFF latency comparison, and no run has done a live-loop threat-versus-neutral recall contrast (474 measured synthetic tick() calls; 659 and 888 are replay/AOR-buffer measures). The CeA leg additionally inherits the saturated mode register.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim is not untested: seven landed runs cover backward compatibility, substrate readiness, analog-versus-binary discrimination and both child mechanisms; the residual is a literal-wording gap, not an absence of evidence.
claims.auditor_notes: cea_mode_prior is registered on affinity_weights with a single external_task entry, so a CeA latency effect can only express through the external_task affinity path; any EXQ-A rerun should record that path's bounding-operator treatment, which GFLAG-0370 shows is already contested for the bounded external_task_drive signal.

claims.claim_title: Rule-selective persistence in lateral-PFC-analog: stimulus-abstracted rule representations in SD-033a persist across simulated time steps without external drive, remain selective through distractor events, and emerge through training rather than being innate.
claims.falsifier_summary: rule_state is stimulus-bound (same-rule novel-stimulus cosine no higher than cross-rule), or it collapses across the internal_replay window at the storage site, or it is already selective before training -- any of which means the SD-033a substrate does not meet its functional spec.
claims.required_event: Intervening events during a maintained rule episode -- simulated distractor stimuli, forced internal_replay, and MECH-092 micro-quiescence cycles -- occurring between rule establishment and rule-dependent action.
claims.manipulation: use_candidate_rule_source ON versus OFF (differentiated CandidateRuleField source versus the legacy delta_proj/world_proj source), crossed with forced internal_replay injected during the maintenance window, and for signature (1) a transfer block presenting novel stimuli under an already-trained rule.
claims.control: The legacy-source arm reproducing the measured monomodal collapse as a negative control, a no-distractor arm to establish the undisturbed persistence baseline, and a different-rule transfer block so generalisation is distinguished from stimulus memorisation.
claims.DV: Three separable quantities: (1) cosine between rule_state under a trained stimulus and under a novel stimulus of the SAME rule, compared against the cross-rule cosine; (2) rule_state drift across the distractor window, read BOTH at the storage site and on the selection path, since 874b showed they dissociate; (3) rule-selectivity as a function of task exposures, to test training-dependent emergence.
claims.instrument: LateralPFCAnalog holds the rule_state buffer and 598c supplies a working cosine probe, but that probe reads the storage site only and its own docstring disclaims MECH-262; no experiment combines the GAP-B source, forced internal_replay and a novel-stimulus transfer block, and no recorder pairs the storage-site read with a selection-path operative-rule read in the same run.
claims.consumer_locus: The lateral-PFC-analog rule representation itself -- its abstraction, its survival through intervening events, and its emergence with training -- read at BOTH the storage site and the selection path, since a storage-site read alone is now known not to track the operative rule.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: rule_state must be differentiated across rule contexts with use_candidate_rule_source=True -- the inversion of 598b's C3 trainable_not_monomodal collapse -- and this must be demonstrated in-run before persistence is scored. A monomodal rule_state makes any distractor-resistance reading vacuous, since an undifferentiated vector cannot be shown to survive a distractor selectively.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate the WWA waits on has landed, but no experiment exercises it for this claim: 598c probes the storage site without forced internal_replay and explicitly disclaims MECH-262, 874/874b own the distractor battery under MECH-467, and nothing tests stimulus-abstraction transfer at all. The 874b storage-versus-selection dissociation means a single-site read cannot settle signature (ii).
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT

claims.claim_title: Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.
claims.falsifier_summary: FPC-analog activity tracks chosen-option value instead, in which case SD-033e collapses functionally into SD-033c and the frontopolar subdivision should be folded into the vmPFC-analog. Secondary, slice-only: 726 runs post-clearance and shows no attributable occupancy drop.
claims.required_event: A three-alternative decision episode in which the agent commits to one option while at least two genuine alternatives remain live and their values evolve over multiple steps.
claims.manipulation: Full form: ablate the maintained counterfactual channel (SD-033e) while leaving SD-033c's chosen-option value intact, and vary the switch margin. Narrow slice: use_frontopolar_decommit ON (ARM_FP_ON) versus the flat-urgency contrast (ARM_FP_CONTRAST) in V3-EXQ-726.
claims.control: SD-033c chosen-option value as the dissociation partner; for the slice, ARM_FP_CONTRAST plus frontopolar_release_count, which proves a release is attributable to the counterfactual term rather than flat timeout or F noise.
claims.DV: Full form: whether lateral-FPC-analog activity tracks the value of the best UNCHOSEN alternative rather than the chosen option across trials, and whether the magnitude of that signal predicts switch propensity. Slice: median committed-latch occupancy at release (ncur_last_occupancy_at_release) dropping >= 0.40 in ARM_FP_ON on >= 2/3 strong-F seeds.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/frontopolar_analog.py compute_counterfactual_value (a single-tick geometric advantage, parameter-free) wired at the e3_selector de-commit site; there is no maintained multi-step counterfactual estimator and no three-alternative environment in ree-v3.
claims.consumer_locus: A parallel value channel maintained alongside SD-033c's chosen-option stream, with a threshold-sensitive switch -- not an entry-relative single-tick de-commit pressure on the natural-commit latch.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For the V3-narrow slice: a substrate that sustains competent committed foraging, i.e. a genuine natural-commit latch to de-commit FROM -- the MECH-457 competence floor, still open. For the full mechanism: MECH-163 multi-step trajectory planning landed (without it a counterfactual value is necessarily 1-step and collapses into MECH-257, the dACC immediate-reward comparator) and a 3+-alternative decision task.
claims.blocking_reason: The mechanism asserted -- a RUNNING multi-step counterfactual estimate with a switch margin -- is unbuilt and structurally blocked on MECH-163; at 1 step it collapses into MECH-257. The built V3 slice is an explicitly degenerate single-tick geometric stand-in, and its own validation V3-EXQ-726 is written but HELD on the open MECH-457 competence floor. No three-alternative task exists in CausalGridWorldV2.
false_positives: The 2026-08-07 implementation_phase flip v4 -> v3 is administrative (phase-follows-dependency from MECH-487) and is explicitly not a build authorisation; reading MECH-264 as a V3 experimental target because the registry says phase v3 is the error the claim record warns about.

claims.what_would_answer:
TWO DISTINCT THINGS ARE BEING TESTED HERE, and they must not be conflated.
(i) V3-NARROW GEOMETRIC SLICE (BUILT, 2026-07-09; use_frontopolar_decommit / frontopolar_gain, ree_core/pfc/frontopolar_analog.py compute_counterfactual_value). A parameter-free, SINGLE-TICK goal-proximity advantage of the best unchosen candidate over the committed endpoint (||z_chosen-z_goal|| - ||z_alt-z_goal||), wired only as an entry-relative de-commit PRESSURE on the natural-commit latch (NaturalCommitUrgencyRelease). This is NOT a maintained parallel value channel and is NOT what this claim asserts -- it is a deliberately degenerate stand-in, built to serve a different substrate goal (the MECH-439 F-dominance duration-face de-commit lever), that happens to instantiate MECH-264's switch logic in its simplest possible form.
(ii) V4-FULL SUBSTRATE (UNBUILT). The mechanism this claim actually asserts: a RUNNING, MULTI-STEP counterfactual-value ESTIMATE maintained in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal (not recomputed fresh each tick), with a switch fired when it exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin. Structurally blocked on MECH-163 (hippocampal multi-step trajectory planning, unmet) -- without multi-step plans a counterfactual value is necessarily 1-step and collapses to MECH-257 (dACC immediate-reward comparator), which is a different mechanism entirely.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any result is interpretable): - For (i): the isolated-GAP-A substrate must sustain a genuine natural-commit
  latch to de-commit FROM -- i.e. competent committed foraging must exist at
  all. V3-EXQ-726 (the slice's own validation script, arms ARM_FP_CONTRAST vs
  ARM_FP_ON) is written and gate-hygiene-fixed but explicitly HELD, NOT QUEUED:
  its resume condition is "a substrate that sustains competent committed
  foraging," which is the SAME substrate gap the MECH-457 competence-floor
  campaign (V3-EXQ-724 lineage, GOV-FANOUT-1) is diagnosing. That campaign
  remains open (candidate/v3_pending) as of the latest confirmed evidence
  (V3-EXQ-821, 2026-07-25). Running 726 before MECH-457 clears would
  self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on a precondition already known to
  be unmet.
- For (ii): requires MECH-163 multi-step planning landed, plus a non-degenerate
  3+-alternative decision task (this claim's own functional_restatement names
  "simulated three-alternative decision tasks").

CONFIRMING observation: - (i), once MECH-457 clears and V3-EXQ-726 runs: ARM_FP_ON's median committed-
  latch occupancy (ncur_last_occupancy_at_release) drops >= 0.40 vs
  ARM_FP_CONTRAST on >= 2/3 strong-F seeds, WITH frontopolar_release_count > 0
  on the ON arm (proving the release is attributable to the counterfactual
  term firing when cfv_now > cfv_at_entry, not to flat-timeout or F noise).
  This would confirm the geometric switch signal behaves as a genuine
  counterfactual-value comparator even in its degenerate 1-step form --
  supportive but NOT sufficient to promote MECH-264 itself, since (i) is
  explicitly not the claim's mechanism.
- (ii), in a V4 implementation: lateral-FPC-analog activity tracks the value
  of the best UNCHOSEN alternative (dissociable from SD-033c's chosen-option
  value stream) during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, and
  individual variation in the counterfactual signal's magnitude predicts
  switch propensity (per Boorman et al. 2009).

FALSIFYING observation (this claim's own primary falsifier, verbatim from functional_restatement): if lateral-FPC-analog activity in a V4 implementation tracks CHOSEN-option value rather than counterfactual-option value during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, MECH-264 fails at source and SD-033e collapses functionally into SD-033c -- in that case the OFC/vmPFC/FPC value architecture is over-specified at REE's level of description and the frontopolar subdivision should be folded into the vmPFC-analog. A secondary falsifier applies to (i) alone: if V3-EXQ-726 runs post-clearance and ARM_FP_ON shows no attributable occupancy drop (frontopolar_release_count == 0, or the drop is indistinguishable from the flat-urgency contrast), the geometric slice fails to behave as a counterfactual comparator even in its minimal form -- this would NOT itself falsify MECH-264 (the slice is not the claim), but would remove the one piece of experimental purchase currently available on any instantiation of the mechanism.
Until MECH-457 clears, MECH-264 has zero experimental evidence (genuine_exp_count: 0 in claim_evidence.v1.json; all current evidence entries are literature) and cannot be tested even in its narrow V3 form.

claims.claim_title: Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).
claims.falsifier_summary: Under the corrected gate, no cap value or regime-conditioning yields anything but a step function -- occupancy ~1.0 below some r and ~0.0 above it with n_switches invariant -- which falsifies the GRADED framing (H2) while leaving the Schmitt trigger's existence intact.
claims.required_event: A mode-switching episode in which salience pressure crosses the enter rail into a mode and then decays toward the exit rail, so the Schmitt asymmetry can bind or release.
claims.manipulation: Per-mode exit_threshold swept via set_hysteresis_ratio across r in [0.10, 2.00] with enter_thresholds held fixed, on a bounding operator whose cap behaviour is matched across arms rather than swapped between clamp and squash.
claims.control: The symmetric-threshold baseline (empty enter/exit dicts, legacy MECH-259 behaviour), plus a matched-occupancy arm at the same mean dwell so the dose-response cannot be read off occupancy level alone.
claims.DV: Mode dwell time and switch count as a continuous function of the exit/enter ratio within an accessible regime, plus the under-binding/over-binding behavioural continuum; the discriminating quantity is whether occupancy varies continuously with the hysteresis parameter or only as a step.
claims.instrument: cingulate/salience_coordinator.py implements the two-rail trigger (enter_thresholds / exit_thresholds, setters at :504-520) and returns enter_threshold, exit_threshold and current_mode_prob per tick; experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py now supplies the regime-conditioned non-vacuity gate that the old min-across-arms statistic corrupted.
claims.consumer_locus: The SalienceCoordinator mode register -- the enter/exit rails on the aggregate salience vector, not the E3 candidate score.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A contested mode must be genuinely occupiable at an intermediate level: at least one accessible cap/regime must produce fractional external_task occupancy rather than the 0.0/1.0 step function 934/935/935a found, and the bounding operator must not itself shift the external_task logit (GFLAG-0370's measured squash-vs-clamp confound, -0.96 to -1.50 at the cap).
claims.blocking_reason: H2 (structurally bang-bang) is not eliminated and is the live alternative: 19 of 21 arm/ratio cells sat at exactly 0.0 or 1.0, and no single cap graded on more than 1 of 3 seeds. The bounding-operator build that would widen the crossing is implemented_pending_validation, and its validation run was refused at red-team over a confound (GFLAG-0370).
false_positives: The 2026-06 reading that external_task mode was unreachable is withdrawn: 464e/467e reached occupancy 1.0 at r=0.10 on every seed, and the 'mode_not_occupied' route_reason those runs emitted was factually false.

claims.claim_title: Mode-conditioned hippocampal trajectory proposals: HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories must condition on operating_mode (SD-032a) in addition to world_state. External_task mode proposes task-relevant trajectories; internal_planning mode proposes counterfactual / branching trajectories; internal_replay mode replays past-successful trajectories; offline_consolidation mode proposes stability-check trajectories. Without mode conditioning, replay content contaminates external-task selection.
claims.falsifier_summary: Even with H3 as default and a properly powered gate, the predicted ordered four-mode gradient is not restored and only the extreme pair separates, or internal_replay proposals either fail to bias external_task selection at all or bypass the MECH-094 write gate.
claims.required_event: Proposal generation under each of the four operating modes at production CEM settings, with the SD-032a salience coordinator supplying a genuine mode probability vector.
claims.manipulation: Vary operating_mode across external_task / internal_planning / internal_replay / offline_consolidation with mode_conditioning_enabled on, crossed with mode_partitioned_cem ON/OFF (H3, confirmed load-bearing) and mode_value_weight ON/OFF (H2, a clean null).
claims.control: mode_conditioning_enabled OFF baseline plus the H2-OFF cell, which V3-EXQ-928 measured at +0.0015, t=+0.48 -- a null that eliminates the value-weight route and isolates partitioning as the mechanism.
claims.DV: Two channels. Breadth: mode-conditioned proposal spread and the extreme-pair (broad versus tight) separation in a paired per-seed contrast (V3-EXQ-928: H3-OFF delta +0.0167, t=+4.34, 24/30 seeds positive). Content/location: the mode-conditioned shift of the proposal distribution's centre, which is what the ordered four-mode gradient requires.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/module.py records _last_operating_mode, _last_noise_scale, _last_mode_horizon_scale and _last_effective_horizon. The content/location DV was to be a proposal-output centroid, and the 1005 red-team plus the 1009 ceiling spike both established that instrument cannot resolve the elite-selection channel at production settings -- no cell cleared on untrained or grounded E2, floor on or off.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Mode conditioning must be non-vacuous at the tested CEM operating point. At production settings (num_cem_iterations=3, support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.2 clamped after every refit) the elite-selection channel moves the proposal centroid by 0.0001-0.001 standardised units against a 0.02 floor, so a centroid DV cannot register mode content; and both fix facets (mode_partitioned_cem, mode_value_weight) default OFF.

claims.claim_title: dACC conflict saturation: the dACC-analog (SD-032b) prediction-error / conflict signal caps and habituates under repeated identical outcomes; it does not grow unboundedly as conflict persists. Without saturation, a stuck governance loop can generate unbounded pe signal that never triggers a mode change, which is the control-theory signature of persistent rumination.
claims.falsifier_summary: With a genuinely swept recurrence count in a live loop, sat_factor does not vary with recurrence (only a binary on/off step), or post-saturation pe does not decline under repetition, or no downstream consumer state changes -- the cap is then not the graded habituation the claim asserts.
claims.required_event: A live agent loop in which the same outcome class recurs a controlled number of times in the saturation window, with the recurrence count swept rather than pinned, and a closure event available to reset the buffer.
claims.manipulation: Sweep the realised recurrence count (via outcome-stream composition) with dacc_saturation_enabled ON, against the OFF arm; a second axis toggles SD-034 closure so buffer resets can be separated from habituation.
claims.control: dacc_saturation_enabled OFF (f_sat identically 1.0 by early return) and a mixed-outcome stream at matched harm exposure, so a saturation effect is distinguished from a harm-exposure effect.
claims.DV: Realised sat_factor and post-saturation pe as a graded function of the recurrence count in the live loop, plus a downstream consequence -- mode-transition rate or de-commitment out of internal_planning -- rather than the pre-saturation pe alone.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py records _last_saturation_factor and _outcome_history; agent.py:10410 calls record_outcome from the select_action tail, and V3-EXQ-729's counting spy proved that live path fires. Only pre-saturation pe is recorded; no run records post-saturation pe or any downstream consequence.
claims.consumer_locus: The dACC-analog pe post-processing stage between MECH-258's raw pe and the mode-governance / commit-gate consumers, in a live agent loop rather than a synthetic injection harness.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The outcome stream must be varied enough that the recurrence count moves -- if the chronic-harm driver pins n_rec at the FIFO window length, f_sat is a constant and gradedness cannot be observed. dacc_saturation_enabled must be on, and the current-class referent (dacc_saturation_thread_current_class) must be set, or the factor is computed against the previous class.
claims.blocking_reason: The mechanism-level and live-wiring bars are met. Gradedness is not testable in the regime that has been run: the chronic-harm precondition saturates n_rec at the window length, making sat_factor the arithmetic constant 0.25 in every ON cell, and the run recorded no post-saturation pe or downstream consequence.

claims.claim_title: Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

claims.control: A no-anchor-selection baseline composing the start state from all streams, plus a shuffled-eligibility control that gates the same number of streams at random so the gate's CONTENT, not the act of gating, is what is tested.
claims.DV: Prediction-vs-outcome gap of the resulting rollouts, conditioned on anchor label; fraction of probe-tagged rollouts entering the ARC-018 viability map before realized validation; and mark_inactive events per PAG release.

claims.claim_title: Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).
claims.falsifier_summary: Rebinding events fire but are bit-identical ON versus frozen on the behavioural DV (the MECH-269(b) V3-EXQ-478 inert-reset signature), or rebinding affinity fails to exceed the shuffle control, which would make it arbitrary anchor-sensitivity rather than functional tracking.
claims.required_event: A genuine competing-configuration overtake mid-episode: the world-config that best matches the agent's realized situation changes while the self-anchor is perturbed, generated either by directed traversal (the P-B test-bed) or by an ecological patch-set flip.
claims.manipulation: Rebinding ON (live cross_stream_binder with rebinding_probe active) versus a rebinding-FROZEN arm at matched seeds, with the shared anchor perturbation held identical across arms.
claims.control: A config-label-shuffle control for DV1 (rebinding affinity must exceed it) and the frozen-binding arm for DV2, plus the directed_tour_p0_coverage flag that decouples region coverage from foraging survival so readiness is not confounded with competence.
claims.DV: DV1: rebinding-alignment with the ground-truth competing config, measured against the shuffle control. DV2: a graded non-saturating behavioural consequence -- re-acquisition latency in steps, ON versus frozen -- chosen to avoid the V3-EXQ-725a frac_state_div saturation.
claims.instrument: experiments/_lib/rebinding_functional_harness.py records DV1/DV2 and the readiness gates; ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py supplies rebinding_probe() and couple(); the ecological variant is experiments/_lib/rebinding_ecological_harness.py.
claims.consumer_locus: The self-anchor to world-configuration binding consumed by the binder's couple() injection in e2_fast.py, and from there the foraging policy -- the entity layer above MECH-269(b)'s proposer stream-anchor.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The learned cross_stream_binder must be converged, every candidate config must have been visited in P0 (the region-coverage floor), overtake count per seed must clear the readiness quorum, the oracle must clear the achievability floor, and the couple() path must carry behavioural authority -- disabling the binding must move foraging, or a null ON-versus-FROZEN DV2 is uninterpretable (the V3-EXQ-478 false-weakens hazard).
claims.blocking_reason: Runnable now and already run twice on the directed-traversal test-bed: the substrate, both harnesses, the shuffle control and the graded DV all exist, and the P0-coverage blocker was closed by the rebinding-harness-p0-coverage-decoupling queue item (implemented). Only the ECOLOGICAL generalisation remains blocked, on couple() lacking foraging authority.
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note's framing that MECH-456 is blocked on readiness is stale: the 733/733a readiness failures were fixed by the directed-traversal harness and 733b/733c both PASSed, promoting the claim to provisional.

claims.claim_title: MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Anchored replay (trusted starting state, MECH-269) preferentially reaches subiculum -> entorhinal deep layers -> neocortex (E1 consolidation) and lateral PFC (SD-033a viability map); probe replay (low-verisimilitude seed, strengthened tag) preferentially reaches BLA (affective tagging without consolidation) and NAc (curiosity / novelty scaffolding). Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.
claims.falsifier_summary: Probe content still reaches consolidation destinations at OFF-baseline rates with the flag on and a clean substrate (which would support MECH-094's source-side boolean framing instead), or forced full tag loss produces no measurable rise in E1-prediction-divergence on probe content.

claims.claim_title: MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.

claims.claim_title: The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.
claims.falsifier_summary: Correctly sourced writeback moves parameters without improving independent residual/correction DVs, or produces a stable but unresponsive collapsed attribution
claims.required_event: Repeated sleep cycles after spurious attribution and later independent counter-evidence; a genuine mid-run change in causal contingency

claims.instrument: E2_harm_s gradient steps and parameter deltas exist. claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Preserve the existing WWA's seven gates including at least five cycles, varied real waking tuples, intact waking attribution, and separate no-writeback control. Additionally verify which region's attribution target is paired with each waking tuple before interpreting region-specific correction.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all seven must hold in the ON arm, or the run is `scoring_excluded`, not scored -- the V3-EXQ-514m/642 vacuity discipline; V3-EXQ-702's own per-claim guards are the reusable template):
(P1) The sleep phase must actually fire, N>=5 times. The pathway is armed with `use_sleep_aggregation_cluster=True` (which force-enables all eight sub-flags via `enable_sleep_aggregation_cluster()`; setting `use_mech273_self_model` alone leaves the cluster silent -- that was GAP-3). Sleep entry is boundary-only via `SleepLoopManager.notify_episode_end()` (sleep_substrate:GAP-9), so the driver MUST be multi-episode (GAP-7) with `sleep_loop_episodes_K` chosen such that at least 5 cycles complete, or `use_within_life_sleep_trigger=True` with `within_life_sleep_step_ceiling` set. Report the realised cycle count; fewer than 5 completed cycles = excluded.
(P2) The consolidation window must be non-empty. `mech273_n_offline_steps > 0` and the realised `mech273_n_offline_steps` per cycle must equal it (the config documents `n_steps <= 0` as a silent no-op diagnostic mode -- a run that lands there registers a wired aggregator that never updates anything).
(P3) The replay buffer must be non-empty AND non-constant at SLEEP_ENTRY. `harm_replay_buffer_len > 0` is necessary but NOT sufficient: `offline_gradient_pass` falls back to a synthetic `(z_harm_s zeros, round-robin one-hot action)` batch on an empty/None buffer, which is precisely the GAP-4 defect closed 2026-05-16, and a batch of near-identical real tuples is the same vacuity with better paperwork. So additionally require `Var(z_harm_s)` across the snapshotted buffer to exceed a pre-registered floor and `>= 2` distinct actions present. This is the live risk on this substrate: a competent agent routes around hazards, which is exactly how V3-EXQ-843 was invalidated by zero harm exposure (MECH-203) and is the same pathology that has kept SD-029's C2 unevaluable across 13+ runs. Report harm-contact counts per seed.
(P4) The `self`-domain posterior store must be non-empty at WRITEBACK: `n_regions >= 1` with a non-uniform staleness snapshot (V3-EXQ-574's C2 and V3-EXQ-702's `mech285_snapshot_is_uniform: false` guard).
(P5) The OFF arm must show genuine zero movement: `mech273_param_delta_l2 == 0.0` and `mech273_n_offline_steps == 0`, as V3-EXQ-702 demonstrated on 3/3 seeds. A non-zero OFF arm means the bit-identical-OFF guarantee has regressed and the contrast is uninterpretable.
(P6) The waking half must be intact and measurable in BOTH arms. MECH-273 predicts that ablating the sleep half leaves single-episode attribution intact; if per-episode attribution is itself flat or unmeasurable, "degraded cross-episode stability" has no baseline to degrade from. Report the waking-half attribution signal (MECH-256/SD-029 comparator output, C1-equivalent `forward_r2 >= 0.9`) in both arms. Do NOT gate on SD-029's C2 (Shergill-style self-vs-external attenuation): per SD-029's own already-digested falsifier that criterion has never once been evaluable on this substrate, and importing it would import a known vacuity.
(P7) E1 EXCLUSION. No acceptance criterion may read `ContextMemory` slot content or `slot_cosine_sim`. That path is behind SD-017's live `substrate_ceiling` (`ContextMemory.write` CONTENT gap, confirmed 2026-08-30 by V3-EXQ-436g: addressing fixed 16/16, WAKING_ONLY `slot_cosine_sim` 0.9993) -- see INV-049's own `what_would_answer` for the full precondition, do not re-derive it. A MECH-273 verdict that depends on E1 differentiation is a verdict on SD-017.

CONFIRMING (three arms, matched seeds, >= 5 seeds; ARM_OFF = `use_sleep_aggregation_cluster=False`; ARM_ON = cluster True with `mech273_offline_n_steps=100`; ARM_SLEEP_NO_WRITEBACK = cluster True with `mech273_offline_n_steps=0`, i.e. the full sleep loop, replay sampling, routing and posterior accumulation all running but MECH-273's own gradient step suppressed. The third arm is load-bearing and is the INV-050 lesson imported: without it, any positive result is a verdict on the sleep cluster as a whole -- SD-017 + MECH-285 + MECH-272 + MECH-275 -- and MECH-273 collects credit for its neighbours' work. It costs one integer):
- C1 (held-out residual; the design-of-record's own Phase-E gate). E2_harm_s one-step prediction residual on a HELD-OUT set of `(z_harm_s, a, z_harm_s')` tuples collected during waking but excluded from the replay buffer, measured after each of 5 sleep cycles. CONFIRM: residual decreases monotonically across the 5 cycles in ARM_ON, and is flat-or-increasing in BOTH ARM_OFF and ARM_SLEEP_NO_WRITEBACK. Effect gate: `delta_residual(ON) - delta_residual(NO_WRITEBACK) >= max(0.5 * SD(delta across seeds), 0.02)` in normalised residual units, on >= 3/5 seeds.
- C2 (spurious-attribution correction; the EXP-0169 spec). Seed a spurious self-attribution -- inject a biased `self`-domain posterior mean at a known region, or run a waking block in which the agent's action reliably co-occurs with a harm outcome it does not cause -- then let post-hoc counter-evidence accumulate. CONFIRM: the `self`-domain posterior mean at that region shifts toward the true causal_sig by >= 0.5 SD within 3 sleep cycles in ARM_ON, and by < 0.15 SD in both ARM_OFF and ARM_SLEEP_NO_WRITEBACK.
- C3 (durability, with an anti-flattening guard). Cross-episode variance of the attribution at a fixed region over the final K episodes is LOWER in ARM_ON than in both controls, AND -- this half is what distinguishes a durable model from a collapsed one -- ARM_ON still tracks a deliberate mid-run change in the true causal_sig with a lag of <= 2 sleep cycles. Both halves required. The guard is not hypothetical: the claim's own mixed literature entry (`2026-04-28_type_prototype_sleep_disruption_hennies2017`, Hennies 2017) reports that cued reactivation during SWS *abolishes* rather than attenuates the sleep abstraction benefit, so "replay flattens everything toward a constant" is a live outcome that would satisfy a variance-only criterion while refuting the claim.

FALSIFYING (any one is a genuine refutation of MECH-273 as stated, provided P1-P7 hold):
- F1 (the decisive one -- inert writeback). ARM_ON is statistically indistinguishable from ARM_SLEEP_NO_WRITEBACK on C1 AND C2, while ARM_OFF differs from both. The sleep *loop* does work; MECH-273's *offline gradient pass* -- the specific step this claim asserts is the self-model's sleep half -- contributes nothing beyond it. Parameters demonstrably move (V3-EXQ-702, L2 delta 0.37) without improving anything, i.e. the movement is noise injection. This is the outcome the two banked PASSes are structurally incapable of detecting.
- F2 (no correction). ARM_ON fails to correct a seeded spurious self-attribution (C2 shift < 0.15 SD over 3 cycles) despite P1-P4 all holding -- directly refutes "correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases".
- F3 (no durability, or false durability). ARM_ON shows no reduction in cross-episode attribution variance relative to the controls; OR it reduces variance but fails the C3 tracking half (lag > 2 cycles, or no movement at all on a genuine mid-run causal_sig change). The second branch refutes the claim's own words -- a self-model that cannot revise is not durable, it is stuck -- and is the specific reading Hennies 2017 warns about.
- F4 (the waking half suffices). ARM_OFF matches ARM_ON on C1/C2/C3 with the waking comparator intact (P6). Refutes "without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model" -- the episode-local signature would then already be durable, and the sleep half is redundant rather than constitutive.
- What would NOT count either way: a run failing P1-P7 (`scoring_excluded`, non-contributory); any criterion reading E1 `ContextMemory` slot content (that is a verdict on SD-017); and a re-run of the V3-EXQ-574 / V3-EXQ-702 mechanism-fires criteria, which are already banked and cannot move this claim further in either direction.

claims.claim_title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

claims.control: Properly ordered stage-1-then-stage-2 arm at identical total budget, environment and feature set; the secondary leg additionally contrasts an engineered-z_world arm against an intervention-reconstructed decomposition.
claims.DV: Stability and noise of formed object-schemas in the mis-ordered versus ordered arm (schema stability, decomposition consistency), and for the secondary leg, agreement between the reconstructed decomposition and the engineered SD-005 split.
claims.instrument: The stage-2 mechanism is the gap. MECH-276's feedstock readiness is now confirmed by V3-EXQ-703a, but MECH-278 object-schema-via-intervention is phase_locked v4 and explicitly bypassed in V3 by the engineered SD-005 z_world, and no motor-babbling / action-space-discovery code exists (verified against config.py action_dim and causal_grid_world.py's fixed ACTIONS literal).
claims.consumer_locus: The dependency edge between stage-1 self/world attribution and stage-2 object-schema formation -- whether the ordering is load-bearing, not whether either stage mechanism holds in isolation.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Gate (1) must clear: V3 hand-wires the action space (action_dim fixed at 4, ACTIONS a fixed 5-entry literal, no motor-babbling or action-space-discovery code), so a withhold-stage-1 manipulation must ablate the counterfactual-backed self/world attribution mechanism rather than merely truncate an episode count. A stage-2 manipulandum must also exist, which it does not while MECH-278 is phase_locked v4.
claims.blocking_reason: The primary ablation has no manipulandum: stage 2 (MECH-278) is phase_locked v4 and bypassed in V3 by the engineered z_world, and stage 1's action space is hand-wired with no discovery code to withhold. The gate the claim names as live (MECH-276 feedstock) has in fact been closed since 2026-08-08.

claims.claim_title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.
claims.falsifier_summary: Route entropy and proposal overlap are indistinguishable between ON and OFF arms, or the OFF arm never reaches monostrategy at all -- in which case the proposal distribution was never recency-converging and the bonus has nothing to correct.
claims.required_event: Repeated CEM trajectory proposal and commitment in a two-or-more-route layout over extended evaluation, so that recently committed waypoints accumulate and can be down-weighted.
claims.manipulation: Anti-recency exploration bonus ON versus OFF at trajectory scoring time, before elite selection: a fitness penalty proportional to a decaying waypoint-visitation count over recently committed trajectories.
claims.control: Bonus OFF at identical seeds, identical route count and identical curiosity/familiarity settings; plus a route-count factor (2 routes versus 1) so monostrategy onset has a comparator that cannot occur.
claims.DV: Route-choice entropy over extended evaluation (monostrategy onset threshold) as the primary, and mean pairwise waypoint overlap between CONSECUTIVE CEM proposals as the secondary diversity measure.
claims.instrument: Neither DV is recorded today. HippocampalModule stores only the most recently EXECUTED trajectory (_committed_trajectory_buffer, MECH-290) -- explicitly not what CEM considered -- so consecutive-proposal overlap has no recorder; route entropy exists only as strategy-entropy readouts in E3/dACC, not over route identity.

Proposal-level diversity is also unrecorded.

claims.claim_title: LH-PAG override projection: a direct projection from LH (orexin and/or peri-LC GABA analog) to PAG modulates the GABAergic freeze gate (MECH-279) under metabolic demand. The projection does not silence the freeze gate; it raises its threshold (theta_freeze_effective = theta_freeze_base x (1 + alpha_override x override_signal)). This produces the behavioural transition from freeze to active foraging under sustained hunger plus threat -- the foraging-under-predation phenotype the lit-pull surveys.
claims.falsifier_summary: With committed freeze demonstrably entered (pag_release-eligible states non-zero in both arms), the enabled arm shows no freeze-to-foraging transition or the same transition as the disabled arm -- the override projection is not behaviourally load-bearing at the freeze gate.
claims.required_event: Sustained threat (z_harm_a elevated above theta_freeze for many steps, producing committed freeze) concurrent with rising metabolic drive_level.
claims.manipulation: MECH-280 enabled (alpha_override > 0 on PAGFreezeGate, override_signal driven by the BroadcastOverrideRegulator) versus disabled (alpha_override 0.0), on a substrate where PAG freeze is actually engaged -- i.e. after theta_freeze recalibration or under an SD-029-style scheduled sustained-threat curriculum.
claims.control: The alpha_override = 0 arm at matched seeds and matched threat exposure, plus a short-threat/rising-drive arm which the secondary prediction says should NOT override, so the effect is keyed to sustained threat rather than to drive alone.
claims.DV: The drive_level at which the agent transitions from committed freeze to active foraging (freeze-exit / pag_release events per episode and their drive_level threshold), plus the joint dependence of that threshold on threat duration; pag_release_count must be reported as a precondition gate, not only as an outcome.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/pag/freeze_gate.py computes exit_threshold = theta_freeze x (1 + alpha_override x override_signal) x gaba_tone and emits release diagnostics; ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/broadcast_override.py supplies override_signal. The recorder exists; what is missing is an env condition that drives z_harm_a above theta_freeze so the recorder has non-zero events to record.
claims.consumer_locus: The PAG GABAergic freeze gate's exit threshold -- the LH-to-PAG projection raises it rather than silencing the gate, so the causal boundary is freeze-commit exit, not episode reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The agent must actually enter a COMMITTED freeze state for the override scaling to act on: the gate requires z_harm_a x duration > theta_freeze (2.0), and at fishtank baseline z_harm_a never crosses it -- pag_release_count_end was 0 across ALL 12 runs of V3-EXQ-483e including every ARM_3 ON_ON cell. The candidate pool under threat must also not collapse (the shared GAP-A conversion-propagation precondition).
claims.blocking_reason: The mechanism never enters its regime: theta_freeze is never crossed at fishtank baseline, so alpha_override scales a threshold on a state the agent is not in (483e: pag_release_count_end 0 in all 12 runs). Clearing it needs either theta_freeze recalibration (SD-037 axis a) or a sustained-threat curriculum (axis b), neither of which has run.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-483d/483e are recorded non_contributory, not weakening: the claim could not express itself, so they are not evidence against the override projection.
The ceiling_routing_note's 'V3-EXQ-483f reserved/blocked behind 625e' is wrong -- 483f was never minted as a queue entry (confirmed 2026-08-15); the Phase-4 validation is owed but unbuilt.
claims.auditor_notes: Both preconditions are shared with MECH-281 and should be cleared once for the pair, not re-derived per claim -- the WWA already says so.
claims.what_would_answer:
Falsifiable (primary, extracted from this claim's own functional_ restatement): in a paradigm with sustained threat (z_harm_a elevated for many steps) and rising drive_level, an agent with MECH-280 enabled should transition from freeze to foraging at a predictable drive_level threshold; an agent with MECH-280 disabled should remain frozen indefinitely (the EXQ-471 lock).
Falsifiable (secondary): the threshold of the freeze->foraging transition should depend on both drive_level and the duration of sustained threat -- short threats with rising drive should not override; long sustained threats with rising drive should override.
PRECONDITION this test currently cannot clear: the trained-pathway harm landscape must actually cross theta_freeze (currently pinned near-zero at fishtank baseline) AND the candidate pool under threat must not collapse (GAP-A conversion-propagation-under-threat). Both preconditions are shared with MECH-281 and should not be re-derived independently for each claim.

claims.claim_title: Orexin-analog gain modulation of drive-coupled arousal (motor-coupling axis): an orexin-analog modulator gates the coupling between drive_level and arousal-relevant downstream targets (PFC for SD-033a deliberation, BLA/CeA for SD-035 amygdala arbitration, beta-gate for MECH-090). Loss of this coupling produces a cataplexy-analog failure where emotional/drive input fails to recruit motor activation -- z_harm and drive_level compute normally but action selection does not integrate them. This is the motor-coupling axis of orexin function; the wake-stability axis (sleep-state gating, the dominant biological role) is MECH-286. Both axes are downstream of the same SD-037 override_signal, predicting clinical co-occurrence of cataplexy with sleep-state instability under orexin loss (narcolepsy).
claims.falsifier_summary: With the gates demonstrably crossed and consumer outputs non-zero, zeroing override_signal leaves drive-to-action integration unchanged -- the coupling is not gated by the orexin analog at these targets.
claims.required_event: Sustained threat with drive accumulation, so override_signal is recruited while z_harm_a stays above the consumer input thresholds for long enough for the cascade to fire.
claims.manipulation: override_signal pinned at constant zero (the cataplexy lesion test) versus pinned at maximum (the PWS saturation test) versus free-running, with the four motor-coupling consumer gains armed.
claims.control: The OFF_OFF arm with all four consumer gains at 0.0 at matched env, seed and threat schedule -- the arm 483e already ran.
claims.DV: The four consumer outputs (bla_encoding_gain_peak, cea_mode_prior_peak, cea_fast_prime_peak, beta_release_count) plus lateral_pfc rule_state delta, and downstream whether action selection integrates drive_level and z_harm at all -- the inert-despite-both-signals phenotype.
claims.instrument: v3_exq_483e's four-arm driver records every consumer peak and the override_signal saturation count; tests/contracts/test_sd_037_consumer_cascade.py pins the wiring; all four gains and both consumer thresholds are REEConfig.from_dims parameters and therefore sweepable.
claims.consumer_locus: The drive-to-action-pipeline projections at LateralPFC, BLA, CeA and the beta-gate urgency interrupt -- not the override_signal interface, which already fires correctly.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: override_signal must be non-zero AND each consumer's own input gate must be crossed -- BLA arousal_threshold_on 0.4, CeA fast_route_threshold 0.5, the dACC PE-magnitude floors. The SD-037 gain pattern is multiplicative, so a consumer whose input gate never opens stays at zero output for any gain value, and the lesion/saturation contrast is vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: At fishtank baseline magnitudes the consumer input gates never open: 483e measured bla_encoding_gain_peak, cea_mode_prior_peak, cea_fast_prime_peak and beta_release_count all at zero across 12 runs while override_signal saturated, so the multiplicative gain multiplies zero. The recalibration levers exist as from_dims parameters but no experiment has swept them; axis-a P3/P4 are deferred and axis-b P1b is blocked on the F-dominance conversion ceiling.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
claims.auditor_notes: The 2026-08-27 digestion note that the lesion test may be nearer-term than the saturation test survives this audit: the lesion arm needs only the consumer gates to open, not a sustained-threat dynamic range. The cheapest next step is a consumer-threshold sweep using the existing from_dims parameters (axis-a P3), which nothing currently owns as a queued experiment.

claims.claim_title: LPB interoceptive routing into harm-arbitration: a lateral-parabrachial-nucleus analog (LPB) routes interoceptive distress signals (visceral malaise, taste-aversion analogs, hypoxia, hypoglycemia) into the harm-arbitration network via PBN-CGRP -> CeA -> PAG. This is the upstream broadcast arm of the threat-side architecture, parallel to VMHdm's predator-side broadcast. Both feed downstream arbiters where SD-037's override_signal reweights them. Architectural commitment: interoceptive harm has a separable input channel from external-threat z_harm, dissociable in pathology and in normal modulation.
claims.falsifier_summary: With both magnitudes measurably moving and drive held constant, INTERO_HIGH and EXT_HIGH produce statistically indistinguishable override recruitment and freeze duration, or both arms move the same consumer in the same direction -- the two channels are one signal under a split label and the separable-input-channel commitment fails.
claims.required_event: A trained, foraging agent in CausalGridWorldV2 experiencing sustained metabolic/resource deficit (hunger/thirst drive axes, depleted resource field) in episodes that also contain sustained external hazard exposure, so interoceptive and predator-side distress can be elevated independently within one substrate.
claims.manipulation: Four arms at matched seeds: INTERO_HIGH (resource deficit raised, hazards held), EXT_HIGH (hazard proximity raised, resources held), BOTH, and LPB_OFF (use_lpb_interoceptive_routing False, mixed z_harm as before); plus a LESION arm with the LPB channel forced to zero while the resource deficit is driven to its maximum.
claims.control: LPB_OFF at the identical seeds and identical env schedule as the split arms (the mixed-z_harm baseline the claim is registered against), with external harm magnitude, episode budget and drive schedule held as matched constants across the two elevation arms.
claims.DV: Behavioural dissociation between channels: override_signal recruitment rate and its downstream consumers (salience affinity weight, CeA mode_prior log-odds, lateral-PFC eta gain) under INTERO_HIGH versus EXT_HIGH, against PAG freeze-gate duration and avoidance-commitment run length under the same contrast, with the sign of the interaction rather than a main effect.
claims.instrument: The routing and its consumers are instrumented -- ree_core/regulators/lpb_interoceptive_routing.py exposes intero/external magnitudes and diagnostics; broadcast_override.py records override_signal; agent.py wires override_signal into salience, BLA gain, CeA mode prior, PFC eta and PAG. What is missing is any behavioural driver: the only run is V3-EXQ-600a, a 40-tick untrained diagnostic with hand-injected harm_obs slices.
claims.consumer_locus: The recruitment input of the SD-037 broadcast override regulator (intero-driven) versus the PAG freeze-gate duration (external-driven) -- the arbitration inputs, not the z_harm encoder output.
