claims.claim_title: Verisimilitude recognition-for-recall gate: V_s computed at retrieval time (not proposal time) gates whether a stored episode is even a candidate for re-entry into the proposal stream. Recognition (does this fit my current situation?) is logically prior to anchor-eligibility (is this a good place to start a rollout from?). MECH-269's V_s is computed against the proposed anchor state; MECH-283's V_s is computed against the retrieved episode content. Loss of MECH-283 produces intrusive recall -- episodes that don't fit current context get pulled into the proposal stream (PTSD flashback / schizophrenic loose-association phenomenology).
claims.falsifier_summary: Retrieval is at chance between matched and mismatched episode content with the gate on, or the gate's effect is indistinguishable from the existing goal_match admission floor, in which case recognition-for-recall adds nothing over anchor-eligibility.
claims.required_event: A retrieval tick in which the agent's current context matches one stored episode's content and not the other's, and both are eligible as anchors.
claims.manipulation: Retrieval-time V_s gate ON versus OFF, with the gate computed against retrieved episode CONTENT rather than against the candidate anchor state; secondary arm lowers the gate threshold to model intrusive recall.
claims.control: The MECH-269 anchor-state V_s gate left on in both arms, and a context-neutral probe where neither stored episode matches, establishing the chance-retrieval baseline.
claims.DV: Proportion of retrievals that return the context-matching episode rather than the mismatching one at matched anchor eligibility (chance is 0.5), and under the lowered-threshold arm, the rate of context-incongruent episodes entering the proposal stream.
claims.instrument: Partially present: AnchorSet.write_anchor lets a driver seed the two episodes directly, query_by_goal_match and GhostGoalBank.rank expose the retrieval/admission decision with per-term diagnostics, and MECH-269 computes per-stream and per-region V_s. Missing: any V_s computed against retrieved episode content, and any recorder of matched-versus-mismatched retrieval share.
claims.consumer_locus: The retrieval-admission boundary upstream of anchor selection -- GhostGoalBank.rank's admission floor and the proposal stream it feeds -- not the anchor-eligibility gate MECH-269 owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The anchor pool must hold at least two retrievable entries whose stored content differs on the context dimension while their anchor-eligibility (goal_match, availability, recency) is matched; without matched anchor eligibility a retrieval difference is attributable to MECH-269's existing anchor gate rather than to a recognition gate.
claims.blocking_reason: V_s exists but is computed against stream/anchor state and never against retrieved episode content, so it does not reach the retrieval-admission locus the claim names; and no experiment constructs a matched two-episode retrieval probe.
false_positives: MECH-339's context term in GhostGoalBank is not this gate: its context_salience is derived from the anchor's arousal tag, not from a match between current context and stored episode content.
The paradigm is not unbuildable: AnchorSet.write_anchor is a public seeding API, so the two-episode store does not require new environment machinery.
claims.auditor_notes: goal_match plus the admission floor already implement a content-relevance test at retrieval; whoever builds MECH-283 must show the V_s recognition term is separable from it, or the claim collapses into MECH-292's existing ranking.

claims.claim_title: Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).

claims.claim_title: Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.

claims.DV: Slow/outer boundary hit rate against independently-labelled task transitions within a +/-2-tick window, minus the rate-matched chance baseline; false-positive rate on the stationary stretch; and the fast-vs-slow separation in which transition class each scale aligns with.
claims.instrument: event_segmenter.py emits BoundaryEvents with scale, posterior and segment_id and its boundary_fires counters already read 277-287 per cell in V3-EXQ-938; causal_grid_world surfaces harm_exposure, benefit_exposure and the field-at-agent readings from which harness-side ground-truth labels can be built without touching the detector's own inputs.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the LIVE GRADED-MISMATCH PRECONDITION; MECH-206 and any other
consumer claim should cross-reference this text rather than re-derive it). Four conjuncts,
all asserted from the run's own manifest:
(1) *The segmenter is on and firing.* `use_event_segmenter=True` and boundary fires > 0 on
BOTH scales in the measurement window on every measured cell. (V3-EXQ-938's
`boundary_fires_mean_* ~= 277-287` shows this instrumentation already exists.)
(2) *The trigger under test is the trigger the claim names.* The run MUST record which fast-scale
input it used. `agent.sense()` currently calls `step(..., pe_dict=None, ...)`
(`agent.py:5448`), which per `event_segmenter.py:139-142` degrades the fast scale to a
latent-delta magnitude `sum_s ||z_s(t) - z_s(t-1)||`, NOT the PE-spike trigger of Verdict 1.
A run that leaves `pe_dict` unset is testing the latent-change detector and must say so; it
cannot be read as evidence for or against the PE-threshold commitment.
(3) *Specificity is asserted per scale, not pooled.* Per V3-EXQ-757's own recorded caveat, the
fast/inner PE-threshold scale "fires ~15% on ANY stationary z-score stream by construction",
so it is a gradedness readout only. Any hit-rate gate must be stated separately for slow/outer
(specificity-bearing) and fast/inner (descriptive), and the fast scale's ~15% construction
floor must be the chance baseline it is compared against -- never 0.
(4) *Ground-truth boundaries are independently defined.* The task-natural transition labels
(goal-cell arrival, harm onset, mode switch, episode-phase change) must be emitted by the
environment/harness, not derived from any quantity the detector itself consumes; otherwise the
alignment metric is circular.

CONFIRMING (primary -- the claim's own pre-registered prediction, now made measurable).
An agent with MECH-288 enabled produces boundaries aligned to task-natural transitions above
chance with a bounded false-positive rate, hierarchically split as the claim specifies:
(a) *slow/outer* boundaries align with high-level task transitions (goal switch, episode-phase
change) -- hit rate within a +/-2-tick tolerance window exceeding the shuffled-label chance
baseline by more than max(1.0 x SD of the per-seed hit-rate delta, an absolute floor of 0.15
in hit-rate units), consistent in sign across >= 6 seeds; (b) false-positive rate on a matched
stationary/noise stretch stays below a pre-registered ceiling (V3-EXQ-757's C288_silence
generalised to the in-agent case -- there it was 27 A-slow vs 0 B-slow); (c) *fast/inner*
boundaries align with within-segment perceptual transitions (place-field crossing, action
subgoal completion) above the ~15% construction floor of precondition (3), reported with its
own CI. *Secondary (downstream usefulness), unchanged from the claim text:* per-region V_s
readouts keyed on segment_ids produce more informative anchor-set partitions than uniform
place-binning, measured by anchor-reset latency (the claim names re-running EXQ-475 with
MECH-288 + MECH-269 enabled). *Tertiary (MECH-287 coupling), now near-vacuous by construction:*
lesioning MECH-288 silently lesions MECH-287's broadcast trigger while tonic modulation
survives -- `invalidation_trigger.py` is a pure BoundaryEvent subscriber with "No PE or latent
input", so this is a code-level contract, not an open empirical question; keep it as a
regression test (its C5), not as promotion evidence.

FALSIFYING.
With all four preconditions green: (a) slow/outer boundary times are statistically
indistinguishable from the shuffled-label baseline -- the detector fires, but not *where the
events are*; or (b) the false-positive rate on the stationary stretch is high enough that the
above-chance alignment in (a) is explained by firing rate alone (formally: alignment fails once
the chance baseline is rate-matched to the observed fire rate -- this is the sharpest
falsifier, and it is the in-agent generalisation of the specificity caveat V3-EXQ-757 already
flagged); or (c) the hierarchy does not separate -- slow and fast boundaries align with the
same class of transition at the same rate, refuting Verdict 2's two-scale commitment and
reducing the substrate to a single detector with a redundant second parameterisation; or (d)
segment-keyed anchor partitions do not beat uniform place-binning on anchor-reset latency,
which would refute the *reason the claim exists* (that the V_s invalidation cluster needs a
substrate-native region partition) even if the boundaries themselves are well-placed. (d)
alone is the disposition-changing one: it would move MECH-288 from "the region partition" to
"a boundary detector in search of a consumer".

claims.claim_title: At trajectory completion, HippocampalModule performs a backward temporal credit sweep that propagates the terminal outcome (goal contact or failure) retroactively through preceding states, consistent with the reverse replay observed at reward endpoints in awake rats (Foster & Wilson 2006).
claims.falsifier_summary: With wanting_weight positive in both arms the sweep produces no completion-rate or steps-to-goal advantage in the sparse long-horizon regime, i.e. retroactive credit adds nothing forward-only CEM did not already supply.
claims.required_event: Repeated goal-contact completions at the end of multi-step committed trajectories with uniform, unshaped intermediate steps, i.e. BetaGate release via the ARC-028 hippocampal completion signal after a long run.
claims.manipulation: use_backward_credit_sweep ON versus OFF at matched seeds, with wanting_weight held identical and positive in both arms so the ablation removes only the retroactive write, and backward_sweep_gamma swept as a dose axis.
claims.control: The sweep-OFF arm at matched seeds and matched wanting_weight, plus a dense-reward / short-horizon regime where retroactive credit should add nothing -- the interaction, not a main effect.
claims.DV: Long-horizon task performance under sparse distant reward -- goal-completion rate and steps-to-goal on trajectories with uniform intermediate steps -- measured as the sweep-ON minus sweep-OFF difference, together with the VALENCE_WANTING gradient along early trajectory steps that the sweep is supposed to build.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/module.py backward_credit_sweep() returns n_steps_swept / mean_credit / outcome_quality, and the consumer term is the wanting_score in the module's viability scoring; V3-EXQ-958 records only the internal discount law, not any behavioural DV.
claims.consumer_locus: The residue field's VALENCE_WANTING channel as read by hippocampal viability scoring during CEM candidate evaluation -- the credit must change which trajectory is selected, not merely which residue values exist.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The sweep's downstream consumer must be live: HippocampalConfig.wanting_weight defaults to 0.0, so the VALENCE_WANTING residue the sweep writes is invisible to CEM trajectory scoring unless wanting_weight > 0 in BOTH arms. Completions must also clear backward_sweep_min_quality (0.6) often enough for the sweep to fire, and the goal must be far enough away that credit must propagate more than one step.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate, its wiring at BetaGate release and its diagnostics all exist, but the only counted run (V3-EXQ-958) scores three INTERNAL signatures -- geometric discount law, quality gate, gamma dose-response -- and no behavioural credit-assignment DV. The consumer term is default-off (wanting_weight 0.0), so a naive ablation would compare two behaviourally identical arms.

false_positives: The live_status 'hold_pending_v3_substrate' verdict (as_of 2026-09-01) postdates the substrate: backward_credit_sweep landed and V3-EXQ-958 PASSED on 2026-08-29, so the substrate hold is no longer the binding constraint.

claims.claim_title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the goal-identity precondition met and a continuous-stream design, cued retrieval performs at or near chance, or the payload-consuming arm shows no behavioural advantage over ignoring the payload entirely -- the payload dissociates goal-active from goal-inactive state at the unit level without translating into any measurable recovery advantage.
claims.required_event: A plan failure or reward relocation that leaves an inactive anchor carrying a populated goal payload on the formerly valid path, followed by a post-failure retrieval query with a cue belonging to a DIFFERENT goal epoch.
claims.manipulation: Query the anchor pool with goal-epoch-distinct cues (the natural source being SD-049 per-type resource identity, which makes z_goal vary by resource type) versus a matched cue from the same epoch, with use_sd039_anchor_payload enabled.
claims.control: Unrelated stale anchors at matched staleness but no goal relevance (the V3-EXQ-868 comparator), plus a payload-ignoring arm that ranks by staleness alone.
claims.DV: Top-1 retrieval accuracy for the correct blocked-path anchor at above-chance rate under goal-epoch-distinct cues, with n_distinct_top1_anchors greater than 1 across epochs; at the behavioural level, PLANNED-arm benefit_post_block exceeding HABIT-arm by at least 0.30 on at least 4 of 7 seeds in a detour paradigm.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/anchor_set.py provides AnchorGoalPayload, Anchor.goal_match (SD-079 common-mode-centered since 2026-07-22) and query_by_goal_match; V3-EXQ-889 is authored and landed ready-to-queue. The instrument works; what it measures is degenerate because the cue vector carries no epoch identity, and AnchorSet.reset() wipes active AND inactive traces at every episode boundary.
claims.consumer_locus: Post-failure retrieval from the dual-trace anchor pool, and the downstream consumer decision (MECH-292 ranking, MECH-293 probe seeding) that the payload is supposed to inform -- not the unit-level existence of the payload, which V3-EXQ-494 already confirmed.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The retrieval cue must carry goal-context IDENTITY across distinct goal epochs. As measured in the V3-EXQ-889 dry run (2026-08-03) it does not: z_goal is a single global EMA attractor whose cue-centered max pairwise cosine is 0.99752 against a 0.99 non-degeneracy bar and worsens with re-exposure, so four deliberately distinct goal-epoch cues collapse onto one top-1 anchor. The design must also run within one continuous agent stream.
claims.blocking_reason: z_goal has no goal-context variance to retrieve on: one global EMA attractor, cue-centered max pairwise cosine 0.99752 against a 0.99 bar, four distinct epochs collapsing to one top-1 anchor. Separately, AnchorSet.reset() clears active and inactive traces at every episode boundary, so the invalidation-to-retrieval window cannot span an episode. Both are measured, not hypothetical.
false_positives: The blocker is sometimes read as a missing consumer; MECH-292 and MECH-293 are both landed and wired, and the WWA correctly records that half as satisfied.
SD-079 common-mode centering (landed 2026-07-22, V3-EXQ-807 PASS) is not a fix for this precondition: the 0.99752 figure is already the cue-CENTERED statistic, measured after SD-079.
claims.auditor_notes: No substrate_queue row owns either half of EXP-0552's release_condition. SD-049 multi-resource type identity (Phases 1-3 implemented; identity_head supervised on resource_type_at_agent) is the nearest existing source of goal-epoch cue variance and is the edge worth drawing before anything new is registered. The dual-trace-pool-survives-reset decision is a design call, not a build.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially unmet as of 2026-08-03, root cause identified, not hypothetical): use_sd039_anchor_payload defaults OFF and must be explicitly enabled; a genuine behavioral test additionally needs at least one deferred consumer (MECH-292 ghost-goal bank and/or MECH-293 waking ghost-goal probes) wired to actually USE the payload for downstream decisions. Both are already satisfied today (MECH-292/293 are landed and wired). A THIRD, MEASURED precondition currently blocks the query/retrieval half specifically: the retrieval cue must carry goal-context identity across distinct goal-epochs. As of the 2026-08-03 V3-EXQ-889 dry run this does NOT hold -- z_goal is a single global EMA attractor whose cue-centered max pairwise cosine saturates near ceiling (0.99752 vs a pre-registered 0.99 non-degeneracy bar) and monotonically worsens with re-exposure, so four deliberately-distinct goal-epoch cues collapse onto the same top-1 anchor (n_distinct_top1_anchors=1.0). A valid test design must also run within a single continuous agent stream across the invalidation-to- retrieval window: AnchorSet.reset() clears the entire dual-trace pool at every agent.reset() episode boundary.
CONFIRMING signature, by level: - Unit level (ALREADY MET, V3-EXQ-494 UC5, 2026-04-27): mean goal-match
  on Phase A (goal-inactive) anchors = 0.0 vs Phase B (goal-active)
  anchors = 0.998, 3/3 replicates above the pre-registered 0.3 threshold.
- Consumer-ranking level (PARTIALLY MET, V3-EXQ-868, 2026-08-02): a
  goal-relevant inactive anchor outranks a goal-irrelevant, matched-
  staleness inactive anchor in >=4/7 seeds.
- Retrieval/query level (STILL OPEN, blocked on the precondition above):
  once goal-identity is met, a post-failure retrieval cue correctly
  surfaces the anchor on the formerly-valid-but-now-blocked path as its
  top-1 hit at an above-chance rate, while unrelated stale anchors are
  not surfaced.
- Full behavioral/task level (NEVER COMPLETED, V3-EXQ-495 SIGTERM'd
  2026-04-28, not since requeued): PLANNED-arm benefit_post_block exceeds
  HABIT-arm benefit_post_block by >=0.30 in >=4/7 seeds in the detour
  paradigm, without a harm regression or standard-episode degradation.

FALSIFYING signature: with the goal-identity precondition met and a continuous-stream design, a downstream consumer built on this payload shows NO behavioral advantage over ignoring the payload entirely -- e.g. cued retrieval performs at or near chance even once cues are demonstrably goal-distinct; PLANNED-arm is statistically indistinguishable from HABIT/ABLATED. The payload would then exist and dissociate goal-active/ inactive state at the unit level, without translating into any measurable recovery advantage.

claims.control: The FIELD_ONLY arm at matched seeds and identical displacement schedule as the negative control, plus a no-displacement reference that establishes the un-blocked approach baseline against which abandonment is defined.
claims.DV: Behavioural re-approach after the goal becomes reachable again: fraction of episodes in which the agent returns to and reaches the displaced goal, and latency to re-approach, contrasted between arms conditional on the FIELD_ONLY arm having abandoned.

claims.claim_title: Theta-burst packet contains multi-content joint binding: each ~125ms theta cycle binds a {goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_estimate, state_summary} tuple within one phase-aligned window, with verisimilitude grounding the rollout step that must stay ahead of real time.
claims.falsifier_summary: With every precondition met including the class-count floor and a demonstrated capacity for some contrast to exceed the baseline, JOINT remains indistinguishable from ALTERNATION on the committed-action distribution -- the joint clause is over-specified at this readout.
claims.required_event: A sequence of theta-cycle (E3-heartbeat) boundaries at which the multi-content packet seals a goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_sensory, risk_affective tuple, with the per-stream V_s vintaging active.
claims.manipulation: Binding regime -- JOINT (all four streams co-bound in one cycle) versus ALTERNATION (one live stream plus held priors at coherence_hold_weight) versus SHUFFLED (no co-binding), routed per-candidate through modulatory_channel_route_source=coherence.
claims.control: SHUFFLED arm as the zero-coherence floor, the packet-OFF arm, and the yoked same-arm-versus-same-arm control that must diverge on zero ticks (the V3-EXQ-949 bit-identical paired control).
claims.DV: Mean paired total-variation distance between the committed-action-class distributions of JOINT and ALTERNATION (C1) and of JOINT and SHUFFLED (C2), each against max(0.1, cross_seed_baseline_tv) on at least 7 of 10 seeds.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/multi_content_theta_packet.py seal / compose_per_candidate_coherence plus the route-range authority in e3_selector.py; experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py supplies the de-duplicated denominator. V3-EXQ-840b recorded all twelve preconditions green but under the wrong class-count configuration.
claims.consumer_locus: The committed-action distribution at E3 select -- whether within-cycle joint binding changes what is committed, versus Kay-2020 cross-cycle alternation being sufficient.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: support_preserving_min_first_action_classes must equal action_dim with measured mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5 of 5 in every arm; joint routed coherence range supra-floor and bounded; fresh-select de-duplicated committed-action counts; SD-105 OFF or matched; and a yoked same-arm instrument positive control showing some contrast can exceed cross_seed_baseline_tv.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate, the coherence routing and the P1 knob (support_preserving_min_first_action_classes, default 2, settable to action_dim) all exist; V3-EXQ-840b ran at 2 with a realised 2.0022 classes and no instrument positive control, so between-arm TV was bounded by construction. The successor design exists only as proposal EXP-1386. Whether raising the knob delivers 4.5 realised classes is ARC-065's own open question.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening entry's original diagnosis (route-range supra-floor unmet) was corrected 2026-07-31: the floor was met at 0.063841 with 6x headroom; the precondition that actually failed was adequate_committed_window_sample.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim is FUSED: its PRIMARY falsifier is a joint multi-content decoding analysis on theta-resolved hippocampal/amygdala/BG/ACC recordings, which no published work supplies and which REE cannot run -- that leg is R8 and resolves by literature or collaboration. Do not score the V3 leg as if it settled the primary one.
claims.what_would_answer:
SCOPE. This claim is FUSED. Its PRIMARY falsifier is out-of-substrate for V3: joint
multi-content decoding on hippocampal+amygdala+BG+ACC theta-resolved population recordings,
showing whether semantically-distinct streams (goal vs risk vs state) are simultaneously decodable
within one theta cycle, versus Kay et al. 2020's cross-cycle alternation. No such analysis is
published; that leg resolves by literature/collaboration, not by REE (`evidence_quality_note` and
`ceiling_routing_note` both already say so). What follows is the REE leg only -- the
substrate-side joint-vs-alternation discriminator the 2026-04-26 governance hold named as
route (a).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. Four conditions, all asserted from MEASURED per-arm quantities,
never from config.
(1) The armed-conversion block: see ARC-065's own `what_would_answer` (P1 + P2 + the ARC-062
gated-policy leg) -- do not re-derive it here. P1 is the one V3-EXQ-840b did not have:
`support_preserving_min_first_action_classes` must equal `action_dim`, with measured
`mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim` (>= 4.5 of 5) in every arm. 840b ran
at 2 and measured 2.0022, i.e. the committed-action distribution was capped at ~2 realised classes
identically in all four arms, which bounds any between-arm TV by construction. A null measured
under that clamp self-routes `substrate_not_ready_requeue`, never `weakens`.
(2) The 840b readiness block, retained verbatim in kind: `joint_route_range_supra_floor`
(JOINT routed per-candidate coherence cross-candidate RANGE > 0.01 on the 7th-largest per-seed
value -- the SAME-STATISTIC safeguard against the V3-EXQ-661 rescale-invisible scalar null),
`routed_range_bounded` (< 1e6, the 643a explosion ceiling),
`adequate_committed_window_sample` (worst-cell `n_p1_ticks_past_window` >= 200 -- the precondition
V3-EXQ-840 actually failed, per the corrected diagnosis in
`substrate_queue.json::mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening.diagnosis_correction`).
(3) De-duplication, mandatory and explicit: committed-action counts must be accumulated on the
fresh-select denominator via `experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py` (diagnostics cleared before
every `select_action`, so a latched/held tick contributes no row), with
`adequate_fresh_selection_sample` >= `nominal_window_ticks / beta_rate_max_steps(20)` on the
`MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS`-th largest per-seed value, and `n_latched` / `replication_factor` reported
per cell. Raw per-tick accumulation is ~9x pseudo-replicated and voids the readout
([memory] `reference-hold-weighted-e3-readout-form2`).
(4) An instrument positive control on the DV itself, which 840b lacked. A yoked
same-arm-vs-same-arm control must diverge on 0 ticks (V3-EXQ-949's
`paired_control_is_bit_identical`), AND at least one arm contrast in the design must be shown
capable of exceeding `cross_seed_baseline_tv` -- otherwise the pre-registered pass rule
(`mean_tv > baseline_tv`, driver line 968) is unsatisfiable by construction and a FAIL is a
`measurement_test_design_defect`, not a claim verdict. In 840b `cross_seed_baseline_tv = 0.7669`
and the largest observed contrast was 0.1928, so no arm cleared it.
SD-105 (selection-entropy headroom floor) must be OFF, or matched-constant across all arms with
its realised log-temperature recorded per arm -- an entropy controller acting on the E3 softmax
directly manufactures this DV.

CONFIRMING. On a pool with `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5` and routed coherence
supra-floor and mode-distinct (JOINT > ALT > SHUF ~ 0), the committed-action-class distribution
under JOINT differs from ALTERNATION by mean paired TV > max(0.1, cross_seed_baseline_tv) on
>= 7/10 seeds (C1), AND JOINT differs from SHUFFLED on the same bar (C2). Both must hold: C1
alone with C2 failing is `multi_content_present_joint_not_isolated` -> `mixed`, and does NOT
promote the joint clause. Effect-size gate scaled per [memory]
`feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin`: the absolute floor 0.1 is retained as a floor, and the
`cross_seed_baseline_tv` conjunct supplies the SD-of-the-delta half -- do NOT drop the baseline
conjunct to make the test pass.

FALSIFYING. With every precondition above met -- including P1 at >= 4.5 classes and a
demonstrated capacity for some contrast to exceed the baseline -- JOINT remains
indistinguishable from ALTERNATION on the committed-action distribution (C1 fail). That is the
Kay-2020 parsimonious outcome: the joint-packet clause is over-specified at the
behavioural-committed-action level this substrate can measure. It weakens the *joint* clause only;
it does not touch MECH-089's theta-gamma multiplexing substrate, on which MECH-294 depends and
which is separately lit-anchored (Lisman & Jensen 2013, Colgin 2009, Igarashi 2014).
A second independent falsifying route, if the committed readout stays resolution-limited:
per the claim's own "Falsifiable (secondary)", manipulate V_s anchor-eligibility so packet
components differ in temporal vintage, and show that downstream consumers (E3 commit gate, dACC
adaptive control) respond no differently to the component-typed packet than to a
homogeneous-latent null on a readout upstream of the committed argmax (e.g. the routed
cross-candidate range distribution, or the rank-order of the eligible set) -- a readout not
subject to the class-count ceiling.

claims.claim_title: Regional verisimilitude V_s gates not only hippocampal proposer anchor selection but also which streams ground forward predictions in cortical world models (E1 sensory predictor, E2 transition model). Without symmetric V_s gating on E1/E2 rollouts, downstream consumers receive stale-but-confident-looking prediction errors -- the wired-but-inert failure mode.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the gate demonstrably crossing on the target stream and a DV that carries real variance share, the ON and OFF arms are indistinguishable on the behavioural signature -- symmetric cortical V_s gating buys nothing over the hippocampal-proposer gating alone, and the symmetric-application commitment fails.
claims.required_event: Cortical forward prediction (E1 sensory step, E2 transition step) on a stream whose alignment to perception has decayed, so the gate substitutes a held snapshot for the current latent value.
claims.manipulation: Factorial on use_vs_rollout_gating OFF versus ON under the 475a-conditions substrate (GABAergic decay + PAG freeze + dACC ON), with e1_threshold_per_stream / e2_threshold_per_stream calibrated per stream so the manipulation genuinely crosses for the stream the DV reads.
claims.control: The gating-OFF arm at matched seed and matched substrate, with a demonstrated non-zero held count on the target stream in the ON arm so the two arms are not functionally identical (862a's failure: bit-identical pe series between arms).
claims.DV: A quantity on which V_s gating has non-negligible authority -- the corrective revision actually produced downstream, e.g. the change in committed action or E3 candidate ranking attributable to the held-versus-current stream value, or the dACC control_required term expressed as a share of the total E3 payoff. NOT the raw Spearman of pe against total dACC bias magnitude, which is capped at rho about 0.001.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/vs_rollout_gate.py records per-stream held/refresh counts; dacc.py:205-225 computes pe and the bias; the 862 lineage drivers record pe_series and bias_magnitude_series per seed. The instrument records real quantities; it reads them at a boundary where pe contributes at most 1e-6 of the variance.
claims.consumer_locus: The corrective revision that downstream consumers (dACC adaptive control, E3 commit gate, MECH-269 proposer scoring) actually make on the basis of forward prediction errors -- the wired-but-inert signature is about behavioural consequence, not about correlation at the dACC bias output.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The V_s gate must actually hold the stream the DV reads (z_harm_a), which requires per-stream thresholds calibrated to that stream's own near-ceiling V_s band (0.989-1.000) rather than a global 0.85 borrowed from another stream; and the quantity read must have a non-trivial variance share of the downstream signal it is correlated against.
claims.blocking_reason: The prescribed DV cannot reach its own threshold. pe enters only via control_required = pe * 0.1 * effort 10 * dacc_weight 0.5, against E3-score payoff components of 500-1800, so its maximum attainable variance share of the dACC bias magnitude is at most 1e-6 (measured max rho about 0.001 versus a 0.3 bar). Four consecutive Q-040.c instrumentation failures; Q-040 re-categorised answer_state.
false_positives: The four Q-040.c FAILs are not evidence against MECH-269b; the 862b autopsy explicitly overrides the driver's pre-registered weakens to non_contributory as a measurement/test-design defect.
The WWA describes the fourth successor as 'not yet queued'; it was queued, ran on 2026-08-28, and its autopsy landed as REE_assembly f3a2aa2aa6, ratified at the 2026-08-29 governance walk.
claims.auditor_notes: The structural insensitivity is the same pathology as the modulatory-bias-selection-authority substrate entry (a modulatory channel swamped by the primary E3 score term), so the fix is shared rather than MECH-269b-specific. A fifth Q-040.c run on the same DV should be refused; the successor must change the boundary, not the threshold.

claims.claim_title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.
claims.falsifier_summary: Relief events fire action-contingently and tags are written, yet the probe shows no approach above the unpaired control (the store does not feed the approach attractor); or approach appears but its discounting profile separates from goal-attainment beyond the seed-noise band, or the write signatures differ structurally -- which supports parallel circuitry with a common output instead.
claims.required_event: A sustained downward crossing of the z_harm_a norm derivative produced by the agent's own escape action under threat, followed by a durable consolidation pass, with a discriminable cue present at the relief window.
claims.manipulation: Cross use_suffering_derivative_comparator ON/OFF with contingent-versus-scheduled relief sourcing, teaching a relief-paired cue against a matched unpaired control cue, then probing approach with the comparator, the curriculum and the hazard all OFF.
claims.control: Matched unpaired control cue in the same probe phase, a goal-attainment-paired cue trained on the identical schedule, and the comparator-OFF arm (V3-EXQ-517d's ARM_B recorded 0 events and 0 writes against 686.7/686.7, a clean dissociation of the plumbing).
claims.DV: Conditioned approach to the relief-paired cue minus approach to the matched unpaired cue in the OFF-probe phase; the per-seed fitted temporal-discounting profile for the relief-paired versus the goal-paired cue; and the structural form of the MECH-094 tag-write signature (valence, weight, residue write address) for the two event types.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/comparator/suffering_derivative_comparator.py fires the event and ree-v3/ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py records the paired prototype, but no experiment records a cue-approach rate: V3-EXQ-763/764 measure beta_gate release under harness-induced commitment, and no discounting-profile fit or write-signature comparator exists.
claims.consumer_locus: The shared approach-attractor tag store reached through MECH-057a release, MECH-091 phase reset and the MECH-094 categorical write gate, read at behavioural output after consolidation.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Relief-completion events must be ACTION-CONTINGENT: the agent's own action must terminate the suffering, and the comparator must fire at rates in the same order of magnitude in the relief and the goal condition. The entire 517 lineage evades this -- SD-022 scheduled_limb_damage injects damage independent of agent action, so nothing the agent did can be credited.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot reliably generate an action-contingent relief event: a trained avoidance policy filters out damage-then-heal trajectories (517/517a/517b produced 0-0.33 events per seed), and the SD-022 curriculum that rescued the run injects damage independent of agent action. No conditioned-approach probe, discounting-profile fit, or write-signature comparator exists.
false_positives: The absence diagnosis 'nothing in V3 credits a specific action with relief' is wrong: SD-059/MECH-358 EscapeAffordanceBridge already attributes a d(z_harm_a)/dt drop to the first-action class and emits a threat-gated approach bias, so the action-credit half has an owner; what is missing is a probe-phase approach DV and the shared-store comparison.
claims.auditor_notes: V3-EXQ-763's design records the GAP-I competence wall -- beta_gate.elevate() fires only from the F-selection/commitment path the substrate cannot sustain, so that lineage harness-induces commitment. Any MECH-302 approach probe must either inherit that induction (and say so) or clear GAP-I first.
claims.what_would_answer:
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (affective neuroscience; already answered, no REE run bears on
it): that pain relief recruits the same value-coding VTA-DA / NAc-shell machinery
as appetitive reward -- Navratilova 2012 PNAS (relief activates VTA-DA + NAc-shell
DA, DA-antagonist-blockable, produces CPP; supports 0.84), Andreatta 2012
(relief->striatum / fear->amygdala cross-species double dissociation; 0.86,
LOAD-BEARING), Ramirez 2015 (active avoidance requires BA->NAc-shell; 0.78),
Tanimoto 2004 (Drosophila opponent-timing relief-as-reinforcer; 0.78), with
DA-heterogeneity qualifiers Bromberg-Martin 2010 / Brischoux 2009 (mixed ~0.80)
that motivate the comparator-not-pooled-DA trigger.
REE LEG (the testable claim): MECH-302 asserts the CONSOLIDATION PIPELINE is
SHARED, with polarity set at the input -- a relief-completion event writes into the
SAME approach-attractor tag store as goal-attainment, such that relief-paired
stimuli acquire conditioned approach with the SAME temporal-discounting profile and
the SAME downstream tag-write signature as goal-paired stimuli.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (D1) the comparator must FIRE non-vacuously in BOTH
the relief and the goal condition, at rates in the same order of magnitude. Met and
exceeded on the scheduled-curriculum substrate -- V3-EXQ-517d recorded 686.7 events
and 686.7 writes per seed in ARM_A against 0.0/0.0 in ARM_B, 3/3 seeds.
(D2) THE RELIEF EVENTS MUST BE ACTION-CONTINGENT, NOT ENVIRONMENT-SCHEDULED. This
is the precondition the whole 517 lineage evades by design. V3-EXQ-517/517a/517b
FAILed at 0-0.33 events/seed precisely because a trained avoidance policy filters
out the damage->heal trajectories the comparator needs; the SD-022 scheduled-limb-
damage curriculum rescued the run by injecting damage INDEPENDENT OF AGENT ACTION.
That fix is legitimate for testing the DETECTOR (SD-050) but makes the relief
non-contingent, and a non-contingent relief event cannot produce conditioned
approach to anything the agent DID -- there is nothing to credit. A run using
scheduled_limb_damage_* as its sole relief source is a valid SD-050 test and a
VACUOUS MECH-302 test, and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on the
approach DV. Additionally inherited: SD-050's readout precondition.
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: the DV is conditioned APPROACH to a
relief-paired cue measured in a subsequent extinction-style probe phase with the
comparator, the curriculum and the hazard all OFF -- at the behavioural output,
after consolidation, with every generating mechanism removed. Nothing downstream
can absorb it because nothing downstream is running. Two paired instruments make
the "same pipeline" assertion falsifiable rather than merely plausible: (i) the
temporal-discounting profile of approach to the relief-paired cue versus the
goal-paired cue, fitted per seed, since the claim is SAME-profile not merely
non-zero; (ii) the MECH-094 tag-write signature (tag valence, weight, residue write
address) for the two event types, compared for identity of STRUCTURE rather than of
magnitude. Recording event counts and write counts alone -- what the entire 517
lineage does -- cannot discriminate a shared pipeline from two parallel ones
producing similar counts.
CONFIRMING: in the OFF-probe phase, approach to the action-contingently-relief-
paired cue exceeds approach to a matched unpaired control cue on >=2/3 seeds by a
margin scaled on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor; AND the fitted
discounting profile for the relief-paired cue lies within the seed-noise band of
the goal-paired cue's profile; AND the MECH-094 write signatures for the two event
types are structurally identical, differing only in the input-polarity field the
claim says is the ONLY licensed difference.
FALSIFYING: either (a) relief events fire action-contingently and tags are written,
but the probe phase shows no conditioned approach above the unpaired control -- the
tag store does not feed the approach attractor, so the "shared" pipeline is shared
in name only; or (b) approach IS produced but its discounting profile is separable
from goal-attainment's beyond the seed-noise band, or the write signatures differ
structurally -- which supports PARALLEL circuitry with a common output rather than
the shared-pipeline-with-input-polarity architecture the claim asserts. (b) is the
more informative refutation and the claim should be read as predicting against it.
WHAT 517c/517d DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH: they established the PLUMBING
(comparator fires, beta-gate releases, VALENCE_LIKING write lands, none of it with
the comparator OFF -- 686.7/686.7 vs 0.0/0.0, 3/3 seeds). They did NOT establish
the CLAIM, because relief was environment-scheduled rather than action-contingent
and no approach DV was recorded. The v3_pending clearance those runs bought should
be read as scoped to the plumbing.

claims.claim_title: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).
claims.falsifier_summary: With the gate demonstrably able to discriminate safe from unsafe, ablating MECH-303 leaves background release in safe contexts unchanged because the cue-specific store alone reproduces it, or the intact arm fails to separate safe from hazardous contexts -- the contextual store is not carrying a distinct signal.
claims.required_event: Repeated exposure to a spatial context in which harm does not occur, long enough for the safety terrain to accumulate, followed by a vigilance test in that context and in a matched hazardous context, with a cue-specific safety signal separately available.
claims.manipulation: use_contextual_safety_terrain ON versus OFF (the MECH-303 ablation) crossed with use_conditioned_safety_store ON, so contextual safety is removed while cue-specific safety is intact -- the reciprocal of the dissociation V3-EXQ-763 already ran.
claims.control: Forced-closed and forced-open gate arms as in V3-EXQ-939a, plus a hazardous-context arm at matched seeds, and a cue-present versus cue-absent split so contextual and cue-driven release are separable within the same run.
claims.DV: Avoidance-commitment release rate in the safe context with the cue absent -- the background-vigilance readout -- contrasted between the MECH-303-ablated arm and the intact arm, with MECH-304-driven cue-present release measured in both arms as the sparing check.
claims.instrument: ResidueField.accumulate_safety / evaluate_safety (ree_core/residue/field.py) and the release path in agent.select_action exist and are exercised; v3_exq_939a_mech303 implements the four-arm release-rate DV with a proximity-sourced gate. ConditionedSafetyStore (ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py) supplies the MECH-304 side. No driver crosses the two ablations in the MECH-303-ablated direction.
claims.consumer_locus: The beta-gate release threshold under contextual safety -- a diffuse lowering of background avoidance commitment, distinct from the cue-triggered release MECH-304 owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The contextual-safety gate must be able to discriminate safe from unsafe contexts in the regime under test: with contextual_safety_gate_source at its z_harm_a default under SD-022 damage sourcing it cannot (measured AUC <= 0.52 at all 18 swept thresholds), so the dedicated proximity signal must be selected and its threshold set reachably. For the dissociation leg, MECH-304's store must be ON and demonstrably trained, otherwise ablating MECH-303 removes the only release path and the contrast is vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim's extinction-asymmetry prediction cannot discriminate: accumulate_safety calls add_residue with no decay at all, so the contextual safety terrain never extinguishes, while ConditionedSafetyStore has its own decay_rate -- the asymmetry is trivially infinite by construction rather than an emergent property. The reciprocal ablation leg is runnable but unrun.
false_positives: V3-EXQ-939's self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue and its 'the mechanism could not express itself' degeneracy reason were rejected by its own confirmed autopsy: the same manifest carries a clean four-arm dissociation and all three DVs passed.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: MECH-303's registered falsifiable clause predicts SLOWER extinction of context-conditioned safety than cue-conditioned safety; with no extinction path on the contextual terrain the comparison is degenerate and cannot be run either way.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: An extinction/decay path on the MECH-303 contextual safety terrain -- accumulate_safety routed through the existing add_residue decay_rate argument behind a default-0.0 (bit-identical OFF) config knob, so harm reintroduction in a previously safe context can erode the accumulated safety value.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: A per-episode readout of contextual safety value at a fixed probe location after harm reintroduction, comparable against ConditionedSafetyStore prototype norm decay over the same window, giving the two extinction rates on one axis.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: No substrate_queue entry, claim, closure-plan node or governance flag owns a safety-terrain extinction mechanism. SD-052 owns the accumulation build, SD-067 owns terrain bandwidth and SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING owns the gate signal; none touches decay, and accumulate_safety passes no decay_rate to add_residue, so the field is monotone by construction.

claims.claim_title: Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. claims.falsifier_summary: The reef/forage attractor structure fails to produce diversity even under an externally injected discriminative policy -- which V3-EXQ-522 has already ruled out -- so the live falsifying outcome is narrower: the trained policy's occupancy is indistinguishable from baseline while an injected policy on the identical env is not, locating the failure in the policy rather than the substrate.

claims.claim_title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.
claims.falsifier_summary: cand_world_pairwise_dist fails to rise above the OFF baseline under a numerically stable ON arm; or it rises while held-out contrastive accuracy stays at chance, meaning the loss decreased without the discrimination task being learnable; or a Pathway-B-only manipulation reproduces the entire downstream effect, which would route to the PLSM (lever A) or SWIRL (lever C) fallback.

claims.claim_title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

crf_n_slots` and the mint time course (mints per 10% of the episode). At least one mint must
occur in the final third of the window, and `crf_live_rules_final < crf_n_slots` at the end. A

not a trigger contrast. With `crf_availability_maintenance=True` and `crf_maintenance_floor

`>= crf_mint_recurrence_threshold` (3) times: the measured recurrence count at mint is >= 3 on

mint count falling monotonically, with the surviving mints still distinct (dist unchanged within
noise). If raising the threshold does not reduce mints, the counter is not what is gating.

offers, not elapsed time or tick count. Across a 3-regime vs a 1-regime variant of the same
ecology, `crf_live_rules_final` in the 3-regime variant exceeds the 1-regime variant by

claims.claim_title: Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.
claims.falsifier_summary: Time-on-task holds but neither incentive-reversibility nor rest-recovery does (the signal is then indistinguishable from the SD-011 suffering pole); or the helplessness arm ALSO recovers with rest; or the parsimony arm reproduces all three legs from SD-012 drive_level with no two-bound accumulator, in which case the claim is over-specified.
claims.required_event: Sustained effortful time-on-task driving F to its upper bound and emitting a STOP/disengage, followed by a rest or offline phase during which F recovers to the lower bound.
claims.manipulation: Fatigue accumulator ON versus OFF; within ON, vary time-on-task, vary incentive at FIXED accumulated F, and insert versus omit a rest/offline phase.
claims.control: F-OFF arm for the effect-size floor, a matched suffering/learned-helplessness arm (uncontrollable aversion, SD-011/SD-019b) run on the SAME disengage DV, and a parsimony arm feeding SD-012 drive_level directly into MECH-342 with no two-bound accumulator.
claims.DV: Disengagement hazard as a function of time-on-task at fixed harm and fixed controllability; the shift in that hazard when incentive is raised at fixed F; and re-engagement latency plus hazard after a rest phase, contrasted against the helplessness arm which must NOT recover.
claims.instrument: The effort axis and its positive control exist -- CausalGridWorldV2 carries effort_harm_coupling_enabled, effort_dissociation_enabled and effort_benefit_asymmetry (v3_exq_730_q080a_effort_harm_coupling.py exercises them). No F recorder exists because no F accumulator exists; the only ree_core items named fatigue are an env AR(1) observation-noise term and PCCConfig.fatigue_weight reading SD-012 drive_level.
claims.consumer_locus: The in-task STOP entering MECH-342 as a new deficit input and ARC-078 via a non-aversive cost/benefit channel; the recover half sits on SD-012/SD-017, not in MECH-342.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Gate (0) existence aside, the accumulator must have headroom -- each seed must cross the upper bound at least once AND recover to the lower bound at least once, with bound-residency fractions reported; z_block must be pinned or use_blocked_agency=False so MECH-353 DECOMMIT cannot fire on the same observable; harm and the escapability gate held constant; and effort_harm_coupling_enabled=False with the Q-080.b effort_benefit_asymmetry positive control passing first.
claims.blocking_reason: The fast within-task two-bound effort accumulator does not exist -- ARC-078 appears nowhere in ree_core -- so V3 cannot generate the bound-crossing event or the STOP it emits. The slow Process-S leg has an accumulator (EntryPressureAccumulator) but it integrates MEL demand, not effort, has one bound not two, and emits no in-task STOP.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0142 (resolved, user-approved 2026-09-10) already owns the owed item: register the fast two-bound EFFORT accumulator as a substrate_queue build entry. FAST within-task accumulator, which remains unbuilt and unqueued (part i, owed). For the SLOW
Process-S leg it is SATISFIED IN FORM: SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE (EntryPressureAccumulator,
ree-v3 ree_core/sleep/mel_consumer.py, 2026-08-26) is a hysteretic sleep-pressure accumulator
that exists and is reachable, so the slow leg's open question is narrowed to its INTEGRAND --
effort versus waking prediction error -- plus one-bound-versus-two-bound, not to whether an
accumulator exists at all. Gates (1)-(4) below are unaffected and still apply to both legs.
(1) TWO-BOUND LIVENESS AND HEADROOM -- BOTH bounds must be reached and neither pinned: each seed must
show F crossing the UPPER bound at least once AND recovering to the LOWER bound at least once, with
the fraction of steps spent at each bound reported. An F pinned at either bound reproduces the exact
V3-EXQ-642a/642b degeneracy -- see MECH-353's own `what_would_answer` precondition (1) for the full
statement of why a bounded-accumulator DV must have headroom; do not re-derive it here.
(2) DISCONFOUNDING FROM z_block (MECH-353) -- the run MUST set `use_blocked_agency=False`, or pin
`z_block` to a constant. MECH-353's ARC-016-gated DECOMMIT fires on the SAME observable
(disengagement) from the OPPOSITE antecedent (external block with capacity retained). With both live,
a stop/disengage DV cannot attribute, and a null on MECH-354 would be uninterpretable.
(3) HARM AND CONTROLLABILITY PINNED -- `z_harm_a` and the SD-019b/Q-036 escapability gate held
constant across the time-on-task axis. If they drift, the disengage is the suffering pole, which is
precisely the DEV-NEED-002 conflation this claim exists to cure.

`effort_harm_coupling_enabled=False` setting so effort cost is not a harm proxy, and run the Q-080.b

reading any negative result.

is shared with the suffering pole):
(a) TIME-ON-TASK -- disengagement hazard rises monotonically with time-on-task at FIXED harm and FIXED
controllability, on `>= 3/5` seeds, effect `>= max(1.5 * SD(per-seed delta), an absolute floor derived
from the F-OFF arm's spread)`.
(b) INCENTIVE-REVERSIBILITY -- raising incentive at a FIXED accumulated F measurably delays or cancels
the STOP. This is the leg that discriminates the Boksem-Tops cost/benefit recalibration account from a
pure-depletion account, which predicts no incentive effect at fixed F.

disengagement hazard return toward baseline, AND a matched suffering/learned-helplessness arm
(uncontrollable aversion, SD-011/SD-019b) run on the SAME DV shows NO rest-recovery. Without the
matched comparison arm this leg is not a dissociation, only a description.

FALSIFYING: with the accumulator built and (1)-(4) met, ANY of --
(i) (a) holds but (b) and (c) do not -- the stop is neither incentive-reversible nor rest-recoverable,
so on its OWN decisive dissociator the signal is indistinguishable from the SD-011 suffering pole and

accumulator. MECH-354 asserts the "smallest computational form" is Meyniel's two-bound accumulator; if
a one-bound leaky drive suffices, the claim is over-specified and should be narrowed rather than
confirmed.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two independent gaps must both close before a
test can discriminate the strong reading from ARC-062's weak reading, and
NEITHER is currently met.

(1) SUBSTRATE COMPLETENESS. candidate_rule_field.py (862 lines) implements
only 4 of 6 distinctive pieces -- CREATE/REPRESENT/GATE/CREDIT (MECH-349-352)
landed. Missing: hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping (zero references
in the module), the full named status lifecycle (only mint/retire exist),
structured per-action evidence-trace records (CREDIT is a scalar trace,
not the rollout->commitment->outcome->residue chain the claim specifies),
and sleep-side refinement wiring (no CRF reference anywhere under
ree_core/sleep/).

(2) SHARED DOWNSTREAM CONVERSION CEILING. Every ARC-062 GAP-B behavioural
falsifier run (V3-EXQ-654g/654j/485h/485m/714/719a, 21 autopsies) shows
the identical C1-holds/C2-fails signature: rule-biased signal reaches E3
with genuine authority but fails to convert to committed-class diversity
(MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, shared by both readings,
in-flight via ARC-108/MECH-450). Until this lifts, any committed-action
strong-vs-weak test is confounded.

CONFIRMING signature (once both clear), using ARC-063's own pre-registered
fork: (a) SCALE/HISTORY -- ARC-062's heads degrade below floor past 2
competing strategies or with history-dependent cuts, while the CRF holds;
(b) CLINICAL FAILURE MODE -- a rule-field-directed failure (paranoid
over-generalisation, depressive rollout-constraint) inducible via
named-rule residue attribution with no ARC-062 analogue; (c) SLEEP
ASYMMETRY -- a sleep-phase pass measurably reorganises the rule pool
beyond an equivalent waking-only pass, no ARC-062 analogue.

FALSIFYING signature: with both preconditions cleared, (a)/(b)/(c) all
fail to discriminate -- would falsify the strong reading's claimed
INDEPENDENT NEED and argue for retiring ARC-063 to a persistent-flag/V4
watch rather than an active V3 design target.

Given neither precondition is met, and given zero experimental evidence
to date (claim_evidence.v1.json: 29 lit entries, 0 exp entries,
evidence_quadrant plausible_unproven), disposition is substrate-blocked.

NOTE FOR FUTURE DIGESTION: ARC-062 (weak reading) already has a mature,
21-times-run experimental falsifier design (the GAP-B behavioural
lineage) -- digesting it is mostly formalizing criteria that already
exist, not designing new tests. It should reuse precondition (2) above
verbatim (both readings share the identical MECH-439 conversion ceiling)
so the pair does not drift into inconsistent release conditions.

claims.claim_title: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.
claims.falsifier_summary: ARM_1 shows no acquisition or retrieval advantage over ARM_0 for that rule class -- the pathway is redundant with ARC-062/ARC-064 and should be reframed as a special case of one of them rather than carried as an independent commitment.
claims.required_event: A scaffolding episode: a caregiver structures exposure and marks a regularity ostensively, so a candidate rule enters the field already bound to the scaffolding context.
claims.manipulation: ARM_1 adds MECH-337 caregiver-scaffolded population plus MECH-338 cue-driven context-bound retrieval; ARM_0 holds ARC-065 diversity and the ARC-063 field constant with those channels absent or disabled.
claims.control: ARM_0 (field plus diversity, no social population channel) at matched seeds, with the ARC-062 and ARC-064 routes left intact so their independent reach is measured rather than assumed.
claims.DV: Acquisition rate and retrieval fidelity for context-bound rules whose discriminative cut depends on agent/episode history rather than current observation, with rollout-eligibility tracking the scaffolding-episode context tag.
claims.instrument: The ARC-063 CandidateRuleField substrate exists (ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py) for its create/represent/gate/credit faces, so the field is readable. The social in-face has no substrate: grep of ree_core, experiments and coordinator for caregiver, teacher_agent and ostensive returns zero hits, re-verified for this audit.
claims.consumer_locus: The write path INTO the CandidateRule field from outside the learner, plus the cue-matched retrieval gate -- not the express face, which ARC-063 already owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A second agent (or an environment mechanism that can emit ostensive cues independent of the learner's own action stream) must exist, and the rule class under test must be one that ARC-062's top-down discriminator and ARC-064's bottom-up behaviour clustering demonstrably cannot reach alone -- otherwise ARM_0 succeeds and the third-source framing is untested rather than falsified.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate does not exist and V3 is single-agent, so the required ostensive-exposure event cannot be generated. The claim says so itself and the lit gate, already discharged, does not change it.
false_positives: Every scaffold hit in ree-v3 is unrelated (avoidance_scaffold_floor, SleepLoopManager code scaffolding, the single-agent InfantCurriculumScheduler); this audit re-confirmed the 2026-08-07 grep rather than relying on it.
claims.auditor_notes: PHASE-LABEL DRIFT worth a governance look: ARC-077 carries implementation_phase v3 and v3_pending true, and its children MECH-337/MECH-338 are also labelled v3, while the claim's own what_would_answer declares the test V4-bound and hard-gated on a substrate V3 does not have. claims.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED PRECONDITION: this claim is not yet testable, and the blocker is unchanged since registration (2026-05-18). Re-verified 2026-08-07: (a) the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate implementation_prerequisite (3) remains fully unmet -- grep of ree-v3/ree_core, experiments/, and coordinator/ for "caregiver" and "teacher_agent"/"teacher-agent" returns zero hits; every "scaffold" hit is a false positive (protective avoidance_scaffold_floor, SleepLoopManager Phase-A code scaffolding, InfantCurriculumScheduler -- a single-agent curriculum, not a second agent). V3 remains single-agent: no substrate exists that can deliver scaffolded exposure or ostensive cues from outside the learner. (b) Prerequisite (2), the ARC-063 CandidateRule field, is prototyped and v1-substrate-implemented (candidate_rule_field.py, 2026-06-04) for its CREATE/REPRESENT/GATE/CREDIT faces, but ARC-063's own record is explicit that "only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3)" -- the specific write-path this claim needs remains unbuilt. Prerequisite (1), the GAP-L lit-pull, is discharged (2026-05-18, lit_conf 0.74) and does not on its own promote the claim. Sibling routes ARC-062 (substrate_ceiling, v3_pending) and ARC-064 (hold_pending_v3_substrate) also remain unpromoted, consistent with the cluster as a whole staying pre-V3-tractable for this pathway.
Once the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate exists (a second agent, or an environment mechanism that can deliver ostensive/scaffolded cues independent of the learner's own action stream) and MECH-337 (population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven retrieval) are built on top of it, the discriminating test is the claim's own functional_restatement, made explicit:
DESIGN: hold ARC-065 (behavioural diversity) and the ARC-063 CandidateRule field substrate constant across two arms. ARM_0 = field + diversity, NO socially-scaffolded population channel (MECH-337/338 absent or disabled). ARM_1 = ARM_0 + MECH-337 (caregiver-scaffolded population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven, context-bound retrieval). Measure acquisition of context-bound rules whose discriminative cut is a function of agent/episode history rather than current observation -- i.e. rules that cannot be recovered from ARC-062's top-down context-discriminator route or ARC-064's bottom-up behaviour-clustering route alone, per this claim's peer-pathway framing.
CONFIRMING: ARM_1 acquires and reliably retrieves this class of context-bound, history-dependent rule (rollout-eligibility and behavioural expression track the scaffolding-episode context tag) where ARM_0 fails or acquires it at markedly lower rate/fidelity -- adding the socially-scaffolded channel rescues exactly the acquisition class ARM_0 cannot reach, sharpening ARC-063's falsifiable prediction (a) and validating ARC-077 as a genuinely distinct third rule-source rather than a redundant restatement of ARC-062/ARC-064.
FALSIFYING: ARM_1 shows no measurable acquisition or retrieval advantage over ARM_0 for this rule class -- the agent acquires the same context-bound rules at the same rate/fidelity with or without socially-scaffolded population, or ARM_0 (top-down/bottom-up routes alone) already reaches this class once the substrate exists. Either result means the "third source" framing is not doing independent work: the pathway is redundant with ARC-062/ARC-064's existing routes rather than a peer, and the claim should be reframed as a special case of one of them (or demoted) rather than carried forward as an independent architectural commitment.
This test cannot run, and this claim cannot be promoted or demoted on experimental grounds, until the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate is built. Until then this claim remains a structural slot backed by literature only (lit_conf 0.74), not evidence.

claims.claim_title: Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.

claims.claim_title: Cue-driven context-bound rule retrieval (the 'cue pipeline' / 'select' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). Environmental or internal cues are matched against CandidateRule context tags to gate rollout-eligibility: a rule populated in a context becomes available again when that context, or a cue associated with it, recurs (context-dependent / cued recall; Tulving & Thomson encoding-specificity; Godden & Baddeley context-dependent memory). This is the retrieval pay-off of context-bound population (MECH-337) and the access gate that decides which CandidateRules enter hippocampal rollout. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull.
claims.falsifier_summary: Eligibility is statistically indistinguishable between matched and mismatched cues at matched n_matched, meaning the context tags written at population time carry no retrieval-relevant information and the in/select coupling asserted in the title fails.
claims.required_event: A tick at which the current context either overlaps a stored rule's context_tag or is matched-but-non-overlapping, with the same candidate pool present in both conditions.
claims.manipulation: Present cue A, which overlaps the tags of a rule minted in context A, versus a matched cue B that does not, on the identical rule field -- a within-pool cue swap, not a population manipulation.
claims.control: The same rules under a scrambled-tag arm (tags permuted across rules, preserving tag geometry but destroying the population-time association), which separates retrieval-relevant tag content from tag-vector statistics.
claims.DV: Rollout-eligibility of the target rule -- whether it is selected active by gate_and_select and enters the rule_state handed to SD-033a -- under matched versus mismatched cue, on the same pool and at matched n_matched.
claims.instrument: Present: CandidateRuleField.gate_and_select sets rule.active (available AND context-matched) and exposes active_rule_state; the agent records the CRF source at its step site. Missing: no experiment runs the matched-versus-mismatched cue contrast -- the 654 lineage tests ARC-062/ARC-063 rule-state differentiation and churn, not cued retrieval.
claims.consumer_locus: The retrieval/availability gate inside the CandidateRule field, upstream of the ARC-063 Tolerance-Principle eligibility decision it feeds -- not the population path MECH-337 owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The field must hold at least two rules with genuinely differentiated context_tags and clear the tolerance gate: V3-EXQ-654d showed that when tags cluster within the match threshold, 7 to 8 rules co-match per tick and theta rises to roughly 1.65, gating every matched rule out. claims.claim_title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
claims.falsifier_summary: With P1 and P2 both witnessed, ARC-062 gating ON and ceiling headroom demonstrably present, the ALL-ON arm's fraction-of-ceiling entropy is statistically indistinguishable from ALL-OFF and from the matched-magnitude noise control on >= 2/3 seeds; the collapse must then be re-rooted to z_world under-differentiation or F-dominance.
claims.required_event: A trained agent selecting committed actions across a full episode on an armed conversion stack, where the candidate pool genuinely realises near action_dim distinct first-action classes so committed-class entropy has headroom to move.
claims.manipulation: Multi-arm ablation of the diversity-generation substrates: ALL-OFF (use_noise_floor False + use_structured_curiosity False + striatal novelty OFF) versus single-substrate-ON arms and an ALL-ON arm, at the raised class floor with modulatory selection authority armed.
claims.control: A matched-magnitude noise control arm plus the ALL-OFF yoked reference sharing a private per-runner RNG stream, with the conversion stack, training budget and ceiling covariate held as matched constants across arms.
claims.DV: committed_class_entropy reported as a fraction of the run's own achieved ceiling ln(mean_distinct_first_action_classes), plus yoked per-tick committed-action divergence against the matched reference arm, per seed.
claims.instrument: All three mandatory instruments exist and have been exercised: v3_exq_955 records mean_distinct_first_action_classes, fraction-of-ceiling committed_class_entropy, yoked private-RNG divergence and authority_rel_deviation_mean; v3_exq_949 established the yoked-pair design. The levers are ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py, ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py and the SP-CEM defaults in ree_core/utils/config.py.
claims.consumer_locus: Terminal committed action at E3 select, downstream of every candidate scorer, eligibility gate, shortlist and argmin -- not the per-candidate proposal range.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both config clamps must be lifted and WITNESSED per arm, not assumed: support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim with measured mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim, and use_modulatory_selection_authority = True with authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05 in every lever-bearing arm. ARC-062 gated policy heads plus the learned context discriminator must be ON in every arm so a monomodal outcome is attributable to absent diversity rather than an absent consumer.
