claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a multi-arm behavioural ablation of the diversity-generation
substrates on an ARMED conversion stack -- not by any run in the
569/687/707/708/714 lineage, all of which were measured against a class-entropy
ceiling they were already at.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (ARMED-CONVERSION; shared with MECH-440 and MECH-441,
which cross-reference this text rather than restating it). Two independently-
defaulting config clamps must BOTH be lifted, and both asserted from MEASURED
per-arm quantities, not from the config:
 (P1) support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim, with measured
 mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim in every arm. At the
 shipped default of 2 (set literally at 273 driver call sites) the candidate pool
 realises only ~2.16-3.08 distinct first-action classes of 5, so committed-CLASS
 entropy is capped at ln(~3) ~ 1.08 nats IDENTICALLY IN EVERY ARM -- an
 arm-invariant ceiling no diversity lever can move. V3-EXQ-708b measured
 precommit_n_distinct_classes_mean = 2.959 / 2.958 / 2.956 across its three arms
 with precommit_class_entropy at 97.8% of that ceiling in the OFF baseline.
 (P2) use_modulatory_selection_authority = True, with measured
 authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05 in every arm bearing a modulatory lever
 (~1e-8 is the OFF signature). With authority OFF, a per-candidate modulatory
 contribution is added at fixed small magnitude to scores whose raw range is
 10-560, and cannot move the argmin by construction.
 Both load-bearing, neither substitutes for the other: V3-EXQ-949 (5 seeds)
 measured yoked committed-action divergence 0.000 with P1 alone, 0.000 with P2
 alone, 0.3675 with both. A null with either clamp in place is VACUOUS and must
 self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never weakens.
 A third precondition remains from the original design: ARC-062's gated policy
 heads and learned context discriminator must be ON in every arm, so that a
 monomodal outcome is attributable to absent diversity rather than an absent
 consumer of it.
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: primary DV is committed_class_entropy over the
episode -- the terminal output of E3 selection, downstream of every candidate
scorer, eligibility gate, shortlist and argmin, so nothing remains to absorb it.
Three MANDATORY instruments, whose absence made the prior lineage unreadable:
(i) mean_distinct_first_action_classes per arm as a covariate, so the
combinatorial ceiling ln(distinct) is VISIBLE and the DV is reported as a FRACTION
of it rather than an absolute nat count; (ii) yoked-pair per-tick committed-action
divergence against a matched control arm sharing a private RNG stream (the
V3-EXQ-949 design), which detects authority acquisition even when episode-level
entropy has not yet moved; (iii) authority_rel_deviation_mean per arm, so P2 is
witnessed rather than assumed.
CONFIRMING: on an armed stack, complete ablation of the diversity-generation
pathway (LC-NE tonic floor OFF + structured curiosity OFF + striatal novelty OFF,
ARC-062 gating ON) drives committed-class entropy to monomodal collapse -- a
fraction-of-ceiling at or near its floor -- while at least one single-substrate-ON
arm reaches a strictly higher fraction-of-ceiling on >=2/3 seeds by a margin scaled
on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor. The partial-ON arms then
discriminate load-bearing from contributory among the substrates. ARC-065 is
confirmed as an ARCHITECTURAL SLOT if ANY substrate arm lifts the DV; it does not
require that all four do, and its own text says so.
FALSIFYING: on a fully armed stack (P1 and P2 both witnessed, ARC-062 gating ON,
ceiling headroom demonstrably present -- fraction-of-ceiling in the ALL-OFF arm
materially below 1.0), the ALL-ON arm's committed-class entropy is statistically
indistinguishable from the ALL-OFF arm AND from a matched-magnitude noise control,
on >=2/3 seeds. Then diversity generation is not the missing architectural function
and the collapse must be re-rooted to the representation ceiling (INV-088 z_world
under-differentiation) or to F-dominance (MECH-439). Note the asymmetry
deliberately: a null in the ALL-OFF arm is uninformative (nothing to lift), so the
ceiling-headroom check is a precondition on the FALSIFYING branch specifically.
SCOPE SPLIT OWED ON SUBSTRATE (b): currently lumps striatal novelty (MECH-314a),
frontopolar uncertainty (MECH-314b) and learning-progress curiosity (MECH-314c)
into one "curiosity" slot. MECH-458 splits that slot by POLARITY: density-
attraction curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier contributing
0.00 diversity force at the decision point and 0 directed behaviour on an unshaped
map, while uncertainty- and disagreement-driven curiosity (MECH-314b/c, MECH-441)
carry the opposite, Bellemare polarity. Any curiosity arm must DECLARE which
polarity it instantiates and record a visitation-density covariate.

claims.claim_title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).
claims.falsifier_summary: both-OFF does NOT collapse to monomodal behaviour, meaning some other anti-monostrategy mechanism is doing the work; or 313-only produces no measurable entropy lift over both-OFF at adequate N, corroborating the co-equal NULL reading carried since the 2026-07-09 GOV-CEIL-1 demotion that the LC-NE noise floor is inert.
claims.required_event: Sustained waking action selection on the SD-054 reef substrate with ARC-062 gated policy enabled, long enough for probe-state action distributions and reef/forage occupancy to be estimated per seed.
claims.manipulation: The Q-045 four-arm ablation -- both-OFF, 313-only (use_noise_floor), 260-only (use_dacc with dacc_suppression_weight), both-ON -- with noise_floor_alpha and noise_floor_min_temperature at their landed values.

claims.DV: Action-distribution entropy at probe states and reef/forage occupancy coefficient of variation across seeds, ranked across the four arms -- both-ON above each single-mechanism arm above both-OFF if the two mechanisms are mutually load-bearing.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py (NoiseFloor, pure-arithmetic temperature lift at the e3.select() call site); contracts tests/contracts/test_mech_313_noise_floor.py; the four-arm driver exists as v3_exq_687_q045_mech313_mech260_4arm_tonic_noise_ablation.py and its predecessor v3_exq_603b. The entropy DV is recorded; committed_sufficiency is what gates it.

claims.claim_title: structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the ceiling lifted and non-degeneracy certified, the sweep produces no Pareto frontier and the three-arm ablation produces no distinct signatures -- the structured-curiosity bonus is not load-bearing, and Q-044 resolves toward one mechanism rather than three.
claims.required_event: Action selection in a regime where uncertainty or information gain genuinely differs across candidates, so a curiosity bonus has something non-uniform to express.
claims.manipulation: Parametric sweep of the MECH-314 weight against the MECH-313 noise-floor weight (Q-043), plus a three-arm sub-flavour ablation 314a-OFF / 314b-OFF / 314c-OFF against all-on (Q-044).
claims.control: All-on baseline and a MECH-313-only arm; matched selection authority and matched candidate pool across arms so the contrast is the curiosity channel, not the arena.
claims.DV: A Pareto frontier on behavioural-diversity versus task-reward across the weight sweep, and THREE DISTINCT failure signatures across the sub-flavour ablation (reduced novelty-driven return-to-explore; reduced uncertainty-resolution rollouts; reduced learning-curve curvature).
claims.instrument: ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py with per-sub-flavour switches and diagnostics; 314a Phase-2 visitation buffer and 314b Phase-2 per-candidate uncertainty have live producers (agent.py:6447, 8538, SD-063 uncertainty head), but 314c has NO live per-candidate learning-progress source -- the module docstring names MECH-482, the epistemic-deficit accumulator, as the missing producer.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 committed selection: whether the curiosity bias changes what gets committed, not merely what gets scored.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The single-arena F-dominance conversion ceiling must have genuinely lifted on the substrate under test (GAP-A pool divergence, curiosity-bias non-degeneracy, and selection authority genuinely moving the argmin, all measured on the run), and each sub-flavour must be genuinely per-candidate before a three-arm ablation can dissociate them.
claims.blocking_reason: Nulls remain uninformative while the shared single-arena ceiling stands (GAP-A lift generalisation not demonstrated; v4_loop_segregation ready=false), and the 314c leg additionally has no live per-candidate producer, so a three-way dissociation cannot be run at parity across sub-flavours.

claims.claim_title: novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error. Biological substrate: ventral striatum response to stimulus novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus.
claims.falsifier_summary: 314a-OFF does not reduce return-rate to rarely-visited states, or its signature is indistinguishable from 314b-OFF and 314c-OFF (the Q-044 collapse hypothesis), or -- as 590b already indicates on the exploration index -- no nonzero gain beats the gain=0 control even though the argmin moves.
claims.required_event: Episodes containing states the agent has visited rarely or not at all, reachable within the episode, so a return-rate to rarely-visited states is definable and non-zero in the all-on arm.
claims.manipulation: Three-way ablation on one substrate: 314a-OFF (use_curiosity_novelty False) versus 314b-OFF versus 314c-OFF, all against ARM_ALL_ON, with curiosity_novelty_weight swept for the Goldilocks calibration.
claims.control: ARM_ALL_ON as the reference and the gain=0 arm as the do-nothing control -- the comparison V3-EXQ-590b showed no nonzero gain beat -- so that authority-moves-argmin is separated from signal-is-adaptive.
claims.DV: Return-rate to rarely-visited states (revisitation of low-count z_world regions, derivable from the Phase-2 rolling visitation buffer), compared across the three ablation arms; selected_action_class_entropy is a non-vacuity readout only, because it cannot distinguish novelty-specific exploration from any modulatory perturbation of the argmin.
claims.instrument: structured_curiosity.py _compute_novelty computes the per-candidate novelty, and the Phase-2 rolling z_world visitation deque exists in agent.py (appended in sense(), MECH-094-gated, cleared on episode boundary). No experiment currently reduces that buffer to a return-rate DV: 604c scores committed-class entropy and 590b scores an exploration index over gains.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 candidate scoring, where the per-candidate novelty bonus competes for selection authority against the primary harm/goal term.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Candidates must be action-divergent (V3-EXQ-604's per-candidate novelty collapsed to uniform on a monostrategic pool; the C0 pairwise-distance guard at 0.03 is the check), and modulatory bias must have selection authority at E3.select (604a measured curiosity_bias_abs_mean 0.0 even ON). Both preconditions are now met on the GAP-A-ready substrate.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim's own discriminating DV -- return-rate to rarely-visited states -- has never been measured. The sub-flavour ablations score committed-class entropy, which cannot separate novelty-specific exploration from any modulatory perturbation, and no driver reduces the existing Phase-2 visitation buffer to a revisitation statistic.

claims.falsifier_summary: With committed-path authority established and both mechanisms witnessed operative, the four arms are indistinguishable on committed diversity -- neither anti-monostrategy pressure reaches committed behaviour and the collapse question is answered elsewhere (F-dominance), not in the LC/dACC split.
claims.required_event: Repeated committed action selection on the scaffolded SD-054 foraging substrate with ARC-062 gated policy on, over a horizon long enough for across-trial outcome history to accumulate (the Kennerley temporal-horizon design gate).
claims.manipulation: The four-arm ablation both-OFF / 313-only / 260-only / both-ON, but carried on a lever that reaches the committed pick, extended per the 2026-05-11 lit R4 to 8 cells (4 arms x 2 LC amplitudes) or with an explicit LC->ACC coupling-ablation cell so the Tervo asymmetry can show as non-superposition.
claims.control: both-OFF at matched seeds and matched training budget as the monostrategy reference, plus a matched-magnitude noise arm so a diversity lift is not attributable to added variance per se, with the conversion stack armed identically in every arm.
claims.DV: Committed behavioural-diversity ranking across the four arms (committed first-action / action-class entropy on the fresh-select denominator), tested specifically for whether both-ON exceeds the LINEAR SUPERPOSITION of the singletons -- the directionally-coupled outcome -- rather than only for the three-way ordering.
claims.instrument: The arms and readouts exist (NoiseFloor at the e3.select call site, dACC FIFO with record_action, the 687/687a drivers and their per-arm authority diagnostics), and 687a was purpose-built to MEASURE the invariance rather than infer it -- but it FAILED its own readiness gate (no noise-floor arm cleared conversion_stack_routes_range), so even the diagnostic reading is unobtained.
claims.consumer_locus: The committed selection in E3TrajectorySelector.select -- not the pre-commit softmax, where a temperature lift is already known to move the diagnostic entropy without moving committed class.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: MECH-313 must have committed-path selection authority before a four-arm committed DV can discriminate at all: either use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature=True (which changes the question to MECH-313 GIVEN MECH-439 and must be declared) or a state-conditioned injection site such as MECH-440 weight noise. Alongside it, MECH-260 operativity (dacc.record_action reached, FIFO non-empty) and a live cross-candidate conversion range must be witnessed per arm -- V3-EXQ-687a failed exactly that readiness gate.
claims.blocking_reason: MECH-313's tonic channel has no committed-path consumer: uniform temperature cannot move an argmin, so the interaction cell is arithmetically degenerate on any committed DV. use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature exists but defaults False and flipping it manufactures the authority the claim asserts. 687a's attempt to measure the invariance failed its conversion readiness gate.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT

claims.claim_title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).
claims.falsifier_summary: ARM_1 does not beat ARM_0 on the no-cue substrate beyond noise even with the children live and the boundary instrument reading, or ARM_0 alone already solves the no-cue task at ARM_1's rate -- the top-down machinery suffices and the bottom-up slot is not load-bearing.
claims.required_event: Episodes on a no-external-cue substrate whose contingency changes without any observable cue -- CausalGridWorldV2's world_rule_shift_enabled action-map re-permutation is the existing primitive, with steps_since_world_rule_shift emitted so re-learning within a stationary window is measurable -- matched by a cued-control variant in which the same regime change is explicitly signalled.
claims.manipulation: ARM_0 ARC-062 alone (gated policy heads plus the learned context discriminator) versus ARM_1 ARC-062 plus the ARC-064 children (chunk proposal injection via use_chunk_proposal_injection, the rule_state abstraction path, and a cross-episode regularity extractor that must still be built), each run on BOTH the no-cue and the cued-control substrate.
claims.control: The cued-control substrate is the load-bearing control -- ARM_1 must give no material benefit there -- plus a fixed-policy or random-policy floor on the no-cue task that rules out solvability without discovery.
claims.DV: Primary: chunk-boundary detectability in the action stream (action-distribution entropy troughs at chunk boundaries in ARM_1 and not in ARM_0) and the rate at which behaviour re-differentiates between hidden regimes after an uncued shift. Secondary and explicitly ceiling-bounded: episodes-to-criterion and terminal reward.
claims.instrument: Mixed. The compression mechanism and its counters exist (ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py: ChunkedPrimitive initiation_set / termination_condition, formation_candidates, mint, ChunkLibrary.register; crystallisation_counter), and the rule-state path exists via SD-033a / candidate_rule_field.py. The claim's own falsifying DV does not: the 2026-09-01 absorption check records that nothing anywhere emits a behavioural chunk-boundary statistic.
claims.consumer_locus: The bottom-up path from the observed-behaviour stream to a rule-state abstraction that changes behaviour -- architecturally distinct from ARC-062's cue-to-context-discriminator-to-policy-mode path, which is what the dissociation across cued and uncued substrates is designed to separate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: (1) The no-cue substrate must not be solvable without rule discovery: a fixed policy or random control must not already reach near-ceiling. (2) The bottom-up-derived signal must be shown to reach committed action, which on this substrate is the MECH-439 F-dominance washout and is now unfixable by the route of record -- so the primary DV must be moved to the representation/behaviour-stream boundary rather than committed-action learning curves. (3) The ARC-064 children must exist as functional substrate: MECH-317 and MECH-318 partly do via absorption; MECH-316 cross-episode regularity extraction has no substrate at all.
claims.blocking_reason: Three-layered. The claim's own falsifying observable -- chunk boundaries in the action stream -- has no instrument anywhere in the substrate. MECH-316 has zero built substrate, so ARM_1 cannot be assembled in full. And the committed-action learning-curve DV the WWA proposes sits behind the MECH-439 F-dominance washout, whose owning substrate entry is now closed wontfix, so that route will not clear.
false_positives: The WWA's statement that all three children have zero built substrate is wrong for MECH-317 (ARC-071/MECH-323/MECH-324 satisfy its S1-S4 properties, only the S5 boundary DV is missing) and for MECH-318 (SD-033a/MECH-262 rule_state is live; V3-EXQ-606 already measured rule_state_active PASS).

The WWA treats 'no no-cue substrate exists' as implicit; CausalGridWorldV2 world_rule_shift_enabled provides an uncued contingency change with a re-learning telemetry signal, already used by several drivers.
claims.auditor_notes: The behavioural chunk-boundary readout (S5) is the cheapest unblocking item and is already owned as a residual of GFLAG-0087 and the GAP-I-absorption node -- an instrument, not a new mechanism. The coordinator should check with the MECH-316/317/318 auditors before minting anything, since all four claims share this one instrument.

A two-arm learning-curve comparison on a no-external-cue substrate where
the rule must be discovered from the observed-behaviour stream, matched
by a second run on a cued-control substrate where the rule is
externally signalled. This operationalises the design the claim's own
functional_restatement already specifies.

DESIGN: ARM_0 = ARC-062-alone (top-down gated-policy + learned context
discriminator, the existing V3 rule-apprehension instantiation). ARM_1
= ARC-062 + ARC-064 children (at minimum the load-bearing subset of
MECH-316 cross-episode regularity extraction, MECH-317 behavioural-
pattern compression, MECH-318 rule-state abstraction). Substrate
candidates named in the claim's own evidence_quality_note: SD-054
extended with hidden cross-episode structure (a transition/reward
contingency that varies between two regimes with NO externally
observable cue distinguishing them), or a serial-reaction-time-task
analog with hidden sequence structure. Run BOTH arms on BOTH the
no-cue substrate and a matched cued-control variant (same substrate,
rule signalled by an explicit external cue).

CONFIRMED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 produces a measurably
better learning curve than ARM_0 (lower episodes-to-criterion, higher
terminal reward, or earlier behavioural divergence between the hidden
regimes) AND, on the cued-control substrate, ARM_1 gives no material
benefit over ARM_0 (consistent with "ARC-062 alone suffices when the
cue is external"). This dissociation -- large ARC-064 contribution
only where the rule must be discovered -- is what would establish
bottom-up rule discovery as architecturally distinct, load-bearing
functionality rather than a redundant restatement of the top-down
pathway.

FALSIFIED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 does not outperform ARM_0
beyond noise (adding MECH-316/317/318 gives no measurable
learning-curve advantage even when the rule genuinely must be
discovered from behaviour alone), OR if ARM_0 alone already solves the
no-cue task at a rate matching ARM_1 (existing top-down/updater
machinery already suffices for what looks like "discovery," so the
claimed bottom-up/top-down architectural distinction is not
load-bearing). Either result argues ARC-064 does not name a separate
architectural function from ARC-062.

interpretable):

rote memorisation independent of any rule-discovery machinery -- ARM_0
(or a null/random-policy control) must not already saturate
near-ceiling performance on the no-cue task for reasons unrelated to
rule discovery (e.g. an episode horizon too short for the hidden
regime to matter, or a reward structure solvable by a fixed policy
regardless of regime).
(2) The comparison must clear the SAME structural conversion-ceiling
bottleneck already identified on the sibling ARC-062/MECH-309
falsifier line (MECH-439 F-dominance / E3 commit-selection-authority

signal MECH-316/317/318 mint must be shown to actually reach committed
action (readiness gates analogous to the ARC-062 GAP-B C1 gates), not
merely exist in representation. Absent that check, a null ARM_1 result
is confounded with the known selection-authority washout rather than
informative about the top-down/bottom-up architectural question -- the
same failure mode V3-EXQ-606 (below) ran into for MECH-318 alone.
(3) MECH-316/317/318 must exist as at least minimally functional
substrate before the comparison can run at all.

claims.claim_title: cross_episode_regularity_extraction (episodic_RL_successor_representation_CLS_monosynaptic_analog). A mechanism for extracting cross-episode statistical regularities from observed behaviour streams, producing a representation that supports prediction of future state-occupancy distributions. Biological substrate: hippocampal monosynaptic CA1 path (Schapiro et al. 2017 CLS bi-pathway); statistical learning in hippocampus (Davachi 2015). Computational analog: successor representation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017 Nat Neurosci). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.
claims.falsifier_summary: The ON arm's regime-conditioned occupancy predictions are indistinguishable from the OFF arm's, or do not scale with regime count, on a seed majority with the event and coverage preconditions green.
claims.required_event: A cross-episode regime change in the transition structure -- an action-map re-permutation fired by CausalGridWorld._maybe_shift_world_rule, which is persistent across episode resets and emits world_rule_shift_count / steps_since_world_rule_shift.
claims.manipulation: MECH-316-ON versus MECH-316-OFF (successor-representation / cross-episode-statistics module armed versus ablated), with regime count (1-regime versus >= 2-regime variant) as the crossed factor.
claims.control: The 1-regime variant of the same ecology at matched seeds and matched shift schedule, plus a schedule-only depth-0 shift arm (already legal in the env) that fires the schedule without changing the rule.
claims.DV: Divergence between the two regimes of the learned state-occupancy prediction (discounted future-occupancy distribution per state), measured per seed as the distance between regime-conditioned occupancy predictions, against the ON/OFF and 1-regime/multi-regime contrasts.
claims.instrument: MISSING. No successor-representation, state-occupancy or cross-episode-statistics readout exists in ree_core (direct grep for successor_representation / successor_rep / state_occupancy / occupancy_prediction returns zero hits). The event side IS instrumented by the env info dict.
claims.consumer_locus: The bottom-up rule-discovery layer (ARC-064): a representation in which cross-episode regularity is an explicit feature available to downstream rule-state abstraction (MECH-318), not merely decodable from episode traces.

claims.claim_title: rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session. Parent claim for the multi-variable, multi-channel, dynamic-within-session arbitration that selects between competing rules / policy modes / action sources at the policy layer. Arbitration is governed by at least four distinct sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a/b/c/d), each falsifiable independently, with a candidate fifth (controllability/agency) deferred pending V3 substrate availability. Recommended combination rule: multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax of reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity products) per Pull 3 R4 verdict; falsified against additive-logit baseline in V3-EXQ-543b/c. Reframed 2026-05-10 from earlier dual-channel-arbitration sketch following Pull 3 SYNTHESIS R5 SUB-MECH SPLIT recommendation (conf 0.78).
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same preconditions met, the two arms produce statistically indistinguishable committed-action signatures across the low-confidence-single-channel regime, or the additive arm matches or beats multiplicative on the architecture's own selection criteria -- either reopens the Pull 3 R4 architectural default.
claims.required_event: A within-session regime in which two or more competing rules or policy modes are simultaneously available and at least one arbitration channel is at a low-confidence value, which is the only regime where multiplicative and additive combination diverge.
claims.manipulation: Multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax over the product of reliability, cost, agency, V_s freshness and practice maturity) versus an additive-logit baseline over the same channel values, holding the channels themselves fixed so the contrast is the combination FORM.
claims.control: The additive-logit arm at matched channel inputs and matched training budget, plus a channel-shuffle control so a divergence cannot be attributed to which single channel happened to be strongest on a trial.
claims.DV: Divergence of committed action selection between the two combination-rule arms specifically on low-confidence-single-channel trials, reported as committed-class divergence rate and attributable to the gate form rather than to any one channel's value.
claims.instrument: Absent at the manipulation, not only at the recorder: grep across ree_core and experiments returns zero hits for multiplicative_gate, additive_logit, practice_maturity and V_s_freshness, and the live gated-policy substrate is the ARC-062 Phase-1 single-scalar two-head form w*head_0 + (1-w)*head_1 with one sigmoid discriminator.
claims.consumer_locus: The policy-layer arbitration that selects between competing rules before E3 commits an action -- one level above each sub-mechanism's own weighting channel.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least two differentiated, simultaneously-arbitrable rule states must be live at the selection moment AND the arbitration weights must be able to move the committed argmax; a run in which the weights change per-candidate scores without changing the committed action is re-deriving the MECH-439 F-dominance ceiling rather than adjudicating a combination rule.
claims.blocking_reason: There is no multi-channel arbitration gate of either form to contrast: the live substrate is a single-scalar two-head gate, and the four channel quantities the claim multiplies together are not computed anywhere. The CRF amend did land differentiated rule states (crf_frac_active 0.94), so the remaining vacuity is the F-dominance conversion ceiling plus the missing gate, not an empty rule pool.
false_positives: The WWA's clause that GAP-B leaves no differentiated rule states to arbitrate over is now half-superseded: the crf-availability-maintenance entry records V3-EXQ-654g clearing C1 with crf_frac_active 0.94 and non-vacuous propagation, so the live vacuity is the conversion ceiling (weights not moving the committed argmax), not an undifferentiated pool.

claims.claim_title: uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims.falsifier_summary: Arbitration weight is invariant to source-manipulated reliability, or tracks it non-monotonically, on a substrate where reliability is decoupled from practice-maturity.
claims.required_event: Trials in which two candidate rules or policy modes are simultaneously eligible and their reliabilities have been driven apart -- one recently failing, one consistently succeeding -- under otherwise matched context.
claims.manipulation: Drive the recent exception rate of one candidate up while holding the other's fixed, and separately toggle the arbitration channel (use_dualsystem_arbitration ON/OFF at the policy-mode locus; uniform-weighting comparator at the rule locus).
claims.control: Uniform-weighting arm (arbitration OFF), plus a reliability-matched arm in which both candidates carry the same exception rate, so a weight difference cannot arise from the candidates' identity.
claims.DV: Ratio of arbitration weight assigned to the high-reliability versus low-reliability candidate, regressed on the measured reliability ratio; slope must be positive and monotonic, with the OFF arm flat.

claims.claim_title: practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims.falsifier_summary: Proposal weight is invariant to practice count, tracks it non-monotonically, or is fully explained by the binary crystallisation threshold with no graded component, on a substrate where practice and reliability are decoupled.
claims.required_event: Selection ticks on which a high-practice candidate (many corroborated real executions) and a low-practice candidate are simultaneously eligible in the same context bucket.
claims.manipulation: Vary the number of corroborating real executions a candidate has accumulated (crystallisation_counter / R_min) while holding its outcome-consistency fixed, and toggle practice-weighting against uniform weighting.
claims.control: Uniform-weighting arm, plus a practice-matched arm where both candidates carry the same execution count, so any weight difference must come from something other than practice.
claims.DV: Arbitration / proposal weight assigned to each candidate regressed on its accumulated practice count, at fixed reliability; the claim predicts a positive monotonic slope across the practice range, not a single threshold step.
claims.instrument: ChunkedPrimitive exposes crystallisation_counter, formation_timestamp, state, selection_weight, n_reacquisitions and reacquisition_repetitions, and ChunkLibrary sorts the pool by selection_weight -- so practice IS recorded and IS consumed. But selection_weight is set to 0.0 or 1.0 by lifecycle transition, so the graded practice-to-weight function the claim asserts cannot be read off it. CandidateRule carries no practice count at all.
claims.consumer_locus: The proposal-pool weight on a candidate at selection time -- ChunkLibrary selection_weight for crystallised chunks, and CandidateRuleField availability gating for rules.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Practice-maturity and reliability must be experimentally decoupled -- a high-practice candidate that is currently failing and a low-practice candidate that is currently succeeding must both exist and both be eligible. Without that decoupling any weight-tracks-practice result is confounded with MECH-312a reliability.
claims.blocking_reason: The maturity signal exists and is consumed, but only through a binary lifecycle gate: selection_weight is 0.0 or 1.0 (policy_chunking.py:1279, 1540, 1553, 1579) so monotonic tracking has no dynamic range to be measured in. CandidateRule itself carries no practice channel, and no experiment manipulates practice at fixed reliability.
false_positives: The migrated 'ARC-063 not yet built' note is wrong (landed 2026-06-04), as the claim already records.

claims.claim_title: affective_stream_modulation_of_arbitration_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated by affective stream load: when the SD-010 / SD-011 affective stream produces high load (high salience harm or affect), the arbitration layer routes more weight to rules associated with affect-laden context, suppressing arbitration weight on neutral-context rules. The REE-novel claim is the FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCE: dual-stream architecture (SD-010/SD-011) is well-anchored in Murray-Rudebeck 2018 and Pessoa-Adolphs 2010, but the modulation of rule-arbitration weights by affective-stream load is REE-specific (MEDIUM-HIGH divergence). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims.falsifier_summary: Arbitration weight is flat across affect conditions, or affect-congruent selection appears equally in the OFF arm, showing the affective stream does not modulate rule arbitration.
claims.required_event: Re-elevation of affective-stream load in a context where rules previously deployed under high-affect conditions and rules previously deployed under neutral conditions are both eligible.
claims.manipulation: Vary SD-010/SD-011 affective-stream load across conditions (an affect-cue extension of the SD-054 bipartite layout), and toggle the affect-modulation channel against uniform weighting.
claims.control: Neutral-affect arm at matched harm exposure, plus a MECH-312c-OFF arm in which arbitration is blind to affect, so affect-congruent selection cannot arise from the affect manipulation changing the candidate set.
claims.DV: Interaction between affective load and prior-deployment affect context on arbitration weight -- weight on high-affect-tagged rules minus weight on neutral-tagged rules, as a function of current affect load. Flat across affect conditions in the OFF arm.
claims.instrument: The dual-stream substrate (SD-010/SD-011) is landed and its streams are readable, but CandidateRuleField has NO affect channel: a grep of candidate_rule_field.py for affect, harm, v_s, freshness or stale returns zero hits, and context_tag is a generic cosine-matched cue vector with no affect dimension. No per-rule affect-weighted readout exists.
claims.consumer_locus: The arbitration weight on candidate rules at selection time -- the routing decision inside CandidateRuleField, not the affective stream itself and not the E3 score.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Affective load must vary within a run with harm-magnitude and controllability separable from it, and rules must have been deployed under both high-affect and neutral contexts so that an affect-congruence comparison has two populations to compare. A single-affect-condition environment makes the interaction term unestimable.
claims.blocking_reason: Two absences, both verified in code. CandidateRuleField carries no affect-weighted channel and no affect dimension on context_tag, so the DV cannot be recorded at the asserted locus; and no affect-variable condition exists in the SD-054 family, so the required event is not generated.
false_positives: The shared 'ARC-063 not yet built' note is wrong for the whole 312 family; CandidateRuleField landed 2026-06-04.
claims.auditor_notes: The clinical corollary (depressed/anxious over-deployment of mood-congruent rules) is correctly V4/clinical and should stay out of the V3 pool; the affect-channel and affect-variable-condition items are the V3-tractable pieces. SD-054's bipartite layout already gives two regions, which lowers the cost of the affect-cue extension.
claims.what_would_answer:
On a substrate where affective load varies (SD-054 extended with affect-cue conditions), arbitration weight should show interaction effects with affect load: rules previously deployed under high-affect conditions should receive higher weight when affect re-elevates. MECH-312c-OFF agents should show flat arbitration across affect conditions.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (verified current): the dual-stream structural substrate (SD-010/SD-011) is landed and stable -- this part is NOT blocking. Two things are: (1) SD-054 has no affect-variable condition yet; (2) CandidateRuleField carries no affect-weighted channel or context-tag- by-affect distinction -- context_tag is a generic cosine-matched cue vector with no explicit affect dimension. Both must be built before this claim is testable, in addition to the shared GAP-B rule_state-differentiation precondition (met) and the downstream conversion-ceiling clearance (unmet).
Clinical corollary (mood-congruent decision-bias prediction) flagged for V4/clinical-substrate work, not currently V3-testable even once the above lands.

claims.claim_title: V_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated per-region by V_s freshness (the per-region staleness scalar from MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287); rules associated with stale regions receive lower arbitration trust, regardless of their reliability or practice. HIGH divergence (REE-novel per-region scope + rule-trust function): Behrens 2007 ACC volatility and Bouton 2004 contextual renewal are nearest cousins, but per-region continuous scalar + arbitration-trust routing are REE-specific. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims.falsifier_summary: Arbitration weight on stale-region rules matches fresh-region rules despite measured V_s divergence, showing freshness does not gate rule trust.
claims.required_event: Region-specific staleness induction: a previously-active region's world-state changes so its V_s ages while another region stays fresh, with rules previously deployed in both still eligible.
claims.manipulation: Rotate the reef / resource configuration so V_s ages on previously-active regions only, and toggle freshness-gated arbitration against ungated arbitration.
claims.control: No-rotation arm with matched episode length, plus a MECH-312d-OFF arm where arbitration ignores freshness, so a weight drop cannot be attributed to the rotation changing the candidate set.
claims.DV: Arbitration weight on rules derived from a region, regressed on that region's measured StalenessAccumulator value; the claim predicts a monotonic decline, with the OFF arm invariant despite the same measured V_s drift.
claims.instrument: The freshness quantity IS recorded: StalenessAccumulator (ree_core/hippocampal/staleness_accumulator.py, MECH-284) is region-indexed, leaks per tick and exposes get(region_key), lookup_by_anchor_key and snapshot(). What is missing is any route from it into arbitration weight, and any per-rule region-provenance tag.
claims.consumer_locus: The multiplicative freshness gate on a candidate rule's arbitration weight inside CandidateRuleField -- the rule-trust boundary, not the V_s representation itself and not anchor selection.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Per-region V_s staleness must actually diverge across regions within a run -- some regions aged, others fresh -- and rules must be attributable to the regions whose data formed them. If all regions age together, the freshness gradient is constant and the prediction is unreadable.
claims.blocking_reason: The staleness scalar exists and is live but reaches no consumer at the rule-arbitration locus -- candidate_rule_field.py contains no reference to V_s, freshness or staleness, and rules carry no region provenance. Separately, no reef-configuration rotation exists in ree_core/environment, so region-specific ageing cannot be induced.
false_positives: The shared 'ARC-063 not yet built' note is wrong for the whole 312 family.

claims.claim_title: simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. the claim's functional_restatement carries a second, V4-bound,

claims.claim_title: tonic_vigor_coupling (capacity-to-action-bias, average-reward-rate / LC-NE tonic / DA effort-vigor analog). Architectural commitment: behaviour-bias toward action scales with capacity (high energy AND low recent prediction error AND low drive -- 'things are going well, deploy'), independent of any specific target. Distinct from existing behavioural-source slots (z_harm threats, z_goal deficit-seeded wants, novelty curiosity) which all fall to zero when the agent is well-fed, safe, and the world is familiar. Without ARC-066 a healthy REE agent has no gradient to act; biology has a positive gradient (felt phenomenology: drive to deploy energy when one has it). First of three slots in the non_deficit_action_drives family; companion ARC-067 (idle aversion / boredom) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) cover the aversive-of-rest and cost-of-passivity halves of the same architectural commitment. Family principle: behaviour comes from surplus capacity AND from deficits, not deficits alone.

claims.claim_title: idle_aversion_boredom (sustained-low-engagement aversive valence accumulator). Distinct from the policy-side ARC-066 vigor coupling: ARC-067 instantiates an aversive-side accumulator that recruits the same downstream as actual harm (z_harm-like channel), so engagement-poverty competes for action-selection priority on the same axis as discomfort. claims.claim_title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.
claims.falsifier_summary: With preconditions met and both triggers verified to fire, the ON arm shows no measurable compression and no re-decomposition benefit -- the two operations fire individually but do not compose into the claimed cluster-level cost benefit.
claims.required_event: A long-horizon repeating task where the same sub-sequence is executed successfully many times (composition trigger) and a chunked primitive later fails to ground under induced prediction failure (decomposition trigger), within the same run.
claims.manipulation: Four cells crossing use_policy_chunking and use_policy_decomposition ON versus OFF, with the ARC-069-OFF cell as the flat-grain control and an induced-prediction-failure phase to drive re-decomposition.
claims.control: The both-OFF arm at matched seeds, episode count and task schedule, which by the claim's own prediction must still propose at single-action grain at episode 1000; plus per-trigger telemetry so a null can be attributed to a trigger that never fired.
claims.DV: Rollout cost on the repeatedly-successful sub-sequence (proposal grain and per-decision planning cost) and its recovery under induced prediction failure, reported jointly with chunk-formation and decomposition counts so the cluster-level cost benefit is separable from either trigger firing alone.

claims.claim_title: tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias (capacity-keyed E3 score-side action drive / mesolimbic-DA-vigor-analog / average-reward-rate opportunity-cost regulator). Child mechanism for ARC-066 (tonic_vigor_coupling) AND ARC-068 (opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty -- collapse into MECH-320 per ARC-068 lit-pull R3 verdict 2026-05-16; MECH-320's w_passive term IS the ARC-068 implementation). Adds a tonic vigor scalar v_t to E3 trajectory scoring as an additive bias toward action-trajectories and an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary trajectories, where v_t is a slow EWMA over the realised E3-score-receipt stream. Target-free: bias applies regardless of whether any z_goal is currently active. Distinct from MECH-313 (LC-NE noise floor -- noise on choice, orthogonal axis), MECH-216 (target-conditioned wanting), SD-012 (deficit-keyed drive, opposite coupling), and MECH-330 (ARC-067 boredom -- valence-side z_harm_a write, different architectural layer).
claims.falsifier_summary: With v_t certified live (positive scalar, non-zero bias) and selection authority on, action density shows no monotonic rise with v_t relative to the inert ARM_0 baseline -- the tonic-vigor coupling does not exist or is not load-bearing at E3.
claims.required_event: Well-fed, safe, familiar operation -- full energy, no z_goal active, familiar environment, no harm signal -- sustained long enough for the slow EWMA to accumulate a positive advantage.
claims.manipulation: Three arms: ARM_0 baseline (MECH-313 ON, MECH-320 OFF), ARM_1 MECH-320 additive, ARM_2 MECH-320 multiplicative, all with baseline_mode='ewma' so v_t is live, plus a parametric sweep of v_t against a pre-existing action preference.
claims.control: ARM_0 with MECH-313 ON only, predicted inert at the noise floor; plus a dead-scalar control arm (baseline_mode='none') to show the previously measured null reproduces and is attributable to the dead scalar.
claims.DV: Action density (fraction of committed ticks that are non-no-op) as a function of v_t, ON versus ARM_0; and, for the additive-versus-multiplicative sub-hypothesis, whether the action-vs-no-op score gap scales linearly with v_t independent of pre-existing preference or differentially under strong preference.
claims.instrument: ree_core/policy/tonic_vigor.py computes and exposes v_t and the per-candidate bias, control-vector logging carries the v_t scalar, and tonic_vigor_baseline_mode / tonic_vigor_baseline_half_life / tonic_vigor_v_t_floor are the live levers. No experiment in the corpus sets baseline_mode, and nothing is queued.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 committed selection on the action-versus-no-op axis -- vigor must change what is committed, not merely what is scored.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Selection authority on (use_modulatory_selection_authority), AND the vigor scalar demonstrably alive on the run: tonic_vigor_baseline_mode='ewma' (or a positive tonic_vigor_v_t_floor) with measured v_t > 0 and a non-zero action-vs-no-op bias recorded per arm. claims.claim_title: policy_decomposition_via_event_segmenter (rollout-side consumer of MECH-288 boundary pulses; re-segments the rollout proposal stream at finer grain when a chunk's region shows low V_s / boundary fires on the imagined trajectory). First child mechanism for ARC-070. Bidirectional extension of MECH-288 substrate (R2 lit-pull verdict 2026-05-10): MECH-288 already detects boundaries on whatever latent + PE streams it consumes; MECH-321 wires the rollout / imagination input stream into MECH-288 and consumes the resulting boundary pulses at the policy-primitive layer to decompose chunked primitives into finer-grain sub-elements. PE-driven primary trigger (V_s drop on chunk's region per Zacks 2007 / Schapiro 2017); bottleneck-state framing is a separate consolidation-phase mechanism, not the primary trigger. Recursive multi-level decomposition; depth cap 3 is an ENGINEERING choice, not a literature-derived constant (provenance corrected 2026-07-27 -- see evidence_quality_note). The MULTI-LEVEL commitment is ARC-070's R3 verdict (Badre & D'Esposito 2009) and STANDS; that source never supported a level COUNT, and Badre & Nee 2018 (Badre's own re-appraisal) finds the evidence supports neither a unitary model of lateral frontal function nor a unidimensional abstraction gradient, so there is no single ordered axis along which to cap. The cap rests instead on tractability + operator symmetry (mirrors ARC-071's chunk_max_depth so the inverse operations stay symmetric; open Q-claim on hard-vs-soft). Magnitude prior only, with an explicit grain caveat: Koechlin 2003 resolves a 3-level lateral-PFC cascade (4 with Koechlin & Summerfield 2007 frontopolar branching), but at ANATOMICAL grain -- heterogeneous, anatomically fixed control levels, NOT homogeneous recursion depth of one operator re-applying to its own output. Both pre-commit and mid-execution phases supported via the same mechanism, with downstream effects gated by MECH-094 hypothesis_tag (rollout fires under hypothesis_tag=True write nothing; observation / execution fires under hypothesis_tag=False enable the existing observation-side consumer chain unchanged).

claims.control: The rate-matched yoked arm 938 introduced (ARM_YOKED fires the same number of decompositions at PE-independent loci) plus an ARC-070 OFF baseline, with the arm-invariant abort rate held fixed.
claims.DV: Realised task harm and forward prediction error on the decomposed sub-sequences, ARM_PE minus ARM_YOKED at matched decomposition rate over >= 40 paired seeds, with the effect required to exceed the run's own 80%-power MDE rather than merely the direction being right.
claims.instrument: policy_decomposition.py evaluate() and the 938 driver record decomposition counts, boundary fires, rate-match and abort-rate controls adequately. Any future design must either (a) verify its own matching assumption empirically before trusting its C1 statistic, or (b) remove the dependence on post-hoc divergence-tick matching altogether (e.g. an unconditional whole-episode harm-rate comparison across all measurement seeds at matched abort-rate arms, as recommended by the 2026-08-05 pending-review-batch autopsy).

 caller-supplied E3-score-receipt scalar). Population variance on a span-S range
 is at most S^2/4, so at F_high = 0.45 dissolution needs S > 1.342 and S >= 2.0 is

no literature support; only the orderings are grounded (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012;

scores nothing.
 (C1) FORMATION READINESS -- ALREADY ANSWERED; DO NOT RE-DERIVE. V3-EXQ-810a and

(i) MECH-323's formation precondition met upstream; (ii) use_chunk_maintenance ON
(with it OFF, chunks form and NEVER crystallise BY CONSTRUCTION, contract
test_c7_formation_only_arm_never_crystallises, so every maintenance DV is
identically null and the run measures the flag); (iii) outcome span S >
2*sqrt(F_high) = 1.342, S >= 2.0 recommended. AT THE REGISTERED F_high = 0.45 ON A
0-1 SCALE THE CRYSTALLISED -> DISSOLVING TRANSITION IS ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE
(max population variance on span S is S^2/4 = 0.25), which takes DISSOLVED, and
with it ALL THREE RELAPSE FALSIFIERS, out of reach at the registered defaults.
Emit the reachability arithmetic as an explicit per-cell precondition.
(2) THE REVIVAL GATE MUST READ THE ISOLATED WINDOW
(use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON). With it OFF the revival gate reads
accumulator._tally[key] -- the whole-lifetime sliding window, BY CONSTRUCTION
saturated with the contaminating high-variance stream at the moment dissolution
completes. Report r_reacq/W per cell as the standing degeneracy check.
(3) OPERATOR-LEVEL, NOT AGENT-LEVEL -- AND SAY SO IN THE MANIFEST. V3-EXQ-810
measured the MECH-323 accumulator SILENT under agent control, so an agent-level run
measures that readiness gap rather than MECH-324. Evidence from a driver-level run
attaches to the OPERATOR and licenses nothing about chunk-driven behaviour; it must
not be read as evidence for ARC-071's LEG 3, which has never been queued.
(4) PERSISTENCE FLAGS SCOPED TO THE PROBE PHASE ONLY -- the V3-EXQ-871 guard.
CONFIRMING: target the ORDERINGS. F_high = 0.45, the ratio 0.45/0.15, C_min = 5,
W_maint = 100, T_dissolve = 50, N = 75 and f_reacq = 0.25 are UNCALIBRATED
ENGINEERING DEFAULTS. Barnes 2005 and Bouton 2012 establish the DIRECTION and
NEITHER quantifies any of them. A calibrated threshold quoted WITHOUT the outcome
span it was calibrated at is not interpretable.
 (C1) DUAL-OPERATOR DISSOCIATION -- the load-bearing prediction, structurally
 mirroring Smith & Graybiel 2013 IL optogenetic disruption. ARM_1 (MECH-323 on,
 MECH-324 off) vs ARM_2 (both on): chunks form at COMPARABLE RATES in both arms,
 but only ARM_2 yields crystallised, selectable chunks with the accompanying
 rollout-cost / latency signature. The formation-rate equivalence is part of the
 confirmation, not background.
 (C2) RETENTION, NOT ERASURE -- PARTIALLY ANSWERED, supports. V3-EXQ-829's C3
 discriminator held cleanly: with the dormant-state flag OFF, 12/12 dissolved cells
 stayed dead; ON, they revived. Confirms the STRUCTURE, says nothing about the RATE.
 (C3) HYSTERESIS ORDERING, measured as crossings rather than read off the config.
 Dissolution requires a strictly larger outcome-variance excursion than formation
 tolerated (F_high > F_low as MEASURED crossing points), AND takes strictly more
 trials than formation took on the same sequence in the same run. The timescale
 half is better-grounded -- Barnes 2005 is a timescale/retrievability result, not a
 variance-threshold measurement, so F_high > F_low as a variance gate is supported
 only by analogy across two constructs.
 (C4) RECOVERABILITY FROM DISSOLVING (V3-EXQ-829's C5 mild-dissolution robustness
 held).
 (C5) REPLAY-ORIGIN ASYMMETRY (MECH-322 sub-mechanism C). A replay_origin=True
 chunk uncorroborated by real waking execution retires DIRECTLY to DISSOLVED and is
 NEVER revived at the reduced bar, while an otherwise identical
 replay_origin=False chunk IS. Both halves in one run: the second half is the
 MECH-094 posture the carve-out exists to preserve.
FALSIFYING:
 (F1) RAPID REACQUISITION -- TESTABLE NOW, and the claim's own prediction has NOT
 yet been tested on the corrected substrate. FALSIFIED IF re-formation of a dormant
 chunk takes >= r_acq measured on the same run, OR if r_reacq does not order with
 f_reacq, with use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON and r_reacq/W reported.
 V3-EXQ-829 returned exactly this shape but is VOID as a verdict (DV tracked W).
 V3-EXQ-829a confirms the FIX works; it is a bug-fix confirmation, NOT a falsifier
 run. The claim's pending_retest_after_substrate flag points here.
 (F2) DUAL-OPERATOR DISSOCIATION FAILS: ARM_1 and ARM_2 yield the same
 selectable-chunk behaviour and the same rollout-cost / latency profile, OR ARM_1
 crystallises without maintenance.
 (F3) HYSTERESIS INVERTED OR ABSENT.
 (F4) RENEWAL -- NOT TESTABLE; STRUCTURALLY BLOCKED, AND THE BLOCKER IS UPSTREAM OF
 THIS CLAIM. Not expressible, and NOT for the registered reason. The registration
 locates the asymmetry as "formation is context-conditioned, dissolution is
 context-blind"; the substrate has NO asymmetry -- BOTH halves are context-blind,
 because initiation_set is declared-but-never-populated. Two traps make "just scope
 dissolution to initiation_set" a refusal rather than a deferral: Layer 1 -- scoping
 to a universally-empty set is a SILENT NO-OP that READS as renewal-capable; Layer
 2, load-bearing -- populating it from raw z_world does NOT fix it (one bucket,
 ~0.98-cosine common-mode cone). A renewal run on that substrate HAS NO CONTEXT B,
 would return FALSIFIED BY CONSTRUCTION OF THE INSTRUMENT, and that verdict would
 land against Bouton 2012's biology rather than against REE's context
 representation. Classification: puzzle (known rules).
 (F5) RESURGENCE -- NOT TESTABLE; a STRUCTURAL GAP, not a prediction this operator
 makes. Requires dissolution state SHARED ACROSS COMPETING library candidates;
 MECH-324's gate is per-chunk on its own variance, and nothing in policy_chunking.py
 implements a competition term (VERIFIED 2026-08-28). Classification: complicated
 (buildable), zero evidence either way.
TRANSFER LIMIT ON F1 / F4 / F5 -- load-bearing, not boilerplate. The sources are
rodent T-maze procedural learning (Barnes 2005) and single-response operant
contingencies (Bouton 2012). In both, the extinguished object is a SINGLE RESPONSE;
a chunk is BY CONSTRUCTION multi-element, and REE's outcome dimension is an
E3-score-receipt over policy primitives rather than a food reward. Whether a
SEQUENCE extinguishes with the same asymmetry -- and whether context-dependence of
extinction survives COMPOSITION at all -- is EXTRAPOLATION, NOT EVIDENCE.
SHARED EXPERIMENT: F1 and C2/C3/C4 are scored by the SAME chunking-lifecycle run
that scores MECH-323's C2/F1/F2. C1/F2 (the ARM_1-vs-ARM_2 dissociation) is a
SEPARATE, agent-level design and inherits the LEG-3 readiness gap -- do not bundle
it into the lifecycle run.

claims.claim_title: pfc_context_bias_as_hippocampal_retrieval_gate -- PFC active goal/task representations send top-down bias signals that steer which hippocampal trajectory templates are retrieved or replayed; different PFC context states should produce different hippocampal retrieval subsets, enabling context-appropriate behavioral option selection; without this routing, the trajectory library is queried uniformly regardless of goal state.
claims.falsifier_summary: Under witnessed non-degenerate retrieval, the proposed candidate distribution is statistically indistinguishable across contexts -- the trajectory store is queried uniformly regardless of goal state, which is the failure mode the claim names.
claims.required_event: Two or more distinct active goal or cue contexts within a run on a goal-rich environment, each followed by hippocampal candidate proposal, so the retrieved candidate sets can be compared context against context.
claims.manipulation: Cross use_differentiable_cem ON versus OFF with E3Config.use_action_object_bias_channel ON versus OFF, and contrast candidate sets proposed under different active goal or cue contexts at matched state.
claims.control: A context-shuffled arm in which the cue is mis-paired with the state at matched entropy, so any retrieval divergence is attributable to the context signal rather than to state differences or to proposal noise.
claims.DV: Cue-conditioned divergence of the proposed candidate set and of the committed action across contexts -- distributional distance between per-context candidate distributions -- not a gradient-flow statistic, which V3-EXQ-568 already established.
claims.instrument: The V3 staging path is built and validated: SD-055's softmax-weighted CEM mean restores gradient to cue_action_proj (use_differentiable_cem in hippocampal/module.py:2428, V3-EXQ-568 PASS), and a per-candidate E3 ranking channel for the cue action bias landed 2026-09-01 (compute_action_object_alignment_bias, e3_selector.py:297, called at agent.py:9353). The MECH-325 trajectory library it would retrieve from returns zero hits anywhere in ree_core.
claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal retrieval / proposal step, keyed by an active context -- the claim asserts z_goal as the key, whereas the built cue path keys on z_world through extract_cue_context.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Retrieval must be non-degenerate before divergence can be read: SD-016's parking record measures z_world queries at cosine 0.998 across batch with action_class_entropy 1.1e-10 on all arms, so a cue-conditioned retrieval contrast has nothing to separate until cross-context query variation exists. The differentiable-CEM path must also be ON, since with use_differentiable_cem False no gradient reaches cue_action_proj at all.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim's key is z_goal, but the built retrieval path is keyed on z_world through extract_cue_context, so the asserted PFC-goal bias has no route to the retrieval operation. Above that, MECH-325's trajectory library does not exist in ree_core, and the behavioural cue-divergence run SD-055 deferred has still never been queued.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT

claims.claim_title: During sensorimotor play, E1 prediction-error locus upweights probe-action selection: actions targeting high-PE regions of z_world are preferentially selected, implementing curiosity-driven exploration within the play frame.
claims.falsifier_summary: The high-PE-targeting fraction is the same inside and outside the play frame at matched terrain, which would make MECH-327 a restatement of the already-built frame-free curiosity bonus rather than a play-specific mechanism.
claims.required_event: A sensorimotor play episode in which some regions of z_world carry measurably higher prediction error than others, and probe-type actions toward those regions are available.
claims.manipulation: Play frame ON versus OFF at matched PE terrain, with the PE-driven curiosity bonus enabled in both arms -- the claim's content is the frame-conditional UPWEIGHT, not the existence of a PE bias.
claims.control: A curiosity-bonus-OFF arm (use_model_disagreement_curiosity and use_structured_curiosity both false) and a non-play episode with identical PE terrain and identical candidate sets.
claims.DV: The fraction of selected actions targeting the top-PE quantile of z_world, inside versus outside the play frame at matched terrain -- confirming requires the in-frame fraction to exceed the out-of-frame fraction, over and above the frame-free bonus effect.
claims.instrument: The bias side is instrumented -- e3_selector records last_score_diagnostics["model_disagreement_bonus_range"] (:3905) and StructuredCuriosity exposes compute_score_bias (ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py:356). The conditional cannot be formed because no play-frame tag exists anywhere in ree_core.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 action-object candidate scoring before CEM evaluation, conditioned on the frame tag -- not goal representation, which is MECH-328's territory.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two things must be non-degenerate. The PE terrain over z_world must vary across regions, and the curiosity bias must have live dynamic range at selection (the recorded model_disagreement_bonus_range must be non-zero) so the bias is not swamped inside the E3 argmin. A play frame that can be switched on and off is the third, missing, requirement.
claims.blocking_reason: The PE-weighted exploration bonus is BUILT and reaches E3 scoring; what is missing is the play frame that makes this claim distinct from MECH-441 and MECH-314. false_positives: The claim note that PE-weighted probe-action selection is "missing / flagged as DEV-NEED" overstates the absence -- MECH-441 model-disagreement curiosity and MECH-314 structured curiosity both compute a PE/uncertainty-weighted per-candidate bonus that reaches E3 scoring.
