claims.claim_title: During sensorimotor and constructive play, is a persistent background signal (L2) sufficient for frame integrity monitoring, or are explicit mid-episode repair signals (L3) also required?
claims.falsifier_summary: L2-only shows no significant increase in frame-collapse rate versus L2+L3 under perturbation, below an absolute floor on at least 2 of 3 seeds -- the persistent background signal suffices for low-ambiguity play.
claims.required_event: A sensorimotor or constructive play episode carrying a persistent play frame, interrupted mid-episode by a contingency break (partner stops responding for k ticks) or a brief compositional-goal violation.
claims.manipulation: Ablate the L3 mid-episode repair signal -- arm 1 L2 background play_frame_tag only, arm 2 L2 plus L3 repair -- with perturbation strength swept.
claims.control: The L2+L3 arm under the same perturbation schedule, matched on seeds, perturbation timing and episode length.
claims.DV: Frame-collapse rate (fraction of episodes where the play frame drops and is not re-established) and time-to-recovery, as a function of perturbation strength.
claims.instrument: Absent. There is no play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, ambiguity_threshold or L3 repair signal anywhere in ree_core (re-confirmed by direct source search, recorded in INV-059's what_would_answer), so neither the DV nor the manipulation has a recorder.
claims.consumer_locus: Play-frame maintenance across an episode -- a bilateral context tag co-maintained by agent and partner (ARC-049), not the MECH-094 hypothesis tag.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The perturbation must genuinely stress frame integrity: the L2+L3 arm must itself show non-zero frame-collapse and recovery events, otherwise there is nothing to repair and the L2-only arm trivially matches it.
claims.blocking_reason: Neither the manipulated signal nor the measured one exists. The L1/L2/L3 play-frame architecture is unimplemented in ree_core, and the partner-contingency perturbation needs a second agent -- ARC-047 SocialGridWorld is candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5, and ree_core/environment holds only causal_grid_world.py.
false_positives: The claim's description asserts 'V3-tractable: ablate L3 signals during simple play episodes'; the ablatable signal does not exist in the substrate, so the tractability note is a plan, not a state.
claims.auditor_notes: The compositional-goal-violation half of the perturbation is single-agent scriptable and would fit ARC-049's own V3-degenerate slice (experimenter-scripted signal, testing whether the tag is load-bearing for the agent's OWN policy); the partner-contingency half is not. No substrate_queue entry exists for any play substrate -- ARC-049/MECH-194/INV-058 own the design as CLAIMS only. A single queue entry for the ARC-049 play-frame tag channel would connect Q-048, Q-049, MECH-198 and INV-059 at once; flagged for the coordinator rather than proposed here, since the design already has an owner.
claims.what_would_answer:
Ablate the L3 mid-episode repair signal during simple (sensorimotor /
constructive) play episodes and measure frame-integrity under perturbation.
Arms: (1) L2 background play_frame_tag only (L3 repair OFF); (2) L2 + L3
repair ON. Perturb mid-episode (partner stops contingent responding for k
ticks, or the compositional goal is briefly violated) and measure
frame-collapse rate (fraction of episodes where play_frame_tag drops and is
not re-established) plus time-to-recovery. ANSWER 'L2 sufficient for simple
play' if the L2-only arm shows no significant increase in frame-collapse rate
vs L2+L3 under perturbation (delta below an absolute floor, >=2/3 seeds) --
the persistent background signal alone holds the frame for low-ambiguity
content. ANSWER 'L3 also required' if L2-only collapses (or fails to recover)
significantly more often than L2+L3, with the gap scaling on perturbation
strength. HARD PRECONDITION: the perturbation must actually stress frame
integrity -- the L2+L3 arm must itself show non-zero collapse/recovery events
under perturbation, else the test is vacuous (nothing to repair) and routes to
a stronger-perturbation re-design rather than a 'sufficient' verdict.

claims.claim_title: Does pretend play require the hypothesis tag (MECH-094) and play frame tag (ARC-049) to be continuously co-active throughout the episode, or do they merely need to be co-active at the moment of object substitution?
claims.falsifier_summary: Event-only matches continuous on both false-commit rate and pretend-policy quality -- the co-tag is needed only at the substitution moment.
claims.required_event: A pretend-play episode requiring object substitution, perturbed by reality intrusions and competing literal-use affordances.
claims.manipulation: Two co-tag regimes -- CONTINUOUS (hypothesis_tag and play_frame_tag held co-active every step) versus EVENT-ONLY (co-active only at the moment of substitution, allowed to lapse between events).
claims.control: Matched pretend episodes across the two regimes with identical seeds, substitution schedule and perturbation schedule.
claims.DV: False-commit rate (committing to the literal, non-pretend interpretation when the pretend frame should hold) and pretend-policy quality, at 1 SD-of-delta with an absolute floor on at least 2 of 3 seeds.
claims.instrument: Half present. MECH-094 hypothesis_tag is live (LatentState.hypothesis_tag, gating update_z_goal, the MECH-219 accumulator and the blocked-agency regulator), but play_frame_tag does not exist in ree_core and there is no substitution-event detector or false-commit recorder.
claims.consumer_locus: The decoupling operator at commitment -- whether suspension of reference, truth and existence relations must be held continuously or only re-asserted at each substitution.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both tags must be operative and the substitution event detectable in the trace with non-zero co-tag activation; the event-only arm must actually drop co-activity between substitution events, otherwise the two arms are identical and the test is vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: One of the two co-active tags is missing. hypothesis_tag is live and already gates several regulators, but play_frame_tag / frame_open / frame_close have zero occurrences in ree_core, so no co-tag regime can be configured and no object-substitution event or false-commit can be recorded.
false_positives: The claim's description calls this V3-tractable via 'compare policy quality under continuous co-tag vs event-only co-tag'; only one of the two tags exists in the substrate, so the comparison cannot currently be configured.
claims.auditor_notes: Q-049 is strictly cheaper to unblock than Q-048: it needs no partner, only the play_frame_tag channel plus a scripted object-substitution event, both single-agent. MECH-198 (candidate) is the claim that asserts the co-operation of the two tags and is the natural owner of any build. Same missing substrate_queue node as Q-048 -- avoid minting two.
claims.what_would_answer:
Compare two co-tag regimes for pretend play in V3: (1) CONTINUOUS co-tag --
hypothesis_tag (MECH-094) and play_frame_tag (ARC-049) held co-active for
every step of the pretend episode; (2) EVENT-ONLY co-tag -- the two tags
co-active only at the moment of object substitution, otherwise allowed to
lapse. Run matched pretend episodes requiring object substitution under
perturbation (reality intrusions, competing literal-use affordances) and
measure policy quality and false-commit rate (committing to the
literal/non-pretend interpretation when the pretend frame should hold). ANSWER
'continuous co-tag required' if the event-only arm shows a significantly
higher false-commit rate or degraded pretend-policy quality (>=1 SD-of-delta,
absolute floor, >=2/3 seeds), i.e. the decoupling lapses between substitution
events and reference/truth/existence relations leak back. ANSWER 'event-only
sufficient' if event-only matches continuous on false-commit and policy
quality. HARD PRECONDITION: both tags must be operative and the substitution
event must be detectable in the trace (non-zero co-tag activation at
substitution); if the event-only arm never actually drops co-activity between
events the two arms are identical and the test is vacuous.

claims.claim_title: Do games-with-rules require per-step dual-level content monitoring (rule compliance + strategic rationality simultaneously), or does sequential sampling across turns suffice?
claims.falsifier_summary: Interleaved sampling matches per-step detection latency and accuracy across all three violation types at matched compute -- answering sequential sampling suffices.
claims.required_event: A turn-structured game episode in which a partner agent emits violations of three kinds -- rule-only, strategy-only, and both -- at a controlled alternation rate.
claims.manipulation: Monitor architecture: per-step dual-level scoring (both levels every turn) versus sequential sampling that interleaves the two levels across turns, matched for total monitoring compute.
claims.control: Matched-compute sequential-sampling arm plus a no-monitor baseline; violation type, base rate and alternation rate held fixed across arms.
claims.DV: Detection latency (turns from violation to flagged) and detection accuracy per violation type, specifically on the level the sequential arm was not sampling at that turn.
claims.instrument: Absent at every layer. There is no multi-agent episode loop, no partner-move generator, no rule-compliance or strategic-rationality scorer, and therefore no per-turn violation-detection recorder anywhere in ree-v3.
claims.consumer_locus: The per-turn monitoring/appraisal boundary inside a two-party game frame -- not episode reward, and not any single-agent appraisal path V3 already has.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A genuine second agent whose moves can be rule-legal but strategically irrational (and vice versa) must exist, so that rule-compliance and strategic-rationality violations are dissociable. Verified absent: ree_core/environment/ holds exactly one environment (causal_grid_world.py) and ree_core/ contains no other_agent, partner or multi_agent machinery at all.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 has one single-agent gridworld and no play-frame substrate, so it cannot generate a strategically irrational partner move at all. The contrast is vacuous by construction, exactly as the claim's own hard precondition states.
claims.auditor_notes: ARC-047 (SocialGridWorld, implementation_phase v5, candidate) is the only registered multi-agent substrate node; ARC-049/MECH-197 own the play frame. Nothing connects Q-050 to a build node, so the edge is missing rather than the node.
claims.what_would_answer:
In a multi-agent games-with-rules environment, contrast a per-step dual-level
monitor (rule-compliance AND strategic-rationality scored every turn, Schmidt
2015) against a sequential-sampling monitor (the two levels interleaved across
turns, not simultaneous). Introduce partner moves that violate ONLY rules,
ONLY strategic rationality, and both. ANSWER "per-step dual-level required" if
the sequential-sampling arm misses or lags on violations that fall on the
level it is not currently sampling -- detection latency or accuracy strictly
worse on mixed/fast-alternating violations -- while the per-step arm catches
them. ANSWER "sequential sampling suffices" if interleaved sampling matches
per-step detection across violation types. HARD PRECONDITION: a genuine
multi-agent substrate that GENERATES strategic violations is required (a
partner that can defect or play irrationally). The V3 degenerate case is an
experimenter-complicit environment that never produces strategic violations,
so neither level can be stressed and the contrast is vacuous (depends_on
ARC-049 / MECH-197 play substrate, Q-035). Wait for the planned upstream V4
multi-agent substrate; suggested_experiment_type multi_agent_behavioral.

claims.claim_title: Does cooperative play require a continuous bilateral background signal (L2) plus explicit repair at ambiguity (L3), or do one-sided frame-open/close events (L1 only) suffice for cooperative frame maintenance?
claims.falsifier_summary: One-sided open/close events maintain bilateral alignment and cooperative performance as well as the full stack across role-switches -- answering L1 suffices.
claims.required_event: A cooperative episode with scripted role-switch points and injected frame ambiguity, in which one party's frame state can diverge from the other's.
claims.manipulation: Three-level ablation of frame-maintenance machinery: L1-only one-sided open/close events; L1+L2 adding a continuous bilateral background signal; L1+L2+L3 adding explicit repair at ambiguity from both parties.
claims.control: A no-frame baseline (neither party asserts a frame), so mismatch can be scored against absence rather than only against the full stack, per Ham 2024.
claims.DV: Cooperative task performance and measured frame-alignment between the two parties across role-switch and ambiguity points, plus alignment recovery following a repair event.
claims.instrument: Absent. There is no frame-state representation for either party, no bilateral alignment metric, and no repair-event recorder in ree-v3.
claims.consumer_locus: The bilateral frame-maintenance channel between two agents, at the role-switch and ambiguity boundaries -- not a single agent's internal mode flag.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two parties must each be able to assert, hold and repair a play frame and to swap roles, so that a one-sided assertion can produce a genuine bilateral mismatch. Verified absent: no multi-agent or role-switching machinery exists in ree_core, and the only environment is the single-agent causal_grid_world.py.
claims.blocking_reason: The bilateral mismatch this test needs cannot be generated by a single-agent substrate; INV-059 itself frames unilateral assertion as manipulation rather than as a weaker frame. No second party, no role switch, no frame state exists in V3.
claims.auditor_notes: Same missing edge as Q-050: ARC-047 is the registered v5 multi-agent node and nothing links either question to it. Q-050 and Q-051 should be scheduled together on whatever substrate lands, since they share the whole environment build.
claims.what_would_answer:
In a cooperative-play environment with role-switching across extended
episodes, ablate the frame-maintenance machinery to three levels: L1-only
(one-sided open/close frame events), L1+L2 (add a continuous bilateral
background signal), and L1+L2+L3 (add explicit repair at ambiguity from both
parties). Inject frame ambiguity and role-switch points. ANSWER "full L1+L2+L3
required" if the L1-only arm produces frame mismatch that degrades cooperation
worse than no-frame baseline (Ham 2024: mismatch is worse than absence) while
the L2/L3 arm recovers, AND repair events at ambiguity measurably restore
alignment. ANSWER "L1 suffices" if one-sided open/close events maintain
bilateral alignment as well as the full stack across role-switches. HARD
PRECONDITION: bilateral role/goal-state monitoring requires a multi-agent
substrate with two parties that each assert and repair frames and that can
role-switch -- INV-059 frames unilateral assertion as manipulation, so a
single-agent or experimenter-complicit V3 env cannot generate the bilateral
mismatch the test needs (vacuous). Wait for the planned upstream V4
multi-agent substrate (depends_on ARC-049 / MECH-197 / INV-059 / Q-035).

claims.claim_title: The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.
claims.falsifier_summary: Monostrategy/V_s collapse persists in the WITH arm at levels statistically indistinguishable from WITHOUT despite all preconditions holding -- routing the root cause back to the MECH-439/INV-088/MECH-457 cluster and folding ARC-074 into that disposition.
claims.required_event: A reward-free pre-scoring epoch in which the agent acts with E3 weighting suppressed, so that Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, z_self structure and residue heterogeneity accumulate before any scored selection occurs.
claims.manipulation: Two-arm A/B on training-phase ordering: WITH a reward-free Phase 0 epoch preceding E3 activation versus WITHOUT (E3 scoring active from step 0, the current default), diversity parameters held at existing validated settings.
claims.control: Matched seeds, matched total step budget and identical config apart from the ordering; plus the non-degeneracy check that diversity-channel activation is non-zero in both arms so a null cannot be blamed on an inert diversity stack.
claims.DV: Residue entropy and per-candidate E3-score variance measured at and after Phase 1 onset, and the size of the diversity-mechanism effect (monostrategy/V_s collapse rate) in the WITH arm relative to the WITHOUT arm.
claims.instrument: The DV side is largely present -- residue coverage and entropy telemetry landed as infant_substrate GAP-5/GAP-6, and residue field statistics are exposed in ree_core/residue/field.py. The MANIPULATION side is absent: nothing can suppress E3 weighting for an initial epoch or gate exit on the two named criteria.
claims.consumer_locus: The training-phase ordering boundary before E3 scoring is first applied -- the cold-start residue field feeding candidate scoring, not the downstream selection or representation layers the F-dominance cluster already localises.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Phase0Config must exist and be wired ahead of E3 activation with both gate criteria live, the criteria must separate fresh-init from Phase-0-completed agents, ARC-065's diversity channels must be non-zero in BOTH arms, and the task must be confirmed solvable. Verified FAILING on the first: grep of ree_core returns zero hits for Phase0Config, residue_entropy_min, z_self_loss_max and motor babbling machinery.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate the required event: there is no way to suppress E3 weighting for an initial epoch, no Hebbian pre-training loop, and no gate on residue_entropy_min / z_self_loss_max. EXQ-ISEF-006 has never been queued, and the DV instrumentation alone cannot substitute for the missing manipulation.
false_positives: experiments/infant_curriculum.py defines an InfantCurriculumScheduler with its own 'Phase 0' gated on H_pos crossing counts. That is a DIFFERENT construct: E3 scoring is active throughout it, there is no Hebbian pre-training and no residue_entropy/z_self_loss gate, so it must not be read as ARC-074 already being built.
claims.auditor_notes: Name collision risk for the coordinator: 'Phase 0' means two different things in this registry. ARC-074 has no substrate_queue entry despite a fully specified implementation (Phase0Config fields, two gate criteria, error-on-gate-failure), so the missing edge is claim-to-build-node.
claims.what_would_answer:
CROSS-REFERENCE (mandatory reading before any retest is queued): this claim's mechanism is NOT an independent discovery. It is a candidate fifth locus in the registry's existing conversion-ceiling / monostrategy investigation (MECH-439 F-dominance, INV-088 representation-ceiling, MECH-457 competence-floor/actor-critic). That campaign has run 20+ confirmed experiments against a substrate where E3 is ALREADY ACTIVE and found the diversity-mechanism failure structural and downstream of selection (F-dominance) or attributable to representation under-differentiation in an already-training z_world (INV-088) or to action-learning-machinery failure independent of representation (MECH-457) -- NONE of which manipulate the pre-E3, pre-training period ARC-074 targets. INV-088's own memory record already proposes an untested "differentiate-first" ordering prediction structurally identical in shape to ARC-074's Phase 0, for z_world rather than the residue field specifically. ARC-074 should be read as sharpening/extending that untested ordering prediction to the residue field and to the very start of training, NOT as a rediscovery of the F-dominance or competence-floor findings, and NOT as something those findings already settle.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any A/B result is treated as informative): (i) Phase0Config is actually implemented and wired ahead of E3 activation (epoch_steps, hebbian_lr, residue_entropy_min, z_self_loss_max gate criteria; Phase 0 skipped only on warm-start checkpoint load; gate failure within epoch_steps raises a training error) -- not a stub or no-op default. (ii) The gate criteria genuinely discriminate a trained vs. untrained state -- residue_entropy and z_self encoder loss must show real separation between fresh-init and Phase-0-completed agents. (iii) ARC-065's diversity mechanisms (MECH-313/314/320) are genuinely exercised downstream in both arms -- confirm non-zero diversity-channel activation in both arms so a null result cannot be attributed to the diversity stack being silently inert for an unrelated reason. (iv) The environment/task used is confirmed solvable (an oracle/greedy baseline clears the floor).
CONFIRMING (2-arm A/B, WITH-Phase-0 vs WITHOUT, diversity params at existing validated settings): E3 scores measurably differentiate once Phase 0 completes (residue_entropy and per-candidate E3-score variance both rise from step-0 baseline) AND the WITH-Phase-0 arm shows a measurable, non-degenerate diversity-mechanism effect the WITHOUT arm does not, under matched seeds/config.
FALSIFYING: monostrategy/V_s collapse persists in the WITH-Phase-0 arm at statistically indistinguishable levels from WITHOUT, despite the non-degeneracy preconditions holding. This would mean the root cause is NOT cold-start residue-field flatness but lies where the existing MECH-439/INV-088/MECH-457 cluster already localizes it -- in which case ARC-074 should be folded into that cluster's disposition rather than treated as a separate open front, and EXQ-ISEF-006's warm-start gate calibration should not be attempted on this substrate.
A partial result -- Phase 0's own gate met but E3 scores still fail to differentiate once Phase 1 begins -- is itself diagnostic: the ordering fix would be necessary but not sufficient, and should route to the F-dominance/representation-ceiling cluster rather than to a Phase0Config parameter retune.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: Phase0Config confirmed UNBUILT (zero hits across ree-v3/ree_core for Phase0Config/hebbian/phase_0/residue_entropy_min/z_self_loss_max outside an unrelated MECH-094/ARC-108 Hebbian eligibility-trace mechanism). EXQ-ISEF-006 has never been queued or run (absent from experiment_queue.json, evidence/, and git log -S on ree-v3).

claims.claim_title: The wanting system (mesolimbic dopamine / approach motivation) seeds z_goal anchors via accidental benefit contacts before the liking system (hedonic evaluation) is calibrated -- producing a first wave of super-ordinal goals shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference.
claims.falsifier_summary: Anchor composition is indistinguishable between wanting-first and liking-first once counts are matched, or the adult hierarchy is unaffected by removing the Phase 0 accidental-contact window -- the ordering carries no consequence for what the hierarchy contains.
claims.required_event: A phase-gated developmental run in which approach drive (z_goal seeding) is active before hedonic evaluation is calibrated, and accidental benefit contacts occur during that window.
claims.manipulation: Schedule contrast on the ORDER of system onset -- wanting_first (z_goal seeding active in the child window, benefit_eval delayed) versus liking_first (the reverse) versus both_delayed as the write-path positive control.
claims.control: both_delayed forced-feed arm establishing that writes fire when the substrate is fed, and a matched-seed liking_first arm so anchor formation under calibrated preference is the comparator rather than an empty store.
claims.DV: Not anchor COUNT alone. The distinguishing quantity is the CONTENT of the first wave: the fraction of child-phase anchors whose write was triggered by approach-drive proximity rather than by a calibrated benefit evaluation, and the downstream adult consequence (goal-hierarchy occupancy and adult seeding rate) when Phase 0 contacts are removed.
claims.instrument: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory.get_state exposes only aggregates -- n_writes, n_reinforce, n_allocate, n_occupied, last_salience, last_complexity. There is no per-anchor provenance record of WHICH drive triggered each write, so the 669 line can only score counts and a complexity percentile, which is what it does.
claims.consumer_locus: The child-phase write gate in REEAgent.update_z_goal (the MECH-189 salience-and-complexity conjunction), and the resulting composition of the adult goal hierarchy.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The write path must fire at all (both_delayed positive control forming anchors and writes), the wanting-schedule manipulation must take, and the anchor store must not saturate at one slot. All three were MET in V3-EXQ-669c (19 anchors and 550 writes in the control, max_anchor_count 64 across arms), so the SD-077 context-diversity ceiling that made this claim unmeasurable is lifted.
claims.blocking_reason: The substrate is built and now demonstrably non-degenerate, but the only experiment line scores anchor COUNT and a p01 complexity percentile. Neither addresses the claim's actual content -- that the FIRST WAVE is shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference -- and the anchor store records no per-write provenance, so composition cannot be scored without new telemetry.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: epistemic_category substrate_ceiling is stale: SD-077 lifted the merge-similarity collapse on 2026-07-21 and V3-EXQ-669c met R1, R2 and R3 with non_degenerate true, so the ceiling reading no longer describes the substrate.

669c's per-claim 'weakens' rests on C3 (p01 complexity) failing at 1/3 seeds while C1 passed 3/3; it weakens the complexity-percentile operationalisation, not the ordering claim's content, which was never measured.
claims.auditor_notes: Shares its instrumentation gap with MECH-189: one addition -- record per-write provenance (triggering drive, context id) and per-seed retrieved slot -- serves the open leg of both claims. INF-ENV-003 (transient benefit patches) is already implemented, so the Phase-0-removal arm needs no new environment work.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The write path must fire at all (both_delayed positive control forming anchors and writes), the wanting-schedule manipulation must take, and the anchor store must not saturate at one slot. All three were MET in V3-EXQ-669c (19 anchors and 550 writes in the control, max_anchor_count 64 across arms), so the SD-077 context-diversity ceiling that made this claim unmeasurable is lifted.
CONFIRMING: Anchors laid down in the wanting-first window are predominantly approach-triggered and survive the write freeze, and removing Phase 0 contacts (transient benefit patches off) leaves the adult store structurally empty relative to the wanting-first arm. There is no per-anchor provenance record of WHICH drive triggered each write, so the 669 line can only score counts and a complexity percentile, which is what it does. Consumer / boundary: The child-phase write gate in REEAgent.update_z_goal (the MECH-189 salience-and-complexity conjunction), and the resulting composition of the adult goal hierarchy. Existing ownership: MECH-189, SD-077, INF-ENV-003, EXP-0081, SD-049-PHASE-2.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate is built and now demonstrably non-degenerate, but the only experiment line scores anchor COUNT and a p01 complexity percentile. Neither addresses the claim's actual content -- that the FIRST WAVE is shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference -- and the anchor store records no per-write provenance, so composition cannot be scored without new telemetry. claims.claim_title: idle_aversion_acute_restlessness_accumulator (engagement-rate-keyed aversive accumulator on z_harm_a / affective stream at the acute timescale ~minutes/tens-of-episodes. First child mechanism for ARC-067. Routes boredom-aversive through SD-011 affective harm stream / AIC analog per Danckert 2018 AIC-deactivation under boredom and Wilson 2014 Science self-shock exchangeability with physical pain. Three-input executive-engagement-rate estimator: commit transitions per episode, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate; novel-observation count dropped as primary input (van Tilburg 2017 meaning-seeking not stimulation-seeking). MAC meaning-component adds a parallel secondary channel via existing z_goal substrate (SD-012 / MECH-308). Cross-talk to MECH-331: sustained MECH-330 activation without discharge seeds the chronic frontostriatal effort-allocation substrate.)
claims.falsifier_summary: Action density in the ON arm is indistinguishable from the noise floor, or matches the yoked-constant arm, which would mean the engagement-rate keying carries no behavioural content and boredom is better treated as one more generic action-pressure term.
claims.required_event: A sustained idle period in which the engagement-rate estimate (commit transitions, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate) falls below threshold, followed by a discharge event (a commit transition or residue-write spike).
claims.manipulation: ARC-067 OFF versus MECH-330 ON (the engagement-rate-keyed accumulator writing w_boredom * boredom_t into z_harm_a), with e_threshold and H_acute pre-registered.
claims.control: The ARC-067-OFF arm at the MECH-313 noise floor, plus a yoked arm in which an equal-magnitude constant is written to z_harm_a irrespective of engagement rate, which separates the aversive write from its engagement keying.
claims.DV: Action density time-locked to the boredom_t threshold crossing -- rising specifically after crossing and not before -- together with the decay of action density after a discharge event, both measured against the yoked-constant control.
claims.instrument: Absent end to end. There is no boredom, idle_aversion or engagement_rate symbol anywhere in ree_core; the three named inputs are not composed into a windowed rate estimator, and no recorder emits boredom_t. The sibling pure-arithmetic modules that fix the build pattern do exist (policy/noise_floor.py for MECH-313, policy/tonic_vigor.py for MECH-320), as does the z_harm_a affective stream and its E3 consumption path.
claims.consumer_locus: The z_harm_a affective-harm stream write, feeding E3 scoring through the same channel physical harm uses -- deliberately not the SD-037 broadcast override and not the score-side vigor or noise layers.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The environment must be able to hold the agent in a genuinely low-engagement state -- well fed, safe, familiar, no active z_goal -- for long enough to integrate over H_acute, while leaving action available; and the always-on action-pressure sources (MECH-313 noise floor, MECH-320 tonic vigor, structured curiosity) must be held fixed across arms so any action-density change is attributable to the boredom channel.
claims.blocking_reason: The mechanism is unbuilt and unowned: no accumulator, no engagement-rate estimator, no boredom_t recorder, and no substrate_queue entry for ARC-067 at all (the queue holds ARC-066 tonic vigor only). Neither the ON arm nor the DV can be produced.
false_positives: The idle environment is not the blocker: hazard-free, resource-satiated long-horizon fishtank configurations already exist, so the required regime is reachable once the mechanism and its recorder exist.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: A measurable engagement-rate signal and a defined discharge event, so that any boredom accumulator can be keyed to something observable and its behavioural effect time-locked.

claims.claim_title: Nociceptive attenuation on z_harm_s is implemented by two mechanistically dissociable parallel pathways: (1) per-step efference-copy comparator (MECH-256/SD-029, spinal/cortical substrate, triggered by a_actual) and (2) commitment-gated PAG/RVM precision suppression (SD-021, PAG/RVM substrate, triggered by committed-trajectory state). Their substrates and triggers are independent; their attenuation effects are additive.
claims.falsifier_summary: Any one of: D1 collapsing to the ARM_NEITHER level with Pathway 1 ablated; D2 below 1.15 on a seed clearing the event-balance gate; either signature metric degrading by more than 0.15 when the other pathway is co-active; or z_harm_a attenuated in A-ON arms.
claims.required_event: Sustained committed traversal of expected harm (beta gate elevated) together with a balanced mix of agent-caused and externally-imposed hazard transitions in the same run.
claims.manipulation: Four-arm 2x2 on Factor E (use_e2_harm_s_forward) x Factor A (use_aic_analog + harm_descending_mod_enabled), both A knobs set by direct attribute assignment on the constructed config because REEConfig.from_dims silently drops undeclared kwargs, and the commit bar armed so the gate can fire.

claims.DV: Three paired contrasts on pre-registered thresholds: z_harm_s_ratio across A-ON arms (D1), self_other_discrimination_ratio across E-ON arms (D2), and each pathway's own signature metric measured with the other co-active versus absent (D3 independence, not summed gain).

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four gates; all four must be recorded in the manifest as MEASURED values, and the first is the one both prior runs silently failed).

(P0) REALISED-CONFIG PROOF, not declared flags. V3-EXQ-878 and 878a both recorded `harm_descending_mod_enabled: true` per arm while the live config held `False`, because `REEConfig.from_dims()` silently drops undeclared kwargs and whole sub-config objects. Any run scored against this claim MUST (i) set both Pathway-2 knobs by attribute assignment on the returned config (`config.harm_descending_mod_enabled = True`, `config.heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable = True`) -- the idiom `v3_exq_325a_sd021_descending_pain_modulation.py:130-133` already uses -- and (ii) read the values back off the constructed config and emit those read-back values, not the intended flags dict. Additionally: `ARM_BOTH` and `ARM_E2_ONLY` must differ on at least one Pathway-2-sensitive quantity (e.g. `z_harm_s_mean_uncommitted`). A bit-identical ARM_BOTH/ARM_E2_ONLY pair is not a null result -- it is proof the A factor is inert, and it self-routes `substrate_not_ready`.

(P1) COMMITMENT LIVE (inherited -- see MECH-090's own `what_would_answer` for the persistent-handle / object-identity precondition; do not re-derive). `n_committed_steps >= 8` in every A=ON arm on at least 2 of 3 seeds, AND `z_harm_s_mean_committed > 0`. In V3-EXQ-878 the reported `z_harm_s_ratio = 1.0` in every arm was a fabricated 0/0 (`z_harm_s_mean_committed = 0.0`, `n_committed_steps = 0`), not a measured null.

(P2) EVENT BALANCE, ENFORCED AS A GATE (inherited -- this is SD-029's C0/C2 precondition; see SD-029's own `what_would_answer` for why it has been the binding constraint for 13+ runs, and do not re-derive it). Per seed, per E=ON arm: `n_agent_caused_trials >= 6` AND `n_env_caused_trials >= 6`, AND `residual_agent_caused_mean > 1e-3`. This must gate `d2_pass`, not merely be recorded beside it: V3-EXQ-878 seed 13 had `n_agent_caused_trials = 0`, whose `self_other_discrimination_ratio = residual_env / max(1e-6, residual_agent)` evaluated to 1.8e5 and trivially cleared the 1.15 floor, scoring `d2_pass: true` vacuously.

(P3) HARM CHANNEL LIVE AND NON-SATURATED (the precondition shared across the z_harm_s / z_harm_a family; see MECH-219's `what_would_answer` for the dynamic-range wording and SD-011's for the regime-declaration requirement). The run must declare `harm_history_len`, `use_gabaergic_decay`, and `limb_damage_enabled`, and z_harm_s must show nonzero variance across both the committed/uncommitted partition and the agent-caused/env-caused partition. A flat or saturated z_harm_s makes both `z_harm_s_ratio` and `self_other_discrimination_ratio` fabricated quantities regardless of how the flags landed.

CONFIRMING (thresholds pre-registered in V3-EXQ-878; PASS on >= 2 of 3 seeds). Four-arm 2x2 on Factor E (`use_e2_harm_s_forward`) x Factor A (`use_aic_analog` + `harm_descending_mod_enabled`), arms ARM_BOTH / ARM_E2_ONLY / ARM_AIC_ONLY / ARM_NEITHER, identical arena and curriculum across arms:
- D1 (Pathway 2 works without Pathway 1): `|z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] - z_harm_s_ratio[BOTH]| <= 0.20` AND both `<= z_harm_s_ratio[NEITHER] - 0.03`. That is: commitment-gated attenuation of z_harm_s appears whether or not the efference-copy forward model is trained, and is near-equal in magnitude with and without it.
- D2 (Pathway 1 works without Pathway 2): `|self_other[E2_ONLY] - self_other[BOTH]| <= 0.60` AND both `>= 1.15`. That is: the residual `z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual)` is measurably smaller on agent-caused than on externally-caused hazard transitions, with the descending pathway entirely absent -- and the Shergill-2003 partial, graded pattern, not binary abolition (this is the same discriminator SD-029's CONFIRMING clause states; a near-total attenuation falsifies there and here).
- D3 (independence / non-interference, NOT literal additivity): `z_harm_s_ratio[BOTH] <= z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] + 0.15` AND `self_other[BOTH] >= self_other[E2_ONLY] - 0.15`. That is: each pathway's own signature metric survives undegraded when the other is co-active. No summed-gain number is claimed or measured, because Pathway 1 is not a gain on z_harm_s at all -- it is a prediction residual consumed by the MECH-276 attribution buffer, while only Pathway 2 multiplies z_harm in `agent.sense()`.
- SELECTIVITY (from SD-021's already-drafted falsifier, cross-referenced not re-derived): z_harm_a must remain unattenuated in every A=ON arm. Attenuating both streams is the Hofbauer-2001 violation SD-021 already names.

FALSIFYING (any one, with P0-P3 all met -- otherwise the run is non_contributory, not a refutation):
- D1 fails: with Pathway 1 ablated, z_harm_s attenuation during committed traversal collapses to the ARM_NEITHER level (`z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] > z_harm_s_ratio[NEITHER] - 0.03`). Pathway 2 is then not independent -- it requires the forward model, and there is one pathway with two triggers, not two pathways.
- D2 fails: with Pathway 2 ablated, `self_other[E2_ONLY] < 1.15` on a seed whose event counts clear P2. Self/other discrimination on z_harm_s then depends on descending modulation, again collapsing the two pathways into one.
- D3 fails: either signature metric degrades by more than 0.15 when the other pathway is co-active -- one pathway crowds out or overwrites the other, refuting independence directly (this is the falsification most likely to be informative, since it is the only one of the three that cannot be produced by a mis-wired ablation).
- SELECTIVITY fails: z_harm_a is also attenuated in A=ON arms.

NOT falsifying, and this is the load-bearing exclusion: a bit-identical or near-identical pair of arms that differ only in flags proven un-landed at P0. Both existing MECH-332 runs (V3-EXQ-878 2026-08-03, V3-EXQ-878a 2026-08-08) fail P0 on measurement and are `non_contributory` for that reason, over and above the `n_committed_steps = 0` reason their autopsies recorded.

claims.claim_title: Staggered ventral->dorsal commitment-loop calibration windows: the three commitment loops do not share a single critical period. Their calibration windows are staggered ventral->dorsal -- the limbic/value loop (ventral striatum / OFC) opens earliest and is the most environmentally sensitive, the associative loop next, the sensorimotor loop last -- with region-specific consolidation latencies (a calibration can be induced during a window but only expressed after it closes).
claims.falsifier_summary: Calibration outcome is invariant to window order and to staggering versus sharing, which would make ARC-076's single-window treatment sufficient and reduce this claim to a biological description with no REE consequence.
claims.required_event: A staged developmental run in which each loop's plasticity window opens and closes at a different phase, followed by a post-window probe.
claims.manipulation: Per-loop plasticity windows: freeze and unfreeze each learning channel's parameters (and apply the MECH-334 EWC anchor per channel) on a staggered schedule -- value/E3 channel first, then associative, then sensorimotor -- versus a single shared window, which is what crystallize_at_phase3 currently implements.
claims.control: The single-shared-window arm (current infant_curriculum phase-3 crystallization) and a reversed-order arm, with total plasticity budget per channel equalised across arms.
claims.DV: Per-loop calibration quality measured AFTER each window closes -- the post-critical-period expression test -- so an induced-but-unexpressed calibration is detectable; plus the order-dependence of final calibration across the forward, reversed and shared schedules.
claims.instrument: Partially present: MECH-334's EWC anchor and ewc_penalty plus crystallize_at_phase3 give a global window, and experiments/infant_curriculum.py provides the phase structure. Missing: per-channel window control and any post-window per-loop expression readout, so latent consolidation cannot currently be separated from no calibration.
claims.consumer_locus: The plasticity schedule over the three learning channels, not the within-episode commitment decision; the claim's content is the ORDER of the windows and the lag between induction and expression.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The three commitment loops must be behaviourally dissociable before their calibration windows can be staggered: V3-EXQ-993a merged the three learning channels and found no degradation, and governance recorded that verdict as mixed because the merge acted on experiment-local surrogate heads over a frozen latent rather than the E1/E2/E3 modules ARC-021 names. Each loop must also have a per-loop expression readout, or a latently-consolidated calibration cannot be detected after window close.
claims.blocking_reason: No experiment stages per-loop windows even though drivers own their optimisers and could freeze channels independently, and the ventral-to-dorsal ordering has no registered mapping onto V3's three learning channels -- which of E1/E2/E3 is the limbic, associative or sensorimotor loop is nowhere stated, so the ordering prediction is not yet well-formed.
false_positives: Critical-period machinery is not absent: MECH-334's EWC anchor plus crystallize_at_phase3 already provide window-close semantics; what is missing is that the window is single and global rather than per-loop.
claims.auditor_notes: Sequence behind ARC-021's own dissociability question: a staggered-window result is uninterpretable while a full channel merge produces no measurable degradation, and 993a's joint power on that comparison was about 12 percent.

claims.claim_title: Maladaptive-lock failure mode (personality-pathology analog): adequate environmental input does NOT determine the locked calibration value. A stable subset of agents locks a maladaptive commitment-loop configuration despite sufficient input (lock-onto-bad-calibration), and failure to lock at all yields an unstable / diffuse commitment policy. These are the REE substrate of personality-disorder-analog failure modes: lock-too-early / lock-onto-bad-value (rigid maladaptive personality) and failure-to-lock (identity diffusion).
claims.falsifier_summary: Post-lock outcomes are unimodal and tightly concentrated at matched input, which would restore the adequate-input-determines-calibration position and remove the REE handle on personality pathology.
claims.required_event: A developmental window closing on many independently-seeded agents that received the same adequate curriculum, followed by a post-lock task-distribution shift that a well-calibrated policy should absorb.
claims.manipulation: Crystallization ON (crystallize_at_phase3 with EWC anchor) versus OFF, across a seed population large enough to resolve a subpopulation, with the phase-3 task distribution conflicting with phases 0 to 2 as the V3-EXQ-656 redesign specifies.
claims.control: The no-crystallization arm and an input-adequacy positive control demonstrating that the same curriculum can produce an adaptive lock, so failure-to-lock is distinguishable from failure-to-learn.
claims.DV: The DISTRIBUTION across seeds of post-lock policy quality under the shifted task -- specifically whether it is multi-modal with a stable low-performing mode (lock-onto-bad-calibration) at matched input, and separately the dispersion of commitment policy within an agent over time (identity-diffusion arm: high variance, no stable configuration).
claims.instrument: Cross-seed distributions are recordable from existing arm_results, and the 610/655 drivers already log per-seed phase-2 and phase-3 action entropy plus EWC penalty magnitude. Missing: any lock-detection statistic (did this agent crystallize a stable configuration at all) and any pre-registered bimodality or subpopulation test; the existing criteria are arm-mean deltas that cannot see a subpopulation.
claims.consumer_locus: The post-window crystallized configuration itself -- which value got locked -- rather than the average effect of locking, which is what the INV-074 necessity line measures.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The lock must have a measurable behavioural consequence before lock QUALITY can vary: across six iterations (V3-EXQ-610a through 610f) the stripped no-crystallization control never collapsed (entropy deltas -0.010 to -0.012 with no entropy floor load-bearing), so locked and unlocked agents were behaviourally indistinguishable and a maladaptive-lock subpopulation could not be defined. Input adequacy must also be certified equal across agents, or an outcome spread is attributable to exposure rather than to under-determination.
claims.blocking_reason: The lock regime has never been instantiated: six necessity iterations plus V3-EXQ-655 failed to make the unlocked control collapse, so locking currently has no measurable consequence and a maladaptive lock cannot be distinguished from any other. The redesigned task-shift successor V3-EXQ-656 exists as a script with no manifest.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The 610 lineage's repeated FAILs are not evidence against MECH-336 or INV-074: the necessity premise was never instantiated, so they are unmet-precondition results, not negative ones.
claims.auditor_notes: A cross-seed subpopulation DV needs far more seeds than the 610/655 lineage used; the coordinator should expect this to be cost-gated on the task-shift redesign landing first.

claims.claim_title: The unresolved-goal bank is a content-addressed cue-addressed retrieval system: the current goal/context is the retrieval cue, the SD-039 payload is the stored trace, and rank_ghost_goals() is cued recall. A correct bank must satisfy three structural constraints -- outshining-gated composite cue, dissociable-additive channels, and a non-closeable recoverability term with an explicit-divergence abandon path.
claims.falsifier_summary: The full bank does not outperform either comparator, or fewer than three C2 failure states are inducible, or the outshining-violated / closeable-cutoff arm is indistinguishable from the full bank.
claims.required_event: A goal that is deferred or blocked, followed later by a context change under which it must be recovered and re-approached.
claims.manipulation: The C1+C2+C3 bank (outshining composite cue, additive dissociable channels, non-closeable recoverability with the MECH-340 persistence gate) against a field-only agent and against a bank violating C1 or substituting a closeable recoverability cutoff.
claims.control: Field-only (ARC-060) arm and the C1-violating / closeable-cutoff arm, plus the three C2 channel-suppression conditions (goal_match zeroed, wanting zeroed, both) for the dissociation legs.
claims.DV: Flexible recovery of blocked or deferred goals (re-approach rate and latency under changed context), plus whether all three C2 dissociated failure states are separately inducible.
claims.instrument: rank_ghost_goals and the SD-039 payload preservation exist in HippocampalModule, and V3-EXQ-594/823/807/868 measure child-level quantities, but no recorder tracks deferral-then-recovery of a specific goal across a context change, and no run is tagged to the ARC-060-versus-ARC-078 comparison.
claims.consumer_locus: Cue-to-trace retrieval in the ghost-goal bank -> re-probed goal -> re-approach behaviour.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All three master switches must be ON TOGETHER -- use_composite_cue_outshining, use_mech292_ghost_bank and use_persistence_efficacy_gate are each default False in config.py -- since any one left at its no-op default collapses the arm into a child-level test already covered elsewhere; and the task battery must be one a field-only agent is STRUCTURALLY unable to solve, not merely worse at.
claims.blocking_reason: The required event cannot be generated: causal_grid_world has no goal-deferral-then-recovery battery -- MECH-353 scheduled action blocks are single-tick cancellations with no layout change -- so there is nothing a field-only agent is structurally unable to solve. Secondary: the three flags are default OFF and have never been run together, and Q-053 leaves the C3 gate signal unresolved.
false_positives: EXP-0316 release_condition names goal_pipeline GAP-2 as the blocker, but that plan node is recorded done/superseded; the live blocking element is the absent deferral-recovery battery plus the unflipped flags, not GAP-2.
claims.auditor_notes: The same battery is the missing event for the MECH-389 resumption half, so one environment item serves both sides of the abandon/resume pair the claim notes already wire together.
claims.coordinator_note: Prerequisite candidate (goal-deferral-then-recovery task battery) NOT registered as a new node: substrate_queue sd061-resume-progress-ecology (commissioned 2026-09-19, candidate, unbuilt) is an environment commission of the same shape (a stall that genuinely resumes; its option 2 is a solvable blocked path), and goal_deliberation_v4_plan GDL-5 owns the interrupt->reorient->resume span and asks for exactly a V3 demonstration. Edge repair applied: sd061-resume-progress-ecology annotated as also serving ARC-078 and MECH-389's resumption event.
claims.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated by an EXQ that flips MECH-339 (use_composite_cue_outshining), MECH-292 (use_mech292_ghost_bank, additive form), and MECH-340 (use_persistence_efficacy_gate) ON SIMULTANEOUSLY on one bank configuration, and contrasts flexible recovery of blocked/deferred goals across three arms: (i) the C1-C3-satisfying bank, (ii) a field-only agent (ARC-060 continuous-field prediction, no discrete bank), and (iii) a bank that violates C1 (no outshining gate / flat additive context term) or substitutes a closeable recoverability cutoff for C3's non-closeable term.
CONFIRMING: (i) recovers blocked/deferred goals more flexibly than both (ii) and (iii) on a shared task battery requiring goal deferral + later recovery under changed context, AND all three of C2's dissociated failure states are separately inducible: wanting-channel-only failure (goal_match suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on drive alone), goal_match-channel-only failure (wanting suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on cue match alone), and independent joint failure (neither channel alone reproduces the other's failure mode).
FALSIFYING: (i) does not outperform (ii) and/or (iii) on flexible recovery, OR fewer than all three of C2's failure states are inducible (e.g. the wanting and goal_match channels covary such that only one dissociated failure mode is reachable), OR the outshining/closeable-cutoff variant (iii) performs indistinguishably from (i).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all three flags must be genuinely wired ON together, not tested pairwise or with one held at its no-op default -- a single flag left OFF collapses the arm back toward a form already covered by an existing MECH-level confirmer (e.g. v3_exq_868, C2-only; v3_exq_823/807, C1-on-but-unmanipulated, C3-off) and would falsely read as support for or against the PARENT claim when it only tests a child. The task battery must require goal deferral-then-recovery that a field-only agent is STRUCTURALLY unable to solve (no discrete retrieval target to re-probe), not merely worse at solving.
HARD PRECONDITION shared with Q-053: MECH-340's three control/efficacy failure signatures must be inducible and separable on the substrate before C3 can be meaningfully included in this test; if Q-053's gate signal is still unresolved when this EXQ is designed, use its front-runner (control/efficacy unattainability appraisal) as C3's operationalisation and flag the result as conditional on that choice, not as an independent confirmation of it.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: currently BLOCKED at substrate-assembly, not at design -- C1/C2/C3 are each individually implemented (MECH-339, MECH-292, MECH-340 substrate landed) but all three master switches remain default OFF (use_composite_cue_outshining, use_mech292_ghost_bank, use_persistence_efficacy_gate) as of this check, no experiment has run them together, and no run has been tagged to the ARC-060-vs-ARC-078 comparison this claim requires. Q-053 confirmed still open, no experiment queued. One child substrate landing is not evidence for the parent architectural claim (per the claim's own notes) -- this EXQ is the missing joint test.

claims.claim_title: Composite retrieval cue: the ghost-bank cue is z_goal plus a context channel composed from the already-preserved-but-match-unused SD-039 payload fields (arousal_tag, last_vs, cause), combined by an outshining gate so a strong direct z_goal match suppresses the context channel. Context-cue retrieval is the conditional fallback regime, not an always-on additive term.
claims.falsifier_summary: With centering on and arousal spread measured, either the GATED arm changes the top-1 entry as often as FIXED_ADDITIVE does in the strong-match stratum (the outshining gate is not load-bearing and the composite collapses to a fixed-weight additive term), or it changes nothing in the weak-match stratum (the context channel carries no retrieval signal at all).
claims.required_event: A populated ghost-goal bank ranked on a live agent across two retrieval regimes within one run: cues with a strong direct centered goal_match above outshine_pivot, and cues whose direct match is weak or absent, with arousal-tagged and untagged anchors present in both.
claims.manipulation: Three ranking arms over the identical anchor pool and identical cues: OFF (use_composite_cue_outshining False, the shipped default), GATED (composite on, context_weight > 0, outshine_pivot 0.5 -- the MECH-339 form), and FIXED_ADDITIVE (context term added with the gate forced to 1.0, i.e. no outshining).
claims.control: The OFF arm at identical seeds and identical stored anchors is the bit-identical baseline; FIXED_ADDITIVE is the discriminating comparator that isolates the gate rather than the context channel.
claims.DV: Top-1 bank entry identity, measured separately in the strong-direct-match and weak-direct-match strata: the rate at which the top-ranked anchor changes between OFF and each composite arm, plus the realised gate value and context_term distribution per stratum.
claims.instrument: GhostGoalBank.rank emits per-entry components including the context term, and _outshine_gate / _context_salience_for_anchor are directly readable (ree_core/hippocampal/ghost_goal_bank.py); V3-EXQ-594 exercises the four predictions on synthetic anchors. No driver fires the channel on a centered cue with real arousal tags -- v3_exq_807 and v3_exq_823 measure the SD-079 centering itself and record the gate as pinned.
claims.consumer_locus: The retrieval-cue composition step upstream of ghost_priority ranking, i.e. which stored anchor is returned, not the downstream consumer of the returned anchor.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both inputs to the gated term must have live range on the SAME anchor pool: (a) AnchorSetConfig.goal_cue_centering must be True, because on a raw cue z_goal pairwise cosine sits at 0.988 in the SD-008 common-mode cone, goal_match exceeds outshine_pivot for every anchor and the gate is identically 0.0 -- the context channel is unconditionally dead (pinned by test_sd_079_centered_goal_anchor_match.py C3); and (b) AnchorGoalPayload.arousal_tag must be non-zero with cross-anchor spread, which requires the BLA analog writing tags at encoding, since the field defaults to 0.0 and context_salience is then exactly 0.
claims.blocking_reason: At shipped defaults the mechanism cannot enter its discriminating regime: goal_cue_centering is False, so the gate is identically 0.0 on every anchor (measured and contract-pinned), and arousal_tag defaults to 0.0, so context_salience is 0 even if the gate opened. V3-EXQ-594 validated the arithmetic on synthetic anchors; no run fires the channel on a real centered bank.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The implementation_note's reading that the substrate step is complete and only validation is owed understates the problem: the landed default configuration makes the gate arithmetically inert, so a validation run at defaults would measure nothing rather than fail.
claims.auditor_notes: SD-079 centering is the landed repair for the dead gate but is itself default-OFF; any MECH-339 driver must declare and witness both goal_cue_centering and a measured arousal_tag spread, otherwise it re-runs 594's synthetic arithmetic.

claims.claim_title: Persistence of an unresolved goal as an active re-probe target is a GATED control/efficacy-detection operation; disengagement is the ungated default. The trace is preserved (no erase -- this matches biology); 'abandonment' is the persistence gate failing to fire, after which the un-gated trace decays in rank and ceases to be re-probed. This RESOLVES ARC-078's C3 by inverting its 'add an explicit abandon path (deliberate divergence)' framing.
claims.falsifier_summary: Either failure mode appears in the gate-ON arm, or the failure-keyed abandon-trigger control is behaviourally indistinguishable from the gated design -- in which case the inversion's differential causal claim fails.
claims.required_event: An episode containing a goal that becomes unattainable while its SD-039 trace is preserved in the bank, alongside at least one attainable alternative goal, so that persistence on the unattainable target and engagement with the alternative can be read separately.
claims.manipulation: Three arms: gate ON (gated persistence, default disengagement), gate OFF (ungated persistence, the stuck-on framing), and a bolted-on abandon trigger keyed on accumulated failure or effort cost (the original, non-inverted ARC-078 C3 design).
claims.control: The gate-OFF arm and the failure-keyed abandon-trigger arm at matched seeds and goal schedules, with the attainable-goal arm confirming the trace is preserved rather than erased.
claims.DV: Two failure-mode readouts on the same run: (a) re-probe perseveration -- fraction of ghost-probe seeds still drawn from the unattainable entry after it becomes unattainable; (b) cross-goal apathy -- engagement with the ATTAINABLE alternative after disengagement, testing whether passivity generalises. The claim requires both to stay bounded in the gate-ON arm.
claims.instrument: ree_core/hippocampal/persistence_appraisal_compute.py builds the appraisal from live agent tick signals, and ghost_goal_bank.rank() exposes the exclusion counter (n_below_persistence) and the persistence license; what is missing is a behavioural readout of cross-goal engagement, so leg (b) has no recorder today.
claims.consumer_locus: Ghost-goal re-probe eligibility inside GhostGoalBank.rank -- whether a preserved SD-039 trace continues to be re-probed -- and its behavioural consequence for engagement with other goals; the trace store itself is never erased.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The gate must be separable and actually exercised: use_persistence_efficacy_gate enabled with a PersistenceAppraisal built only from control/unattainability (never recoverability, staleness, wanting or accumulated failure), and the license must fall below persistence_floor for some entries and not others -- if the floor excludes every entry or none, the bank degenerates and neither failure mode can be distinguished from the default.
claims.blocking_reason: The gate primitive and its appraisal exist and are validated at readiness level, but the claim's distinguishing DV is a pair of behavioural failure modes and only the perseveration half has a recorder. Cross-goal apathy needs a multi-goal episode with an unattainable target plus an engagement readout, neither of which any existing driver assembles.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The WWA's precondition line says the gate was 'never run in a real experiment'; V3-EXQ-607 ran it on 2026-05-21 and PASSed (supports), tagged MECH-340 only -- a readiness validation of the primitive, not of ARC-079's behavioural double-avoidance, but not nothing.
ARC-060's blocked-goal recovery driver already produces an unattainable-goal event, so the event half of the design does not need inventing.
claims.auditor_notes: The 2026-09-15 literature pull added a counter-case (Mu 2019: astrocytic integration of failure evidence actively suppresses swimming) that argues for a failure-integrating disengage mechanism -- worth carrying into the falsifier as a third arm rather than only as the predicted-pathology control.

claims.claim_title: The persistence/efficacy gate: a control/efficacy-detection signal that maintains an unresolved-goal bank entry as an active MECH-293 re-probe target. It is gated ON by an unattainability-negative / control-positive appraisal, NOT by accumulated failure, repeated suppression, bare effort-cost, or staleness.

claims.required_event: An unresolved goal held in the ghost-goal bank while the agent's control/efficacy appraisal changes -- i.e. a goal that becomes appraised as unattainable or out of control without being achieved.
claims.manipulation: Three arms: gate OFF (pure disengagement default); gate ON with the licit appraisal (control_efficacy x (1 - goal_unattainability)); and a mis-keyed arm in which the gate is driven by accumulated failure, repeated suppression or MECH-292 staleness -- the hard negatives the claim forbids.

claims.claim_title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
claims.falsifier_summary: Either the diverse pool is collapsed by scoring regardless of the preserver (post-scoring class count does not exceed OFF), or the 660 within-class lift fails to replicate at the raised pool where niches shrink to singletons and stratified_select short-circuits to argmin -- indicating the ratified result was an artefact of the 2-class clamp.
claims.required_event: An E3 scoring step over a genuinely class-diverse CEM candidate pool -- a pool in which several distinct first-action classes are present before scoring.
claims.manipulation: use_e3_score_diversity ON versus OFF at a RAISED candidate pool (support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim), with the entropy-bonus and stratified-select sub-flags per arm.
claims.control: use_e3_score_diversity=False arm at the same raised pool, plus the legacy clamped-pool cell for continuity with the 660 result.
claims.DV: Number of distinct first-action classes SURVIVING the scoring step (post-score, pre-commit) ON versus OFF, and the within-class-representative readout H(rep_signature | committed_class) against legacy argmin, both scored on the fresh-select denominator.
claims.instrument: ree_core/predictors/e3_score_diversity.py (E3ScoreDiversity, stratified_select, entropy bonus) with its diagnostics, consulted on both committed and uncommitted paths in e3_selector.py; experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py supplies the fresh-select denominator and the n_fresh_select / n_latched counters.
claims.consumer_locus: The E3 scoring step alone -- post-CEM, pre-commit. Committed-action-class entropy is NOT this claim's DV; that conversion belongs to MECH-439 / MECH-442.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Measured mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim in the PRE-scoring pool (support_preserving_min_first_action_classes raised to action_dim); substrate measured operative (n_stratified_fired > 0 on every ON arm and seed, entropy_bonus_max_abs non-trivial against mean_top2_class_gap); fresh-select denominator with n_fresh_select / n_latched / replication_factor reported; SD-105 OFF or matched-constant.
claims.blocking_reason: R0: every element exists and the non-degeneracy precondition is demonstrably reachable -- V3-EXQ-949 measured mean_distinct_first_action_classes 4.83-5.00 at floor=5 across 4 arms and 5 seeds. The only thing missing is the run itself (EXP-1387 is proposed but not queued).
false_positives: A flat committed-action-class entropy is not evidence against MECH-341; the scope fence assigns that conversion to MECH-439 / MECH-442, and 614e/660 both showed byte-identical committed-class entropy while MECH-341 passed.
The substrate_queue MECH-341 entry's stale status string (GFLAG-0185) does not indicate a substrate gap -- the module and knobs are in place with lambda=0.5 and bias_scale=1.0 as the WWA states.
claims.auditor_notes: Highest-readiness item in this batch. The proposal EXP-1387 flags a label collision with the retired graded-in-K 660c; per the EXQ policy it should get a fresh number rather than a letter.
claims.what_would_answer:
SCOPE, ratified 2026-06-14 and load-bearing for reading this falsifier. MECH-341 asserts
scoring-layer PRESERVATION -- that E3 score aggregation does not collapse an upstream-diverse
candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. It does NOT assert that the preserved
diversity reaches the COMMITTED action; that conversion is the shared E3 selection-authority
ceiling tracked on `behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A` / MECH-439 F-dominance, and is MECH-442's
territory, not this claim's. A flat committed-action-class entropy is therefore not evidence
against MECH-341 (614e and 660 both showed byte-identical committed-class entropy while MECH-341
passed). Two falsifier shapes are additionally RETIRED and must not be resurrected:
(a) graded-in-K dose-response -- retired by confirmed `failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-660b_2026-06-11`
because a graded response over-specifies a binary preserve-or-collapse claim (three convergent
iterations 660 / 660a / 660b; no 660c); (b) in-isolation clearance via the
`entropy_bias_scale` lever -- V3-EXQ-616 proved mathematically that a uniform additive bias
cannot move a single-class CEM proposer output (bit-identical across scales 1/2/4/8), so the
B_only arm's structural bound sits at the *proposer* layer (SP-CEM presence), not the score-layer
knob. MECH-341 is a preserver, never an in-isolation generator.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION.
(1) There must be something to preserve, and this is the condition every run to date missed.
Measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes` in the PRE-scoring candidate pool must be
`>= 0.9 * action_dim` (>= 4.5 of 5), i.e. `support_preserving_min_first_action_classes` raised to
`action_dim` -- see ARC-065's own `what_would_answer` (P1) for the full statement and the
V3-EXQ-949 evidence; do not re-derive it here. At the shipped default of 2 the pool realises
~2-3 classes and `min_classes_for_stratification = 2` is only just satisfied, so a "preservation"
verdict is measured at the mechanism's degenerate boundary.
(2) The substrate must be OPERATIVE and measured as such, not assumed from config
(`use_e3_score_diversity` and both sub-flags default `False`): `n_stratified_fired > 0` on every
ON arm and every seed (the V3-EXQ-611 C1 criterion -- 611's ARM_2 recorded
`n_stratified_fired = 0` across all seeds and that FAIL was a wiring artefact, not a claim result),
and `entropy_bonus_max_abs` non-trivial relative to the observed `mean_top2_class_gap` (the 611c
C2 lesson: `lambda = 0.05` produced a 0.045 bonus against gaps of 0.27-1.96 and was inert; the
defaults are now `lambda = 0.5`, `bias_scale = 1.0`).
(3) De-duplication: the pre/post class counts and the within-class representative entropy must
be accumulated on the fresh-select denominator (`experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py` -- select
diagnostics cleared before every `select_action`, latched ticks contribute no row), with
`n_fresh_select`, `n_latched` and `replication_factor` reported per cell. A held/latched E3 decision
re-counted per tick inflates every class count by the hold factor (~9x) and is the standing
hold-weighted readout hazard.
(4) SD-105 (selection-entropy headroom floor) OFF or matched-constant with realised log-temperature
recorded per arm.

CONFIRMING. On a pool with measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`: the number of
distinct first-action classes SURVIVING the E3 scoring step (post-score, pre-commit) is
strict-above the same quantity with `use_e3_score_diversity = False`, on >= 2/3 seeds; and the
established within-class-representative readout `H(rep_signature | committed_class)` (the 660
corrected readout mandated by the 614e autopsy's Learning #2 -- not committed-class entropy)
remains strict-above legacy-argmin by a margin exceeding both an absolute floor and the
cross-seed SD of the delta. The already-established instance at the clamped pool is 660:
4.862 vs 4.781 nats, +0.081 against a 0.05 threshold -- note this margin is thin and its
SD-scaled robustness was never established, which is part of what the raised-P1 arm would test.

FALSIFYING. Two distinct routes, either sufficient.
(i) Collapse at a genuinely diverse pool: with `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`
upstream and the substrate measured operative, the post-scoring distinct-class count does NOT
exceed the `use_e3_score_diversity = False` control (the diverse pool is collapsed by scoring
regardless of the preserver) -- MECH-341's preservation assertion fails exactly where it should
bite hardest. (ii) Boundary artefact: the 660 within-class-representative lift does not
replicate at the raised pool -- at ~4.9 classes the niches are small (often singletons, where
`stratified_select`'s own code short-circuits to argmin: `len(class_idxs) < 2`), so a +0.08 nats
effect that vanishes when niches shrink would indicate the ratified result was an artefact of the
2-class clamp rather than a property of the preserver. Either outcome is a genuine weakening and
would put the 2026-06-14 ratification back in front of governance.

claims.claim_title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).
claims.falsifier_summary: On a properly powered ecological run that clears the precondition, the coupling either fails to fire when the deficit crosses its floor (a true miss), fires but produces no measurable behavioural benefit over the OFF ablation (correct substrate, ecologically inert), or causes harm the OFF arm does not show -- premature abort, non-targeted release, or re-commit/release churn.
claims.required_event: A naturally established, sustained committed motor program that then degrades mid-execution -- score_margin decisiveness and/or nav_competence falling below their release-triggering floors while the beta latch is still elevated and z_harm_a stays below the MECH-091 threshold.
claims.manipulation: use_maintenance_release ON versus OFF over the same ecological degradation episodes, at matched seed and matched curriculum, with the degradation itself driven by the environment rather than by a forced state machine.
claims.control: The OFF ablation over the identical degradation episodes, plus a matched no-degradation / recovery control arm that guards the premature-abort pole (the release must not fire on a still-viable commitment).
claims.DV: Behavioural benefit over the OFF arm across degradation episodes -- reduced wasted or hazardous persistence in a now-unwinnable commitment -- with mech342_fires greater than zero at the point the deficit crosses its floor, release TARGETED to the degraded program only, and no increase in premature aborts on the recovery control.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/commit_maintenance_release.py exposes the pressure accumulator, release bound and fire counter; the release branch sits in REEAgent.select_action after the MECH-091 urgency block and reads decisiveness from e3.last_scores and nav from commit_readiness.get_readiness(). V3-EXQ-592g validated all six state-machine criteria on a forced state; the 629 drivers carry the ecological gates.
claims.consumer_locus: The active beta latch on the currently committed motor program at maintenance time -- the OR-composed release dual of MECH-090's AND-composed admission, distinct from MECH-091 threat, ARC-028 completion, MECH-269b schema staleness and MECH-340 goal-level timescale.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A run tests MECH-342 only if it FIRST establishes genuine sustained commitment -- beta latch elevated on real nav-competence/foraging engagement, not a forced state -- on at least 2 of 3 seeds, AND verifies the readiness-degradation manipulation actually crosses the score_margin and/or nav_competence release floors mid-commitment. V3-EXQ-629b cleared this on 1/3 seeds; 629c on 0/3 (contact_rate 0, three gates false).
claims.blocking_reason: There is no natural sustained commitment to release. The registered open failure 'no natural commit when score margins are flat' (V3-EXQ-629) is still live in code as of 2026-09-19; 629b cleared genuine commitment plus degradation on 1/3 seeds, 629c on 0/3, and 460l returned non_contributory for MECH-342. The internal state-machine correctness question is already closed by 592g and is not what is blocked.
false_positives: 629b and 629c are not substrate_ceiling hits against MECH-342; both were categorised measurement_test_design_defect because the ecological scenario never materialised, and on the one competent seed (43) the release fired correctly.
The substrate_queue MECH-342 row records current_blocker: None and status implemented_validated_v3_exq_592g, which reads as unblocked; the ecological precondition is unmet and the blocker is live.
claims.auditor_notes: The nav-competence/natural-commit prerequisite is owned upstream by the MECH-457 competence-floor cluster (mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer, blocked_pending_dependency on MECH-229) and by commitment_closure:GAP-4, but MECH-342's own substrate row carries no edge to either and reports current_blocker: None. A retest inheriting the 629b/629c ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingScheduler harness must also re-verify the goal state is live, per the 2026-07-27 frozen_z_goal_scaffold_family finding.
claims.what_would_answer:
The substrate's internal correctness is ALREADY CONFIRMED and is not what this
falsifier tests. V3-EXQ-592g (forced state-machine diagnostic) passed all six
acceptance criteria -- including C4, the conjunction criterion 592f could only
pass VACUOUSLY, now strictly positive (max_drop 0.6) -- so "does the pressure
accumulator/release-bound machinery fire as coded" is closed. What remains open
is whether the mechanism, once ecologically triggered, produces adaptive
behaviour -- promotion to provisional/active requires exactly that: an
ecological, evidence-grade experiment, not another diagnostic probe.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue /
measurement_test_design_defect, NOT a verdict): a run only tests MECH-342 if it
first establishes GENUINE sustained commitment (beta latch elevated on real
nav-competence/foraging engagement, not a forced state) in >= 2/3 seeds, AND the
readiness-degradation manipulation (score_margin and/or nav_competence actually
crossing their release-triggering floors mid-commitment) is verified non-vacuous.
Two prior ecological attempts failed this precondition, not the mechanism:
V3-EXQ-629b (2026-06-12) cleared genuine commitment + degradation on only 1/3
seeds (foraging contact-guard held on seed 43 only); V3-EXQ-629c (autopsied
2026-07-24) failed it entirely (contact_rate 0, 3 gates false) and was
categorised measurement_test_design_defect, explicitly NOT a substrate_ceiling
hit, precisely because the ecological scenario never materialised. A future
retest must confirm >= 2/3 seeds clear the same nav-competence/contact floor
629b used before treating any release/non-release result as informative. Note
also the adjacent, still-open frozen_z_goal_scaffold_family finding
(2026-07-27): the 629b/629c test harness (ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingScheduler)
belongs to a scaffold family with a documented frozen-z_goal measurement-phase
issue; that audit confirmed 629b/629c's own non-scoring status stands (nothing
to reopen), but a retest inheriting the same harness should re-verify the goal
state is live/unfrozen as intended for the arm being measured, not assume it.
CONFIRMING signature: once the precondition above is cleared, commit_maintenance
_release fires (mech342_fires > 0) at the point score_margin and/or
nav_competence cross their release floors; the release is TARGETED (only the
degraded committed program is released -- unrelated ongoing behaviour is
unaffected, mirroring 592g's C5 no-false-abort criterion but measured
ecologically); and agent behaviour measurably improves relative to a matched
ON/OFF ablation over the same degradation episodes (e.g. reduced
wasted/hazardous persistence in a now-unwinnable commitment) without an increase
in premature aborts on a matched no-degradation/recovery control arm.
