claims.claim_title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and MECH-257's evaluator-mode E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* (prospective rollout-scoring; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

claims.claim_title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

claims.manipulation: Selective per-type devaluation after binding, with use_incentive_token_bank ON; the comparator arm disables the bank so the benefit pulse writes the legacy single-attractor z_goal at the current latent instead of binding to the contacted type tag.

claims.claim_title: Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same spread witnessed and kappa scaled, most_wanted is determined by base_value alone and never flips with the drive axis, or base_value fails to revalue toward received benefit -- either would falsify the relocated drive-multiplier form wanting = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive_axis).
claims.required_event: Multi-type foraging episodes in which at least two resource types have been contacted and cached, and the agent's per-axis deficits then diverge (one axis standing depleted while another is restored) before the next goal seeding.
claims.manipulation: Cross use_incentive_token_bank ON versus OFF with a standing per-axis differential: per_axis_restoration_fraction < 1.0 plus a divergent per_axis_drive_decay tuple, and incentive_drive_kappa_scale raised so kappa times the realised drive spread is comparable to the base_value gap.
claims.control: An arm with incentive_use_per_axis_drive=False (scalar drive applied uniformly) at matched contacts and matched base_value history, which isolates the identity-matching claim from the plain revaluation claim; plus the bank-OFF legacy seeding arm.
claims.DV: The rate at which the per-axis drive state changes which resource type is most_wanted at seeding (argmax flips of wanting[k] under matched base_value), and the base_value trajectory's tracking of received benefit versus its decay between contacts.
claims.instrument: Fully present and read-only inspectable: IncentiveTokenBank in ree_core/goal.py:659-780 holds base_value, z_object, decay(), update() EMA revaluation and wanting()/most_wanted(); state_dict exposes the per-type values; the consumer redirect is at agent.py:12009-12034 where seed_latent is replaced by the most-wanted object's embedding. No experiment script references MECH-345 at all.
claims.consumer_locus: The z_goal seeding decision -- which stored object embedding becomes the attractor -- not a downstream behavioural readout.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The per-axis drive spread at the moment wanting is read must be large enough to compete with the base_value gaps it multiplies: the V3-EXQ-514r autopsy measured an in-run spread of ~0.006 against object base_value gaps above 0.5, so at the shipped defaults (incentive_drive_kappa_scale 1.0, per_axis_restoration_fraction 1.0, equalised per_axis_drive_decay) no drive state can flip most_wanted and the identity-matching leg cannot discriminate.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing is missing from the substrate; the shipped defaults make the load-bearing half degenerate. Every lever needed to fix that exists (incentive_drive_kappa_scale, per_axis_restoration_fraction, divergent per_axis_drive_decay), and no queued or completed experiment arms any of them for this claim.

claims.manipulation: use_incentive_token_bank ON (z_goal seeded from IncentiveTokenBank.most_wanted) versus OFF (z_goal seeded from the raw last-contacted z_resource), at matched seeds, matched drive schedule and an unchanged GoalState firing gate.
claims.control: The drive-uniform arm, which subtracts the categorical mismatch a random pointer would produce, plus the bank-OFF raw-seed arm; both at matched consumption schedules.

claims.instrument: agent.update_z_goal and ree_core/goal.py implement the pointer; the dissociation readout exists in experiments/v3_exq_514n-q and v3_exq_693/693a, which already read most_wanted and compare it to the just-consumed type.

claims.claim_title: Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.
claims.falsifier_summary: Post-cue approach lift toward the cued type is within noise of the background rate across the gain/kappa sweep despite a measurable z_goal pull, i.e. cue-triggered wanting reaches z_goal but not pre-consummatory approach.
claims.required_event: A perceived object cue with NO benefit pulse and no token revaluation, occurring while the corresponding per-axis drive is elevated and the cued object is not the one most recently consumed.

claims.control: The cue-off arm at matched seeds and matched cue schedule, plus the within-run background approach rate on non-cue steps, which is the comparator V3-EXQ-652 already computes.
claims.DV: Post-cue approach-rate lift over the matched background rate toward the CUED object type specifically, scored against an effect-size floor scaled on the SD of the per-seed delta -- not a 2-of-3 sign count -- with mean_cue_zgoal_pull_norm reported as the mediator-strength precondition.
claims.instrument: ree_core/goal.py cue_pull + agent.cue_recall_wanting, the _harness.py automatic cue-recall perception hook, and experiments/_lib/z_goal_stream.py, which counts both z_goal writers; the approach-lift DV is recorded by v3_exq_640b/652 but without an effect-size floor.

claims.claim_title: Drive-state modulation of wanting (incentive salience): the homeostatic drive STATE modulates the wanting target and/or intensity dissociably from liking -- the most-wanted object tracks the currently-most-depleted drive axis (incentive-salience amplitude ~ base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)) even when the liking/consummatory target does not. Split from MECH-229 2026-06-16: MECH-229 asserts wanting and liking are dissociable SIGNALS (the object-bound dissociation, established by V3-EXQ-514o); MECH-436 is the distinct, finer claim that wanting is additionally DRIVE-STATE-MODULATED -- the incentive-salience core the 514m/514p/514q lineage kept (in different broken ways) trying to express.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the enriched spread, bounded kappa, live overshoot control and floored OFF arm all reported, the continuous amplitude shift is indistinguishable from the drive-nulled arm -- wanting is not drive-state modulated at all. The flip leg failing alone is NOT falsification: overshoot flipping most_wanted established that the shortfall is a magnitude artefact of the object-value landscape.
claims.required_event: Sustained foraging on the SD-049 multi-resource enriched substrate where several homeostatic axes deplete at different rates and are only partially restored on contact, so a standing per-axis drive spread is present at the wanting-scoring moment.
claims.manipulation: Cross the drive state (natural enriched per-axis spread versus a drive-nulled arm versus an overshoot positive control at drive magnitude 5.0) with the coupling scale incentive_drive_kappa_scale inside the bounded band, reading wanting through GoalState at incentive_drive_kappa_weight times scale.
claims.control: The OFF / token-bank-disabled arm, which floors the wanting-liking difference at zero; a matched drive-nulled arm at identical seed and object layout; and the overshoot arm as a positive control certifying the drive channel can carve at adequate magnitude.
claims.DV: Primary, the continuous incentive-amplitude shift mean_cont_amplitude_shift of the wanting score toward the most-depleted axis against its 0.05 floor (514u measured 0.164). Secondary and still open, the discrete most_wanted target flip rate toward the depleted axis, reported against the per-seed base_value gap that bounds it.
claims.instrument: Complete and exercised. GoalState.wanting applies kappa equals incentive_drive_kappa_weight times incentive_drive_kappa_scale to per-axis drive (ree_core/goal.py); the env half is per_axis_restoration_fraction in CausalGridWorldV2; the contract is test_sd049_phase2_drive_coupling.py; and V3-EXQ-514u is the recorder that already produced a scored PASS on the amplitude reading.
claims.consumer_locus: The benefit-to-wanting transduction inside GoalState, where cached base_value is multiplied by the drive gain before any argmax -- upstream of, and dissociable from, liking and from global approach vigour.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Reported per run: enriched per-axis drive spread above 0.1 (514u measured 0.222) produced by per_axis_restoration_fraction below 1.0 plus a divergent per_axis_drive_decay tuple; effective kappa held inside the 514s C8 bounded-kappa invariant (incentive_drive_kappa_scale at or below 6.0, since 12.0 regressed the delta); incentive_use_per_axis_drive True; the OFF/bank-disabled arm flooring at wanting equal to liking; and, for the flip leg only, the in-run object base_value gap reported per seed, since gaps above 0.5 are unflippable even at overshoot magnitude 5.0.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks a run: levers, env amend, controls and a scored instrument all exist and the intensity disjunct already PASSED on V3-EXQ-514u, which is why the substrate ceiling was lifted. The residual is that the DISCRETE flip disjunct is non-degenerate only on seeds whose in-run base_value gap is below the reachable drive term, and the kappa lever that would widen it is exhausted and bounded by the 514s C8 invariant.
false_positives: The claim's live_status still reads from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-514t (non_contributory/substrate_ceiling, 2026-06-20); the ceiling was lifted the next day on V3-EXQ-514u PASS and epistemic_category was flipped to standard.
The notes' instruction 'DO NOT build the SD-049-PHASE-2 substrate amend until 514r resolves' is spent -- 514r resolved, the amend was greenlit, built and validated.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim is disjunctive (target AND/OR intensity) and the intensity disjunct has a scored PASS, so the coordinator should treat the remaining work as a promotion/disposition question for governance rather than a new falsifier build.

claims.claim_title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the conflict genuinely established and the repaired trace accumulating, INTACT still fails to clear 2/3 or fails to beat LESION -- freeze-suppression fires without the predicted survival benefit, which would falsify the instrumental-acquisition architecture rather than its test-bed.

claims.claim_title: Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).
claims.falsifier_summary: With readiness met (gate engaging and suppressing at 1.0, freeze committing on the lesion arm), the INTACT arm shows no graded advantage in freeze duration or escape latency -- or suppression onset tracks instantaneous z_harm_a spikes rather than the learned trace, which would collapse the SD-037/MECH-281 distinction the claim's distinctness depends on.

claims.manipulation: use_instrumental_avoidance ON (ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression plus instrumental-avoidance action bias) versus the ilPFC-lesion arm with the gate OFF, both carrying the harm-pathway training and the escape-affordance bridge so the gate is the sole variable.
claims.control: The gate-OFF lesion arm at matched seeds and hazard config; plus an arousal-yoked control in which suppression is driven by instantaneous z_harm_a/threat scale rather than the learned avoidance_efficacy trace, which is the SD-037/MECH-281 confound the claim's distinctness rests on.
claims.DV: A GRADED per-tick escape DV rather than the binary Stage-H survival fraction: freeze duration under threat, latency to first directed action after threat onset, and the correlation of suppression onset with the learned avoidance_efficacy trace rather than with instantaneous threat magnitude.
claims.instrument: The gate records efficacy, engagement and suppression per tick (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py; agent.py caches whether the last emitted action was directed), and the escape-affordance bridge records per-class credit. claims.claim_title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. claims.claim_title: Is a maladaptive depressive network-regime (MECH-367) REVERSIBLE -- reconfigurable by REE's existing repair machinery (offline integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, re-access to social affordances, goal-stream re-coupling) -- or does chronicity lock the regime past a threshold (RA-001) such that the repair routes that work early fail or reverse-sign late?
claims.falsifier_summary: The routes that reconfigure the early regime fail or reverse sign late, consistent with the RA-001 connectivity-severity sign flip and the MECH-124 self-amplifying consolidation loop -- answer chronicity locks the regime.
claims.required_event: Induction of a maladaptive depressive network-regime in the MECH-367 regime-vector substrate, sustained to two distinct chronicity points.
claims.manipulation: Apply REE's repair routes -- offline-integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, social-affordance re-access, goal-stream re-coupling -- at EARLY (pre-threshold) versus LATE (post-threshold) chronicity.
claims.control: Untreated regime trajectories matched for induction and chronicity, so spontaneous drift is separated from repair effect, with the same routes applied in both windows.
claims.DV: Recovery of the regime vector toward baseline connectivity and goal-coupling after repair, and crucially its SIGN and magnitude at LATE versus EARLY -- comparable recovery means reversible, failure or sign reversal late means chronicity locks the regime.
claims.instrument: None in V3 and correctly so -- there is no regime-vector state to read. The readout would have to be the MECH-367 depressive-regime vector itself plus its connectivity and goal-coupling components, which exist only in the V4/V5 roadmap.
claims.consumer_locus: The network-regime state and its repair operators across a chronicity axis -- a V4/V5 architectural boundary, not any V3 per-episode behavioural metric.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The induced depressive regime must be a genuine self-sustaining attractor that persists without an ongoing stressor, and the LATE point must lie past the RA-001 chronicity threshold, else EARLY and LATE are the same regime and the duration-dependence question is untestable rather than answered.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: the MECH-367 depressive-regime vector substrate does not exist, and the claim record and its proposal both say explicitly not to queue a V3 experiment. The V4/V5 node that would unblock it (ethics_as_coherence_v5 ETH-7) does not list Q-061 among the claims it unblocks.
claims.auditor_notes: ETH-7 already lists MECH-367 in unblocks_claims, so Q-061's release condition has an owner it is simply not linked to -- adding that edge is bookkeeping, not a build. Keep the anti-overclaim guard attached: a positive result would not license calling depression a reversible software state.
claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a duration-graded repair comparison once the MECH-367
depressive-regime vector substrate exists (V4/V5 -- DO NOT queue a V3
experiment). Induce a maladaptive depressive network-regime, then apply REE's
existing repair routes (offline-integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing,
decommitment from ruminative loops, social-affordance re-access, goal-stream
re-coupling) at TWO chronicity points: EARLY (pre-threshold) and LATE (past
the RA-001 ~24-month-analog chronicity threshold). The discriminating
observation is whether the SAME repair routes reconfigure the regime in both
windows. ANSWER 'reversible / not threshold-locked' if late repair recovers
the regime toward baseline connectivity and goal-coupling with the same routes
that work early (no sign reversal, recovery magnitude comparable). ANSWER
'chronicity locks the regime' if the routes that reconfigure the early regime
FAIL late, or REVERSE sign late (consistent with the RA-001
connectivity-vs-severity sign flip and the MECH-124 self-amplifying
consolidation loop), implying late repair needs a different mechanism. HARD
PRECONDITION: the induced regime must be a genuine self-sustaining attractor
(persists without ongoing stressor) and the late point must be past the RA-001
threshold, else 'early' and 'late' are the same regime and the
duration-dependence question is untestable. ANTI-OVERCLAIM GUARD: a positive
result does NOT license asserting depression is 'merely a reversible software
state'.

claims.claim_title: Should REE represent a clinical syndrome as a weighted VECTOR over the ARC-086 latent vulnerability axes (with comorbidity = axis-overlap and pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple axes), rather than as a diagnosis-specific locus mapping -- and if so, how is comorbidity represented without exploding the claim registry, and how is axis-predisposition (which axes are fragile) kept distinct from axis-expression (gated by REE's developmental / plasticity machinery)?
claims.falsifier_summary: The vector encoding does not reduce entry count or loses syndrome-specific discriminability, or predisposition and expression collapse into one quantity -- the per-syndrome locus mapping is then adequate.
claims.required_event: A panel of clinical syndromes, including known comorbid pairs and at least one pleiotropic mechanism loading several axes, encoded twice over a built ARC-086 axis substrate.
claims.manipulation: Encoding A, the current per-syndrome locus mapping, versus encoding B, a weighted vector over the ARC-086 axes with comorbidity as axis overlap and pleiotropy as one mechanism loading several axes.
claims.control: The same syndrome panel and the same evidence under both encodings, so that any economy or discriminability difference is attributable to the representation and not to which syndromes were chosen.
claims.DV: Two quantities -- registry economy, the number of registry entries needed for N syndromes plus their comorbid combinations (linear in axes versus combinatorial in syndrome pairs); and predisposition/expression factoring, whether one predisposition vector yields different expressed syndromes under different developmental and plasticity gating.
claims.instrument: None in V3 and correctly so -- there is no axis-vector substrate to encode into. The readout would be an entry-count comparison over the two encodings plus a gating sweep on the vector, both of which presuppose the ARC-086 substrate.
claims.consumer_locus: The representational boundary between vulnerability axes and expressed failure modes in a V4/V5 substrate, not any V3 module and not the running agent.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The ARC-086 axes must be empirically separable -- non-degenerate, discriminable loadings -- before any syndrome can be located in axis space. Degenerate axes make the vector representation vacuous and the comparison unfalsifiable rather than negative.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: the ARC-086 latent-vulnerability-axis substrate does not exist, and the claim record and proposal both say explicitly not to queue a V3 experiment. The owning plan node (ethics_as_coherence_v5 ETH-7, phase 4, status deferred) names the Q-064 vector readout only in its prose table.
claims.auditor_notes: Leg (a), registry economy, is a registry-DESIGN exercise (count entries under two encodings) that needs no substrate at all and could be settled on paper; only leg (b), the predisposition/expression factoring, genuinely requires the V4/V5 axis substrate. If the coordinator wants partial closure, split the claim rather than waiting on ARC-086 for both.
claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a representational comparison once the ARC-086
latent-vulnerability-axis substrate exists (V4/V5 -- DO NOT queue a V3
experiment). Build two encodings of a panel of clinical syndromes (including
known comorbid pairs and a pleiotropic mechanism loading multiple axes): (A)
the current per-syndrome locus mapping; (B) a weighted VECTOR over ARC-086
axes (comorbidity = axis-overlap, pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple
axes). The discriminating tests: (a) REGISTRY ECONOMY -- count claim-registry
entries needed to represent N syndromes plus their comorbid combinations;
ANSWER 'vector representation preferred' if (B) represents comorbidities as
overlapping axis activation with NO combinatorial blow-up (entry count grows
~linearly in axes, not in syndrome-pairs) while (A) needs a new locus per
combination; ANSWER 'locus mapping adequate' if (B) does not reduce entry
count or loses syndrome-specific discriminability. (b)
PREDISPOSITION/EXPRESSION FACTORING -- the vector must keep 'which axes are
fragile' (axis-predisposition) separable from 'which failure mode is currently
expressed' (gated by developmental timing / plasticity / environment); ANSWER
'vector preferred' only if the same predisposition vector can yield different
expressed syndromes under different developmental/plasticity gating
(genetic-risk != inevitability), and 'inadequate' if predisposition and
expression collapse into one quantity. HARD PRECONDITION: the ARC-086 axes
must be empirically separable (non-degenerate, discriminable loadings) before
any syndrome can be located in axis space; degenerate axes make the vector
representation vacuous.

claims.claim_title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.
claims.falsifier_summary: Any live convergence point is found where two nominally distinct affect streams share a learning target or a gating predicate; or the dominant channel's share is flat or rises when the evaluators are armed.
claims.required_event: Committed selections under a measurably dominant gradient channel, with two or more affect evaluators armed and non-degenerate on the same tick.
claims.manipulation: Arm versus disarm the affect evaluators (leg ii), holding the incumbent channel and task fixed; for leg (i) no manipulation is required -- it is an architectural audit of learning targets and gating predicates at each shared convergence point.
claims.control: The disarmed-evaluator arm at matched seeds for leg (ii); for leg (i), the paired comparison is between channels at the SAME convergence point, not against an ablation.
claims.DV: Leg (i): whether any two converging channels share a learning target or a gating predicate at a convergence point. Leg (ii): the committed-selection variance share of the dominant channel, armed versus disarmed, on at least 2 of 3 seeds, scaled on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor.
claims.instrument: Partially present. At the E3 score-bias convergence point e3.last_channel_terms retains per-candidate unreduced [K] tensors per NAMED channel under use_finer_channel_gating, which is exactly the covariance-correct decomposition the claim asks for and is already used by V3-EXQ-785/787/925. The other three convergence points have nothing: no channel attribution on commitment gating, residue writes or offline consolidation.
claims.consumer_locus: The per-channel decomposition immediately upstream of each shared consumer with channel identity preserved -- never the summed bias tensor, where distinct channels are indistinguishable by construction.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least two affect evaluators must be simultaneously LIVE and CONSEQUENTIAL in the step loop -- computed and consumed by a decision, not config fields, default-off flags or diagnostic counters. This bar is non-trivial: both named E3 consumers of z_harm_a default to 0.0, and z_world participation ratio near 1.06 leaves cannot-express alive as a rival to affect-does-not-prevent.
claims.blocking_reason: Three of the four convergence points have no channel-identity-preserving recorder: commitment gating, residue writes and offline consolidation record no attribution of which channel moved the decision. The E3 leg is runnable today. Leg (ii) additionally sits under the V3-EXQ-785a null with the cannot-express rival still live.
false_positives: The parenthetical that per-channel decomposition is stored as reduced scalars, losing the covariance this claim needs, is true of agent.py but no longer the binding constraint: e3_selector.last_channel_terms retains the unreduced per-candidate tensors precisely so covariance-correct cross-terms can be computed, and experiments already read it.
claims.auditor_notes: Do not spawn substrate under this umbrella -- the claim forbids it and GFLAG-0081 already resolved as HEADLINE FALSE when a flag restated the claim's own text as a finding. The productive next step is an audit of the three unattributed convergence points, not a new experiment.
claims.what_would_answer:
A UNIFYING MAP over already-owned claims. Answered by ARCHITECTURAL AUDIT plus one
coherence check, NOT by a new experiment, and it registers no substrate -- its own
notes are explicit that new affect work attaches to the relevant owned child rather
than to this umbrella. Do not invent redundant substrate claims under it.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: that emotion-like systems in biology are a set of
partially-independent, natively-integrated control systems rather than a scalar
appraisal bolted onto a rational optimiser is an affective-neuroscience position
with its own literature (Pessoa). REE cannot test it and no REE run bears on it. It
is the FRAMING that motivates the REE leg; per the lit/exp decoupling rule it must
not be counted as evidence for it.
REE LEG: (i) the DISTINCTNESS CONSTRAINT -- the affective streams may converge on
shared CONSUMERS (E3 score bias, commitment gating, residue, offline consolidation)
but their LEARNING TARGETS and GATING CONDITIONS must remain distinct, i.e. they
must NOT be merged into one value scalar; and (ii) the ANTI-COLLAPSE FUNCTION --
that this arrangement measurably prevents behaviour collapsing onto the currently
dominant gradient.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: for (i), the audit must find at least TWO affect
evaluators simultaneously LIVE and CONSEQUENTIAL in the current step loop --
actually computed and actually consumed by a decision -- not merely present as
config fields, default-OFF flags or diagnostic-only counters. An architecture in
which only one affect stream is live trivially satisfies "distinct streams" while
exhibiting none of the structure the claim asserts. This bar is non-trivial here:
SD-086's default_off_scope_note records that both named E3 consumers of z_harm_a
default to 0.0. For (ii), the dominant-gradient channel must be measurably dominant
AND the substrate must be able to express the alternative -- V3-EXQ-785a recorded
z_world participation ratio ~1.06, which leaves "the substrate cannot express it"
live as a rival to "affect does not prevent it."
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: at the CONVERGENCE POINTS, per channel, not at
the aggregate. The claim's own architectural consequence is that streams share
consumers, so the aggregate score bias is exactly where distinct channels become
indistinguishable -- measuring there guarantees absorption by construction. The
audit target is the per-channel decomposition immediately upstream of each shared
consumer, with channel-identity preserved: for E3 score bias, per-channel
cross-candidate range and channel-to-channel COVARIANCE (not the summed bias
tensor, and not reduced scalars -- MECH-463's instrumentation audit records that
agent.py stores per-channel decomposition as REDUCED SCALARS, losing exactly the
covariance this claim needs); for commitment gating, which channel's threshold
movement admits or refuses each commit; for residue and offline consolidation,
which channel's polarity determined each write.
CONFIRMING (i): the audit finds, at each shared convergence point, that the
converging channels have (a) DISTINCT learning targets -- no two trained toward the
same scalar -- and (b) DISTINCT gating conditions -- no two armed and disarmed by
the same predicate -- while sharing the consumer.
FALSIFYING (i): any shared convergence point is found where two or more
nominally-distinct affect streams have been collapsed to a common learning target
or a common gating predicate, such that the architecture is a single value scalar
wearing several names. Finding this ANYWHERE in the live consequential path
falsifies the distinctness constraint, independent of behavioural outcome.
CONFIRMING (ii): with the affect evaluators armed and non-degenerate, the
committed-selection variance share of the dominant channel is strictly LOWER than
with them disarmed, on >=2/3 seeds, by a margin scaled on the SD of the paired
delta plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING (ii), AND THE LIVE STATE OF THIS BRANCH: refuted if the dominant
channel's share is flat or RISES when the affect evaluators are armed. THIS BRANCH
CURRENTLY HAS A CONTRADICTING RESULT ON THE RECORD, WHICH ARC-088 DOES NOT CARRY
AND SHOULD. MECH-463 was registered as the sharpened version of exactly this
prediction, and its decisive test V3-EXQ-785a (2026-07-19; urgency set exogenously
over an 8.5x range, gate GREEN, non-degenerate, 1757 independent committed
selections, injection fidelity 5.6e-17, randomisation corr 0.0177,
effective_threshold genuinely moved 0.3761 -> 0.2570) found the incumbent share
moved 0.9375 -> 0.9411 (+0.0036 against a +0.02 threshold) and var_total fold
0.970. The 2026-07-20 autopsy filed does_not_support/standard. The null is TIGHT,
not underpowered: within-level share SE ~0.0044, so the measured gap sits under
1 SE. Reading: the global-scalar affective channels are neither de-concentrating
(ARC-088's prediction) nor amplifying (MECH-463's) but CAUSALLY INERT with respect
to the dominant channel -- and an inert channel prevents no collapse. TWO CAVEATS
MUST TRAVEL WITH THIS: single incumbent regime tested (harm-weighted), so
channel-agnosticism -- half of what is asserted -- is untested; and z_world
participation ratio ~1.06 leaves live the alternative that the substrate cannot
EXPRESS the effect. So this weakens the GLOBAL-SCALAR route to anti-collapse
specifically, and says nothing about the PER-CANDIDATE route (MECH-359, v4) or the
gated-evaluator route the claim's title actually names.

claims.claim_title: Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.
claims.falsifier_summary: The learned head matches the fixed per-action-class table on held-out combinations -- no generalisation gain -- or its bias fires when safe, or fails to extinguish, in which case the trainable form buys nothing over MECH-358.
claims.required_event: A directed, non-noop action taken while threat_scale > 0, followed by a temporally-close drop in z_harm_a not explained by passive drift -- and, for the extinction half, an expected relief action that fails to reduce harm.
claims.manipulation: use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner ON with use_relief_critic=True, against the fixed-arithmetic SD-059 EscapeAffordanceBridge EMA table, at matched threat exposure and matched bias_scale.
claims.control: The MECH-358 fixed per-first-action-class EMA table arm (current default), plus a novel-state generalisation probe -- state-action-threat combinations held out of training -- which is where a parametric critic must beat a lookup table if trainability is the claim's content.
claims.DV: Generalisation of relief credit to unseen state x action x threat-context combinations: predicted relief on held-out combinations versus the fixed table's, plus extinction rate when a previously-crediting action stops reducing harm, plus the resulting bounded E3 score-bias magnitude.
claims.instrument: TrainableEscapeAffordanceLearner exposes relief_values, best_escape_class, diagnostics() and a per-update TrainableEscapeAffordanceLearnerOutput carrying relief_target, relief_value, relief_loss, bias_max_abs, updated, optimizer_step and simulation_skipped -- the DV is fully recordable. What does not exist is any experiment that turns the flag on.
claims.consumer_locus: The bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias entering E3 via compute_approach_bias (agent.py:8837-8861), trained from the realized transition at agent.py:5146-5154 -- never a global approach signal.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The relief head must have headroom and be non-vacuous: threat must be present on some ticks and absent on others, directed non-noop actions must occur under threat, and action-contingent z_harm_a drops must be separable from passive environmental drift. A run where every relief target is zero, or where harm falls without any action, cannot discriminate a learned critic from the fixed EMA table.
claims.blocking_reason: Not a build gap. The head is built and fully wired (construction agent.py:2305-2327; update :5146; bias :8861; reset :3874) with a master switch use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner default False, and contract tests exist -- but zero experiments set that flag, so the manipulation has never been applied.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim's notes say the trainable parametric critic is 'PLANNED but NOT YET BUILT' and that the right next step is to BUILD it. That is wrong and was wrong at registration: ree_core/pfc/trainable_escape_affordance_learner.py landed 2026-06-08 (commits 7a0a417, 58535af), one day BEFORE the claim was registered on 2026-06-09, with PyTorch relief and safety heads and all four guards (bias_scale bound, threat_floor gate, leak_rate extinction, simulation_skipped MECH-094 safety).

The epistemic_category substrate_conditional suppression, justified by 'the head does not exist', therefore rests on a false premise and is holding this claim off the experiment-proposal lane without cause.

claims.claim_title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.
claims.falsifier_summary: Safety predictions are indistinguishable from the fixed table on held-out combinations, or track 'low harm' / 'recent relief' rather than prospective threat absence, or fail to extinguish on threat recurrence.
claims.required_event: A cue/context/action followed by threat absence (threat_scale falls to zero) licensing commitment release, and separately a 'safe'-predicted cue followed by threat recurrence, which must drive the negative target.
claims.manipulation: use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner ON with use_safety_predictor=True against the fixed MECH-358 safety EMA table; and, for the contrastive leg, a background feature deliberately confounded with relief so that an undisciplined predictor will over-generalise to it.
claims.control: The fixed per-action-class safety EMA arm, plus a z_goal-presence arm confirming the predictor is tracking threat ABSENCE and not goal presence, plus a confound-free arm where no background feature co-varies with relief.
claims.DV: Predicted safety on held-out cue x context x action combinations versus the fixed table; the rate at which safety predictions attach to the confounded background feature (the over-generalisation DV); and commitment-release / re-approach latency after threat offset.
claims.instrument: The learner records safety_target, safety_value, safety_loss and per-class safety_values, and get_state()/diagnostics() expose the positive, negative and noop-skipped counts -- so the prospective-safety DV is recordable. The over-generalisation DV is NOT: no contrastive term exists anywhere in the module (grep for 'contrast' returns zero hits), and the positive target is literally threat_scale <= 0.0 -> 1.0.
claims.consumer_locus: The bounded, threat-context-gated safety bias entering E3 through compute_approach_bias, and the commitment-release decision it is meant to license -- not the harm stream and not z_goal.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Threat must both offset and RECUR within a run, with cues that co-vary with threat absence separable from stable background features. If every low-harm state is also a safe-cue state, safety and 'low harm' are the same variable and the claim's own distinguishing failure mode cannot be tested.
claims.blocking_reason: Two layers. The trainable predictor is built and wired but no experiment enables it (flag default False, zero experiment hits). And the claim's distinguishing CONTRASTIVE discipline is genuinely absent from the implementation -- the safety target is set by threat_scale <= 0.0, which is precisely the 'safety == absence of threat' shortcut the claim warns against, so the over-generalisation leg has no instrument.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim's notes say the trainable safety predictor is 'PLANNED but NOT YET BUILT'. It landed 2026-06-08, a day before registration, as the use_safety_predictor half of TrainableEscapeAffordanceLearner, with positive targets on threat absence, negative targets on threat recurrence (the elif branch at lines 508-527) and leak-driven extinction.

claims.manipulation: Two arms over the same task and same agent: ARM_governed enforces the manifest -> review -> governance -> claim mediation (INV-077); ARM_direct grants direct score authority, allowing confidence updates straight from the evaluation channel.

claims.claim_title: Schema integration during offline/imagination-adjacent consolidation (MECH-272 probe-channel routing, MECH-273 sleep-half self-model aggregation) is constrained to recombining waking-derived trace primitives: the material a schema-integration pass restructures must trace back to real, committed (hypothesis_tag=False) waking experience, and a schema update computed from one imagination/consolidation cycle's output must not itself become input material for a later cycle's schema integration without an intervening waking-encoded checkpoint. Without this constraint, successive offline cycles could compound self-amplification of imagined content into schema structure -- confabulation by accretion rather than by single-event failure.
claims.falsifier_summary: A schema update produced by cycle N is consumed as integration input by cycle N+1 with no intervening waking-encoded episode, so imagination bootstraps off its own prior output across cycles.
claims.required_event: Two or more back-to-back sleep cycles in which the MECH-272 routing gate and MECH-273 self-model writeback both run, with the waking harm_replay_buffer held fixed (or empty) between them.
claims.manipulation: Compare cycle N+1's schema-integration input under (a) normal alternation with waking encoding between cycles and (b) forced back-to-back cycles with no waking encoding, tracing each item entering integration to its provenance.
claims.control: A cycle-1-only arm and a waking-checkpointed arm at matched cycle count, so any change measured at cycle N+1 is attributable to re-injected offline output rather than to extra gradient steps.
claims.DV: Fraction of items entering schema integration at cycle N+1 whose provenance is cycle N's own schema output rather than a hypothesis_tag=False waking episode, plus the magnitude of the E2_harm_s parameter change produced at cycle N+1 when the waking buffer contributes nothing new.
claims.instrument: Partially present. The waking gate is real and checkable -- agent.py buffers (z_harm, action) pairs into _harm_replay_buffer only when hypothesis_tag is False (~line 5921) -- and SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass documents its inputs and its single scoped MECH-094 exception. What is missing is any per-item provenance tag on the aggregator posterior store, so cross-cycle carry-over is currently visible only as an aggregate parameter delta.
claims.consumer_locus: The input construction of the offline schema-integration pass (MECH-272 routing into MECH-275/MECH-273 aggregation and E2_harm_s writeback), not the per-event MECH-094 write gate that MECH-094 itself owns.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least two successive offline cycles must run without an intervening waking-encoding checkpoint, which SleepLoopManager.force_cycle() makes producible on demand; with a single consolidation pass per waking bout the compounding failure mode cannot appear and the test is vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: The static provenance audit is runnable today -- the sleep cluster (replay_sampler, routing_gate, bayesian_aggregator, self_model_aggregator, phase_manager) is built and force_cycle exists -- but no experiment or audit has been run, and the aggregator carries no per-item provenance field, so the item-level clause must be inferred from code rather than recorded.

false_positives: Treating the sleep cluster as unbuilt would be wrong: phases B-E all exist and config carries a single convenience switch that arms use_mech285_sampler, use_mech272_routing, use_mech272_routing_consumer and use_mech273_self_model together.

GFLAG-0396 flags MECH-525 as a v3-phase claim depending on phase_locked v4 ARC-092; that routing conflict is unresolved and is a registry question, not a runnability one.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires MECH-272/MECH-273's schema-integration pass to run over
more than one offline (sleep or equivalent) cycle without an intervening waking-encoding
checkpoint; a substrate that only ever runs a single consolidation pass before returning to
waking cannot exhibit the compounding failure mode this claim is about.

CONFIRMING: an audit of MECH-272/273's actual input stream at each successive offline cycle
shows that every item entering schema integration traces back to a hypothesis_tag=False
(waking, committed) episode -- never to the SCHEMA OUTPUT of a prior offline cycle re-injected
as if it were fresh waking material. Cai et al. 2009's dissociation (REM restructures
associative links among waking-encoded primed words, without gaining new item-level content)
is the empirical LICIT-side shape this claim requires REE's own consolidation pass to match.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery that a schema update produced by one offline cycle is fed
back into a LATER offline cycle's schema-integration input without having first been
represented in, or corrected against, a subsequent waking (hypothesis_tag=False) episode --
i.e. the substrate lets imagination bootstrap off its own prior imagination, cycle over cycle,
with no waking-reality checkpoint between them. This is the accretion-confabulation failure
mode distinct from MECH-094's single-event failure mode (Schnider 2003): each individual write
might pass MECH-094's per-event gate while the SEQUENCE of writes still compounds unchecked
imagined content into schema structure.

PARTIAL AUDIT AVAILABLE TODAY: MECH-272/273 already exist in V3 (status: provisional /
stable-adjacent); a code audit of their input construction is possible now, before MECH-365

claims.claim_title: Outputs of counterfactual exploration (imagined/simulated candidate rollouts scored during E3 selection or equivalent planning) are LICIT only as priors for future waking testing -- i.e. as inputs to policy/value preference (which action to prefer, which hypothesis to test next) -- and are FORBIDDEN from being treated as knowledge: they must not be written into the world-model's own predictive parameters, used to validate or score a REAL prediction's accuracy, or logged as an established fact. This is REE's architectural analogue of expected-free-energy policy scoring (Friston et al. 2015): imagining a candidate's likely outcome to choose among candidates is a distinct operation from updating the model that did the imagining, and the two must not be allowed to collapse into one write path.

claims.required_event: An E3 selection tick whose candidate scores are computed from imagined rollouts, followed by any arbitration-weight, world-model parameter, prediction-validation or fact/schema write in the same or a later tick.
claims.manipulation: Enumerate every candidate-scoring site and trace its consumers; then open the known violating lever (use_simulation_mode_rule_gate=True with simulation_mode_rule_gate_admit_writes=True) as a positive control that the audit's detector actually fires.
claims.control: The gate's normal setting (admit_writes=False, blocking simulation writes) and the bit-identical master-off setting, so a detected write in the admit arm and no write in the block arm validate the audit rather than merely asserting compliance.
claims.DV: Per candidate-scoring site, a binary of whether the imagined score or outcome reaches (a) a parameter update, (b) a real-prediction accuracy score, or (c) a fact/schema write without an intervening enacted observation; plus the measured arbitration-weight delta under the admit-writes positive control.
claims.instrument: Present. simulation_mode_rule_gate.py exposes effective_simulation_mode(simulation_mode, site) with a documented truth table and the V3-EXQ-543c falsifier flag; e3_selector.py contains no backward()/optimizer call at all, so candidate scores never train parameters directly; MECH-094 call-site gating is explicit throughout agent.py, goal.py, bla.py and cea.py.
claims.consumer_locus: The boundary between policy/preference evaluation (which candidate wins, what prior it sets for a future waking test) and generative-model updating -- the arbitration-weight and parameter write sites, not the selection decision itself.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least one code path must exist where an imagined candidate evaluation could plausibly reach a durable store, otherwise the claim is vacuously satisfied. Such a path does exist: MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate carries an explicit simulation_mode_rule_gate_admit_writes lever that ADMITS simulation writes into arbitration weights, and MECH-273 Phase E is a scoped documented exception to the no-parameter-writes rule.

claims.claim_title: ARC-092 licenses plan optimisation (choosing among imagined candidate action sequences) as LICIT, while forbidding durable world-model updates driven by imagined content. But plan optimisation and world-model update are not always cleanly separable in a single learned system: if E3's candidate-scoring pathway shares parameters, representations, or a training signal with the world-model/predictor (E1/E2), then IMPROVING plan optimisation performance could, as a side effect, also shift world-model parameters -- exactly the FORBIDDEN path, smuggled in through a shared substrate rather than an explicit write. Where, mechanistically, does plan-optimisation's LICIT gradient/update signal stop and the world-model's FORBIDDEN one begin, in REE's actual (not merely intended) parameter-sharing architecture?

the designed control law HOLDS, measured entirely at the PROPOSAL layer -- upstream
of the E3 committed-selection argmin, and therefore NOT subject to the G4
shared-conversion absorption. (1) Detector non-vacuity: stuck_score rises above
threshold under impasse and decays as the impasse clears, with the asymmetric EMA
producing fast rise / slow fall (the MECH-343 hysteresis). MET, V3-EXQ-694 C1, 3/3.
(2) Regulator load-bearing: ON adds exactly `extra` candidates and lifts
differentiable_cem_temperature transiently, restoring it afterward; OFF is
bit-identical. MET, V3-EXQ-694 C2, 3/3. (3) THE OPEN LEG: the count-widening plus
temperature lift must actually CONVERT into proposal-layer diversity --
candidate_first_action_entropy must RISE under stuck relative to a within-seed
pre-stuck baseline AND relative to the OFF arm's own drift, then decay. This is the
criterion SD-061's own evidence_quality_note names and it has NOT been met.
(4) Goal-salience guard holds: the detector does NOT fire on goal ABANDONMENT
(stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-gone) -- a negative control with salience withdrawn must
show no widening. (5) Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority
remain untouched: no change to score-margin distribution or admission counters
attributable to the regulator.

not raise first-action entropy, i.e. the extra candidates are duplicates or the CEM
temperature lift is swamped. THIS IS THE LIVE RISK, and there is already data
pointing at it: V3-EXQ-694's ON arm shows first_action_entropy FALLING on 3/3 seeds
(-0.0812 / -0.0734 / -0.0953) against a mixed-sign OFF drift. The 694 script
explicitly excluded this from its gate as a "behavioural-conversion question for the
Q-056 governance falsifier", a defensible scoping call that leaves the design
decision's own stated success criterion unmet and pointing the wrong way. (2) The
asymmetric EMA does not produce hysteresis -- fall time matches rise time, so there
is no decay dynamic to gate on. (3) The regulator perturbs scoring or commitment
(score-margin distribution or mech090_n_elevation_admitted/_blocked shift
attributably) -- falsifies the design's core "widens proposals, not behaviour"
separation.

conversion -- that is MECH-343's claim and it is ceiling-bound.

claims.claim_title: E2 world-forward carries a conditional predictive-uncertainty head (distribution-free quantile form) AVAILABLE TO E3 commitment gating -- consumer built, never exercised: E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate has never been True in any experiment driver in the repo (narrowed from 'feeding E3 commitment gating' 2026-09-10, GFLAG-0216). The forward model emits a per-prediction predictive spread that tracks realized error, instead of relying only on E3's running-variance EMA (a temporally-smoothed global estimate whose predicted uncertainty has near-zero per-point error correlation).
claims.falsifier_summary: Same-sign |coverage_err_80| > 0.05 on >= 4 of 5 seeds (narrow to the ranking reading), or precision_error_corr failing its permutation null, or yoked_divergence_frac == 0.0 with all preconditions met (consumer inertness), or the SD-031 cf_gap dropping below 0.75 of head-OFF.
claims.required_event: Held-out (z_world_t, a_t) -> z_world_{t+1} transitions under a trained z_world encoder, plus, for the consumer leg, live E3 commit/hold decisions on >= 300 candidate ticks.
claims.manipulation: Swap the E2 forward uncertainty source: the SD-063 quantile/pinball head (use_e2_world_uncertainty=True) versus the matched point head and E3's running-variance EMA; and, for the C4 leg, set E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate True with the head's predictive_variance supplied at the commit gate.
claims.control: Matched point head and the EMA null at identical seeds, identical candidate sets and identical transition sets, with the gate flag the only difference in the yoked arm; SD-031 agency-residual guard held at >= 0.75 of its head-OFF cf_gap.
claims.DV: coverage_80 error against nominal 0.80, pvar_relative_spread, precision_error_corr against its permutation null, CRPS improvement over the point head, and yoked_divergence_frac (fraction of candidate ticks whose commit/hold decision changes when the per-input variance replaces the EMA).
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_world_uncertainty.py records predictive_variance and pvar spread; 716a/977 manifests carry coverage_80, precision_error_corr and CRPS. NO instrument exists for yoked_divergence_frac because no live producer feeds the gate.
claims.consumer_locus: The ARC-016 commit decision inside E3Selector.select() -- commit_variance compared against effective_threshold -- not offline predictor quality.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All four of the WWA's stated gates must hold in the scored run: encoders_trained true, e2_world_uncertainty_last_pvar_relative_spread >= 1.0 (relative, never absolute range), norm_residual = point_rmse / target_std >= 0.05, and n_test >= 200 held-out transitions per arm per seed.
claims.blocking_reason: The commit-gate consumer exists in e3_selector.py:4047 but nothing produces its input in the live loop: agent.py builds _e3_select_kwargs (9558-9697) with no conditional_predictive_variance key, so select() always receives None and falls back to the EMA even with the flag True. The only producer-to-consumer wiring is a module docstring example and three contract tests.
false_positives: GFLAG-0216 diagnosed the gap as 'no driver ever ASSIGNS use_conditional_precision_gate'. That is true but understates it: even assigning True would change nothing, because agent.py never passes conditional_predictive_variance into select(), so the gate is unreachable from the live loop regardless of the flag.
claims.auditor_notes: The C4 fix is one kwarg in agent.py's _e3_select_kwargs (read head.predictive_variance for the leading candidate's (z_world, a) and pass it), not a new mechanism. EXP-1400 already proposes the two-arm design; it should be amended to state the plumbing as a precondition, otherwise a run setting only the flag will silently measure the EMA arm twice.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four must hold in the scored run, or the run self-routes
`substrate_not_ready` rather than reporting a verdict):
(i) ENCODER TRAINED -- the P0 warmup ran (`encoders_trained: true`); an untrained z_world encoder yields
a near-invariant latent and a trivially-fittable spread (the MECH-353 / V3-EXQ-642 vacuity lesson, and
the reason V3-EXQ-977's `encoders_trained: false` coverage reading is indicative rather than decisive).
(ii) HEAD TRAINED, NOT RANDOM-INIT -- `e2_world_uncertainty_last_pvar_relative_spread >= 1.0` evaluated
across all action classes at a fixed z_world. RELATIVE spread, never absolute range: per
`e2_world_uncertainty.py`'s measured note, an UNTRAINED head has the LARGER absolute range (8.63e-04 vs
7.14e-04) and passes any absolute-range gate, so `last_uncertainty_dev_range > 0` is necessary but NOT
sufficient (this is the corrected ARC-065 section-5 gate; V3-EXQ-949 used `HEAD_REL_SPREAD_FLOOR = 1.0`).
(iii) TRANSITIONS NON-DETERMINISTIC ENOUGH FOR AN INTERVAL TO MEAN ANYTHING -- this arm's own normalised
held-out residual `norm_residual = point_rmse / target_std >= 0.05` (716a's
`readiness_norm_residual_floor`; 977 measured 0.087-0.155 and 716a 0.414). A deterministic transition set
makes the nominal-80% band trivially wide-or-empty and the coverage test vacuous.
(iv) SUFFICIENT HELD-OUT MASS -- `n_test >= 200` held-out transitions per arm per seed (977's floor;
716a banked 714 eval / 2142).

CONFIRMING (all three, majority of >= 3 seeds, with the SD-031 guard held):
(C1) CALIBRATION -- empirical coverage of the monotone-rearranged `[q0.1, q0.9]` band on held-out
`(z_world_t, a_t) -> z_world_{t+1}` transitions matches its nominal 0.80:
`|coverage_80 - 0.80| <= max(0.03, 2 x SD(coverage_80) across seeds)`. The absolute floor of 0.03 is
what stops a high-variance run from passing by being noisy.
(C2) THE WIDTH CARRIES INFORMATION BEYOND A CONSTANT -- (a) `pvar_relative_spread > 0` and
(b) `precision_error_corr >= 0.15` (716a's `corr_floor`) AND above its own permutation-null p95 (977's
instrument; measured p95 ~0.055 there). Both legs are required: (a) alone is passed by a head whose
width varies arbitrarily, (b) alone is undefined for a constant-width band.
(C3) IT BEATS THE NULL IT CLAIMS TO REPLACE -- CRPS improvement over the matched point head
>= 2% (716a's `crps_improve_frac`), and `precision_error_corr` strictly above E3's running-variance EMA
null, which is 0.0 by construction.
(C4, the consumer half the title asserts) WITH `E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate = True` and the
head supplying `conditional_predictive_variance`, a YOKED comparison against the EMA fallback (identical
seeds, identical candidate sets, gate the only difference) shows `yoked_divergence_frac > 0` on
>= 300 candidate ticks -- i.e. the per-input spread changes at least some commit/hold decisions.

FALSIFYING (any one):
(F1) COVERAGE SYSTEMATICALLY OFF -- `|coverage_err_80| > 0.05` with the SAME SIGN on >= 4 of 5 seeds.
This is the Chung-2021 failure mode already carried as `mixed` literature on this claim, and it is
exactly what V3-EXQ-977 measures on z_world at 5/5 seeds under-covering (0.7015-0.7346, mean err 0.0846)
with an untrained encoder. A pinball head can win CRPS and still be miscalibrated; if C1 fails while C3
passes, SD-063's per-prediction spread is a good RANKING signal and a bad PROBABILITY, and the claim
must be narrowed to the ranking reading (which is what the E3 commit gate, a threshold comparison in
variance space, actually needs) rather than kept as stated.
(F2) THE INTERVAL WIDTH CARRIES NO INFORMATION BEYOND A CONSTANT -- `precision_error_corr` fails to beat
its permutation null, or `pvar_relative_spread` is at floor while precondition (ii) passes. The head is
then an expensive constant band and the EMA null is not beaten.
(F3) CONSUMER INERTNESS -- C4's `yoked_divergence_frac == 0.0` with all four preconditions met. The head
is computed and never consumed at the commit gate; SD-063's "feeding E3 commitment gating" clause is
then false as stated, independently of C1-C3. Precedent that this is a real risk, not a formality:
V3-EXQ-949's `ARM_B314_ON_AUTH_OFF` (`yoked_divergence_frac` 0.0, per-candidate deviation 1.5e-05 vs a
score range of 277) and V3-EXQ-964's FAIL label `accumulator_live_but_never_changes_committed_action`.
(F4) SD-031 GUARD BREACHED -- the E2WorldForward agency residual (`cf_gap`) drops below 0.75 of its
head-OFF value under joint training (716a's `c3_preserve_frac`). Structurally defended (separate module,
detached inputs and target) but still empirically required on every scoring run.

claims.claim_title: Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. claims.control: The parameter/compute-matched ISOLATED arm supplies each module's marginal gain, whose sum is the additive baseline; the blocked-share-zero readiness readout is the negative control that the isolation is real.
claims.DV: Joint world-model R2 plus affordance accuracy of the INTEGRATED arm minus the additive baseline (sum of the isolated modules' marginal gains), scored against a pre-registered margin built on the SD of the paired per-seed delta plus an absolute floor.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All three readiness gates must be green and measured in the run itself -- non-zero cross-module gradient on the shared latent, iterative inference iterated to convergence, and an active consolidation transfer pass -- plus the recalibrated readiness-cosine tolerance band, since a min-cosine gate false-routed V3-EXQ-680d on gradient-orthogonality noise.

claims.what_would_answer: V3 ablation. ARM INTEGRATED: E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model (and, in a third arm, the object spine) trained over a SHARED L-space latent with cross-module gradient flow. ARM ISOLATED: parameter- and compute-matched modules trained with NO shared features (gradient stop between streams). PASS = joint world-model R2 + affordance accuracy of the integrated arm EXCEEDS the additive baseline (sum of each isolated module's marginal gain) by a pre-registered margin. FAIL = integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline. READINESS PRECONDITION (the discriminating non-degeneracy gate, per Daniel 2026-06-12): the integration machinery must demonstrably be doing cross-module work before the test means anything -- (i) the shared latent must carry NON-ZERO cross-module gradient (measured), (ii) the inference loop must be running to convergence, and (iii) offline/consolidation transfer (DMN-analogue + sleep replay, MECH-121) must be active and moving traces across modules. claims.manipulation: Three arms: CTRL = q_true only; NON_POTENTIAL = a raw/absolute proximity bonus retaining a per-candidate entry-vantage nuisance; POTENTIAL = the difference form gamma*Phi(s') - Phi(s) over the same proximity, in which the nuisance cancels by construction.
claims.control: The CTRL arm on the identical base landscape and seeds, which fixes the clean-goal optimum the two proxy arms are scored against.
claims.DV: Diversion of the selected candidate's true-goal quality from the clean-goal optimum, measured separately per arm (diversion_np vs diversion_pot), with a one-sided tolerance on the potential arm.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_872_inv087_proxy_tethering_constraint.py, which ran 2026-08-02 and recorded a PASS with diversion_np clearly positive and diversion_pot within tolerance.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 candidate selection, i.e. the point at which an additive shaping term can change which action is committed -- not the learning update.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The clean-goal optimum must be discriminable -- selected-candidate true quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on an identical base landscape -- and V3-EXQ-872's readiness checks (clean_landscape_discriminative, entry_noise_moves_argmin, proxy_correlates_with_truth, probe_regime_uncommitted) all recorded that as met.
claims.blocking_reason: R0: the registered falsifier exists, is non-degenerate and has already been executed and passed. The residual is a different boundary -- the Grzes 2017 entry added 2026-08-07 shows potential-difference invariance can fail in EPISODIC finite-horizon settings with goal-terminal states, and the single-hop, no-environment, no-training probe cannot reach that regime.
false_positives: The claim is not falsifier-less or unrunnable: its WWA was instantiated as V3-EXQ-872 and executed to a PASS on 2026-08-02, so any sweep counting INV-087 as an untested candidate is wrong.
claims.auditor_notes: If governance wants the episodic leg, it needs a multi-step environment arm with goal-terminal states, not a re-run of 872; that is a new node's worth of work and should not be folded into this claim's existing WWA.
claims.what_would_answer: Inject a maintenance proxy that is NOT a potential difference over goal-proximity (e.g. a raw progress bonus) into the E3 selection landscape and show it shifts the selected-candidate distribution AWAY from the clean-goal optimum (true-goal quality of the selected candidate drops), while a potential-based proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s)) over the SAME proximity leaves the clean-goal optimum intact. NON-DEGENERACY: the clean-goal optimum must be discriminable -- selected- candidate true-quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on an identical base landscape (else nothing to divert). Tractable as a controlled E3-selection probe in the V3-EXQ-674 family (no env / no training -> avoids the monostrategy / z_goal-collapse confounds). FAIL = the non-potential proxy does NOT divert behaviour (tethering constraint not load-bearing on this substrate).

claims.claim_title: state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

claims.claim_title: priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.
claims.falsifier_summary: Priority weighting is indistinguishable from matched-mass uniform admit on >= 2/3 seeds, or any lift disappears once total write mass is matched, or the only priority that works is reward magnitude -- which Carey 2019 biologically falsifies as the posited signal.
claims.required_event: A ghost/replay/DMN pass during which the MECH-319 gate is open (admit_writes=True), supplying a stream of replayed transitions of differing update-utility to the rule-arbitration layer.
claims.manipulation: Grade the admitted writes by a per-transition update-utility (surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage) priority weight instead of writing them uniformly -- substrate that does not exist: SimulationModeRuleGate.effective_simulation_mode returns a bool, and LateralPFCAnalog.update applies one scalar gate-modulated EMA rate to the whole source vector.
claims.control: Uniform admit at matched TOTAL write mass (MECH-319 admit_writes=True with equal integrated eff_eta), plus the BLOCK arm as the 628 reference, on the same captured early-waking latents so the only difference is the ordering/weighting of the admitted writes.
claims.DV: Rule-arbitration retention/selectivity measured AT rule_state (per-arm rule_state delta across the replay phase and post-replay divergence between priority-weighted and uniform arms), not at committed action.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-628 already records rule_state deltas and the ADMIT-vs-BLOCK divergence at exactly this locus, and SimulationModeRuleGate.get_state gives per-site admit/block counts. Missing: any per-transition priority scalar to record, and any selectivity statistic over rule_state beyond norm deltas.
claims.consumer_locus: The replay write channel into the rule-arbitration layer -- the GAP-K write-gating boundary at the LateralPFCAnalog.update / GatedPolicy.forward replay call sites, upstream of the F-dominated E3 commit.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The rule_state readout must be non-degenerate under admitted replay: the ADMIT arm's rule_state delta across the replay phase must clear a floor materially above the BLOCK arm's ~0 (V3-EXQ-628 used ADMIT_DELTA_THRESHOLD 1e-4 with EPS_BLOCK 1e-7), and total write mass must be matched across arms, otherwise a priority-weighting difference is unreadable or is a write-mass artefact.
claims.blocking_reason: The graded write primitive is unbuilt: the gate is a bool and the rule_state write is a single scalar-gated EMA, so there is no per-transition weight to manipulate or record. A matched-total-write-mass control is therefore also unconstructible, and the claim's own pre-gate warns the rule_state readout may be pinned.
false_positives: The claim's routing of a committed/behavioural variant behind MECH-439 is correct and is not itself the blocker here: the rule_state-level test is blocked one level earlier, on the absence of a graded write primitive, not on conversion.
claims.auditor_notes: GAP-K is in-progress with MECH-319's binary gate landed and 628 PASS; MECH-443 needs only a write-primitive enrichment entry under that node, not a new claim. SD-082's measured rule_state -> action-bias propagation of exactly 0.0 is a reason to keep this DV at rule_state, not a reason to widen it.
claims.what_would_answer: SUPPORTS if arming a per-transition update-utility (surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage) priority weight on the admitted replay writes lifts rule-arbitration retention/selectivity -- measured AT rule_state (upstream of the F-dominated E3 commit, in the GAP-K write-gating locus, NOT at committed action) -- STRICTLY above a matched-TOTAL-write-mass uniform-admit control (MECH-319 admit_writes=True with equal write mass) on >=2/3 seeds. FALSIFIES if priority-weighting is inert versus the matched-mass uniform admit, OR if any lift is explained solely by greater total write mass (the matched-mass guard isolates this degenerate confound), OR if priority is operationalized as reward magnitude / committed-policy value rather than value-of-the-update (Carey et al. 2019: hippocampal replay biases AWAY from the currently-preferred outcome, so a reward-keyed priority is biologically falsified). Pre-gate: the readout must be non-degenerate -- if admitted replay barely moves rule_state on the current substrate so the metric is pinned across seeds, the falsifier is vacuous and MECH-443 re-routes to a replay-write-magnitude substrate enrichment (NOT to MECH-439). Any COMMITTED/behavioural variant of this test is MECH-439-conversion-ceiling-gated (V3-EXQ-654g: the rule_state channel cannot move the argmax today and the 569i top-k bypass does not reach it) and is sequenced behind the 689a F-rebalance.

claims.claim_title: staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.
