REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.
claims.falsifier_summary: The split yields no behavioural or failure-mode distinction beyond the additive MECH-449 scalar under positive straddle and non-zero da -- decorative, and dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-versus-decorative ablation test.
claims.required_event: Loop-segregated selection episodes containing both approach-avoidance conflict candidates (high Go and high No-Go simultaneously) and indifference candidates (low Go and low No-Go), with a non-zero tonic-DA proxy.
claims.manipulation: use_d1_d2_population_split ON versus OFF at matched seeds, plus a targeted asymmetric lesion sweeping d2_da_gain (D2 hypofunction) against d1_da_gain held fixed, and a single-scalar lesion control that scales the additive accumulator by the same amount.
claims.control: The additive-scalar arm (split OFF, MECH-449 Go-promote/No-Go-suppress sign only) at matched seeds and matched loop segregation, plus a da == 0 shadow arm (loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0) isolating the dopamine dependence.
claims.DV: Leg (i): separation of committed-behaviour statistics between conflict and indifference cells that the additive scalar collapses, read from loop_d1_d2_conflict_signal against committed-class outcomes. Leg (ii): a disorder-analog behavioural signature under D2 hypofunction (perseveration rate / commit-run length / action-initiation rate) that the matched single-scalar lesion does not reproduce, on >= 2/3 seeds.
claims.instrument: loop_d1_d2_conflict_signal, loop_*_straddle_frac and loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0 are exposed in e3_selector.last_score_diagnostics and surfaced by experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py; there is NO registered disorder-analog readout (akinesia / perseveration episode statistics) for leg (ii).
claims.consumer_locus: The within-loop selection layer of E3 -- the two-population representation feeding cross-loop arbitration -- not the learning-update D1-LTP/D2-LTD asymmetry, which already existed.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Within-loop accumulators must straddle zero on a non-trivial fraction of eligible candidate pairs (loop_assoc_straddle_frac / loop_limbic_straddle_frac > 0) and dopamine da must be non-zero, since at da == 0 the net equals accum bit-identically. claims.claim_title: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.
claims.falsifier_summary: With the same substrate and a scoring null, settling converges to the same argmin winner and adds no entropy over the pre-filters -- the recurrence is unnecessary in V3.
claims.required_event: Committed-selection steps where several first-action classes are eligible and a modulatory channel disagrees with the F-winner, so an attractor flip is possible in principle.
claims.manipulation: Run bounded mutual-inhibition settling rounds over the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field before commit (parameter-free kernel and/or learned W_lat), against the one-shot argmin readout, and across segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops rather than one arena.
claims.control: Settling OFF (byte-identical), a uniform-kernel ablation arm isolating the structured class-surround, and a magnitude-matched same-layer random-structure null as the noise-as-diversity guard.
claims.DV: Committed-action-class entropy lift over the one-shot argmin readout, and the rate of committed-attractor flips away from the F-winner, with no harmful-class disinhibition.
claims.instrument: e3_selector._soft_competitive_settle emits per-round diagnostics (scs_mean_round_delta) and the corrected non-hold-weighted GateDV instrument landed at experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py; the older 700-lineage null perturbed policy temperature and was decoupled from the committed-class DV.
claims.consumer_locus: The within-eligible modulatory field immediately before commit, inside segregated loops whose cross-loop arbitration happens after within-loop competition -- not the single shared foraging selector.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The settling must move the field across rounds (scs_mean_round_delta greater than zero; measured 5-8) with the uniform-kernel ablation reproducing OFF bit-identically, and a magnitude-matched null injected at the settling-field layer must be able to verify-lift committed-class entropy, which the 700-lineage policy-temperature null could not.

claims.claim_title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
claims.falsifier_summary: Per-loop ablations leave committed-class behaviour indistinguishable from a matched single-arena parameterisation on the corrected instrument -- segregation is then a re-parameterisation rather than an architectural requirement, and ARC-110 should be narrowed to its already-weakened artefact clause.
claims.required_event: Committed-selection ticks on which the limbic/motivational valuation of a candidate disagrees with the motor loop's F-ranked preference, so within-loop competition and cross-loop arbitration can diverge.
claims.manipulation: use_loop_segregation ON (N >= 3 parallel motor/associative/limbic loops, each with its own eligibility mask, Go/No-Go and settling, arbitrated after within-loop competition) versus the single collapsed E3 arena, plus per-loop DROP ablations isolating each loop's contribution.
claims.control: A0_SINGLE_ARENA on matched seeds, plus the magnitude-matched in-layer same-layer null injected at the eligibility/settling field (loop_segregation_noise_on) so a lift attributable to added structure-free variance is removed.
claims.DV: Committed-action-class entropy accumulated only on verified-fresh E3 selections, A1_LOOPS strictly above max(A0_SINGLE_ARENA, the live null) plus margin; and for the architectural leg, a loop-localised conversion the collapsed arena provably cannot produce, shown by per-loop ablation.
claims.instrument: experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py and the 707c fresh-select repair supply the corrected committed-class recorder; the per-loop diagnostics (loop_cross_loop_w_eff, m_range, limbic_ge_motor) exist in e3_selector. What has no instrument is the architectural leg's distinctive prediction -- there is no readout that separates 'loops are load-bearing' from 'loops are a re-parameterisation of one arena'.
claims.consumer_locus: Committed-action selection: within-loop competition first, cross-loop arbitration after, so F can dominate only the motor loop and cannot drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' value.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The per-loop channels must carry live cross-loop variance -- a segregated loop pinned to the motor loop's winner is a vacuous split. 707c met this (named-channel routing live, graded limbic competition worst cell 4.28 against a 0.05 floor, a live same-layer null, 4/4 divergent seeds), so the narrow leg's precondition is satisfied and should not be re-derived.
claims.blocking_reason: The claim bundles an architectural assertion with a narrow artefact sub-hypothesis; only the narrow one was operationalised, and 707c settled it (weakens) on a valid instrument. The surviving assertion has no written falsifier, and the learned-integration rescue it depends on has never been validly measured for conversion (hold-weighted DV; 713x re-letter refused and the refusal holds).
false_positives: The 707b-2026-06-29 weakens was withdrawn as a measurement_test_design_defect (hold-weighted histogram entropy, 97.6% exposure imbalance); the same conclusion only became admissible when 707c reproduced it on a clean instrument.

claims.claim_title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.
claims.falsifier_summary: Every observed context effect is reproducible by context-conditioned gain on a fixed weight set -- the ARC-044 gain form suffices and ARC-111 is over-specification.
claims.required_event: Repeated committed selections in at least two distinguishable z_world contexts that impose different channel orderings, with enough per-context experience for a local plasticity rule to separate them.
claims.manipulation: Context-indexed weights ON versus OFF: a per-context effective weight set at the E3 gating layer versus the shipped single global w_chan, with the ARC-044 gain form (terrain_weight, precision, mode-conditioned write gating) armed identically in both arms.
claims.control: The gain-only arm -- context-varying gain over a fixed weight set -- which is the discriminator: a gain model can rescale a fixed policy but cannot REORDER it.
claims.DV: Context-dependent REORDERING of committed channels (rank change, not rescaling) on at least 2 of 3 seeds, together with measured cross-context variance of the learned weights.
claims.instrument: The readouts exist: lcg_w_chan_range and fcg_w_chan_finer_range/std are emitted per tick, and last_channel_terms gives per-candidate channel biases for a rank readout. What does not exist is any per-context weight object for them to read -- w_chan and w_chan_finer are single global buffers, so cross-context weight variance is structurally zero.
claims.consumer_locus: The learned connection weights of the E3 channel-gating layer as a function of context -- the transfer function itself, not a multiplicative gain applied to a fixed one.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A context variable must actually index the weights: the substrate must hold more than one effective weight set, selected or generated per context, with measured cross-context variance. A single weight vector shared across contexts is the gain model in disguise and makes the discriminator vacuous.

claims.claim_title: Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

claims.claim_title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).
claims.falsifier_summary: ON equals OFF everywhere (the term never moves committed action -- decorative, dropped per the ARC-106 ablation test), or ON avoids the irreversible branch regardless of uncertainty (un-gated risk aversion, not the claimed quasi-option-value mechanism).
claims.required_event: A choice between a cheap REVERSIBLE branch and a costly IRREVERSIBLE branch (a one-way door or a region-collapsing consumable) whose selection measurably changes the agent's reachable-future-option count -- an environment transition CausalGridWorld cannot currently generate.
claims.manipulation: Add an E3 option-value cost term penalising the post-action drop in reachable distinct future states/goals, scaled by forecast PE, and cross it ON/OFF against MANIPULATED outcome uncertainty (high versus low forecast PE) at matched reward.
claims.control: The term-OFF arm at identical seeds and identical branch structure, plus a low-uncertainty condition in the term-ON arm as the within-arm comparator that distinguishes uncertainty-GATED preference from flat risk-aversion.
claims.DV: Probability of committing to the option-preserving branch, as a function of measured forecast uncertainty: the ON-minus-OFF difference must be large at HIGH uncertainty and converge to zero at LOW uncertainty, with the reachable-option count per branch reported alongside.
claims.instrument: Nothing records reachable-option count: grep of causal_grid_world.py and e3_selector.py finds no reachability, option-value or empowerment quantity, and config.py carries no such knob. The nearest existing object is the Q-080.a irreversible exertion ratchet (_exertion_permanent), which is resource depletion, not option-space foreclosure.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 trajectory scoring at the committed-selection boundary -- a self-directed, non-harm decision cost sitting alongside harm/benefit/goal/residue, distinct from INV-026's foreclosure-of-OTHERS harm and from MECH-094 write irreversibility.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both non-degeneracy gates the claim names, measured per arm: the two branches must differ in post-action reachable distinct states/goals by more than a floor (else the cost term has nothing to act on), AND forecast uncertainty (E2 forward-PE or E3 running_variance) must VARY across the manipulated conditions by more than a floor (else the gating clause is untestable and only un-gated risk-aversion can be read).
claims.blocking_reason: Neither of the two substrates the claim names exists: CausalGridWorld generates no reachable-option-dissociating branch, and E3 has no option-value cost term or reachable-option instrument. With no reachable-option count recorded, even the non-degeneracy gate cannot be evaluated.
false_positives: V3 is not wholly innocent of irreversibility: causal_grid_world carries a Q-080.a irreversible exertion ratchet, so 'REE has no irreversibility axis' would be wrong -- what is missing is specifically reachable-OPTION-SPACE foreclosure, not irreversibility as such.

The env extension is the cheaper of the two and is the one that unblocks measurement.

A future ablation SUPPORTS this if, with the term ON vs OFF under MANIPULATED outcome uncertainty, the ON arm prefers the option-preserving action MORE than OFF specifically when forecast uncertainty is HIGH and converges to OFF when it is LOW (uncertainty- GATED), on a strict majority of seeds. claims.claim_title: Should EFFORT / energy expenditure COUPLE to REE's harm / residue / allostatic stream (over-exertion -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent state, treated with harm's irreversibility-aware special status), with energy-conservation weighted as an evolutionarily-PRIMARY drive (a least-effort prior) -- or does the existing VALUE-SUBTRACTION (dACC EVC effort_cost, MECH-320/ARC-068 opportunity-cost-of-time) + pACC allostatic load already suffice WITHOUT a harm-coupling? I.e. is wasted/excessive effort a 'harm' in REE, or only a foregone value?
claims.falsifier_summary: The value-subtraction plus allostatic-load baseline already reproduces all three behaviours and the harm coupling adds nothing measurable -- effort is a foregone value, mint no mechanism.
claims.required_event: Two equal-length corridors to the same benefit with different per-cell effort cost, plus a sustained high-effort regime long enough for the exertion accumulator and its irreversible ratchet to move.
claims.manipulation: effort_harm_coupling_enabled on versus off (Q-080.a), routing effort-driven depletion into the z_harm_a / harm_obs_a stream; and a least-effort prior on versus off under effort_benefit_asymmetry=0.0 (Q-080.b).
claims.control: The value-subtraction-only baseline (dACC EVC effort_cost plus pACC allostatic load, harm coupling off), plus the CONTROL_ASYM arm with effort_benefit_asymmetry > 0 as the non-vacuity check on that baseline.
claims.DV: Three behaviours the baseline should not produce: low-corridor entry fraction under tied benefit, protective disengagement rate under chronic exertion before depletion, and avoidance of exertion beyond the irreversible ratchet mark.
claims.instrument: causal_grid_world.py records per-step effort cost, the exertion load, _exertion_permanent ratchet and the coupling into harm_obs_a; v3_exq_730_q080a_effort_harm_coupling.py and v3_exq_731_q080b_least_effort_prior.py record the criteria. Only 731 has run.
claims.consumer_locus: Whether excessive effort enters the harm/allostatic stream with harm's irreversibility-aware handling, or remains a subtracted value term at the dACC EVC boundary.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The env must show a genuine effort/benefit dissociation AND a responsive value term: the CONTROL_ASYM arm must prefer the HIGH-effort corridor when benefit justifies it. V3-EXQ-731 failed exactly this non-vacuity control (C2, 0 of 3 seeds), so the value-subtraction baseline was inert at the tested settings.
claims.blocking_reason: The env and both drivers are fully built, but the only run (V3-EXQ-731, 2026-07-09) failed its own non-vacuity control: the value term did not prefer the HIGH corridor even when benefit justified it, so the baseline arm both experiments contrast against is degenerate. V3-EXQ-730, the primary harm-coupling sub-question, has never run.
false_positives: The claim's live_status still cites decision:Q-080@2026-07-10 narrow_open_question/applied and does not reference the V3-EXQ-731 FAIL that landed the day before, so the record reads as if no run has been attempted.
claims.auditor_notes: V3-EXQ-731 is UNAUTOPSIED (confirmed against the contamination corpus audit's autopsy column) and is Q-080's only experimental entry, also flagged under GFLAG-0304 as hazard-free without the contamination opt-out. claims.what_would_answer: NARROWED 2026-07-09 (/claim-synthesis) into three orthogonal, independently-testable sub-questions -- Q-080.a harm-coupling, Q-080.b least-effort prior, Q-080.c MECH-454 energy-grounding -- enumerated with their discriminating tests, version scopes, and lit anchors under status_note. The overall discriminating frame is unchanged: DISCRIMINATING TEST (or derivation). Build an env that DISSOCIATES effort from benefit: a LOW-effort and a HIGH-effort path to the SAME benefit, with a measurable per-action energy/effort cost, plus a chronic-exertion regime (sustained high effort that could deplete). ANSWERED 'effort SHOULD be harm-coupled / energy-conservation primary' if routing effort into the harm/allostatic stream (effort -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent cost with harm's irreversibility-aware handling) produces behaviour the VALUE-SUBTRACTION baseline does NOT: (a) a least-effort PRIOR (prefers the low-effort path when benefit is indifferent, by default), (b) protective DISENGAGEMENT under chronic over-exertion (fatigue/allostatic withdrawal before depletion), and (c) irreversibility- aware caution (avoids over-exerting into a depletion it cannot cheaply reverse). ANSWERED 'existing machinery suffices, close' if the dACC EVC value-subtraction + pACC allostatic load ALREADY reproduce (a)/(b)/(c) and the harm-coupling adds nothing measurable (then effort is a foregone value, not a harm -- do NOT mint a mechanism). NON-DEGENERACY (else the question is untestable): the env must offer a genuine low-vs-high-effort dissociation to the SAME benefit AND a chronic-exertion regime, with the effort/energy cost measurable and varying -- if the two paths cost the same energy, or depletion never accrues, neither pole can be distinguished.

claims.claim_title: competence_based_intrinsic_motivation / goal_achievement_progress_wanting. A wanting bonus indexed to the agent's RATE-OF-IMPROVEMENT in ACHIEVING its own active goals: per active goal, an EMA of the derivative of goal-achievement competence (success-rate, or 1 - proximity-at-termination) injected as intrinsic wanting alongside MECH-229 VALENCE_WANTING, biasing the agent toward goals it is currently getting BETTER at reaching. This is the SECOND intrinsic-motivation family in Mirolli & Baldassarre (2013) -- COMPETENCE-based IM (reward = progress in achieving a self-generated goal, i.e. improving the agent's SKILLS) -- which REE's registered IM stack (MECH-314 info-gain / MECH-314a novelty / MECH-314c learning-progress, all KNOWLEDGE-based: reward = improving the WORLD MODEL) entirely lacks. Same derivative-not-level discipline as MECH-314c, but the operand is BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCE, not predictive error.
claims.falsifier_summary: Selection share and competence are indistinguishable from the yoked control at matched bonus magnitude, or the effect survives permuting competence across goals (so it is bonus magnitude, not competence progress).
claims.required_event: Repeated attempts at the same active goal whose success rate is changing, so a rate-of-improvement in achievement exists to be read.
claims.manipulation: A per-goal EMA of the derivative of achievement competence injected as an additive wanting bonus alongside MECH-229, ON vs OFF, routed to the committed action via use_cem_modulatory_throughput plus modulatory_channel_route_source=cem_elite so the bonus can actually reach the argmin.
claims.control: A yoked bonus of identical magnitude and arity permuted across goals (competence ORDERING destroyed), plus OFF, plus a level-not-derivative arm to pin the derivative discipline.
claims.DV: Share of goal selections directed at the goals whose achievement competence is currently improving, and foraging competence per episode against the 1.0/episode WS-1 floor.
claims.instrument: Nothing records achievement-competence derivative. The nearest existing recorder is GoalState.record_progress / _progress_velocity (SD-093, MECH-426), which is a within-episode goal-PROXIMITY velocity over a 5-tick window consumed by effort modulation and default OFF; mech457_retention_trajectory_probe samples unshaped foraging_competence but not per-goal success rate.
claims.consumer_locus: Wanting term -> goal selection / trajectory scoring -> committed action.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two things must hold or the test is vacuous. (P1) Goal-achievement competence must be ABOVE the floor and moving, since a derivative of a flat 0.065-0.455 resources/episode competence is zero for reasons unrelated to the claim. (P2) The wanting channel must have measurable authority over the committed action: V3-EXQ-931 measured the wanting term cross-candidate spread at ~0.37% of the terrain term, first flipping the elite argmin at wanting_weight ~50 and 5/5 seeds at ~500.
claims.blocking_reason: No competence-progress quantity exists anywhere in ree_core, and the channel the claim proposes to inject into is itself a measured non-consumer: the wanting term needs ~100x scaling to move the elite argmin, and elite flips do not imply throughput (at wanting_weight 5000 the elite argmin flipped on 80.3% of refits while mean_resource_proximity stayed bit-identical).
false_positives: The claim sequencing-exemption -- that MECH-455 is partly exempt from the wired-but-inert routing block because it injects into the wanting path rather than the broadcast-novelty path -- is wrong: V3-EXQ-931 measured the same authority failure on the wanting term itself, one layer upstream inside the CEM elite stage.
claims.auditor_notes: If governance wants this built, the cheapest honest first item is a per-goal achievement-rate recorder (an extension of MECH-426 record_progress to cross-episode success rate), not the bonus itself.

claims.claim_title: action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.
claims.falsifier_summary: The actor-critic arm fails the floor WHILE a vanilla non-REE learner on the identical observation also fails -- the bottleneck is the observation encoding, not the policy substrate (H2), which weakens this claim. V3-EXQ-742 already weakened the sufficiency reading, and 770/771/772 eliminated drive-schedule, reward-coupling and credit-horizon as the axis.
claims.required_event: A foraging episode sequence in which the agent must repeatedly locate and consume resources, long enough for an RPE-driven actor-critic update loop to install and then retain competence.
claims.manipulation: use_actor_critic ON versus the incumbent thin bias_head REINFORCE readout, with actor_critic_cotrain_encoder as the representation co-shaping lever and actor_critic_use_sf_critic as the successor-feature variant.
claims.control: Two controls, and both are load-bearing: a privileged oracle / local-view-greedy arm establishing the achievable ceiling, and a non-REE vanilla learner on the IDENTICAL observation -- if that also fails, the target is the observation encoding (H2), not the policy (H1).
claims.DV: Unshaped foraging competence per episode against the 1.0/episode floor, sampled as a TRAJECTORY on a fixed post-install schedule during RL refinement (not terminal-only), so that installed-then-decayed is distinguishable from never-installed.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/action_learning/actor_critic.py (ActorCriticPolicy: dorsal-striatal actor, value_head at lines 142-145, optional successor-feature critic) behind use_actor_critic and the co-shaping knobs; the retention trajectory probe and the schedulable bc_aux_coef, distributional critic and KL-anchor levers are all recorded implemented in substrate_queue.json; drivers in experiments/_lib/mech457_bootstrap_explorer.py and mech457_explorer_classes.py.
claims.consumer_locus: The action-learning system itself -- a separately parameterised policy taught by a reward-prediction-error signal -- as distinct from a bias term on a prediction-trained encoder. The claim is about necessity at that boundary, explicitly NOT sufficiency.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The DV must have headroom and the environment must be solvable from the agent's own view before any arm is scored -- V3-EXQ-765's readiness leg established the 5x5 view supports local_view_greedy 48.05 and an oracle 57.2 against a 1.0 floor, so the env is not the limit. The actor must also NOT ride a frozen z_world: V3-EXQ-737 measured a trainable actor-plus-critic on the frozen latent scoring below random, and V3-EXQ-737a found 0 of 4 world_encoder and 0 of 61 latent_stack tensors changed after 200 P0 episodes. And on D3_hazard_free the return does not rank the foraging DV at all (random_walk mean_episode_reward -1.006, greedy oracle surviving 20.4 steps versus vanilla PPO's 175).
claims.blocking_reason: The installability half is unresolved: every arm sits at or near the floor while the oracle clears it, so the discriminating DV has no headroom in the arms that matter. The competence_floor question is DECIDED for RETENTION only (value estimator and update constraint each independently set the decay half-life); the representation explanandum -- whether prediction-trained z_world confers any advantage -- is the live frontier, carried by zworld_adequacy and conversion_ceiling_root's H-observation-interface.
false_positives: Reading the MECH-457 campaign as 'discrimination still pending' is wrong: GFLAG-0093 verified the competence_floor hypothesis set is fully enumerated and the retention decision_question is adjudicated (decision_log 2026-07-25T23:26:31Z). claims.claim_title: Curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier, not a diversity generator: the SD-025 hippocampal curiosity / density-attraction drive pulls only toward representational structure that reward (SD-024/MECH-232 DA-expansion) has ALREADY sculpted -- a rich-get-richer loop with zero PROACTIVE pull toward unshaped / novel / under-represented regions. Its only diversity affordance is a weak, lagging, REACTIVE familiarity-discount brake (~half the strength of the exploitation force it opposes, and zero at the decision point). COROLLARY: proactive strategy-diversity GENERATION requires a SEPARATE rarity-seeking drive (Bellemare-2016 polarity: attraction to LOW-count / under-represented strategy classes, independent of prior reward-shaping), NOT a novelty-magnitude increase on the existing drive; and any such drive is ORDERING-GATED on INV-088 z_world differentiation (a rarity term over an under-differentiated map has nothing to range over).
claims.falsifier_summary: A magnitude sweep of the existing density-attraction drive alone lifts flat-map diversity -- the deficit was then strength, not polarity, and the category claim that curiosity is structurally the wrong force is refuted.
claims.required_event: Action selection on an UNSHAPED map, before dopaminergic density expansion has sculpted representational structure, with at least some candidate strategy classes visited far less often than others.
claims.manipulation: A proactive rarity-seeking score bias with Bellemare polarity (attraction to LOW visit-count z_world regions or strategy classes, independent of reward shaping) versus (a) OFF and (b) a pure novelty-MAGNITUDE sweep of the existing SD-025 density-attraction drive.
claims.control: The magnitude-sweep arm is the discriminating control: it varies the existing drive's strength without changing its polarity, so a lift there would refute the category claim rather than support the rarity corollary; SD-025 OFF supplies the floor.
claims.DV: Per-candidate and committed-class strategy diversity on the unshaped map measured AT THE DECISION POINT, alongside the decomposed force magnitudes on the CEM score-margin scale that V3-EXQ-767a used (density attraction 39.3 versus familiarity-discount ceiling 20.4, diversity term 0.00 at selection).
claims.instrument: The counting primitive already exists and is instantiated unconditionally -- VisitationCounter in ree_core/hippocampal/visitation.py records exact per-anchor visit COUNTS -- but its own module docstring pins it read-only and bars it from scoring and selection paths (one gated exception, the MECH-057b completion gate, default off). MECH-314's structured-curiosity bias is the existing score-bias site, but its visitation source is a distance-to-visited-set novelty term, not an inverse-count rarity term.
claims.consumer_locus: E3 per-candidate score bias at the committed-selection moment, where SD-025 currently supplies 39 units of exploitation pull and zero diversity pull.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Ordering gate INV-088: a rarity term needs a differentiated z_world map to range over, or it chases the sparse corner instead of diverse strategies. The flat-map arm must also be genuinely unshaped -- V3-EXQ-768a's demonstration that SD-025 alone reads zero on a flat map is the positive control that the regime is reached.
claims.blocking_reason: The visit-count quantity exists and is always on, but has no consumer at the selection locus: VisitationCounter is read-only by design, and MECH-314's visitation source is a distance-based novelty term rather than an inverse-count rarity term. The remaining gate is INV-088 z_world differentiation, without which a rarity term has nothing to range over.

An unconditional exact visit-count tracker with a z_world-scaled kernel already exists (VisitationCounter) -- what is missing is the edge from that count to a score bias, which is a much smaller build than the corollary's wording implies.

Any build here must not duplicate MECH-314's existing score-bias site.
claims.what_would_answer: ONCE INV-088 z_world differentiation is cleared (the ordering gate), build a proactive rarity-seeking generation drive on ARC-065/MECH-314 (Bellemare polarity: attraction to low-count / under-represented strategy classes or z_world regions, independent of reward-shaping) and run a discriminative arm against (a) OFF and (b) a pure novelty-MAGNITUDE sweep of the existing SD-025 drive (the infant_substrate:GAP-13 lever). claims.claim_title: return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).
claims.falsifier_summary: The floor does not move under the shape-preserving knock-out while the readiness anchors hold -- the two-sided normaliser is exonerated, the weaker noise-re-amplification form falls with it, and the four eliminated axes (769/770/771/772) regain their face value as constraints on the mechanisms they tested.
claims.required_event: MECH-457 actor-critic training episodes in the near-zero-forage regime where the reward stream is harm_signal plus novelty_bonus only, so the advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- the regime in which the claim says the two-sided operator manufactures a full-magnitude unit-variance noise gradient.
claims.manipulation: Replace ONLY the per-episode standardisation adv_t = (adv_t - adv_t.mean()) / (adv_t.std() + 1e-8) at experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::train_rawview_ac_rl with the one-sided adv / max(1, Per95(adv) - Per5(adv)), everything else byte-identical; optionally a second arm that also removes the Welford running reward-std divide.
claims.control: The unmodified two-sided pathway at matched seeds and identical budget, plus the behavioural-cloning reference (32.72, which clears the floor by bypassing the return pathway entirely) as the achievability anchor, and the local_view_greedy / greedy_oracle readiness controls.
claims.DV: Foraging competence after the knock-out relative to the unmodified arm, reported with the advantage-composition split (forage-contact versus novelty/harm |adv| mass, pre and post normalisation) and the critic separation between pre-reward and post-reward states on BC-visited states, so an unmoved floor is attributable.

claims.claim_title: transient_behavioral_prior_bootstrap / bc_seed_then_rl_without_permanent_demonstrator. What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.
claims.falsifier_summary: Competence collapses to the ctrl/floor level the moment the auxiliary is removed (a permanent crutch, not a bootstrap); or the response is flat across guide quality, which points at the converter rather than the seed; or value-side seeding adds nothing over policy-only.
claims.required_event: A behaviour-cloning warm-start installs a floor-clearing prior into the actor, RL then continues at matched budget, and the prior is subsequently withdrawn from the loss (and, for the stronger form, from the action path).
claims.manipulation: Three separable manipulations: anneal bc_aux_coef to zero mid-training via the existing bc_aux_schedule callable (prior removal); swap the demonstrator across greedy_oracle / local_view_greedy / random_walk (guide-quality gradient); and seed the value head and successor-feature critic in addition to the policy logits (value-side seeding).
claims.control: The 780 ctrl arm (no warm-start, bc_aux_coef=0) at matched budget and representation; the post-BC probe as the with-prior reference point; and the three anchor policy arms as achievability ceilings.
claims.DV: Foraging competence after prior removal, read against BOTH the post-BC probe value and the ctrl arm (residue, not absolute level); the slope of final competence across guide quality; and critic calibration error on demonstrator-visited states for the policy-only versus policy-plus-value seeding contrast.
claims.instrument: warmstart_bc_rep, the post-BC evaluate_seed probe, bc_aux_schedule, bc_seed_took / bc_seed_survives_rl and the three anchor policies all exist in experiments/_lib. Missing: any critic or value-head cloning path (warmstart_bc_rep trains rep.step logits by cross-entropy only) and any guide-in-the-action-path handoff parameter in train_a2c.
claims.consumer_locus: The converter itself -- whether the seed leaves a residue in the actor and critic once the guide leaves -- not the demonstrator's own competence, which is already established at 48.05 (local_view_greedy) and 57.2 (oracle).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The seed must actually install before any post-removal readout is scored. V3-EXQ-780 records bc_seed_took per cell: 0 of 3 on the z_world representation (action-match 0.31-0.37, post-BC forage 0.4-0.8) and 3 of 3 on raw (match 0.87, post-BC forage 17.8-26.2). A null from a cell where the prior never installed is uninformative about transience.

The anneal hook exists but is unused; there is no critic-side clone and no rollout handoff. SUPPORTED if competence persists post-removal above the 780 ctrl; FALSIFIED (as a SEED reading) if it collapses to the 0-1 floor the instant the auxiliary/guide is removed, which would make the prior a permanent crutch rather than a bootstrap. claims.claim_title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.
claims.falsifier_summary: The drive fires yet leaves the actor at the passive-survival floor on both representations (the pattern V3-EXQ-781 actually produced: drive ~0.70, zero seeds supra-target on either representation), and equally for the basis half if a primitive-basis arm also fails to lift at matched drive.
claims.required_event: Cold-start foraging at rung D3 with no demonstrator anywhere in the loop, from an actor that has not yet cleared the competence floor.
claims.manipulation: Two halves. (i) A constant-coefficient, non-extinguishing intrinsic approach reward on resource proximity (approach_coef>0, approach_extinguishes_on_contact False) -- built and already run. (ii) A converter given a pre-specified action-primitive basis versus one that must compose its repertoire from single-step actions, at matched drive -- not built.
claims.control: The 781 ctrl arm (approach_coef=0) at matched budget on both representations, plus the local_view_greedy and greedy_oracle anchors as achievability references.
claims.DV: Foraging competence lift of the treatment over ctrl against the pre-registered lift target (13.05, margin 7.83) on BOTH representations, conditioned on the drive having fired; for the second half, the same lift statistic contrasted across primitive-basis versus single-step repertoire.
claims.instrument: train_a2c exposes approach_drive / approach_coef / approach_extinguishes_on_contact and the driver records per-arm mean_approach_reward_recent, so the drive half is fully instrumented. PolicyChunking mints chunks from experienced action runs and offers no entry point for a pre-specified primitive basis.
claims.consumer_locus: The converter's action selection -- a reward-independent engagement channel acting on an action alphabet, rather than a tuning of the existing reward-conditional exploration signal.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For the drive half, mean_approach_reward_recent must be non-zero so a null is informative rather than a plumbing bug (V3-EXQ-781 measured 0.698 on z_world and 0.707 on raw, and both floor anchors were met at 48.05 and 57.2). For the primitive-basis half, a pre-specified composable multi-step primitive set must exist and be selectable at matched drive.
claims.blocking_reason: The drive half is runnable and HAS run: V3-EXQ-781 delivered exactly the pre-registered falsifying pattern, but was scored to MECH-457 only, so MECH-461 carries no evidence edge to it. The primitive-basis half -- the claim's distinctive content -- has no arm, because policy chunking forms chunks from experience rather than accepting a pre-specified basis.
false_positives: The digest presents the drive half as untested; it is not. V3-EXQ-781 ran on 2026-07-18 with the drive confirmed firing and 0 of 3 seeds supra-target on both representations -- the claim's own falsifying signature, merely unlinked.
claims.auditor_notes: COORDINATOR: the highest-value action on this claim is an evidence edge, not a new experiment -- V3-EXQ-781's manifest already carries the drive-half falsifier result and is tagged claim_ids=[MECH-457]. Governance should decide whether that run is admissible evidence against MECH-461's drive half before any successor is designed.
claims.what_would_answer: The V3-EXQ-781 pre-registered readout is the direct test on the drive half: a sustained, non-extinguishing, demonstrator-free approach drive (constant-coefficient intrinsic reward on resource proximity) that leaves the actor at the passive-survival floor on BOTH representations -- with mean_approach_reward_recent confirming the drive actually fired, so a null is informative rather than a plumbing bug -- FALSIFIES the drive half. The PRIMITIVE-BASIS half is NOT tested by 781 and is the claim's distinctive, currently-untested content: it would be answered by contrasting a converter given a pre-specified action-primitive basis (a small set of composable multi-step motor primitives) against one that must construct its repertoire from single-step actions, at matched drive. A drive-only arm clearing the floor would show the primitive basis is unnecessary; a primitive-basis-only arm clearing it would show the drive is.

claims.claim_title: Consolidation-phase damage is content-scorable only where the phase's output is a FIRST-ORDER content-bearing quantity (NREM inter-store transfer; SWS retrieval margin). A phase whose output is a SECOND-ORDER quantity over representations -- REM precision / confidence recalibration -- is content-free BY TYPE, and its damage is readable only through a downstream behavioural discrimination consequence, never through a statistic computed on the precision quantity itself.
claims.falsifier_summary: Either the downstream readout is also content-free (the phase carries no recoverable damage signal and the recoverability half of the type story is wrong), or a direct precision-quantity readout can be made content-contingent (the type fact is simply false and 778c/778e/778f were construction defects after all).
claims.required_event: A diffuse-damage consolidation-lesion run at graded sigma over the REM phase on the V3-EXQ-778e cells, followed by post-REM retrievals that are individually scorable as correct or incorrect and carry a confidence value.

REVISED 2026-08-26 (thought-digestion wave 2, user-gated). The prior version would have produced a TAUTOLOGICAL FALSE POSITIVE; see the third conjunct, which is mandatory. REACHABILITY -- OPEN, AND MEASURED NEGATIVE (corrected 2026-09-01, GFLAG-0056/0057; previously recorded here as "settled on recorded data, no longer open", which was wrong). Setting `agent.e3.config.commitment_threshold ~ 0.0057` POST-CONSTRUCTION is still the right idiom -- it does NOT land through `from_dims`; use direct attribute assignment as in v3_exq_018b / v3_exq_050b. What is wrong is the headroom argument built on it.
THE POOLING ARTEFACT, stated plainly because it is subtle and it fooled a prior pass. The five percentiles this claim quoted -- p5 0.00259, p25 0.00330, median 0.00562, p75 0.00618, p95 0.00721 -- are the distribution POOLED ACROSS ALL FIVE SEEDS. Recomputed independently from the 785a per-tick sink (n=1765) 2026-09-01: pooled IQR/median = 0.5133. But post-warmup (tick >= 90, this design's own pre-registration) the WITHIN-seed IQR/median is 0.0116, 0.0104, 0.0729, 0.0848, 0.0193 -- one to eight percent of median. Seed medians span 0.00261 -> 0.00670, a 2.6x range. So the pooled dispersion is almost entirely BETWEEN-seed: five near-point-masses sitting at different locations. A threshold placed "inside the dispersion" is placed inside SEED IDENTITY, not inside any within-run quantity, and the claimed commit-rate span of roughly 0.60-0.95 (versus 785a's 0.0099, "about 35x more headroom") is an artefact of that pooling. A 4000-point threshold sweep finds ZERO feasible thresholds on ANY individual seed; the best single seed reaches 5 of 6 urgency levels. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION, three conjuncts, ALL required: (1) HEADROOM -- median gate margin (`commit_variance / effective_threshold`) within [0.5, 2.0] on >= 50% of scored FRESH-SELECT ticks; commit rate at EVERY urgency level within [0.05, 0.95]; baseline (urgency-off) commit rate within [0.2, 0.8]. Warmup excluded by pre-registration (~first 90 ticks / ~10 fresh selects), since `precision_init = 0.5` starts the EMA above the bound. (2) DISPERSION FLOOR -- IQR(rv)/median(rv) >= a pre-registered floor. 785a's 0.51 is the POOLED figure and MUST NOT be used as a per-seed bar: scored per seed, no seed can reach it (max 0.085), so as previously written this conjunct was simultaneously unsatisfiable per-seed AND silently passable if scored pooled. SCORE IT PER SEED, and set the floor from within-seed data. Do NOT simply lower the floor to make it passable -- a regime that collapses rv dispersion is exactly what this conjunct exists to catch. (3) THE RESIDUAL DV -- THE CONJUNCT WITHOUT WHICH THE EXPERIMENT IS NOT WORTH RUNNING. Because urgency multiplies the BOUND while the gated quantity is provably FLAT (median `commit_variance` 0.00561-0.00564 across all six 785a urgency levels, a 0.5% span -- there is no code path by which arousal writes the running variance), a boundary-regime run that simply asks "does commit rate vary with urgency?" returns SUPPORTS **arithmetically**, from the shape of the rv CDF, for ANY non-degenerate dispersion. That is not a mechanism finding; it is the definition of a threshold crossed against a distribution. So: construct the COUNTERFACTUAL commit rate by evaluating the OFF-arm's empirical rv CDF at each level's shifted threshold, and score the RESIDUAL (observed minus predicted). SUPPORTS only if the residual is signed and exceeds a pre-registered floor. CONFIRMING: with conjuncts 1-2 green, the residual is signed and above its floor on the pre-registered seed majority -- arousal changes whether commitment fires by some route BEYOND sliding the bound against a fixed distribution. FALSIFYING: conjuncts 1-2 green and the residual is indistinguishable from zero. Arousal slid the bound and nothing else happened -- which is precisely what MECH-463 needs to be distinguished FROM, and makes "changes whether commitment fires" empty beyond arithmetic. NOT A VERDICT: any run failing conjunct 1 or 2 self-routes `substrate_not_ready_requeue`. A ceiling-effect null (785a's failure mode) and a collapsed-dispersion null are both uninterpretable, not negative.

SD-006 guarantees that E1/E2/E3 run at characteristic rates; nothing asserts or tests that the heterogeneous streams (E1/E2/E3, harm, goal, salience, hippocampal, control) thereby occupy recurrent system-level configurations or exhibit homologous transition motifs. Configured rate separation does not entail shared organisation.

claims.claim_title: Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.
claims.falsifier_summary: One accepted, production-reachable mechanism whose admission predicate reads only on signal presence or magnitude and was not flagged as a deliberate exception; a second such instance plus a governance decision declining to add a gate falsifies the descriptive half.
claims.required_event: Acceptance of a new mechanism that admits a signal to a committed-selection surface, a durable write path, or a consolidation-rate control.
claims.manipulation: None -- the falsifier is a code audit, not a run: each corpus member classified gated or ungated by READING its admission predicate in ree_core, never its claim prose.
claims.control: The near-miss shape the audit must reject: an ungated internal scalar that cannot reach a committed surface is not a counterexample here (that is ARC-130 rung), so the discriminator is whether the ungated signal demonstrably reaches a committed action, a durable write or a consolidation rate.
claims.DV: The count of corpus rows whose admission predicate reads only on signal presence or magnitude, with no eligibility, mode, learnability or provenance condition.
claims.instrument: The dated audit table itself (claim_synthesis_ARC-120_2026-09-07.md is the first instalment), re-run at each governance cycle that accepts a new authority-granting mechanism; there is no tool that enumerates the corpus, and nothing schedules the re-run.
claims.consumer_locus: The admission predicate of each authority-granting mechanism in ree_core, at the boundary where a signal becomes a committed action, a durable write, or a consolidation rate.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The audit corpus must contain at least 5 authority-granting mechanisms accepted since 2026-08-06 that are production-reachable and NOT default-off-and-never-enabled; with 0-2 the correct output is insufficient corpus. Every post-2026-08-06 authority-adjacent module in ree_core is gated behind a default-False flag (use_selection_entropy_floor, use_possibility_topology, use_defensive_orienting), and the 2026-09-03 probe found all four instance gates default-off or inert.
claims.blocking_reason: The audit is executable today but its corpus is degenerate: REE ships every new mechanism default-off (config.py holds 502 bool=False against 103 bool=True defaults) and all post-2026-08-06 authority-adjacent modules follow that convention, so the production-reachable filter leaves too few rows to distinguish an enforced ordering from an emergent one.
false_positives: Reading ARC-120 experimental debt as dischargeable by a V3 run is wrong and already refused at the queue-experiment guardrail; equally, the claim own evidence note already records that Set A evidences only that existence does not confer authority, so the positive clause remains unevidenced.
claims.auditor_notes: If the default-off filter is kept as written the audit may be permanently in insufficient corpus; governance may want to decide whether an EXPERIMENT-enabled mechanism counts as accepted, which is a narrowing decision on the precondition, not new substrate.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is an audit, and an audit over an empty or trivial corpus is the
characteristic vacuity here. The corpus is every mechanism that ACTUALLY GRANTS AUTHORITY -- i.e.
whose effect is to admit a signal to a committed-selection surface, a memory/representation write
path, or a consolidation-rate control -- that was ACCEPTED (registered `active`/`stable`/
`provisional`, code present in `ree_core/`, reachable on a production path, not default-off-and-
never-enabled) since ARC-120's registration on 2026-08-06. At least 5 such mechanisms must be in
the corpus; with 0-2 the correct output is "insufficient corpus", never "confirmed". Each must be
classified gated/ungated by READING ITS ADMISSION PREDICATE IN CODE, not by reading its claim prose
-- a claim whose text promises a gate that the code does not implement counts as UNGATED, and that
asymmetry is the whole point of running the audit against `ree_core/` rather than against
`claims.yaml`.

CONFIRMING: every mechanism in the corpus conditions its authority grant on at least one
competence-like predicate -- per-event eligibility (ARC-107), a learnable rather than fixed store
(SD-032b), operating-mode write gating (MECH-261), real-vs-simulated provenance tagging (MECH-094),
or a demonstrable equivalent. WORKED CONFIRMING INSTANCE, already in the record and usable as the
audit's first row: the ARC-108 JOB-2 habenula de-commit (`ClosureOperator.habenula_tick`, ree-v3,
2026-06-22) grants a genuinely NEW behavioural authority -- abort a live commitment on a
worse-than-expected outcome -- and gates it on `hypothesis_tag is False` (MECH-094, so a replay/DMN
outcome cannot abort a waking commitment) AND `beta_gate.is_elevated` (nothing to de-commit
