claims.previous_what_would_answer: Four-arm ablation on a task battery deliberately constructed to contain at least two distinct discrepancy types (e.g. a perceptual-doubt trial requiring resampling and a provenance-doubt trial requiring source reconstruction) at matched base difficulty. Arm 1 (monitoring-only): agent registers a typed low-confidence/conflict signal but the processing configuration never changes. Arm 2 (parametric-only): agent may adjust precision/commitment threshold on a typed signal but cannot recruit additional subsystems. Arm 3 (untyped coalition): agent may recruit arbitrary additional subsystems but all discrepancy types collapse into one undifferentiated REFLECT trigger (no typing). Arm 4 (typed coalition, the mechanism under test): discrepancy type is matched to a coalition template that recruits only the relevant subsystems. PASS (supports): Arm 4 shows selective improvement concentrated in the matched problem class (e.g. provenance-doubt trials improve on the provenance-coalition, not on perceptual-doubt trials) at lower computational cost than Arm 3, and Arms 1-3 each show their predicted deficit signature (1: accurate confidence but no behavioural improvement; 2: generic caution/deferral without resolving type-specific uncertainty; 3: costly over-recruitment / interference / unstable switching). FAIL (does not support): Arm 4 does not outperform Arm 3 on the matched problem class (typing does no discriminative work beyond raw recruitment), or Arm 2 alone matches Arm 4 (coalition/topology control adds nothing beyond existing parametric modulation). NON-DEGENERACY: the underlying typed discrepancy signals (confidence/provenance/coherence-conflict) must show non-zero cross-trial-type variance in Arm 1's baseline; if the agent cannot distinguish discrepancy types at all, the typing manipulation in Arms 3 vs 4 is vacuous and the run is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. A fifth check (coalition persistence -- premature dissolution vs over-long engagement, scenario 5 in the source thought) is a follow-on refinement, not part of this claim's primary falsifier -- register separately if Arm 4 passes.

claims.claim_title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.
claims.falsifier_summary: Raw novelty or raw uncertainty alone predict the same information-seeking as the accumulator, OR the accumulator stays elevated after verified resolution (no satiation), OR the system preferentially engages irreducible over learnable uncertainty -- the last of these being untestable until an expected_resolvability term and an irreducible-noise locus exist.
claims.required_event: A persistent, consequential model inadequacy at a spatial target -- uncertainty that stays unresolved across many ticks after raw novelty and instantaneous prediction error have decayed to baseline -- followed by a diagnostic or resolving observation at that same target.
claims.manipulation: curiosity_learning_progress_source epistemic_deficit versus broadcast, yoked on identical rollouts, crossed with a resolution event that supplies the evidence needed to quench one target while leaving a matched target unresolved.
claims.control: A value-shuffled (permuted) readout and a synthetic-magnitude readout on the same ticks -- both already implemented in 1047 -- plus a self-yoked zero-divergence control, so any effect must be attributable to the accumulator's ORDERING and not to its magnitude or to write volume.
claims.DV: The accumulator's per-target trajectory against the novelty and instantaneous-PE trajectories at the same targets (does it stay elevated after they fall), and the drop in that trajectory following a verified resolution at that target versus a matched unresolved target -- satiation, not selection authority.
claims.instrument: EpistemicDeficitAccumulator's two-phase UPDATE/READOUT and get_state expose the per-target deficit, so the trajectory DV is recordable. What is missing is any driver that records it: 964, 964a, 964b and 1047 all measure whether the readout can move an argmax, which is the SD-102 substrate question and is explicitly excluded from governance evidence on this claim.
claims.consumer_locus: The accumulator itself as a persistent, target-bound state distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b) and learning-progress rate (MECH-314c) -- and, for the consequentiality half, any downstream read path, of which there is currently exactly one.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Two halves, only one met. The substrate half is now met -- SD-102 landed as ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py with per-candidate/per-region tracking, and V3-EXQ-964a validated the multi-target regime (max_n_targets 14-16, cross-candidate readout range 4.4e-3 to 7.3e-3 on all 3 seeds). The empirical half is NOT met: no run has shown the accumulator's own trajectory carries cross-condition variance distinguishable from the value-shuffled control, and at every gain rung in V3-EXQ-1047 the permuted control fired as often or more often than the real readout.
claims.blocking_reason: The whole 964/964a/964b/1047 lineage measures selection authority, not the claim's accumulator dynamics. The satiation DV needs a verified-resolution event the environment does not define, and the expected_resolvability disjunct cannot be tested at all: epistemic_deficit.py implements 3 of 5 inputs with an additive form and deliberately omits importance and resolvability, since no such signal exists in V3.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: V3-EXQ-1047's self-routed label deficit_readout_magnitude_limited is not sustained by its own cells; the autopsy corrected it to inconclusive_controls_did_not_separate, so the magnitude hypothesis is not established.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0182 stands: epistemic_deficit is a 4-file single-consumer container with no read path from harm evaluation, replay, planning or closure, so the claim's 'consequential' qualifier has no signal behind it and MECH-482 is simultaneously ARC-121's own falsifying instance.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a substrate where target-bound
uncertainty can be tracked per-candidate/per-region (MECH-314b is currently
a global scalar per the existing curiosity intake -- not yet built in V3)
AND where cross-seed/cross-condition variance in the accumulator is
non-zero (not floor-pinned at zero or ceiling-saturated) -- below that the
run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature
(once built): an unresolved, consequential uncertainty accumulates across
time steps even as raw novelty and instantaneous prediction error fall to
baseline, AND providing diagnostic/resolving evidence specifically quenches
the accumulator (satiation) rather than only reducing raw uncertainty.
FALSIFYING signature: no persistent deficit state is needed to explain
information-seeking behaviour -- raw novelty (MECH-314a) or raw uncertainty
(MECH-314b) alone predict exploration equally well, OR the accumulator
remains elevated after verified resolution (no satiation), OR the system
preferentially engages irreducible noise over learnable uncertainty (would
falsify the expected_resolvability term).

claims.claim_title: orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.
claims.falsifier_summary: Orient/survey behaviour is indistinguishable from random wandering with no later-competence benefit, OR persists despite already-adequate information (no termination), OR the same benefit is fully reproduced by MECH-313/314/320/ARC-065 with no distinct regime.
claims.required_event: A diffuse, pre-cue-identification episode in which accumulated epistemic_deficit is high, commitment is temporarily reduced, behavioural sampling widens, and commitment then resumes once uncertainty falls.
claims.manipulation: Structured orient/survey condition (deficit-gated commitment reduction) versus matched stochastic-exploration-only and no-orienting baselines, with total step budget and observation exposure matched.
claims.control: Stochastic-exploration-only arm at matched behavioural entropy, a no-orienting arm, and an arm in which the MECH-313/314/320/ARC-065 substrates are individually enabled, so a benefit can be attributed to a distinct regime rather than to existing curiosity machinery.
claims.DV: LATER action-selection quality after the orienting phase -- competence on the subsequent task segment, not entropy or state-coverage -- plus a termination measure showing commitment resumes as measured uncertainty falls.
claims.instrument: MECH-482's accumulator exists (ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py, built 2026-08-29) with per-target persistent state and a readiness readout, so the driver quantity is recorded. Missing: any trajectory-regime classifier (no orient/survey, survey_steps or heading-structure measure anywhere in ree_core or experiments) and any commitment-modulating consumer of the deficit.
claims.consumer_locus: A third primitive behavioural regime in the policy layer, sitting between approach and avoid and preceding cue identification -- distinct from MECH-395's narrow post-cue vector resolution.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Trajectories must be classifiable as orient-mode versus random-exploration versus directed-approach on a structural measure with non-zero variance across conditions, AND the epistemic_deficit readout that is supposed to drive the regime must itself be discriminative. V3-EXQ-1047 (2026-09-17, confirmed autopsy) failed to discriminate magnitude- from pattern-limited readout, with controls matching or beating the real arm at every rung, so the driver is not yet usable.
claims.blocking_reason: The regime's driver is not yet discriminative -- V3-EXQ-1047's own cells refute its self-routed magnitude-limited label and no rung put the real arm above both controls -- so a deficit-gated regime cannot enter a discriminating regime. Beyond that, no orient/survey control state and no trajectory-regime classifier exist in V3.
false_positives: The ORNT-2 resume_condition text lags its own plan: both 2026-08-22 gates cleared and the readiness criterion as written (last_uncertainty_dev_range) was falsified in favour of _last_pvar_relative_spread; a reader taking the resume_condition at face value would conclude the accumulator is unbuilt, which it is not.
claims.auditor_notes: ORNT-3 is explicitly 'DO NOT build in V3 yet' and gated on ORNT-2; the routing already recorded for ORNT-2 (/implement-substrate on sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness, not another ladder rung) is the live path, so nothing new is needed here. The regime classifier is the one piece with no owner and is an instrument, not a mechanism.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires trajectories to be classifiable as

claims.claim_title: Defensive-orienting response: a toggleable PAG-analog phasic gate (DefensiveOrientingGate) that arrests locomotion on a sudden, unidentified onset (positive-derivative detector over residue_surprise AND z_harm_s norm, distinct trigger channels from MECH-279's chronic z_harm_a), holds until an identification-confidence accumulator (driven by decay of the triggering channel's excess-over-baseline, not a fixed timer) reaches sufficiency, then releases into a valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume decision expressed as an E3Selector.select() score_bias toward/away from the trigger location. The Sokolov orienting-reflex shape, and the organism-level closure of the observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b Section 4 affect-behaviour temporal-decoupling finding.
claims.falsifier_summary: Decision class is independent of the concurrent event class (indistinguishable from the shuffled null), or the histogram stays pinned at one class as in 910/910a; the trigger leg is already fairly falsified at 0.33/0.35/0.75 percent alignment on the three injected event types.

claims.manipulation: Two arms at matched seeds: orienting_on (use_defensive_orienting=True at shipped config defaults) vs orienting_off (gate not instantiated, structurally zero overrides), on the reused 906b eval; dose on the two trigger channels (residue_surprise vs z_harm_s onset deltas) if the trigger leg is re-opened.
claims.control: The orienting_off arm is a structural negative control (n_override_ticks forced to 0), plus the pre-build incidental baselines measured in the 906b review Section 12b (P(moved@t+1|spike)=44.3 percent vs 24.0 percent unconditional; P(mode-change@t+1|spike)=15.4 percent vs 11.1 percent).
claims.DV: Two quantities: (a) event_trigger_alignment.alignment_rate per injected event type (trigger leg, already measured at 0.33/0.35/0.75 percent); (b) the joint distribution of per-override decision (approach/withdraw/resume) against the class of the concurrently injected event at the triggering tick, versus a shuffled-event null.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/pag/defensive_orienting.py plus the agent-side cache _orienting_last_output; the 906b driver step log already records orienting_trigger_fired, orienting_override_fired, orienting_decision AND the three injected-event flags in the SAME row, so the event-class join is recordable there. The 910/910a/910b drivers did not record that join.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The gate must be instantiated (use_defensive_orienting=True) and must actually override: 910b measured only 21 genuine override ticks pooled over 3 seeds x 48 eval episodes, 15 of them in one numerically extreme seed. A valence-tracking readout is uninterpretable below a per-seed override floor, and each override tick must carry the class of the event that triggered it.
claims.blocking_reason: The decision leg's discriminating DV -- per-override event class versus decision -- was never recorded by the 910 lineage, although the 906b driver logs both fields in one row. Override rate at shipped defaults (21 pooled ticks, 15 in one seed) is near the non-degeneracy floor. The trigger leg is not blocked: it ran and was falsified.

an absolute floor, not on a raw difference.

threshold moves the leg-1/leg-3 boundary WITHOUT moving the leg-2
boundary, and sweeping the epistemic_deficit threshold moves the leg-2
boundary WITHOUT moving the leg-1/leg-3 boundary. This is what separates

three legs simultaneously non-degenerate -- every setting at which leg 1

precondition block rather than restating it.

claims.claim_title: Does the admission criterion for retaining a predicted-but-not-acted-on harm/success alternative (MECH-485 leg 3) share the same cut-scale as the real-time interrupt threshold (MECH-090/141/138), just at a lower cut-point, or does it have an independent relevance criterion such as goal-match (per the MECH-292/293 cue-system reading) that is dissociable from proximity to the interrupt threshold?
claims.falsifier_summary: None of the named predictors explains retention above chance (the question is malformed and should be reframed), or the off-diagonal cells cannot be populated in any available REE environment, which would mean the admission criterion is a design stipulation after all.
claims.required_event: An E3 candidate that is predicted-but-not-acted-on and is then either retained past the tick on which it was rejected, or discarded -- an event V3 cannot currently produce at all.
claims.manipulation: A 2x2 factorial crossing predicted-harm magnitude with goal_match, populating both off-diagonal cells deliberately, plus a separate shift of the interrupt threshold to test whether the retention boundary moves with it.
claims.control: Same-scale versus independent-criterion versus multiplicative-joint versus staged models fitted to the same retention data; the threshold-shift arm is the control that separates one shared scale from two.
claims.DV: Per-alternative retention probability (and, for the staged reading, retention duration) regressed on magnitude, goal_match and their interaction, with off-diagonal cell counts reported alongside.
claims.instrument: Half present. goal_match is a live quantity in the MECH-292/293 ghost-goal bank (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, ghost_goal_bank.py, with goal_match_floor and mech293_mean_goal_match_at_seed diagnostics). The retention side has no recorder: e3_selector discards non-winning candidates and MECH-487's retention buffer is registered but unbuilt, so the dependent variable cannot be observed.
claims.consumer_locus: The admission criterion of the retained-alternative store (MECH-485 leg 3), and its relation to the real-time interrupt cut-point on the MECH-090/141/138 pathway.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Everything MECH-485's own precondition requires (inherited, do not re-derive), plus the decisive one: predicted-harm magnitude and goal_match must be measurably DECORRELATED in the probe distribution, with the two off-diagonal cells (low-magnitude/high-goal-match and high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant) reported by count. Empty off-diagonal cells make the readings indistinguishable and the run vacuous.
claims.blocking_reason: The DV cannot exist: nothing in V3 retains a rejected E3 candidate past its tick, so retention probability is unobservable. The magnitude predictor is also unavailable unaveraged (MECH-485 precondition 2), leaving goal_match as the only live predictor -- which is exactly the silent-degeneracy failure this question's own precondition warns about.
claims.auditor_notes: Fully downstream of MECH-485 in this same batch; both are blocked on the identical unbuilt MECH-487 retention node, so they should be routed together rather than as two separate prerequisites.
claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a 2x2 FACTORIAL over (predicted-harm magnitude) x (goal-match),
measuring which alternatives actually get retained. This is a question, not
an assertion, so BOTH readings have confirming signatures -- the failure
mode here is a vacuous test, not a wrong answer.

THE READINGS, and why they are dissociable (extracted from this claim's own
notes, the raw thought's Addendum 5, and this claim's targeted lit-pull):
-- SAME-SCALE: leg 3's admission is a second, lower cut-point on the same
predicted-harm magnitude scale the interrupt threshold sits on. Predicts
retained alternatives cluster just below the interrupt cut-point;
retention probability is monotone in magnitude; goal-match adds no
independent variance once magnitude is in the model.
-- INDEPENDENT-CRITERION: retention tracks goal-relevance instead, via the
MECH-292/293 cue system -- specifically SD-039's `goal_match`, the
cue-to-trace match score between a live z_goal/context cue and a stored
goal-snapshot payload. Predicts dissociation cases the same-scale reading
cannot produce: low-magnitude/high-goal-match alternatives RETAINED, and
high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant alternatives NOT retained.
-- MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT (Mattar & Daw 2018, targeted_review_q_090, conf=0.62):
retention is normatively the PRODUCT of a Gain-like term (magnitude) and a
Need-like term (goal-relevance/context-match) -- neither factor alone, nor
a simple two-stage split, is the correct rule; a low value on EITHER factor
suppresses retention even when the other factor is high. Distinct from
both SAME-SCALE (which ignores goal-match entirely) and from BOTH-AT-
DIFFERENT-LEVELS below (which is staged, not multiplicative).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION, in two parts. The first is inherited; the
second is the one that actually decides whether this question is askable.
(1) INHERITED -- everything MECH-485's own what_would_answer requires
(Leg 0 cleared, magnitude consumed, confidence term exists, leg-1 pathways
wired, retention mechanism exists). Do NOT re-derive it here; see
MECH-485. As of 2026-08-07 all five are unmet, so this question is not
askable at all yet. Additionally SD-039's own retrieval/query level is
still measured-open (z_goal cue collapse across goal-epochs, V3-EXQ-889,
2026-08-03) -- if `goal_match` is not a live, discriminating quantity,
the independent-criterion and multiplicative-joint arms have no
measurable predictor and the test silently degenerates into "magnitude
explains everything", which LOOKS like a clean same-scale answer and is
not one.
(2) SPECIFIC AND DECISIVE -- MAGNITUDE AND GOAL-MATCH MUST BE
MEASURABLY DECORRELATED IN THE TEST DISTRIBUTION. If harmful alternatives
happen to also be goal-irrelevant in the environment used, the readings
make IDENTICAL or near-identical predictions and no outcome distinguishes
them, however clean the statistics look. The test therefore requires a probe
set deliberately populated in the OFF-DIAGONAL cells --
(low-magnitude, high-goal-match) and (high-magnitude, low-goal-match) --
with those two cells reported by count, not merely assumed present. A run
whose off-diagonal cells are empty or near-empty is VACUOUS and must be
reported as such rather than scored. This is the single most likely way
for this question to be answered wrongly-but-convincingly.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF SAME-SCALE if: retention is well predicted by
magnitude alone; adding `goal_match` explains no significant additional
variance; the off-diagonal cells behave as magnitude alone predicts
(low-magnitude/high-goal-match NOT retained, high-magnitude/goal-
irrelevant RETAINED); and the fitted retention cut-point sits below the
interrupt cut-point on the same scale, the two moving together when that
scale is rescaled.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF INDEPENDENT-CRITERION if: `goal_match` explains
retention variance over and above magnitude; the off-diagonal cells
dissociate in the direction the reading predicts (low-magnitude/high-goal-
match RETAINED, high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant NOT); and moving the
interrupt threshold shifts the interrupt boundary while leaving the
retention boundary where it was.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT if: a Gain x Need interaction
term (magnitude x goal_match) fits retention significantly better than
either main effect alone AND better than a two-stage/additive model; the
off-diagonal cells show SUPPRESSED retention when EITHER factor is low
(not just when magnitude is low), unlike INDEPENDENT-CRITERION which
predicts high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant alternatives are simply NOT
retained via goal_match alone regardless of magnitude's own value.

ANSWERED "BOTH, AT DIFFERENT LEVELS" if magnitude predicts ADMISSION
(whether an alternative is retained at all) while `goal_match` predicts
PERSISTENCE (how long it survives, or whether it is consolidated rather
than decayed) -- a STAGED criterion, distinct from MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT's
single-stage interaction. This is a real outcome the binary framing hides,
and it is named here so the test is not forced into a false dichotomy. It
would mean leg 3 has a two-stage criterion and Q-090's own framing needs
revising rather than answering.

THE QUESTION IS MALFORMED (report as such, do not force an answer) if:
none of the above predictors explain retention above chance once the
substrate exists -- retention is driven by something none of the readings
name, e.g. recency or capacity pressure, which is an informative finding
about leg 3 and a reframe of this question, not a null result. OR if the
off-diagonal cells cannot be populated in ANY available REE environment,
making precondition (2) structurally unachievable -- in which case the
admission criterion genuinely is a design stipulation after all, contrary
to the user's framing of it as empirically resolvable, and that reframe
should be recorded here explicitly rather than treated as a failure to
answer.

claims.claim_title: Does a held-out, permutation-tested classifier ('umpire') over a multivariate trajectory-segment feature signature (refuge occupancy, excursion structure, hazard relationships, transitions, spatial distribution) detect context-sensitive behavioural differentiation between SD-054 reef-ON and reef-OFF conditions -- above BOTH a permutation null AND a matched untrained/random-policy control -- and does that differentiation show selective sensitivity to the reef-presence axis specifically, as distinct from an orthogonal nuisance perturbation (e.g. hazard_food_attraction magnitude)?
claims.falsifier_summary: Accuracy sits at chance inside the permutation null's spread, or clears the null but not the untrained-policy control (environment geometry, not policy), or is equally sensitive to the nuisance axis as to the reef axis.
claims.required_event: Held-out episodes generated by trained policies under reef_enabled True and reef_enabled False in causal_grid_world, at an episode budget set by the design's power calculation.
claims.manipulation: The reef-presence axis (reef_enabled, with n_reef_patches / reef_patch_radius / reef_scent_sigma fixed) as the condition label, plus an orthogonal nuisance perturbation on hazard_food_attraction magnitude as the selectivity check.
claims.control: A matched untrained/random-policy control sampled from the same two environments (rules out pure environment geometry), a label-permutation null, and a within-class feature-permutation null reported as a companion diagnostic rather than a gate.
claims.DV: Held-out classification accuracy of condition (reef-ON versus reef-OFF) from a multivariate trajectory-segment feature signature, relative to the permutation null's own spread and to the matched untrained-policy control's accuracy on the same pipeline.
claims.instrument: experiments/_lib/trajectory_metrics.py supplies two of the needed feature families (spatial geometry, action-label structure) but its docstring EXPLICITLY excludes the ecological/excursion family (in_reef occupancy, harm-in-versus-out-of-shelter ratios) and EXPLICITLY provides no discriminability/classifier harness; neither exists anywhere else in the tree.
claims.consumer_locus: The measurement layer -- whether cross-environment classifier discriminability detects policy-carried behavioural structure that the existing Rung-2 within-environment TV test at two hand-picked probe states does not test for.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Both trained-policy arms must produce non-zero-variance trajectory-segment feature vectors on held-out episodes, and the identical pipeline must land at chance when run on null data and on the design variables (seed, CV fold), inside the label-permutation null's own spread, before the real reef-ON/reef-OFF result is read in either direction.
claims.blocking_reason: Two instrument pieces are absent by explicit scoping decision: the ecological/excursion feature family (refuge occupancy, excursion structure, hazard relationships) and the umpire harness itself (held-out classifier, permutation null, matched-control and orthogonal-perturbation guards). The environment axes reef_enabled and hazard_food_attraction both already exist.
false_positives: Reading trajectory_metrics.py as the Q-092 instrument is wrong -- its own docstring states it deliberately covers neither the excursion/ecological feature family nor the classifier harness.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: Q-092's confirming signature requires held-out classification of condition from a multivariate trajectory-segment feature signature, benchmarked against a label-permutation null, a matched untrained-policy control and an orthogonal-perturbation selectivity check -- none of which any current module or driver provides.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Produces no new event: reef_enabled and hazard_food_attraction already exist in causal_grid_world. It packages the existing episodes into held-out folds blocked by episode and seed, which is what the pipeline-validity precondition needs.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Exposes (a) an ecological/excursion feature family (refuge occupancy fraction, excursion count and duration, harm rate in versus out of shelter) explicitly excluded from _lib/trajectory_metrics.py, and (b) a reusable discriminability harness returning held-out accuracy with label-permutation, feature-permutation, null-data and design-variable controls.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: The 2026-08-11 metrics-library scoping proposal deliberately scoped BOTH pieces out (Sections 3a and 3b item 4) and nothing took them up: there is no substrate_queue entry, no experiment proposal and no closure-plan node for either. MECH-490 already plans to reuse the same methodology for the pre/post-sleep case, so a shared harness has a second consumer.

claims.auditor_notes: Prefer registering ONE node covering both pieces (feature family plus harness) -- they are the same measurement layer and the scoping doc already records three independent reinventions of trajectory statistics, so a split invites a fourth.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires both trained-policy arms (reef-ON, reef-OFF) to
produce non-zero-variance trajectory-segment feature vectors on held-out episodes (a run
where either condition collapses to a single degenerate trajectory self-routes
substrate_not_ready, not a verdict).
PIPELINE-VALIDITY PRECONDITION (added 2026-08-18, Goergen et al. 2018 "same analysis
approach"): before the real reef-ON/reef-OFF result is interpreted in EITHER direction, the
identical pipeline must be run on null data and on the design variables themselves
(classifying held-out episodes by seed, or by cross-validation fold, where the true answer
is chance) and both must land at chance level, inside the label-permutation null's own
spread. See the minimal-experiment design's "Guard 3" in
thought_intake_2026-08-11_behavioural_diversity_umpire.md for the concrete recipe.
CONFIRMING signature: a classifier trained on held-in episodes classifies held-out
episodes' condition (reef-ON vs reef-OFF), at a held-out episode budget set by the design's
power calculation ("Guard 1"), at accuracy exceeding a label-permutation null (p<0.05) AND
exceeding the same pipeline run on an untrained/random-policy control sampled from the same
two environments (rules out "the environments just look different" regardless of policy)
AND remains selectively sensitive to the reef-presence axis under an orthogonal nuisance
perturbation (e.g. hazard_food_attraction shifted) rather than losing or gaining
discriminability indiscriminately. Report, as a companion diagnostic and NOT a gate on this
PASS (added 2026-08-18, Ojala & Garriga 2010 "Guard 2"): whether accuracy also clears a
within-class feature-permutation null. A PASS that does not clear the feature-permutation
null means the signal is carried by a single dominant marginal (most plausibly refuge
occupancy) rather than genuine joint structure across the feature families -- this bears on
Stage 2 interpretation, not on whether Stage 1 discriminability exists, and must be stated
plainly rather than folded silently into a bare PASS.
FALSIFYING signature: held-out accuracy sits AT chance, inside the permutation null's own
spread (a genuine null -- no evidence of discriminability); OR it clears the null but does
not exceed the matched untrained-policy control (the signal is environment-geometry, not
policy-behaviour); OR the orthogonal-perturbation check shows the discriminator is equally
sensitive to the nuisance axis as to the real one (not ecological-problem-specific).
NOT A FALSIFYING SIGNATURE -- A PIPELINE FAULT TO DIAGNOSE (added 2026-08-18, Goergen et al.
2018): held-out accuracy sits SYSTEMATICALLY BELOW chance, below the permutation null's own
lower tail. This is the signature of a cross-validation-fold/episode-blocking mismatch, not
an absence of signal -- do not report it as a clean null in either direction. Diagnose the
fold structure against the pipeline-validity precondition's null/design-variable control
runs above, fix the mismatch, and re-run before drawing any conclusion.

claims.claim_title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.
claims.falsifier_summary: The resolved structure is the same in both environments, or a structure transplants without loss, or the between-environment difference is fully accounted for by write() call counts rather than latent structure.
claims.required_event: The same agent architecture resolving its representational structure in two environments of materially different latent complexity, each run long enough for structure to settle.
claims.manipulation: Vary ONLY the environment's ground-truth latent-context count between arms (architecture, num_slots and training budget held fixed), then transplant the structure resolved in one environment into the other.
claims.control: The reciprocal transplant arm, a write-count-matched arm, and an identical-environment replicate pair that bounds run-to-run variation in the resolved structure.
claims.DV: Effective bucket count and relational topology of the resolved representation in each environment, plus MECH-495's relational-appropriateness score for the locally-resolved structure against the transplanted one; the between-environment difference must survive matching on write() calls.
claims.instrument: Absent at both ends. ree-v3 has one environment family (ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py) and no ground-truth context labels anywhere (zero hits for context_id/true_context/ground_truth_context), and ContextMemory is a fixed 16-slot buffer with no effective-bucket-count or relational-topology readout; no MECH-495 relational-appropriateness measure exists in code.
claims.consumer_locus: The crystallised representational partition (ContextMemory slot organisation and its induced distance structure), not downstream task reward.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: At least two environments whose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context count differs by a designed margin; MECH-496's schedule preconditions holding separately in each; identical architecture and identical num_slots in both arms; and write() call counts matched or explicitly reported so a capacity effect cannot masquerade as a structural one.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 cannot generate the required contrast: one environment family, no declared ground-truth latent-context count, no plastic dimensionality (MECH-496 unimplemented; ContextMemory num_slots fixed at 16) and no relational-topology instrument. Nothing in substrate_queue owns any of these.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: An environment-conditional claim needs two arms whose latent complexity differs by a KNOWN margin, plus a readout of the resolved representational structure that is not a fixed-N spread statistic.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: A declared ground-truth latent-context count on CausalGridWorld (a labelled context/regime generator) and a second, designed complexity level of the same environment family, so latent complexity can be varied with architecture held fixed.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: Effective bucket count (occupancy-aware) and a relational-topology readout over ContextMemory, reported alongside write() call counts so the capacity confound is measurable rather than assumed.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: MECH-495 owns the memory-side objective and MECH-496 the plasticity schedule; neither owns the environment-side ground truth or the structure readout, and substrate_queue has no entry mentioning INV-101, MECH-495 or MECH-496.

claims.auditor_notes: This is a measurement/environment item, deliberately not a new cognitive mechanism. It is also the cheapest route to evidence for MECH-495's 2x2 off-diagonal cells, which the WWA identifies as doubling as a dimensionality mis-specification detector.
claims.coordinator_note: Merged with MECH-493's environment candidate into ONE registered node (context-ambiguity 2x2 environment family with ground-truth latent-context labels + ContextMemory occupancy/relational-topology readout), per the 2026-08-19 hippocampal intake's own instruction to build the 2x2 family once for both intakes.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) At least TWO environments whose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context count differs by a
known, designed margin. A single environment cannot test an environment-conditional
claim in either direction. This is a design constraint on the substrate, not an
afterthought -- the same constraint MECH-495 states for its own ground-truth labels.
(ii) MECH-496's schedule preconditions must hold in EACH environment separately, or a
between-environment difference is unattributable.
(iii) The SAME architecture and the SAME num_slots in both arms. Varying the
environment and the architecture together makes the comparison uninterpretable.

CONFIRMING: the resolved structure -- effective bucket count AND the relational
topology of the resulting representations -- DIFFERS between the two environments in
the direction of their ground-truth latent-context counts, starting from an identical
architecture; and in each environment the locally-resolved structure scores better on
MECH-495's relational-appropriateness measure than the other environment's resolved
structure does when transplanted in.

FALSIFYING: the resolved structure is the SAME in both environments (architecture
dominates, so the target is a constant after all); OR a structure resolved in one
environment transplants to the other WITHOUT LOSS (the conditioning does no work); OR
the between-environment difference is FULLY accounted for by the number of write()
calls rather than by latent structure.

THE CONFOUND TO GUARD is that last one -- a capacity effect masquerading as a
structural one. It is the same shape as the confirmed V3-EXQ-429 defect, where an
untouched 16-slot bank cleared a differentiation threshold at P=1.0000 because the
statistic responded to bank size rather than to organisation. Match or explicitly
report write() call counts across arms.

MEASUREMENT COROLLARY (bears on GFLAG-0047; does NOT resolve it). If this claim holds,
MECH-495's 2x2 off-diagonal cells double as a DIMENSIONALITY MIS-SPECIFICATION
detector, not only an objective detector: the different-appearance/same-context cell
detects OVER-provisioning (spurious splitting) and the similar-appearance/
different-context cell detects UNDER-provisioning (forced merging). That is a second,
independent use for a test which is already designed, and it is the cheapest route to

claims.claim_title: A bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidate trajectories: it persists WHICH differentiated alternative was considered (identity plus a trajectory/value sketch, not merely a transient scalar) past the tick it was rejected on, so a later stage can counterfactually evaluate it and attribute responsibility -- admitted and typed under the MECH-322 template (audited replay_origin-style flag, fail-closed admission, accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution), riding ON the MECH-094 imagination/reality write gate rather than relaxing it.
claims.falsifier_summary: Retained content cannot be kept distinguishable without hand-tuned case-by-case gating (no MECH-322-shaped template suffices, so the confabulation risk is not tractably bounded), or persistence of identity changes no responsibility-relevant behaviour over the existing transient scalar.
claims.required_event: An E3 tick that rejects a behaviourally distinct alternative, followed later by an occasion for counterfactual evaluation or self-attribution that could use the rejected alternative's identity.
claims.manipulation: Build and enable a bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer that persists the rejected candidate's identity plus trajectory/value sketch past its rejection tick, typed under the MECH-322 template (audited replay_origin-style flag, fail-closed admission, accelerated dissolution without waking corroboration), versus discard-immediately.
claims.control: The MECH-264-only baseline (frontopolar cfv_now transient scalar, discard at end of tick) at matched seeds, plus a provenance-stress arm in which retained content is offered to the residue/valence/hippocampal write paths to test the confabulation guard behaviourally rather than by design.
claims.DV: Three quantities: persistence of rejected-alternative identity past the rejection tick; leakage of imagined-only content into residue/valence/hippocampal channels and any elevated confidence attached to it; and a measurable change in counterfactual-evaluation or self-attribution behaviour over the MECH-264-only baseline.
claims.instrument: The value half exists and is transient by construction -- FrontopolarAnalog.compute_counterfactual_value writes a single overwritten _last_counterfactual_value scalar per tick; the typing template exists (MECH-322 in policy_chunking.py / hippocampal module; MECH-094 committed_vs_imagined). Nothing persists WHICH alternative existed: ree_core has no rejected_candidate / uncommitted_candidate / candidate_retention store of any kind.
claims.consumer_locus: The retention store between E3 candidate rejection and later counterfactual evaluation, riding ON the MECH-094 imagination/reality write gate rather than relaxing it -- not the online frontopolar comparison.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The claim's own gate, which is still unmet: MECH-439's E3 conversion ceiling must clear so the candidate set carries genuinely differentiated rejected alternatives -- with a monostrategy candidate pool there is nothing distinct to retain and the discard-immediately baseline is identical to retention by construction. Q-090's admission criterion (same-scale versus independent goal-match) must also be resolved before a buffer is scoped.
claims.blocking_reason: Two blockers, the first binding: the conversion ceiling leaves the candidate pool undifferentiated, so retention-versus-discard cannot discriminate; and the buffer itself is unbuilt, with only the typing template (MECH-322/MECH-094) and the transient cfv scalar in place. No self-attribution DV is instrumented at the retention boundary.
false_positives: The 2026-08-07 phase-consistency WARN on ARC-085 is a confirmed false positive: ARC-085 is named as a candidate eventual host, not a load-bearing dependency, and MECH-487's V3 content stands without it -- GFLAG-0396 nonetheless still carries it as an unadjudicated root leak.
claims.auditor_notes: The claim explicitly forbids building ahead of the MECH-439 clearing and of Q-090's admission-criterion resolution; the coordinator should keep it sequenced behind f_dominance_conversion_ceiling rather than minting a build node now.
claims.what_would_answer:
Registered 2026-08-07 from the dedicated lit-pull commissioned by MECH-485 /
INV-012 leg 3 and by memory project_imagination_learning_constraints.md
(2026-05-10), which gated this exact registration "do NOT register without
dedicated lit-pull". Literature: evidence/literature/
targeted_review_uncommitted_candidate_retention/ (5 entries).

MECHANISM SHAPE the lit-pull grounds -- TWO disciplines, both required:
(1) a TYPING discipline (Schnider 2013 orbitofrontal reality filtering,
10.3389/fnbeh.2013.00067; Bouzerda-Wahlen 2015 reality-filter / source-
monitoring dissociation, 10.1162/jocn_a_00686): retained content must carry a
fast, standalone provenance/reality tag -- separable from the "which
alternative" content -- that keeps it typed considered-but-not-real and off
the residue/valence/hippocampal write paths committed action gets; the failure
mode of an untyped store is confabulation. This is REE's MECH-094
committed_vs_imagined bit, made load-bearing.
(2) a BOUNDING discipline (Janner 2019 MBPO, arXiv:1906.08253): imagined /
non-executed content may feed evaluation/learning only within a bounded,
uncertainty-gated, corroboration-limited regime -- MBPO's short model-trust
horizon is the algorithmic form of MECH-322's fail-closed admission plus
accelerated dissolution of any chunk not corroborated by real waking
execution; the trust bound should scale with model uncertainty (REE
epistemic_deficit / MECH-482), tying retention to the same confidence term
that routes MECH-485's orient/survey leg.

LICITNESS (the other half of the lit-pull's question): Boorman 2011
(10.1371/journal.pbio.1001093) shows a dedicated frontopolar network tracks
the BEST counterfactual (unchosen) option and carries a counterfactual
prediction error for learning from hypothetical feedback -- so retaining and
learning from rejected options is a normal adaptive function, not confabulation
by construction, PROVIDED it stays a prior for future testing (memory LICIT
category #4) under the bounding discipline above. Its selectivity (the BEST
option, not all) bears on Q-090's admission criterion.

WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT vs MISSING: Boorman 2009 (10.1016/j.neuron.2009.05.014)
is the biological anchor for REE's SD-033e/MECH-264 frontopolar counterfactual
value, but the signal is an ONLINE relative-advantage magnitude -- exactly
MECH-264's cfv_now transient scalar overwritten every tick. So the substrate
for representing a rejected alternative's VALUE exists; what does NOT exist in
ree-v3 in any form is persistence of WHICH alternative existed, past the tick,
in a store usable for retrospective evaluation. That identity + persistence is
MECH-487's novel content.

CONFIRMED if a built retention buffer (a) persists a rejected E3 candidate's
identity / trajectory-sketch past the tick it was rejected on, (b) keeps it
provenance-distinguishable from committed/real content under test (no elevated
confidence for imagined-only content leaking into residue/valence/hippocampal
channels -- the confabulation guard holds behaviourally, not just by design),
and (c) supplies a function -- measurably different counterfactual evaluation
or self-attribution behaviour -- BEYOND what MECH-264's existing transient
scalar already provides, over a discard-immediately ablation baseline.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept distinguishable from
committed content without a hand-tuned, case-by-case gate (no general
MECH-322-shaped template suffices) -- i.e. the confabulation risk is not
tractably bounded, and the mechanism should be retired or radically narrowed --
OR if a bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer produces no measurable
change in counterfactual-evaluation / responsibility-relevant behaviour over
the discard-immediately (MECH-264-only) baseline, i.e. persistence-of-identity
adds no function beyond the existing transient scalar.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with MECH-485 / INV-012 leg 3): MECH-439's
E3 selection conversion ceiling must clear first (ceiling_decision: exhausted
as of registration) -- with no genuinely differentiated candidates to select
among, there is nothing to retain, so no retention test is meaningful. Do NOT
build ahead of that clearing, or ahead of Q-090's admission-criterion
resolution (same-scale vs independent goal-match). Architectural synthesis
grounded in the cited literature; not yet verified against a built ree-v3
retention buffer, which does not exist.

claims.claim_title: REE requires a general, typed, multi-relation possibility topology -- not merely the existing parent/subgoal edge -- in which represented possibilities/goals are connected by explicit relation types (requires, enables, is_part_of, prevents, conflicts_with, substitutes_for, provides_information_about, may_become_useful_under_context) below active-goal salience; the active goal/subgoal hierarchy is a temporary, context-sensitive executive projection from this larger structure, discovered and revised through action rather than merely traversed.
claims.falsifier_summary: A scalar-relevance baseline plus the existing ghost-goal ranking reproduces the same discover-retain-reactivate behaviour, or performance is invariant to relation type once admitted-candidate count is matched -- the typed store would then be unneeded structure.
claims.required_event: Mid-episode discovery of a possibility related to the current goal by a non-parent/subgoal relation (an observed anchor-remap succession A -> B written as 'A enables B'), retention across a context shift, and later retrieval when context changes.
claims.manipulation: Possibility topology enabled versus disabled on the GhostGoalBank read path, plus a second registered relation type (requires or is_part_of, reachable via register_relation) so that relation TYPE rather than mere edge presence is the manipulated variable.
claims.control: A Kinny-and-Georgeff-shaped scalar baseline: no stored relation types, only the existing MECH-292/293 ghost-goal ranking and a reconsideration-rate parameter, tuned on the same relevance signals and matched on admitted-candidate count.
claims.DV: Retrieval and action on the retained possibility after the context shift -- which regions the CEM probes (rank()[:n_ghost] composition) and the resulting behaviour -- compared between the typed-topology arm and the count-matched scalar baseline, and across relation types.
claims.instrument: ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/possibility_topology.py (typed edge store over AnchorKeys), its writer in hippocampal/anchor_set.py write_anchor, and its consumer in hippocampal/ghost_goal_bank.py rank() feeding HippocampalModule._propose_ghost_seeded; contract-pinned in tests/contracts/test_sd_097_possibility_topology.py.
claims.consumer_locus: Ghost-probe seeding: which anchors' z_world the CEM probes from -- the one live consumer through which a relation can change behaviour.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The typed-versus-scalar contrast only discriminates if MORE THAN ONE relation type is registered and consumed: the shipped store registers exactly one (enables), so a single-relation arm is indistinguishable from an untyped edge or a scalar relevance bump. The scalar baseline must also be matched on the NUMBER of extra anchors admitted, or the typed arm merely probes more candidates.
claims.blocking_reason: With exactly one registered relation and one consumer, the TYPE cannot be load-bearing, so the claim's central typed-versus-scalar discrimination is degenerate as shipped. No experiment exists, and the count-matched scalar comparator that would separate 'typed' from 'admits more candidates' has not been designed.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim's registration-time stance ('no ree-v3 code implements any form of typed multi-relation possibility storage') is now wrong: a minimal single-relation topology with a live ghost-probe consumer landed on ree-v3 main 2026-09-17 (a902639).

The claim's premise that it generalises 'the existing parent/subgoal edge' is wrong at source, as the module's own header records: SD-092 couples two latent vectors by an EMA pull, with no node identity and no edge object.
claims.auditor_notes: Apparent tension for the coordinator to resolve: V3-EXQ-1055's header records a user decision dated 2026-09-17 'do NOT build SD-097's typed topology', and the minimal topology landed the same day. Registering a second relation type is a one-call change to the store but needs a consumer, which is exactly the inert-substrate failure this build was triaged to avoid.
claims.what_would_answer:
Registered 2026-08-07 from a dedicated lit-pull commissioned by the Stage 2
thought intake's own "Next steps" (Section 13): a search across hippocampal/
entorhinal relational-map literature, goal-reconsideration/opportunistic-
planning literature, and hierarchical-RL/subgoal-discovery literature.
Literature: evidence/literature/targeted_review_relational_possibility_topology/
(5 entries).

GROUNDING the literature supplies: Whittington et al. 2020 (Cell, Tolman-
Eichenbaum Machine) and Park, Miller & Boorman 2021 (Nat Neurosci,
multidimensional social-hierarchy grid code) both show the hippocampal-
entorhinal system represents RELATIONAL structure that generalizes well beyond
spatial parent/child navigation -- direct support that a typed-relation
substrate is biologically plausible, not merely a symbolic graph bolted onto
the architecture. Khetarpal et al. 2020 (ICML, Theory of Affordances in RL)
supplies a second, independent relation type (what-can-I-do-here / enables)
already formalized in the RL literature, evidence that "requires/enables" is
not an ad hoc addition. Veeriah et al. 2021 (NeurIPS, meta-learned subgoal
discovery) evidences the DISCOVERY-THROUGH-ACTION half of the claim -- that
useful subgoal structure can be learned online rather than pre-specified.

NON-DEGENERACY / SKEPTICAL BASELINE the lit-pull deliberately sought out:
Kinny & Georgeff 1991 (IJCAI, commitment in situated Tileworld agents) show a
"bold" agent with NO stored relational structure at all -- only a scalar
policy for how many plan-steps to execute before reconsidering -- achieves
near-perfect effectiveness whenever the environment is not highly dynamic,
with the entire bold/cautious tradeoff explained by one scalar (rate of world
change). This is real evidence that a large share of ordinary goal
reconsideration needs no topology at all. Its explicit limit: it has no
analogue of RETAINING an inactive possibility across time for later
reactivation (MECH-292/293's job), so it stress-tests only the discovery/
reconsideration half of this claim, not the retention half.

CONFIRMED if an agent is shown to (a) discover, mid-episode, a possibility
related to its current goal by a relation type OTHER than parent/subgoal
(e.g. enables or conflicts_with), (b) retain it at sub-goal salience without
acting on it, and (c) later retrieve and act on it when context changes -- AND
this requires representing the relation TYPE itself (not merely a scalar
relevance/priority value) to succeed: a model built only from SD-092's
parent/subgoal edge plus MECH-292's ghost-goal ranking, tuned on the same
relevance signals, must be shown to fail or require an ad hoc special case
per new relation type, where the typed-topology model does not.

FALSIFIED if the same behaviour is fully reproduced by a Kinny & Georgeff-
shaped scalar-commitment-dynamism baseline (no stored relation types, only a
reconsideration-rate parameter) plus the EXISTING MECH-292/293 ghost-goal
ranking -- i.e. if nothing beyond the already-registered substrate is needed
to produce the behaviour the raw thought described.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: any test must first confirm the baseline model
(scalar relevance + parent/subgoal only) is actually exercised under
non-degenerate conditions (live cross-seed variance in which possibilities get
revisited) before concluding the typed-relation extension adds function --
an untrained or degenerate baseline would make the typed model look necessary
when it is merely the only one that was actually tested.
