claims.claim_title: Does REE's organising/control machinery (E1, E2, E3, commitment, replay, residue, goal-maintenance dynamics) scale sublinearly relative to the richness of the representational spaces it organises (latent fields, perceptual/semantic knowledge, hippocampal structures) -- measured as competence achieved per unit of total lifetime computational and experiential cost (developmental/training compute, environmental experience, inference, memory storage/retrieval, offline replay/consolidation, adaptation after environmental change, planning/ counterfactual simulation) -- at approximately MATCHED behavioural competence against comparison systems, rather than at unmatched competence or raw parameter/model-size counts?
claims.falsifier_summary: At matched competence REE's control-machinery cost scales comparably or worse, or REE's control machinery must scale roughly in proportion to representational richness to sustain competence -- no efficiency dividend from persistent structured state.
claims.required_event: A shared task family on which both system classes reach comparable behavioural competence, with the full lifetime accounted end to end -- developmental/training compute, environmental experience, inference, memory storage and retrieval, offline replay, and post-change adaptation.
claims.manipulation: Two separate comparisons: across system classes at matched competence (REE versus a baseline), and within REE across configurations that vary representational richness (latent dimensionality, ContextMemory slots, hippocampal store size) while holding E1/E2/E3 control-machinery size fixed.
claims.control: Matched-competence pairing is itself the control for the cross-system leg; for the within-REE leg, a fixed-control-machinery series plus a series in which the control machinery is scaled together with representation, so sub-proportionality is read against proportional scaling.
claims.DV: Competence achieved per unit total lifetime cost, and the exponent of control-machinery cost against representational richness at fixed control size -- sub-proportional growth versus roughly proportional growth.
claims.instrument: No lifetime-cost ledger exists: ree_core records no FLOP, parameter-count, experience-step or memory-footprint accounting (the only param_count-like reference in ree_core is in policy/gated_policy.py), so the denominator of every stated DV is currently unrecorded.
claims.consumer_locus: The scaling relationship between the organising/control machinery and the representational spaces it organises -- not per-step inference cost and not raw parameter counts.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: REE and the comparison system must first be matched at approximately equal behavioural competence on the same task family; comparing lifetime cost at unmatched competence measures the competence gap, not efficiency. That matching is not achievable for REE-v3 and the claim's own record says so.
claims.blocking_reason: Correctly not runnable in V3: no matched-competence comparison point exists and the claim's own text says REE-v3 is far less competent than the systems it would be compared with. Separately, even the within-REE leg has no cost instrument -- nothing in ree_core records lifetime compute, experience or memory footprint.
claims.auditor_notes: Deliberately NOT proposing a lifetime-cost ledger node: the primary class is R8 and building the denominator for a comparison whose numerator is unreachable is premature. Flagging it so the coordinator can decide -- if the within-REE scaling leg is split out as its own claim, a per-run cost ledger becomes the one instrument it needs and would then be worth registering.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison is vacuous unless REE and the baseline system are first matched at approximately equal behavioural competence on the same task family -- comparing lifetime-compute or footprint at UNMATCHED competence proves nothing about efficiency, only about the competence gap. This precondition is not yet met for REE-v3 (see notes); this claim cannot be tested validly until it is.
CONFIRMING: once matched-competence comparison points exist, REE's total lifetime cost at matched competence is lower than baseline systems', AND/OR the cost of REE's control/organising machinery (E1/E2/E3, commitment, replay, residue, goal maintenance) grows sub-proportionally as the richness of what its representational spaces (z_world, semantic/episodic memory, hippocampal structures) can encode increases across REE configurations of fixed control-machinery size.
FALSIFYING: at matched competence, REE's control-machinery cost scales comparably to or worse than baseline systems, or REE's own control machinery must scale roughly in proportion to representational richness to sustain competence as that richness grows (no efficiency dividend from persistent structured state + selective computation over in-context recomputation).

claims.claim_title: MECH-286's sleep-permission threat conjunct is an UNCALIBRATED, UNDECLARED-SOURCE consumer of the same shared z_harm_a.norm() expression whose place-safety informativeness V3-EXQ-917 showed is set by unrelated driver config: the gate's third term is `z_harm_a.norm() < mech286_threat_tonic_threshold` (default 0.4), the identical expression MECH-303's contextual-safety gate reads, which measures at chance (AUC <= 0.52 across 18 swept thresholds) under damage_sourced and at AUC 0.84-0.97 under the proximity_ema_sourced default. MECH-286 declares no sourcing mode of its own and inherits whichever the driver happens to set, and its 0.4 threshold has never been calibrated against any measurement of that signal. Therefore, with use_mech286_sleep_onset_gate enabled, threat_ok does not reliably gate on place safety; being ANDed into a three-way conjunction, a near-constant term silently degrades the gate to an effective always-permit (or, above threshold, always-refuse) rather than a safety gate.
claims.falsifier_summary: mech286_threat_ok discriminates above the 0.6 bar under BOTH sourcing modes at the default 0.4 threshold, which would show the term does gate on place safety regardless of driver configuration.
claims.required_event: The agent occupying hazardous and non-hazardous locations while evaluate_sleep_onset_permit is evaluated at those positions, under a random-walk policy that does not avoid hazard.
claims.manipulation: Sourcing mode: limb_damage_enabled True (damage_sourced) versus False (proximity_ema_sourced), which is exactly the driver-config inheritance the claim says MECH-286 never declares.
claims.control: The random walk itself as positive control (both hazard classes reachable by construction); the label-balance and apparatus-validity readiness gates; and the hand-set-z_harm_a design explicitly excluded rather than reused.
claims.DV: AUC of mech286_threat_ok against the ground-truth hazard label, computed separately per sourcing mode, against a pre-registered 0.6 discrimination bar -- measured 0.5016 (damage_sourced) and 0.4966 (proximity_ema_sourced), i.e. chance under both.
claims.instrument: ree_core/sleep/sleep_onset_gate.py already emits mech286_threat_ok, mech286_z_harm_a_norm and mech286_threat_tonic_threshold from evaluate_sleep_onset_permit; no ree_core change was needed and none was made -- V3-EXQ-950 is a driver over the existing diagnostics.
claims.consumer_locus: The threat conjunct of the three-way AND (override_ok and staleness_ok and threat_ok) that decides whether the agent may enter sleep at all.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The agent must be driven through real world positions with ground-truth hazard and the gate's own emitted diagnostics read there, never with z_harm_a set by hand (the V3-EXQ-891 degenerate form). V3-EXQ-950 met this: both hazard classes populated at min class fraction 0.219 against a 0.1 floor, z_harm_a apparatus valid at 1.0 against a 0.99 floor.
claims.blocking_reason: None. Every element exists and the falsifier has fired: V3-EXQ-950 drove real positions with ground-truth hazard under both sourcing modes, met all readiness preconditions, and returned chance discrimination -- the claim's own confirming branch. Read the manifest's combination_rule, not criteria[].passed, which shows false for all four by design.
false_positives: The evidence_quality_note clause 'no run has ever correlated mech286_threat_ok against ground-truth hazard' is superseded by V3-EXQ-950 and is already annotated as such in the claim record.
claims.auditor_notes: The weaker ALSO-FALSIFYING leg -- that the term is near-constant but another conjunct is always the binding one, so the silent-degradation consequence does not hold -- was NOT measured by 950, which scored discrimination only. That leg needs a run with the gate enabled and all three conjuncts logged; it is a narrowing question, not a blocker on the main claim.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the falsifier must drive the agent through REAL world positions with known ground-truth hazard and read the gate's own emitted diagnostics there. It must NOT set z_harm_a by hand -- see the V3-EXQ-891 correction in notes below, which is exactly the degenerate form.
NO NEW SUBSTRATE INSTRUMENTATION IS NEEDED: evaluate_sleep_onset_permit already emits mech286_threat_ok, mech286_z_harm_a_norm, and mech286_threat_tonic_threshold in its diagnostics dict. A new DRIVER is needed (891 cannot be reused as-is); no ree_core change is.
The falsifier must be run under BOTH sourcing modes (limb_damage_enabled True and False), because the whole point of the claim is that MECH-286 declares neither and inherits whichever the driver sets.
CONFIRMING (claim SUPPORTED): mech286_threat_ok fails to discriminate hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under the sourcing mode(s) tested, OR is invariant across the ground-truth hazard gradient (near-constant 0 or 1 across all locations), OR discriminates under one sourcing mode and not the other -- the last being the specific "informativeness inherited from unrelated driver config" leg, and the one that would confirm the claim in its exact registered form.
FALSIFYING (claim REFUTED): mech286_threat_ok discriminates hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under BOTH sourcing modes at the default threshold of 0.4, i.e. the term does gate on place safety regardless of driver configuration and the sourcing is adequate as built.
ALSO FALSIFYING (weaker, partial): the term is shown to be near-constant but the conjunction's behaviour is nonetheless unaffected because another conjunct is always the binding one -- in which case the wiring is still undeclared but the "silently degrades the gate" consequence does not hold, and this claim should be narrowed rather than supported.

claims.claim_title: Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.
claims.falsifier_summary: Context switching is fully explained by similarity retrieval or unsigned prediction error alone (no residual for hysteresis to explain), or the added machinery fails to improve hidden-context discrimination and instead raises orienting occupancy without competence gain.
claims.required_event: Episodes in an environment family where perceptually similar states require opposing policies, containing both transient ambiguity (which should not switch the active context) and genuine persistent evidence shifts (which should).
claims.manipulation: Add a switch threshold plus switch cost and a protected post-selection exploitation window on the CONTEXT variable, ablated against a no-hysteresis soft per-step gate (the ARC-062 learned discriminator as built).
claims.control: Matched no-hysteresis arm at identical training budget, plus an orienting-without-exploitation-window arm to expose the predicted permanently-epistemic pathology rather than only a null.
claims.DV: Mean dwell in the correct context, switch count under transient versus persistent ambiguity, task competence conditioned on correct-context dwell, and orienting occupancy -- with the competence gain required to trace to increased correct-context dwell, not merely to fewer switches.
claims.instrument: Partially absent. ContextMemory lives in ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py and has no dwell, switch-cost, hysteresis or exploitation-window state (zero hits for those names in that module); the closest existing probe, V3-EXQ-847a, is a context-conditioned mode-switch measurement-adequacy diagnostic over the ARC-062 gated policy, not a hysteresis ablation.
claims.consumer_locus: The context-selection step itself -- which latent situation is treated as active -- one level above the action/mode variable where MECH-106/MECH-047 commitment hysteresis is already built.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The context variable must be observably live (context assignment varies across episodes rather than collapsing to one ContextMemory slot, cf. V3-EXQ-436f), the agent must not have collapsed to monostrategy (MECH-309) so context-conditional behaviour exists to protect, and MECH-153's undifferentiated-ContextMemory finding (cosine similarity near 1.0 without a supervised context objective) must be excluded.
claims.blocking_reason: The required environment does not exist: ree_core/environment holds only causal_grid_world.py, and no perceptually-similar/opposing-policy context pair is built anywhere in experiments/. Separately, no context-level dwell or switch-cost state exists to ablate, so even with the environment there is nothing to toggle.

prerequisite_candidate.falsifier_requirement: All three claims need the same similar-appearance / different-context cell: an environment family where near-identical observations demand opposing policies, so that misassignment is behaviourally costly and dwell/switch dynamics become measurable.
prerequisite_candidate.event_or_manipulation_produced: Paired contexts with near-identical observations and inverted contingencies, plus experimenter-controlled transient ambiguity episodes and genuine persistent context shifts.
prerequisite_candidate.dv_or_instrument_exposed: A per-episode context-assignment trace exposing dwell length, switch count, orienting occupancy, and competence conditioned on correct-context dwell, with off-diagonal cell counts reported.
prerequisite_candidate.why_no_existing_owner: The 2026-08-19 intake instructs that the environment be built once for MECH-493/494/495 but no substrate_queue entry, claim, closure-plan node or experiment script owns it; CausalGridWorldV2 is the only environment in ree_core/environment.

claims.auditor_notes: Duplicate-node risk: check MECH-495's sibling intake before registering, since the same 2x2 design is described there and may already be partly specified under a different name.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory -- without it the run is vacuous):
(i) the context variable must be observably live -- context assignment must vary
across episodes and be recoverable from the substrate, NOT collapsed to a single
value (cf. V3-EXQ-436f, where 3/5 seeds occupied exactly 1 of 16 ContextMemory
slots despite thousands of write() calls); (ii) the agent must not have collapsed
to monostrategy (MECH-309) -- either run on the ARC-062 gated-policy substrate or
pre-register MECH-309 collapse as an alternative explanation, because a
monostrategy agent has no context-conditional behaviour for context arbitration
to affect and will produce a null for reasons unrelated to this claim;
(iii) MECH-153's undifferentiated-ContextMemory finding (cosine_sim ~= 1.0 without
a supervised context objective) must be excluded or the retrieval path is silent.

CONFIRMING: in an environment family containing perceptually similar states
requiring OPPOSING policies, an agent with hysteresis + exploitation window
(a) maintains the active context under minor/transient ambiguity, (b) switches
when evidence genuinely and persistently favours another context, and (c) achieves
higher task competence than a matched no-hysteresis ablation BECAUSE it sustains
an interpretation long enough to act on it -- with the competence gain traceable
to increased mean dwell in a correct context, not merely to fewer switches.

FALSIFYING, two distinct routes, BOTH of which count against this claim:
(1) SUFFICIENCY OF THE SIMPLE ACCOUNT -- context switching in these environments is
fully explained by similarity retrieval alone or by unsigned prediction error
alone, with no residual variance for hysteresis/orienting to explain; the larger
mechanism is then unnecessary.
(2) OVERBUILD / PATHOLOGY -- adding uncertainty-sensitivity, orienting and
hysteresis fails to improve hidden-context discrimination, OR produces pathological
indecision (the permanently-epistemic failure: orienting occupancy rises without a
corresponding competence gain). Note route (2) is a REAL predicted risk of this
claim's own mechanism, not merely a null -- an agent with orienting but without a
protected exploitation window should be predicted to get WORSE, and observing that
specific pattern supports the necessity of the window while falsifying any account
that treats orienting alone as sufficient.

claims.claim_title: The criterion for abandoning an inferred context is PERSISTENT, STRUCTURED evidence that the currently inferred latent situation no longer explains observations OR THEIR ACTION CONSEQUENCES -- not unsigned prediction-error magnitude. A startling transient, sensor noise, gradual environmental drift, and a genuine latent-state transition can all produce large prediction error, and should NOT produce the same response: transient surprise should not switch context, gradual drift may warrant update-in-place rather than switch, and only genuine latent transition should switch. The ACTION-CONSEQUENCE term is the part with no existing REE analogue: MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD change-point already supplies a persistence-based (rather than threshold-based) boundary signal over z_goal, but it is computed over observations and is consumed as a region KEY by downstream substrates (MECH-269 anchor sets, per-region V_s, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-287 broadcast) -- nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts.
claims.falsifier_summary: Switch behaviour is fully predicted by an unsigned-PE threshold or by MECH-288's observation-side change-point alone, with the action-consequence term adding no independent power; or the four conditions cannot be dissociated at all, which is non_contributory rather than a claim-layer falsification.
claims.required_event: Transient surprise, sensor noise, gradual drift and abrupt latent transition, each independently inducible -- causal_grid_world supplies interoceptive_noise / autonomic_noise, background_drift, environment swap, and world_rule_shift, which permutes the action-to-direction map and so reverses action consequences with appearance unchanged.
claims.manipulation: Condition type as a four-level factor at matched onset PE, plus the discriminating fifth condition in which observations remain well explained while action consequences do not (world_rule_shift or a policy-reversal of the same scene).
claims.control: PE-magnitude-matched conditions against each other, and MECH-288's observation-side slow-scale BOCPD boundary posterior as the incumbent predictor the action-consequence term must beat.
claims.DV: Context-switch rate per condition, and the incremental predictive power of a PERSISTENT action-conditioned explanatory-failure statistic over both instantaneous unsigned PE and MECH-288's boundary posterior -- switches rare under transient surprise and noise, update-in-place under drift, reliable under abrupt transition and under consequence reversal.
claims.instrument: MECH-288's event_segmenter BOCPD and MECH-287's InvalidationTrigger exist but are computed over observation/z_goal streams and feed anchor reset and staleness only. E2World.forward is action-conditioned and yields the right raw residual, but nothing computes a persistence statistic over it and nothing emits a switch/retain/create event to count.
claims.consumer_locus: Arbitration over STORED contexts -- retain the current inferred context, switch to another, or create a new one -- rather than region keying, anchor reset or staleness, which is where the existing boundary signal terminates.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The four conditions must produce COMPARABLE unsigned prediction error at onset -- verify the per-condition PE distributions before scoring any switch behaviour, or the design cannot separate this claim from a PE-magnitude threshold. Separately, a retain-versus-switch-versus-create decision must be observable at all, which it currently is not.
claims.blocking_reason: No consumer arbitrates retain-versus-switch-versus-create over stored contexts, so the DV -- a context-switch event -- is not emitted anywhere and cannot be counted. The action-consequence explanatory-failure term, the claim's load-bearing novelty, is computed nowhere, although E2World's action-conditioned residual is the available raw material for it.
false_positives: The environment half is not the blocker: all four conditions plus the consequence-reversal condition are constructible today from existing causal_grid_world knobs (interoceptive/autonomic noise, background_drift, world_rule_shift), so this is a consumer and instrument gap rather than an environment gap.
claims.auditor_notes: Cheapest instrument that would move this: a persistence statistic (a second BOCPD instance, or the existing segmenter re-pointed) over E2World's action-conditioned residual, which would give the action-consequence term a recorder without building the arbitration mechanism. MECH-493 is the sibling that owns the arbitration substrate both claims need; designing either alone risks duplicating it.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the four conditions must be genuinely dissociable in
the substrate -- transient surprise, sensor noise, gradual drift, and abrupt latent
transition must each be independently inducible and must produce COMPARABLE
unsigned prediction-error magnitude at the moment of onset. If the abrupt-transition
condition simply produces larger PE than the others, the design cannot distinguish
this claim from a PE-magnitude threshold and the run is vacuous. Verify by
measuring the PE distributions per condition BEFORE scoring any switch behaviour.

CONFIRMING: context-switch rate is predicted by persistent structured explanatory
failure and NOT by instantaneous PE magnitude, specifically -- switches are rare
under transient surprise and under noise (high PE, no sustained explanatory
failure), rare-or-update-in-place under gradual drift, and reliable under abrupt
latent transition. Additionally, and this is the discriminating half: a condition in
which OBSERVATIONS remain well-explained but ACTION CONSEQUENCES do not (the same
scene now rewards the opposite policy) triggers switching, which an
observation-only criterion such as MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD cannot detect.

FALSIFYING: switch behaviour is fully predicted by an unsigned-PE threshold or by
MECH-288's existing observation-side change-point alone, with the action-consequence
term adding no independent predictive power; OR the four conditions cannot be
behaviourally dissociated at all, which would indicate the criterion is not
implemented (distinct from being wrong -- report as non_contributory, not as a
claim-layer falsification).

claims.claim_title: The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).
claims.falsifier_summary: A maximal-separation objective predicts downstream generalisation and discrimination at least as well across all four cells; or latent-context ground truth is not recoverable at adequate power, which is non_contributory rather than falsified.
claims.required_event: Episodes in which perceptual similarity and latent-context identity vary INDEPENDENTLY -- above all the different-appearance/same-context cell, which the incumbent differentiation objective scores backwards and which is therefore the discriminator.
claims.manipulation: Assignment to the 2x2 cell (appearance similar/different crossed with context same/different) at a fixed declared training point, with the differentiation-maximising objective as the incumbent comparator arm.
claims.control: The two diagonal cells, which any similarity-driven store gets right for free, and a differentiation-scored arm run alongside, so the two objectives' opposite predictions in the off-diagonal cell are read on the same data.
claims.DV: Agreement between representational similarity structure and ground-truth latent-context structure -- specifically, representations in the different-appearance/same-context cell overlapping MORE than those in the similar-appearance/different-context cell -- and whether that ordering predicts downstream generalisation and discrimination. Explicitly not slot_cosine_sim or sws_slot_diversity.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-970a's NMI-excess statistic (I(cluster;slot)/H(cluster) minus a label-shuffle null over the full contingency table) is an existing agreement-with-ground-truth instrument at the write-ADDRESS level; no RSA-style relational statistic over slot CONTENT exists, and no driver assembles the off-diagonal cells.
claims.consumer_locus: The objective that the ContextMemory write/selection path is optimised toward -- what the store is for -- rather than whether a differentiation metric is computed correctly.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: (i) multi-slot occupancy verified BEFORE any topology statistic -- now satisfiable, since the write-path build landed and V3-EXQ-943 measured 16 of 16 slots occupied on 5 of 5 seeds under write_usage_balancing, though the argmin default still collapses to one slot; (ii) ground-truth latent-context labels exposed; (iii) all four 2x2 cells populated; (iv) a declared, fixed read point per MECH-496.
claims.blocking_reason: No driver assembles the 2x2 and no relational statistic over slot content exists; the existing lineage varies appearance and context together (env_safe versus env_dang blocks every five episodes), so the decisive off-diagonal cell has never been generated. The occupancy blocker the precondition names has LANDED and is no longer the obstacle.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: Precondition (i)'s single-slot blocker (V3-EXQ-436f, 3 of 5 seeds at 1 of 16 slots) is closed: the write-usage-balancing build landed and V3-EXQ-943 measured 16 of 16 occupancy on 5 of 5 seeds, so a topology statistic is now computable provided the arm enables it.

GFLAG-0047 is RESOLVED (2026-08-25, user-adjudicated: the validation DV should be a relational-topology statistic), so the DV fork is decided; what is missing is a driver that instantiates the decision, not a further governance call.
claims.auditor_notes: The off-diagonal cells look composable from existing env knobs -- world_rule_shift for similar-appearance/different-context and SD-049 multi_resource_heterogeneity for different-appearance/same-context -- but no run has demonstrated that composition, so treat R3 as a real but probably shallow risk rather than a settled environment gap.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory): (i) the memory store must actually be
recruiting multiple slots -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16
slots despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each, and a single-slot store has NO
topology to evaluate, making any relational statistic undefined rather than merely
null; verify occupancy BEFORE computing any topology statistic. (ii) The environment
must expose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context labels, since the statistic is an agreement
measure against that structure -- this is a design constraint on the substrate, not
an afterthought. (iii) All four cells of the 2x2 must be populated at adequate n.

TEST DESIGN: vary perceptual similarity and latent-context identity INDEPENDENTLY --
(similar appearance, same context), (similar appearance, DIFFERENT context),
(different appearance, SAME context), (different appearance, different context).
The diagonal cells are what any similarity-driven store gets right for free. The two
OFF-DIAGONAL cells are the entire test: similar-appearance/different-context is
where a nearest-match store fails by MERGING; different-appearance/same-context is
where a maximal-separation store fails by SPLITTING.

CONFIRMING: representational similarity structure tracks LATENT-CONTEXT structure
rather than perceptual similarity -- specifically, representations in the
different-appearance/same-context cell overlap MORE than those in the
similar-appearance/different-context cell, and this ordering predicts downstream
generalisation and discrimination performance. Critically, a differentiation-
maximising objective scores the similar-appearance/different-context cell correctly
and the different-appearance/same-context cell BACKWARDS, so the two objectives make
OPPOSITE predictions in that cell -- that cell is the discriminator between this
claim and the incumbent objective, and a design that omits it cannot decide between
them.

FALSIFYING: a maximal-separation objective predicts downstream generalisation and
discrimination at least as well as the relational-topology objective across all four
cells (i.e. appropriate overlap confers no measurable benefit and separating
everything is not merely harmless but optimal); OR the relational statistic cannot be
computed at adequate power because latent-context ground truth is not recoverable
from the substrate (report non_contributory, not falsified).

NOT ANSWERED BY: any re-run of the SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 lineage scored on a
differentiation DV, however correctly that DV is computed. Six generations
(V3-EXQ-436a..436f) have established measurement and substrate facts about
differentiation; none of them tested whether differentiation is the right target.

(iv) DEVELOPMENTAL TIMING (added 2026-08-23 per MECH-496 / INV-101): the topology
statistic must be read either AFTER representational structure has stopped changing,
or as a trajectory ACROSS the change. A system whose bucket structure is still
plastic will read as poor relational agreement on any static snapshot, and that
reading is an artifact of TIMING, not evidence against the objective -- so a run that
omits this precondition can produce a false FALSIFYING result. If no crystallisation
schedule exists in the substrate (TRUE AT REGISTRATION: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) is
a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth or allocation policy), record the structure at
a declared, fixed training point and state that point explicitly, so the snapshot is
at least comparable across arms. See MECH-496's own what_would_answer precondition
(iii) -- do not re-derive it.

claims.claim_title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.
claims.falsifier_summary: Effective bucket count tracks num_slots rather than the environment; or downstream performance is monotone in num_slots (a capacity parameter, not a structure to resolve); or the effective count is flat across training, so no schedule is doing any work even if the final count is right.
claims.required_event: Training runs spanning under- and over-provisioning of num_slots relative to an environment with a known ground-truth latent-context count, with the effective bucket count in use changing (or not) across training.
claims.manipulation: num_slots treated as a declared experimental sweep dimension rather than the constant it is, across a range bracketing the environment's ground-truth context count; the claim's own CHEAPEST FIRST STEP, scoped as a probe rather than a self-sizing build.
claims.control: The fixed num_slots=16 configuration as the incumbent, plus the requirement that downstream generalisation/discrimination be compared ACROSS the sweep rather than within a single N.
claims.DV: Three legs: whether the effective bucket count converges toward the ground-truth context count rather than toward num_slots; whether that convergence is non-monotone in plasticity (high early, reducing) rather than flat; and -- the load-bearing leg -- whether downstream generalisation is FLAT in num_slots over the range where the first leg holds.
claims.instrument: ContextMemory registers a slot_write_counts buffer and existing drivers already derive n_occupied_slots from it (436f, 943, 970a, 972), so per-episode polling of the effective bucket count needs only a driver-side call. No instrument is missing; the manipulation variable is.
claims.consumer_locus: The representational partition itself -- the number and granularity of ContextMemory buckets -- rather than the scoring/policy plane where INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 already specify the open-then-crystallise schedule.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: (i) the store must recruit more than one slot before any dimensionality statistic (inherited from MECH-495, now satisfiable under write_usage_balancing); (ii) num_slots must actually be VARIED, which is currently impossible without a code change; (iii) the effective bucket count must be recorded per episode, not only at the end, or crystallised-at-N cannot be distinguished from always-N.
claims.blocking_reason: num_slots is hard-coded to 16 at the ContextMemory construction site in E1DeepPredictor.__init__ (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) and has no E1Config field, so precondition (ii) cannot be met and even the cheap probe cannot run. The full form additionally needs an allocation/growth policy, which does not exist in any form.
false_positives: The claim describes ContextMemory's memory as a fixed nn.Module buffer; it is an nn.Parameter of shape [num_slots, memory_dim], which does not change the substance (no growth, no allocation policy) but matters to anyone planning the plumbing.
claims.auditor_notes: The missing edge is a two-line plumb -- an E1Config num_slots field passed through E1DeepPredictor.__init__ -- and EXP-0588 already owns the probe. Keep the probe and the self-sizing build separate, as the claim insists: the probe is complex (probe-gated), the build is not authorised by it.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) The store must be recruiting more than one slot before ANY dimensionality
statistic is computed -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16 slots
despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each. A single-slot store has no dimensionality to
measure. This INHERITS MECH-495's precondition (i); do not re-derive it.
(ii) num_slots must actually be VARIED. The claim is about dimensionality as an
OUTCOME, so a single fixed-N run cannot address it in either direction.
(iii) The schedule must be OBSERVABLE: whether the effective number of distinct
buckets in use CHANGES over training must be recorded per-episode, not only at the
end. A single end-of-training snapshot cannot distinguish "crystallised at N" from
"was always N", and the distinction is the claim.

CONFIRMING: with num_slots varied across a range spanning under- and
over-provisioning relative to the environment's ground-truth latent-context count --
(a) the effective bucket count in use converges toward the GROUND-TRUTH count rather
than toward num_slots; (b) that convergence is non-monotone in plasticity -- high
early, reducing -- rather than flat; and (c) downstream generalisation /
discrimination is FLAT with respect to num_slots over the range where (a) holds.
(c) is the LOAD-BEARING leg: it is the claim that the architecture is insensitive to
a constant which is currently hand-set.

FALSIFYING: effective bucket count tracks num_slots rather than the environment (the
store simply fills what it is given); OR downstream performance is MONOTONE in
num_slots (more is just better, so dimensionality is a capacity parameter and not a
structure to be resolved); OR the effective count is FLAT across training (no
schedule, so crystallisation is doing no work even if the final count happens to be
right).

CHEAPEST FIRST STEP -- A PROBE, NOT A BUILD. Treat num_slots as a declared
experimental variable rather than a constant and re-run the V3-EXQ-436 lineage across
a small sweep. If the 436-lineage results are STABLE across num_slots, the
dimensionality question is not currently load-bearing and this claim can wait; if they
MOVE, it is. This is `complex (probe-gated)` work resolving to `puzzle (known rules)`,
NOT the `complicated (buildable)` self-sizing-memory build, and must not be routed as
the latter. Registered as a proposal at intake; see manual_proposals.v1.json.

NOT ANSWERED BY: any run at a single fixed num_slots, however well designed --
including MECH-495's own 2x2, unless that 2x2 is itself swept over num_slots.

claims.claim_title: Should REE's active context representation include INTERNAL variables -- current goal, bodily/interoceptive state, confidence, inferred social situation -- rather than being primarily sensory scene identity? MECH-150 records a deliberate design decision that E1 ContextMemory is queried with z_world ALONE and explicitly NOT the full [z_self, z_world] state, on terrain-weighting grounds. If context is the organism's inference about which latent SITUATION it is in (MECH-493/MECH-494) rather than which SCENE it is looking at, then two states with identical z_world but different goal, bodily state or confidence may be different contexts, and the z_world-only query cannot represent that distinction in principle.
claims.falsifier_summary: The augmented query adds no discrimination, or degrades retrieval by making context over-sensitive to continuous internal fluctuation (unstable slot selection tick to tick) -- MECH-150's existing exclusion stands.
claims.required_event: Task states that genuinely share z_world while differing in z_self (goal or bodily/interoceptive state) and that require different policies -- verified in the substrate rather than assumed.
claims.manipulation: Query ContextMemory on the E1 cue path with z_world alone (the MECH-150 decision, currently hard-wired via world_query_proj in extract_cue_context) versus with the full [z_self, z_world] state (the composition query_proj already accepts on the generate_prior path), holding slot contents and everything downstream fixed.
claims.control: Matched-seed z_world-only arm as the incumbent; plus a slot-selection-entropy non-vacuity control read from the cached _last_cue_slot_weights diagnostic (uniform equals ln(num_slots), about 2.773 for 16 slots), so an undifferentiated bank is detected before the comparison is read.
claims.DV: Whether the augmented query discriminates matched-z_world/differing-z_self states that the z_world-only query provably cannot, AND whether that discrimination translates into behavioural competence on the policy-differentiating task -- with retrieval stability across ticks reported alongside, since over-sensitivity to continuously varying bodily state is the stated failure mode of inclusion.
claims.instrument: e1_deep.py already exposes both query paths (world_query_proj for z_world-only, ContextMemory.query_proj for the full latent) and caches _last_cue_slot_weights for selection entropy; what is missing is a no-op-default config flag that selects the query composition on the cue path, so the ablation can be armed without editing the module.
claims.consumer_locus: The E1 cue-indexed retrieval seam (SD-016), and through it the two downstream signals action_bias (E1 to E2 affordance modulation) and terrain_weight (E1 to E3 precision modulation).
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: ContextMemory must produce differentiated slot selection before any query-composition comparison is meaningful. This is NOT yet true in code: e1_deep.py's own comment records that cue_context is constant under uniform attention, MECH-153 records cosine_sim ~1.0 without a supervised context objective, and the write-path addressing fix is implemented_pending_validation with no scored run.
claims.blocking_reason: ContextMemory is still undifferentiated at the point of query (uniform-attention saddle, cosine similarity about 1.0), so two query compositions over that bank are indistinguishable by construction; the write-path addressing fix that would change this is implemented_pending_ validation. There is also no flag to switch the cue-path query composition.
false_positives: The WWA's 'cheap, go FIRST' framing understates one dependency: the cue path runs only under sd016_enabled, which defaults False, and no flag selects the query composition -- a one-line no-op-default SD-016 amend is needed before the comparison can be armed.
claims.auditor_notes: The missing edge is concrete and small: an SD-016 amend adding a no-op-default flag (e.g. sd016_cue_query_include_z_self) that routes extract_cue_context through ContextMemory.query_proj instead of world_query_proj. Registering it under the existing SD-016 node is preferable to a new node.
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ContextMemory must be producing differentiated
representations at all before a query-composition comparison is meaningful --
MECH-153 records cosine_sim ~= 1.0 without a supervised context objective, and two
query compositions over an undifferentiated bank are indistinguishable by
construction. Also requires states that genuinely share z_world while differing in
z_self, which must be verified in the substrate rather than assumed.

ANSWERED BY: a substrate comparison of ContextMemory queried with z_world alone
versus [z_self, z_world], on a task family containing states with matched z_world but
differing internal state (goal or bodily state) that require different policies.
Resolves toward INCLUSION if the augmented query discriminates those states and the
z_world-only query provably cannot, with the discrimination translating into
behavioural competence; resolves toward MECH-150's EXISTING DECISION if the augmented
query adds no discrimination, or degrades retrieval by making context over-sensitive
to internal fluctuation (the plausible cost: bodily state varies continuously, so
including it risks the context variable never being stable enough to exploit --
which is MECH-493's permanently-epistemic pathology arriving by a different route).

This is cheap and should go FIRST among the 2026-08-19 intake's follow-ons: it needs
no new environment family, only matched-z_world/differing-z_self states against the
existing bank, and MECH-150's own rationale for the exclusion is on record so the
comparison is well-posed.

claims.claim_title: Does explicit hippocampal episodic organisation (binding, segmentation, separation, completion, indexing, remapping treated as ONE coordinated organising principle) add predictive or behavioural capability beyond REE's existing trajectory-generation account and the individually-registered mechanisms that already cover its parts (MECH-147, MECH-154, MECH-242, MECH-288, MECH-074d) -- or is it a REINTERPRETATION of mechanisms REE already has? claims.falsifier_summary: With every individual mechanism armed, the existing architecture already produces the appropriate overlap/separation pattern and downstream competence -- the thought is a re-description and should stay as explanatory framing without further mechanism registration.

claims.manipulation: The MECH-495 2x2: coordinated episodic-organisation principle on/off crossed against the sum of the individually-registered mechanisms (MECH-147, MECH-154, MECH-242, MECH-288, MECH-074d) armed or not.
claims.control: The sum-of-parts arm with every individual mechanism armed is the load-bearing control -- it is what distinguishes "adds capability" from "re-description"; plus an all-off baseline to show the parts do anything at all.
claims.DV: Downstream generalisation and episodic discrimination competence -- not any internal representational statistic such as pattern overlap or separation index, which the claim's own what_would_answer explicitly rules out as the scoring currency.
claims.instrument: MECH-288's event-segment detector is built (ree_core/hippocampal/event_segmenter.py, with a structural MECH-094 stream gate); the remaining arms have no instrument because MECH-147 and MECH-242 are unbuilt, and no driver currently scores relational-appropriateness downstream competence.
claims.consumer_locus: The hippocampal episodic-organisation layer treated as ONE coordinated principle, tested at the downstream behavioural boundary rather than at the representational-statistic boundary.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The individually-registered mechanisms must be ARMED before "the existing architecture already suffices" can be tested. Re-verified against the registry: MECH-147 and MECH-242 are still phase v4 and unbuilt, MECH-074d is still candidate after its 2026-08-16 demotion, MECH-288 is provisional, and the ContextMemory write-path repair is implemented_pending_validation with no scored run -- so a null now would measure readiness, not this question.
claims.blocking_reason: The sum-of-parts control arm cannot be constructed: MECH-147 and MECH-242 are phase v4 and unbuilt, so the comparator that distinguishes "adds capability" from "re-description" is missing, and the ContextMemory readiness this rides on is still unvalidated.
claims.auditor_notes: Q-095 is correctly deprioritised by its own text ("should NOT be the first thing tested from this intake"). claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the existing mechanisms must be ARMED and functioning
before "the existing architecture already suffices" can be tested. As of 2026-08-20
this is NOT the case -- MECH-288 is built, but MECH-147 is phase v4 and unbuilt,
MECH-074d was demoted 2026-08-16, and the ContextMemory write path was only repaired
on 2026-08-19 (ree-v3 76cbf844) with no validation run yet scored. A null result

ANSWERED BY: comparing REE with and without an explicit coordinated organising
principle on the 2x2 design in MECH-495's what_would_answer, scored on downstream
generalisation and discrimination rather than on any internal representational
statistic. Resolves toward ADDS CAPABILITY if the coordinated version achieves
relational topology and downstream competence the sum of the individually-registered

This question is deliberately gated behind MECH-495 and behind substrate readiness;

claims.claim_title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.
claims.falsifier_summary: Every rung co-varying: across mechanisms, no case is found in which a mechanism passes rung N and fails rung N+1, so the stages are not separately demonstrable and a flat implemented/not-implemented label loses no information. Equivalently, if each apparent dissociation resolves into an upstream rung that was never really cleared.
claims.required_event: A V3 mechanism that is constructed, enabled, endogenously recruited, locally operating and holds competitive authority at its own selection boundary, in a run that then independently measures committed behaviour, ecological effect and retention.
claims.manipulation: Force the mechanism's competitive authority upward while holding the downstream selector fixed -- the V3-EXQ-931 in-run positive control raised the wanting weight from 0.5 to 5000 -- so authority varies and throughput is read as a separate quantity.
claims.control: The ablation arm on the identical observation and candidate pool, matched seeds, plus the mechanism's own OFF arm as the existence-rung negative; V3-EXQ-932 is the paired PASS that makes 931's null interpretable.
claims.DV: Per-rung pass/fail on one mechanism in one run -- e.g. wanting_authority_ratio and selection_flip_rate for competitive authority against mean_resource_proximity for committed throughput. ARC-130 predicts these dissociate: 931 reached 80.3 pct elite argmin flips at forced authority while mean_resource_proximity stayed bit-identical to ablation (0.6229773644254133).
claims.instrument: ree-v3/experiments/_lib/capability_contract.py reports interpretation_route ordered by the ladder (ROUTE_PRECEDENCE, line 237) across existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation and competitive authority / committed throughput, with test_capability_contract.py line 225 asserting the non-zero-influence clause. It has NO route for ecological consequence or retention/generalisation, and the per-stage MechanismReachTrace is recorded in claims.yaml as an UNBUILT, explicitly unauthorised instrumentation proposal.
claims.consumer_locus: The recording boundary for mechanism status -- the failure-autopsy and diagnostic report, GOV-FAILLOC-1's territory. This is an audit projection over a recurrent, distributed, multi-rate organism, not a claim about computational topology.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For the ladder to discriminate, at least two ADJACENT rungs must be separately measurable on the SAME mechanism in the SAME run, with the upstream rung demonstrably CLEARED -- otherwise a downstream null is an upstream-failure artifact rather than a stage dissociation. claims.blocking_reason: Rungs 7 and 8 have no recorder. capability_contract.py's route set stops at committed throughput, and the per-stage reach-trace instrument is deliberately unauthorised -- claims.yaml notes say do not build it without a separate decision, and GFLAG-0134 resolved with user decision (b): close on existing convergent evidence, NO instrumentation authorised.
false_positives: EXP-1344's first gating reason, 'NO MEASUREMENT SURFACE FOR THE LADDER', is only partly true: experiments/_lib/capability_contract.py already provides a ladder-ordered measurement surface for rungs 1 through 6 and a contract test asserting the ARC-130 competitive-authority clause. claims.claim_title: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

claims.claim_title: Argmax collapse at the incentive-to-goal interface: the per-object drive-conditioned value structure wanting[k] is computed over ALL stored objects and then reduced by most_wanted()'s ARGMAX to a single winner before it reaches selection, so z_goal is seeded from one object embedding and every candidate trajectory is scored against that one target. The comparative structure that would let candidates differ from one another for a value-relevant reason is destroyed upstream of the selector, not absent from it -- predicting that a downstream readout is FLAT in upstream wanting range except at rank flips, and becomes sloped when the argmax is replaced by a norm-matched graded read.
claims.falsifier_summary: ARM_GRADED is not separable from ARM_ARGMAX at matched seed norm with the preconditions passing, or ARM_GRADED matches ARM_SHUFFLE, or ARM_ARGMAX already tracks wanting range continuously.
claims.required_event: Scored ticks on which the bank holds >= 3 distinct tokens each with a stored z_object and the per-object wanting vector has non-trivial range.
claims.manipulation: Replace the ARGMAX seed (agent.py: seed_latent = bank.most_wanted()[1]) with a norm-matched softmax mixture over z_object weighted by wanting, with a wanting-permuted mixture as the negative control, and dose-sweep incentive_drive_kappa_scale.
claims.control: ARM_ARGMAX (the current code) and ARM_SHUFFLE (same mixture, wanting permuted across k) at matched seed norm and identical arity.
claims.DV: Cross-candidate range of the E3 goal-score term as a function of wanting_rel_range, with argmax_flip_rate as the competing regressor.
claims.instrument: Partially missing at the required aggregation. E3TrajectorySelector.compute_goal_score exists and the e3_score_decomp path records the goal term, but only as its MEAN over candidates (_dc_goal_w = mean); cross-candidate RANGE diagnostics exist for other channels (loop_*_pref_range, noisy_selection_bias_range, model_disagreement_bonus_range) and not for the goal channel.
claims.consumer_locus: The incentive-to-goal interface: per-object wanting -> most_wanted argmax -> z_goal seed -> per-candidate goal score inside E3 selection.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: P1-P4 as written in the claim still bind and still match code: use_incentive_token_bank is default False (goal.py builds IncentiveTokenBank only under that flag), so a default-config run is vacuous; the wanting vector must carry real range; the stored z_object embeddings must be separable; and the E3 consumer must be able to move, with f_variance_share reported because F-dominance forbids reading a behavioural DV.
claims.blocking_reason: The DV has no recorder at the stated locus -- the score decomposition keeps the MEAN of the goal term, which destroys exactly the cross-candidate range the claim is about -- and the graded arm has no lever, since the argmax seeding is hardcoded in agent.py with no mixture flag. SD-080 (untrained action-object head) is the registered upstream blocker on seed separability.
claims.auditor_notes: The range-diagnostic pattern already exists for three other E3 channels, so the missing edge is a one-line-per-channel recorder rather than new machinery; V3-EXQ-514u is the partial prior evidence the claim cites and it is at the interface, not behavioural.
claims.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (P1) LIVE SITE -- use_incentive_token_bank=True (DEFAULT-OFF, so a default-config run is vacuous for reasons unrelated to this claim); require bank_populated_frac == 1.0 and >= 3 distinct tokens each with a stored z_object. (P2) UPSTREAM RANGE IS REAL -- wanting_rel_range = (max_k w[k] - min_k w[k]) / (mean_k |w[k]| + 1e-9), median over scored ticks >= 0.10; if the wanting vector is near-flat there is no range to destroy. (P3) SEEDS ARE SEPARABLE -- z_object_min_pairwise_cos_dist >= 0.05, else argmax and mixture emit the same seed and the contrast is arithmetically empty. (P4) CONSUMER CAN MOVE -- e3_goal_score_cross_candidate_range > 1e-6 on >= 90% of scored ticks, and report f_variance_share (V3-EXQ-571 basis); > 0.95 forbids scoring any behavioural readout. claims.claim_title: One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. Measured in V3-EXQ-817a: ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone fell from ~0.995 to ~0.721, moving roughly 28 percent of O's variance out of action-coding, while the consequence-ordering metric M6 remained weak and sign-unstable (mean ~+0.12, negative on 2 of 5 seeds). O stopped being a clean action code without becoming a reliable consequence code.
claims.falsifier_summary: With P1-P4 met, ARM_1's search budget and proposal diversity are statistically indistinguishable from ARM_0's (entropy delta within +/- 0.05 nats and below 0.5 SD, no drop in above-floor ao_std_mean) -- the two masters do not contend and 817a's null bites against SD-004 and ARC-133.
claims.required_event: Hippocampal CEM proposal rounds under a training objective that reallocates O's variance -- i.e. the 817a consequence-grounding regression applied to E2.action_object_head.
claims.manipulation: ARM_0 frozen O versus ARM_1 world-effect-grounded O versus ARM_2 shuffled-target content control, exactly the three arms v3_exq_817a_sd080_worldeffect_grounding_falsifier.py already implements, re-run while CAPTURING the propose-side diagnostics 817a computed and discarded.
claims.control: ARM_2 (shuffled target, M5 staying >= 0.99) for content, ARM_0 as the paired within-seed baseline, and the support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.0 arm as the precondition-clearing control.
claims.DV: Paired within-seed DROP from ARM_0 to ARM_1 in BOTH (a) the search budget -- mean above-floor cem_iteration_diagnostics ao_std_mean -- AND (b) proposal diversity -- pre_refit_first_action_entropy and pre_refit_unique_first_action_classes at the same iterations -- with the (b) drop >= 0.10 nats and >= 1.0 SD of the paired per-seed delta on >= 4/5 seeds.
claims.instrument: BUILT and verified 2026-09-22 in ree_core/hippocampal/module.py: cem_iteration_diagnostics carries ao_std_mean/ao_std_max per iteration and pre_refit_first_action_entropy / pre_refit_unique_first_action_classes per iteration, action_object_roundtrip_recovery is in the propose return, and support_preserving_ao_std_floor is settable through from_dims.
claims.consumer_locus: O itself as a shared fixed variance budget at the compression/search-coordinate boundary inside the hippocampal CEM (ao_mean + ao_std*noise decoded to actions), not the behavioural outcome.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: All four gates of the existing WWA, unchanged and all verified present in code: (P1) the search budget must not be floor-set -- HippocampalConfig ships use_support_preserving_cem True with support_preserving_ao_std_floor 0.2, so either ao_std_max must exceed 1.10x the floor on >= 50% of scored iterations or a matched floor=0.0 control arm must carry the read; (P2) ARM_0 must have diversity to lose; (P3) the float32 guard; (P4) the grounding manipulation must reproduce 817a's 0.721/0.271/0.995.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks it. Every instrument the WWA names exists in the live hippocampal module, the floor=0.0 control arm is settable through from_dims, and the three-arm grounding driver is already written -- only the queueing decision (EXP-0589) is outstanding.
false_positives: substrate_queue SD-080 (pending_implementation, ready false) lists MECH-518 in unblocks_claims, which reads as a substrate block; MECH-518's manipulation is the DRIVER-side grounding regression 817a already implements and does not require SD-080's training wire -- the claim's own notes say it is testable today.
claims.auditor_notes: The routing decision (whether to queue, and against which lineage given the live re-derive brake on the 689/485/445/625 families) is deliberately left to governance by the claim's own notes; this audit only confirms runnability. Run this before MECH-517, which depends on its P1 to define a non-collapsing interface.
claims.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four, in BOTH arms, or the read is vacuous): (P1) THE SEARCH BUDGET MUST NOT BE FLOOR-SET. HippocampalConfig defaults are use_support_preserving_cem=True with support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.2, and the elite refit is clamped to that floor. Measured live on default config: CEM iteration 0 ao_std_mean 1.000 (constant init, not O); iteration 1 mean 0.206 (partly clamped); iteration 2 mean 0.2000003, min 0.200, max 0.200 (FULLY clamped) -- against ARM_0's own O carrying mean_per_dim_action_std 0.0296, an order of magnitude BELOW the floor. At defaults the CEM's search WIDTH is set by a constant rather than by O's variance, so the channel this claim is about cannot express itself. REQUIRE ao_std_max > 1.10 * floor on >= 50% of scored iterations in both arms, OR run a matched support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.0 control arm and read the test there. (The floor value and the clamp measurement are sourced; the 1.10x / 50% trigger is a judgement call.) (P2) ARM_0 MUST HAVE DIVERSITY TO LOSE -- action_object_roundtrip_recovery.true_unique_classes >= 2 and pre_refit_first_action_entropy > 0.10 nats on >= 4/5 seeds. A candidate set already collapsed to one first-action class has no diversity for grounding to degrade, and a drop measured from zero is not a drop. (P3) FLOAT32 GUARD (V3-EXQ-643) -- mean pairwise L2 between the K candidates' get_action_object_sequence()[:,0,:] in ARM_0 > 1e-3. At ARM_0's magnitudes a difference-of-means in float32 is only ~4 decades above eps, and the V3-EXQ-604a rule ("scaling a zero range is still zero", quoted verbatim in module.py) applies to a floored ao_std the same way. (P4) THE GROUNDING MANIPULATION MUST REPRODUCE -- ARM_1 median ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone <= 0.90, median paired (ARM_0 - ARM_1) M5 >= 0.10, ARM_2 (shuffled target) staying >= 0.99. All three sourced from V3-EXQ-817a's own measured 0.721 / 0.271 / ~0.995. CONFIRMING: with P1-P4 met, ARM_1 (grounded) shows a paired within-seed DROP versus ARM_0 (frozen) in BOTH (a) the search budget -- mean over CEM iterations of cem_iteration_diagnostics[i].ao_std_mean, restricted to iterations above the floor -- AND (b) proposal diversity -- pre_refit_first_action_entropy and pre_refit_unique_first_action_classes at the same iterations -- with the paired drop in (b) >= 0.10 nats AND >= 1.0 SD of the paired per-seed delta, on >= 4/5 seeds. Direction and per-seed consistency are what matter, not absolute level. A confirming read means V3-EXQ-817a's behavioural null is a MEASUREMENT ARTEFACT of the shared budget rather than evidence against consequence-grounding, and the remedy is to split the roles (ground a consequence READOUT of O while leaving the CEM's search coordinates action-conditioned). FALSIFYING: with P1-P4 met, ARM_1's search budget and proposal diversity are statistically indistinguishable from ARM_0's -- paired per-seed delta in pre_refit_first_action_entropy within +/- 0.05 nats and below 0.5 SD of the paired delta on >= 4/5 seeds, with no drop in above-floor ao_std_mean. Then O's variance reallocation does not propagate into the search geometry, the two masters do not contend, and 817a's null bites directly against SD-004's efficiency rationale and against ARC-133. RESIDUAL that any FALSIFYING write-up must state: ao_std is floored but ao_mean is NOT, so a null on the variance channel accompanied by movement in ao_mean's candidate geometry falsifies the "shared fixed budget = O's VARIANCE" formulation specifically, not the weaker claim that O's geometry is shared.

claims.claim_title: REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.
claims.falsifier_summary: A loss whose backward reaches action_object_head or the depth encoders is found on the named ref, or a comparable training signal is supplied at site (a) or (b) and the ceiling does NOT move -- the latter making that ceiling a genuine capacity finding.
claims.required_event: No behavioural event is required for the inspection half. The corollary half requires a training run at one named site with a witnessed non-zero parameter delta, followed by re-measurement of the ceiling result originally taken there.
claims.manipulation: Supply a training signal at site (a) E2.action_object_head (SD-056 contrastive or a consequence-grounding loss) or at site (b) the ARC-004 beta/theta/delta cascade, and compare the ceiling statistic before and after against the untrained baseline.
claims.control: The untrained-site arm at matched seeds and matched budget is the control, exactly as SD-070 / V3-EXQ-783 did for z_world (trained PR 5.261 versus untrained 9.121, retained fraction 0.577 against a 0.50 floor).
claims.DV: For the inspection half, the presence or absence of a gradient path: an optimiser group or a backward-reaching loss at the named site. For the corollary, the movement of the site's own ceiling statistic once the signal is supplied.
claims.instrument: Source inspection, and it reproduces today on current code: action_object_head appears exactly twice in ree_core (construction at predictors/e2_fast.py:144 and the forward call at :602), beta_encoder / theta_encoder / delta_encoder appear zero times in agent.py, the depth cascade is three parallel EMAs sharing the hardcoded alpha_shared = 0.3 at latent/stack.py:1540-1596, and compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() at agent.py:11377.
claims.consumer_locus: The training graph itself -- which parameters any loss can reach -- not any behavioural boundary.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: For the inspection half there is none beyond naming the ref, which is the claim's point. For the methodological corollary, a training signal must actually reach the site and be witnessed by a weight delta -- otherwise the re-measurement repeats the original null and says nothing about capacity.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks the inspection half; it was re-verified in source for this audit and holds unchanged. The corollary half is blocked at site (a) by SD-080 being pending_implementation with ready false, and at site (b) by no substrate node existing at all for the ARC-004 depth cascade.
claims.auditor_notes: Two precision points for the coordinator. (1) The FALSIFYING clause as written -- an optimiser group holding the depth encoders -- is literally met OUTSIDE ree_core: experiments/_lib/goal_pipeline_tier1.py:536 and _lib/baselines/affective_fishtank.py:318 both build an Adam over agent.latent_stack.parameters(), which includes them; no loss reaches them so the operative claim survives, but the clause should be narrowed to a loss whose backward reaches the site. (2) Site (b) has no owner in substrate_queue at all, unlike site (a) which SD-080 owns and names MECH-523 in unblocks_claims.
claims.what_would_answer: This claim is VERIFIABLE BY INSPECTION rather than by experiment, and that is the point -- it is a statement about the substrate's training graph, not about behaviour. CONFIRMING (all three, each a direct source check on a named ref): (a) `grep action_object_head` across `ree_core/` returns only construction and the forward call, with no loss, optimiser or backward reference; corroborated behaviourally by V3-EXQ-809 (re-drawn heads reach the CEM proposals but behaviour is invariant to their content) and by the spike measurement that the head's parameters are bit-identical after 40 warmup episodes. (b) `grep -c beta_encoder|theta_encoder|delta_encoder` in `agent.py` returns 0 for each, and no optimiser anywhere in `ree_core/` holds their parameters. (c) every value-shaped loss either detaches its latent input or terminates in a head, so no gradient path exists from a value target to any encoder. FALSIFYING (any one): a training signal is found that reaches one of the three sites on the named ref -- e.g. an optimiser group holding `action_object_head` or the depth encoders, or a non-detached value loss reaching `world_encoder`. Since this is an inspection claim, a falsification is a code citation, not a run. THE METHODOLOGICAL COROLLARY, which is the part that needs testing rather than inspecting: for each site, a representational-ceiling result measured there should MOVE once a training signal is supplied. SD-070 is the one worked instance and it went the claim's way -- z_world was measured collapsing to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128, an anti-collapse training recipe was built, and V3-EXQ-783 then measured trained PR 5.261 vs untrained 9.121 (retained_fraction 0.577 against a 0.50 floor). If a comparable training signal is supplied at site (a) or (b) and the ceiling does NOT move, the corollary is refuted for that site and the ceiling is a genuine capacity finding after all.

claims.claim_title: 'Long life' in an artificial organism is not one property but at least four separable continuities -- cognitive/affective/mnemonic state continuity, parameter/plasticity continuity, body/homeostatic continuity, and ecological/world continuity -- which can be held or broken independently of one another. A persistent-organism experiment must therefore declare which of the four it preserves, because duration under a broken continuity is not developmental opportunity: an organism whose cognitive state persists while its body and world regenerate at every boundary is not aging in a world, and an organism observed for many ticks with its parameters frozen is not developing. The decomposition separates four confounds that a scalar 'lifespan' or 'ticks survived' cannot: age from layout luck, learning from reset effects, injury/recovery from death, and memory accumulation from environmental regeneration.
claims.falsifier_summary: Developmental delta is invariant to which continuities were held once tick count is matched, in which case the four-way decomposition buys vocabulary but no interpretive difference and a scalar lifespan readout loses nothing.
claims.required_event: A multi-segment life in which segment boundaries recur many times (V3-EXQ-913 runs 24 segments per seed), so that each continuity has repeated opportunities to be held or broken.
claims.manipulation: Factorially set the four continuities at matched tick count: world/layout continuity via env.reset_to() (913's _continuity_reset) versus env.reset() re-randomisation (906b/906c/911/912); parameter continuity via the sleep/offline-update arms and frozen-parameter eval; body/homeostatic continuity by carrying agent_health across the boundary (reset_to unconditionally restores it to 1.0 at causal_grid_world.py, so the driver must re-write it); cognitive/mnemonic continuity held by construction in this family.
claims.control: The 906b/906c arm (world and body continuity broken at every boundary, cognitive state held) as the reference cell, with tick count, segment count and resource budget matched across cells.
claims.DV: Within-life development measured as the early-vs-late segment change in harm rate, benefit rate and mode entropy (913's within_life_development block), compared ACROSS continuity configurations at identical tick counts; the claim requires the same tick count to yield different developmental deltas depending on which continuity was held.
claims.instrument: V3-EXQ-913 already records within_life_development, a layout_continuity_confirmed precondition and per-segment done_cause; experiments/_lib/capability_contract.py's nine-mode PLASTICITY_MODES tuple plus PlasticityRequirement.load_bearing record what a run ALLOWED versus DEPENDED on changing. No recorder exists for body/homeostatic continuity because no driver carries agent_health across a boundary.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Within-life change must be measurable at all in the chosen driver: the 906/913 family must show a non-zero early-vs-late competence delta under at least one continuity configuration, otherwise no configuration can differ from any other and the four-way decomposition cannot discriminate. The four continuities must be set independently rather than co-varied by a single boundary policy.
claims.blocking_reason: No experiment sets the four continuities factorially; 913 varies world continuity and sleep only, against 906b/906c as a historical rather than matched control. Body continuity has no driver that carries agent_health, and 913's own within-life deltas were flat-to-negative, so the discriminating regime is not yet demonstrated.
