claims.claim_title: MECH-524's interruption_snapshot captures z_world at the moment of interruption. By the time a spare-compute or sleep-entry trigger re-seeds it into MECH-293/MECH-285, real time has passed during which the actual world may have changed (REE's forward direction: MECH-269 V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive). How should resumption reconcile the snapshot's SAVED V_s against V_s as CURRENTLY computed? Candidates: (a) current-only -- discard the saved V_s and let MECH-269 recompute cold, keeping only the snapshot's non-V_s content (CEM stage, rule-arbitration weights, what-was-attempted); (b) max(current, saved*decay) -- treat the saved V_s as a decaying floor rather than a fresh read, structurally transplanting MECH-284's spatial region-staleness decay logic onto this temporal/episodic case; (c) abort-on-divergence guard -- compare saved vs current V_s and refuse the snapshot-primed resumption path (fall back toward restart-from-scratch) if divergence exceeds a threshold, functioning as a targeted application of MECH-287's existing anchors-inactive broadcast rather than a new invalidation mechanism; (d) context-dependent -- the correct rule depends on interruption duration, interruption cause (hazard vs. voluntary capacity reallocation), or domain volatility, and no single rule suffices.
claims.falsifier_summary: No single rule wins uniformly: the best rule flips with interruption duration, cause or domain volatility, confirming (d) and refusing a single transplanted decay or threshold.
claims.required_event: A task interrupted mid-execution, a gap of controlled duration during which the relevant world region is (or is not) materially changed, then a spare-compute or sleep-entry trigger that reseeds the snapshot.
claims.manipulation: The reconciliation rule applied at reseed: (a) current-only recompute, (b) max(current, saved*decay) floor, (c) abort-on-divergence guard, (d) a context-dependent switch on interruption duration and cause -- crossed with world-changed versus world-unchanged during the gap.
claims.control: A world-unchanged gap at each interruption duration (the overhead-only comparator), plus a no-snapshot restart-from-scratch arm that bounds the value of reusing the snapshot at all.
claims.DV: Resumption efficiency (steps or compute to regain pre-interruption performance) when the world did not change, and resumption safety (harm contacts and acted-on-stale-belief rate) when it did, both read per reconciliation rule.
claims.instrument: Partially present for the forward direction only: ree_core/hippocampal/staleness_accumulator.py and anchor_set.py record region staleness and anchor inactivity while awake. Nothing records a SAVED V_s, and nothing compares saved against currently-computed V_s, so the divergence quantity the abort guard needs is unrecorded.
claims.consumer_locus: The reseed boundary where a saved snapshot re-enters MECH-293/MECH-285 valuation -- an episodic/temporal gap, not the continuous spatial staleness boundary MECH-284 already governs.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A resumption path must exist that can carry a saved V_s forward and act on it, and the world must be manipulable during the interruption gap at controlled magnitude, so the four rules can diverge. Verified failing: grep of ree-v3 returns zero hits for interruption_snapshot and MECH-524 is candidate, implementation_phase v3, v3_pending, unbuilt.
claims.blocking_reason: V3 has no interruption-snapshot store and no resumption path, so the required event cannot be generated; and no recorder exposes saved-versus-current V_s divergence. MECH-524 owns the store but has no substrate-queue entry commissioning it.
claims.auditor_notes: The forward machinery (staleness accumulation, anchor inactivity) is genuinely live, so the temptation to declare the backward case already covered is real; it is not -- nothing saves or re-reads a paused V_s. MECH-524 is absent from substrate_queue.json despite being phase v3 and v3_pending.
claims.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated empirically, by contrasting the four candidate reconciliation rules on a resumption
task where the world is manipulated to change (or not) during the interruption interval, at
controlled magnitude and rate. NOT pre-committed here -- registered as open per the chip brief
that surfaced it. Discriminating measurements: (i) resumption efficiency when the world has NOT
materially changed during the interval (candidates should differ mainly in overhead: (a) pays a
full V_s-recompute cost even when unneeded, (b)/(c) should approach (a)'s eventual accuracy at
lower cost); (ii) resumption SAFETY/appropriateness when the world HAS changed materially during
the interval (a) should be safest since it never acts on stale belief but forfeits the snapshot's
speed benefit for its V_s component specifically -- note this is a V_s-COLD-restart, not a full
restart, since the snapshot's CEM-stage/rule-arbitration/what-was-attempted content can still be
reused; (b) risks confidently acting on a stale-but-not-yet-decayed V_s floor, reproducing exactly
the failure MECH-287's broadcast exists to prevent, unless the decay term is calibrated against
real-world change rates; (c) risks two failure directions depending on threshold calibration -- a
threshold too loose reproduces (b)'s stale-confidence risk, a threshold too tight reproduces (a)'s
forfeited-benefit cost AND risks a dissociative-shaped "never trusts its own snapshot" pattern if
ordinary V_s measurement noise routinely exceeds it; (d) is the default null hypothesis until one
of (a)/(b)/(c) demonstrates uniform superiority across interruption-duration and volatility
conditions, at which point (d) is falsified in favour of that single rule.

claims.claim_title: Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.
claims.falsifier_summary: Arm 3 fails to beat arm 2, or the near-tie negative control fails (the trigger is uncertainty after all), or perturbation never decays after resolution, or variation rises without the policy relocating (the Neuringer 2001 variability-without-escape pattern).
claims.required_event: Ecologically arising, persistent confidence-without-resolution -- a stable, confident policy that repeatedly fails to reduce the active need/goal error -- followed by resolution.
claims.manipulation: Stuckness-triggered perturbation injected ABOVE the immediate-action level (candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, dominant-attractor precision), with escalating breadth under continued stuckness.
claims.control: Three arms: no perturbation; low-level action noise of the MECH-313/MECH-440 class; stuckness-triggered above-action perturbation. Plus a matched near-tie negative control in which two well-understood similarly-good options must produce no perturbation above baseline.
claims.DV: Escape probability and discovery latency from the false bottom, basin quality after escape, post-resolution decay of perturbation magnitude, and the per-axis contribution to stuck_score at every firing -- with the arm-3-minus-arm-1 escape-probability delta required to exceed max(2 x SD of the per-seed delta, 0.20).
claims.instrument: Detector and one channel exist: ree_core/cingulate/stuck_state_detector.py computes stuck_score with declared_axes and sd061_n_present counters, and ree_core/policy/difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py is the trajectory-widening channel. The measured axis availability recorded in that module is the problem: committed_action_class arrives 0/100 ticks and choice_difficulty 0/100, while progress saturates at 1.0 and score_margin sits at 0.0, so is_stuck never fires at the default threshold.
claims.consumer_locus: Organism-level variation injection above the action layer -- proposal, retrieval, decomposition and precision -- not the action-sampling temperature that MECH-313/MECH-440 already own.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: A genuine false bottom must be shown to exist by a control unrelated to this claim (a competent-by-other-means arm reaching materially better basin quality while the no-perturbation arm sits stable and confident); the trigger must be carried by the stall and committed-diversity axes rather than the two near-tie axes; firing must arise from ecological blockage with duty cycle strictly inside (0.05, 0.80); and if epistemic_deficit drives the trigger, the persistent-PE channel must be isolated.
claims.blocking_reason: The selectivity precondition is currently unsatisfiable: the committed-diversity axis the claim requires to carry the firing arrives on 0/100 ticks (it needs a beta elevation, blocked by MECH-342's no-natural-commit failure), leaving only the saturated progress axis and the near-tie score-margin axis the claim says must trigger nothing. No above-trajectory perturbation channel exists, so the escalation leg has no second channel.
false_positives: The registered blanket 'the perturbation channel does not exist, do not queue' directive is superseded (GFLAG-0200): the trajectory-widening channel is built and was exercised by V3-EXQ-694.
claims.auditor_notes: The substrate_queue entry sd061-resume-progress-ecology (status candidate, ready false) is the existing owner of the duty-cycle/decay precondition but its unblocks_claims lists only MECH-343 and Q-056 -- MECH-527 should be added there rather than a new node being created. That entry also names MECH-342 as the gate on the diversity axis, which is this claim's selectivity blocker.
claims.what_would_answer:
SCOPE NOTE. This claim's trajectory-proposal-widening leg is MECH-343/SD-061's question, already
built (`ree_core/policy/difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py`) and already partially measured
(V3-EXQ-694). See MECH-343's own `what_would_answer` -- in particular its
SHARED-CONVERSION-PRECONDITION (G4) reference, its "DECLARE WHICH TEMPERATURE the entropy DV
reads" clause (SD-061's CEM proposal-layer knob vs the SD-069/MECH-313 E3 select() softmax --
different knobs; a run that conflates them cannot attribute its result), and its "PRIOR TO
CARRY IN" record that V3-EXQ-694's ON arm entropy FELL on 3/3 seeds. Do not re-derive any of
it. What follows tests only what is left after that: escalation ACROSS channels, and the
trigger's selectivity.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. Apply TRIGGERED-STRUCTURAL-EVENT PRECONDITION (G9) in full, plus
three requirements specific to this claim, all of which must be reported before any verdict:
(a) *A genuine false bottom must be demonstrated to EXIST in the ecology, by a control that has
nothing to do with this claim.* Show that a competent-by-other-means agent (an oracle, a shaped-
reward arm, or a hand-coded policy) attains materially better basin quality than the no-
perturbation arm converges to, and that the no-perturbation arm's policy is STABLE (low
committed-class turnover) and CONFIDENT (high score margin) while it sits there. Without that
control, a null on escape is indistinguishable from "there was nothing to escape to". The
MECH-457 / V3-EXQ-769 D3_hazard_free passive-survival optimum is a documented instance and the
`MetabolicForageWrapper` in `experiments/_lib/mech457_probe_envs.py` is the dissolving control.
(b) *The trigger must be selective, and the near-tie axes must be shown NOT to be carrying it.*
This claim's load-bearing distinction is that unresolvedness triggers and uncertainty does not.
SD-061's `StuckStateDetector` combines four axes, of which two (E3 score margin, dACC choice
difficulty) are near-tie/ambiguity axes that this claim asserts should trigger NOTHING. Report
each axis's separate contribution to `stuck_score` at every firing. CONFIRMING requires that
the stall and committed-diversity axes carry the firing in the false-bottom condition; if the
two near-tie axes carry it, the run has tested MECH-440's trigger, not this one, and must
self-route rather than report a verdict.
(c) *The trigger must fire from naturally-arising blockage, and must also NOT fire.* Detector
peak must exceed threshold and then decay on >= 2/3 seeds from ecological stuckness, not from
an experimenter-induced impasse (V3-EXQ-694 induced its impasse; that route is already spent).
Report the duty cycle: with `ema_alpha_rise` 0.3 vs `ema_alpha_fall` 0.05, a pinned-high score
is the expected failure and turns every arm contrast into a dose contrast. Duty cycle must lie
strictly inside (0.05, 0.80).
(d) *If MECH-482's `epistemic_deficit` is used as the trigger, the persistent-PE channel must
be isolated.* Per the 2026-09-01 synthesis, the uncertainty and disagreement inputs are
suppressed exactly in the confident-but-failing case, so an unmodified `epistemic_deficit` that
fails to rise is a substrate artifact, not evidence against the claim. Either consume the
persistent-PE channel only, or use the SD-061 stall + committed-diversity axes, and say which.

CONFIRMING (the claim's own registered design, preserved). A >= 3-arm run in a demonstrated
false-bottom ecology -- (1) no perturbation; (2) low-level ACTION noise (MECH-313/MECH-440
class); (3) stuckness-triggered perturbation ABOVE the action level -- on organism-level DVs:
arm 3 strictly beats BOTH arm 1 and arm 2 on escape probability and discovery latency, with
basin quality after escape strictly better than the false bottom's, AND perturbation magnitude
decays after resolution, AND the no-unnecessary-exploration negative control holds (a matched
near-tie condition with two well-understood, similarly-good options produces NO perturbation
above arm 1's baseline). Effect-size gate: the arm-3-minus-arm-1 escape-probability delta must
exceed max(2 x SD of the per-seed delta, an absolute floor of 0.20 escape probability), on
>= 2/3 seeds.
ESCALATION LEG (separately gated, and currently the claim's weakest commitment). Under CONTINUED
stuckness the perturbation must broaden across channels, not merely intensify within one: at
least one channel beyond candidate trajectories must be shown to engage, later than channel 1,
and only after channel 1 has failed to resolve. Recorded as a KNOWN GAP rather than an
asserted property: the 2026-09-01 synthesis found no biological support for graded escalation
(Karlsson 2012 gives the destabilise-then-decay, nothing gives the ladder), and the only
precedent is algorithmic. Do not gate the claim's verdict on this leg until it has grounding.

FALSIFYING.
(1) With the preconditions met, arm 3 does not beat arm 2 -- low-level action noise escapes the
false bottom as often and as fast as above-action-level perturbation. This is the claim's own
load-bearing distinction from MECH-440/MECH-313 and its failure is the cleanest refutation.
(2) The no-unnecessary-exploration control fails: arm 3 perturbs in the matched near-tie
condition as much as in the false-bottom condition. The trigger is uncertainty after all, and
the claim collapses into the operationalisation V3-EXQ-959 already weakened.
(3) Perturbation rises under stuckness and never decays after resolution -- falsifies the
annealing/triggered half, leaving a tonic floor (which MECH-313 already owns and V3-EXQ-687
found non-propagating).
(4) Variation rises but the policy does not RELOCATE: the dominant response stays dominant with
rare variants beneath it, and basin quality is unchanged. This is Neuringer, Kornell & Olufs
(2001, PMID 11199517) under extinction, flagged by the 2026-09-01 synthesis as the specific
reason "attractor escape" is over-claimed. It falsifies the ESCAPE framing while leaving a
weaker "variability injection under stuckness" reading standing -- record it as a narrowing,
not a demotion, and rename accordingly.
NOT FALSIFYING. A null on channel 1 (candidate-trajectory widening) alone. V3-EXQ-694 already
established that count-widening does not lift first-action entropy; that is MECH-343's owed
question and its `what_would_answer` routes such a null to the conversion-ceiling line, not to
a weakening.

claims.claim_title: A merge/split operator over the existing EntityObservation boundary must exist and be corrigible by consequence evidence, at FIXED capacity -- no dynamic per-population regulation, no settling competition. This is the minimal P0 substrate floor ARC-134 and MECH-529 both name as currently absent: `ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py` has no merge or split of tokens anywhere, and matching is strict 1:1 greedy over a caller-built List[EntityObservation]. Distinguished from MECH-521/MECH-522: this claim asserts only that a corrigible operator exists and responds to consequence-divergence evidence (MECH-126's overmerge/oversplit taxonomy), not that occupancy is an emergent order parameter of a settling competition, and not that capacity itself is dynamically regulated -- those remain MECH-521/522's richer, explicitly v4/v5-deferred claims.
claims.falsifier_summary: Corrections are statistically indistinguishable from the yoked random control on both DVs (informationless regrain), or the operator cannot be built without introducing per-population dynamics or dynamic capacity, which would collapse this claim into MECH-521's scope and show it has no distinct minimal form.
claims.required_event: A tick at which the current strict 1:1 greedy assignment is wrong -- two observations that should share one token, or one token that should split -- and consequence evidence subsequently diverges from the assignment's prediction.
claims.manipulation: Replace the strict 1:1 greedy match with a merge/split operator driven by consequence-divergence evidence, at fixed capacity.
claims.control: A yoked, rate-matched RANDOM-REGRAIN arm: the same number of merge/split events at the same ticks with targets chosen at random among eligible tokens, mirroring ARC-134's L3 falsifier design.
claims.DV: MECH-126's overmerge_rate and oversplit_rate, with net error reduction required against the yoked random control on both, plus a fixed-capacity manipulation check.
claims.instrument: Absent on both sides. ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py has only _birth, _enforce_capacity, _evict_stale, query and active_tokens -- no merge or split anywhere -- and a repo-wide grep finds zero occurrences of overmerge or oversplit, so neither DV is recorded by anything today.
claims.consumer_locus: The EntityObservation-to-token assignment boundary inside the object-file buffer -- the P0 grain floor that ARC-134 and MECH-529 both name as absent -- not the richer occupancy dynamics MECH-521/522 defer to v4/v5.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The merge/split operator must be built over EntityObservation tokens at FIXED capacity, with no capacity change and no per-population coupling or settling dynamics (which belong to MECH-521/522), and a consequence-divergence signal must be wired so corrections have something to track. A manipulation check must confirm capacity stayed fixed throughout.
claims.blocking_reason: The operator does not exist, so the required merge/split event cannot occur, and the two DVs have no recorder anywhere in the repo. The claim was registered from the GOV-V4CUT-1 cut audit but has no substrate_queue entry, so the build is unrouted.
claims.auditor_notes: Not proposed as a new node because MECH-531 IS the node; what is missing is a substrate_queue entry routing it to a build, and an overmerge/oversplit recorder. The claim's own falsifier names a third outcome (needing a demand-manipulation environment ARC-134's P2 says does not exist) that should self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as falsification.
claims.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the operator must be BUILT (merge + split over EntityObservation tokens, replacing the current strict 1:1 greedy match) and exercised at fixed capacity -- no capacity change, no per-population coupling/settling dynamics (those are MECH-521/522's scope, explicitly excluded here). A consequence-evidence signal must be wired: MECH-126's overmerge/oversplit taxonomy, or an equivalent prediction/consequence-divergence signal, available to drive correction. CONFIRMING: the operator's merge/split decisions track genuine consequence-divergence evidence (MECH-126 DV pair: overmerge_rate, oversplit_rate) with a net error reduction versus a YOKED, RATE-MATCHED RANDOM-REGRAIN control -- same number of merge/split events at the same ticks, targets chosen at random among eligible tokens (mirrors ARC-134's own L3 falsifier design, which exists precisely to distinguish "regrains" from "regrains informatively"). Capacity must remain fixed throughout (a manipulation check that no dynamic regulation crept in). FALSIFYING (any one): the operator's corrections are statistically indistinguishable from the yoked random control on both MECH-126 DVs (informationless regrain); the operator cannot be built/exercised without introducing per-population dynamics or dynamic capacity (collapses into MECH-521's scope, meaning this claim has no distinct minimal form); or building it requires a demand-manipulation environment ARC-134's own P2 precondition says does not yet exist (would mean the operator cannot even be exercised, not merely that it fails -- a substrate-not-ready result, not a falsification). EXPLICITLY NOT ASSERTING (MECH-521/522's scope, deferred v4/v5, unchanged by this claim): occupancy as an emergent order parameter of a coupling-vs-lateral-inhibition settling competition; dynamic/derived capacity; ephaptic coupling-constant specialisation. MECH-521's own notes ("DO NOT build in V3. DO NOT queue an experiment.") continue to apply to that scope exactly as registered.

claims.claim_title: At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.
claims.falsifier_summary: The pairing lands and validates at a site with no measurable change in that site's ceiling-null behaviour or gradient informativeness relative to the untrained baseline -- pairing does not matter, and the untrained-site pathologies have another cause.
claims.required_event: Training episodes at a designated compression site (z_world via E2.world_forward, or O via E2.action_object_head) in which action-conditional divergence and a downstream ceiling-null are both measurable in the same run.
claims.manipulation: z_world site: enable e2_action_contrastive_enabled with SD-070's P0 anti-collapse encoder recipe at the encoder, against the same configuration with the contrastive loss off. O site: wire a trained decompression/readout head onto action_object_head against the frozen random projection.
claims.control: The matched untrained-decompression arm at the same site (contrastive off / head frozen), same seeds and training budget, with the other site untouched so the effect is site-attributable.
claims.DV: cand_world_pairwise_dist (non-degenerate versus the 0.0000 collapse) at the z_world site; at O, ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone recovering toward its pre-817a ~0.995 without M6 sign instability; and, for the claim's actual content, whether a previously-measured ceiling-null at that site becomes reproducibly different under the trained-decompression arm.
claims.instrument: ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py supplies both the SD-056 contrastive objective (world_forward_contrastive_loss, plus the multistep amend) and the cand_world_pairwise_dist diagnostic, with a live training entry point in ree_core/agent.py; ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py is SD-070's landed recipe. There is no trained-decompression head at action_object_head -- o_t is a frozen projection of z_a.
claims.consumer_locus: The compression site's readout boundary -- E2.world_forward's action-conditional prediction, or O as the space SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates -- and the interpretability of a capacity null measured there.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The compression site must actually be collapsed before a decompression pairing can matter: cand_world_pairwise_dist must be at or near the 0.0000 pre-fix collapse in the untrained-decompression baseline, and the O-site arm needs a ceiling-null that is reproducible under the frozen baseline. A site whose candidates already diverge, or a ceiling-null that is not reproducible, cannot discriminate the pairing.
claims.blocking_reason: The z_world half is buildable now (contrastive loss coded behind e2_action_contrastive_enabled=False, diagnostic present, SD-070 landed 2026-07-18) but no experiment pairs it with a ceiling-null rerun. The O half has no trained decompression head and its owner SD-080 is still pending_implementation. The WWA's path (1) also stops at demonstrating the pairing, without testing the interpretability conditional the claim actually asserts.
claims.gap_disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT
false_positives: The claim title reads SD-070 as unbuilt v3 work; ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py landed 2026-07-18 and has since been extended by SD-106 (preservation_weight plus use_world_encoder_skip, 2026-09-11).
claims.auditor_notes: SD-106's preservation head at the same observation->z_world bottleneck post-dates this WWA and is the more current lever for the compression half; a rewrite should name it alongside SD-070. The claim is satisfied by either site, so the z_world path is the cheap one.
claims.what_would_answer: CONFIRMING (either path suffices -- this claim is about the PAIRING pattern, not about which site instantiates it): (1) SD-056 is re-queued and lands with a validated run showing E2.world_forward's contrastive loss preserves action-conditional divergence (cand_world_pairwise_dist non-degenerate, above the 0.0000 collapse measured pre-fix) AND SD-070's anti-collapse encoder recipe is landed/exercised at the z_world site, jointly demonstrating a trained compression+decompression pairing in production; OR (2) an explicit trained decompression/readout stage is built at O (E2.action_object_head) and resolves or measurably improves the SD-080 zero-gradient finding / MECH-518's dual-role variance reallocation (ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone moving back toward its pre-817a ~0.995 without M6's sign instability), and a representational-ceiling null previously measured at O (a V3-EXQ-817a-shaped rerun) becomes reproducibly different under the trained-decompression arm versus the frozen baseline. FALSIFYING: SD-056/SD-070 land and validate with no measurable effect on any downstream ceiling-null's interpretability, AND a trained decompression stage built at O produces no measurable change in O's gradient informativeness or in ceiling-null behaviour relative to the untrained baseline -- i.e. pairing a compression site with a trained decompression stage does not matter, and whatever explains the untrained-site pathologies MECH-523 describes is something else entirely.

claims.claim_title: Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.
claims.falsifier_summary: A single readout moves under two or more operations, or one operation's readout moves when only another was enabled -- showing the four are not separable outcomes and replay-plus-one-readout is a sufficient description after all.
claims.required_event: An offline bout in which exactly one of the four typed transformations (retention repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, behavioural-access repair) is allowed to occur, with upstream content held fixed.
claims.manipulation: Selectively enable one offline operation at a time by restricting its declared write target and provenance class, then read all four distal waking readouts on each arm -- a four-by-four operation-by-readout matrix rather than a single replay-on/off contrast.
claims.control: Replay-matched arms in which transport and sampling are identical across operations, so any readout difference is attributable to the transformation rather than to replay volume; plus a held-fixed-upstream-content arm for the access-repair leg.
claims.DV: Readout specificity: each operation's own readout must move while the other three do not. Retention measured as preserved competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation as changed relational transfer with trace/index continuity; recalibration as improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never narrower uncertainty alone; access repair as restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment and executed behaviour.
claims.instrument: Only the retention leg has a harness (the SD-068 consolidation lesion harness and the EXT-007 ablation that produced V3-EXQ-994), and its one run was non-degenerate. No instrument records the provenance CLASS of consumed content or the declared write target per operation, and ARC-020's permissive list does not even name the access-route quantities the fourth operation would write (GFLAG-0128).
claims.consumer_locus: The offline transformation itself -- write target, provenance class and distal waking readout per operation -- not the replay transport that all four share.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: Each of the four typed offline operations must be separately inducible and its own distal waking readout separately measurable, and the interference/damage dose must be non-degenerate. V3-EXQ-994 shows this is not currently met on the one reachable leg: the WITHOUT arm never sustained a measurable interference dose (retention_score 0.9997, non_degenerate false).
claims.blocking_reason: Three of the four operations cannot be induced separately in V3 -- reorganisation is blocked on sleep GAP-2 and the unresolved SD-016 ContextMemory discrimination, and access repair has no permitted offline write target -- while the one reachable retention leg's only run returned non_degenerate false. No provenance-class or write-target instrument exists at any of the four.

claims.claim_title: Phasic burst refractory duty bound: the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst envelope must be given a REFRACTORY (event firing suppressed for N waking ticks after an event, while the envelope keeps decaying -- carry-mode decay) and an EXTINCTION LEVEL (a decayed envelope snaps to exactly 0.0), so that "the burst is active" is a regulator-side predicate rather than a floor each consumer picks for itself, and so that the realised burst duty cycle is bounded BY CONSTRUCTION -- A = 1 + floor(ln(extinction_level) / ln(1 - decay)); duty <= min(1, A / (refractory_ticks + 1)) -- rather than being a function of the surprise stream. Without this the burst is re-armed by max(decayed, drive) before it can decay on a warmed agent, and the MECH-063 (ii) tonic/phasic dissociation has no separable transient to measure.
claims.falsifier_summary: The realised duty exceeds the closed-form bound on a warmed agent (the refractory counter does not in fact bound duty -- the episode-length dependence the lifetime counter was introduced to remove has returned), or duty is bounded yet |dS_phasic| does not shrink, in which case the burst's contamination of the sustained baseline was not a duty-cycle effect.
claims.required_event: Repeated phasic surprise events on a warmed agent, dense enough that the SD-069 envelope would be re-armed by max(decayed, drive) before decaying, across enough E3 selections for a duty cycle to be estimated per cell.
claims.manipulation: Arm the two SD-104 knobs against their no-op defaults: phasic_burst_refractory_ticks 0 versus 29 and phasic_burst_extinction_level 0.0 versus 0.05 (A = 5, closed-form bound 0.167), with the phasic and tonic axes otherwise as in the 963a design.
claims.control: The knobs-at-default arm is bit-identical to SD-069/SD-075 (verified differentially against origin/main) and reproduces the unbounded-duty regime; SD-105 is enabled identically in all arms so its entropy lift cancels out of the tonic difference.
claims.DV: Worst realised burst duty cycle over PHASIC-ON cells against the closed-form bound A / (refractory_ticks + 1), and, as the consequence the claim is registered for, the MECH-063 (ii) dominance term |dR_phasic| versus |dS_phasic| -- whether the transient stops contaminating the sustained baseline.
claims.instrument: Fully instrumented: ree_core/regulators/phasic_surprise_burst.py computes and asserts burst_duty_cycle_within_bound, contracts A1-A11 (including the A6 positive control and A9 simulation-mode invariance) pin the arithmetic, and V3-EXQ-963b implements the realised-duty gate R7 (ceiling 0.25) plus dv_headroom gates R8/R9 against 963a's own achievable ranges.
claims.consumer_locus: The regulator-side predicate for burst activity, upstream of every consumer that previously picked its own floor -- the duty cycle is bounded by construction rather than as a function of the surprise stream.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The OFF configuration must still reproduce the 963a regime on this substrate -- contract A6 is the positive control and fails if it does not -- so the refractory and extinction knobs are measured against a live re-armed burst rather than an already-quiescent one; and the agent must be WARMED (the 963a condition, duty 0.390-0.884), not the colder 779a regime where the burst already decayed on its own.
claims.blocking_reason: Nothing blocks the run. The substrate landed 2026-09-04, the contracts pin the closed-form bound, and V3-EXQ-963b is written, smoke-tested (refractory suppressed 15-24 re-fires per cell, realised duty 0.125-0.200) and gated. It has simply never been queued -- the live queue holds only V3-EXQ-1067 and no 963b manifest exists.

claims.claim_title: Selection-entropy headroom floor: a TONIC behavioural-variability set-point on the E3 selection softmax temperature -- a one-sided integral controller in log-temperature that raises the effective tonic temperature only as far as needed to hold realised normalized selection entropy at a floor, never lowering it below the uncoalitioned value. Where MECH-313 noise_floor adds a state-INDEPENDENT constant lift, this is the state-dependent form that survives a warmup which has made the policy confident. Without it, the SD-074 warmup drives baseline selection entropy to 0.0195-0.153 (against 0.152-0.610 on a colder agent), pinning the R5 headroom gate at its 0.02 floor and leaving a SHARPENING manipulation ~2% of the readout's range to move into, so any null is uninterpretable.

claims.required_event: A warmed, confident policy whose realised selection entropy has collapsed into the 0.0195-0.153 band measured by V3-EXQ-963a, leaving a sharpening manipulation almost none of the readout's range to move into.
claims.manipulation: Apply a converged, frozen, shared log-temperature multiplier m at or above 1.0 on the tonic side (after MECH-313, before the SD-069 phasic delta) versus the multiplier off, with the tonic-phasic contrast design otherwise unchanged.
claims.control: The multiplier-off arm at identical seeds as the paired reference for the contrast-preservation leg, plus the per-arm saturation report that lets a cell be declared uninformative rather than reported as a compressed measurement.
claims.DV: Two paired quantities: the T0P0 baseline realised normalized selection entropy (must move from below E_SAT_LOW 0.02 into the 0.02-0.98 band) and, load-bearing, the tonic contrast dS_tonic measured under the frozen multiplier versus with it off, as a per-seed paired difference.
claims.instrument: The regulator and its reporting exist (ree_core/regulators/selection_entropy_floor.py: observe, apply_to_temperature, temperature_multiplier, headroom_met, saturated, n_ticks_saturated; agent.py applies it after MECH-313; contracts B1-B10). The freeze/share API does NOT: a read of that module finds no freeze latch and no frozen state, exactly as open GFLAG-0295 measured when V3-EXQ-963c was refused at Step 2.5.
claims.consumer_locus: The tonic E3 selection softmax temperature, upstream of the phasic delta and of e3.select -- the channel MECH-313 also lifts state-independently, and the one whose realised entropy MECH-063 (ii) reads out.

with the commit duty cycle -- MECH-108's sweep is on by default and MECH-104/MECH-250 would move

frozen multiplier is statistically indistinguishable from the same contrast measured with the
multiplier off, on a per-seed paired comparison (paired difference CI containing 0, and
|mean paired difference| below 0.25 x the multiplier-off `|dS_tonic|`). Leg (ii) is exactly what

claims.claim_title: Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.
claims.falsifier_summary: Under the same witnessed preconditions, R_1 for the generic-only arm stays >= 0.75 -- the class survives a compression with no organism-relevant pressure on it -- or the class-1 scaffold arm is indistinguishable from the matched-arbitrary control, which would make the lift a generic auxiliary-head effect rather than preservation.
claims.required_event: A trained observation -> z_world compression (SD-070 P0a warmup with zworld_p0_episodes > 0) over rollouts whose states instantiate the class-1 consequence distinction, followed by frozen-latent adapter training.
claims.manipulation: Five-arm preservation ladder over the P0a objective: A0 raw-field ceiling, A1 untrained z_world projection, A2 generic-only (variance / covariance / reconstruction with all class-1 grounding weights at 0.0), A3 generic plus the class-1 scaffold, A4 generic plus a matched arbitrary auxiliary through the caller-supplied target callable.
claims.control: A1 supplies the R_k zero and A4 the GOV-MATCHAUX-1 matched-arbitrary control at equal head capacity, loss budget, update cadence and example count, with the scaffold head REMOVED at evaluation and majority-class / repeat-previous-action floors reported alongside.
claims.DV: R_1 = (agreement_arm - agreement_A1) / (agreement_A0 - agreement_A1) from the V3-EXQ-1002 oracle adapter at its pinned 2x128 capacity, reported with delta world_obs reconstruction loss and delta E2 one-step prediction MSE for the losses-blind clause.
claims.instrument: The training seam now exists in full -- run_zworld_p0 takes config=ZWorldP0Config and target_fn, and _train_all_on_agent takes zworld_p0_config -- and ZWorldP0Config exposes every objective weight separately. What is defective is the measurement layer V3-EXQ-1017 used: the headroom gate was computed on ws250_pca-minus-untrained cells rather than the objective-choice contrast, and the sense-path own-target probe is applied cold and unrefit, so it cannot support any conclusion in either direction.

claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The seven NDPs in the existing WWA remain the right gate, and NDP-5 (DV resolution) is the one V3-EXQ-1017 broke on: the adapter DV must be shown to MOVE with the P0a objective choice before any preservation verdict is read, since the pre-registered C0 sensitivity witness measured 0.0326 / 0.0078 / 0.0041 against a 0.05 bar on the objective-choice contrast while the headroom gate certified 0.1745 on a different contrast class entirely.

Until the DV is re-gated on the objective-choice contrast and the sense-path probe is refit on the path it is evaluated on, every preservation verdict is vacuous rather than negative.

claims.auditor_notes: Two registry actions fall out of this and neither is an experiment: the two blocked_substrate proposals should be re-adjudicated against the landed seam, and the sense-path own-target probe in the 1017 driver family is broken for every claim that reads it, not only INV-104.
claims.what_would_answer:
SCOPE. This falsifier is written for ONE preservation class at a time, on ONE named compression
step, and is instantiated here for class 1 (consequence / opportunity-and-threat) at the
observation -> z_world encoder step (`ree_core/latent/stack.py` SplitEncoder world path, SD-005),
which is the only compression site in `ree_core` that has a training signal at all (MECH-523).
Class 2 (controllability / intervention-sensitivity) is the second instantiation and is reachable by
setting `e2_action_contrastive_enabled = True` (default False). Classes 3, 4 and 5 are
substrate_conditional and carry no falsifier yet; per-class falsification NARROWS the preservation
list, it does not retire the claim.

THE TWO-TIER MEASUREMENT, because the obvious one-tier version is already known to mislead.
T1 (PRESENCE): a held-out probe -- centred logistic regression for a categorical class, ridge for a
continuous one -- on the frozen compressed representation. T2 (RECOVERABILITY-IN-USE, which is what
the claim actually asserts): a capacity-matched supervised adapter (V3-EXQ-1002's own 2x128 MLP)
behaviour-cloning an oracle that must use the class, trained from the FROZEN representation, and
scored as a retained fraction
`R_k = (acc_compressed - acc_untrained_projection) / (acc_raw_input - acc_untrained_projection)`.
T1 alone is NOT the test: V3-EXQ-978 measured the class-1 field linearly decodable at r2 0.710
sense-path / 0.858 encoder-path while V3-EXQ-948 measured a downstream reader on that same latent at
0.5 res/ep against a 1.0 competence floor (raw obs 9.033). "Present" and "recoverable through its
dynamics" came apart on this exact class, which is why INV-104's own wording says "preserve, OR leave
recoverable through its dynamics" and why R_k, not r2, is the verdict statistic.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS -- all six must be reported in the manifest, and any one unmet makes
the verdict vacuous rather than negative.
NDP-1 THE COMPRESSION STAGE IS TRAINED. `zworld_p0_episodes > 0` (the SD-070 P0a recipe via
`experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.run_zworld_p0`), with the P0a held-out grounding lift reported
(SD-070 measured +0.23 to +0.47 across four heads / 3 seeds; V3-EXQ-978 measured field r2
0.678 / 0.627 / 0.653). SD-070 is bit-identical-off by construction and appears on NO default agent
path, so without this the site is an untrained random projection and a "not preserved" verdict is
MECH-523's finding restated, not evidence about compression.
NDP-2 IT IS A COMPRESSION, NOT A COLLAPSE AND NOT AN IDENTITY. z_world participation ratio inside the
SD-070 trained band, PR in [4.0, 6.5] (measured 5.19 / 5.41 / 4.64 at world_dim=128, 3 seeds; the
collapsed reference is 1.06; the untrained-random reference is 9.21 / 6.63 / 8.56). At PR ~ 1 the
run measures SD-070's collapse; at PR ~ untrained-random nothing was compressed.
NDP-3 THE CLASS IS DETERMINABLE FROM THE ENCODER'S OWN INPUT. Raw-input ceiling arm held-out accuracy
>= 0.90 (V3-EXQ-1002 measured 0.985 / 0.980 / 0.973 for class 1). A low ceiling means the environment
does not instantiate the distinction -- V3-EXQ-978's "environment too sparse" vacuity, generalised.
NDP-4 THE FLOOR ARM IS PRESENT. Same-capacity adapter on an UNTRAINED z_world projection, so R_k has
a real zero (V3-EXQ-1002 measured 0.688 / 0.681 / 0.695). Elevation over
`max(majority-class, repeat-previous-executed-action)` is reported alongside (measured 0.250 / 0.566
class), because an adapter can clear a floor on a trivial shortcut.
NDP-5 THE ORGANISM-LEVEL DV HAS RESOLUTION. Report the DV quantum and the within-arm seed spread, and
require the claimed effect to exceed one quantum. V3-EXQ-978's arm difference was one third of one
0.05 res/ep quantum, and its within-arm spread was 21x the arm-mean difference -- a null under those
conditions is uninterpretable, not negative.
NDP-6 GOV-MATCHAUX-1 COMPLIANCE ON THE RESTORATION LEG. (i) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control with
equal head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples, targeting learnable but
organism-irrelevant structure, with any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED not silently accepted;
and (ii) evaluation with the auxiliary head REMOVED, scored on downstream organism-level measures,
never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss.
NDP-7 INSTRUMENT HYGIENE, inherited from V3-EXQ-972's disclosed defects. Any cosine/similarity
statistic used as a supporting read must be CENTRED (972's `separability_score` is an uncentred
contrast and its own autopsy states it "does not support the stronger 'there is no structure for any
objective to condition on'"), and must carry a block-shuffle permutation null over stored
`(episode_idx, step_idx)` -- the fix 972's red-team specified and did not build. Without the null,
slow representation drift across an episode block can read as class separation. Any absolute
threshold on such a statistic must be reported as calibrated-or-not; 972's 0.05 floor is
self-described as "a conservative noise floor ... not a rigorously derived value".

CONFIRMING (INV-104 supported for class k) -- all four, on >= 3 of 5 seeds:
(i) DESTRUCTION IS REAL: `R_k <= 0.25` through the trained compression while NDP-3 holds
(ceiling >= 0.90). The step discards most downstream access to a class its own input determines.
(ii) THE LOSSES DO NOT SEE IT -- this is the clause "regardless of reconstruction or prediction
loss", and without it the claim reduces to ordinary representation-learning. Report
`delta world_obs reconstruction loss` and `delta E2 one-step prediction MSE` between the
access-destroyed and access-restored arms and require both to fall within 1 SD of the within-arm
seed spread. If restoring class-k access also visibly improves reconstruction/prediction, the result
is consistent with INV-104 but does not discriminate it from generic representation learning, and
must be reported as non-discriminating.
(iii) RESTORATION PAYS, WITH THE SCAFFOLD REMOVED: training a class-k scaffold and then REMOVING the
head at evaluation raises `R_k` by >= 0.20 absolute AND raises an organism-level DV
(resources/episode against the 1.0 D3 competence floor; secondarily harm_rate) by
>= `max(2 x SD of the seed-matched delta, one DV quantum)`.
(iv) IT IS NOT JUST MORE SUPERVISION: `delta_class-k - delta_matched-arbitrary >= 2 x SD` of the
seed-matched delta on the organism-level DV. Absent (iv) the finding is "extra supervision helps",
which GOV-MATCHAUX-1 rules inadmissible as evidence that an objective ORGANISES a latent.

FALSIFYING -- three independent routes, any one of which is decisive for the class:
F1 VACUITY (falsifies the contract's usefulness, and the claim's own registration text says a null
here is a useful result). `R_k >= 0.75` for every class measurable at this stage, through a
compression trained on generic predictive / reconstruction objectives alone with NO class-specific
pressure. Then generic compression already preserves what the organism needs, the preservation
contract does no work, and pressure to complicate z_world is reduced. This is the cluster's own
red-team 5 and MECH-520's counter-constraint.
F2 NO-COST (falsifies the normative half, and is the sharpest route). Condition (i) holds -- access
IS destroyed -- but restoring it moves no organism-level DV: the delta between access-restored and
access-destroyed arms sits within 1 SD of the within-arm seed spread on >= 4 of 5 seeds, with NDP-5
demonstrated (DV quantum smaller than the claimed effect). Then destroying class k is NOT a
developmental regression, and class k is struck from the preservation list.
F3 SCAFFOLD DEPENDENCE (falsifies the claim's own removability clause on its own instance). The
improvement in (iii) is present with the auxiliary head attached and disappears when it is removed at
evaluation. Per the source thought, that "demonstrated supervision dependence rather than emergence
of a useful world representation".

ONE CONDITIONAL-INTERPRETATION CLAUSE, and it is why the RUN is gated even though this text is
not. If V3-EXQ-1002 returns H-B (a capacity-matched supervised adapter CAN reproduce the
`local_view_greedy` oracle from the frozen z_world, i.e. the consumer never learned the mapping),
then the organism-level leg of (iii)/(iv)/F2 is being read through a reader that cannot use ANY
representation, and F2 is inadmissible -- a flat organism-level DV under H-B is a consumer
finding, not evidence against preservation. Under H-B the falsifier runs through the oracle-adapter
readout rather than the production policy. Under H-C (geometry mismatch) the production readout is
the right one and F2 is admissible. This is MECH-517's ordering dependency, made explicit rather than
assumed away.

claims.claim_title: Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.
claims.falsifier_summary: The decodability inside P_comm X is indistinguishable from the same-rank random-subspace ensemble (the loss is a rank effect, not a routing effect -- route to F3 consumer insensitivity or F1 target absent), or the subspace estimate is unstable across frame or receiver-state strata, which fails the single-subspace premise and hands the question to MECH-547/MECH-555.
claims.required_event: Paired sender-activity and actual consumer-input captures on a live agent over enough held-out blocks that a cross-validated reduced-rank regression can be fitted at the parsimonious rank and a distribution of same-rank random subspaces can be drawn against it.
claims.manipulation: Compare task decodability from three representations of the same captured sender activity: the full sender X, its projection into the cross-validated communication subspace P_comm X, and the orthogonal complement -- with a MULTI-DRAW random same-rank subspace ensemble as the orientation reference, not a single random-rank arm and not a row permutation.

claims.claim_title: Phase as an addressing coordinate: the receiver-potent communication subspace between two REE subsystems is indexed by an ENDOGENOUS CYCLIC coordinate that belongs to neither endpoint -- S_comm(A -> B | phi, c) rather than S_comm(A -> B) -- so a sender dimension can lie INSIDE the receiver-potent subspace at one phase and OUTSIDE it at another with no change whatever in the sender's representation, and information can be continuously decodable from the sender while its downstream causal effect varies systematically with phi. COROLLARY, which is the sharper and more falsifiable half: TEMPORAL separability can substitute for GEOMETRIC separability, so two concurrently represented streams need not be near-orthogonal in population geometry if they become receiver-effective at different temporal addresses -- predicting a measurable trade-off in which the principal angle between two stream subspaces and their phase-conditioned overlap with S_comm move in opposite directions while behavioural intrusion stays flat. FOUR-CELL VERDICT GRID, pre-registered: GEOMETRY-ONLY (angle changes, phase conditioning adds nothing) / TIMING-ONLY (geometry flat, causal impact alternates with phase) / JOINT (both reorganise and jointly predict intrusion) / NULL (neither beats a static consumer model at matched complexity). FALSIFIERS: a static subspace explains receiver activity and behaviour as well as any phase-conditioned model at matched complexity; a global scalar gain explains it without receiver-specific temporal structure; RANDOM temporal labels do as well as the endogenous coordinate; or the dependence disappears after controlling for ordinary task context, action identity, arousal, or trivial periodicity in environment sampling.

claims.claim_title: A reproduced deterministic RECIPE is not a frozen ENDPOINT: re-running a documented training recipe reconstitutes an operating REGIME, which licenses a within-run paired comparison and nothing whatever about the identity of the artifact a PRIOR run measured. Any claim naming a specific earlier endpoint -- "decoded the 1002/1008 latent", "the same frozen encoder", "the banked representation" -- requires that endpoint's weights and observations to have been PERSISTED and LOADED, not re-derived; where they were re-derived, the admissible statement is bounded to the regime ("the consumer-width values fall in the declared band and the participation ratios match"), and the endpoint-identity claim must be withdrawn. The discriminator is mechanical and cheap: a recorded state hash at both endpoints, re-verified at every evaluation boundary, with a mismatch aborting rather than warning. A pinned substrate COMMIT is not a substitute -- it constrains the code that produced the endpoint, never the endpoint's realised weights, which is why a commit-pinned run can and does report substrate_stable_across_run false.

claims.claim_title: objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one. The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.

claims.claim_title: encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.
claims.falsifier_summary: Agreement stays in the 0.72-0.74 band with a verifiably well-trained action head, which routes the failure upstream to encoder capacity or observation content.
claims.required_event: A P0a encoder-warmup pass over buffered rollout states for which the acceptance consumer target (the local_view_greedy oracle action at each state) is available as a label.
claims.manipulation: Add an oracle-action cross-entropy head on the SAME latent during P0a at a weight retaining non-trivial gradient share, against the current P0a objective (preservation, variance hinge, covariance penalty, four grounding CE heads).
claims.control: The GOV-MATCHAUX-1 matched arbitrary-auxiliary arm (experiments/_lib/matched_aux_targets.py, exercised at V3-EXQ-1017) at matched achieved supervision, plus a no-aux arm; the degeneracy pre-check arm is actor_critic_cotrain_encoder with latent participation ratio logged before its DV is read.
claims.DV: Held-out oracle_action_agreement (currently 0.72-0.74, bar 0.85), co-reported with grounding-head held-out lift and preservation R^2.
claims.instrument: The DV and its co-measurements exist -- oracle_action_agreement across the x1002/x1008/x1010/x1023/x1065 lineage, p0a_grounding_label_balance and grounding lift in the P0a block -- but the training-side channel does not: ZWorldP0Trainer.observe() buffers world_obs plus ONE scalar proximity target, run_zworld_p0 types target_fn as returning Optional[float], and the grounding heads derive labels from world_obs alone.
claims.consumer_locus: The encoder objective itself -- gradients into split_encoder.world_encoder during P0a -- read at the frozen-latent acceptance consumer.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The auxiliary head must be demonstrably trained (its own train and held-out accuracy reported) before a null on the DV is read as evidence against the claim, and preservation R^2 must be pinned at or below the V3-EXQ-1023a value of 0.8501 so any agreement gain is not bought with more preservation. The grounding heads held-out lift must be co-reported because z_world is a shared latent.
claims.blocking_reason: The P0a trainer has no categorical target channel: observe() carries world_obs plus one scalar, target_fn is scalar-typed, and ZWorldP0Config has no action-head weight -- so the consumer target cannot enter the objective even though the CE-head machinery, class-balanced weights, held-out lift reporting and oracle labels all exist elsewhere.
false_positives: Reading MECH-567 as blocked substrate would be wrong: every element except the label channel is built, and the missing piece is a label plumb plus one loss weight in an existing trainer, not a new mechanism.
claims.auditor_notes: GFLAG-0387 is open and names MECH-567 as V3-EXQ-1065 pre-registered M1_FALSIFY route, so this claim already has a live governance owner expecting the test.
claims.what_would_answer: CONFIRMING: adding an oracle-action (or reward/RPE) cross-entropy head on the same latent during P0a, at a weight retaining non-trivial gradient share, raises held-out oracle_action_agreement toward the 0.85 bar WHILE preservation R^2 is held at or below its V3-EXQ-1023a value of 0.8501 -- i.e. transfer improves without being bought with more preservation. FALSIFYING: agreement stays in the 0.72-0.74 band even with a well-trained auxiliary action head (the head's own train and held-out accuracy verified high, so the head is not simply untrained); the latent then cannot carry the consumer's target however it is supervised, and the failure routes upstream to encoder capacity or observation content instead of here. MANDATORY CO-MEASUREMENT, not optional: the grounding heads' held-out lift must be reported alongside the DV in any arm, because z_world is a SHARED latent -- SD-106's own note lists SD-015, ARC-030, MECH-117, the EXQ-085h..o cluster, MECH-457 and ARC-065 as consumers -- and an arm that buys the acceptance DV while grounding falls has demonstrated the Poort-2015 entanglement cost, not a win. DEGENERACY PRE-CHECK if the co-train route is taken instead of the auxiliary-head route: REE already owns config.actor_critic_cotrain_encoder (the co-shaping lever, exercised at V3-EXQ-742/752/772/780/788 but never against this DV), and REE has NO policy-improvement operator, so a co-train arm is the predicted degenerate case -- log latent participation ratio under co-training before reading its DV.

claims.claim_title: task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.
claims.falsifier_summary: Held-out agreement is flat in the grounding heads' measured gradient share across the w=50/200/500 ladder -- crowding is real but is not the transfer-limiting step, and MECH-566/MECH-567 are untouched.
claims.required_event: A ZWorldP0Trainer.train() pass at the P0a operating point over buffered world_obs, with the preservation decoder and the grounding classification heads both instantiated.
claims.manipulation: Replace the fixed preservation weight with a saturating free-bits floor -- the preservation term contributes zero gradient once its normalised fraction-of-variance-unexplained falls below a target -- at fixed nominal weight, against the already-run fixed-weight ladder w=50/200/500.
claims.control: The shipped fixed-weight arms (preservation_weight 0/50/200/500) at identical seed, buffer, epochs, head set and step budget; plus a floored arm whose target is set so the floor never binds, as the byte-identical null.
claims.DV: Held-out oracle_action_agreement as a function of the MEASURED per-term gradient-norm share of the grounding/task heads on z_world, with preservation held-out R^2 kept within noise of the floored target.
claims.instrument: Absent at the objective: ZWorldP0Trainer sums all terms into one scalar and records only variance_term/covariance_term values, so no per-term gradient norm is logged. The generic recorder already exists -- shared_latent_gradient_probe returns per-module norm of d(loss)/d(z) plus pairwise cosines -- but nothing wires the P0 terms into it. oracle_action_agreement itself is recorded by V3-EXQ-1002/1023/1065.
claims.consumer_locus: The encoder objective's gradient into the shared world path (z_world), upstream of the oracle/actor consumer -- not the loss decomposition, and not the agreement score read alone.
claims.non_degeneracy_preconditions: The P0a objective must sit in the measured crowding regime: SD-106 preservation head active at a shipped weight, the four SD-070 grounding CE heads present, and at least two terms contributing non-degenerate gradient on z_world. Loss share is not gradient share -- the variance hinge can hold 80 percent of the loss while sitting near its kink and contributing little gradient.
claims.blocking_reason: The falsifier's own prerequisite instrument is unbuilt: per-term gradient-norm shares are never computed at the P0a operating point, and the shipped objective has no saturating-floor form to manipulate (grep for free_bits in ree_core returns nothing). Both are small experiment-layer additions on top of an existing reusable probe.
claims.auditor_notes: shared_latent_gradient_probe was built for MECH-423 R1 readiness and is a pure function -- the measurement half of this falsifier needs no substrate change, only that the P0 loss terms be passed as separate callables on z.
claims.what_would_answer: CONFIRMING: at FIXED preservation weight, making the preservation term contribute no gradient once its normalised fraction-of-variance-unexplained is below a target (the free-bits form) raises held-out oracle_action_agreement while preservation R^2 stays within noise of that floored target. FALSIFYING: agreement is flat in the grounding/task terms' measured GRADIENT share across the w=50/200/500 sweep already run -- crowding is then real but is not the transfer-limiting step, and this claim falls while MECH-566 and MECH-567 are untouched. PREREQUISITE INSTRUMENT, and this claim must not be adjudicated without it: per-term gradient-NORM shares logged at the P0a operating point. The recorded trained-state figures -- variance hinge 80.3%, covariance 9.3%, four grounding CE heads 9.5%, reconstruction 0.80% -- are LOSS shares and do NOT license a gradient-share conclusion, because a term can hold a large loss share while contributing little gradient (a hinge sitting near its kink is exactly this case, and the variance term IS a hinge). Measuring that is cheap, requires no substrate change, and is the honest first step; if the grounding heads already hold a large gradient share, this claim is weakened before anything is built.
